jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• Payroll, Time, Benefits Specialist
• Position summary
The Payroll, Time & Benefits Team focuses on payroll, benefits, absence management, customer service and advisory support to employees, manager and business partners ensuring end-to-end process completion in line with customer focused principles to ensure the Roche People Practices work for the business.
As a Payroll, Time & Benefits Specialist, you are responsible for executing HR system data maintenance and administrative activities in a timely and accurate manner, in support of P&C business processes in the area of payroll, tax, social insurance, time, and several local and global benefits. etc. You are also contributing to the continuous improvement of the P&C People Support Solutions delivery through analysis of the interactions and collaboration with other P&C functions within and outside of P&C People Support Solutions. You need a broad understanding across local HR processes and tools, as well as local and global downstream impacts on employee lifecycle management, finance, procurement, IT, etc. This is coupled with strong customer focus, communication skills and solution orientation.

Responsibilities
● Service Delivery
○ Execute system data maintenance and administrative activities in support of P&C business processes in the area of payroll, tax, social insurance, time, several local and global benefits administration, etc. (details refer to the country service catalog)
• ○ Provide customer service on pay, time and benefits related activities, such as inquiry resolution, request management, and troubleshooting.
• ○ Understand and have working knowledge of local time/absence policies. ○ Correspondence with managers and leaders to confirm accuracy of employee time/absence entry.
• ○ Manage, process and reconcile mass upload files for all pay frequencies. ○ Monitor data flows to/from Workday to Vendor for accuracy
• ○ Ensure integrations are processed timely and resolve any errors ensuring accurately processed
• ○ Ensure regulatory compliance in line with the countries, customers, and regulations.
• ○ Develop and manage key stakeholder relationships and communications to partner in a proactive and customer outcomes focused way.
• ○ Supports P&C Chapters in system maintenance activities.
• ○ Provide guidance and advisory to first level P&C support teams.
• ○ Be up to date on processes, own the knowledge development on processes, and contribute to the update of relevant documentations (KA, SWIs).
• ○ Participating in project activities as required
• ○ Ensure consistent and reliable service delivery for customers serviced.
• ○ Implement processes and initiatives to ensure continuous improvement as well as service enhancement.
• ○ Ensure end to end ownership of resolution
• ○ Ensure operations according to defined KPIs and ServiceNow OKRs. ○ Support country non-PTB activities upon the business needs if applicable.

● Cross-Functional Collaboration
• ○ Build relationships with P&C colleagues as well as with customers to ensure ongoing service delivery effectiveness.
• ○ Collaborate with peers within the region and globally to ensure the People Support Solutions network provides consistent and effective services to our customers.
• ○ Achieve our P&C vision by driving local consistency through collaboration.

● Outputs & Deliverables
• ○ Continuous contribution to the improvement of the performance of People Support Solutions
• ○ Reaching high customer satisfaction through consistent, high quality delivery and application of customer care principl

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Device Development department within Roche Technical Development is responsible for the development and support of drug delivery devices for the product portfolio. Our activities span a range of engineering disciplines from the requirements definition phase through to commercialization and marketed product support.

The Device Engineering section combines design, engineering, testing, and manufacturing to develop reliable and safe drug delivery devices that meet the needs of patients, healthcare providers and Health Authorities.

The opportunity:

In this role, you will engage in extensive cross-functional collaboration, particularly with Quality Assurance (QA), Regulatory Affairs, Clinical, and Commercial teams. Additionally, you will take on strategic responsibilities and contribute to efforts led by the Device Engineering leadership team.
This role reports to the Section Head of Device Engineering and is integrated into the Roche Device Development function.

• Act as project leader / team leader / technical expert to successfully bring combination products and medical devices to the market

• Evaluation of new and breakthrough technologies. Application of theoretical engineering knowledge, to establish robust technical product requirements, and develop engineering design solutions to assure devices maintain the required level of performance throughout the life of the product

• Author design control documentation (Design Development Plans, User Requirements Specifications, Design Inputs, Design Outputs, Design Verification Plans and DHF creation/maintenance DHF), conformity assessments and risk management documentation.

• Forecast and plan resource demands for device development projects. Execute projects within the agreed time, quality and cost constraints, resulting in state-of–the-art drug delivery devices

• Apply knowledge of the regulatory landscape to ensure standard compliant designs (e.g. ISO 13485, 21CFR820, ISO14971 and 21 CFR 820.30)

Who you are:

• You have university level education (engineering degree or related discipline).

• You have a minimum 10-year proven track record in mechanical engineering and drug delivery device development with experience in pharma or other closely-regulated environments, under current Good Practice (cGxP), Quality System Regulation (QSR), or similar working practices.

• You have hands-on Pen injector / Auto injector development expertise.

• You have sound knowledge of legislation, regulation, industry standards, and guidance within the area of combination products and medical devices.

• You have experience with Health Authority interactions.

• You have demonstrable knowledge of drug delivery devices, parenteral drug delivery, risk assessment, tolerance analysis, statistical techniques, process capability, manufacturing processes, and reliability engineering.

• You possess excellent documentation, presentation, interpersonal communication skills and strategic thinking.

• You have an excellent command of the English language; proficiency in German is preferable.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Business Architect, you will define and maintain the architectural vision and strategy for the Roche organization, ensuring alignment with business goals and supporting the adoption and implementation of Roche’s Reference Architecture. Acting as the authority and guardian of the Reference Architecture, you will create comprehensive solutions, promote best practices, and ensure architecture components and building blocks are reusable, scalable, and align with established standards. Through collaboration across the organization, you will lead efforts to integrate applications and systems effectively, drive innovation, and uphold the architectural integrity of Roche's customer-facing products. Furthermore, you will play a key role in advancing Roche’s common platform strategy by contributing to its scalability, reliability, interoperability, and alignment with the needs of digital medical products and engineering teams.
Your tasks and Responsibilities

• Architectural Guardianship: Define and maintain the Architecture roadmap and Reference Architecture, ensuring all solutions are scalable, reliable, and aligned with the Roche Ecosystem strategy.

• Strategy & Integration: Lead the delivery of actionable technology strategies and blueprints, guiding the integration of applications using standard building blocks and reusable components.

• Platform Leadership: Drive "platform-first" approaches, identifying technical gaps and developing innovative solutions for data interoperability and event-driven frameworks.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with Engineers, Product Managers, and Sales/Medical teams to support strategic outcomes and ensure consistent technological implementation across customer-facing products.

• Quality & Risk Management: Analyze non-functional requirements (security, performance, scalability) and establish governance to reduce duplication and improve system robustness.

Who you are

• Education & Experience: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering, with at least 10+ years of experience in business/reference architecture and shared platform strategies.

• Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of platform strategies, architectural governance, APIs, and shared services models. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and frameworks like TOGAF or SAFe is highly valued.

• Sector Knowledge: Familiarity with healthcare standards such as FHIR and HL7 , along with expertise in compliance-based design and industry regulations.

• Soft Skills: Advanced consulting and communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate in cross-functional, global environments and translate business goals into technical roadmaps.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Toxicology Project Leader
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Toxicology Project Leader

The position is within the toxicology group in Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) and located at China Innovation Center of Roche (CICoR). This group leads in the development of the non-clinical safety assessment of drug candidates during the discovery and development phases at Roche.

Your responsibilities are:
· Developing and executing high quality, timely, integrated and scientifically sound nonclinical safety strategies from target assessment through discovery and global clinical development.
· Representing the toxicology function on multi-functional project teams and acting as a key contributor to the selection and development of potential new medicines through close interactions with other functions such as DMPK, biology, CMC and clinical development.
· Generating concise safety assessments and leading efforts of investigating mechanisms of toxicity for internal decision making, accountable for result analysis and interpretation, trouble shooting, as well as contributing to protocol/report of safety studies and related documentation.
• · Developing and optimizing immunosafety and immunogenicity assay strategies to characterize candidate molecules
• · Managing assay outsourcing to local and global CROs and develop/troubleshoot mechanistic immunosafety and immunogenicity assays in house where needed
• · Collaborating with global subject matter experts (SMEs) and external partners to provide relevant immunosafety and immunogenicity input locally where needed and act as local SME

In addition, you are expected to:
• · Live the culture of humility, curiosity, and responsibility
• · Embrace agile ways of working and collaborative spirit
• · Aim for scientific excellence, embrace innovation and utilize emerging technologies to support risk assessments with continuous learning
· Expand scientific visibility and maintain effective interactions with internal and external collaborators, and contribute to scientific advancements in the toxicology and immunosafety/immunogenicity field

Profile:
You have a Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM), PhD (immunology/toxicology or pharmacology preferred) or equivalent and >1 year of post-doc/working experience in relevant immunology/toxicology areas. Large molecule toxicology and immunosafety/immunogenicity experience is preferred. Good knowledge of toxicology including common safety assessment strategy and technology. Strong interpersonal skills and team player. Good organizational and multi-tasking abilities. Good English communication and presentation skills.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• 3-years experience in a centralized purchasing environment and Supply Chain with production planning background.

• Experience of working in a shared service center across a global / large organization will be an added advantage.

titleByLocale.it: Coach per la costruzione di capacità

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharmaceuticals

Role Purpose

• Build and enhance commercialization capabilities, ensuring alignment with Taiwan Pharma Ambition and boosting ecosystem mastery for customer-facing roles.

• Address skill gaps through coaching, insights, and learning programs, driving improved performance and patient value delivery.

• Support affiliate-wide excellence by connecting global best practices and fostering capability-driven strategies across all commercial functions.

Role scope:

• Lead commercialization capability learning programs, ensuring direct alignment with Pharma International’s overall business strategy and connecting with Taiwan Pharma Ambition.

• Translate global standards into local actionable roadmaps that ensure every PJP and partner has a clear path from foundational skills to advanced ecosystem mastery.

• Act as a strategic partner with PJS cluster leads and PJP team leads to identify key skill gaps and provide data-driven insights to improve individual and ecosystem-wide performance.

• Provide field coaching and timely feedback on customer engagement to remove roadblocks and unlock value for patients.

• Responsible for design and implement necessary trainings and connect internal / external resources

• Collaborate with Agile Coach to foster Working by Outcome realization at the affiliate level and facilitate key rituals like Impact Retrospectives to translate learnings and insights into business strategies.

• Partner with the Taiwan leadership team and chapter leaders to focus on capability building, ensuring end-to-end excellence across all commercialization functions.

• Serve as the Primary Subject Matter Expert and central point of contact for functional commercialization capability needs for Taiwan Pharma.

• Connect across APAC, Pharma International, and the extended global network to support ACE realization and share best practices across borders.

Requirements:
Qualifications:
Education:

• University degree (scientific, economic, or business degree). An advanced degree in Life science and/or MBA is a plus.

Working Experience:

• At least 8+ years work experience in commercial functions in the pharmaceutical industry.

• Strong business acumen with desired expertise in commercialization, medical and customer experience excellence

• Solid experience in commercialization roles, such as Marketing, Sales, Medical, or Digital, with the ability to act as a credible coach for senior stakeholders

• Experienced in in-house training design, capability building, L&D, or Organizational Development within a complex, matrixed environment is a plus

Competencies:

• Strong strategic thinking and program/system design skills

• Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to engage, inspire and influence stakeholders at all levels.

• Innovative mindset with a continuous improvement approach to learning and development practices.

• Excellent facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to influence and inspire teams without formal authority.

• Fast-learner, good digital fluency with the ability to leverage AI tools, data analytics, and modern learning platforms to enhance learning experience.

• Fluent in the local language. Proficient in English to collaborate internally across the broader Roche enterprise is highly desired

jobs.title: IT Workplace Experience Expert

titleByLocale.it: Esperto di esperienza sul posto di lavoro IT

jobs.description:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality.

The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here .

Here's what we're looking for:

We’re seeking an innovative and proactive IT Workplace Experience Expert
who can empower employees with the tools, resources, and knowledge they need to do their jobs effectively and reach their full potential. You continuously evaluate and improve the employee experience through subject matter expertise in the digital workplace, focusing on efficiency, employee satisfaction and ensuring business continuity. This is a varied role and can give you a springboard into other careers in Informatics and beyond. Within this position you will frequently travel between our 2 affiliates in Vienna.

Your upcoming mission:

• Providing technical consultancy for enterprise and business applications to business colleagues

• Adoption and Training to foster digital enablement

• Providing consultancy for specific groups and work with them how to leverage the existing tool for their benefit

• Proactively approaching business functions to understand their processes and suggest methods to increase productivity

• Increasing the adoption of IT services and solutions by promoting the use and features of IT services to connect end users with the appropriate tool for the job.

• Embracing agility through process automation and increased focus on stakeholder management and digital employee experience

• Keeping track of what changes are coming in the enterprise platforms and solutions and analyzing how it can affect employee productivity

• Automating business processes based on analysis and consultancy with business representatives

• Act as a digital enabler for our business colleagues & functions

• Act as the owner of the digital employee experience for the respective site

• Drive employee productivity through consultancy, provide intimacy and site proximity at the sites, and ensure a personalized Roche employee experience.

• Leverage available data (e.g.: Nexthink, SNOW) for proactive support

• Support and manage the Incident/ Request management processes to ensure SLA's are met and drive continuous improvement through trend analysis.

• Manage IT hardware lifecycle management & deskside support processes/managed services for the site

• Provide support & guidance for onsite services (e.g. events and meetings) by leveraging from internal and external providers. Drive the user experience and promote best practice.

• Drive and enable standard workplace infrastructure, global/local projects and deployments in collaboration with product teams.

• Proactively address and follow through on process-improvement ideas

• Support & drive budgeting process related to the respective site

• Support local audit, inspection and certification requirements

• Support local Business Continuity and IT Disaster Recovery planning activities

• Partner with our internal and external service providers

Essential skills for your mission:

• Manage risks progressively and in a way that leads to opportunity

• Lean-Agile & Enterprise mindset that can break down silos. Focus on delivery through collaboration, and bringing people together to work towards the same purpose across organizational boundaries

• Intellectual curiosity and integrity and has a strong passion for innovation

• Understanding of Roche-supported operating systems, devices and applications, including the Google Suite of Applications

• Experience with ticketing systems and troubleshooting hardwar

Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality.

The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here .

Here's what we're looking for:

We’re seeking an innovative and proactive IT Workplace Experience Expert
who can empower employees with the tools, resources, and knowledge they need to do their jobs effectively and reach their full potential. You continuously evaluate and improve the employee experience through subject matter expertise in the digital workplace, focusing on efficiency, employee satisfaction and ensuring business continuity. This is a varied role and can give you a springboard into other careers in Informatics and beyond. Within this position you will frequently travel between our 2 affiliates in Vienna.

Your upcoming mission:

• Providing technical consultancy for enterprise and business applications to business colleagues

• Adoption and Training to foster digital enablement

• Providing consultancy for specific groups and work with them how to leverage the existing tool for their benefit

• Proactively approaching business functions to understand their processes and suggest methods to increase productivity

• Increasing the adoption of IT services and solutions by promoting the use and features of IT services to connect end users with the appropriate tool for the job.

• Embracing agility through process automation and increased focus on stakeholder management and digital employee experience

• Keeping track of what changes are coming in the enterprise platforms and solutions and analyzing how it can affect employee productivity

• Automating business processes based on analysis and consultancy with business representatives

• Act as a digital enabler for our business colleagues & functions

• Act as the owner of the digital employee experience for the respective site

• Drive employee productivity through consultancy, provide intimacy and site proximity at the sites, and ensure a personalized Roche employee experience.

• Leverage available data (e.g.: Nexthink, SNOW) for proactive support

• Support and manage the Incident/ Request management processes to ensure SLA's are met and drive continuous improvement through trend analysis.

• Manage IT hardware lifecycle management & deskside support processes/managed services for the site

• Provide support & guidance for onsite services (e.g. events and meetings) by leveraging from internal and external providers. Drive the user experience and promote best practice.

• Drive and enable standard workplace infrastructure, global/local projects and deployments in collaboration with product teams.

• Proactively address and follow through on process-improvement ideas

• Support & drive budgeting process related to the respective site

• Support local audit, inspection and certification requirements

• Support local Business Continuity and IT Disaster Recovery planning activities

• Partner with our internal and external service providers

Essential skills for your mission:

• Manage risks progressively and in a way that leads to opportunity

• Lean-Agile & Enterprise mindset that can break down silos. Focus on delivery through collaboration, and bringing people together to work towards the same purpose across organizational boundaries

• Intellectual curiosity and integrity and has a strong passion for innovation

• Understanding of Roche-supported operating systems, devices and applications, including the Google Suite of Applications

• Experience with ticketing systems and troubleshooting hardwar

jobs.title: Head of Planning
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
1. Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)

Work out Production Plan, Capacity Plan, Resource Plan and Material Requirement Plan to meet sales requirement as well as to control inventory within reasonable level. Continuous enhancement of Integrated Production Plan to consolidate and reconcile all site activities plus downtimes meanwhile to maximize capacity/facility utilization at a consistent level.
制定生产/产能/资源计划和物料需求计划以满足销售需求并将库存控制在合理的水平。持续改善整合生产计划，整合并协调厂区的各种活动以及停产时间，于此同时实现产能/设备利用率的持续性和最大化。

2. Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities

1. Take overall charge of PT Shanghai Budget process, get alignment with cross functional teams to ensure the maximum capacity utilization with reasonable inventory level and acceptable period cost; Act as China SPOC to ensure a timely and accurate budget publication as well as to clarify all the details with Global.

2. Be responsible for site production capacity plan and resource plan, which are the baseline for site budget and Headcount plan; Be responsible for site Master Production Schedule and Daily Production Schedule with all the factors into consideration including sales demand, production capacity, inventory level, etc.

3. Take care of Material Requirement Plan for packaging material and excipient, ensure sufficient material supplies to support consistent production without any shortage.

4. Monitor the procedure of procurement, delivery, production, testing, releasing and deviation etc. Assess business impact for major variance beyond tolerance and lead cross-functional coordination for action plans when necessary to meet sales demand on time.

5. Coordinate with involved stake holders to integrate all necessary site activities and projects so as to maximize capacity/facility utilization as well as to minimize any negative impact to production.

6. Closely cooperate with regional & global demand/supply planners and PSCO to exchange the latest production data and information as well as to obtain necessary support and resource for PT Shanghai.

7. Be responsible for CMO products supply plan including DS/DP replenishment coordination; Be responsible for CMO finish goods, DS inventory level management.

8. Lead production and material planning team, coach and develop subordinates.

3. Qualification and Experience

Education/
• Qualifications
l Degree Holder

Leadership Competencies
l Good management & influencing skill to coach, engage and motivate subordinates to realize their potential so as to meet expectation from both business growth and individual development.

Job Required Competencies
l Above 10 years working experience (more than 8 years in production planning preferred)
l Familiar with SAP system (PP&MM modules, APO)
l With good English (CET6) and skillful operation of computer
l Good interpersonal skill
l Good analytical and expressive skill
l Good at communication, cross-functional cooperation and ability of adaptability

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future,

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As the most senior member in the team, set strategy and priorities for the team, allocate resources accordingly, provide coaching and mentorship to the team members and represent the team internally and externally or otherwise delegate as appropriate.
Orchestrate and oversee pre-launch registration strategies and lead the co-creation of launch readiness in collaboration with respective pods
Oversee and manage all Regulatory Affairs work of the Affiliate; oversee external parties, such as distributors, agents, etc. if applicable.
Drive continuous process optimization in the Regulatory Affairs area, with an aim to improve efficiency as well as compliance
Engage Health Authorities, government bodies, as well as pharmaceutical industry associations in shaping regulatory policies and environment towards continuous improvement in addressing unmet medical needs for patients.
All Roche employees are expected to practice high standards of compliance with both external and internal policies and regulations as well as participate and be involved in SHE initiatives within the Company.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

• Regulatory Strategy & Influence: Develop and implement innovative, risk-based regulatory strategies for all affiliate products to accelerate access, and lead/influence the development of global regulatory strategies, considering local regulations and business needs.

• Filings and Submissions: Lead strategic oversight of all regulatory filing activities across product life cycles, ensuring timely regulatory submissions and approvals for new products, line extensions, and maintenance updates, aligned with commercial and supply continuity.

• Stakeholder Relations: Build trusted partnerships by leading contacts and negotiations with local Healthcare Authorities (HAs) and internal stakeholders, influencing for successful regulatory outcomes, and communicating filing statuses.

• Regulatory Compliance & Inspection Readiness: Ensure all Affiliate regulatory activities comply with Roche global standards and local regulations, maintain current knowledge of practices and standards, and ensure the Affiliate is prepared for regulatory inspections and audits.

• Leadership and Team Management: As the senior team member, set the team's strategy and priorities, allocate resources, provide coaching and mentorship, and assist in recruiting and retaining talent.

• Regulatory Intelligence and Policy Shaping: Own the gathering and dissemination of regulatory intelligence for the Affiliate, and actively shape the regulatory environment through leadership roles in industry associations.

• Product and Documentation Support: Oversee end-to-end local product packaging and labeling, act as the Company Pharmacist for specific compliance (e.g., Poison/Psychotropic License), support local market access, and ensure affiliate regulatory documentation is maintained and archived compliantly.

Requirements:

• Experience: Minimum of 5 years in a regulatory affairs role within a pharmaceutical environment.

• Training: Trained in Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) and Good Distribution Practice (GDP) requirements for pharmaceuticals.

• Education and Accreditation: Possesses a Degree in Pharmacy, accredited by the relevant authority with the Ministry of Health, Malaysia, and is eligible to hold necessary pharmaceutical licenses.

• Regulatory Knowledge: Knowledgeable in pharmaceutical regulations and registration requirements in Malaysia.

• Language and Computer Skills: Fluent in w

• Regulatory Strategy & Influence: Develop and implement innovative, risk-based regulatory strategies for all affiliate products to accelerate access, and lead/influence the development of global regulatory strategies, considering local regulations and business needs.

• Product and Documentation Support: Oversee end-to-end local product packaging and labeling, act as the Company Pharmacist for specific compliance (e.g., Poison/Psychotropic License), support local market access, and ensure affiliate regulatory documentation is maintained and archived compliantly.

• Experience: Minimum of 5 years in a regulatory affairs role within a pharmaceutical environment.

• Training: Trained in Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) and Good Distribution Practice (GDP) requirements for pharmaceuticals.

• Education and Accreditation: Possesses a Degree in Pharmacy, accredited by the relevant authority with the Ministry of Health, Malaysia, and is eligible to hold necessary pharmaceutical licenses.

• Regulatory Knowledge: Knowledgeable in pharmaceutical regulations and registration requirements in Malaysia.

• Language and Computer Skills: Fluent in w

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche aims to be an innovation accelerator in China, collaborating with partners to jointly develop and deliver novel therapies for patients across the world. This effort is designed to expand and deepen their collective impact on patient health.

The global I2CVRM Search & Evaluation (S&E) team, a component of Corporate Business Development (CBD), is focused on identifying and securing external innovation opportunities that strategically align with the Immunology & Infectious Diseases (I2) and Cardiovascular, Renal, and Metabolism (CVRM) Therapeutic Areas (TAs).
This involves active engagement with the external innovation community, including academic institutions, venture capital firms, Roche Accelerator, KoL, PI and the startup biotech ecosystem.
The S&E team works collaboratively with internal teams (e.g. Asian partnering team) to advance opportunities from initial identification and incubation through to pre-due diligence. A key function is translating the I2CVRM TA's end-to-end strategy (DAS) into regional sourcing and activation plans designed to bring high-impact science into our pipeline.

We are looking to partner with pharma and biotech in China. Currently, the global I2CVRM S&E team has one Search and Evaluation China Strategy Lead CVRM opportunity available in Shanghai .

The Opportunity

The CVRM S&E China Strategy Lead will be responsible for proactively shaping and nurturing key relationships and stakeholders (prioritized academic research centers, Roche accelerator, venture capital investors, life science and health technology incubators and start-ups) to ensure Roche is perceived as a “Partner of Choice” in their respective regions. This leader will also work closely with the global S&E I2CVRM team & local Asian partnering team, to scout, triage and conduct early evaluations activities to understand the true value of further pursuit through provision of scientific expertise.

This role reports to the Global Head I2CVRM S&E who is based in Basel (CH).

Responsibilities will include, but will not be limited to the following:

• External Search: to cover the China CVRM landscape, to partner closely with the Global S&E Head to set the sourcing strategy and engagement plan aligned with the TA end to end strategy & CBD priorities

• To lead the triage process and work closely with TA partners and CBD colleagues to conduct initial evaluations and ensure alignment with our strategic focus. To provide scientific thought leadership and analysis in initial scientific review.

• The S&E China CVRM Strategy Lead will maintain overall oversight of S&E CVRM activities in China, with the autonomy to delegate specific landscaping, scouting or evaluation tasks to CBD team members (e.g. BDPLs from Asia partnering team) as appropriate.

• Building close relationships with relevant Roche & Genentech businesses. This is to both understand/contribute to strategy/requirements and to develop sufficient influence in order to champion new opportunities, including those that are potentially “off strategy” but where a compelling business case can be made.

• Supports the transition of identified opportunities to the Due Diligence phase via collaboration and transfer of background and scientific context to a BDPL

• Serves as an ambassador for CBD internally and externally at industry events

• The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list, and you may be required to undertake any other reasonable duties compatible with your experience and competencies.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责/责任
(Major functions of the position) （职位的首要职能）
1、 依据抗感染市场策略、行业发展及数据分析，结合内外部资源，制定重点客户发展策略，并与重点客户达成长期战略合作，完成业务目标

• 结合抗感染市场策略、零售药店行业发展趋势，设计重点客户管理体系与模式，制定重点客户发展策略，与多家全国性连锁达成战略合作

• 深入洞察客户发展策略及方向，分析与我司的切入点和双方特点，进行框架协议谈判、战略合作评估、销售目标制定、投资计划制定等

• 同客户共建业务跟进管理机制，实施中不断优化，最大化投入产出比，推动业务持续向前发展

2、制定速福达在重点客户的联合发展计划，作为重点客户全国合作的全面对接人，整合内外部资源，将联合发展计划落实

• 与重点客户全国总部共同制定联合发展计划，结合客户特点，设计以推动业务为目的的合作项目

• 结合总部推动和重点分部共同合作的方式，推动项目高质量落地

• 协助重点客户进行关键分子公司和旗舰门店的推广管理

3、与内部相关团队及生态圈内跨团队建立良好的沟通与联动合作机制，最大化公司业务目标

• 积极配合市场部执行公司在零售端的品牌策略，扩大目标产品在C端知晓度

• 保持与医院销售相关团队的密切合作，探索院内外联动机制，推动业务增长

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.
Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) is the organization that manufactures and delivers Roche’s groundbreaking therapies to 127 million patients around the world. PT is involved in producing every Roche medicine – from the development process through clinical trials – and continuing to product maturity. Our organization coordinates all aspects of production of Roche medicines in all disease areas and dosage forms.

Pharma Technical Development (PTD) is integral to Roche’s mission to develop innovative and transformative meaningful medicines for patients by applying leading technical expertise to design, develop, supply, and register clinical stage products globally.
Within PTD, Synthetic Molecules Technical Development (PTDC) leverages advanced science and technology to drive the development of synthetic molecules from first-in-human studies through commercialization. Based in Basel, Switzerland, our team of approximately 700 experts works collaboratively to bring our vision to life, delivering impactful solutions that support our mission and uphold our core values.

The Opportunity

In the position as Head of Pharmaceutical R&D , you will be accountable for consistently and effectively:

• Lead Pharmaceutical R&D by driving scientific excellence in solid-state sciences, formulation development, and drug delivery technologies.

• Develop robust, scalable manufacturing processes for clinical and commercial drug products, ensuring efficiency and regulatory compliance.

• Innovate and implement new technologies in pharmaceutical development, including digital solutions, predictive modeling, and automation.

• Ensure regulatory readiness for global health authorities, leading efforts in compliance, GMP standards, and Pre-Approval Inspections (PAI).

• Collaborate cross-functionally with research, process development, quality, and regulatory teams to streamline product development.

• Oversee clinical supply manufacturing, ensuring quality, efficiency, and on-time delivery of drug products for global trials.

• Build, mentor, and inspire high-performing teams, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.

• Partner with external and internal stakeholders, including launch sites, contract manufacturers, and industry leaders, to enhance product development.

• Embed operational excellence and digital transformation, shifting from reactive problem-solving to predictive, data-driven decision-making.

Who You Are:

• Extensive experience in pharmaceutical development for Synthetic Molecules, including cross-functional team leadership and end-to-end process expertise.

• Extensive knowledge and experience in multiple facets of technical development with sound judgment and decision making framework

• Outstanding knowledge of regulatory guidelines and standards for pharmaceutical process development and manufacturing and cGMP and SHE requirements practices

• Consistent track record of developing diverse, high performing organizations and teams with high standards for scientific excellence, driving innovation and operational effectiveness

• Skilled in managing complex stakeholder relationships, leading transformative initiatives, and ensuring rapid, high-impact decision-making.

• Strong business acumen, with the ability to proactively identify and resolve issues that influence business direction and drive changes within the industry or discipline.

• Strategic thinking an

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.
Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) is the organization that manufactures and delivers Roche’s groundbreaking therapies to 127 million patients around the world. PT is involved in producing every Roche medicine – from the development process through clinical trials – and continuing to product maturity. Our organization coordinates all aspects of production of Roche medicines in all disease areas and dosage forms.

Pharma Technical Development (PTD) is integral to Roche’s mission to develop innovative and transformative meaningful medicines for patients by applying leading technical expertise to design, develop, supply, and register clinical stage products globally.
Within PTD, Synthetic Molecules Technical Development (PTDC) leverages advanced science and technology to drive the development of synthetic molecules from first-in-human studies through commercialization. Based in Basel, Switzerland, our team of approximately 700 experts works collaboratively to bring our vision to life, delivering impactful solutions that support our mission and uphold our core values.

The Opportunity

In the position as Head of Pharmaceutical R&D , you will be accountable for consistently and effectively:

• Lead Pharmaceutical R&D by driving scientific excellence in solid-state sciences, formulation development, and drug delivery technologies.

• Develop robust, scalable manufacturing processes for clinical and commercial drug products, ensuring efficiency and regulatory compliance.

• Innovate and implement new technologies in pharmaceutical development, including digital solutions, predictive modeling, and automation.

• Ensure regulatory readiness for global health authorities, leading efforts in compliance, GMP standards, and Pre-Approval Inspections (PAI).

• Collaborate cross-functionally with research, process development, quality, and regulatory teams to streamline product development.

• Oversee clinical supply manufacturing, ensuring quality, efficiency, and on-time delivery of drug products for global trials.

• Build, mentor, and inspire high-performing teams, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.

• Partner with external and internal stakeholders, including launch sites, contract manufacturers, and industry leaders, to enhance product development.

• Embed operational excellence and digital transformation, shifting from reactive problem-solving to predictive, data-driven decision-making.

Who You Are:

• Extensive experience in pharmaceutical development for Synthetic Molecules, including cross-functional team leadership and end-to-end process expertise.

• Extensive knowledge and experience in multiple facets of technical development with sound judgment and decision making framework

• Outstanding knowledge of regulatory guidelines and standards for pharmaceutical process development and manufacturing and cGMP and SHE requirements practices

• Consistent track record of developing diverse, high performing organizations and teams with high standards for scientific excellence, driving innovation and operational effectiveness

• Skilled in managing complex stakeholder relationships, leading transformative initiatives, and ensuring rapid, high-impact decision-making.

• Strong business acumen, with the ability to proactively identify and resolve issues that influence business direction and drive changes within the industry or discipline.

• Strategic thinking an

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, over 95,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity, and diversity. We believe every employee makes a difference. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives. We are courageous in both decision and action; we believe that good business means a better world. And as Roche Services & Solutions Network (RSS) we are fully committed to enabling our Roche Network to transform the way they operate to ultimately focus on patients and deliver what patients need next.

The Opportunity
As an External Engagement Coordinator – Grants, Sponsorships and Donations Specialist , you bring expertise in operational management and compliance to ensure the effective handling of Grants, Sponsorships, and Donations (GS&D) requests initiated by Roche R&D Networks and Roche Global Congress Teams.
You act as a gatekeeper and facilitator, ensuring that all financial and non-financial contributions to Healthcare Organizations (HCOs) and Patient Groups (PGs) align with Roche’s compliance principles, adhere to local laws, and meet internal financial reporting standards. This includes upholding international regulations, such as EFPIA standards for sponsorships, and ensuring full transparency in the management and documentation of grants and donations.
While the business retains overall accountability, your role ensures that every transaction is ethically vetted, medically justified, and audit-ready.
You oversee the full GS&D process end-to-end, managing the operational workflow in partnership with relevant Roche Networks. This includes intake, documentation gathering, milestone tracking, final closure, and evidence collection to maintain the highest compliance standards.

• Compliance Expertise and Advisory: Provide independent, expert healthcare compliance advice to senior leaders and ensure adherence to global and local regulations throughout the external engagement process.

• End-to-End Compliance Management: Manage the end-to-end compliance process for HCP/HCO, patient engagements, and GSD management, including accurate FMV calculation, compliant ToV transfers, and reconciliation of POs, invoices, and payments to ensure timely and accurate execution.

• Global Coordination & Reporting: Collaborate with global pharma compliance offices and affiliates to determine FMV, hospitality restrictions, and gain approvals, while ensuring timely and compliant submission of Actual Spend Reports in coordination with PCO.

• Travel & Logistics Execution: Execute travel and logistics activities as needed to support engagement processes.

• Customer Service & Engagement: Deliver high-quality customer service by responding to complex compliance-related queries, guiding stakeholders, tracking engagement processes, and ensuring timely, high-quality execution.

• Process Development & Continuous Improvement: Partner with Compliance and Procurement Leads to develop new processes, tools, or resources, scale up team capabilities, and address deviations and CAPAs with the Global Compliance Senior Leader.

• Inspection & Audit Readiness: Support the preparation of documentation for inspections and audits, ensuring compliance and readiness.

Who You Are

• Educational and Professional Requirements: Bachelor’s degree is mandatory, with 5+ years of experience in Customer Relations Management, Finance, Procurement, Event Ma

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Foodlicious ist unser Tagesgeschäft
Aus der Taverne Roche ist in über 30 Jahren ein erfolgreiches Gastronomieunternehmen im Bereich der Gemeinschaftsgastronomie entstanden. Die Tavero AG ist eine 100% Tochtergesellschaft der F. Hoffmann-La Roche. An den Standorten Basel und Kaiseraugst beschäftigen wir rund 350 Mitarbeitende aus über 41 Nationen.
Unser Angebot umfasst sowohl Staff Restaurants, die vielfältigen Genuss bieten, als auch Fine Dining Restaurants mit gehobener Küche und exzellentem Service. Darüber hinaus gibt es Restaurants mit Köstlichkeiten aus aller Welt, Kaffee in allen Varianten, gezaubert von unseren Baristi, sowie die höchstgelegenen Lounges der Schweiz – traumhafte Afterwork-Spots über den Dächern der Stadt. Grab'n'Go-Angebote von Sushi bis Burger und der erste und einzige Club in der Geschichte von Roche ergänzen unser Angebot.
Zusätzlich bieten wir unseren Gästen Sitzungszimmer- und Eventcatering für bis zu 1.500 Personen an. Die öffentlichen Gastronomien, das Schöpfli im Park und das Chez Jeannot im Museum Tinguely, runden unser Angebot ab.

Wir suchen per sofort eine:n Mitarbeitende:n für unsere Cafeteria in Kaiseraugst AG.

Aufgaben:

• Korrekte Auskunft über das Angebot sowie aktiver Verkauf und attraktive Warenpräsentation, Vorbereitungsarbeiten in der Cafeteria

• Entgegenkommen bei Sonderwünschen

• Verantwortlich für korrekte und attraktive Ausgabe von Speisen und Getränken am Buffet und einen reibungslosen Ablauf aller Servicestationen (Buffet, Kasse, Ausgabe und Office)

• Bedienung an der Kasse inkl. korrekte Erfassung des Angebots sowie Abrechnung

• Mitverantwortlich für die täglichen Bestellungen

• Einhaltung der Vorschriften zu Lebensmittelhygiene und Qualitätsvorschriften, Umsetzen aller TQM-Vorgaben

• Durchführung von Reinigungsarbeiten einschließlich Grundreinigung

• Einsatzbereitschaft von MO-FR zwischen 6.00-19.30 Uhr

• Einsatzbereitschaft in verschiedenen Abteilungen sowie bei Sondereinsätzen ausserhalb der üblichen Arbeitszeiten zu arbeiten

Profil:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung in der Gastronomie und/oder Hotel von Vorteil

• Mehrjährige Arbeitserfahrung in der Gastronomie in einer ähnlichen Position

• Barista-Ausbildung und entsprechende Erfahrung von Vorteil

• Sicheres, kundenorientiertes Auftreten und sehr gute Umgangsformen

• Teamfähigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit sind für dich selbstverständlich

• Selbstständige, flexible und organisierte Arbeitsweise

• Gastgeberpersönlichkeit mit einem freundlichen Auftreten

• Du verfügst über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, um deine Kunden kompetent beraten zu können

• In einer digitalen Welt wünschen wir uns zudem, einen sicheren Umgang mit Computerprogrammen (MS Office)

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Expert Android Design System Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality.

The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here .

Here's what we're looking for:

Roche utilizes a unified Design System to streamline the user interfaces of its digital products and deliver a consistent, harmonized user experience for our customers. The One Design System encompasses all web and mobile applications developed at Roche Diagnostics.

Our Engineering Team is looking for an Android Expert able to lead the development of Android Mobile components ensuring the correct design and implementation of cutting-edge user interfaces for Android mobile applications. You are able to translate UX and clients requirements into technical solutions and vice versa, and you will lead the development of such components.

You will be located either in of Vienna, or in Sant Cugat (near Barcelona).

Your upcoming mission:

Hands-On Engineering & Tech Execution:

• Architect, develop, maintain the Design System components & interaction patterns for mobile, consistent with platform strategies, governance policy, and standards.

• Write and review clean, testable, scalable code aligned with best practices and design patterns.

• Maintain code quality through automated testing, code review, and continuous integration pipelines.

• Provide Technical assessment of development of the design components in mobile, ensuring the approach is of quality, it is customer centric, future thinking and easy to use.

• Participate actively in the creation of the architecture for Mobile Applications, consistent with platform strategies, governance policy, and standards.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration:

• Collaborate with Design & Development teams to align on goals, scope and business outcomes.

• Ensure Documentation on Mobile Components and support the mobile development community in adoption, implementation, testing and maintenance.

• Work with Roche clients (project leaders, architects, designers, front-end developers) to establish collaboration, understanding their needs and solve their doubts.

• Champion the adoption of the Design System together with the client and the Usability Engineers across Roche.

Creative / Strategic activities:

• Brainstorm improvements and propose innovative solutions to improve community engagement.

• Evaluate new technologies, patterns, and frameworks for potential adoption.

• Contribute to design review, prototypes, and mobile user experience standards.

AI powered design system:

• Create documentation for AI agents to ensure the users of the design system can vibe code with the library

• Create test applications using vibe coding to ensure the compatibility of the library with AI

• Document all the components in Fiigma code connect

Essential skills for your mission:

• Android Developer for at least 5 years

• Expert in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and Git

• Experience with Material Design 3 for Jetpack Compose and Design Systems in general

• Strong experience to build reusable, testable, composable UI components

• Proficiency to write unit tests, screenshot tests, Compose UI tests

• Deep knowledge of implementing accessibility best practices (A11y) in Jetpack Compose

• RTL Knowledge

Bonus skills:

• Vivid interest in modern technology trends and best practices

• Curiosity in domains outside of Android: iOS development, Cross-platform solutions knowledge.

• Innersourced products experience

• Engagement in dev communities, community management, active contribution to open s

• Experience with Material Design 3 for Jetpack Compose and Design Systems in general

• Strong experience to build reusable, testable, composable UI components

• Vivid interest in modern technology trends and best practices

• Curiosity in domains outside of Android: iOS development, Cross-platform solutions knowledge.

• Innersourced products experience

• Engagement in dev communities, community management, active contribution to open s

jobs.title: Network Service Delivery Lead

titleByLocale.it: Guida alla consegna del servizio di rete

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has newly been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As a Network Service Delivery Lead , you will work to ensure fulfillment of the Global Digital Hub long term outcomes, overseeing the seamless operation, alignment, and evolution of Pharma Network processes and teams . This role supervises Network teams in selected regions and with other partners to ensure a seamless service experience. You will be also responsible for service delivery while monitoring Roche’s content KPIs at Network level.

The Opportunity:

• Ensuring adoption of Digital Content and Services on a Network level, continuously improving the service-engagement layer operating model.

• Designing and implementing a sustainable standard of service to create consistent levels of service performance to enhance experience of affiliates as internal clients.

• Ensuring optimal utilisation of assigned budgets / reduction in overall spend on a Network level, leading to OPEX savings in the areas of content and digital communication.

• Collaborating with the assigned Network teams as well as the global team to improve the processes of content strategy execution that advances business objectives. Maximizing customer experience by monitoring and reviewing the work of the production teams, Network engagement team and evaluating their performance.

• Analyzing third-party as well as internal content-creation processes, and creating strategies for service delivery optimisation, establishing and monitoring digital service related KPIs at Network level.

• Understanding technology tools and platforms which support the digital content creation ecosystem ( monday.com , Veeva Vault PromoMats etc.), providing and adhering to digital content best practices by channel and audience type/segment.

• Fulfill activities as functional leader of the assigned Network teams, including the identification of onboarding and training needs of Network teams, develop a standardized training plan, supervise team members’ performance, provide feedback on operational improvement areas.

Who you are:

• You have a Bachelors or Masters degree in a business or a quantitative field and multiple years of digital product design experience , preferably inclusive of both healthcare and consumer goods industry experience.

• You have experience in service design: consistently focusing on the end-to-end user experience to deliver cohesive, and efficient service solutions and process enhancements.

• You have experience in managing budgets, forecasting resource needs, and optimizing team member utilization to ensure high business value and operational efficiency.

• You are an accomplished functional leader , with a proven experience in leading and managing digital teams, and with a deep knowledge of digital content

• You have demonstrated success in designing and executing operational process enhancement s and providing high quality enablement of digital engagement.

• You have strong leadership skills: excellent team management, coaching and mentoring skills, superior planning, process and influencing skills. Also, you have demonstrated the ability to partner with cross-functional and global teams, managing high-level stakeholders and providing excellent support.

•

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责 / 责任
(Major functions of the position) （职位的首要职能）
1、 建立并维系 与区域政府决策部门及核心智囊机构的战略合作关系； 制定并落地 区域市场准入策略，推动产品 加速纳入 多层次医疗保障体系并实现报销覆盖最大化； 深度协同 区域业务团队，确保持续、顺畅的医保落地与报销执行。
Establish and cultivate strategic partnerships with regional government authorities and key think tanks. Formulate and execute regional market access strategies to accelerate product inclusion into multi-level reimbursement schemes and maximize coverage. Collaborate closely with the Regional Business Team to ensure seamless reimbursement implementation.
2、 确保区域准入策略与产品核心策略的深度协同 ；基于全生命周期管理要求及新政策环境，制定并落地区域市场准入计划。通过 优化医保报销政策 、 前瞻性化解准入风险与壁垒 ，持续最大化患者的用药可及性。
Ensure strategic alignment between regional market access initiatives and core product strategies. Formulate and execute regional access plans grounded in lifecycle management and the evolving policy landscape. Optimize reimbursement policies , proactively mitigate risks and barriers , and maximize patient accessibility.
3、 确保中央准入策略在团队内的协同与高效执行 ；建立并维护区域内医疗及卫生技术（HTA）领域的关键利益相关者关系； 全方位支持 从中央到省级及区域层面的市场准入工作。
Ensure alignment and execution of central market access strategies within the team. Manage key stakeholders in the medical and health technology (HTA) sectors. Provide comprehensive support for market access initiatives at national, provincial, and regional levels.
4、 构建并运营 区域市场准入平台，确立与政府部门的 长期战略合作 机制，统筹相关项目的落地实施。 深度研判 区域医药政策趋势，为业务决策提供智力支持，并 赋能 区域业务团队，确保政策信息的精准传达与应用。
Establish and operate regional market access platforms , ensuring the effective execution of collaborative projects. Cultivate long-term strategic partnerships with government authorities. Analyze and interpret key regional healthcare policies to support business decision-making, while empowering local commercial teams with actionable policy intelligence.
5、 构建区域跨职能协作与资源整合平台 ，统筹各部门资源以最大化利用效率； 强化 部门间协调机制，确保公司级项目中的深度协同，共同 驱动 区域业务目标的达成。
Establish a cross-functional collaboration and resource integration platform within the region. Orchestrate inter-departmental coordination to maximize resource efficiency, ensuring seamless synergy on corporate projects to drive the achievement of business objectives.

Q ualification and Experience 能力与经验

Education/Qualifications 教育程度 / 所获资格证书
本科及以上；医学、药学、药经或相关领域优先考虑

Job Required Competencies 岗位所需胜任力

• Experience: Minimum of 2 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry and policy affairs. 至少2年医药行业及政策事务相关工作经验。

• Specialization: Possess at least 2 years of experience in reimbursement account management. 具备至少2年政府客户管理经验。

• Project Management: Proven track record in project management and execution. 具备出色的项目管理与落地执行能力。

• Interpersonal Skills: Exceptional communication and networking skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and build strong professional relationships. 卓越的人际沟通与影响力，善于建立并维护稳固的业务关系网。

• Personal Attributes: Proactive, passionate, and highly self-motivated. 工作积极主动，富有激情，具备高度的自我驱动力。

• Teamwork: Strong sense of accountability, dedication, and a collaborative team spirit. 强烈的责任心与敬业精神，优秀的团队协作意识。

• Language: Proficiency in written and spoken English. 优秀的英语听说读写能力（可作为工作语言）

• Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in data analysis and presentation (PowerPoint/Excel). 精通PPT制作及数据分析技能。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the glob

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deine Abteilung
Wir freuen uns auf Unterstützung und Deine Ideen im Teams des Regional Customer Support Centers in Mannheim. Wir sind verantwortlich für den technischen und applikativen Kundenservice: vom technischen Produktmanagement über Trainings zur Bedienung von Analysegeräten bis zur telefonischen Hotline. Während Deines Praktikums arbeitest Du zusammen mit unseren Spezialisten im Bereich der Laborsysteme zur medizinischen Diagnostik. Hier sammelst Du Erfahrungen direkt an der Schnittstelle zwischen Technik, IT, Naturwissenschaft und Medizin und lernst unsere teils internationalen Kunden aus Labor und Krankenhaus in Deutschland, Österreich, der Schweiz, Belgien, der Niederlande, Griechenland und der Türkei kennen.

Deine Aufgaben
• Du unterstützt und koordinierst applikative und technische Serviceprojekte

• Du hilfst bei der Erstellung und Pflege von Wissensmanagement-Tools

• Du unterstützt bei der Trainings- und Hotlineplanung sowie der Reklamationsbearbeitung

• Du arbeitest aktiv an der Optimierung und Bearbeitung von Prozessbeschreibungen mit

• Du erstellst Analysen und Reports für Controlling-Zwecke

Dein Profil
• Du bist aktuell in einem Masterstudium der Fachrichtung Biologie, Molekularbiologie, Biochemie, Chemie, Medizin oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung eingeschrieben

• Du hast idealerweise bereits Erfahrungen in Projektmanagement gesammelt

• Du hast Routine im Umgang mit dem MS / Google-Office-Paket, insbesondere Excel und Powerpoint beherrschst du sehr gut

• Du überzeugst mit einer analytischen Herangehensweise, hinterfragst konventionelle Denkmuster und verfügst über ein hohes Maß an Eigenständigkeit und Koordinationsfähigkeit

• Arbeiten im Team ist für dich selbstverständlich, speziell auch im internationalen Kontext

• Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse (C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Deine Vorteile
• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268€ Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 4 Monate

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/offline)

Deine Bewerbung
Bitte lade Deinen Lebenslauf und Anschreiben online hoch.

Denke daran, dass sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation richtet oder alternativ an Personen im Gap-Year.

Zeitraum: ab Juli 2026 für 6 Monate

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer zona Centro
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Misión
En Roche Diagnostics, estamos comprometidos no solo con el avance de soluciones diagnósticas que puedan ayudar a los profesionales sanitarios a tomar decisiones críticas para la salud de sus pacientes, sino también con la mejora de la forma en que estas herramientas esenciales se integran en los sistemas sanitarios de todo el mundo, a un coste menor, sin dejar de obtener los mejores resultados posibles.

En más de 100 países, ofrecemos la cartera de pruebas de diagnóstico in vitro más completa del sector, combinada con apoyo a la toma de decisiones clínicas, consultoría, diagnóstico digital, gestión de enfermedades, automatización de laboratorios y soluciones de software para proporcionar soluciones integradas a laboratorios, clínicos y sistemas sanitarios.

El Field Service Engineer presta un servicio científico/técnico a los sistemas y soluciones instalados en cliente, garantizando la mayor eficiencia y eficacia en cada una de las actividades asignadas: Instalaciones, mantenimiento preventivo, correctivo, evolutivo y modificaciones. Asegura que el servicio prestado genera ventaja competitiva, convirtiéndose en el elemento diferencial de la propuesta de valor de Roche, y consiguiendo niveles óptimos de satisfacción del cliente.

Responsabilidades

Como Field Service Engineer tus principales responsabilidades van a ser:

• Alcanzar y mantener un nivel de operatividad excelente en todas las soluciones asignadas (que incluyen instrumentos, reactivos y software) mediante una correcta ejecución de los procedimientos previstos para mantenimientos preventivos, correctivos, evolutivos, instalaciones y modificaciones, capacitando a los usuarios en el manejo y uso de los mismos.

• Establecer y mantener un excelente nivel de comunicación, seguimiento y colaboración proactiva con el Cliente, informando de las actualizaciones de los reactivos y controles de calidad e implementar nuevos protocolos.

• Incorporar la digitalización en el área de servicio postventa mediante el uso de herramientas digitales que permitan evolucionar hacia un modelo de servicio más eficiente y proactivo, orientado a maximizar la experiencia de servicio de nuestros clientes.

• Reportar la actividad en CRM de las actividades realizadas de forma remota o in situ, garantizando a su vez la correcta documentación de las características técnicas de la instalación en cliente y su actualización cuando se requiera, según los estándares de calidad de reporte definidos por la Organización.

• Asegurar, el seguimiento y cumplimiento en tiempo y forma de las modificaciones y mantenimientos preventivos de los sistemas instalados en los clientes asignados, utilizando el Dashboard de Servicio como herramienta clave para garantizar la sostenibilidad de los clientes y el cumplimiento de las metas estratégicas de servicio.”

• Trabajar estrechamente con el Área Comercial para abordar las necesidades de los clientes y respaldar las ventas de soluciones y ofertas de servicio.

Formación

• Grado en Ingeniería Técnica o Superior Ciencias de la Salud, Biotecnologia o similar

• Experiencia en posición similar imprescindible

• Inglés fluido. Español nivel alto

Experiencia

• Experiencia en el sector in-vitro diagnostics, mínima 2 - 5 años

• Valorable experiencia previa gestionando clientes complejos

• Ubicación en Madrid

Competencias clave

• Liderazgo y comunicación

• Trabajo en equipo

• Conocimiento profundo del portafolio de producto y/o servicios de Roche

• Gestión de stakeholders y conocimiento de l
