jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within the Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen Roche's digital capabilities globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting, and Creative Design.

As a member of the Global Digital Hub Team, you will work to ensure fulfillment of the Global Digital Hub long term outcomes and strategy, as well as excellent delivery of our various digital operations priorities. You are responsible for supporting and executing different initiatives. You work with relevant stakeholders and consult on how to develop their digital performance further and ensure they leverage the available digital tools in order to meet their overall goals.

A Digital Project Coordinator (Enterprise Web Product Project Management) is a technically-qualified person (expert) who strives to achieve business goals through web presence and digital platforms by supporting stakeholders with providing hands-on delivery coordination and consultative advisory to local markets and global teams. The Digital Project Coordinator (Enterprise Web Product Project Management) is responsible for consulting and partnering with Roche Divisions and/or affiliates in executing the digital strategy by delivering a full suite of objectives across the Roche online presence. The Digital Project Coordinator (Enterprise Web Product Project Management) is a skilled expert in all aspects of digital project management, content management, and tool development across different platforms, and can build out reporting metrics that support the business in continuing their growth to meet KPIs and objectives.

The Opportunity:

• Lead intake, triage, and prioritization of Enterprise Web Product (Adobe Experience Manager) requests in line with business objectives

• Advise stakeholders on the effective use of Enterprise Web Product functionalities and best practices

• Act as the main liaison between BPOs, internal requestors, IT/technical teams, and external partners

• Act as an internal consultant and bridge between business teams and IT, overseeing the process from strategy development to implementation and hypercare

• Share specialist knowledge and building expertise by training stakeholders, mentoring colleagues, and promoting innovative digital practices

• Drive process improvements and governance through process optimization, documentation, and occasional handling of incidents and service requests

Who you are:

• You have 7+ years in IT systems, digital operations, and website management within agencies or large organizations (including healthcare or tech), plus proven success leading large-scale or global digital projects.

• You are skilled in developing digital strategies and action plans, managing agencies and stakeholders, and providing expert consultancy to global business teams.

• You have excellent project management, analytical, and technical skills; effective communicator in English with the ability to engage senior leaders and work in global, cross-functional teams.

• You are quick learner, detail-oriented, passionate about technologies, comfortable working under pressure, and dedicated to continuous improvement.

In exchange, we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments,

jobs.title: Financial Compliance GBPS - Authorizations
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Locations: Budapest (HU) / Manheim ( Germany)
The Financial Compliance SAP Authorization Governance is responsible for the design of single business process task authorization and business roles. During the design process, we ensure the business process related governance and all compliance requirements are fulfilled.
The opportunity
As a Financial Compliance Global Business Process Specialist ( SAP Authorization Specialist) you will be a part of the RSS Financial Compliance Product Area and will report directly to the Chapter Lead.
Driving the implementation of the end-to-end Business Process Management (BPM) strategy.

• Designing global, cross-divisional, state-of-the-art processes and authorizations within the assigned business process area

• Acting as an empowered decision-maker across divisions, aligned with GBPM guardrails for end-to-end process ownership

• Collaborating closely with E2E GBPMs and the GBPS network to ensure fit-for-purpose process and system solutions

• Reviewing global authorization concepts and processes, aligning role and job function design, ensuring compliance throughout the design phase, addressing authorization-related issues based on root cause analysis, and coordinating role requests accordingly

Who you are
We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. In order to provide innovative healthcare solutions to our patients, we need the best talent in our organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you would have:

• Expertise in SAP Authorizations : Proven experience in designing, building, and maintaining SAP security roles

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Informatics, Engineering or a comparable education and 5-7 years professional experience, preferably in Business Process Management, Information Management / IT, Finance/Procurement, Risk/Internal Control Management, Accounting, Audit

• Strong knowledge in the area of authorization and access management and GRC tools , based on business process management or IT experience and expertise

• SAP ABAC Specialist: Proven experience designing and implementing Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) policies using the SAP standard framework to supplement traditional RBAC (Role-Based Access Control).

• Advanced technical expertise in SAP S/4 HANA analytical privileges as well as interfaces with analytics and reporting and how data-centric security translates from the application layer to the database layer.

• Preferred experience working with cross-platform modern BI specifically AppSheet, LookerStudio, TABLEAU and Alteryx.

• Business fluency in English

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities : Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits : Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average.) We crea

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
(Major functions of the position)

Medical Strategy and planning

• Accountable for development, delivery and maintenance of DA medical strategy

• Builds deep understanding of the current and future direction of the assigned DA(s)

• Drive the synthesis and translation of complex scientific data/clinical situations into strategy and solutions to optimize care for patients

• Creates and executes long term medical affairs DA strategy

• Ultimately accountable to provide strategic perspective based on a deep understanding of clinical decision-making to inform decisions about unmet medical needs and the impact of clinical data on clinical practice pattern

• Accountable for team development, delivery and maintenance of strategically aligned Medical Plans (on-market & in portfolio) within assigned DA(s)

• Leads Country Medical Managers and Medical Science Manager(MSM) Leaders working on the same product or DA to develop and execute annual medical plan

• Ensure medical plan is to aligned with global medical plan, DA strategy and brand strategy

• Leads Country Medical Managers to periodical update medical plan to reflect the change of the competitive landscape and critical business strategy change if appropriate

• On time, quality and within budget delivery of the medical plan, either directly or through team member(s)

• Supervises team to actively build up internal cross-functional strategic partnership for assigned DA(s), also including global networking

• Acts as point of contact for any strategic discussion on the assigned DA(s)

• Partner effectively across the medical and strategy network, within China cross functions(Access, CPS, PD China, CiCOR) and with global(PD, PDMA & GPS) colleagues to create and deliver options to support short and long-term goals on the assigned DA(s)

• Upgrades the influence level to the global IMT (International Medical Team)

• Accountable for the scientific & strategic leadership for all other key medical activities for the assigned DA(s), including medical information service, epidemiology/outcome research, medical education, medical publications, pharmacovigilance, and biomarker science, etc. to ensure alignment of the overall medical strategy and optimal execution of the medical plan

• Accountable for the medical and scientific support provided to the commercial activities for the product(s) within assigned DA(s), including medical input in the marketing strategy, external professional interaction, sales training, promotional material generation

Evidence generation

• Medical/scientific accountability for formation and execution of high quality clinical studies and other sources of evidence generation (e.g. RWD ), including but not limited to defining study concepts/synopses, protocol development, medical monitoring, final study reports and preparation of data for publication of study results

• Accountable for close collaboration with regulatory and development teams to provide unmet medical needs assessment and product value proposition to ensure an optimal local registration strategy for the new product and/or new indication(s)

• Accountable for identifies potential medical interest for line extensions according to the scientific rationale and the understanding of the actual and anticipated future medical practice in key markets

Knowledge exchange/Data communication

• Accountable for full execution of MSM action plan

• Leads MSM Leaders to ensure the executio

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
主要职责
患者全程管理
1.在生态圈内绘制患者就医流转图，从而更好的推动全程管理在医院内/间的落地。
2.协助生态圈内医院及相关科室推进和打造会诊通道，协助上下层医院间衔接流转，助力绿色转诊通道的建立，最终实现患者获益。
3.管理生态圈内患者全程管理项目的各项落地实施，并确保其合规性。
支付方案
与准入团队合作，协助整合罗氏相关支付方案，传递完整支付解决方案信息。
疾病认知（患者教育)
与第三方机构协作，针对相关疾病领域区域现状及整体策略，协助开展患者教育，提升疾病认知，促进患者获益。

能力与经验
岗位所需胜任力
• 成长性思维和快速学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 优秀的沟和资源整合能力
• 合作伙伴及大客户管理能力
工作年限
•5年以上医药行业工作经验，有管理经验者优先
•有跨职能、或者治疗领域经验优先
教育程度/所获资格证书
•医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

ASPIRE is a Roche-wide, enterprise business transformation program that aims at harmonizing, simplifying and automating business processes to enable us to focus our efforts even more on doing now what patients need next.

Scaled Agile Framework® (SAFe®) was adopted for ASPIRE to design and execute incremental builds with fast, integrated learning cycles, by applying the same cadence with cross-functional planning and decentralizing decision making, enabling us to further accelerate agility.

The Opportunity

• Manage the product roadmap, prioritize the team backlog in alignment with the ART Backlog, and determine Agile team capacity allocation.

• Prioritize issue resolution, coordinate User Stories, and ensure approval against Definition of Done, also responsible for user story definition and acceptance criteria.

• Participate in exploration activities to further learn customer needs, ensure features meet Definition of Ready, and deliver input to program execution and incremental planning.

• Engage and collaborate with Product Management, Business SMEs, Data owners, and operational teams to align on E2E data governance processes and collaboratively reduce master data defects.

• Work to ensure training, consistency, and accuracy of master data across systems.

• Demonstrate expertise in SAP-MDG systems, Business partners data, workflow processes, and business improvements experience driven by in-depth business partners business process knowledge.

• Support vision and strategy for Master Data Governance , deployments, testing, creation of master data for other teams, and foster relationships to achieve project goals and objectives.

Who you are

We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development.

• Bachelor's/Master’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent work experience, with over 5 years of master data management experience in the Business Partners Data domain.

• Over 3 years of experience with Enterprise Applications, such as SAP-MDG, and a deep understanding of governance impacts on both business process management and IT.

• Familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA, and other business partners -specific data privacy regulations, alongside robust interpersonal, communication, and networking skills.

• Proven track record of delivering in a matrixed organization across geographies and divisions, with a strong focus on quality, attention to detail, and the ability to make decisions in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.

• Agile mindset and experience working with Agile Organizations, outstanding customer service, and excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a background in consulting or business management services as a strong plus.

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, intern

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Foodlicious ist unser Tagesgeschäft
Aus der Taverne Roche ist in über 30 Jahren ein erfolgreiches Gastronomieunternehmen im Bereich der Gemeinschaftsgastronomie entstanden. Die Tavero AG ist eine 100% Tochtergesellschaft der F. Hoffmann-La Roche.
An den Standorten Basel und Kaiseraugst beschäftigen wir rund 350 Mitarbeitende aus über 37 Nationen.Unser Angebot umfasst sowohl Staff Restaurants, die Vielfalt leben, als auch Fine Dining Restaurants mit gehobener Küche und exzellentem Service. Zusätzlich bieten wir Restaurants mit Köstlichkeiten aus aller Welt, Kaffee in allen Varianten, gezaubert von unseren Baristi, sowie die höchstgelegenen Lounges der Schweiz – traumhafte Afterwork-Spots über den Dächern der Stadt. Grab'n'Go-Angebote von Sushi bis Burger und der erste und einzige Club in der Geschichte von Roche ergänzen unser Angebot.
Zusätzlich bieten wir unseren Gästen Sitzungszimmer- und Eventcatering für bis zu 1.500 Personen an. Die öffentlichen Gastronomien, das Schöpfli im Park und das Chez Jeannot im Museum Tinguely, runden unser Angebot ab.

Per sofort suchen wir eine:n Koch EFZ für unsere Staff Restaurants in Basel.

Hauptaufgaben:

• Termingerechte Bereitstellung und Produktion aller Angebotskomponenten sowie Service im jeweiligen Arbeitsbereich

• Kochen im Frontcooking

• Respektvoller Umgang mit dem Produkt

• Zubereitung nach Rezeptur, inkl. Degustation und kontinuierlichem Verbesserungsprozess

• Einhalten von Hygienebestimmungen (TQM / HACCP)

• Wirtschaftliches Arbeiten um Ziele der Firma zu erreichen

• Verantwortlich für die korrekte und ordentliche Lagerung der Waren in den Kühl, Tiefkühl und Lagerbereichen – tägliche Kontrolle

• Sichere Warenbewirtschaftung sowie interne und externe Bestellungen tätigen

• Tägliches führen der Inventarlisten und Mitarbeit bei der monatlichen Inventur

Anforderungsprofil:

• Du hast eine abgeschlossene Kochausbildung (EFZ)

• Du verfügst über mind. 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung (exkl. Ausbildungsjahre)

• Du hast Erfahrung im Bereich des Frontcooking

• Du bist ein Organisationstalent und hast ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein

• Du besitzt ein Durchsetzungsvermögen

• Du hast eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise und übernimmst Verantwortung

• Teamfähigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit sind für dich selbstverständlich

• Einsatzbereitschaft von MO-FR zwischen 6.00 bis 18.00 Uhr möglich

• Du hast Kenntnisse der Schweizer Lebensmittelgesetzgebung

• Du verfügst über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, um deine Kunden kompetent beraten zu können

• In einer digitalen Welt wünschen wir uns zudem, einen sicheren Umgang mit Computerprogrammen (MS Office)

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Tägliches führen der Inventarlisten und Mitarbeit bei der monatlichen Inventur

Anforderungsprofil:

• Du hast eine abgeschlossene Kochausbildung (EFZ)

• Du verfügst über mind. 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung (exkl. Ausbildungsjahre)

• Du hast Erfahrung im Bereich des Frontcooking

• Du bist ein Organisationstalent und hast ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein

• Du besitzt ein Durchsetzungsvermögen

• Du hast eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise und übernimmst Verantwortung

• Du verfügst über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, um deine Kunden kompetent beraten zu können

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.title: Squad Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose

• As the leader for the squad team, set the vision and strategic ambition for the squad and be accountable for the delivery of Disease Area MTO/STO

• As an enterprise leader, prioritize squad outcomes and ensure resource requirements are met to align with affiliate MTO/STO and portfolio priorities.

• As country connector to work closely with DCL (Disease Commercialization Lead) and affiliate key stakeholders (ET/CL/TL) to mobilize affiliate and network resources

Role Scope
1. Set Ambition and Strategic Vision:

• Establish the squad's vision, high ambitions, and key outcomes for the squad by leveraging insights from customer facing roles and other key stakeholders across the enterprise.

• Hold overall accountability for the squad’s performance, including delivering outcomes and managing the P&L within a framework of shared responsibility.

• Lead the prioritization of disease area strategies, co-create the squad's OBP, and support financial planning to drive long-term impact.

2. Lead and Inspire Teams:

• Collaborate with people leaders to foster squad member capability growth to deliver team shared goals and actively participate in the employee contribution cycle.

• Empower the squad team to make decisions, enable prioritization, and manage conflicts effectively to achieve ambitious outcomes, fostering a collaborative and continuous learning environment.

3. Ensure Strategic Prioritization and Resource Allocation:

• Adopt an enterprise mindset, taking into account affiliate strategies and portfolio priorities to prioritize squad outcomes.

• Ensure resource requirements are met to deliver on MTOs and STOs.

• Partner with WPO to enable effective WP execution and prioritization aligned with affiliate priorities.

• Facilitate squad resource prioritization and fluidity, ensuring alignment under the OBP cycle on a 120 days cycle.

4. Foster Partnerships and Network Engagement:

• Foster both external and internal partnerships, ensuring that clinical and non-clinical stakeholders view Roche as their preferred partner.

• Mobilize the network swiftly to address the urgent needs of key stakeholders.

• Inspire the squad team to engage and dialogue with key stakeholders to ensure organizational alignment and timely support.

• Enable cross-affiliate networking to achieve and scale team and organizational outcomes, connecting and mobilizing DA network resources to fit local needs.

5. Catalyze Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing:

• Partner with internal stakeholders to catalyze collaboration towards achieving the triple-win goal.

• Accelerate learning and sharing across squads, promoting a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

Qualifications:

• Good Compliance track record. No material Compliance violation has been identified in the past 5 years.

• Minimum 8+ years working experience in the pharma industry.

Education:

• A bachelor degree in scientific, economic, or business related fields. An advanced degree in Life Science and/or MBA is a plus.

Working Experience:

• Experience in managing senior key stakeholders

• Experience in leading cross-functional teams

• Experience in planning and managing resources prioritization

• Experience in leadership role (formal or informal) is preferred

Competencies

• A VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst and Coach) leader with a creative mind. Unites people around a shared vision and a common purpose, inspiring them to achieve squad-aligned outcomes. Ensure individuals and teams are

jobs.title: Patient Access Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Position Summary and Purpose
The Patient Access Partner is a strategic role responsible for driving and executing the integrated access, pricing, and policy strategy for an assigned Disease Area (DA) Ecosystem. This role translates national policy into tangible access and pricing decisions at the disease level, focusing on improving and accelerating access to innovation. As a key player in the integrated access strategy, the Partner identifies shared purpose and value, co-creates flexible pricing solutions with DA Squads, and implements them across the ecosystem to ensure better health outcomes for more patients faster.

Core Responsibilities and Key Accountabilities
1. Ecosystem & Disease Area Policy Strategy

• Strategic Alignment : Execute and develop Disease Area Policy activities that support the strategic outcomes of the Squad. This involves ensuring all access strategies are aligned with current and anticipated national legislative trends.

• Integrated Planning : Manage the end-to-end patient access process for assigned therapeutic areas, coordinating strategy from monitoring early-stage portfolios to achieving final reimbursement.

• System Shaping : Catalyze the ability to see broader trends in healthcare systems, bringing external insights into Roche to influence DA strategy and sharing Roche’s expertise with the external ecosystem.

• Pricing Strategy: Responsible for defining the Pricing Strategy (e.g., target price, discount caps, and risk-share structures) based on commercial ambition

2. Pricing, Negotiation, and Technical Execution

• Reimbursement Journey: Acts as the Strategic Project Lead for the reimbursement journey, responsible for the overall timeline, squad alignment, and final negotiation outcome.

• Strategic Negotiation : Serves as the Primary Point of Contact (PPOC) for strategic therapy area payer dialogue, pricing negotiations, and policy-level external meetings.

• Value Proposition: Accountable for translating the technical value proposition into a commercial narrative and negotiation strategy tailored to the specific payer or Disease Area Squad needs.

• External Relationship Management : Maintain and foster a relevant network with pricing and reimbursement decision-makers within the healthcare system to support favorable commercial conditions.

3. Cross-Functional Squad Partnership

• Core Squad Member : Act as a primary member of Disease Area Squads, connecting Market Access strategy, Policy, and Pricing directly to commercialization excellence and field execution.

• Evidence Generation : Responsible for identifying strategic evidence gaps required to support negotiation and commercial goals (e.g., 'We need to prove X to the payer').

• Enterprise Partnership: Work as a strategic bridge between high-level market access strategy and operational reality, partnering with Finance and Brand teams to recommend and shape national access strategies.

• Collaboration : Partner cross-functionally with Healthcare System Partners and Patient Journey Partners to leverage internal networks and pull in resources needed for the therapeutic area.

Skills, Knowledge, and Capabilities

• Strategic Agility : Ability to maintain focus on long-term strategy while successfully adapting to changing environmental and legislative conditions.

• System Thinking : Capability to think from an enterprise level to bring the best possible outcomes to the local health environment and the broader Roche global network.

• Impactful Communication : Skilled in

jobs.title: Backlog Elaboration Team Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Backlog Elaboration Team Lead

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
As an accomplished Systems Engineer with a strong background in end-to-end new product development programs and successful launches, you will play the role of Backlog Elaboration Team Lead being at the forefront of leading Roche Tissue Diagnostics’ design & development programs. Using the Agile method of development, you will primarily focus on the prioritization, definition, estimation, tracking and continuous maintenance of solution level backlog by heavily collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders.

The Opportunity

• You will facilitate and improve Backlog Elaboration by leading backlog elaboration meetings, ensuring they are productive and owning the project’s backlog elaboration WiKi site.

• You will collaborate and seek guidance from the program’s Solution Train Engineer to continuously iterate and refine processes with a goal to have backlogs sequenced, defined & estimated for confident predictability and project schedule tracking.

• You will manage interdependencies by developing a deep understanding of System, Software, Assay, Consumables and Hardware teams & the Agile Release Trains (ARTs) to ensure that all Epics, Capabilities & Features are clearly defined & documented in the backlog.

• You will continually look for ways of enhancing tools (such as Azure DevOps and Lucid) and communication by streamlining our workflow, be the central point of contact for backlog-related communications & engaging with a wide range of stakeholders (including Product Managers, ART leads, and senior leadership) to align everyone towards a unified goal.

• You will strategize and plan for the future by developing and communicating yearly backlog goals that provide clear direction for the teams. This includes implementing Agile SAFe's rolling-wave planning approach involving detailed planning for upcoming Program Increments while keeping a high-level view of future PIs. Over time, this role can grow into co-facilitating PI Planning with the Solution Train Engineer.

Who you are

• An Agile & SAFe expert with strong understanding of Agile principles including backlog elaboration, just-in-time planning, and rolling-wave planning. You must know how to apply these concepts to maintain a healthy and predictive backlog.

• An expert at organizational & planning skills to effectively manage complex backlogs, track dependencies across multiple teams (SW, Assay, System, etc.), and maintain the Project Backlog Elaboration wiki. The ability to sequence work and ensure a high-level project schedule will be a direct outcome of this skill.

• While not a developer, you must have a solid grasp of the development lifecycle and key milestone deliverables. This technical acumen & understanding is crucial for effective communication and for ensuring that backlog items are well-defined and feasible.

• Expert in using Azure DevOps and Lucid tools is essential. You'll be responsible for driving tool improvements and using these platforms to manage and visualize the backlog, dependencies, and project flow.

• An excellent facilitator & communicator. This role requires strong skills in facilitating meetings and communicating with diverse stakeholders, from team members

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Backlog Elaboration Team Lead

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
As an accomplished Systems Engineer with a strong background in end-to-end new product development programs and successful launches, you will play the role of Backlog Elaboration Team Lead being at the forefront of leading Roche Tissue Diagnostics’ design & development programs. Using the Agile method of development, you will primarily focus on the prioritization, definition, estimation, tracking and continuous maintenance of solution level backlog by heavily collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders.

The Opportunity

• You will facilitate and improve Backlog Elaboration by leading backlog elaboration meetings, ensuring they are productive and owning the project’s backlog elaboration WiKi site.

• You will collaborate and seek guidance from the program’s Solution Train Engineer to continuously iterate and refine processes with a goal to have backlogs sequenced, defined & estimated for confident predictability and project schedule tracking.

• You will manage interdependencies by developing a deep understanding of System, Software, Assay, Consumables and Hardware teams & the Agile Release Trains (ARTs) to ensure that all Epics, Capabilities & Features are clearly defined & documented in the backlog.

• You will continually look for ways of enhancing tools (such as Azure DevOps and Lucid) and communication by streamlining our workflow, be the central point of contact for backlog-related communications & engaging with a wide range of stakeholders (including Product Managers, ART leads, and senior leadership) to align everyone towards a unified goal.

• You will strategize and plan for the future by developing and communicating yearly backlog goals that provide clear direction for the teams. This includes implementing Agile SAFe's rolling-wave planning approach involving detailed planning for upcoming Program Increments while keeping a high-level view of future PIs. Over time, this role can grow into co-facilitating PI Planning with the Solution Train Engineer.

Who you are

• An Agile & SAFe expert with strong understanding of Agile principles including backlog elaboration, just-in-time planning, and rolling-wave planning. You must know how to apply these concepts to maintain a healthy and predictive backlog.

• An expert at organizational & planning skills to effectively manage complex backlogs, track dependencies across multiple teams (SW, Assay, System, etc.), and maintain the Project Backlog Elaboration wiki. The ability to sequence work and ensure a high-level project schedule will be a direct outcome of this skill.

• While not a developer, you must have a solid grasp of the development lifecycle and key milestone deliverables. This technical acumen & understanding is crucial for effective communication and for ensuring that backlog items are well-defined and feasible.

• Expert in using Azure DevOps and Lucid tools is essential. You'll be responsible for driving tool improvements and using these platforms to manage and visualize the backlog, dependencies, and project flow.

• An excellent facilitator & communicator. This role requires strong skills in facilitating meetings and communicating with diverse stakeholders, from team members

jobs.title: Warehouse Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities主要职责/责任
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:
● Participate in new facility realization, including but not limited to FAT, SAT, IOPQ etc. to contribute to project delivery.
● Participate in the implementation of warehouse operation readiness, eg: draft equipment operation procedures and logbook, 5S, etc. according to readiness plan.
● Trained and qualified in the daily operation in the warehouse.
Routine Operation:
Technical & Operational
● Material Handling: Receive raw materials, packaging materials, and finished goods. Verify
quantity and inspect for damage or discrepancies against purchase orders and shipping
documents. Also including dangerous and chemical goods
● Storage and Inventory: Safely store materials in designated warehouse locations. Perform accurate and timely stocktaking, including cycle counts and physical inventories, to ensure stock accuracy.
● Documentation: Maintain precise and complete records for all warehouse activities, including receiving records, material transfer forms, and inventory records. Ensure all documentation is accurate and legible.
● Picking and Packing: Accurately pick materials for production orders or shipments. Stage materials in designated areas, ensuring they are ready for use or transport. Prepare finished goods for shipment, including packing, labeling, and documentation.
● System Operations: Operate the Warehouse Management System (WMS) or other inventory management software to record all material movements and transactions.
● Equipment Operation: Safely operate warehouse equipment such as forklifts, pallet jacks, and other material handling equipment. Perform pre-operational checks and report any maintenance issues.
● Other tasks assigned by AM.
Compliance & Safety
● Adhere to all GMP and SOPs to ensure the quality and integrity of all materials and products.
● Follow all SHE rules and regulations, including wearing appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and maintaining a clean and orderly work area.
● Report any deviations, quality issues, or safety hazards immediately to the supervisor/manager.
● Participate in team meetings, safety training, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/
• Qualifications
● A college degree or above in logistics management, warehouse management, or related fields (Pharmaceutical / Biological is preferred)
● Qualification of dangerous and chemical goods handling
Job Required Competencies 岗位所需胜任力
● 3 years of experience in a warehouse or logistics environment.
● Experience operating a forklift and other material handling equipment.
● Familiarity with WMS (e.g. SAP, MES) and Microsoft Excel (data entry and basic reports)
● Strong knowledge of cGMP and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry, especially in the biological industry
● Good communication with team members and cross function colleagues.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier

jobs.title: Learning Technology Systems Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Learning Technology Systems Analyst

The Opportunity

Network Quality QA/QC Operational Systems team works in partnership across major global business functions, establishing and implementing an overall Technology strategy for PT Quality and driving the delivery and scale of key solutions in support of our PT vision.
As a Product Owner (PO) or Sub-Product Owner in Roche PT, you will play a pivotal role in standardizing and optimizing the systems and technology that powers our Quality operations and data insights. In this role you will serve as the Global Product Owner, or sub-product owner, for applicable technologies used in PT. The PO will be responsible for translating business use cases and project requirements into standardized technology solutions. This role requires a blend of technical expertise and the ability to bridge the gap between intricate business challenges and transformative solutions. Working in multidisciplinary teams, you’ll maintain, transform, and construct technologies integral to our technology landscape. This role will also be responsible for global master data entity. As a PO, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams consisting of business stakeholders, use case leads, IT, and validation teams to understand business needs, translate them into technical requirements, and deliver impactful solutions that are compliant to regulations. This role works with Business and Informatics to ensure high quality innovative solutions are defined, developed, enhanced and implemented using consistent technologies and processes and assists the organization with expertise during inspections, investigation and resolution of deviations and implementation of initiatives.
This role calls for a collaborative, open-minded individual who values learning from colleagues, thoughtfully challenges ideas, and prioritizes impactful work. We seek someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, has a passion for continuous learning, and can be relied upon to work in the best interest of the team.

• Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) with extensive domain expertise in focused technologies such as Veeva, RMS, LIMS, LES, AI Solutions, SPECA, Equipment Software, and Learning. Solve complex problems by adopting new perspectives with existing technologies, supporting compliance and efficiency improvements.

• Lead lifecycle management for multiple products and systems, overseeing upgrades, replacements, retirements of computerized systems, and managing enhancement features/backlogs to align with business needs. Act as a Business Data Steward, supporting data governance and acceleration initiatives.

• Ensure compliance with system access processes, periodic user access reviews, and adherence to GxP Computer Systems' intended use and regulatory standards. Maintain a compliant mindset with data from commercial manufacturing processes while enforcing Information Security standards.

• Drive product vision, roadmaps, and continuous improvements for software systems, ensuring smooth introductions of new functionalities, strategic alignment of technologies, and formulation of future innovations via interdepartmental and industry collaborations.

• Lead interdepartmental teams, business initiatives, IT projects, process improvements, and system designs, collaborating with stakeholders to ensure alignment with global strategies, technology portfolios, and fit-for-purpose innovative solutions through the SDLC.

• Manage and validate master data within global quality syst

jobs.title: Principal Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Diagnostics International Ltd in Rotkreuz is one of the world’s leading providers of diagnostic system solutions for clinics, laboratories and doctors’ offices. The company employs over 2200 people in Rotkreuz and is one of Roche Diagnostics main sites. Roche is an equal opportunity employer and strictly prohibits unlawful discrimination based upon an individual’s race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin/ancestry, mental/physical disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The Opportunity
As a Principal Engineer within our PCR HW Chapter, you will be a hands-on technical leader driving innovation for Molecular, Core, and Point of Care laboratory solutions. In this domain-expert role, you will define, build, and release high-quality software for both IVD and non-IVD products, directly influencing our future product portfolio through the following responsibilities:

• Conceptual Leadership: Develop technical concepts and lead feasibility studies to ensure all technical requirements and overarching system designs are met.

• Software Lifecycle Ownership: Perform hands-on development tasks, including defining, estimating, and planning work packages while documenting SW unit specifications and designs.

• Architectural Contribution: Contribute to the SW architecture, defining key quality attributes and ensuring the team stays current with evolving technology trends.

• Quality & Maintenance: Conduct root-cause analysis for complex issues and provide high-quality bug fixes for post-market software releases using established checklists and templates.

• Risk Management: Continuously assess and report project risks, creating contingency and scenario plans for major risks on the critical path.

• Process & Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to regulatory and market standards (IVD) while proposing process improvements to enhance development efficiency.

• Cross-Functional Communication: Collaborate across business areas to present complex technical topics to high-level audiences, utilizing excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Who You Are
You’re a self-motivated team player who wants to influence your own development. It is natural for you to be proactive in working with your teammates and other parts of the organization. You like sharing your know-how to help the whole team advance. Bringing in new ideas to improve existing products with new functions and cost optimization is important to you. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies—where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point.
To be successful in this role, you should possess the following core qualifications and experience:

• 10+ Years of Technical & Management Experience: Must demonstrate:

• Management: Proven history of direct oversight of global teams, including talent acquisition, performance management, and strategic program delivery.

• Technical: Continuous, active, hands-on architectural leadership in high-end embedded systems.

• Expert-Level Medical Instrument Control: Proven mastery in designing and architecting software for Real-Time Linux (Debian/Yocto) environments, specifically for complex, high-precision laboratory or diagnostic medical instruments (IVD).

• Advanced Modern Systems Stack: Deep technical proficiency in C++ a

jobs.title: Expert-Manufacturing BPM
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
The OE & BPM Lead within the Manufacturing Department is responsible for driving a culture of Continuous Improvement on the shop floor. By utilizing Lean Six Sigma methodologies and other optimization tools, this role identifies and eliminates waste, optimizes production business processes, and ensures the achievement of departmental KPIs. This position serves as both a catalyst for production efficiency and a critical bridge for cross-functional process synergy.

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities

1. Lean Leadership & Project Management

• Lead Core Projects: Spearhead major Lean improvement projects on the front line (e.g., OEE enhancement, SMED/changeover reduction, yield loss mitigation, etc.).

• Capability Building: Design and implement internal Lean training systems; coach production supervisors and staff in applying Lean tools (5S, Kaizen, VSM, etc.).

• Culture Promotion: Foster a "Continuous Improvement" atmosphere, ensuring Lean thinking is deeply embedded in shop floor operations.

2. KPI & Workshop Management

• KPI Setting & Cascading: Coordinate the setting of annual/quarterly production goals, cascading site-level objectives into measurable departmental KPIs.

• Performance Review: Organize and facilitate departmental Management Reviews and Workshops, ensuring early warning of performance deviations.

• Action Tracking: Responsible for tracking the execution of production improvement action plans to ensure closed-loop management.

3. Business Process Management & Optimization

• Process Mapping: Identify redundancies in production management and enhance administrative and operational efficiency through Business Process Reengineering.

• Site-level Collaboration: Represent the Production Department in site-level optimization initiatives, such as Digital Transformation and Supply Chain synergy.

• Compliance Balance: Ensure all process optimization solutions strictly adhere to GMP requirements, mitigating compliance risks while improving efficiency.

Qualification and Experience

Education/Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or above in Science, Engineering, or Management
Majors in Pharmacy, Bio-engineering, or Industrial Engineering are preferred

Job Required Competencies
Work Experience:

• 5+ years of experience in Operational Excellence (OE) or Lean improvement within large-scale manufacturing, with at least 2 years in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry.

• Familiar with Change Control and Deviation Management processes under GMP environments.

Professional Skills:

• Proficient in Lean Manufacturing tools; certification as a Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt is preferred.

• Data Visualization & Presentation: Exceptional data visualization and presentation skills. Ability to translate complex data into intuitive dashboards and deliver compelling narratives to stakeholders at all levels. Proficiency in Minitab, Power BI/Tableau, Excel，and PowerPoint is required.

Soft Skills:

• Change Management: Proven ability to navigate resistance to change, with excellent cross-functional communication and interpersonal influence.

• Project Management: Ability to manage multiple project priorities simultaneously with a strong result-oriented mindset.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
The OE & BPM Lead within the Manufacturing Department is responsible for driving a culture of Continuous Improvement on the shop floor. By utilizing Lean Six Sigma methodologies and other optimization tools, this role identifies and eliminates waste, optimizes production business processes, and ensures the achievement of departmental KPIs. This position serves as both a catalyst for production efficiency and a critical bridge for cross-functional process synergy.

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities

1. Lean Leadership & Project Management

• Lead Core Projects: Spearhead major Lean improvement projects on the front line (e.g., OEE enhancement, SMED/changeover reduction, yield loss mitigation, etc.).

• Capability Building: Design and implement internal Lean training systems; coach production supervisors and staff in applying Lean tools (5S, Kaizen, VSM, etc.).

• Culture Promotion: Foster a "Continuous Improvement" atmosphere, ensuring Lean thinking is deeply embedded in shop floor operations.

2. KPI & Workshop Management

• KPI Setting & Cascading: Coordinate the setting of annual/quarterly production goals, cascading site-level objectives into measurable departmental KPIs.

• Performance Review: Organize and facilitate departmental Management Reviews and Workshops, ensuring early warning of performance deviations.

• Action Tracking: Responsible for tracking the execution of production improvement action plans to ensure closed-loop management.

3. Business Process Management & Optimization

• Process Mapping: Identify redundancies in production management and enhance administrative and operational efficiency through Business Process Reengineering.

• Site-level Collaboration: Represent the Production Department in site-level optimization initiatives, such as Digital Transformation and Supply Chain synergy.

• Compliance Balance: Ensure all process optimization solutions strictly adhere to GMP requirements, mitigating compliance risks while improving efficiency.

Qualification and Experience

Education/Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or above in Science, Engineering, or Management
Majors in Pharmacy, Bio-engineering, or Industrial Engineering are preferred

Job Required Competencies
Work Experience:

• 5+ years of experience in Operational Excellence (OE) or Lean improvement within large-scale manufacturing, with at least 2 years in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry.

• Familiar with Change Control and Deviation Management processes under GMP environments.

Professional Skills:

• Proficient in Lean Manufacturing tools; certification as a Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt is preferred.

• Data Visualization & Presentation: Exceptional data visualization and presentation skills. Ability to translate complex data into intuitive dashboards and deliver compelling narratives to stakeholders at all levels. Proficiency in Minitab, Power BI/Tableau, Excel，and PowerPoint is required.

Soft Skills:

• Change Management: Proven ability to navigate resistance to change, with excellent cross-functional communication and interpersonal influence.

• Project Management: Ability to manage multiple project priorities simultaneously with a strong result-oriented mindset.

The Position
Medical Science Partner in Roche Central Asia (Ophthalmology)

Role purpose
Leads the development and is accountable for implementation of the medical part of dedicated Therapeutic Area (TA) strategy that ensures better pts outcomes by being timely diagnosed and treated, accelerating pts access through medical\scientific value creation and customer centricity.
Accountability for Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, Mongolia and Belarus.
Reports to Science Chapter Lead

Requirements\ qualifications

• High education in Medicine is a must

• Previous working experience in ophthalmology is preferred, but not essential

• Established disease area network and strong stakeholder engagement skills including partnering with HCPs and TAEs is preferred

• Experience in building medical\scientific exchange, communication and value creation

• Expert knowledge of disease area\areas

• Fluent English is a must

• Knowledge in Real World Evidence (RWE), experience in working with agile methodologies is a plus

• Position is based in Almaty or in Astana

Critical capabilities

• Clinical Expertise

• Environmental expertise (patient journey, healthcare system landscape, clinical practice landscape, etc.)

• Growing mindset

• Strategic thinking

• Strong communication skills

• Ability to work effectively in Network (both Roche internal and external)

• Fast learner

Responsibilities

• Contribute to developing integrated TA (Ophthalmology) strategy aligned to Global strategy

• Ensures proactive science partnership with key clinical\scientific experts (regular F2F and online meetings)

• Unsure building external clinical advocacy

• Demonstrate deep scientific expertise in assigned molecules/products and therapeutic areas to exchange relevant information with thought leaders and healthcare decision makers

• Build and leverage relationships with key external scientific and medical customers to understand evolving healthcare trends

• Ensures scientific support for PPOCs and other internal stakeholders in frame of Ophthalmology and assigned products

• Act as an expert in Ophthalmology to provide medical insight and work with the team to develop strategies for medical education

• Member of launch readiness and value&access affiliate teams, contributes to launch readiness; value creation and patent access in Ophthalmology and assigned products

• Contribution in frame of Ophthalmology for regulatory\safety outcomes

• Contribution in frame of Ophthalmology for value dossiers preparation

• Accountable for collecting evidence gaps and related needs in Ophthalmology and ensure their inclusion in global Integrated Evidence Plan (if needed)

• Leads RWD activities (in close collaboration with Clin Ops responsible) in Ophthalmology

• Leads One Roche approach in close collaboration with Roche Dia in Ophthalmology

• Leads MedInfo support in Ophthalmology

• Involvement in Affiliate Teams work, Network and Global activities, as required

• Compliance with relevant internal standard operation procedures and external regulation

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high,

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED ) , we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

The pRED Oncology team is focused on discovering and developing step-change innovations in cancer immunotherapy and molecular targeted therapy for cancers where there are few treatment options, or where treatment choices simply don’t exist.
Our goal is to prioritize our best scientific discoveries, and then bring these innovations from the lab to the clinic as quickly, effectively and safely as possible, so patients can benefit from transformative medicines when they need them.
The position is located in the department of Early Clinical Development Oncology (ECDO)

The opportunity
You are leading a team of highly qualified clinical scientists and medical writers and report to the Head of Oncology Early Clinical Development. You are mentoring and enabling the clinical scientists and medical writers to support the planning, implementation and execution of the clinical development plans of the pRED Oncology programs. The role contributes to the strategic direction and culture of Oncology Early Clinical Development as part of the Oncology Early Clinical Development Leadership Team as well as a member of other guidance or governance bodies and committees (within and/or outside the Oncology Disease Therapeutic Area).
In your role, you will:

• Lead and develop a high-performing team of Clinical Scientists and Medical Writers, fostering a culture of ownership and coaching to ensure talent reaches its full potential.

• Strategically oversee clinical and regulatory excellence across the Oncology Early Development portfolio, ensuring high-quality documentation (Protocols, IBs, CSRs) and optimal resource allocation.

• Drive innovative trial design and data interpretation in close partnership with Medical and Biomarker leadership to optimize clinical development plans and dose selection.

• Influence global strategy and external networks as a core member of the Leadership Team, while maintaining a patient-centric approach through a network of world-class investigators and advisors.

• Proactively identify and implement new/best practices and work cross-functionally within Roche with other Clinical, Statistics, Data Management, Data & Analytics, Medical Writing, Clinical Operations and other stakeholders to ensure quality, speed and consistency across studies in Oncology Early Clinical Development.

• Chair or co-chair the Protocol Review Forum; member of the Development Board; core member of the Early Clinical Development Leadership Team.

Who you are
You thrive in a dynamic, inclusive environment, which gives you full accountability for your own contributions and development. You have a keen interest in continuously building a personal network. You are resourceful and flexible in problem solving and in working in a collaborative and inclusive manner. You create an innovative and inclusive culture and have a sense for ensuring that everyone has the required information at all times.

● You hold a PhD and/or PharmD/MD
● You have extensive Pharma / Biotech industry experience with a minimum of 8 years experi

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Pharmaceutical Development DP SM Parenterals group is responsible for the development of parenteral drug products Synthetic molecules from Phase 1 through Launch. Activities encompass formulation and manufacturing process development for all clinical stages and the market , the transfer of product and process to commercial manufacturing sites,as well as line extension development.

We are seeking a seasoned expert to play an anchor role in the development and launch of parenteral peptide formulations, particularly within the Pharmaceutical Development DP SM Parenterals group in Pharma Technical Development (PTD) in Basel.

The opportunity:

The position requires deep scientific expertise and strategic vision to support the drug development portfolio (CMC expertise) and drive innovation within cross-functional teams.

• Develop the technical roadmap defining activities for industrialization readiness for the peptides portfolio through strategic collaboration with global stakeholders

• Advise and coach the CMC teams for the development of robust formulations and manufacturing processes managing risks and mitigations for parenteral DP synthetic molecules portfolio ensuring timely delivery of technical activities

• Stay updated on advancements in peptide research, formulation science, and parenteral drug development to advise on cutting-edge practices.

• Lead scientific strategies and decision-making processes to deliver optimized development and research plans.

• Mentor and coach staff in preparation and authoring of CTA and New Drug Applications (NDAs).

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to address challenges and ensure success in research and development programs.

Who You Are:

• You hold a Ph.D. or master’s degree in chemistry, chemical/process engineering, or related fields, with a minimum of 6 years of industry experience in formulation and process development for peptide parenteral dosage forms.

• Proven track record of authoring Drug Product (DP) sections of an NDA for peptide products and developing and launching peptide combination products for parenteral use.

• Deep expertise in chemistry, solid-state characterization, and related scientific fields.

• Experience in peptide analytical techniques, aseptic manufacturing processes, scale-up, technology transfers, and understanding regulatory and quality requirements.

• Direct experience in writing and reviewing regulatory CMC source and submission documents, with a demonstrated ability to assess program and submission risks from a drug product formulation and manufacturing perspective.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with strong stakeholder management and the ability to think end-to-end and globally.

• A proven team player with a problem-solving mindset and a passion for innovation in the pharmaceutical field.

We are looking for candidates based in or willing to relocate to Basel , with the expectation of working from the office a minimum of three days per week .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healt

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities

 Drive strategic and organizational alignment
- Drive alignment and coordination of goals, priorities, and efforts for the Medical Affairs Department.
- Establish and maintain a structure for co-creation and co-execution of WBO.
- Develop and support the Medical Affairs team around future-looking vision, mission and strategic initiatives.
- Lead cross-therapeutic areas and functions strategic programs to support Medical Affairs priorities.
 Lead operational efforts to execute medical excellence
- Lead in working across boundaries within the broader organization and cross-functional team to establish excellent ways of working/ process workflows.
- Enable the implementation of strategic priorities with a closed-loop management approach.
- Lead in developing integrated medical plan across Medical Affairs department to prioritize tasks to ensure strategic focus and timely execution of deliverables.
- Enable the operational effectiveness of Medical Affairs to manage complexity and oversee the performance; Responsibility for development & delivery of medical dashboard and associated metrics with cross-functional teams by timely collection, reporting and aligned interpretation of performance metrics and key activities across Medical Affairs department.
- Organize regular meetings and activities, ensuring seamless coordination across value chains.
- Gather and prepare internal and external information for the Medical Affairs Head to facilitate key business decisions and generate important speeches/slides.
 Drive for people excellence
- Drive development of Medical Affairs competencies; Oversight of Medical Affairs professional development and training both in terms of technical as well as soft skills.
People development and management to building up the capacity and capability of medical excellence team by providing coaching and feedback to team members.

Qualification and Experience

Education/Qualifications
- Master’s degree and above with Medical, R&D, Marketing, Access or Corporate strategy experience in Pharmaceutical or related industry. MBA or top consulting firm background is a plus.
- Have experience in people leadership.

Leadership Competencies
- A VACC (visionary, architect, coach, catalyst) leader
- Ability to influence and manage in a matrix organization
- Ability to build an effective team and handle difficult people issues
- Excellent influential, communication and negotiation skills
- Strong cross-functional collaboration capability. Self-motivated

Job Required Competencies
- Strategic agility with innovative approaches
- Deep understanding of medical affairs value to the whole business, customer and patients
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Mandarin and English
- Confident in communication with management team, ability to partner and connect with people from all levels of the medical organization.
- Good strategic agility and analytic capability.
- Have the ability to see the big picture as well as the sensitivity to critical details.
- Track record in project management and problem-solving skills to handle complexity.
- High learning agility and open-minded and able to work under pressure.

jobs.title: System Shaping Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join the Health System Shaping Lab as a System Shaping Partner . This pivotal role is your opportunity to drive large-scale, long-term national health system reform. Leverage your deep policy expertise and strategic agility to proactively influence legislation, align diverse stakeholders, and ensure sustainable access to cutting-edge healthcare for patients.

As the strategic analyst and implementation expert, you will report to the Government & External Affairs Lead. Your core mission is to shape a resilient market environment by addressing systemic healthcare challenges and championing policy changes that directly support our organization's strategic vision—both current and future.

Key Accountabilities

• Policy and Legislative Foresight: Conduct advanced Legislative Monitoring and Policy Analysis to deliver strategic intelligence, mitigate risks, and uncover opportunities for healthcare innovation.

• National Advocacy: Design and execute high-impact advocacy initiatives, including the development of compelling narratives, position papers, and white papers to advance our National Policy Shaping strategy.

• Stakeholder Ecosystem Collaboration: Build and maintain strategic partnerships with critical external stakeholders—policymakers, thought leaders, payers, and academic institutions—to build evidence and co-create solutions that generate mutual value for patient care and system efficiency.

• Integrated Strategy Execution: Collaborate seamlessly with the Commercialization Community to ensure a unified "OneRoche" approach in all external engagements and communications.

Candidate Profile
Education and Professional Experience

• Education: Master’s degree (required) in Business, Economy, Health Economics, Medicine, Pharmacy, or an equivalent academic background in Life Sciences.

• Experience:

• Minimum 5 years of proven experience in Reimbursement, Market/Patient Access, or Health Policy, demonstrating a comprehensive understanding of healthcare financing, reimbursement systems, and relevant compliance frameworks.

• Minimum 7 years of professional experience within the Health Care sector in Slovakia.

Required Mindset and Competencies

• Strategic Agility: Ability to maintain a clear focus on the long-term vision while effectively navigating ambiguity, complexity, and uncertainty.

• System Thinking: Capacity to think and operate at an enterprise level, looking beyond organizational boundaries to achieve optimal outcomes for the local health environment.

• Impactful Communication: Exceptional skill in articulating complex value propositions and translating external insights into actionable intelligence for internal teams.

• Agile Mindset: Enthusiastic adoption of agile, self-managed working models based on trust, continuous learning, and adaptability.

• VACC Leadership: Embodies the principles of Visionary, Architect, Coach, and Catalyst, driving change both externally and internally.

jobs.title: Government & External Affairs Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Position: Government & External Affairs Lead
Team: Health System Shaping Lab
Reports to: General Manager

Roche Slovensko is seeking a Government & External Affairs Lead to join the Local Leadership Team (Purpose Enabling Board - PEB). This senior role is responsible for shaping national policy and creating patient access strategies.

The successful candidate will proactively drive changes in the national policy and legislative environment. You will lead strategies to influence key stakeholders, ensuring patient access to our innovations. This position requires strategic thinking, political knowledge, and an entrepreneurial approach to impact the Slovak healthcare system.

Key Responsibilities:

• Policy Advocacy: Lead targeted efforts to influence public health and pricing legislation to drive systemic improvements for patient access and innovation.

• Stakeholder Management: Develop and maintain strong, strategic relationships with political stakeholders, decision-makers, and payers at the national level.

• External Representation: Serve as the primary representative for OneRoche, building alliances with external organizations to enhance reputation and create value.

• Strategic Alignment: Manage the External Engagement Strategy, ensuring it supports Patient Access goals and integrates across Pharma, Diagnostics, and the wider Roche enterprise.

• Leadership: Participate in the Purpose Enabling Board (Affiliate Leadership Team), connecting the Health System Shaping group's goals to the affiliate strategy, and guiding the team.

Required Qualifications:

• Experience: Minimum 5 years in Government & External Affairs (policy/network development). Minimum 7 years of experience in the Slovak Health Care. Minimum 6 months in leadership roles.

• Expertise:
Deep understanding of healthcare funding and external conditions impacting the system. Proven ability in strategy development, execution, and navigating complex or uncertain situations (Triple Win concept).

• Mindset:

• Systemic & Enabling: Focus on leveraging networks for value creation and scaling.

• Entrepreneurial: Self-managed, comfortable with risk, committed to continuous learning.

• Ethical: High integrity and strong alignment with affiliate values.

• Skills:
Strategic Thinking (Enterprise Mindset), VACC Leadership, Influencing, Effective Decision Making (in ambiguity), Strategic Agility (managing long-term goals amid change).

• Education & Language:
Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Medicine, Law, Health Economics). Fluent in Slovak and proficient in English.

Salary starts from 5410 EUR gross/month. Roche Slovakia provides 13th month Salary. Final salary depends on the level of experience, skills and qualifications

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
