jobs.title: Global Medical Affairs Lead Genomic Profiling

titleByLocale.en: Global Medical Affairs Lead Genomic Profiling
titleByLocale.it: Responsabile Global Medical Affairs Genomic Profiling
titleByLocale.de: Global Medical Affairs Lead Genomic Profiling
titleByLocale.fr: Global Medical Affairs Lead Genomic Profiling

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Join an experienced and collaborative team of dedicated Global Medical Affairs Leads in Clinical Development and Medical Affairs (CDMA) at Roche Diagnostics. Work with the International Business team for Foundation Medicine ex-US on the development and commercialization of Comprehensive Genomic Profiling and molecular diagnostics solutions in oncology and hematology. This is an unparalleled opportunity for career development and job satisfaction as you help advancements in personalized healthcare around the globe to improve patient experiences and outcomes. The position is based in Basel, Switzerland.

The Opportunity

• Subject matter expertise in cancer genomics, oncology and hematology diagnostics to provide strategic medical and scientific input and leadership developing global medical strategies for integrated evidence generation, investigator-initiated studies, research collaborations and medical communications, as well as executing medical activities including advisory boards, scientific symposia, independent or sponsored medical education or training events.

• Build strong partnerships with medical and patient communities including global thought leaders, investigators, academic networks and professional societies to drive safe adoption of comprehensive genomic profiling solutions while ensuring operational excellence and compliance with industry regulations and HCP interaction guidelines.

• Develop and deliver content for timely and effective communication of science and clinical data within and outside the organization in educational programs, publications and congress presentations.

• Partner across functions, regions, cultures, and time zones to create an environment of belonging and identify mutual value and opportunities for collaborations.

• Champion patient and customer-centricity in mindset, behaviors and actions by always putting the needs of the patients and customers first.

• Model Roche’s values of integrity, courage, and passion and We@Roche Diagnostics (culture, mindset and behaviors) in everything you do.

• Act in line with legal, regulatory and company standards and codes of practice including Roche Code of Conduct and other relevant directives and guidelines.

• Ensure compliance with HCP interaction guidelines, handle compliance questions and considerations, complete all required training and specific responsibilities beyond the standard scope of work and oversee appropriate documentation and reporting.

• Work independently and autonomously, act as coach for colleagues with less experience.

Who you are

You’re someone who wants to advance healthcare globally and influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies, where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point.

• You have extensive knowledge and expertise in cancer genomics with an advanced degree (MD and/or PhD) in related disciplines, as well as 5+ years of industry experience in oncology and hematology medical affairs or development leading the design and implementation of clinical studies, scientific communication and educational efforts that help tailor treatment to individual patients.

• You have a deep understanding of molecular-guided therapeutic approaches and clinical practice guidelines, translating genomics and real-world data into clinically relevant actions in complex healthcare ecosystems.

• You have excel

• Develop and deliver content for timely and effective communication of science and clinical data within and outside the organization in educational programs, publications and congress presentations.

• Partner across functions, regions, cultures, and time zones to create an environment of belonging and identify mutual value and opportunities for collaborations.

• Champion patient and customer-centricity in mindset, behaviors and actions by always putting the needs of the patients and customers first.

• Model Roche’s values of integrity, courage, and passion and We@Roche Diagnostics (culture, mindset and behaviors) in everything you do.

• Act in line with legal, regulatory and company standards and codes of practice including Roche Code of Conduct and other relevant directives and guidelines.

• Ensure compliance with HCP interaction guidelines, handle compliance questions and considerations, complete all required training and specific responsibilities beyond the standard scope of work and oversee appropriate documentation and reporting.

• Work independently and autonomously, act as coach for colleagues with less experience.

You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies, where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point.

• You have extensive knowledge and expertise in cancer genomics with an advanced degree (MD and/or PhD) in related disciplines, as well as 5+ years of industry experience in oncology and hematology medical affairs or development leading the design and implementation of clinical studies, scientific communication and educational efforts that help tailor treatment to individual patients.

• You have a deep understanding of molecular-guided therapeutic approaches and clinical practice guidelines, translating genomics and real-world data into clinically relevant actions in complex healthcare ecosystems.

• You have excel

jobs.title: Strategic Account Executive - Pathology Lab

titleByLocale.it: Esecutivo del Conto Strategico - Laboratorio di Patologia

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Strategic Account Executive

The Opportunity:
This role supports our Tissue Diagnostics franchise and will be responsible for meeting and exceeding sales objectives in targeted accounts across specified territories.

Responsible for meeting and exceeding sales objectives (capital instruments & reagents) in targeted Anatomic Pathology labs within the assigned geography. This role is focused on the region’s largest customers, large strategic scenarios, reference labs and competitive opportunities. Must maintain & grow existing accounts & develop new accounts in the assigned geography. Develop partnerships with all levels of Buying Influences to include: C-Suite, Lab Directors, Lab Managers, Histotechnologist, Safety Officers, Materials Management, etc. Additionally, position requires value quantification presentations to potential customers.

This is a field based role: the territory includes Michigan (Detroit, Ann Arbor, Grand Rapids). Prefer candidate to reside in Detroit area. Candidates must reside within 50 miles of the territory border. Relocation benefits are not provided for this role.

Job Facts:

• Must demonstrate in-depth knowledge of the full portfolio of products offered by Roche Diagnostics, Tissue Division.

• Actively promote and sell Roche products and software solutions to customers through daily engagement with Pathologists, Medical Directors, Lab Administration and Lab technicians.

• Proven ability to manage and prioritize multiple account management projects at a time, while maintaining sharp attention to detail

• Meet with customers to discuss their evolving needs and to assess the quality of our company’s relationship with them

• Coordinate the involvement of company personnel, including support, service, and management resources (specialists), in order to meet account performance objectives and customers’ expectations.

• Proactively lead a joint company-strategic account planning process that develops mutual performance objectives, financial targets, and critical milestones for a one and three-year period.

• Clearly communicate the progress of monthly/quarterly initiatives to internal and external stakeholders

• Proactively assesses, clarifies, and validates customer needs on an ongoing basis.

• Achieves assigned sales quota in designated strategic accounts.

• Closely coordinates company executive involvement and Customer Service Representatives to ensure customer satisfaction and problem resolution.

• Customer focused selling skills are a must to drive consistent results & partnerships.

Who you are (minimum qualifications):

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• You hold 5+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience

Preferred Qualifications:

• Capital sales experience

• Pathology/Digital Pathology sales experience

• Strategic planning and organizational skills

• Experience working with multiple call points (lab managers, directors, clinicians, c-suite)

• Proven leadership abilities

• Understanding of performance metrics

• Ability to work in a regulated environment

• Excellent oral and written communication skills including making impactful presentations

• Hands on experience with CRM software and MS Office (particularly MS Excel)

• Strong negotiation skills with a problem-solving attitude

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Michigan is $105,100 - $195,300. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and o

jobs.title: Sales Executive, Near Patient Care

titleByLocale.it: Sales Executive, Vicino alla cura del paziente

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Rcohe Diagnostics

The Mission:

• Achieve the sales budget of the assigned territories as per sales plan

• Promotion of Near Patient Care Product Portfolio ( Diabetes Care and Point of Care products) to Diabetes Mellitus Centres in Hospital Authority hospitals, Patient Resources Centres, NGOs, private hospitals, primary care and specialist clinics, Community Health Districts Centres, and Health Management groups in Hong Kong and Macau

• Implement sales promotion strategies as per plan

Job Details:

Achieve the sales budget of the assigned territories as per the sales plan

• Implement promotion plan for Near Patient Care Product Portfolio (Diabetes Care and POC products) and achieve sales target as per sales plan

• Provide product demonstration to healthcare professionals and end-users

• Create demand by providing accurate and up-to-date product information and medical values support to physicians, pharmacists, and other customers

• Update relevant account-related activities to Company Customer Relation Management systems or equivalent systems

Build good relationships with customers

• Develop and maintain good relationships with key opinion leaders, doctors, pharmacists, nurses and other customers

• Explore collaboration or partnership with NGOs to expand patient access

Collect and report market information and intelligence

• Actively collect market information

• Timely update of sales activities in Salesforce

• Keep up-to-date product information vs competition

• Prepare sales argumentation against competitive products

• Collect market intelligent information for market and sales analysis

Qualification & Expereince :

• University graduate or above

• 5 year of sales experience, preferably in the Pharmaceutical or Medical Device industry

• Good communication skills

• Accountable, self-motivated and a good team player

• Possess basic knowledge of science

• MS word, Excel, Access literacy

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Mission Statement
Finance Enterprise Partner is a critical role to maximize Revenue and Profitability by acting as a Co-driver and Guardian of the business.
The role's core mission is to provide a holistic, forward-looking financial view of the Japanese In-Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) market, enabling leaders to make faster, better strategic decisions.
Finance Enterprise Partner is not a support function but an active co-pilot of business performance, sitting at the intersection of finance, strategy, and commercial execution to establish a profit-driven company culture to achieve long-term company ambition.

Core Responsibilities
Finance Enterprise Partner will mainly focus on three core pillars:

1. Financial Planning & Analysis
[Planning & Forecasting]

• Lead & facilitate the rolling forecast events: drive annual budget, monthly forecast, and mid-term planning, ensuring strict alignment with commercial strategy.

• Design and maintain comprehensive financial models: incorporate volume, price, product mix and cost assumptions to ensure robust and agile financial planning.

[Performance Monitoring & Visualization]

• Drive performance reviews with clear and actionable visualization: produce executive-level dashboards and visualize performance by portfolio, product, and segment to foster shared understanding and clarify current financial positioning for next actions.

• Own the Gross Margin bridge analysis and prepare financial commentary, KPI scorecards, and forward-looking outlooks to clearly explain variances between actuals, budget, and prior periods with clear business narratives.

[Business Insights & Scenario Planning]

• Provide actionable business insights: proactively identify risks and opportunities in P&L and bring data-driven recommendations, focusing on actionable strategies beyond mere analysis. Translate macro market trends (pricing pressure, tender cycles, aging demographics) into quantified financial impact and scenario analysis.

2. Advanced management decision support
[Strategic Profitability Management]

• Evaluate and challenge current strategies for new and existing businesses. Conduct product-level and customer-level margin analysis to identify revenue growth opportunities, surface dilutive contracts, and prioritize high-value segments.

[Financial modeling for Complex Deals]

• Partner on strategic deals: build deal-level financial models, ROI analyses, pricing frameworks, and risk-adjusted projections. Participate in key customer strategic business reviews, providing top management with value-added financial insights and suggestions, bringing financial credibility to commercial discussions.

[Smart Risk Taking & Problem Solving]

• Enable "Smart Risks" for complex business cases: establish a collaborative system with business members to advance tough and highly complex business cases. Maximize value by providing expert quantitative analysis, consultation, and improvement proposals that drive strategic decisions.

3. Foster Profit-Driven Culture & Establish Organizational Governance
[Profit-Driven Culture]

• Foster financial acumen across the organization: contribute to profitability improvement and cultural change by embedding a mindset where all employees routinely engage in activities for profit improvement as their own responsibility.

[Cross-Functional Value Creation]

• Drive cross-functional financial initiatives: partner with Supply Chain, Commercial Operations, Finance Excellence and other groups to model the financial impa

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
職務の目的
ロシュのパーパスである ”Doing now what patients need next” 、Healthcare Excellence (HCE)　本部のビジョン「RDKKのビジネスを支え、日本の医療課題解決への道を切り拓いていく」を具現化するため、薬事グループは、薬事許認可プロセスマネジメントを通じて許認可を取得/維持することで、我々の検査に患者がアクセスできる環境を確保します。

職務内容
弊社製品（免疫・生化学・遺伝子・病理検査関連の試薬、機器、プログラムなど）の薬事申請担当者として、他の3グループ（クオリティマネジメントグループ、Medical Scientific Affairs、マーケットアクセス・ガバメントアフェアーズグループ）と連携して、以下の業務を行っていただきます。

• 製品導入関連部署（Global Regulatory Team、ビジネスチーム、メディカルチームなど）と連携して、合理的な薬事導入戦略を立案する

• PMDA相談等の実施、行政（厚労省、PMDA）担当者、Global担当者との折衝を通して、論理的かつ合理的な体外診断用医薬品、医療機器（プログラム医療機器を含む）の製造販売の許認可申請および取得、並びに許認可の維持を遂行する

• 社内での薬事関連業務（変更管理、包材・各種資料の確認など）の遂行

• ジュニアスタッフの人財育成

求める経験

• 体外診断用医薬品あるいは医療機器（プログラム医療機器の経験であれば尚可）の薬事申請業務の経験（3年以上）を有すること。

• 経験年数とともに職責を広げ、業務を自律的・主体的に進め、成果を上げた経験。

求める知識・スキル、マインドセット

• 薬事関連法規に関する一般的な知識。

• 生化学、生物学、免疫学、微生物学、工学、農学又は薬学に関連する学位（同等もしくはそれ以上でも可）。生化学・免疫・遺伝子・病理検査、プログラム医療機器に関する知識があれば尚可。

• 生化学、生物学、免疫学、微生物学、工学、農学又は薬学系の科学技術論文、データの解釈ができるスキル。

• 読み書きする英語力は必須。加えて日常会話以上の英語力（ビジネスレベルであれば尚可）。

• 論理的な思考力、並びに文章構成力（正確性を含む）。

• 日常業務に限らず各種プロジェクトにおいても職務グレードによらず、業務/プロジェクトを自律的・主体的に進めることができるリーダーシップ。

• 関連部署とのコミュニケーション力、調整能力。

• 薬事スペシャリストとして、新しい分野を学び、挑戦する意欲があること。

• Growth MindsetとOut of Box Thinking：成長思考を持ち、これまでの経験にとらわれずに革新的な発想ができること。

海外関連部署を含め、他部門とのコミュニケーションを積極的に取り、建設的な発想を論理的、合理的な思考で実現することができる方を求めています。
ヘルスケアのリーディングカンパニーで薬事スペシャリストとして活躍できるポジションです。ロシュ・グローバルとの繋がりも密接であり、グローバルなキャリアを望む方にも、社内留学制度など、グローバル・キャリア・パスをサポートする体制が整備されています。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love

• Co-create with DAN, PPOCs, local Enablers and other functions to build DA/TA integrated strategies and OBP (DA affiliate outcomes: LTO, MTO & STO) - aligned with global and regional strategies.

• Support DAN, PPOCs on building and reviewing business planning, re-define go-to-market model

• Collaborate with PPOCs to engage with local stakeholders/partners to provide and validate local market competition and customers insights

• Support DAN and PPOCs on market research to gain market insights for building strategies

• Lead and collaborate with PPOCs and other stakeholders to conduct the short term, mid term and long term forecasting of business for related TAs

• Co-create with DAN and PPOCs to create promotional materials and build digital marketing contents for both HCPs and patients

• Provide input, develop and adaptation to all promotional materials in local language in alignment with Roche code of conduct and local regulations

• Give advices for email/App/HCP platform campaign content

• Support PPOCs on Email/App/HCP platform campaign deployment

• Provide input for the development of, and develop Digital Integrated Personalized Offerings

• Internal training:

• Provide input and adaptation to all training materials required in local languages.

• Local Marketing Enablers may be required to conduct the training for PPOCs in the local language

• Collaborate with DAN and PPOCs for implementing OBP. Prioritize efforts to DA/TA Work Packages requiring highly localized insights and/or activities

• Promotional & medical events management (i.e. national level events/webinars)

• Collaborate with PPOCs to manage Grant/ Sponsorship/ Donation

• Co-create with PPOCs and other enablers on stakeholders mapping, managing relationships with local HCP organizations

• Lead the access and pricing strategy for all DA related products.

• Collaborate with Access and other functions to develop and deploy pricing strategies (including PN, FPS)

• Lead the deployment of FPS/PSP programs in alignment with DA strategies.

• Collaborate with the Access & Policy Chapter in HTA assessment, reimbursement listing

• Coordinate with local distributors to ensure drug supply to patients (including formulary listing)

• Coordinate with other functions for monthly rolling forecast and supply planning to ensure drug availability.

• Must-have University degree in Pharmacy/Medical

• Additional Master / MBA is an advantage

• Additional Master / Bachelor Degree of Marketing is an advantage

• Competent Market analytics

• Experience in developing/ launching new business(es)/ product(s).

jobs.title: Market Access and Policy Advisor
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role scope :

• Develop and implement market access strategies/solutions for strategic products covering reimbursement, pricing, pharmacoeconomics/HTA strategy, and policy-related strategy to maximize patient access and portfolio value.

• Shape sustainable pricing strategies from pre-launch through lifecycle management, aligned with overall portfolio and long-term business objectives.

• Prioritize pipeline assets and define access pathways to ensure successful future launches.

• Ensure payer relevant evidence is generated through clinical trials, health economic modeling, real-world evidence studies, systematic literature research and meta-analysis effectively to demonstrate the value comprehensively.

• Translate evidence into compelling value propositions tailored to Taiwan payer and policy environment.

• Identify patient access opportunities and/or issues/barriers and develop access solutions to address them and create access for patients for Roche innovations in self-pay market

• Engage external stakeholders to remove access barriers and deliver value based discussion for Roche products.

• Reimbursement:

• Work cross functionally with PPOC, Marketing, and Medical stakeholders to develop the reimbursement strategy and engagement plan with KOL and advocacy groups.

• Collect data and prepare a dossier for the National Health Insurance Administration (NHIA) submission. Highlight the key evidence and product value proposition for the payer.

• Support policy shaping activities to support patient access as appropriate.

• Lead negotiation and contracting processes to secure an optimal outcome for the company

• Collaborate with the global team and other affiliates through the network to ensure alignment on the access and pricing strategy.

• Contribute to the planning and execution of our policy and health system shaping activities to ensure the system is ready and willing to recognize, value, and reimburse our future innovations.

Qualifications:

• Good compliance track record. No material compliance violation has been identified in the past 5 years.

Education:

• A bachelor degree in the field (pharmacy, nursing, public health, economics, public policy). An advanced (Master’s or doctorate) degree is preferred.

Working Experience:

• Experience working on reimbursement applications and self-pay strategy is preferred

• Some prior commercial experience within the pharmaceutical, medical device, or broader healthcare industry is essential.

• Familiar with NHIA process of medical devices and key stakeholders.

Skills & Knowledge:

• Strong business acumen with ability to think strategically.

• Deep appreciation of science and ability to translate scientific information into strategy. Ability to take evidence and other complex data and convert them into easy to understand deliverables that can support commercial use.

• Possess an understanding of the access landscape, relevant stakeholder groups, value assessment/HTA methods and pricing concepts.

• Possess an understanding of how policies are made within the healthcare system, including identifying key institutions and stakeholders involved and the importance of policy in shaping the healthcare environment.

• A collaborative attitude and ability to manage multiple demands and priorities on time, influence without authority, gain alignment and drive decision making.

• Excellent communication and leadership skills are a must with a strong track record of delivering results in a matrix-based environmen

jobs.title: Product Specialist Trainee (Portuguese speaker)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Product Specialist Trainee, your main responsibility will be to provide specialized remote technical and applications support to users of our analyzers in the Anatomic Pathology and Molecular Biology product lines. You will be responsible for maintaining excellent communication, follow-up, and proactive collaboration with customers to ensure a rapid resolution of any issues or requests raised. This position offers a hybrid work arrangement. You will have the flexibility to work remotely while also having the opportunity to collaborate and engage with colleagues in the office.

Key Responsibilities:

• Provide specialized remote technical and applications support to users of our analyzers in the Anatomic Pathology and Molecular Biology product lines

• Maintain excellent communication, follow-up, and proactive collaboration with customers

• Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues in a timely manner

• Document and escalate complex issues to higher-level support teams when necessary

• Provide training and guidance to customers on the operation and maintenance of our analyzers

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure customer satisfaction

Required Profile:

• Students of Biomedical Engineering, Biomedicine, or Health and Life Sciences.

• Ability to make curricular and/or extracurricular internship agreements

• Fluent in Spanish and English (conversational and good writing skills), Portuguese is a must

• Proactive and solution-oriented mindset

• Strong teamwork and collaboration skills

• Interest in new technologies

• Analytical thinking

What do we offer?

During the internship, you will get an insight into a global company. As a Product Specialist Trainee, you will have the opportunity to gain practical experience and develop your skills in the following areas:

• Learn the functioning of a microbiology and/or anatomical pathology laboratory.

• Receive specific product training on Roche's offerings in these areas.

• Enhance your communication, troubleshooting and customer service skills and expand your network within the company.

• Develop essential core skills such as customer interaction, critical thinking, intercultural collaboration, and resilience.

• Provide remote support to customers and field specialists, assisting with troubleshooting, application usage, and implementing new protocols.

Additionally, you will have the chance to collaborate with cross-functional and collaborate with global teams when necessary. This internship will provide valuable hands-on experience and the opportunity to contribute to customer satisfaction.

You will learn what "Customer centricity" means and how the Global Customer Support of Roche Diagnostics implements this in its daily work.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

You will be responsible for maintaining excellent communication, follow-up, and proactive collaboration with customers to ensure a rapid resolution of any issues or requests raised. This position offers a hybrid work arrangement. You will have the flexibility to work remotely while also having the opportunity to collaborate and engage with colleagues in the office.

Key Responsibilities:

• Provide specialized remote technical and applications support to users of our analyzers in the Anatomic Pathology and Molecular Biology product lines

• Maintain excellent communication, follow-up, and proactive collaboration with customers

• Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues in a timely manner

• Document and escalate complex issues to higher-level support teams when necessary

• Provide training and guidance to customers on the operation and maintenance of our analyzers

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure customer satisfaction

Required Profile:

• Students of Biomedical Engineering, Biomedicine, or Health and Life Sciences.

• Ability to make curricular and/or extracurricular internship agreements

• Fluent in Spanish and English (conversational and good writing skills), Portuguese is a must

• Proactive and solution-oriented mindset

• Strong teamwork and collaboration skills

• Interest in new technologies

• Analytical thinking

What do we offer?

During the internship, you will get an insight into a global company. As a Product Specialist Trainee, you will have the opportunity to gain practical experience and develop your skills in the following areas:

• Learn the functioning of a microbiology and/or anatomical pathology laboratory.

• Receive specific product training on Roche's offerings in these areas.

• Enhance your communication, troubleshooting and customer service skills and expand your network within the company.

• Develop essential core skills such as customer interaction, critical thinking, intercultural collaboration, and resilience.

• Provide remote support to customers and field specialists, assisting with troubleshooting, application usage, and implementing new protocols.

Additionally, you will have the chance to collaborate with cross-functional and collaborate with global teams when necessary. This internship will provide valuable hands-on experience and the opportunity to contribute to customer satisfaction.

You will learn what "Customer centricity" means and how the Global Customer Support of Roche Diagnostics implements this in its daily work.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Institute of Human Biology (IHB), embedded within Roche’s Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED) Division, is a leading research institute focused on accelerating the development of transformative medicines. It specializes in developing novel and robust human model systems that functionally resemble human physiology and disease. By bridging the gap between academic discovery and industrial application, IHB facilitates the rapid translation of groundbreaking science into patient-focused solutions.

The Opportunity

We are building next-generation human kidney models by tackling a central unsolved problem in the field: how to generate organotypic, vascularized kidney organoids that show enhanced maturation.

As part of a newly funded IHB fellowship, you will drive an ambitious research program at the interface of stem cell biology, vascular biology, and single-cell genomics, with the goal of creating translationally relevant systems for drug discovery and safety.

In this role, you will define innovative approaches to uncover the biological principles of vascular–parenchymal interaction, ultimately helping to establish a new class of human model systems through the following responsibilities:

• Drive the development of vascularized iPSC-derived kidney organoids, with a focus on tissue specification and maturation

• Use single-cell genomics to dissect endothelial specification, nephron maturation, and cell–cell communication

• Work closely with bioengineers to integrate biology into perfusable, next-generation culture systems

• Translate biological insights into functional, predictive models relevant for human kidney safety

Who You Are

• A scientist with a PhD and a strong track record in iPSC-derived 3D tissue models or organoids. To qualify for this early-career position, you must have completed your doctoral studies within the last four years.

• Experienced in generating and analysing single-cell transcriptomic data and comfortable translating complex datasets into biological insight

• Scientifically ambitious, with the ability to drive new concepts rather than follow established protocols

• Ideally with a strong background in developmental biology, with expertise in kidney, vascular, or related organ systems

Additional Information

You will be embedded in a highly interdisciplinary ecosystem at IHB, working with leading experts in bioengineering, stem cell biology, and computational analysis, and closely connected to Roche’s drug discovery and safety teams.
This is a unique opportunity to define how human kidney models are built and used in the future—from fundamental biology to direct impact on drug development.

Application Process

To apply, please submit the following materials:

• Current CV: Please provide a comprehensive CV, including a full list of your peer-reviewed publications.

• Professional References: Include contact details for two references who can speak to your scientific expertise and professional character.

• Ph.D. Documentation: Provide an official diploma or certificate confirming your degree (if already obtained).

• Timeline & Availability: The start date of this position is 1st September 2026.

The initial duration is for 2 years, with the potential for extension.

jobs.title: MarTech Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Marketing Technologies (MarTech) embedded within the GPS Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI) function, will bring together key business and IT capabilities with the ambition to add meaning and value to all Roche’s customer interactions through a single, common, integrated customer-centric technology ecosystem.

The Marketing Technologies (MarTech) Business Operations Manager is a critical role dedicated to ensuring that our technology investments translate into tangible business performance.
Rather than focusing on technical maintenance, you will oversee a business readiness framework, designing the governance and operational structures that allow our teams to capitalize on new tools without disrupting core performance. You are the custodian of the "run state," responsible for ensuring that the business outcomes and growth are enhanced through the effective use of technology.
A primary driver of success for this role is the continuous evolution of our business processes. Your objective is to ensure that our operational model is not just stable, but a competitive advantage, delivering measurable improvements in speed-to-market, cost-to-serve, and overall organisational productivity.

The Opportunity
As the Business Operations Manager, you are responsible for implementing changes and managing the service model to ensure the long-term operational success and sustainability of our business platforms. You will support the Business Operations Lead in managing the entire transition from project-led implementation to a stable, continuous, and high-performing "business as usual" (BAU) state.

• Audit existing business workflows to identify inefficiencies; lead the design and implementation of "to-be" processes that maximize the value of our technology stack while simplifying user experience

• Implementation of the "run-state" governance required to manage ongoing business process changes. You will ensure that any future technical iterations are prioritized based on their ability to deliver business value and organizational stability

• Partner with end users to assess how technical shifts impact the user and operational layers of the business, ensuring that resource allocation is optimized for new ways of working and relevant services are resourced and trained appropriately

• Identifies gaps in the operational model that translate into missed/lost value realisation and propose tactics to capitalise on missed opportunities

• Operationalise the 'run-state' governance framework for managing ongoing business process, solution, data and user changes after go-live

• Establish and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) related to process speed, cost-to-serve, and operational friction, driving a culture of continuous improvement

• Manage stakeholder alignment (with vendors, RDT/IT, and business) to ensure all transition plans and the future "run" model are co-created and fully supported

Who you are
Success in this role requires a highly structured, process-oriented leader with a deep understanding of business operations and service management. You are the steady hand that ensures the program's strategic vision becomes a stable, reliable, and continuously improving operational reality.
Key characteristics include:

• >3 years of experience in Business Operations, Service Delivery in a large-scale, global environment with a strong understanding of how to run and support enterprise platforms in a "business as usual&#

You are the custodian of the "run state," responsible for ensuring that the business outcomes and growth are enhanced through the effective use of technology.
A primary driver of success for this role is the continuous evolution of our business processes. Your objective is to ensure that our operational model is not just stable, but a competitive advantage, delivering measurable improvements in speed-to-market, cost-to-serve, and overall organisational productivity.

The Opportunity
As the Business Operations Manager, you are responsible for implementing changes and managing the service model to ensure the long-term operational success and sustainability of our business platforms. You will support the Business Operations Lead in managing the entire transition from project-led implementation to a stable, continuous, and high-performing "business as usual" (BAU) state.

• Implementation of the "run-state" governance required to manage ongoing business process changes. You will ensure that any future technical iterations are prioritized based on their ability to deliver business value and organizational stability

• Partner with end users to assess how technical shifts impact the user and operational layers of the business, ensuring that resource allocation is optimized for new ways of working and relevant services are resourced and trained appropriately

• Identifies gaps in the operational model that translate into missed/lost value realisation and propose tactics to capitalise on missed opportunities

• Operationalise the 'run-state' governance framework for managing ongoing business process, solution, data and user changes after go-live

• Establish and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) related to process speed, cost-to-serve, and operational friction, driving a culture of continuous improvement

• Manage stakeholder alignment (with vendors, RDT/IT, and business) to ensure all transition plans and the future "run" model are co-created and fully supported

Success in this role requires a highly structured, process-oriented leader with a deep understanding of business operations and service management. You are the steady hand that ensures the program's strategic vision becomes a stable, reliable, and continuously improving operational reality.
Key characteristics include:

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Team Lead Engineering Primary Data Analysis, Aggregation and Reporting

The Biometrics team is pivotal in drug development, managing the acquisition, ingestion, curation, and analysis of clinical trial and real-world data to enable comprehensive regulatory filings. By ensuring data quality, applying advanced analytics, and adhering to regulatory standards, the team transforms complex datasets into actionable insights. Their work underpins evidence-based decisions, accelerates drug development timelines, and ensures successful regulatory submissions, enabling innovative therapies to reach patients efficiently.

As a Team Lead you will spearhead a high-performing team focused on establishing a simplified, scalable advanced analytics ecosystem. This role is at the forefront of our digital transformation, leveraging AI and machine learning to accelerate primary data analysis for clinical development. You will balance technical visionary leadership with a focus on people development to ensure our data workflows meet the highest production standards.

The Opportunity

• Lead and inspire a high-performing engineering team, fostering an environment of innovation in AI and machine learning.

• Drive the end-to-end delivery of validated, production-grade automated workflows to accelerate clinical data analysis.

• Architect a scalable analytics ecosystem that serves as the foundation for enterprise-wide digital transformation.

• Define an AI driven technical roadmap and platform strategy to consolidate, onboard and host a diverse portfolio of future analytics use cases.

• Refine data analytics workflows to ensure high-quality data ingestion, curation, and actionable insights for regulatory filings.

• Empower team members by supporting self-defined career journeys and removing roadblocks to their professional growth.

• Manage senior stakeholders across Pharma Development, negotiating priorities to align technology with business objectives.

• Champion engineering excellence by implementing initiatives that improve collaboration and psychological safety across development teams.

Who you are

• Proven Engineering Leader: You have 10+ years of experience in people leadership or program management, with a track record of building high-performing teams.

• AI & Machine Learning Expert: You possess deep technical know-how in AI/ML frameworks and their application in advanced analytics ecosystems.

• Data Analytics Specialist: You have extensive experience managing complex data content and primary analysis within a regulated environment.

• Technologically Savvy: You have a strong understanding of software development, process architecture, and modern service delivery methodologies.

• Sector Experienced: Y ou bring 2+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry.

• Academic Background: You hold a Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Business, Information Technology, or a related technical field.

• VACC Leader: Y ou demonstrate Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, and Coach behaviors, effectively navigating ambiguity and complex organizational boundaries.

What you get*:

• Salary range 23,300 - 43,300 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance (target 20%).

• Company car or car allowance.

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Progr

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Maintenance Specialist, you will perform electrical or mechanical troubleshooting to determine problems in non-functioning electro-mechanical equipment used in the manufacturing process. You will dismantle, adjust, repair, and assemble equipment according to layout plans, blueprints, operating or repair manuals, rough sketches or drawings. You’ll use test and diagnostic equipment to perform checkouts. You will rebuild manufacturing equipment as required. You will also perform equipment modifications as directed by manufacturing engineers. You may use predictive maintenance technologies and techniques in order to improve operational efficiencies.

The Maintenance Specialist position will entail specialized knowledge of a particular area, system, or equipment and requires specific training and certification. You will apply some advanced skill to the position or specialization. You may adapt procedures, processes, tools, equipment and techniques to meet the more complex requirements of the position. Your duties are generally routine, but may include non-routine tasks. You will resolve most questions and problems and refer only the most complex issues to higher levels. You will apply basic skills and may develop advanced skills appropriate for the position. Your duties and tasks are standardized. You will work under direct supervision and follow standard procedures to accomplish tasks.
You will also be responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

Responsibilities:

• Performs troubleshooting to determine problems and may be required to do corrective maintenance. Completes preventative maintenance task according to detailed procedures and schedules. May provide emergency call-in support for operations that run during off-hours. Maintain accurate records of all activities.

• Provides technical set-up support for manufacturing areas.

• Performs equipment modifications, including installation, validation support and start-up, of new equipment as well as decommissioning activities.

Requirements:

• High school diploma or equivalency

• 4 years related operations or manufacturing experience

• In-depth knowledge of company policies and procedures

• Basic computer skills

• Must be available to work Sunday -Thursday (10:30pm – 7:00am)

Preferred:

• Associates degree or equivalent military training

• Documented experience troubleshooting and repairing the following types of systems: electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.
The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Indianapolis, is 51,500.00 - 95,700.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, s

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Account Executive - Pathology Lab

The Opportunity:
This role supports our Tissue Diagnostics franchise and will be responsible for meeting and exceeding sales objectives in targeted accounts across specified territories. Typically responsible for medium to large accounts or have a medium to large quota/territory. Must develop customer prospects and create and maintain relationships with decision makers. Contacts/visits existing and potential customers. Works to build and maintain network of colleagues, partners, and customers to share information and obtain prospects. Additionally, position requires value quantification presentations to potential customers. Must demonstrate in-depth knowledge of product line and have a more in-depth knowledge of other products or services.

A seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of area of specialization. Resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This job is the fully qualified, career-oriented position. Has a complete knowledge of company products and services. Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Networks with senior internal and external personnel in own area of expertise. Responsible for selling the company's products or services, developing new accounts and/or expanding existing accounts. Normally receives little instruction on day-to-day work, general instructions on new assignments.

This is a field based role - the territory includes Michigan. Relocation benefits are not provided for this role. You must live within 50 miles of the territory.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

• Contacts new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. This includes identifying and developing strategic account plans, developing and delivering the differentiating message and quantifiable economic value for products and services, selling the primary differentiation of Roche products, overcoming and managing objections, and negotiating to obtain sales.

• Generates demand and maximizes product awareness by working with and providing education and information to customers.

• Implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate sales process and productivity.

• Works with others, as needed or required, to prepare proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.

• Conducts and organizes necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency. Conducts business analysis and planning.

• Communicates competitive market information internally.

• Networks and interfaces with internal colleagues to share information and best practices while remaining actively involved in industry/customer organizations that impact business.

• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• You hold 3 years relevant sales or equivalent experience

• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellowship or rotational program may be considered in lieu of experience.

Preferred:

• Proven leadership abilities

• Negotiation, contracting and pr

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As the Senior Solution Architect, you will be the key responsible for the SAP Solution Manager 7.2 ecosystem. You are responsible for the end-to-end "Requirements to Deploy" (R2D) framework, ensuring that all SAP changes—from global templates to local rollouts—are governed, tested, and deployed with zero disruption. You will lead the configuration, maintenance and optimization of Focused Build and ChaRM to support high-velocity Agile delivery in a complex, multi-track S/4HANA landscapes.

Description of the area
Senior Solution Architect for ERP Application Lifecycle (ALM) Processes, Framework and Tools. Responsible for the strategic design and operational excellence of all ERP specific ALM capabilities related to the end to end process "Requirements to Deploy", incl. and not limited to Business Process Modelling, Requirements, Change, Transport, Release, Test, Defect and System Documentation Management

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a specific Solution Context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex problems by taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple information sources. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the solution. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for the solution and its interfaces. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, and ensures Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are appropriately recorded.

• Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive information clearly and actively works to build consensus among stakeholders. Drives information sharing and exchange about the solution.

• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates primarily within a defined Solution Context.

• Business / Technical ability: Applies general and in-depth knowledge in one or two technology areas. Contributes minimally but effectively to Architecture Practices development and mentoring.

Qualifications

• ALM Toolset Mastery: 8+ years of hands-on experience with SAP Solution Manager (Focused Build, ChaRM, Solution Documentation, Test Management, Project management), SAP Cloud ALM, Adonis, and Worksoft.

• Release Management: Deep expertise in ERP change management, hybrid environments on CTS, CTS+, cTMS, transport layers, conflict analysis, and downgrade protection.

• Lifecycle Leadership: Proven track record of managing 2–3 full-scale ERP implementation or upgrade lifecycles in a global corporate setting with strong stakeholder management skills.

• System Configuration: Extensive experience configuring and adapting SAP Solution Manager to meet complex business needs.

• Process Standards: Strong

Job Purpose
Assume full responsibility in managing Retail customers including field promotion and
business partnership to ensure sales and KPI achievement in Retail Chapter in a cost
effective manner. Develop and implement annual HCP plan and promotions to solidify CS-
NPC leading position in the target market.
負責零售通路客戶群、現場推廣及事業夥伴的全部責任，確保以有效成本達成銷售和KPI績效
。 制定並實施年度Retail Chapter計劃和推廣活動，以確保CS-NPC在目標市場領先地位

Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in
Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and Roche Safety, Security,
Health, and Environmental Protection policies, while demonstrating a solid understanding of
compliance requirements and upholding the high standard of integrity.
在進行所有業務活動時，應完全遵守羅氏安全政策、羅氏商業行為準則、羅氏競爭法互動對
話準則以及羅氏安全、安保、健康和環境保護政策，同時展現對合規要求的深刻理解，並堅
持高標準的誠信。

主要工作職責 Main Tasks & Responsibilities :

• Contribute to the formulation of the Annual Sales Plan and develop specific account plans and profiles to maximize coverage, sales and distribution objectives
協助制定年度銷售計劃並製定特定的客戶計劃和資料，以最大程度地覆蓋範圍，銷售和銷售目標

• Develop and implement annual plan and contract for retail customers timely and with quality.
及時並高品質地制定和實施零售通路客戶群年度營銷計劃和合約

• Disease area-based position responsible for developing and enhancing professionalrelationships with healthcare professionals across various specialty networks including endocrinology and so on.
負責疾病領域相關工作，與包括內分泌學等在內的各個專科網絡的醫療保健專業人員建立和加強專業關係。

• Collaborate with the Key Account Team to identify and capitalize on new market opportunities, driving business growth.與關鍵客戶團隊合作，識別並掌握新的市場機遇，推動業務成長。

• Support Portfolio Management / Supports for assigned products
支援產品組合管理/為指定產品提供支援

• Manage retail customers and business partners sales and develop promotions to achieve sales target and KPIs.
管理零售通路客戶群和事業夥伴的銷售並開展促銷活動以實現銷售目標和KPI

• Develop new channels, innovate new sales models, and create cooperation between Roche and other external companies
開發新銷售通路，創新銷售模式，並與其他外部公司之間建立合作

• Visit channels at the required frequency and build strong engagement and partnership with them.
按要求的頻率訪問各通路，並與他們建立牢固的夥伴關係

• Track the results of promotion and effectiveness of field promotion regularly.
定期追蹤區域推廣銷售活動的成果與效能

• Accelerate product off-take in trade and optimize inventory level.
加快商品迴轉，優化庫存水平

• Provide Account sales forecast for order placement and sales tracking.
提供重要客戶銷售預測，以進行訂單投放和銷售追踪

• Well manage M&D budget on Account and business partners.
有效管理客戶和事業夥伴的 M&D預算

• Maintain awareness of market trends, understanding forthcoming customer initiatives and monitor what competitors are doing.
保持對市場趨勢的了解，了解即將到來的客戶計劃並監控競爭對手的行為

• Raise applications of FOC and demo goods from the team, and monitor if applications are written off monthly
提出FOC和展示商品申請，並監視是否每月核銷申請

• Conduct business in full compliance to Behavior in Business and Behavior in Competition.
完全遵守業務行為和競爭行為來開展業務

• Other tasks assigned by Head of CS-NPC
負責人分配的其他任務

Requirements:
Qualifications:

• Good Compliance track record. No material Compliance violation is identified in the past 5 years

• Experience in retail/OTC business management/development is preferred

Education:
University graduate

Working Experience:
At least 3 years retail customers business management experience in medical related field
or consumer healthcare
Skills & Knowledge: Good knowledge of Compliance requirements and clear understanding of high
standards

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras.

Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos.

Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

Como Ingeniero de IT en Lima, te unirás a un Squad multidisciplinario para brindar soporte informático crítico y asegurar que nuestros clientes cuenten con las mejores soluciones de gestión de laboratorio . Esta posición te ofrece la oportunidad de impactar directamente en la eficiencia de la salud a través de la tecnología .

Oportunidad

• Liderar la implementación y el mantenimiento de soluciones informáticas para la gestión de laboratorios y conexiones de clientes .

• Brindar soporte técnico preventivo y correctivo, asegurando el cierre oportuno de actividades en el CRM según los estándares globales .

• Colaborar proactivamente con tu Squad para identificar necesidades de hardware, interfaces y viabilidad técnica de nuevas herramientas .

• Participar en la elaboración de proyectos informáticos y material de especificaciones técnicas para clientes y personal interno .

• Gestionar la instalación de servidores, redes, bases de datos y equipos periféricos (lectores, impresoras) en el entorno del cliente .

• Contribuir al cumplimiento de los indicadores clave de desempeño (KPIs) del área de servicios.

• Realizar visitas de campo y demostraciones técnicas junto a los integrantes del equipo comercial cuando sea requerido .

• Atender el servicio de retén una vez finalizado el periodo de aprendizaje de 6 meses .

Quien eres

• Eres profesional titulado en Ingeniería de Sistemas, Informática o carreras afines, debidamente colegiado y con habilidad profesional vigente .

• Cuentas con al menos 2 años de experiencia comprobada en la gestión de proyectos de IT .

• Posees sólidos conocimientos técnicos en desarrollo de software, manejo de redes y gestión de bases de datos .

• Demuestras autonomía, liderazgo y capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente en entornos dinámicos .

• Te comunicas de manera efectiva en inglés a nivel intermedio .

Beneficios de reubicación no disponibles.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

Como Ingeniero de IT en Lima, te unirás a un Squad multidisciplinario para brindar soporte informático crítico y asegurar que nuestros clientes cuenten con las mejores soluciones de gestión de laboratorio . Esta posición te ofrece la oportunidad de impactar directamente en la eficiencia de la salud a través de la tecnología .

Oportunidad

• Liderar la implementación y el mantenimiento de soluciones informáticas para la gestión de laboratorios y conexiones de clientes .

• Brindar soporte técnico preventivo y correctivo, asegurando el cierre oportuno de actividades en el CRM según los estándares globales .

• Colaborar proactivamente con tu Squad para identificar necesidades de hardware, interfaces y viabilidad técnica de nuevas herramientas .

• Participar en la elaboración de proyectos informáticos y material de especificaciones técnicas para clientes y personal interno .

• Gestionar la instalación de servidores, redes, bases de datos y equipos periféricos (lectores, impresoras) en el entorno del cliente .

• Contribuir al cumplimiento de los indicadores clave de desempeño (KPIs) del área de servicios.

• Realizar visitas de campo y demostraciones técnicas junto a los integrantes del equipo comercial cuando sea requerido .

• Atender el servicio de retén una vez finalizado el periodo de aprendizaje de 6 meses .

Quien eres

• Eres profesional titulado en Ingeniería de Sistemas, Informática o carreras afines, debidamente colegiado y con habilidad profesional vigente .

• Cuentas con al menos 2 años de experiencia comprobada en la gestión de proyectos de IT .

• Posees sólidos conocimientos técnicos en desarrollo de software, manejo de redes y gestión de bases de datos .

• Demuestras autonomía, liderazgo y capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente en entornos dinámicos .

• Te comunicas de manera efectiva en inglés a nivel intermedio .

Beneficios de reubicación no disponibles.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.en: Site Manager External Manufacturing and Business Operations Lead
titleByLocale.it: Gestione del sito Produzione esterna e operazioni aziendali Lead
titleByLocale.de: Site Manager External Manufacturing and Business Operations Lead
titleByLocale.fr: Site Manager External Manufacturing and Business Operations Lead

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Roche External Manufacturing group (Commercial Drug Substance) is Part of the Roche Drug Substance manufacturing unit, we Partner with Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) and ensure that relevant production/manufacturing targets are delivered to Roche on-time, to the highest quality and within-budget and that the CMOs operate in accordance with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) requirements and Roche corporate standards.

The External Manufacturing and Business Operations Manager has two main responsibilities: She/he is the primary relationship manager for specified partner Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) or sites. And She/he also acts as Chief of Staff for the unit, ensures strategy deployment is well executed, and carries ownership of the Performance management process for the group.

The Opportunity:

You act as the primary lead and relationship manager for CMOs throughout the entire product Lifecycle, from initial selection and implementation to decommissioning. That means:

• Lead international governance teams across diverse functions such as Quality, MSAT, Supply chain, Legal, and Procurement to ensure organizational alignment during CMO manufacturing, due diligences or Tech Transfers

• Enforce strict adherence to GMP, Quality, and SHE standards while conducting regular risk reviews to proactively address potential supply issues at CMOs

• Serves as the Chief of Staff and advisor to the DS External Manufacturing Head and site leadership team, closely collaborating on efforts to advance the portfolio toward the Drug substance Network vision

• Lead the Performance Management reporting system, including goals/KPIs, PTN Alignment, and the effective execution of weekly, monthly, and Quarterly Business Reviews

• Works closely with Finance and other stakeholders to lead the business planning and track financial performance

• Develops overall strategy for effective communication across teams, and leads and ensures Risk management across DS External Manufacturing, identifying and incorporating mitigation plans into the site's prioritized portfolio

Who You Are:

We have high expectations around end-to-end thinking and cross functional collaboration in a global network by taking ownership and delegating decisions to the appropriate level. We value an entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to constantly change or adapt in a dynamic environment. We expect you to focus on the most impactful and value adding work by prioritizing your efforts with a clear focus on creating value for the patient. You will be willing to explore new opportunities, be comfortable with ambiguity and taking smart risks, while complying with the latest regulations. Furthermore:

• Education & Core Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Life Sciences (advanced degree preferred) with 10+ years of manufacturing/operations experience within Pharma/Biotech or similarly regulated industries

• Leadership & Project Management: 3+ years leading direct reports or matrixed teams, coupled with 5+ years directing large-scale, complex cross-functional projects (Project Management certification is a plus)

• Technical & Quality Expertise: Deep proficiency in a GMP-regulated environment (specifically biologics drug substance), with a strong commitment to corporate compliance, integrity, and Lean Six Sigma/continuous improvement practices

• Procurement & Advanced Systems: Demonstrated background in sourcing strategy, category management, and ERP s

titleByLocale.en: Sr. Scientist - Computational Biology - Neuroscience & Rare Diseases

titleByLocale.fr: Sr. Scientist - Computational Biology - Neuroscience & Rare Diseases

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence is a global organisation enabling Roche’s Research and Early Development units to develop novel therapeutics that will have an impact on patient lives. Within the Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence, the Computational Biology and Medicine department focuses on furthering our understanding of disease pathogenesis, patient populations, and target biology by having access to the largest Pharma R&D datasets in the world. In partnership with our scientists across Roche, we create better medicines by augmenting every part of R&D through our data-driven culture.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a highly motivated computational scientist to join our Neuroscience and Rare Diseases therapeutic area. In this role, you will be a key member of an interdisciplinary team dedicated to advancing our understanding of neurological diseases. As Roche continues to build and advance its capabilities in computational and data-driven R&D, this position offers an integral role in our strategy. You will identify novel therapeutic targets and biomarkers by analyzing high-dimensional data. You will collaborate closely with leading laboratory scientists and clinicians, contributing directly to a pipeline of innovative medicines for patients with neurodegenerative and neuroinflammation diseases. You will also be part of the wider Computational Biology and Medicine unit of the Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence drawing on the shared experience and expertise of colleagues globally.

Data Analysis & Insight Generation

• Lead the analysis of high-dimensional datasets such as single-cell, spatial, proteomics, metabolomics, and human genetics data to support therapeutic and biomarker development

• Collaborate closely with the AI/ML Foundation Model development teams and apply advanced quantitative methods, supporting drug discovery projects in Neuroscience and Rare Diseases.

• Deliver clear and objective data-driven insights to inform portfolio decision-making

Collaboration & Strategy

• Contribute to the data and analytics strategy for Neuroscience and Rare Diseases efforts in collaboration with partners in the therapeutic area

• Develop effective working relationships with key stakeholders in the disease therapeutic area, laboratory teams, and computational teams

Team & Culture

• Contribute to a collaborative workplace culture of scientific rigor, continuous improvement, and open feedback

• Support the scientific growth of team members by sharing knowledge and expertise

Who you are

You are a dedicated scientist with a strong background in applying computational methods to biological problems. You are motivated by scientific challenges and have a clear interest in translating data into meaningfu
