jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharmaceuticals

The Mission

• Health care is changing: Radical innovation, increased openness to change, increasing patient empowerment, multiple sources of medical information, and pressure on public spending. As a result of all this, the needs of our stakeholders continue to evolve.

• The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering world-class medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption. By doing so the PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organisation, faster.

• The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche Hong Kong and Macau. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions.

• The PJP will deliver better outcomes for patients, better community value and better commercial results, the latter being the consequence of the first two. Committing to improving better care outcomes for patients is good business.

• This role is locally embedded in the Hong Kong ecosystem, it is an integrated role, primary point of contact, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs)

• It has no profitability, sales objectives or incentives

• All Roche Hong Kong & Macau employees are to lead by example, in the network way of working. This is where solutions are sourced from the internal and external network first, to avoid duplications, and to achieve better patient outcomes faster.

• All Roche Hong Kong & Macau employees are to lead by example in accelerating the digital maturity of Roche internally and in the external healthcare environment, aligned with the long term Roche vision of Personalized Health Care.

Major Accountabilities

• All Roche employees are expected to effectively contribute to cross-functional collaboration and coordination and comply with all laws, regulations, policies & procedures that govern our business.

• This position profile serves only to give a broad outline of the duties required and will be renewed and amended at periodic intervals in the consultation with the incumbent.

• The PJP is a senior level role within the affiliate, who has decision making authority to request resources of Roche (both within the affiliate and broader network) in order to have improved impact on the patient journey

• With regards to the ecosystems of Hong Kong and Macau, the PJP will continue to evolve the collaboration within the ecosystem of HA clusters, public and private partnerships and the smooth rolling out of healthcare system changes in which the HSPs will be shaping.

Details:

• The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with both Hong Kong and Macau partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.

• Acts as trusted partner and is the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche; the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster.

• Partners with patient

jobs.title: Senior Medical Writer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within the Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen Roche's digital capabilities globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting, and Creative Design.
As a member of the Global Digital Hub Team, you will work to ensure fulfillment of the Global Digital Hub long term outcomes and strategy as well as excellent delivery of content creation priorities. As a Senior Medical writer, you will support the growing medical writing team within Roche Services & Solution Centre in developing medical writing & digital content solutions for our business partners across various therapeutic areas and play a crucial role in business development and stakeholder engagement

As a Senior Medical Writer, you will be at the forefront of creating high-quality content for medical communications tailored solutions. The Senior Medical Writer is an experienced subject matter expert, advisor and leader within the chapter. Focusing on specific therapeutic areas in dedicated service teams, Senior Medical Writers are responsible for training and mentoring medical writers, copywriters and content editors within their assigned team - also driving cross-team upskilling and knowledge transfer to grow the capabilities of the chapter overall. This critical position has a global scope and a key component of the role involves acting as a trusted advisor and knowledgeable consultant to our business teams on the topic of medical writing and communications.

The Opportunity:

• Apply broad knowledge of medical writing to develop effective scientific content for digital implementation in collaboration with cross-functional partners and clients.

• Manage multiple concurrent projects across therapeutic areas, ensuring delivery on agreed timelines and proactively managing your workload and capacity.

• Ensure that all content, format, and structure comply with regulatory guidelines, Roche best practices, and diligently follow applicable company SOPs.

• As a Senior Medical Writer, you will provide mentorship and technical coaching to team members and new writers joining the team.

• Serve as a Subject Matter Expert in pharmaceutical and medical communications, leading the team in assigned specific therapeutic areas.

• Take ownership for upholding the highest standards of scientific accuracy, quality, and compliance with all applicable industry guidelines.

• Exercise excellent communication skills for professional liaison with internal teams and external stakeholders to obtain comprehensive briefs and lead cross-functional initiatives.

Who you are:

• You have an advanced degree in a biological science or medical discipline and 7+ years of medical writing experience, ideally within an agency setting.

• You have native-level written and spoken English and additional languages are an advantage.

• You possess excellent attention to detail, consistency, clarity, and scientific rigor, demonstrating an accountable, focused, and precise attitude.

• You must be able to effectively coordinate people across multiple organizations and countries while demonstrating strong stakeholder management and a customer-centric mentality.

• You thrive in a fast-paced and changing environment, utilizing a continuous improvement and growth mindset to effectively prioritize tasks.

• You have experience with standard IT applications, with a preference

As a Senior Medical writer, you will support the growing medical writing team within Roche Services & Solution Centre in developing medical writing & digital content solutions for our business partners across various therapeutic areas and play a crucial role in business development and stakeholder engagement

As a Senior Medical Writer, you will be at the forefront of creating high-quality content for medical communications tailored solutions. The Senior Medical Writer is an experienced subject matter expert, advisor and leader within the chapter. Focusing on specific therapeutic areas in dedicated service teams, Senior Medical Writers are responsible for training and mentoring medical writers, copywriters and content editors within their assigned team - also driving cross-team upskilling and knowledge transfer to grow the capabilities of the chapter overall. This critical position has a global scope and a key component of the role involves acting as a trusted advisor and knowledgeable consultant to our business teams on the topic of medical writing and communications.

The Opportunity:

• Apply broad knowledge of medical writing to develop effective scientific content for digital implementation in collaboration with cross-functional partners and clients.

• Manage multiple concurrent projects across therapeutic areas, ensuring delivery on agreed timelines and proactively managing your workload and capacity.

• Ensure that all content, format, and structure comply with regulatory guidelines, Roche best practices, and diligently follow applicable company SOPs.

• As a Senior Medical Writer, you will provide mentorship and technical coaching to team members and new writers joining the team.

• Serve as a Subject Matter Expert in pharmaceutical and medical communications, leading the team in assigned specific therapeutic areas.

• Take ownership for upholding the highest standards of scientific accuracy, quality, and compliance with all applicable industry guidelines.

• Exercise excellent communication skills for professional liaison with internal teams and external stakeholders to obtain comprehensive briefs and lead cross-functional initiatives.

Who you are:

• You have an advanced degree in a biological science or medical discipline and 7+ years of medical writing experience, ideally within an agency setting.

• You have native-level written and spoken English and additional languages are an advantage.

• You possess excellent attention to detail, consistency, clarity, and scientific rigor, demonstrating an accountable, focused, and precise attitude.

• You must be able to effectively coordinate people across multiple organizations and countries while demonstrating strong stakeholder management and a customer-centric mentality.

• You thrive in a fast-paced and changing environment, utilizing a continuous improvement and growth mindset to effectively prioritize tasks.

• You have experience with standard IT applications, with a preference

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Wir sind Roche!
Eines der erfolgreichsten Pharmaunternehmen weltweit. Mit 125 Jahren Erfahrung erforschen, entwickeln, produzieren und vertreiben wir innovative Medikamente, diagnostische Tests und digitale Technologien – für ein besseres Leben und eine nachhaltige Zukunft. Zusammen mit unseren Kollegen aus den benachbarten Bereichen, wie dem Produktionsteam der Pharmaproduktion, verfügen wir über umfassendes Wissen, erstklassige Fachkenntnisse und Fähigkeiten, um die Gesundheit unserer Patienten weltweit zu verbessern und die Versorgung mit Medikamenten zur Behandlung schwerwiegender Krankheiten zu gewährleisten.

Der Bereich Manufacturing, Science & Technology (MSAT)
In dieser Abteilung stellen wir die technische und strategische Kompetenz für die Bereitstellung der klinischen Pipeline, die Einführung und die Unterstützung der kommerziellen Produktion sicher. Unser technischer Support, Engineering, Systeme, Daten und Dokumente sind essentiell für die Herstellung, Bewertung und Freigabe hochwertiger Produkte. MSAT Process Science ist u.a. am Troubleshooting von pharmazeutischen Proteinwirkstoffen, bei der Bewertung von Einsatzstoffen sowie an lokalen und globalen Gremien beteiligt.

Dein Team
Wir sind ein souveränes Team aus Biotechnologie-Ingenieuren, Labortechnikern, Labormitarbeitern und Managern im Bereich Upstream, Downstream, Technology & Data. Modernes Equipment, innovative Analysemethoden und diverse Dokumentations- und Auswerte-Tools stehen uns zur Verfügung. Selbständiges und eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten sind für unsere Aufgaben essentiell, doch der Teamzusammenhalt und der Spaß an der Arbeit sind für uns genauso wichtig. Ein offener und ehrlicher Umgang miteinander, geprägt durch Respekt und Wertschätzung, ist uns besonders wichtig.

Deine Aufgaben können sein
Unterstützung unserer Projektarbeit: Erstellung von Analyse-Templates in Roche-eigenen Systemen, die folgende Anwendungsbereiche umfassen:
Fehlersuche, -analyse und -behebung im kommerziellen Umfeld.
Planung, Bearbeitung und Auswertung von Laborversuchen zur Optimierung, Skalierung und Validierung von pharmazeutischen biotechnologischen Herstellprozessen.
Anwendung diverser chromatographischer (ÄKTA, HPLC) und spektroskopischer Verfahren sowie Filtration im Labormaßstab.

Dein Profil
Du passt am besten zu uns, wenn:
Du Erfahrungen in der Industrie (USP/DSP/DataScience) sammeln willst
Du aktuell für ein naturwissenschaftliches, (bio)informatisches oder ingenieurwissenschaftliches Studium immatrikuliert bist.
Du Biotechnologie nicht nur aus der Theorie kennst.
Dir auch die analytischen Anwendungen der Chromatographie und Spektroskopie vertraut sind.
Du sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift hast.
Selbstständiges und eigenverantwortliches Planen und Arbeiten für dich selbstverständlich sind.
Du ein wahrer Teamplayer bist, ein hohes Durchsetzungsvermögen besitzt und auch in Belastungssituationen immer den Überblick behältst und den Spaß an der Arbeit nicht vergisst.
Erfahrung mit statistischen Methoden (z.B. beschreibende Statistik) und dem systematischen Umgang mit großen Datenmengen ist von Vorteil.

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• Gesetzliche Mindestlohnvergütung für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 3 Monate

• Vernetzungsmöglichkeiten für deine weitere Karriereplanung

• Vergünstigte Preise in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Zugang zu unserem Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boarding House während des Praktikums

Deine Bew

The Position
We focus on the long - term, leading investment in research and development, striving to improve lives today and for generations to come. Poland plays the role of Technology Co-creation and Acceleration Hub building capabilities driving digital innovation. In Roche Informatics we are a diverse team of open and friendly people, enthusiastic about technological novelties and optimal IT solutions.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

Description of the area:
The Demand to Pay (D2P) Value Stream is responsible for driving the end-to-end Procurement, Accounts Payable and Travel & Expense Management Data & AI strategies, by translating Functional strategies into measurable business outcomes.

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Patient Journey Partner , serás el punto primario de contacto (PPOC) para stakeholders clave del área terapéutica asignada. Tu misión será acompañar el recorrido del paciente dentro del sistema de salud, generando valor y mejores experiencias mediante la colaboración con profesionales, organizaciones de pacientes y actores clave del ecosistema, garantizando así que cada paciente acceda a soluciones innovadoras y sostenibles.

La oportunidad

• Ser socio estratégico de profesionales de la salud, asociaciones de pacientes y otros actores clave.

• Identificar barreras y oportunidades en el recorrido de los pacientes para co-crear soluciones.

• Asegurar el acceso y la correcta implementación de las soluciones terapéuticas de Roche.

• Representar a Roche como referente científico en la región asignada.

• Promover el intercambio de conocimientos y experiencias entre especialistas y organizaciones.

• Apoyar la ejecución local de estrategias médicas alineadas con la visión global.

• Colaborar de manera transversal con equipos internos y externos para potenciar el impacto positivo en los pacientes.

Quién eres

• Profesional con experiencia en roles comerciales, marketing o desarrollo de negocio dentro de la industria farmacéutica o de salud.

• Conocimiento profundo del recorrido de los pacientes.

• Excelentes habilidades de relacionamiento e influencia en ecosistemas de salud.

• Mentalidad abierta, colaborativa y con orientación a resultados.

• Disponibilidad para viajar a nivel nacional e internacional.

• Dominio de inglés para colaborar con la red global de Roche.

Esta posición no ofrece beneficios de relocalización.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Strategic Quality Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Has deep and/or broad expertise in his/her area of specialization and has good knowledge of the overarching areas of responsibility.

• Knowledge of the relevant regulations (e.g. ISO 13485, GMP, others)

• Proven in-depth understanding of the end-to-end processes in product lifecycle management

Develops new approaches to complex problems. Can persuade and guide others to solve the problem.

• Pragmatic decision making and the ability to move forward without a perfect solution

• Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

• Ensure effective change management in Product Development Quality Chapter, R&D and other functions

• Support timely and data and fact-based decision-making and implementation.

Shares experience and serves as a source of information for others.

• Implement and continuously improve knowledge management within Pre-Market Quality, promote effective sharing and retention of valuable knowledge and expertise.

• Foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement that supports a creative and problem-solving mindset across R&D, Product Development Quality and other functions

• Act as a role model by demonstrating behaviors that support the transition to a new model of work with a focus on agility, collaboration and adaptability

• Support colleagues as a coach in developing their skills and fostering a learning and development-oriented environment

Ensures the creation and evolution of a quality concept for the assigned strategically important product group that builds on each other, meets requirements and is cost-conscious

• Function as single point of contact within the project team (development of new products / product changes/product transfer)

• Collaborate with team members to ensure efficient and effective documentation of milestones

• Ensure development project plans include the correct documentation as per the D&D module to develop safe and compliant products

Responsible for the efficient implementation of relevant local and international laws, standards and regulations

• Ensure consistent interpretation and implementation of global requirements across all customer areas (CAs), especially China requirements

• Promote the use of the Risk Enabler within and outside the global Q&R organization; prepare and enable risk-based decisions

• Partner to ensure effective resolution of issues (e.g. CAPA, NC)

Lead complex and cross-functional projects

• Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders across the value chain to accelerate the development process and incorporate lessons learned.

• Incorporate learnings from all quality areas across all customer areas (CA) in support of projects and ensure that post-market quality feedback is incorporated into requirements

• Leading and moderating constructive discussions, e.g. at project team meetings

• Ensuring the exchange of information for milestone reviews and setting up effective feedback loops

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED) , we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

This position is located in Preclinical Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Control (pCMC), a department within the Synthetic Molecule Research organization in pRED Therapeutic Modalities, where we pave, in a diverse, ambitious and innovative environment, the path to bring drug candidates from early research into development. We are CMC experts and build our strength on a broad diversity of technical expertise in chemistry, formulation design, material science and analytical chemistry, delivering and innovating in the space of small molecules, peptides and nucleic acid based medicines.

The Opportunity
We offer an exciting opportunity for an experienced CMC professional to lead our Analytical Molecular Characterization (AMC) team while serving as a hands-on Mass Spectrometry (MS) subject matter expert. In this role, you will bridge discovery research and technical development, driving advanced analytical strategies to support our portfolio across the value chain.
You will lead a multidisciplinary team spanning NMR, MS, and chromatography, while developing and applying high-resolution MS methods for the characterization of synthetic molecules. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on scientific contribution, shaping both team direction and analytical excellence.
Your Responsibilities includes:
Leadership & Strategy

• Lead and develop a team of analytical experts across MS, NMR, and chromatography

• Define and execute mid- to long-term AMC strategies aligned with project and portfolio goals

• Foster collaboration across discovery, technical development, and external partners

Analytical & Scientific Expertise

• Develop and apply advanced high-resolution MS methods for structure elucidation and impurity characterization

• Oversee complex analytical activities, including stereochemistry determination and interaction studies (API–excipient)

• Drive analytical method development across SFC, HPLC, and GC for small molecules and peptides

Innovation & Collaboration

• Partner with Data, Digital, and AI teams to advance data workflows, automation, and analytics capabilities

• Identify industry trends and maintain academic collaborations to ensure scientific leadership

• Ensure high-quality analytical support for IPCs, intermediates, and APIs across development stages

Who You Are

• PhD in Analytical Chemistry (or related field) with 5+ years industry experience, or MSc with 10+ years

• Strong expertise in chromatographic and spectroscopic techniques, with deep MS experience in structure elucidation

• Knowledge of API synthesis, impurity profiling, and separation technologies (U/HPLC, SFC)

• Proven leadership experience (≥3 years) managing multidisciplinary teams

• Familiarity with GMP and regulatory requirements

• Strong collaborator able to connect technical depth with strategic objectives

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 em

jobs.title: PSS Transformation & Solution Advisor
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
As a PSS Transformation & Solution Advisor , your mission is to engage and partner primarily with People & Culture (P&C) colleagues across all Chapters and, where needed, with business stakeholders. Your focus is on delivering customized servicing strategies, navigating complex business transformations, and providing exceptional partner experiences in moments that matter. You will play a key role in translating business goals into P&C priorities and ensuring their effective implementation across the organization.
The Position
In this role, you will be responsible for:

• Leading PSS squads to ensure the seamless execution of complex business reorganizations, transformations, Mergers, Acquisitions, and divestitures.

• Representing PSS on Acquisition Core Deal teams and leading Workday system integration workstreams.

• Proactively identifying customer needs and translating gaps into change requests to drive continuous improvements within the P&C network.

• Collaborating on complex P&C challenges , connecting with the right chapters to develop end-to-end solutions and effective change management.

• Driving stakeholder engagement by seeking feedback and striving for high-quality partnerships across the global matrix.

• Providing demand forecasting in collaboration with other PSS workstreams to ensure operational readiness.

• Participating in global and regional squads for the deployment of strategic initiatives and new system launches.

Who You Are
You are a proactive HR professional with a passion for project management and a "can-do" attitude. You bring:

• 5+ years of experience in HR processes, HR shared services, or HR functional/generalist roles, ideally in a global environment.

• Proven expertise in leading teams without direct authority , utilizing analytical thinking and a pragmatic approach to drive results.

• Exceptional stakeholder management skills , with the ability to articulate strategy and "the why" behind P&C initiatives.

• Strong experience in service delivery management and HR process design, preferably within a matrixed organization.

• Excellence in project management or process improvement (certification is a plus).

• Fluency in English (written and spoken); any additional language is an advantage.

In exchange we provide you with:

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted, and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop, and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Opportunity:

• Lead a Global Technical Powerhouse: Serve as the primary architect and visionary for Roche’s pen injector platform, leading a high-performing global team of 10+ technical experts and leaders.

• Drive Strategic Innovation: Design and execute the technology roadmap for pen injectors, ensuring our platforms are at the cutting edge of parenteral drug delivery and integrated seamlessly with the R&D portfolio.

• Own the Lifecycle Excellence: Direct the end-to-end design, development, and commercial readiness of pen technologies, overseeing design engineering, verification, and systems engineering.

• Transform Operational Efficiency: Challenge legacy processes to streamline delivery, ensuring predictable, robust, and agile development timelines for all pen-based combination products.

• Influence the Global Community: Act as the technical authority and strategic thought partner for R&D leaders, representing the pen platform on the Global Device Development Leadership Team.

• Forge Strategic Partnerships: Manage and guide key CDMO partnerships, ensuring external designs are optimized for large-scale, industrial manufacturing and global compliance.

• Cultivate E2E Synergy: Build and maintain deep relationships across Early Research, CMC, Regulatory, Quality, and Device MSAT to ensure a unified approach to patient-centric solutions.

• Embody Modern Leadership: Practice the VACC (Visionary, Architect, Coach, Catalyst) model to foster a culture of continuous learning, professional growth, and technical excellence.

Who you are:

• An Industry Expert: You hold an advanced degree (B.S., M.S., or Ph.D.) in Engineering with at least 15 years of experience in medical device or combination product development.

• A Proven People Leader: You have 10+ years of experience managing technical teams and leaders, with a track record of developing diverse talent and driving results in a matrix environment.

• A Pen Platform Specialist: You possess expert knowledge in drug delivery pen development, from initial concept and industrialization to commercial support and global launch.

• A Regulatory Navigator: You have a deep understanding of global legislation and industry standards (FDA/EMA) for combination products and have successfully led Health Authority interactions.

• A Systems Thinker: You are proficient in risk assessment, tolerance analysis, and statistical techniques, with a firm grasp of parenteral drug delivery and manufacturing processes.

• A Strategic Collaborator: You excel at influencing senior executives and managing complex stakeholder relationships across different cultural backgrounds and global locations.

• A Master Communicator: You possess excellent presentation and interpersonal skills, with full professional proficiency in English (German language skills are a significant plus).

Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Toge

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Patient Journey Partner Ophthalmology
Roche Nederland B.V., Woerden / Landelijke positie

Voor ons multidisciplinaire team Oogheelkunde zijn wij op zoek naar een ervaren en ondernemende Patient Journey Partner Ophthalmology. In deze rol ben je het centrale aanspreekpunt voor alle stakeholders die direct betrokken zijn bij het zorgpad van mensen met een oogaandoening. Met een diepgaand begrip van de behoeften van artsen, patiënten en andere zorgverleners, weet je onze waardepropositie naadloos te integreren. Je primaire doel is om de toegang tot onze innovatieve behandelingen te versnellen en zo de zorg en het leven van patiënten, bijvoorbeeld met maculadegeneratie, significant te verbeteren. Dit is een unieke kans om met jouw ervaring directe, tastbare impact te maken op de patiëntenzorg in een competitieve markt.
Als Patient Journey Partner vorm jij de cruciale verbinding tussen de behoeften van externe stakeholders, zoals oogartsen en physician assistants, en de expertise binnen ons Ophthalmology team. Jij bent onze oren en ogen in het veld; een ondernemer die impact maakt door bestaande relaties te verdiepen en nieuwe samenwerkingen te ontsluiten. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Patient Journey Partner de Oftalmología , tu misión será acompañar el recorrido del paciente dentro del sistema de salud, generando valor y mejores experiencias mediante la colaboración con profesionales, organizaciones de pacientes y actores clave del ecosistema, garantizando así que cada paciente acceda a soluciones innovadoras y sostenibles.

La oportunidad

• Ser socio estratégico de profesionales de la salud, asociaciones de pacientes y otros actores clave.

• Identificar barreras y oportunidades en el recorrido de los pacientes para co-crear soluciones.

• Asegurar el acceso y la correcta implementación de las soluciones terapéuticas de Roche.

• Representar a Roche como referente científico en la región asignada.

• Promover el intercambio de conocimientos y experiencias entre especialistas y organizaciones.

• Apoyar la ejecución local de estrategias médicas alineadas con la visión global.

• Colaborar de manera transversal con equipos internos y externos para potenciar el impacto positivo en los pacientes.

Quién eres

• Profesional con sólida experiencia en Oftalmología .

• Residir en Chaco, Corrientes o Rosario , excluyente.

• Excelentes habilidades de relacionamiento e influencia en ecosistemas de salud.

• Mentalidad abierta, colaborativa y con orientación a resultados.

• Disponibilidad para viajar en la región asignada y eventualmente a nivel nacional.

• Dominio de inglés para colaborar con la red global de Roche.

• Formación universitaria en ciencias de la salud (posgrado valorado).

Esta posición no ofrece beneficios de relocalización.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Patient Journey Partner de Oftalmología , tu misión será acompañar el recorrido del paciente dentro del sistema de salud, generando valor y mejores experiencias mediante la colaboración con profesionales, organizaciones de pacientes y actores clave del ecosistema, garantizando así que cada paciente acceda a soluciones innovadoras y sostenibles.

La oportunidad

• Ser socio estratégico de profesionales de la salud, asociaciones de pacientes y otros actores clave.

• Identificar barreras y oportunidades en el recorrido de los pacientes para co-crear soluciones.

• Asegurar el acceso y la correcta implementación de las soluciones terapéuticas de Roche.

• Representar a Roche como referente científico en la región asignada.

• Promover el intercambio de conocimientos y experiencias entre especialistas y organizaciones.

• Apoyar la ejecución local de estrategias médicas alineadas con la visión global.

• Colaborar de manera transversal con equipos internos y externos para potenciar el impacto positivo en los pacientes.

Quién eres

• Profesional con sólida experiencia en Oftalmología .

• Residir en Chaco, Corrientes o Rosario , excluyente.

• Excelentes habilidades de relacionamiento e influencia en ecosistemas de salud.

• Mentalidad abierta, colaborativa y con orientación a resultados.

• Disponibilidad para viajar en la región asignada y eventualmente a nivel nacional.

• Dominio de inglés para colaborar con la red global de Roche.

• Formación universitaria en ciencias de la salud (posgrado valorado).

Esta posición no ofrece beneficios de relocalización.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care.
Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

• Are you ready to dive into an immersive learning experience where you don't just observe, but actively contribute and implement vital Organization Enablement initiatives? Join us in shaping the future of our organizations together!

Key Responsibilities

• Embark on a journey to understand and contribute to transformative Organization Enablement initiatives, focusing on areas such as:

• Capability Framework: Bring your passion to enhance the efficiency of our Capability Framework, supporting our organization's future workforce needs and driving efficiencies.

• Learning and Development: Dive into the essence of our RSS Academy, supporting its mission to empower our workforce through continuous learning and development opportunities.

• Employee Engagement and Change Communications: Creatively designing, crafting communications and presentations supporting our initiatives

• Collaborate and Innovate: Bring your tech-savvy or creative mindset to co-create innovative solutions with diverse teams for the key initiatives you spearhead. It will be an added advantage if you know tools like g-suite & other automation tools

• Additional Support : Be prepared to lend a hand in various other support activities and initiatives as needed to keep the momentum going.

We're Seeking Someone Who:

• Embodies Curiosity: Whether you're an undergraduate or a recent graduate from a renowned university, we're looking for individuals with insatiable curiosity and a knack for reimagining the status quo.

• Thrives in Creativity: Are you a wordsmith? Social media enthusiast? Digital marketing whiz? Do you excel in creating engaging slideshow presentations? Can you develop captivating videos? These skills are considered a significant advantage in our dynamic environment.

• Values Collaboration: Join a team that values collaboration above all else. We're seeking individuals who thrive in diverse environments and carry a strong sense of ownership for their contributions.

• Communicates with Impact: From verbal discussions to written reports, your English communication skills should be top-notch.

• Driven Individuals: We seek candidates who are self-motivated, willing to take initiative, and possess a solution-oriented mindset.

• PR and Event Management Savvy: Strong skills in public relations and event management are highly valued in this role.

• Commits to Growth: Ready to embark on a journey? We're seeking interns who can commit to a minimum of 6 months, preferably a year, to truly immerse themselves in this transformative experience.

The Position
• 职位概述:
• 负责地区销售任务的执行和客户支持管理。
• 主要工作职责 :
• 1．完成地区经理制定的该区域及卓越客户业务目标及预算内开支
• 2．管理负责的客户团队，调动协调各支持部门资源，以全力支持客户管理的相关活动
• 3．与市场部紧密合作并提供建议方案，以全面开拓市场机会
• 4．加强负责区域内的客户管理系统的执行力度

基本任职资格:
• 教育背景与专业资格:
• 1. 本科以上学历，检验相关专业或商业管理专业
• 2. 英语说写能力俱佳
• 3. 产品和应用的专业知识

• 4．加强负责区域内的客户管理系统的执行力度

• 教育背景与专业资格:
• 1. 本科以上学历，检验相关专业或商业管理专业
• 2. 英语说写能力俱佳
• 3. 产品和应用的专业知识

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.title: Service Delivery Lead – Medical Writing

titleByLocale.it: Lead di consegna di servizio – scrittura medica

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has newly been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As a Service Delivery Lead (SDL) , you are accountable for ensuring effective, scalable, and high-quality operational service delivery within your assigned focus area of the global Roche content and digital services Lab .

You oversee the operational governance of services delivered through internal teams and external vendors, ensuring alignment with defined service models, performance standards, and business priorities. Your focus is on service reliability, performance transparency, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

The Opportunity:

• Strategic Medical Writing Leadership – Direct medical writing service delivery across therapeutic areas, ensuring content production meets regulatory standards, business objectives, and therapeutic-specific demands while maintaining quality and compliance

• Workflow Harmonization & Cross-Functional Integration – Streamline medical writing processes with marketing, medical affairs, and compliance functions, creating seamless content workflows that align creative storytelling with regulatory requirements across all pillars

• Regulatory & Compliance Alignment – Partner with compliance and medical affairs teams to embed regulatory governance into content development, serving as the bridge between creative execution and regulatory oversight

• Service Delivery Accountability – Own day-to-day performance metrics, SLAs, and KPIs for medical writing services, acting as the central coordination point between internal stakeholders, business leads, GDH leads, and external vendors to ensure consistent execution against agreed standards

• Operational Excellence & Process Optimization – Establish and maintain standardized operating procedures, delivery frameworks, and performance monitoring systems; identify inefficiencies and drive continuous improvement initiatives with structured governance and data-driven insights

• Cost-Conscious Scalability & Innovation – Design scalable service delivery models that optimize resource allocation and cost-efficiency while championing technology adoption—including GenAI tools—to enhance operational productivity and service quality

• Capacity & Risk Management – Coordinate capacity planning, manage service incidents and escalations, monitor operational trends, and support business continuity planning to maintain service reliability, workload balance, and proactive risk mitigation

Who you are:

• You hold a university degree in a field that emphasizes life sciences, quantitative analysis, communication, or a proven track record of success in operational leadership, service delivery management, or overseeing global content workflows in a highly regulated healthcare environment.

• You have 3+ years of relevant experience in service delivery management, operational governance, or structured digital/content operations environments (corporate or agency) within global or multi-regional delivery models, including collaboration with offshore/onshore teams.

• You operate effectively in structured governance environments and are comfortable balancing operational oversight with stakeholder alignment and you anticipate risks, address delivery challenges in a time

jobs.title: Praktikum im Event & Gastronomie Management (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Was Dich erwartet

“Wir machen es möglich, dass unsere Mitarbeitenden ihr Bestes geben können.” - Unter diesem Motto bündelt Site Services alle Funktionen & Kompetenzen unter einem Dach, um den Kolleg:innen sowie allen Gästen einen maximal komfortablen Alltag am Standort Grenzach-Wyhlen zu ermöglichen. Das Gebäude FRITZ ist zentraler Ort für Veranstaltungen, Zusammenkunft, Gastronomie und zählt neben weiteren spannenden Standortthemen zur Aufgabe des Site Services Team.

Während Deines Praktikums lernst Du folgende Themen kennen:

● Unterstützen des Site Event Managers bei der Organisation & Steuerung des täglichen Betriebs der On Site Events
● Unterstützen des Site Gastronomy Manager bei der Organisation, Koordination und Weiterentwicklung der gastronomischen Angebote am Standort sowie bei operativen und administrativen 
• Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft.
● Mitgestaltung und Erarbeitung verschiedener Eventkonzepte (z.B. Social Events, Afterwork Events, etc.)
● Unterstützung bei Durchführung/Umsetzung von Event, - und Gastronomie Projekten

Wer Du bist

● Du hast Interesse an Event Management, Gastronomie Management, agiles Arbeiten, Service Management im Pharmabereich und allgemeinen Fragestellungen im gesundheitspolitischen Umfeld.
● Idealerweise bringst Du bereits erste Erfahrung im Event Management, Gastronomie Management, Prozess-Management mit.
● Darüber hinaus bist Du kommunikativ, arbeitest strukturiert und selbstständig und hast ebenso Spaß daran, 
• Aufgaben im Team zu lösen.

Für das Praktikum im Bereich Site Services
bringst Du zudem folgende Voraussetzungen und Kenntnisse mit:

● Generelle Voraussetzung zur Beschäftigung als Praktikant/in ist die ordentliche Immatrikulation während des gesamten Praktikums oder aber das Praktikum wird innerhalb eines Gap Years absolviert, also nach dem Bachelorabschluss in Vorbereitung auf ein Masterstudium oder auf die Promotion.
● Du bist Student (m/w) der Hotellerie (Hospitality Management), Event Management, Wirtschafts,- oder Kommunikationswissenschaften, o.ä.
● Gute Kenntnisse in Google Anwendungen
● Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Was wir Dir bieten

● Flexible Zeiteinteilung
● 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum
● Ermäßigte Preise (-50 %) in unserer Kantine

Deine Bewerbung

Bitte lade nur Deinen Lebenslauf online hoch.

Denke daran, daß sich dieses Praktikum ausschließlich an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation während des gesamten Zeitraums des Praktikums richtet oder alternativ an Personen in einem maximal einjährigen Gap-Year (zwischen Bachelor und Master Studium), wo es schriftlich nachgewiesen werden kann, auf welcher Universität/Hochschule und genau wann (Monat/Jahr) innerhalb eines Jahres die Studien fortgesetzt werden.

Zeitraum: ab 01. Juni 2026 für die Dauer von 6 Monaten.

Beachte bitte, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Wer wir sind

Die Roche Pharma AG in Grenzach ist eines der führenden Pharmaunternehmen und sucht ab sofort einen motivierten Praktikanten (m/w/d), der unser Site Services Team in den Bereichen Fleet & Mobility unterstützt. In diesem Praktikum bieten wir Dir die Möglichkeit, wertvolle Erfahrungen in der Umstellung unserer Dienstwagenflotte auf Elektromobilität sowie in der Erarbeitung und Implementierung von Mobilitätskonzepten für unseren Standort und unsere Mitarbeitenden zu sammeln.

Deine Hauptaufgaben

• Unterstützung bei der Implementierung einer Fleet Management Company (FMC), Effiziente Koordination und Dokumentation regelmäßiger Abstimmungstermine mit Lieferanten zur Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Informationsflusses

• Mitarbeit bei der Erstellung von Mobilitätskonzepten für den Standort, unter Berücksichtigung von Nachhaltigkeit, Effizienz und Kostenoptimierung (z.B. Ladesäulen, Jobrad, Fahrzeug UVV, Führerscheinprüfung, etc.)

• Analyse von Mobilitätsdaten und Entwicklung von Lösungsansätzen zur Verbesserung der Mitarbeitermobilität

• Aktive Mitarbeit in Projekten zur Verbesserung der Fleet, Mobility & Travel Prozesse

• Administrative Unterstützung des Teams sowie Mitgestaltung und Erarbeitung einer nachhaltigen Ablagestruktur für ein konsistentes Wissensmanagement

Wer du bist

• Fortgeschrittenes Studium in den Bereichen Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Projektmanagement, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mobilitätsmanagement oder einem verwandten Fachbereich

• Interesse an Elektromobilität und nachhaltiger Mobilität

• Analytisches Denkvermögen und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und Lösungen zu erarbeiten

• Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Teamgeist

• Eigeninitiative, Selbstständigkeit und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise

• Gute Kenntnisse in MS Office und Google Anwendungen

jobs.title: Senior Scientist- SBX Molecular Engineering
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

Roche Diagnostics acquired Stratos Genomics
( https://www.stratosgenomics.com/ ) in 2020 for its unique chemistry that advances DNA sequencing by nanopore, Sequencing by Expansion (SBX™). You will engineer and synthesize the molecular building blocks for our novel technology. These building blocks translate DNA sequences into a simple to measure surrogate, the Xpandomer, which significantly improves the accuracy and throughput of nanopore sequencing.

The Molecular Engineering group is passionate about the novel molecules they have developed and the impact SBX technology can have on advancing sequencing and patient outcomes. We are looking for people who are excited about the significance of our technology and want to make SBX successful.

The Opportunity:

• Research, design and execute innovative and well-controlled experiments, with high attention to detail.

• Lead, mentor and drive cross functional teams

• Identify and troubleshoot problems in creative ways.

• Contribute to the definition and timely achievement of project goals.

• Develop SOPs to aid in the production of reagents and starting materials

• Participate in the production of reagents and starting materials.

• Perform data analysis and protocol development.

• Maintain accurate, detailed and reliable laboratory records.

• Present findings at group or departmental meetings.

• Maintain the lab’s cleanliness and organization.

• Develop and propose improved processes to fulfill the above functions.

Who You Are:

• You have 6 years of laboratory experience in advanced nucleotide/heterocyclic chemistry, phosphorus chemistry and/or complex/multi-step organic synthesis.

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Organic Synthesis, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Biochemistry or a related field and 8 years of experience

• You have a Master’s degree in Organic Synthesis, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Biochemistry or a related field and 7 years of experience

• You have a PhD Organic Synthesis, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Biochemistry or a related field and 4 years of experience

• Ideally, you will have:

• Demonstrated ability to understand and develop chemistry for:

• Nucleotides

• Phosphoramidites

• Heterocycles

• Amino Acids

• Bio-conjugations

• Mature understanding of how to work with chemical and biochemical samples, including sample handling, reactivity, purification and storage.

• Technical background in next-generation DNA sequencing

• Experience with HPLC, MS, NMR, automated DNA synthesizers, inert atmosphere chambers, and manual pipetting.

​
***Please include a cover letter outlining why you want to work with us, your specific interest in SBX technology and how you would contribute, this is important.***

Relocation benefits are available for this posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Seattle, WA is $104,400 and $193,800. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed here: Benefits

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner, Ophthalmology
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Patient Journey Partner, Ophthalmology
Location: Preference for candidates based in the greater Montreal region.

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Join Our Mission in Ophthalmology!

At Roche, we don’t just build networks; we build bridges to better patient outcomes. As a Patient Journey Partner, you will embody our core values of Integrity, Courage, and Passion to reshape the Ophthalmology landscape.

We are looking for a visionary who has the courage to challenge the status quo and the integrity to build deep, trust-based partnerships with our stakeholders. Your relentless passion for networking won't just open doors, it will fuel your curiosity to uncover the "why" behind customer needs. By fostering authentic connections, you will be the catalyst that unlocks innovative collaborations, ensuring that every partnership we forge translates into a meaningful impact on patients' lives.

The Opportunity :

• Acting as the key liaison between stakeholders and Roche, leveraging your influence to foster impactful relationships, trust, and collaboration within the Ophthalmology sector, thereby driving meaningful connections and mutual growth.

• Ensuring appropriate use of Roche's products, sharing benefits and risks with Health Care Practitioners in a truthful and balanced manner.

• Collaborating with cross-functional colleagues to prioritize and plan account activities based on team priorities.

• Partnering across functions to address stakeholder needs, prioritize solutions, and evaluate progress.

• Implementing an omnichannel approach to engage stakeholders with Roche's offerings.

• Participating in a peer-to-peer coaching and mentorship model within self-organizing teams.

• Embracing self-directed learning and experiential growth as part of the working culture.

Who you are:

• You hold an University degree in scientific, economic, or business field.

• You bring 7+ years' of experience in life sciences or healthcare sector.

• You have the ability to build strong relationships with external stakeholders and deliver tailored solutions.

• You demonstrate an understanding of fast-paced, competitive market dynamics and the Canadian healthcare system.

• You prove expertise in stakeholder engagement and partnering, including leading cross-functional teams and leveraging digital tools for improved stakeholder experience.

• You have the ability to travel depending on the business need.

Preferred:

• Advanced degree.

• You have 3+ years experience in pharmaceutical sales or key account management, Ophthalmology preferred.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

Partenaire du patient dans son parcours, Ophtalmologie
Lieu : La priorité sera donnée aux candidats de la grande région de Montréal.

Un avenir plus sain. C’est ce qui nous pousse à innover. À faire progresser continuellement la science et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé dont il a besoin, aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les personnes que nous aimons. C’est ce qui définit Roche.

Rejoignez notre mission en ophtalmologie !

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Roche Institute of Human Biology (IHB) in Basel, Switzerland, is seeking a Postdoctoral Scientist focused on in vitro modeling of human adaptive immunity. The role aims to define adaptive immune cell states in human CNS disease and translate these insights into improved experimental models and future therapeutic strategies.
You will work closely with a computational postdoctoral scientist and collaborate with drug developers across pRED, forming an integrated experimental–computational and translational team. Together, you will combine human multi-omic data with targeted experimental systems to define and validate T- and B-cell states in neuroinflammation, with a central focus on developing in vitro models of meningeal inflammation relevant to diseases such as multiple sclerosis (MS) and Alzheimer’s disease (AD).
This position is particularly well suited for a scientist with strong expertise in human adaptive immunology who is excited to build experimental systems that directly interface with high-dimensional datasets.

The Opportunity
As a Postdoctoral Scientist, you will pursue your research within the IHB’s highly collaborative open-lab environment. You will lead experimental efforts to generate, validate, and functionally interrogate immune cell states to model human CNS and meningeal tissues, while working iteratively with computational colleagues. In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

Experimental Immunology & Model Systems:

• Design and execute experimental strategies to investigate adaptive immune responses in human neuroinflammation, with a focus on T-, B-, and stromal-cell biology within tissue-relevant contexts.

• Develop and implement in vitro model systems that recapitulate key features of CNS meningeal inflammation, including immune–stromal interactions and TLS-like organization, and model disease-relevant immune responses in contexts such as multiple sclerosis (MS) and Alzheimer’s disease (AD).

• Perform deep immune phenotyping and generate multi-omic datasets (e.g., flow cytometry, single-cell RNA-seq, V(D)J profiling) to characterize immune–stromal interactions, define adaptive immune cell states, and functionally validate and refine in vitro models aligned with human atlases and translational goals.

Scientific Growth & Translation:

• Partner closely with computational scientists to translate atlas-derived cell states into experimentally testable hypotheses and iteratively refine in vitro models based on human data.

• Engage with teams across IHB and pRED—including direct exposure to drug developers—to align experimental findings with translational questions in Neuroscience and Rare Diseases and contribute to long-term portfolio impact.

• Communicate findings through scientific manuscripts, presentations, and cross-functional discussions, clearly articulating experimental insights and their relevance to human biology and therapeutic strategy.

Who You Are
You are a hands-on experimental scientist with a strong foundation in immunology and a deep interest in human disease biology. You enjoy working collaboratively with computational scientists and are motivated by the opportunity to generate data that directly informs systems-level understanding.
You are excited not only by profiling human immune responses, but also by building experimental systems that capture key features of tissue-specific immunity, including meningeal inflammation and ectopic lymphoid structure-like biology. Furthermore, You bring:

• A Ph.D. in Immunol

jobs.title: Post Doctoral Scientist (IHB) - Computational Immunology
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Roche Institute of Human Biology (IHB) in Basel, Switzerland, is seeking a Postdoctoral Scientist in Computational Biology/Immunology to join a cross-functional research effort focused on building a human atlas of CNS meningeal inflammation. This work aims to generate a deeper understanding of immune cell states in human disease and translate those insights into improved experimental models and future therapeutic strategies.
The successful candidate will be housed within the IHB and work in close collaboration with colleagues across the Institute as well as with partners across pRED, including the Neuroscience and Rare Diseases Therapeutic Area and the Computational Center of Excellence. The role is designed to help bridge foundational human biology research at the IHB with translational questions relevant to the portfolio.
This position will particularly suit a scientist excited by the opportunity to combine computational analysis, immunology, and human multi-omic data to address important questions in neuroinflammation and immune-mediated diseases.

The Opportunity
As a Postdoctoral Scientist, you will pursue your research within the IHB’s highly collaborative open-lab environment. You will contribute to an interdisciplinary effort to define immune cell states, repertoires, and molecular programs across human neuroinflammatory settings, with a particular focus on deriving insights that can benchmark and refine future in vitro model systems developed by the team.
In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

• Scientific Leadership:
Lead computational research projects focused on immune cell state biology in human neuroinflammation, integrating multi-omic datasets to uncover mechanisms relevant to disease and therapeutic intervention.

• Atlas Building:
Contribute to the development of a comprehensive human atlas of neuroinflammation, identifying cellular states and molecular signatures associated with healthy and diseased donor or patient outcomes.

• Innovation:
Apply computational and biological insight to high-dimensional datasets, including single-cell, repertoire, and spatial profiling approaches, to generate hypotheses and guide future translational research.

• Immune Profiling:
Drive analyses of T- and B-cell repertoires and high-throughput single-cell B cell receptor (BCR) repertoire profiling, including AIRR-seq, Rep-seq, and scRNA-seq + VDJ datasets.

• Collaboration:
Partner closely with scientists across IHB and pRED, including colleagues in Neuroscience and Rare Disease, to help translate human biology findings into portfolio-relevant questions and experimental strategies.

• Communication:
Contribute to scientific manuscripts, internal presentations, and external conference presentations, clearly communicating computational and biological findings to diverse audiences.

• Mentorship and Team Science:
Support a collaborative and inclusive research culture by working across functions and

Who You Are
You thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment that gives you ownership of your scientific contributions while encouraging strong partnership across disciplines. You are proactive, curious, and solution-oriented, with the ability to work independently and engage productively with experimental and computational colleagues alike. You are motivated by the opportunity to generate insight from complex datasets and translate those findings into meaningful biological and therapeutic understanding.
You are comfortable working at the interface

The role is designed to help bridge foundational human biology research at the IHB with translational questions relevant to the portfolio.
This position will particularly suit a scientist excited by the opportunity to combine computational analysis, immunology, and human multi-omic data to address important questions in neuroinflammation and immune-mediated diseases.

The Opportunity
As a Postdoctoral Scientist, you will pursue your research within the IHB’s highly collaborative open-lab environment. You will contribute to an interdisciplinary effort to define immune cell states, repertoires, and molecular programs across human neuroinflammatory settings, with a particular focus on deriving insights that can benchmark and refine future in vitro model systems developed by the team.
In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

• Scientific Leadership:
Lead computational research projects focused on immune cell state biology in human neuroinflammation, integrating multi-omic datasets to uncover mechanisms relevant to disease and therapeutic intervention.

• Atlas Building:
Contribute to the development of a comprehensive human atlas of neuroinflammation, identifying cellular states and molecular signatures associated with healthy and diseased donor or patient outcomes.

• Innovation:
Apply computational and biological insight to high-dimensional datasets, including single-cell, repertoire, and spatial profiling approaches, to generate hypotheses and guide future translational research.

• Immune Profiling:
Drive analyses of T- and B-cell repertoires and high-throughput single-cell B cell receptor (BCR) repertoire profiling, including AIRR-seq, Rep-seq, and scRNA-seq + VDJ datasets.

• Collaboration:
Partner closely with scientists across IHB and pRED, including colleagues in Neuroscience and Rare Disease, to help translate human biology findings into portfolio-relevant questions and experimental strategies.

• Communication:
Contribute to scientific manuscripts, internal presentations, and external conference presentations, clearly communicating computational and biological findings to diverse audiences.

jobs.description:

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities主要职责/责任
Routine Operation:

• Perform the physical and chemical testing on the samples from incoming raw materials and packaging materials, produced bulks and products, environment monitoring, process validation and cleaning validation, etc. Issue the reliable analytical report in reasonable lead time.

• Adhere to all effective SOPs and safety requirements and document laboratory work consistent with cGMP requirements

• Assist Head of Analytical Testing lab to complete GMP Self-Inspection as well as the relevant CAPAs to maintain the global level of GMP compliance. Presents technical analytical data clearly and concisely to, internal investigations and regulatory inspectors.

• Accomplish the calibration and maintenance of assigned instruments, to ensure they are in good order to meet the analytical needs any time.

• Report the abnormal status, unexpected results to supervisors with initiative.

● By reporting abnormal status and unexpected results during analysis processing by detailed data and information to alert supervisor to investigate and solve the problem in correct way and in time.

• Maintain laboratory cleanliness and inventory of bioanalytical materials and cell supplies

• Supports lean initiatives in the area of lab operations, test method execution, documentation updates and equipment qualification

Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

• Analytical method transfer execution: Support and execute the analytical method transfer for the aseptic product.

• Analytical Method Validation and Qualification: Execute the methods comparison, qualification and validation activities.

• Equipment Support: Support the Performance Qualification (PQ) of laboratory equipment and ensure routine operation.

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/Qualifications
● Bachelor’s Degree (Life Sciences, Microbiology, or Analytical Sciences is preferred) and above

● 2 or more years of QC experience, QC experience, with a focus on bioanalytical and bioassay testing. MNC Bio-pharma experience is preferred
● Sound knowledge of quality control procedures and legal standards, with experience in aseptic assurance and physical and chemical testing.
● Experienced in QC new facility startup readiness and operation ramp up is preferred.
● Fluent communications skills in English
● Project management skills is preferred.

jobs.title: Domain Architect - Dia R&D
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Domain Architect - Diagnostics R&D

The Domain Architect – Diagnostics R&D is a senior-level, key position within the Strategy, Portfolio & Governance Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions team. This position plays a critical role between the Strategy, Portfolio & Governance (SPG) organization and the Diagnostics R&D function. Reporting directly to the Head of Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions with a dotted line to the Head of Dia RDT for DIA R&D, you will champion our enterprise architecture practices while deeply understanding the unique complexities of the Diagnostics R&D environment.
Crucially, in our federated Roche Digital Technology (RDT) model, you will act as the principal orchestrator of the Diagnostics R&D architecture network. By leading this network—which includes yourself alongside all domain and solution architects embedded directly within the Diagnostics R&D organization—you will drive architecture governance and strategy formulation, ensure enterprise coherence, and translate business goals into adaptable, future-ready roadmaps.

Description of the Area

The Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions area serves as the strategic architectural point of contact for business domain leaders, fostering collaboration to align applications, business capabilities, and information assets with technology solutions. For the Diagnostics R&D domain, this involves deeply integrating with teams such as DIA R&D Labs, DIA R&D Computational Science and Engineering, DIA R&D Instrumentation, DIA Clinical Development and Medical Affairs, and DIA Portfolio & Project Management to drive efficiency and innovation with end-to-end accountability. This role ensures that the bridge between SPG’s enterprise vision and Diagnostics R&D’s operational execution is seamless, collaborative, and highly effective.

The Opportunity:

• You will act as the strategic liaison between SPG EA and Diagnostics R&D, partnering with leadership to align business priorities with multi-year roadmaps.

• You lead the Diagnostics R&D architecture network, shaping shared strategic priorities and enabling architects to execute while maintaining enterprise alignment.

• You provide leadership for architecture governance activities, overseeing deliverables and technology guardrails to ensure security and resilience.

• You drive the success of large, critical technology programs by translating strategy into actionable, transformative initiatives that deliver business value.

• You develop and maintain core architecture artifacts, including Capability Maps and Target-State Architectures, using the standard RDT toolchain.

• You partner with Portfolio Management to embed architectural insights into investment decisions, maximizing platform reuse and managing technical debt.

• You monitor emerging technology trends and evaluate vendors to ensure the Diagnostics R&D architecture remains innovative and future-ready.

• You influence a complex, federated RDT model, balancing enterprise coherence with the agility required for local operational execution.

Who you are:

• You hold a Master’s degree and bring 7+ years of experience in IT and enterprise architecture, specifically within complex, matrixed, or federated global organizations.

• You possess deep domain experience in Diagnostics R&D, with a comprehensive understanding of the scientific, clinical, and engineering processes—from computational science and instrumentation to dry & wet laboratory op

• You provide leadership for architecture governance activities, overseeing deliverables and technology guardrails to ensure security and resilience.

• You partner with Portfolio Management to embed architectural insights into investment decisions, maximizing platform reuse and managing technical debt.

• You monitor emerging technology trends and evaluate vendors to ensure the Diagnostics R&D architecture remains innovative and future-ready.

• You influence a complex, federated RDT model, balancing enterprise coherence with the agility required for local operational execution.
