jobs.title: Head of Drug Regulatory Affairs (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Als Head of Drug Regulatory Affairs (d/f/m) gestaltest Du die Brücke zwischen pharmazeutischer Entwicklung und der sicheren Versorgung von Patient:innen, indem Du die Konformität unseres Portfolios in einem dynamischen regulatorischen Umfeld sicherstellst. In dieser Schlüsselposition verbindest Du strategisches Handeln mit wissenschaftlicher Präzision, damit unsere Medikamente unter Einhaltung höchster Standards die Menschen erreichen, die sie dringend benötigen und auch nachweislich davon profitieren. Gemeinsam mit Deinem Team trägst Du so direkt dazu bei, die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens verantwortungsvoll und nachhaltig zu gestalten.

Dein neues Team:
Du leitest ein engagiertes Team von Expert:innen in der Abteilung Drug Regulatory Affairs (DRA), das durch Kooperation, fachlichen Austausch und gegenseitige Unterstützung geprägt ist. Mit ca. 20 regulatorischen Expert:innen mit den verschiedensten Schwerpunkten (Arzneimittel, Medizinprodukte, regulatorische Texte, Systeme etc.) und einem engagierten Führungsteam gelingt es Dir die DRA in der sich stark wandelnden europäischen regulatorischen Landschaft und mit dem breitgefächerten Roche Portfolio weiterhin zukunftsfähig aufzustellen, Chancen in der dazugehörigen digitalen regulatorischen Prozess- und Systemlandschaft zu erkennen, in Koordination mit relevanten Stakeholdern zu implementieren und Herausforderungen zu meistern. Mit Begeisterung für Möglichkeiten mit den etablierten KI-tools in der Regulatorik setzt Du Maßstäbe und förderst Innovation.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich

• Durch intelligente Optimierung der Produktinformation und zugehöriger Prozess Excellence ermöglichst Du die bestmögliche Produkteinführung. Dafür unterstützt Du schon früh im Entwicklungs- Lifecycle, dass die regulatorischen Texte sowohl den Zugang für die Patienten als auch die Therapieentscheidung der Health-Care Professionals gewährleisten.

• Du stellst die korrekte und termingerechte Bearbeitung aller regulatorischen Agenden für das Grenzach-Portfolio gemäß europäischer und nationaler Gesetze sicher. Dabei berücksichtigst Du sowohl Arzneimittel- als auch Medizinprodukte und In vitro Diagnostic (MDR/IVDR).

• Du bist als Informationsbeauftragter gemäß § 74a AMG für die Zulassungskonformität der regulatorischen Texte aller in Deutschland vertriebenen Roche-Präparate verantwortlich.

• Du entwickelst Zulassungsstrategien für neue Produkte und arbeitest eng mit globalen Gremien, regulatorischen Kolleg:innen in europäischen Niederlassungen sowie crossfunktional über eine Vielzahl interner Funktionen am Standort in Grenzach..

• Du etablierst und pflegst den strategischen Dialog zu Zulassungsbehörden sowie Verbänden (z. B. VFA) und vertrittst die Interessen von Roche proaktiv. Damit gestaltest Du die regulatorische Landschaft mit dem Ziel durch Chancen in der General Pharma Legislation und anderen neuen nationalen und EU Gesetzgebungen ein global kompetitives Umfeld in Deutschland und Europa zu schaffen.

• Du treibst als Teil der lokalen Expertengruppe zur Evidenzgenerierung die Ambitionen voran und stellst sicher, dass das Team projektspezifisch den regulatorische Rahmen erkennt und somit innovativ Projekte effizient umsetzen kann.

• Du führst und coachst die Mitglieder des DRA-Teams und verantwortest die Ressourcenplanung sowie die fachliche Weiterentwicklung der Abteilung.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Pharmazie (Approbation bevorzugt) oder eine vergleichba

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner (雲嘉區)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Grade: SE6-SE8
1. The PJP Mission

• Health care is changing: Radical innovation, increased openness to change, increasing patient empowerment, multiple sources of medical information, and pressure on public spending. As a result of all this, the needs of our stakeholders continue to evolve.

• The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the new Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering world-class medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption. By doing so the PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organisation, faster.

• The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions.

• This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs)

• It has no profitability, sales objectives or incentives
2. Responsibilities
The PJP is a senior level role within the affiliate, who has decision making authority to request resources of Roche (both within the affiliate and broader network) in order to have improved impact on the patient journey

• The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.

• Acts as trusted partner and is the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche; the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster.

• Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community.

• Stewards Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner.

• By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, the PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem.

• The role is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other PJPs.

• Ensuring great experiences whenever stakeholders in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services.
3. Mindset & Behaviors/ VACC

jobs.title: Medical Affairs Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Medical Affairs Manager is a forward-looking health expert who drive diagnostics innovation and its implementation into diagnostics routine, areas: neurology / infectious diseases In this role you will provide state of the art medical insights into the therapeutic area to the local and international teams. You will create value by improving patient pathways.

The Opportunity:

• Enable medical standards of care applied by HCP correspond to the latest medical knowledge

• Develop and execute medical affairs strategy, initiates and executes medical initiatives for Poland and export countries

• Engage and partner with clinical stakeholders, develop a network of relevant KOLs and stakeholders

• Map patient journey and influence its transformation towards the innovative diagnostic solutions

• Shape the therapeutic areas focused non product related expertise and discussion (national consultants/KOL on national level).

• Continuously expand the medical and scientific knowledge as well as market knowledge

• Verify and approve scientific content for symposia / workshops/publications/promotional materials

• Approve medical educational grants

Who you are:

• You have a strong focus on Medical Affairs

• You are an expert that can translate the development in their domain(s) into strategy

• You have the ability to learn and transfer new scientific content quickly,

• You have the ability to search, critically analyze and present medical data

• You have a creative-mindset focused on continuous improvement

• You have excellent understanding of medical needs and system capabilities to properly identify unmet medical need

• You provide in-depth specialist knowledge and may coach colleagues and help others develop expertise/skills

• You are able to facilitate high level health stakeholders interactions

• You bring Agile mindset and ways of working

• You are solution- and customer-orientation

Expertise:

• Deep knowledge and insights of Evidence Based Medicine principles

• Therapeutic area knowledge

• 5 years of relevant experience

• Experience in a clinical / medical work environment

• Relevant medical university degree or deep scientific expertise, MD or PhD is an advantage

• Experience in managing relationships with high level KOL

• Network of KOL in the given therapeutic area

• Good analytical skills

• Proficient in Polish and English

INTERESTED? APPLY!

If you feel this offer suits a friend of yours, feel free to share it.

Want to know what it’s like to be a part of Roche? Check out our blog!
https://diagnostics.roche.com/global/en/careers/roche-careers.html

You have the right to access data, rectify it, delete it, limit processing, transfer it and - if processing is based on your consent - withdraw this consent at any time. Contact the Data Protection Officer at: dia.daneosobowe@roche.com. More information on the principles of processing your personal data by Roche at the link: https://www.roche.pl/privacy-policy-recruitment-dia-en .

The Position
Role Purpose

In this very versatile position you act as supporter, trainer and coordinator at the pivotal point between our global affiliates and our internal departments.

You will be responsible of:

jobs.title: (Sr.) Director Pharma Partnering Transactions (BD&L)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Corporate Business Development organization supports Roche and Genentech partnerships worldwide, encompassing R&D assets, technologies (both biotech and digital), and commercial deals. As a pioneer in healthcare, Roche is dedicated to driving groundbreaking science and technology that transforms patients' lives, and external innovation is a cornerstone of its R&D strategy, complementing its extensive internal pipeline.

The Partnering Transaction Group (PTG) is composed of highly experienced business development professionals in Basel and San Francisco with deep expertise in the execution of pharmaceutical licensing and collaboration deals. We are looking for an excellent candidate to join our group in Basel to ensure that negotiated outcomes of our deals clearly reflect desired partnership arrangements and align with our business objectives.

The Opportunity
As a member of the Partnering Transaction Group, you will be an integral part of deal teams to structure and negotiate high-impact deals, and shape the direction of our global partnerships through the following responsibilities:

• Act as a core member of the deal team to drive strategic partnerships and licensing projects across all therapeutic areas and drug development stages worldwide.

• Lead or co-lead the preparation of offers (NBOs, term sheets) and negotiations with biopharma executive teams and external advisors.

• Participate in briefings with senior management at key project junctures to drive business decisions.

• Focus on all elements of deal strategy and execution, including proposed deal structures and financials based on valuation, risks, and diligence assessments.

• Draft term sheets and deliver detailed comments on complex licensing agreements while driving the resolution of deal issues.

• Highlight deviations from standards on financial and key licensing clauses, identifying resulting risks and possible mitigation strategies.

• Take a lead in developing the transaction and negotiation skills of the organization by creating and delivering training materials.

Who You Are
You are an energetic, results-driven self-starter with a strong executive presence and a track record of leading strategic projects in a complex deal environment, meeting the following requirements:

• Advanced degree in Science, Business, Finance, Law, or a related area.

• A minimum of 10 years of experience in the pharma/biotech industry including professional services, advisory or law firm supporting biopharma clients.

• A minimum of 5 years of specific pharma/biotech transactions-related experience.

• Significant experience in negotiating complex licensing or M&A deals, preferably as the lead negotiator in the biopharma space.

• A thorough understanding of corporate functions, including finance, accounting, legal, and intellectual property (IP).

• Proficient communication skills with a collaborative mindset and the ability to think strategically through advanced professional judgment.

Ready for the next step? We look forward to hearing from you. Apply now to discover this exciting opportunity!

titleByLocale.de: Integrated Medical Engagement Change Management Lead

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Integrated Medical Engagement Catalyst team is at the heart of designing and delivering modernised medical communication and engagement models. As part of the Global Integrated Medical Engagement chapter in PDMA, we focus on the evolution of medical engagement and the tools, processes, and mindsets required for the future. We bridge the gap between today’s standards and a future defined by personalised, scientific exchange.

As a Change Management Lead, you will be a "Catalyst" for organisational transformation. You will ensure that our medical network successfully navigates shifts in how we communicate and engage with customers by addressing both systemic requirements and day-to-day implications for individuals. This is a highly collaborative role, working across PDMA, GIME, and our global affiliate medical network to make our new engagement frameworks a sustainable reality.

• Architect the Change Journey: Design and implement end-to-end transformation strategies that bridge the gap between initial design and sustainable business-as-usual adoption.

• Lead Change Interventions: Serve as the primary change lead for major work packages, integrating human-centric plans into the technical delivery of new frameworks.

• Drive a Future-Ready Culture: Foster a growth and experimental mindset across the medical network, empowering teams to move toward proactive, value-based relationships.

• Ensure Sustainable Adoption: Establish and nurture a network of change agents and champions to drive adoption and ensure new frameworks are successfully scaled globally.

• Design Learning Strategies: Execute learning strategies that upskill the workforce in digital fluency and insight-driven engagement for the future operating model.

• Influence Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with Commercial, Digital, and Technology partners to ensure a "One Roche" approach to the customer experience.

• Uphold Ethical Standards: Ensure all activities follow legal, regulatory, and company codes of practice, including HCP engagement policies and Roche directives.

Who You Are

You are a visionary leader who thrives in complex, fast-changing environments and has a passion for guiding people through transformational shifts. jobs.title: Integrated Medical Engagement Catalyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

As an Integrated Medical Engagement Catalyst, you will play a vital role in supporting the execution and advancement of these strategic initiatives. This position focuses on the practical application of new communication tools and frameworks, ensuring they are robust, user-friendly, and deliver measurable value to the medical community. As a key contributor, you will help enable the necessary evolution of how scientific data is shared and experienced globally.

• Innovate Medical Engagement: Envision and enable the evolution of medical engagement models, assisting in the hands-on development of new tools, templates, and platforms.

• Drive Execution: Lead and enable the delivery of new frameworks for medical communication, managing project workstreams and ensuring ensuring milestones are met and that the operational "nuts and bolts" of new communication & engagement models function effectively for the end-useroperational excellence for end-user.

• Scale Experiments: Test innovative engagement experiments, designing pathways to standardise and scale successful models across the global medical network.

• Foster Collaboration: Work closely with internal stakeholders and external agencies to facilitate the rollout of new standards and troubleshoot implementation barriers.

• Ensure Technical Integrity: Ensure all new frameworks and technologies increase customer impact while remaining easy for Medical Affairs teams to adopt.

• Uphold Compliance: Ensure all activities follow legal, regulatory, and company codes of practice, including Roche directives and HCP engagement policies.

Who You Are

You are a proactive professional with a passion for "Scientific Storytelling". You thrive in a dynamic, transformational environment. You look beyond current processes to solve pain points and evolve for the future. You are a collaborative communicator, fluent in English, who can navigate matrix environments and build meaningful partnerships across internal and external teams.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Qualified Expertise: An advanced life-science degree (PhD, PharmD, or MD preferred) with 2-3 years of deep knowledge in Medical Affairs (Scientific Communications, Medical Education, or Field Medical).

• Strategic Agility: Strong project management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple goals in a fast-paced environment.

• Industry Knowledge: A strong understanding of the regulated bio-pharmaceutical environment and a commitment to high ethical standards.

• Future-Oriented Mindset: A passion for innovation and the ability to simplify complex messages for diverse audiences.

• Collaborative Spirit: A proven track record of working effectively within global, cross-functional teams.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Pathology Scientist (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.
Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche Personalized Healthcare Solutions (PHCS) is seeking a full-time Pathology Scientist (m/f/d) to join the Pathology team of the US-accredited Companion Diagnostics (CDx) laboratory located in Penzberg. If you have experience in Immunohistochemistry (IHC), in situ hybridization (ISH), or quantitative image analysis using artificial intelligence or machine learning, we want to hear from you!

At Roche PHCS, we value collaboration, innovation, and the drive to make significant contributions to healthcare. As part of our team, you'll work in a multidisciplinary environment, engaging with experts in bioinformatics, oncology, digital pathology, and biomarker development.

The Opportunity

Join a global team of over 20 pathologists located in both Germany and the United States who work together to drive innovation and bring new products to market. In this challenging role you will

• Provide medical oversight for pathology and slide reading for early phase clinical trials, assay development, CE-IVD and Pharma clients. Ensure quality and continuous improvement initiatives in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.

• Support R&D activities for primary antibodies, detection systems, probes, special stains, and digital pathology, contributing to new product development and process improvements.

• Serve as the medical representative on project teams, addressing all pathology-related aspects and queries, and making strategic contributions through medical knowledge.

• Participate in Pharma client meetings to support biomarker hypothesis testing strategies, and drive activities for publication and/or patent potential.

• Coordinate the work of contracted pathologists, including training, assigning work and advising on day-to-day activities, as needed.

• Contribute to internal pathology education programs, perform training and scoring of slides, read clinical trial patient samples for the CDx laboratory (Penzberg), and stay up-to-date on pathology, oncology, and molecular biology literature.

• Serve as Principal Investigator with medical accountability across multiple European clinical trials within global CDx development programs, acting as the primary medical interface to Pharma partners.

• Provide medical oversight of laboratory processes, procedures, and quality management systems. Ensure compliance with local regulatory requirements as well as global Roche and international standards and supporting continuous improvement initiatives.

Who you are

• We seek a Pathologist (m/f/d) with German board certification, a valid German medical license and at least one year of clinical or industry experience

• The ideal candidates will have proven expertise in immunohistochemistry

• You are experienced in interpretation and assessment of primary antibodies, detection systems, probes, and molecular platforms

• You are proficient in providing pathology support to project teams and clinical trials

titleByLocale.it: Leader del gruppo Affari medici (Sclerosi Multipla)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Roche is seeking a Medical Affairs leader to shape the future of our Multiple Sclerosis (MS) therapy area. As the Group Leader Medical Affairs , you will lead an experienced team of Global Medical Science Leaders (MDs, PhDs, and PharmDs) who are collectively responsible for our MS medical affairs strategy. This team defines the integrated medical strategy—driving evidence generation, strategic engagement, and medical insights that directly influence how we bring innovative assets to patients worldwide. You will sit at the center of a cross-functional ecosystem, collaborating with specialists in Scientific Communications, Patient Partnership, and Real-World Data to ensure our science changes lives.

The Opportunity

In this role, you will:

• Architect Evidence Strategies: Lead the design and execution of global evidence generation plans, bridging medical and market access gaps through clinical studies and Investigator-Initiated Studies (IIS).

• Forge Purposeful Networks: Build and lead scientific exchange with top-tier academic specialists, clinical influencers, and healthcare stakeholders globally to drive RWD initiatives and research collaborations.

• Translate Insights into Strategy: Synthesize complex medical insights to steer commercialization strategies at both the asset and Disease Area levels.

• Enable Market Access: Provide the medical "north star" for market access strategies, ensuring our innovations are positioned for maximum patient benefit and operational success.

• Champion Scientific Innovation: Secure the strategic input necessary to enable the introduction of next-generation therapies.

• Lead with Global Influence: Collaborate seamlessly across Roche’s Pharma and Diagnostics Divisions and our global affiliate network to ensure a unified medical voice.

Who You Are

You are a visionary leader with deep scientific roots and a relentless passion for Neurology. You don’t just manage teams; you inspire experts to push the boundaries of what’s possible.
Your credentials include:

• Deep Expertise: An advanced life-science degree ( MD, PhD, or PharmD ) with a specialization in Neurology or equivalent high-level industry experience.

• Proven Leadership: A distinguished track record in Medical Affairs, with a demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and develop high-performing expert teams.

• Patient-Centric Ethics: Unwavering ethical standards and a mindset that places the patient at the center of clinical development and medical practice.

• Strategic Agility: The ability to navigate complex global environments, make informed decisions under pressure, and influence stakeholders through exceptional communication.

• Global Fluency: Mastery of written and verbal communication, capable of engaging and inspiring diverse audiences worldwide.

Ready for the next step? We look forward to hearing from you. Apply now to discover how your leadership can redefine the MS landscape at Roche!

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Basel. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Medical Manager is a key strategic leadership role requiring therapeutic area expertise and clear business understanding to identify and address the relevant medical needs of clinical practice, to successfully support the optimal use of Roche products.
They link affiliate to Global Medical Affairs objectives to deliver on data generation, knowledge exchange / data communications, and to lead Therapeutic Area Expert engagement in a scientific manner.
The MM acts as a guardian for high standards of compliance, ethics, and safety of Roche products, putting patients at the center of their actions.

The Opportunity:
Development and management of the medical plan

• Identify local data gaps, local studies protocol design, study planning (including budget), input to site selection and feasibility assessment, data dissemination strategy

• Align the local medical plan with the local marketing, CT/IMT/DST strategy and global medical plan, under supervision of Medical Director

• Congress overview and guidelines development

Medical expertise and customer insights to the brand team

• Offer experienced opinion aligned with LCT/IMT/DSC medical recommendations on scientific medical information to identify and develop effective peer-to-peer relationships to implement our product strategies, while holding high ethical standards, compliance to Roche SOP and local/international regulations

• Research, collate, present and offer data insights related to the dedicated disease area and product(s)

• Lead the integrity and accuracy of scientific and medical data communicated both internally and externally for promotional and non-promotional purposes.

• Handle Medical Information activities in accordance with regional/local model, referencing global standard responses

• Manage publication related activities according to Roche Policy and SOPs

• Develop a customer centricity culture, making sure promotional/medical/scientific communications address HCP needs and optimize patient benefit and safety while keeping a fair balance and compliance with regulations and SOPs

Contribution to local clinical operations activities

• Design, oversight of execution, and report of clinical trials according to ICH-GCP, Roche SOPs and local regulations

• Development of effective interactions with Clinical Operations (both PDG and PA/GPS), including but not limited to placing studies, provide input on feasibility, sites and investigators selection.

• Oversee the phase III-B/IV trial program by holding effective relationship with the Clinical Operations team

• Provide early insights on new products and indications in close collaboration with the PDG group

• Inform other Affiliate functions on Global planned studies

• Design and implementation of patient support programs

Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs) engagement plan and execution

• Maintain regular contacts with investigators for key studies

• Identify and develop scientific relationship with external TAEs/ experts who are qualified sources of insight and advice

• Ensure that all activities towards external experts / TAEs are harmonized across the affiliate

• Share Best Practices across customers to facilitate improved patients outcome

• Planning and execution of relevant scientific advisory boards and expert meetings

Who you are:

• Medical Degree or related careers (Health)

• Oncology background is a must.

• Advanced Level of English

• Professional experience within the pharmaceutical industry desirable but not mandatory

The Medical Manager is a key strategic leadership role requiring therapeutic area expertise and clear business understanding to identify and address the relevant medical needs of clinical practice, to successfully support the optimal use of Roche products.
They link affiliate to Global Medical Affairs objectives to deliver on data generation, knowledge exchange / data communications, and to lead Therapeutic Area Expert engagement in a scientific manner.
The MM acts as a guardian for high standards of compliance, ethics, and safety of Roche products, putting patients at the center of their actions.

The Opportunity:
Development and management of the medical plan

• Identify local data gaps, local studies protocol design, study planning (including budget), input to site selection and feasibility assessment, data dissemination strategy

• Align the local medical plan with the local marketing, CT/IMT/DST strategy and global medical plan, under supervision of Medical Director

• Congress overview and guidelines development

Medical expertise and customer insights to the brand team

• Offer experienced opinion aligned with LCT/IMT/DSC medical recommendations on scientific medical information to identify and develop effective peer-to-peer relationships to implement our product strategies, while holding high ethical standards, compliance to Roche SOP and local/international regulations

• Research, collate, present and offer data insights related to the dedicated disease area and product(s)

• Lead the integrity and accuracy of scientific and medical data communicated both internally and externally for promotional and non-promotional purposes.

• Handle Medical Information activities in accordance with regional/local model, referencing global standard responses

• Manage publication related activities according to Roche Policy and SOPs

• Develop a customer centricity culture, making sure promotional/medical/scientific communications address HCP needs and optimize patient benefit and safety while keeping a fair balance and compliance with regulations and SOPs

Contribution to local clinical operations activities

• Design, oversight of execution, and report of clinical trials according to ICH-GCP, Roche SOPs and local regulations

• Development of effective interactions with Clinical Operations (both PDG and PA/GPS), including but not limited to placing studies, provide input on feasibility, sites and investigators selection.

• Oversee the phase III-B/IV trial program by holding effective relationship with the Clinical Operations team

• Provide early insights on new products and indications in close collaboration with the PDG group

• Inform other Affiliate functions on Global planned studies

• Design and implementation of patient support programs

Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs) engagement plan and execution

• Maintain regular contacts with investigators for key studies

• Identify and develop scientific relationship with external TAEs/ experts who are qualified sources of insight and advice

• Ensure that all activities towards external experts / TAEs are harmonized across the affiliate

• Share Best Practices across customers to facilitate improved patients outcome

• Planning and execution of relevant scientific advisory boards and expert meetings

Who you are:

• Medical Degree or related careers (Health)

• Oncology background is a must.

• Advanced Level of English

• Professional experience within the pharmaceutical industry desirable but not mandatory

jobs.title: Portfolio Leader, Oncology
jobs.description:
The Position
At Roche/Genentech, we have a bold Pharma Ambition to deliver 20 transformative medicines addressing diseases with the highest societal burden by 2030. Within Portfolio Strategy & Management (PSM), we bring this Ambition to life by driving high quality decisions to shape our portfolio. We want you to join our vision and be part of our passionate, collaborative, global PSM team! We are a strong, closely-knit, trusting team that operates from a creative mindset. We try things, openly discuss and learn from mistakes and failure, experiment and iterate to achieve our aspirations. We are THE place for talent to grow and contribute; our talent feels valued, connected, and a sense of belonging to something impactful. We have high impact; stakeholders rely on our expertise to help actively manage our portfolio in order to meet our Pharma Ambition.

The Opportunity:
As Portfolio Leader, Oncology you will focus on co-creating the Portfolio Strategy and managing the portfolio of the Oncology Therapeutic Area. You will be expected to closely collaborate with colleagues in groups beyond PSM (e.g., Global Product Strategy, PD Functions, other Portfolio groups in Roche, Program Management, Finance, gRED, pRED, Chugai) in your day to day work. Accountabilities include, but are not limited to, a combination of the following areas:

• Therapeutic Area Portfolio Strategy development - Partner with PD & GPS Therapeutic Area Heads and other Pharma Leaders (LSPC members, PD & GPS Franchise Heads, pRED & gRED Therapeutic Area Leaders, LifeCycle Leaders) to co-create and deliver robust Oncology portfolio strategies that provide the scaffolding for molecule decisions

• Therapeutic Area Portfolio Management - Actively manage the Oncology portfolio with an enterprise mindset, providing data-driven actionable portfolio insights that contextualize individual molecule and project decisions within the Therapeutic Area, Late Stage, as well as Pharma portfolio priorities. Collaborate closely with the Late Stage Governance Team in implementing the governance process at the Therapeutic Area setting, as well as enabling development and business reviews in advance of portfolio investment decisions.

• Decision Support and Valuation - Serve as an active thought partner to decision-makers and mentor to Portfolio Leads for areas including, but not limited to defining/scoping of tactics to deliver on defined portfolio strategies; content expertise to develop strategic options and valuations; trade-off analysis, and/or decision framing including portfolio context. Serve as an objective and expert reviewer at Boards when invited, focusing on strategic options, trade-off analyses, and valuation

• Portfolio assessments and presentations - Understand and communicate portfolio dynamics (risk, value, mix, competitive positioning etc) at the Therapeutic Area, Late Stage, as well as Pharma levels to influence portfolio decisions.

• You will actively support and model talent flow to work with the highest impact across PSM as well as the broader portfolio community across R&D units to deliver more patient benefit.

Who You Are:
You are a talented and passionate individual, driven by our shared purpose of co-creating and delivering the portfolio for the benefit of patients.

You bring the following background and experience:

• Bachelor's degree in science, business, engineering, or a related field. Advanced degree and/or certification (e.g. MBA, PhD, PharmD, MS, MPH) preferred.

• Experience in matrix cross-functional leadership

• Excellent interpersonal skills, including clear, succinct and timely communication, proven ability to build trusting relationships with and influence stakeholders at all levels.

• Strong drug development understanding, along with planning and organizational skills.

• Demonstrated thought partnership and/or ability to influence Senior Leaders on complex topics, including framing, decision support, and options analysis.

• Experience

The Position
Doing now what patients need next. Near Patient Care is committed to helping people with diabetes everywhere in the world think less about their daily diabetes routine, so they can get true relief, day and night. We offer a broad portfolio of solutions for both people with diabetes and their professionals - from blood glucose monitoring to information management to continuous glucose monitoring. Our aim is to offer innovative products, services and comprehensive solutions for convenient, efficient and effective diabetes management.

Internal Manufacturing Indianapolis is a function within Roche Diagnostics - Near Patient Care Operations, responsible for the strip manufacturing of the majority of our blood glucose monitoring portfolio for the global demand of our patients. In the future, Internal Manufacturing Indianapolis will also be responsible for sensor manufacturing for our continuous glucose monitoring portfolio.

The Opportunity:

As a Sr Manufacturing Engineer - Controls, you will provide technical engineering support of automated and semi-automated manufacturing equipment as required by the production schedule. You will troubleshoot equipment and process issues, lead/contribute to process improvement/characterization projects, train maintenance and production personnel, conduct pilot and validation activities following Roche Diagnostics – Near Patient Care Operations policies and procedure. • Leads the development, implementation and maintenance of manufacturing methods, procedures and processes in the manufacture of products, components, subassemblies and final assemblies.

• Develops and improves automation and electromechanical processes by studying requirements; researching and testing manufacturing and assembly methods and materials; and soliciting observations from operators and maintenance technicians.

• Interfaces with design and process development engineering in coordinating the release of new products to the manufacturing process.

• Helps to estimate manufacturing cost and makes recommendations for tooling, controls system hardware and software, and process requirements of new or existing production lines.

• Manages multiple projects and time scopes for each project.

• Ensures process changes are characterized and implemented following validation policies and procedures.

• Assures system and product quality by designing testing methods; testing finished -product and system capabilities; and confirming fabrication, assembly, and installation processes.

• Assists department leadership in setting strategic direction.

• Possess and apply a broad knowledge of principles, practices, and procedures of the field.

• Maintains product and company reputation by complying with government regulations.

• Provide guidance and advice to lower level staff.

The Position
Doing now what patients need next. Near Patient Care is committed to helping people with diabetes everywhere in the world think less about their daily diabetes routine, so they can get true relief, day and night. We offer a broad portfolio of solutions for both people with diabetes and their professionals - from blood glucose monitoring to information management to continuous glucose monitoring. Our aim is to offer innovative products, services and comprehensive solutions for convenient, efficient and effective diabetes management.

Internal Manufacturing Indianapolis is a function within Roche Diagnostics - Near Patient Care Operations, responsible for the strip manufacturing of the majority of our blood glucose monitoring portfolio for the global demand of our patients. In the future, Internal Manufacturing Indianapolis will also be responsible for sensor manufacturing for our continuous glucose monitoring portfolio.

The Opportunity:

As a Sr Manufacturing Engineer - Controls, you will provide technical engineering support of automated and semi-automated manufacturing equipment as required by the production schedule. You will troubleshoot equipment and process issues, lead/contribute to process improvement/characterization projects, train maintenance and production personnel, conduct pilot and validation activities following Roche Diagnostics – Near Patient Care Operations policies and procedure. You will ensure the validated state of the production process/equipment is maintained.

Your Responsibilities;

• Leads the development, implementation and maintenance of manufacturing methods, procedures and processes in the manufacture of products, components, subassemblies and final assemblies.

• Develops and improves automation and electromechanical processes by studying requirements; researching and testing manufacturing and assembly methods and materials; and soliciting observations from operators and maintenance technicians.

• Interfaces with design and process development engineering in coordinating the release of new products to the manufacturing process.

• Helps to estimate manufacturing cost and makes recommendations for tooling, controls system hardware and software, and process requirements of new or existing production lines.

• Manages multiple projects and time scopes for each project.

• Ensures process changes are characterized and implemented following validation policies and procedures.

• Assures system and product quality by designing testing methods; testing finished -product and system capabilities; and confirming fabrication, assembly, and installation processes.

• Assists department leadership in setting strategic direction.

• Possess and apply a broad knowledge of principles, practices, and procedures of the field.

• Maintains product and company reputation by complying with government regulations.

• Provide guidance and advice to lower level staff.

• Participates in the on-call rotation to provide off shift / weekend support to production, as needed.

• Support key initiatives such as information management, cyber security, and life cycle management.

jobs.title: Head of Direct Materials - Global Procurement

titleByLocale.en: Head of Direct Materials - Global Procurement

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Delivery (Category) capability covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. The Delivery (Category) capability comprises many communities grouping categories of the same value chain or having commonality. The communities are key enablers of strong category expertise while allowing flexibility in the procurement delivery response to the evolving needs of our customers.

This position is part of the Materials, Manufacturing & Capex (MMC) Procurement community leadership team reporting into the Chapter Lead of Materials, Manufacturing & Capex Procurement in Global Procurement

As the Head of Direct Materials Global Procurement, you will be accountable for the Procurement accountabilities of the global Pharma Direct Materials spend for Roche. You will work in a dynamic global environment where you will meet the challenge to bring vision, guidance, prioritization, and focus to the Procurement Category capability area such as team vision, capability development, and strategic Delivery prioritization (in line with functional objectives and business needs).

You are a collaborator and through partnership with internal procurement Heads and Leads you will align on needs, identify opportunities, define goals, and advance priorities. You influence decision-making and remove barriers to ensure the delivery of high-quality customer-oriented sourcing and spend management strategies.

You will lead and guide a team of Procurement Category Expert and Senior Experts, working closely with them to develop the team vision, prioritize and focus efforts, and provide coaching and guidance to support your team’s development and growth both as individuals and as a team.

You are accountable for the best allocation of your people to ensure flexibility, excellence in execution, delivery and performance, and talent development. You are part of the MMC Leadership Team and will support the implementation of GP Strategy in addition to your Category and Team accountabilities and be flexible in responsibilities as needed as a Senior Leader in Global Procurement.

The Head of Direct Materials will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and the general business/team requirements, including, but not limited to, these core responsibilities:

The Opportunity

• You utilise your in depth knowledge and expertise in Pharma Direct Materials to act as a Category domain lead providing thought leadership, advice, and know-how on delivery capability topics, strategies, and best practices, and shaping and defining the team’s delivery

• You are a strategic leader overseeing, improving and driving delivery of sourcing, category, contracting, technology and supplier related strategies as well as coaching team members, including modeling behaviors and mindsets necessary for advancing the capability vision.

• You oversee and ensure Supply Resilience, Financial and other core Corporate and Catego

• Operational Excellence: Proficient in Agile and Lean methodologies (e.g., Six Sigma, Scrum) to challenge the status quo and drive innovative change.

• Elite Communication: Exceptional organizational skills and fluency in English, with the ability to influence and present effectively at a corporate level.

jobs.title: (Senior) Regulatory Group Director (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Die Position
In dieser Führungsposition innerhalb von Pharma Technical Regulatory (PTR) verfügst du über ein breites Verständnis der regulatorischen Landschaft und setzt dein Wissen gezielt ein, um Ergebnisse im Einklang mit unserer „North Star“-Vision zu erzielen. Als Führungskraft bist du dafür verantwortlich, Veränderungen in der gesamten Organisation voranzutreiben und unsere Mitarbeitenden in einem globalen Umfeld zu unterstützen. Du hast ein tiefgreifendes Verständnis für Prioritäten und Bereiche mit hoher Hebelwirkung, vernetzt die richtigen Personen und Ressourcen mit den entsprechenden Aufgaben und hilfst der Organisation, sich an veränderte regulatorische Anforderungen anzupassen. Du inspirierst unsere Teams zu mutiger Innovation und Zusammenarbeit, um Ergebnisse zu erzielen, die für Patienten, Stakeholder und das Unternehmen von entscheidender Bedeutung sind.
In der Rolle des Regulatory Group Director verantwortest du sowohl das Portfolio-Management (mit Schwerpunkt im Bereich Biologics / ADCs) als auch die personelle Führung . Dabei unterstützt und befähigst du Teams und Einzelpersonen innerhalb dieses Betriebsmodells, die übergeordneten Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

Deine Chancen

• Strategische Verantwortung: Du übernimmst die Aufsicht und Verantwortung für die Entwicklung und Implementierung von End-to-End-Regulierungsstrategien und -initiativen auf Portfolio-Ebene.

• Portfolio-Steuerung: Du definierst Strategien für ein spezifisches Portfolio (z. B. Produktportfolio innerhalb einer Modalität, cross-funktionale Initiativen für Innovation, Operational Excellence oder Policy) und übersetzt diese in konkrete Ergebnisse. Dabei sicherst du die Transparenz über Squads und Teams hinweg, priorisierst Aufgaben und steuerst die Ressourcenplanung sowie das Budgeting.

• Globale Kollaboration: Du arbeitest auf globaler Ebene eng mit anderen Führungskräften zusammen, um Prioritäten abzustimmen und die Organisationsziele durch punktuelle Unterstützung von Projekten und Initiativen zu fördern.

• Trend-Monitoring: Du hältst dich über interne und externe Entwicklungen sowie Trends auf dem Laufenden, um die Auswirkungen auf alle Programme bewerten zu können, und stärkst das Bewusstsein hierfür im Unternehmen.

• Behördenmanagement: Du leitest Interaktionen mit Gesundheitsbehörden (Health Authorities) sowie die Überprüfung von Einreichungen (Submissions) für zugewiesene Projekte mit erweitertem Umfang. Du vertrittst den Bereich Technical Regulatory in multidisziplinären Terminen mit Behörden. Zudem bist du zentraler Ansprechpartner für einen oder mehrere regulatorische Kompetenzbereiche (z. B. CTA, NDA, LCM, Datenmanagement, Systeme) und treibst dort Effizienz und Exzellenz voran.

• Kommunikation & Stakeholder-Management: Du fungierst als Sprachrohr der Organisation und stellst sicher, dass Herausforderungen, Chancen und Maßnahmen der Führungsebene den Mitarbeitenden strukturiert und transparent vermittelt werden. Du baust Beziehungen zu internen Stakeholdern auf und räumst organisatorische Hindernisse aus dem Weg.

• Modern Leadership: Als Führungskraft befähigst du selbstverwaltete Teams, indem du als Visionär, Architekt, Coach und Katalysator agierst. Du bist für das Performance-Management deiner Direct Reports verantwortlich, gibst zeitnahes Feedback und förderst die individuelle Entwicklung durch regelmäßige Gespräche und Check-ins.

Dein Profil
Du verfügst über exzellente Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten und bist in der Lage, komplexe Sachverha

Du hast ein tiefgreifendes Verständnis für Prioritäten und Bereiche mit hoher Hebelwirkung, vernetzt die richtigen Personen und Ressourcen mit den entsprechenden Aufgaben und hilfst der Organisation, sich an veränderte regulatorische Anforderungen anzupassen. Du inspirierst unsere Teams zu mutiger Innovation und Zusammenarbeit, um Ergebnisse zu erzielen, die für Patienten, Stakeholder und das Unternehmen von entscheidender Bedeutung sind.
In der Rolle des Regulatory Group Director verantwortest du sowohl das Portfolio-Management (mit Schwerpunkt im Bereich Biologics / ADCs) als auch die personelle Führung . Dabei unterstützt und befähigst du Teams und Einzelpersonen innerhalb dieses Betriebsmodells, die übergeordneten Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

Deine Chancen

• Strategische Verantwortung: Du übernimmst die Aufsicht und Verantwortung für die Entwicklung und Implementierung von End-to-End-Regulierungsstrategien und -initiativen auf Portfolio-Ebene.

• Portfolio-Steuerung: Du definierst Strategien für ein spezifisches Portfolio (z. B. Produktportfolio innerhalb einer Modalität, cross-funktionale Initiativen für Innovation, Operational Excellence oder Policy) und übersetzt diese in konkrete Ergebnisse. Dabei sicherst du die Transparenz über Squads und Teams hinweg, priorisierst Aufgaben und steuerst die Ressourcenplanung sowie das Budgeting.

• Globale Kollaboration: Du arbeitest auf globaler Ebene eng mit anderen Führungskräften zusammen, um Prioritäten abzustimmen und die Organisationsziele durch punktuelle Unterstützung von Projekten und Initiativen zu fördern.

• Trend-Monitoring: Du hältst dich über interne und externe Entwicklungen sowie Trends auf dem Laufenden, um die Auswirkungen auf alle Programme bewerten zu können, und stärkst das Bewusstsein hierfür im Unternehmen.

• Behördenmanagement: Du leitest Interaktionen mit Gesundheitsbehörden (Health Authorities) sowie die Überprüfung von Einreichungen (Submissions) für zugewiesene Projekte mit erweitertem Umfang. Du vertrittst den Bereich Technical Regulatory in multidisziplinären Terminen mit Behörden. Zudem bist du zentraler Ansprechpartner für einen oder mehrere regulatorische Kompetenzbereiche (z. B. CTA, NDA, LCM, Datenmanagement, Systeme) und treibst dort Effizienz und Exzellenz voran.

• Kommunikation & Stakeholder-Management: Du fungierst als Sprachrohr der Organisation und stellst sicher, dass Herausforderungen, Chancen und Maßnahmen der Führungsebene den Mitarbeitenden strukturiert und transparent vermittelt werden. Du baust Beziehungen zu internen Stakeholdern auf und räumst organisatorische Hindernisse aus dem Weg.

• Modern Leadership: Als Führungskraft befähigst du selbstverwaltete Teams, indem du als Visionär, Architekt, Coach und Katalysator agierst. Du bist für das Performance-Management deiner Direct Reports verantwortlich, gibst zeitnahes Feedback und förderst die individuelle Entwicklung durch regelmäßige Gespräche und Check-ins.

Du verfügst über exzellente Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten und bist in der Lage, komplexe Sachverha

jobs.title: Ad Operations Coordinator (Fixed-term)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has newly been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

The Ad Operations Coordinator plays a central role in ensuring high-quality campaign activation and reliable data foundations for reporting and performance measurement. This role requires a hands-on operator with strong technical expertise in ad serving platforms, combined with a structured, detail-oriented mindset and a focus on scalable and sustainable operations.

This is a fixed-term opportunity for 1,5 year.

The Opportunity:

• Manage and support the setup, configuration, and ongoing operation of Roche Pharma’s ad server environment, including the rollout and adoption of usage across teams in line with defined standards and best practices

• Execute and oversee campaign trafficking end-to-end, ensuring accurate setup, tagging, ad assignment, and launch readiness, while reviewing and correcting builds to maintain high execution quality

• Act as a subject matter expert for ad server governance, maintaining naming conventions, taxonomy, and trafficking standards, and ensuring consistency, auditability, and operational discipline

• Ensure data integrity across the ad server ecosystem by supporting tagging and tracking frameworks, validating reporting outputs, and collaborating with analytics teams to enable reliable dashboards and measurement

• Troubleshoot campaign and data issues, serve as a key point of contact for stakeholders, and drive continuous improvement of workflows, processes, and scalable ad operations practices

Who you are:

• You have 6+ years of experience in digital marketing, ad operations, campaign management, or a related field, including at least 4 years of hands-on experience in ad trafficking and ad server operations, ideally within a media agency or comparable in-house function

• You have strong hands-on experience with ad-serving platforms such as Campaign Manager 360 (CM360) or equivalent, and understand campaign setup, tagging workflows, placement structures, creatives, and tracking methodologies

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken) are essential and additional languages are a plus, based on region/customer requirements

• You are detail-oriented, well-organized, and efficient with time management

• You are able to work under pressure and work independently

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes, and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching/mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global, inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes,

The Position
Main Responsibilities:
Manages market research needs for products or therapeutic areas within the organization.
Conducts and manages primary and secondary market research projects, including labeling and advertising.
Provides marketing insight and direction to optimize strategic products
Analyzes data and makes strategic recommendations.
Contributes to annual business plan and maximizes market potential. Interprets and translates scientific clinical data into commercial implications.
Directs the development of company marketing plan and supporting sales activities for specific products or product lines including assessment of potential markets.
Establishes pricing strategies, develops budgets and monitors expenditures.
May develop short and long-range strategies for product expansion. Interfaces with Product Development, Production and Manufacturing to develop new products or enhance existing products or product lines.
May act as a technical advisor for specific products.
Oversees market analysis, monitors competitive activity, and identifies customer needs. Defines vision, strategies, and tactics.
Selects, develops and evaluates employees to ensure the efficient operation of the function.

Education/Qualifications

• Bachelor above

• Medical, marketing, commerce preferred

• Adapt well to different cultures and business styles

• Collaborative and supportive approach to teamwork

• Good understanding and strong commitment

• Innovate and highly self-motivated to drive results

• Strong learning agility

Job Required Competencies

• MNC background

• 7-10 years’ experience in marketing and/sales

• 7 years Pharmaceutical or relevant marketing experience preferred

• Strong communication and presentation skills in Chinese and English (oral and writing)

• Strong execution capability, cross-functional communication

• Excellent communication and presentation skills in Chinese and English (oral and writing)

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

PSS Transformation Solution Partner

titleByLocale.it: Partner della soluzione di trasformazione PSS

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Transformation and Solution Partner (TSP) , you will engage and partner primarily with People & Culture (P&C) colleagues across all Chapters and business stakeholders globally. Your mission is to govern M&A and transformation data management frameworks with right solution expertise while driving global P&C solution improvements. You will serve as a centre of excellence for transformation ideation, navigating complex business transformations to ensure a seamless partner experience in collaboration with Transformation and Solution Advisor (TSA). You help translate business goals into P&C priorities, leveraging holistic data and historical learning to iterate and improve the overall global transformation flow.

Your opportunity as Transformation & Solution Partner:

• M&A / Transformation Framework Governance: Lead the governance of transformation frameworks to ensure consistency and excellence across global initiatives.

• Transformation Solution & Framework Expertise: Provide expert guidance and implementation support for digital transformation tools. Serve as a Centre of Excellence for transformation improvement ideations, capturing historical learnings to further iterate and enhance existing transformation experience.

• Strategic Stakeholder Partnership: Partner with Business Partners and business leaders of globally-scaled transformations to provide framework consultancy, from preliminary until embedment stages.

• Cross P&C Solution Improvement: Drive improvements for the overall global transformation flow, identifying gaps and implementing proactive solutions across the P&C network.Collaborates on complex P&C challenges and demands, connecting with the right P&C chapters to develop an end-to-end solution, determine ownership and drive effective change management.

• Continue Improvement : Proactively identifies customer needs or P&C solutions’ gaps, and translates these needs to change requests and builds cross-functional squads to implement continuous improvements within our P&C network.

• Collaboration & Innovation: Share best practices for emerging technologies, such as AI-driven org design and job design to build Transformation and solution advisory team knowledge and capability.

Who you are:
You bring the following skills and competencies:

• Passion for Change: Deep interest in project management, process improvement, and change management.

• Digital Proficiency: Strong expertise in digital solutions like Airtable and Workday, with the ability to lead the transition from manual spreadsheets to integrated technology platforms.

• Exceptional Stakeholder Management: Ability to represent the P&C/PSS vision and articulate the strategy and “the why” behind complex transformations.

• Agility: Ability to work independently and deliver results in a matrixed, fast-paced environment while balancing competing priorities.

• Influencing Skills: Exceptional communication, consulting, and negotiation skills, with the ability to coach colleagues and lead without direct authority.

Further requirements:

• Education: University degree or equivalent, HR preferred.

• Experience: Extensive experience (typically 7–8 years) with HR processes, HR shared services, or HR functional expertise, ideally in a global environment.

• Transformation Expertise: Proven track record in managing large-scale global transformations and M&A activities.

• Languages: Fluent in English required; additional languages are a plus.

• Certification: Project management and/or process

The Position
Head of Digital Strategy, Excellence & Standards, Global Digital & Data Analytics

Why Roche
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

Who We Are
The Global Data, Digital & AI (GDDA) organization plays a central role in Roche Pharma Commercial’s digital and AI ecosystem. GDDA sets the enterprise digital strategy, translates commercial objectives into a coordinated portfolio of investments, and defines the standards and operating model that enable scalable execution across programs and products. By connecting strategy, portfolio, standards, programs, and products, GDDA ensures that data, digital, and AI capabilities are delivered as scalable, enterprise solutions that drive adoption and improve outcomes for patients, healthcare providers, and the broader healthcare ecosystem.

The Opportunity
The Head of Digital Strategy, Excellence & Standards is responsible for shaping and driving the strategic agenda of the Global Data, Digital & AI organization within Pharma Commercial. This role leads development of the GDDA strategic plan, ensuring strategic coherence with GDDA’s core mandates while translating enterprise and Pharma Commercial priorities into clear GDDA objectives, outcomes, and prioritization principles that guide investment decisions. This role also drives the design of GDDA’s operating model and organizational approach including the definition of global vs. local standards and operating discipline for digital products, data, and technology— establishing the bar for quality and consistency across markets and local execution. This role also owns change enablement across the digital ecosystem — ensuring that new standards, processes, and capabilities are adopted effectively through structured communication, stakeholder engagement, and organizational readiness. Partnering closely with leaders across Roche Pharma, the Head of Strategy defines interfaces, aligns initiatives, and avoids duplication across the broader digital ecosystem. Acting as Chief of Staff to the GDDA Leader, this role represents GDDA perspectives in leadership forums, develops executive narratives, and ensures strong cross-functional alignment and a coherent path from strategy to impact. Over time, the role will build and lead a team responsible for delivering and scaling these mandates.

What you will be working on
Strategy & Standards
Lead development and evolution of the enterprise GDDA strategy, including mandate definition, ambition setting, and a multi-year capability vision and strategic direction ensuring alignment with enterprise priorities and continuous evolution based on value realization and external signals.

• Engage in enterprise strategic conversations to ensure pharma commercial digital priorities are represented as enterprise strategies are shaped.
• Ensure ongoing strategic alignment of GDDA initiatives with broader Roche Pharma and enterprise priorities.
• Continuously refresh, connect,

• Act as GDDA’s accountable lead for digital orchestration of the PACE commercialization excellence program, ensuring alignment across product, delivery, and business stakeholders.

• Reinforce alignment between program milestones and product roadmaps, enabling resolution where misalignment exists.
• Ensure that PACE-related decisions and requirements are communicated clearly to program leads and integrated into cross-suite planning and governance processes.

• Cross-Suite Coordination & Dependency Management
• Orchestrate cross-cutting initiatives across product suites and digital programs, ensuring alignment, sequencing, and integration.
• Surface and enable resolution of cross-suite dependencies, sequencing conflicts, and resource constraints across product, program, and delivery teams.
• Provide a consolidated PACE digital view (status, dependencies, risks, capacity) to inform product and portfolio decision-making.
• Orchestrate planning and execution rhythms — ensuring consistent connection and alignment across program, product, and leadership stakeholders.

jobs.title: Data and Analytics Governance (DAG) Lead

titleByLocale.it: Gestione dei dati e delle analisi (DAG)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Data and Analytics Governance (DAG) Lead is a key role responsible for establishing and maintaining effective data & analytics governance practices for Roche’s Digital Backbone (Enterprise Resource Planning environment) and the Finance, Procurement and Roche Solution and Services Domain, working closely with cross-functional teams in ASPIRE program (implementing and deploying the Digital Backbone to all Roche affiliates), Roche Data Office, Informatics and Enterprise Master Data Management (EMDM) to ensure the consistent application of Functional DAG policies, standards and controls derived out of the Global Guidelines from the Roche Data Office.

• Align, Develop and implement a comprehensive DAG Framework, including data policies, standards, and procedures in alignment with the Roche Data Council's policies, standards and procedures.

• Implement and further develop the Framework`s data and analytics -related roles, responsibilities, and accountabilities

• Develop and implement a comprehensive DAG Cookbook, including metadata management guidance

• Build and maintain up to date metadata repository, data lineage, monitor data quality, integrity, and security measures in collaboration with data stewards, data owners, and Informatics teams

• Facilitate DAG meetings, Stakeholder alignment meetings and closely collaborate with the Roche Data Council

• Manage Business Data Stewardship from a Product Owner perspective, including Strategy, Roadmap and Objectives for Data Analytics and Governance (DAG), aligned with Group Data Strategy

Who you are

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Management, or a related field

• 5+ years of experience in data management, governance, or analytics roles

• Strong understanding of data architecture, data modeling, and data warehousing concepts

• Familiarity with data governance frameworks and standards (e.g., DAMA)

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights

• Effective communication and facilitation skills to engage stakeholders at all levels

• Project management experience and the ability to juggle multiple priorities

• Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging data and analytics governance frameworks to continuously improve DAG Roche’s Digital Backbone approach

• Excellent understanding of Data & Analytics, Pharmaceutical Business Processes, Data Governance Solutions (e.g. Collibra)

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive cult

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 1. 职位职责：
• （ 1） 协助 在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （ 2） 协助 进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训
• （ 3） 协助 开展学术会议，向客户介绍产品在不同适应症上的优点
• （ 4） 协助 及时收集、提供市场信息并做出适当建议

2. 职位要求：
• （ 1）在校大学生
• （ 2）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （ 3）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （ 4）熟练运用 Excel、PPT、Word等办公应用软件
• （ 5）拥有良好的英语书写能力

A healthier future drives us to innovate. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
