jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
Als Facility Expert Bau & Brandschutz (m/w/d) stells t Du durch strategische (“Warum, Wohin”) und taktische (“Wie, Wann” ) Steuerung sicher, dass alle Anlagen und Gebäude der Roche Pharma AG sicher, konform, effektiv und energieeffizient betrieben werden. Gewährleistest die Einhaltung aller Gesetze,
Vorschr iften sowie Roche - Standards und überrnimmst die Verantwortung für den Betrieb des baulichen Bestands und die Sicherstellung des baulichen, organisatorischen Brandschutzes als bestellter Brandschutzbeauftragter. Dein Verantwortungsbereich liegt dabei in den Bereich Rohbau (Maurer - , Erd - , Zimmerer - , Dachdecker arbeiten), Fassade, Ausbau (Putz - , Maler - , Trockenbau - , Fenster - , Tischler - , Bodenarbeiten), Landschafts - , Strassenbau - , Markierungsarbeiten. Darüber hinaus übernimmst Du folgende Aufgaben:

• Maintenance Strategy: Entwicklung und Optimierung der Instandhaltungsstrategien für den baulichen Bestand. Erstellung und Pflege von Anlagendaten sowie Wartungsplänen.

• Building Management: Verantwortung für die Instandhaltung der Gebäudehülle, sowie des Innenausbaus des baulichen Bestands. Ebenso für Umsetzung des Corporate Designs

• Baulicher Brandschutz: Sicherstellung der Einhaltung aller brandschutzrechtlichen Vorgaben (Brandwände, Schottungen, Türen). Pflege der Brandschutzkataster und - pläne.

• Bestellung zum Brandschutzbeauftragten. Wahrnehmung der damit verbundenen Aufgaben (DGUV 205 - 003) .

• Technical Standards: Definition und Pflege der technischen Standards und Werksnormen.

• Life Cycle Asset Management (LCAM): Erstellung von Budget - /Investitionsplänen (OPEX/CAPEX) für den Werterhalt und die Sanierung.

• Records Management: Sicherstellung einer lückenlosen und rechtskonformen Dokumentation aller anlagenbezogenen Daten und Pläne.

• Planung und Leitung von Instandhaltungsprojekten . Fachverantwortung und Mitarbeit bei Investitionsprojekten als Betreiber/Bauherrenvertreter.

• Service & Fremdfirmen Management: strategische und taktische Steuerung und Überwachung der Dienstleister als Subject Matter Expert (SME). Abnahme von Leistungen und Qualitätskontrolle. Sicherstellung der Durchführung gesetzlich vorgeschriebener Prüfungen.

• Technical Compliance: Überwachung der Betreiberpflichten im Bereich Bau und Brandschutz.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Studium Bauingenieurwesen, Architektur oder Bautechniker, oder vergleichbar

• Erfahrung im Bauen im Bestand, idealerweise in Industrieumgebung

• Zusatzqualifikation im Brandschutz (z.B. Brandschutzbeauftragter, Fachplaner Brandschutz, feuerwehrtechnische Ausbildung) sehr wünschenswert, bzw. die Bereitschaft diese zu erlangen.

• Kenntnisse der Landesbauordnung (LBO) und Industriebaurichtlinie.

• Projektmanagement - Skills.

• Sprachen: Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, gutes Englisch

• Bereitschaft zur Anwesenheit am Standort, sowie zur betriebsbedingten Rufbereitschaft und Reisetätigkeit

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
Als Site Automation Manager (m/w/d) stellst Du sicher, dass a lle Systeme der Roche Pharma AG sicher, konform und effektiv
betrieben werden. Du gewährleistest die Einhaltung aller Gesetze, Vorschriften und Roche - Standards, unterstützt Prozesse durch Bereitstellung automatisierter Systeme und bietest Fach wissen in Engineering, Design, Installation und Inbetriebnahme von Automatisierungssystemen. Außerdem supportest Du den Betrieb bei der Problemlösung in Bezug auf Automatisierungssysteme sowie der V alidierung von Prozess - und Gebäudeautomation und entwickelst Systemarchitekturen. Darüber hinaus übernimmst Du folgende Aufgaben:

• Maintenance Strategy: Entwicklung und Optimierung der Instandhaltungsstrategien für die Systeme des Verantwortungsbereichs.

jobs.title: Responsable Territorial Equipe Services (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Localisation idéale en région Parisienne

Mission :

• En tant que responsable d'une équipe service pour cette zone géographique, il/elle est responsable de la qualité du service produit par l’équipe et de l’amélioration continue des processus qu’il/elle supervise.

• Leader, il/elle sait partager et engager autour d’une vision stratégique, et structurer les activités de manière efficace et collaborative. En tant que coach, il/elle accompagne le développement de son équipe.

• Multiplicateur de la culture agile, il/elle met en place dans son équipe un cadre d’ autonomie croissante et crée les conditions d’une décision déléguée efficace; il/elle recrute les talents dont l’organisation a besoin, anticipe sur les nouvelles compétences grâce à sa veille des évolutions du marché, et enfin, il/elle incarne les Leadership commitments.

Principales responsabilité:

• De manière opérationnelle, il/elle participe à des projets au sein de son chapter/de la filiale/ de la région .

• Il/elle pilote les activités de ses équipes et assure l’amélioration continue des processus de son activité. Il est le point d’entrée de l’équipe admin Service pour le dispatch et assure un soutien sur les procédures d’inventaires

• Il/elle met en place les conditions facilitant les gains d’efficacité de l’activité, et les plans d’accompagnement au changement vers ces évolutions (notamment partenariats externes et internes)

• Il/elle priorise les activités de son équipe en prenant en compte: les besoins des networks; les plans de déploiements sur son territoire + vision nationale; nos engagements avec les clients; la criticité (business continuité) des nos clients et de RDF

• Il s’assure du maintien à jour des processus métiers liés à son activité et est le garant de la gestion de la connaissance liée à son activité

• Il/elle garantit le respect des règles de conformité au sein de son équipe

Qui vous êtes:

• Vous avez une expérience significative dans le domaine du diagnostic in vitro (ou équivalent) en lien direct avec les dimensions techniques (hardware ou application) et organisationnelle.

• Vous présentez de bonnes qualités de leadership et avez de bonnes appétences pour le coaching et le développement des équipes

• Votre niveau d'Anglais est professionnel

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• De manière opérationnelle, il/elle participe à des projets au sein de son chapter/de la filiale/ de la région .

• Il/elle pilote les activités de ses équipes et assure l’amélioration continue des processus de son activité. Il est le point d’entrée de l’équipe admin Service pour le dispatch et assure un soutien sur les procédures d’inventaires

• Il/elle met en place les conditions facilitant les gains d’efficacité de l’activité, et les plans d’accompagnement au changement vers ces évolutions (notamment partenariats externes et internes)

• Il/elle priorise les activités de son équipe en prenant en compte: les besoins des networks; les plans de déploiements sur son territoire + vision nationale; nos engagements avec les clients; la criticité (business continuité) des nos clients et de RDF

• Il s’assure du maintien à jour des processus métiers liés à son activité et est le garant de la gestion de la connaissance liée à son activité

• Il/elle garantit le respect des règles de conformité au sein de son équipe

Qui vous êtes:

• Vous avez une expérience significative dans le domaine du diagnostic in vitro (ou équivalent) en lien direct avec les dimensions techniques (hardware ou application) et organisationnelle.

• Vous présentez de bonnes qualités de leadership et avez de bonnes appétences pour le coaching et le développement des équipes

• Votre niveau d'Anglais est professionnel

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: System Support Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The opportunity

Develop and deploy strategy to maintain well performance of Roche Products which are Instruments, Reagents, Services and other Peripheral accessories that work together with Roche Diagnostics Thailand Products & Services. Lead the organization's activities to ensure continuity of business operation. Collaborate with other post sales support functions to foster high performance of Roche Diagnostics Products and Services to ensure smooth operation and agreed business targets. Innovate and Promote new processes with compliance and governance, operation excellence and customer engagement. Steer post sales support direction to ensure customer engagement, good experience, effectiveness and cost efficiency according to the company's goal and direction.

Role-Specific Accountabilities
(the primary tasks and responsibilities this job is expected to perform)

• Define clear and agreed targets for instrument, products and services performance related to global, regional and local company direction targets.

• Define work processes to ensure business outcome is achieved and regularly communicate with all team members.

• Monitoring Instrument & Products performance and compare with agreed targets.

• Maintain a high level of data quality in all aspects.

• Ensure adequate knowledge and competency of all members.

• Manage resource effectiveness, efficiency and fairness.

• Collaborate with other functions to ensure smooth operation.

• Develop, adopt existing tools and drive utilization to help performance improvement.

• Actively participating, Collaboratively working as enabling team of PSS.

• Drive compliance in all work processes and actively display as role-model in MQMS.

Who you are
Experience and Competencies:

• Interpersonal Skills: Display patience, cooperativeness and professional presentation in dealings with others.

• Customer Orientation: Demonstrate a desire to assist customers to meet their needs. Look for long-term benefits to the customer and the organization. Maintain clear communication with the customer regarding mutual expectations and monitor customer satisfaction. Give cheerful, friendly service. Express a positive attitude about and towards customers.

• Empathy: Use interpersonal communication skills to accurately hear and understand the needs of customers and colleagues.

• Flexibility: Display an organized but flexible approach to resolving business issues by adapting to and working within a variety of situations.

• Initiative: Display an ability to identify market opportunities and develop programs to maximize sales.

• Result Focus: Demonstrate persistence and perseverance to achieve desirable business outcomes.

• Business Acumen: Understand market opportunities, competitive threats, and strengths and weaknesses of the organization to manage priorities and develop the optimal response.

• Self-motivation: Be focused and able to achieve results without constant supervision. Complete tasks in a thorough and efficient way, making effective use of the available time.

Industry Experience:

• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field such as Medical Technology, Biomedical Engineering, Clinical Laboratory Science, or Information Technology is required.

• Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience within the in-vitro diagnostics (IVD) industry, with a strong background in technical support, field service engineering, or as an application specialist.

• A minimum of 2 years in a leadership, supervisory, or senior sp

jobs.title: Site Hospitality Specialist (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
Als Site Hospitality Specialist (m/w/d) stellst Du die operative Exzellenz und die Qualität der erbrachten Leistungen im Tagesgeschäft sicher. Der Fokus liegt auf der detaillierten Steuerung der Leistungsverzeichnisse und der Vor-Ort-Kontrolle. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Site Hospitality Manager zusammen und leitest Anpassungen der Leistungsverzeichnisse ein. Darüber hinaus übernimmst Du folgende Aufgaben:

• LV-Management & Optimierung: Eigenverantwortliche Prüfung, Anpassung und kontinuierliche Optimierung der Leistungsverzeichnisse (LV) zur Sicherstellung einer bedarfsgerechten Service-Erbringung.

• Operative Qualitätssicherung: Durchführung von regelmäßigen Audits, Begehungen ("Floor-Walking") und Service-Checks direkt mit den Service-Leitern und Teams des Providers.

• User Experience (UX) Konzepte: Entwicklung und Implementierung innovativer Konzepte für Soft Services (Reinigung, Grün- & Graupflege, Winterdienst, Abfallmanagement und Hauswartung, etc.), um die Standortattraktivität zu steigern.

• Mängel- & Reklamationsmanagement: Identifikation von Leistungsabweichungen sowie Überwachung der zeitnahen Mängelbeseitigung und Einleitung von Korrekturmaßnahmen.

• Daten- & Prozesskontrolle: Überprüfung der Dokumentation in CAFM-Systemen und Sicherstellung der operativen Einhaltung von SHE- und Qualitätsstandards.

• Service & Fremdfirmen Management: Fachliche Steuerung und Überwachung der IGM-Dienstleister für die Reinigung, die Schädlingsbekämpfung, die Grün- und Graupflege (inkl. Innenbegrünung), den Winterdienst, das Abfallmanagement und die Hauswartung (inkl. Logistik). Abnahme von Leistungen und Qualitätskontrolle. Sicherstellung der Durchführung gesetzlich vorgeschriebener Prüfungen.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium mit Schwerpunkt Facility Management, Hotellerie, Gastronomie oder anders erworbene Qualifikation .

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in der operativen Umsetzung von Soft Services und deren Leistungsbeschreibungen.

• Sicheres Auftreten vor Ort und ein scharfes Auge für Details und Mängel.

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf/Workday-Profil

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

Bewirb Dich jetzt – wir freuen uns!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Laboratory Manager Pathology CAP/CLIA (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.
Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

At Roche, we believe precision medicine radically improves lives. Our Global CAP/CLIA laboratories are the "heartbeat" of diagnostic innovation, bridging the gap between early research and life-saving commercial diagnostics. As a Laboratory Manager, you aren't just overseeing a facility; you are leading a team that transforms complex biological data into the insights clinicians need to treat patients with cancer and other life-altering diseases.

We are seeking a high-caliber Laboratory Manager (m/f/d) to oversee our dual-specialty pathology and immunoassay laboratory. This role requires a unique blend of technical expertise in tissue-based diagnostics and immunoassay automated testing.
You will be responsible for the operational excellence of the lab, ensuring that both the Histology/Pathology and Immunoassay/Chemistry departments function at peak efficiency while maintaining total compliance with ISO15189, CAP (College of American Pathologists) and CLIA regulations.

The Opportunity

You will oversee a dual-specialty laboratory at the forefront of the industry. Your leadership will span two critical domains:

• Anatomic Pathology: Managing high-complexity tissue-based diagnostics, including advanced Immunohistochemistry (IHC) and In Situ Hybridization (ISH)

• Immunoassay Excellence: Driving peaks of operational efficiency in our automated immunoassay tracks on state-of-the-art cobas® platforms

You will also be a key driver in our Digital Pathology transformation, integrating whole-slide imaging and AI-based image analysis into routine clinical workflows to set new standards for diagnostic precision. Your key responsibilities:

• Visionary Operational Leadership: Supervise the daily "rhythm" of the lab, synchronizing pathology and immunoassay workflows to ensure competitive turnaround times (TAT)

• Guardian of Quality: Maintain an "inspection-ready" culture, serving as the primary lead for CAP/CLIA and ISO 15189 audits

• Champion of People: Lead, mentor, and inspire team of Laboratory scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence

• Strategic Technical Oversight: Manage the validation and implementation of new assays and novel platforms, ensuring every piece of equipment is a high-performing component of our diagnostic system

• Innovate & Improve: Actively identify opportunities for workflow optimization and cost-effective management without ever compromising the quality that defines the Roche name

Who you are

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Clinical Laboratory Science, Medical Technology, or a related Biological Science. A Master’s (MHA/MBA) or PhD is highly preferred.

• Furthermore, you have 5+ years of experience in a clinical laboratory setting

• Proven expertise in both anatomic pathology and automated immunoassay workflows is a distinct advantage

• The ideal candidate isn't just a technical expert; You are a leader who fosters a culture of quality, safety, and continuous improvement with at least 2 years of experience in a leadership role

• You live the Roche mindset by maintaining a track record of zero-deficiency inspections and a passion for navigating the complexities of emerging global regulations

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Software Engineer: AI TechStack

In this role, you will be a key contributor to the Agent Development Portal (ADP), designing and implementing AI workflows, automation pipelines, and agent-based solutions that integrate enterprise data. You will work with modern AI frameworks such as LangChain, and workflow orchestration tools like n8n to enable teams to rapidly build AI-powered applications.

A critical component of your work will be creating reusable blueprints, templates, and reference architectures to accelerate development for other developers and data scientists. Additionally, you will build Proof-of-Value (PoV) solutions for high-impact business teams to demonstrate the platform’s potential and drive organizational adoption.

The Opportunity:

AI Workflow & Automation Development:

• Design and build AI-powered workflows and automation pipelines using agent frameworks like LangChain and orchestration tools like n8n.

• Develop solutions that enable AI agents to interact with enterprise systems, APIs, and data sources.

AI & Data Integration:

• Integrate AI workflows with enterprise data sources, Model Context Protocol (MCP) data connectors, and knowledge systems.

• Enable Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows and data-driven AI applications.

Reusable Blueprints & Archetypes:

• Create reusable blueprints, templates, and architectural patterns for common AI agent use cases.

• Develop reference implementations and archetypes that simplify the development of AI workflows for platform users.

Proof of Value (PoV) Development:

• Build PoV solutions for high-impact business teams to demonstrate the potential of AI agents and workflow automation.

• Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business use cases into AI-enabled solutions.

Platform Enablement:

• Provide technical guidance to developers and data scientists building on the platform.

• Contribute to documentation, best practices, and developer examples to support platform adoption.

Continuous Improvement:

• Evaluate emerging AI frameworks, workflow automation tools, and agent technologies.

• Identify opportunities to improve the developer experience and automation capabilities of the platform.

Who you are:

Education / Experience

• Proven experience successfully driving small to medium (S/M) initiatives (Project/Squad/Product).

• Demonstrated experience acting as a technical mentor and sharing knowledge through speeches and organized events.

Technical Skills:

Technical Core

• AI & Automation: Experience building AI-powered applications using LLMs and frameworks like LangChain.

• Workflow Platforms: Familiarity with automation tools such as n8n, Zapier, Make, or Flowise.

• Programming: Strong skills in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript.

• Development: Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, and microservices.

Data & Infrastructure

• Integration: Experience integrating systems with enterprise data sources and knowledge bases.

• AI Architecture: Familiarity with RAG architectures, embeddings, and vector databases.

• Cloud Platforms: Experience developing solutions on AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Nice to Have

• Experience with multi-agent workflows.

• Familiarity with semantic search and AI evaluation methods.

• Experience building developer platforms or internal tools.

Additional Qualifications

• Cross-functional Teams: Ability to work with AI engineers, product managers, and platform developers.

jobs.title: Indirect Procurement Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras.

Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos.

Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

Como Indirect Procurement Intern en Lima , te unirás a un equipo dinámico donde tu capacidad para interpretar datos impulsará decisiones estratégicas. En este rol, transformarás bases de datos en herramientas de gestión, apoyando la eficiencia de nuestra cadena de suministro en un entorno de aprendizaje continuo.

Oportunidad

• Gestionas y analizas bases de datos de Procurement para generar insights estratégicos.

• Elaboras dashboards y reportes periódicos utilizando Google Suite y Looker Studio.

• Soportas la selección y evaluación de proveedores mediante el análisis de indicadores.

• Realizas el seguimiento detallado de órdenes de compra y desempeño de proveedores.

• Brindas soporte a usuarios internos en procesos de compras y el uso de herramientas globales.

• Apoyas en la automatización de procesos y proyectos de mejora continua del área.

• Colaboras en proyectos regionales con un enfoque de análisis de datos y eficiencia.

Quien eres

• Eres estudiante universitario (7mo ciclo en adelante) de Ingeniería, Administración, Finanzas o afines.

• Manejas herramientas de análisis y visualización de datos como Google Suite y Looker Studio.

• Posees conocimientos en lenguajes de programación orientados a datos como Python o C++.

• Demuestras un nivel intermedio de inglés para interactuar en un entorno global.

• Destacas por tu capacidad analítica, proactividad y orientación al detalle.

• Conocimientos previos o manejo del sistema SAP es deseable pero no obligatorio.

Beneficios de reubicación no disponibles.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a member of Global Customer Support, you will support on-market products, perform advanced second-level troubleshooting, and provide guidance to junior members of the team on troubleshooting techniques and second-level inquiries. You work consistently with cross-functional teams. You lead team members and participate in and/or leads design reviews, and provide direction to junior members of the team on all elements of the project Charter in establishing service requirements on development projects. You create and updates documentation and curriculum, and conduct training for internal personnel. You serves as a technical expert on product(s) and you work on complex projects requiring broad knowledge of products and systems.

The Opportunity:

• Provides on-market support by independently addressing complex Level 2 submissions, applying advanced knowledge of hardware repair and networking principles.

• Updates service manuals, obsoletes outdated documentation, and ensures all published materials are current and accurate.

• Leads design review teams, providing service perspectives and approving design change content while creating necessary deliverables.

• Develops and revises training curricula, delivers training to various groups, and conducts audits to ensure training quality. Responsible for certifying trainers.

• Creates service requirements for development projects, advocates for functional goals, and collaborates with teams to solve complex problems.

• Produces service documentation for internal and external training before Launch Decision and for existing products as needed.

• Utilizes project management fundamentals to ensure timely and quality completion of projects, while representing GCS in relevant meetings and fulfilling additional duties as assigned.

Who you are

• Bachelor’s degree in Medical Technology, Microbiology, Information Technology or related discipline or equivalent work experience. 4 years of progressive experience, with 3 years of specific experience with industry or diagnostics

• 5 years of relevant technical support experience in customer-facing roles, including troubleshooting, training, and working with electromechanical devices.

• Practical experience with Linux commands and navigating log files using the command line interface (CLI).

• Ability to read and understand electrical, mechanical, and assembly drawings, schematics, and service manuals, as well as technical notifications and communications.

• Proficient in using test equipment such as digital multimeters and calibrated gauges, along with hand tools like screwdrivers and wrenches.

• Experience with sequencing instruments and NGS technologies, demonstrating knowledge of sample preparation workflows and Molecular Biology/Biochemistry concepts.

• Possesses good communication, organizational, logical thinking, and presentation skills. Communicates complex and unfamiliar ideas and solutions easily to users with little or no technical knowledge.

• Strong communication, organizational, and logical thinking skills, with the ability to work independently and interact effectively with cross-functional teams while embodying Roche’s cultural beliefs

Travel and Location Requirements: Rotkreuz, CH, Travel time: 30% international.

We are looking forward to receiving your application.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary:
Lead the development and implementation of business plans and marketing activities focused on disease areas. Drive diagnostic solutions through deep cross-functional collaboration, particularly with Pharma partners, to achieve business targets.

The Opportunity:
1. Establish and implement strategic marketing plans to achieve corporate objectives.

• Formulate and implement comprehensive market promotion plans aligned with the overall disease management diagnostic solutions strategy.

• Collaborate closely with Medical Science Affairs (MSA), Corporate Affairs, Communications and Sales teams to plan and execute integrated market events and promotional activities.

• Research, analyze, and monitor financial, technological, and demographic factors to capitalize on market opportunities and minimize effects of competitive activities

• Oversee and evaluate market research and adjust marketing strategy to meet changing market and competitive conditions

• Ensure effective control of marketing results, and take corrective action to guarantee that achievement of marketing objectives falls within designated budgets

• Establish and maintain relationships with industry influences, key communities and strategic partners

• Develop and manage Key Opinion Leader for products for effective promotion of product lines

• Regular key customers visit to understand their requirements and initiate project to maintain customer relationship and use as a marketing promotion material

• Guide preparation of marketing activity reports and presents to executive management

• Achieve satisfactory market share in relation to preset standards and industry and economic trends

• Recommend optimal pricing

2. Build KOL network in terms of product advisory board and speakers.
3. Build, coach, and lead a high-performing assay team. Develop the team's strategic capabilities to provide cross-disease/department strategic solutions.
4. Assist in yearly budgeting and control department expense within budget.
5. Develop career and development plan for the subordinates.

Who you are:
1. Bachelor of Biology related discipline, Masters preferred.
2. Proficiency in both spoken and written English
3. Good command of MS office software application
4. Product & marketing expertise
5. 10 years working experience in a similar capacity and in a similar industry

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. jobs.title: Study Start Up Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• At Roche/Genentech Pharma Product Development Global Clinical Operations (PDG), we are
• determined to transform drug development and realize our Pharma Ambition to deliver 20
• transformative medicines addressing diseases with the highest societal burden by 2029.
• As a key member of our Country Study Start-Up team, you will drive and facilitate the efficient
• initiation of clinical trials, ultimately helping to deliver innovative treatments to patients. You will
• work in a highly collaborative and cross-functional environment, where you have the opportunity
• to influence and shape our clinical trial delivery strategy. This is a unique opportunity to use your
• expertise to make a meaningful impact by ensuring seamless trial execution for patients,
• investigators, and clinical site staff.

The Role
• ● Lead Country Strategy: You will lead the country strategy for study start-up, driving
• efficiency, innovation, and collaboration with external stakeholders.
• ● Oversee Operations: You will oversee start-up operations to ensure timely and efficient
• site activation and regulatory compliance.
• ● Drive Process Improvements: You will identify and lead opportunities for process
• automation, standardization, and innovation at both the country and site levels.

titleByLocale.en: ERP Business Analyst - Finance Consolidation with OneStream
titleByLocale.it: ERP Business Analista - Finanza Consolidation with OneStream
titleByLocale.de: ERP Business Analyst - Finanzen Consolidation with OneStream
titleByLocale.fr: ERP Business Analyste - Finance Consolidation with OneStream

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Business Analyst Financial Consolidation serves as a crucial bridge between financial reporting requirements and IT solutions. He possesses in-depth knowledge of the business domain, relevant technologies, and organizational strategy to provide holistic, enterprise-wide consulting advice. In this role, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, testing, and optimizing the financial consolidation software solutions, ensuring that complex group consolidation processes are efficient, accurate, and compliant. You maintain system integrity, and support the closing process. While maintaining and supporting our current financial consolidation solution is essential, you also largely contribute to consolidation system transformation initiatives.

Description of the area
The ERP Financial Consolidation team supports the financial consolidation process by managing, configuring, and maintaining the software solutions. The team is embarking on a strategic project to replace our legacy Financial Consolidation system (i.e. SAP FC) with the OneStream . This transformation is driven by the upcoming end-of-life for SAP FC and a commitment to leveraging advanced automation and intelligence to enhance financial consolidation, reporting, and analysis across our global operations.

Job Responsibilities:

• Scope: Supports and maintains the Financial Consolidation solutions end-to-end. Oversees initiatives with autonomy, coordinating complexity and scale..

• Accountability: Configures the software for, or adapts it to, new accounting requirements, changes in business structure, and new reporting standards (IFRS), in collaboration with Group Consolidation function. Ensures the closing process runs smoothly while actively participating in a helpdesk team providing support to application users. Ensures seamless data flow into and out of the financial consolidation system.

• Collaboration: Collaborates closely with the corresponding business counterparts such as: Group Consolidation, Group Tax and Insurance, Group Accounting and Controlling.

• Impact/Strategy: Drives significant impact on projects by ensuring the delivery of high-value solutions that align with business strategy. Leads the evaluation of strategic solution options, including advanced value analysis and risk assessment, and actively shapes long-term roadmaps.

• Business / Technical ability: Uses in-depth knowledge of the business or technical domain and relevant technologies to inform business strategies.

​
Qualifications

Education / Experience

• 7+ years of hands-on mastery administering, developing and managing financial consolidation systems or implementing EPM projects ( particularly OneStream ) and with a track record of driving improvements and leveraging technology to enhance reporting quality and efficiency.

• In-depth understanding of Financial Consolidation topics, month-end close processes and ability to hold discussions with business counterparts.

• Extensive experience overseeing initiatives with autonomy, coordinating complexity and scale, and driving alignment across highly ambiguous spaces.

• Demonstrated advanced knowledge of Business Analysis Advisory/Consultancy concepts and practices.

• Business-focused, results-oriented approach with excellent coordination, exceptional problem-solving, and analytical skills, with a mindset to challenge assumptions, resolve discrepancies and ensure integrity of consolidated results.

• Proactive mindset, accountable, and capable of taking ow

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity:

This role is within the Indirect Procurement Delivery group, which manages core procurement activities from category management and sourcing to contracting and content strategy. The group includes communities like Research & Development, Commercial and Corporate Services, Digital & Technology, and Facilities, ensuring category expertise and flexibility in procurement delivery.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

As a Procurement Manager in Corporate Services, you will apply analytical thinking and specialized knowledge to strategic sourcing and delivery. You will be a vital driver in managing the supplier ecosystem, demonstrating the ability to deconstruct complex cost models and challenge commercial structures to drive value beyond simple price savings. You will collaborate and influence business stakeholders, translating their needs into effective sourcing activities and improving the buying experience. Your work will ensure efficient service delivery and translate sourcing outcomes into automated buying channels and content to improve business adoption and overall efficiency.

As a Procurement Manager in Corporate Services, you will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and general business requirements, including but not limited to:

• You are a Category and sourcing subject matter specialist in Congress Meeting and Events, and other Corporate Services categories conducting market and internal analysis to develop strategies and tactical plans for how Roche should source and negotiate for third party goods and services in order to satisfy stakeholder requirements.

• You are a Procurement delivery practitioner delivering and executing sourcing strategies by leveraging spend, category know-how, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, supplier management methodologies and frameworks and project management skills.

• You develop content and automation, translating sourcing outcomes and opportunities into content and automated buying channels that improve business adoption, satisfaction, and overall efficiency.

Who you are:

• You hold a university degree, preferably in business or a related discipline.

• You have 5+ years procurement experience in strategic sourcing, category strategy building and strategic project execution with general contracting understanding and proficiency or relevant commodity experience.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Description of the area
The Network & Perimeter Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate network-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee egress/ingress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are primarily instantiated through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. We work closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s network security posture.
You’ll be working within the Network Security Product area. This area is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of solutions—designing, building, and maintaining the technologies that protect Roche networks and the Internet, whether on-prem or cloud-based. This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection , Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN) , Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape.

Job description
As a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Edge Defense), you will play a pivotal role in the end-to-end lifecycle of our perimeter and cloud security products. Your primary focus will be the global engineering, adoption, and optimization of our Edge security stack, including Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), DDoS mitigation, and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA). You are a technical "implementer" responsible for designing robust, high-availability architectures that protect our global network from external threats while enabling secure, seamless access to multi-cloud environments. By leveraging an "Automation-First" mindset, you will transform traditional perimeter controls into scalable, code-driven security services, ensuring Roche’s digital boundaries remain resilient in an evolving threat landscape.

Job responsibilities

1. Edge Architecture & Engineering

• Perimeter Defense Mastery: Lead the end-to-end deployment, configuration, and maintenance of Next-Generation Firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet), ensuring high availability (Active/Active & Active/Passive) and optimal inspection performance across global entry points.

• Zero Trust Transition: Architect and implement ZTNA solutions to move beyond legacy VPNs, focusing on granular, application-level access and identity-aware security policies.

• Multi-Cloud Network Security: Engineer and manage cloud-native security controls within AWS, Azure, and GCP, ensuring consistent security posture across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

• DDoS & Threat Mitigation: Design and refine DDoS protection strategies and automated threat prevention policies (SSL decryption, IPS/IDS) to shield critical infrastructure from sophisticated external attacks.

​
2. Product Lifecycle & Evolution

• Lifecycle Governance: Oversee the delivery of Edge solutions from initial design through build, global rollout, and continuous optimization, ensuring that all security controls are reliable, scalable, and documented.

• Edge Innovation: Proactively identify emerging trends in Edge computing and SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) to inform the product roadmap and maintain a competitive advantage in network defense.

​
3. Operational Excellence & Visibility

• Technical Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the lead engineer for complex network security escalations, performing deep-packet analysis and root-cause investigations to implement long-

• An MD with relevant clinical research or medical practice experience (patient care decision-making), or an advanced life-science degree (e.g., PhD / PharmD) with a compatible background.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Network & Perimeter Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate network-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee egress/ingress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are primarily instantiated through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. We work closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s network security posture.
You’ll be working within the Network Security Product area. This area is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of solutions—designing, building, and maintaining the technologies that protect Roche networks and the Internet, whether on-prem or cloud-based. This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection , Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN) , Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape.

Job description
As a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer for Internal Network Defense, you will be the primary guardian of our internal environment, protecting our most sensitive segments—from manufacturing plants and research labs to warehouses and corporate offices. Your mission is to architect and enforce robust "East-West" segmentation, preventing lateral movement and securing the diverse environments that drive our core business. This is a technical "implementer" role where you will architect, design, build, and operate high-performance security boundaries using a dual-vendor strategy (Palo Alto and Fortinet). Beyond traditional enforcement, you will champion the adoption of AI-driven insights to identify latent risks and define the safe boundaries for automated security workflows, ensuring our internal network is resilient, compliant, and prepared for machine-speed threats.

Job responsibilities

Architecture, Design & AI Ambition

• Segmentation Strategy: Design, develop and document robust network segmentation architectures leveraging Fortinet and Palo Alto firewalls to meet complex business and security requirements.

• AI-Driven Risk Discovery: Actively explore and integrate AI opportunities to analyze internal traffic patterns and identify emerging security risks within complex Manufacturing and Lab environments.

• Automated Guardrails: Define and establish clear boundaries and governance for automated workflows, ensuring that machine-driven policy changes remain within safe, predictable parameters.

• Solution Blueprints: Create detailed network diagrams, technical design documents, and implementation plans for new segmentation environments (Labs, Manufacturing, Research).

​
Implementation & Deployment

• Firewall Engineering: Configure, deploy, and manage Palo Alto Networks (PA-Series, VM-Series) and Fortinet FortiGate firewalls at scale.

• Centralized Management: Utilize Panorama and FortiManager to enforce consistent security policies, NAT rules, VPNs (IPSec/SSL), and advanced routing features.

• Infrastructure Evolution: Lead the migration and upgrade of existing internal firewall infrastructure, ensuring zero-downtime transitions in critical environments.

​
3. Operational Excellence & Visibility

• Technical Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the lead engineer for complex network security escalations, performing deep -packet analysis and root-cause investigations to implement long-ter

This is a hands-on technical leadership role that requires a solid foundation in Network Security engineering. You will architect, design, build, and operate the monitoring frameworks that ensure our security platforms (Firewalls, NAC, ZTNA) are running at peak operational efficiency. While your focus is on Infrastructure Reliability, success in this role depends on your deep technical understanding of how security controls—such as packet inspection, encryption, and access policies—impact system performance. By bridging the gap between security hardware/software (Palo Alto, Fortinet, ISE) and modern observability toolchains (LogicMonitor, Python, IaC), you will ensure that the organization’s security "engine" is always visible, resilient, and perfectly tuned.

Job Responsibilities

1. Infrastructure Architecture, Design & Build

• Security-Aware Monitoring Architecture: Architect and design a global visibility framework for understanding the key performance, health, and throughput indicators of core security appliances across services such as Edge Firewalls, Network Access Control (NAC), DDoS Mitigation, Network Authentication, Internal Network Segmentation, and VPNs.

• Observability Engineering: Build and deploy the observability toolchain specifically optimized to monitor the hardware and virtualized instances of Palo Alto, Fortinet, and Cisco ISE.

• LogicMonitor Development: Hands-on creation and tuning of DataSources and ConfigSources to capture hardware-level security telemetry (CPU/Data Plane utilization, Session counts, Tunnel health, and HA synchronization).

• Service Health Dashboarding: Design and build real-time operational dashboards that provide a clear view of the health, performance, and compliance status of the global security infrastructure.

​
2. Infrastructure Operations & Evolution

• Global Service Operations: Operate the global monitoring environment, ensuring the continuous health of the observability stack across diverse network segments and security zones.

• Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Leverage APIs and automation (Python/GitLab) to automate the provisioning of monitoring for new security devices, ensuring a "security-first" approach to visibility.

•

jobs.title: Regulatory Policy & Intelligence (APAC) Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Job Title: Regulatory Policy & Intelligence Intern - Asia Pacific

Location: Singapore Kallang Avenue

About Us :

Roche is a global pioneer in pharmaceuticals and diagnostics focused on advancing science to improve people’s lives. The combined strengths of pharmaceuticals and diagnostics under one roof have made Roche the leader in personalised healthcare – a strategy that aims to fit the right treatment to each patient in the best way possible.

Roche is the world’s largest biotech company, with truly differentiated medicines in oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, ophthalmology and diseases of the central nervous system. Roche is also the world leader in in vitro diagnostics and tissue-based cancer diagnostics, and a frontrunner in diabetes management.

Founded in 1896, Roche continues to search for better ways to prevent, diagnose and treat diseases and make a sustainable contribution to society. The company also aims to improve patient access to medical innovations by working with all relevant stakeholders. Thirty medicines developed by Roche are included in the World Health Organization Model Lists of Essential Medicines, among them life-saving antibiotics, antimalarials and cancer medicines. Roche has been recognised as the Group Leader in sustainability within the Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology & Life Sciences Industry ten years in a row by the Dow Jones Sustainability Indices (DJSI).

At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity.

Position Summary :

As a Regulatory Policy & Intelligence Intern in APAC region, you will support the team in monitoring and analyzing regulatory developments, assessing the impact on our business operations, and contributing to strategic projects. This role offers the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a complex and evolving regulatory environment in the healthcare sector.

Key Responsibilities:

• Assist in the tracking, analysis, and impact assessment of regulatory policy changes and trends across the Asia Pacific region.

• Participate in the development of advocacy positions and contribute to policy papers, comments, and other documents by collaborating with global experts and country teams.

• Contribute to regulatory policy initiatives on prioritized topics, including key projects, events, and capability building programs.

• Support strategic communication with key stakeholders both internally and externally to enable knowledge sharing and promote the value of proactive policy shaping, including managing various internal communication platforms/tools.

• Engage in special projects and initiatives as assigned.

Qualifications:

• Current enrollment in a bachelor’s or master’s program in Public Policy, Law, Political Science, International Relations, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field.

• Interest in regulatory affairs, policy, healthcare, and government relations.

• Strong research, analytical, and critical thinking skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Self-driven, disciplined, curious, and creative mindset.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a multicultural team. environment with a strong sense of responsibility.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) or Google Suite.

• Language proficiency in English is require

The Position
Summary
The Customer Planning and Reporting Specialist supports the Roche Diagnostics service field team with various activities including creating and monitoring of cases and reports, producing the Service dashboard containing main department KPI’s, and ensuring interface between call center, customers and Service field team. You prepare Service offers and maintenance plans, perform reconciliation between CRM and billing systems, and support Customer Experience initiatives on deployment and monitoring the customer surveys.

Good command of the German language , both spoken and in writing is a must as this team supports the Roche Diagnostics Service team of Germany.

The work time is from 7:50 AM to 6 PM (German time, equivalent to 8:50 Am to 7 PM Romanian time) and is organised in shifts. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
GPC Training and Service Quality Lead
Department: Global Patient Care (GPC)
Area: Global Customer Support (GCS)
Reports to: GPC Support Lead
Location: Sant Cugat, Spain

About the Role
The Training and Service Quality Lead for Global Patient Care (GPC) plays a pivotal role in shaping service excellence across Roche Diagnostics' customer support network. Leading a dedicated team of Training and Service Quality Specialists, this role ensures the development and implementation of robust training programs and quality assurance frameworks that enable consistent, high-quality, patient-centered care.

Collaborating closely with GPC leadership, you will drive strategies that enhance skill development, align with global service standards, and foster a culture of continuous improvement while ensuring compliance with regulatory and quality standards. Through effective leadership and data-driven insights, you will strengthen the quality and efficiency of interactions with patients and customers, advancing Roche's mission to deliver transformative healthcare solutions.

Your Responsibilities
Strategic Program Development:

• Identify training and service quality improvement opportunities by collaborating with regional Customer Support hubs, Business Implementation Specialists, and other GPC functions to ensure services evolve with business needs

• Design, enhance, or discontinue training and quality programs to uphold service excellence while ensuring compliance with auditable training standards

• Lead projects related to improvements and changes within Global Patient Care to meet evolving business needs

Customer Experience & Operational Excellence:

• Establish and continuously improve a global training and service quality framework to deliver consistent, high-standard customer and patient experiences

• Define and implement operational standards to ensure excellence in Training and Service Quality across all regions

• Implement a robust quality monitoring framework for external Customer Support operations

• Utilize customer satisfaction metrics, feedback, and operational data to identify trends and improvement areas

Training Program Design and Delivery:

• Lead the development and execution of training programs tailored to enhance competencies of frontline teams and specialists

• Ensure training initiatives align with global service delivery objectives and support achievement of organizational KPIs

• Work with external partners to define and implement global training standards

Quality Assurance & Compliance:

• Implement a robust quality assurance framework to monitor and improve interactions with patients and customers

• Ensure compliance with global standards for CRM systems, contact center operations, and regulatory requirements

• Report directly to GPC Leadership to guarantee consistent, high-standard experiences while supporting delivery of Roche's innovative products and digital solutions

KPI Management & Analysis:

• Track, analyze, and report key performance indicators related to training effectiveness and service quality

• Provide actionable insights to leadership teams and regional operations to drive continuous improvement

Team Leadership & Development:

• Foster a culture of excellence, inclusivity, and collaboration while driving team and individual performance

• Lead by example as a VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) leader; set clear goals, provide continuous guidance, motivation, coaching, and feedback

• Cultivate an inspiring, in

jobs.title: Compliance Assurance Lead West
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Mission
As a Global Patient Care Compliance Assurance Lead (East/West), you will play a key role in ensuring the GPC - Global Patient Care Organization has the highest quality standards and remains compliant at all times.

You will lead and manage a team of PRI & Case Monitoring Specialists. You will ensure Roche and partners' products and solutions meet global regulations, corporate standards, and expectations by overseeing the monitoring, reviewing, and timely reporting on the quality of interactions. You will help maintain an effective quality management system and governance, globally, and continually improve the governance to meet evolving business and compliance needs.
Together with your team, you will implement a common quality framework across the GPC Hubs. You will analyze results regularly, conceive corrective and preventive measures in case of findings, and collaborate in the design of training concepts to overcome identified knowledge gaps.

You will ensure the GPC Organization complies with regulatory requirements and corporate standards. You will communicate significant quality, or regulatory issues and risks that may impact operations or regulatory compliance to local, regional or global management. In addition, you will be supporting the preparation, coordination, and conduct of audits, ensuring the GPC Organization operates in an “inspection ready” manner and that audit measures are strictly implemented.

Key Accountabilities

• Effectively lead and develop a team of GPC PRI & Case Monitoring Specialists.

• Design, implement, and continuously improve the Global Compliance Governance Model and related monitoring standards.

• Support the end-to-end audit process, including preparation work, managing the audit schedule, and ensuring the timely implementation of audit-related measures.

• Act as a contact person and expert with the different interfaces for all quality and compliance topics, proactively and in an advisory manner.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

• A fluent command of English is a must; any other language is a plus.

• Proven leadership experience, preferably in an international setting in a medical regulated environment.

• Knowledge of Roche products, solutions, and systems is recommended.

• Minimum 2 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Compliance, or as an Auditor, preferably in a medical regulated environment.

• Profound knowledge of audit-re

jobs.title: GPC Service Performance Lead

titleByLocale.it: Lead delle prestazioni del servizio GPC

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Mission
As the GPC Service Performance Lead, you will contribute that Global Patient Care (GPC) business objectives are achieved efficiently by leading a high-performing team of GPC Service Performance Specialists and managing the performance of GPC’s workforce. In this critical management role, you will design and implement staffing and performance models to meet operational demands while aligning performance management with strategic business objectives across an omnichannel environment.

This role involves overseeing detailed volume forecasting, performance planning, and monitoring trends to maximize efficiency and effectiveness across GPC’s global operations.

You will lead a team responsible for designing and monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs) across all supported channels, validating performance data, and identifying early patterns. You will ensure the GPC Leadership Team is proactively informed when course correction is required, managing the balance between accurately forecast volumes and the desired service levels to ensure a consistent customer experience.

Key Accountabilities

• Develop and implement service performance strategies to meet global operational and efficiency goals.

• Lead and develop a high-performing team of GPC Service Performance Specialists, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability.

• Oversee strategic forecasting processes, ensuring accurate volume and capacity planning across all channels.

• Design, maintain, and validate global KPI frameworks to drive improvement and ensure data-driven decision-making.

• Analyze service performance data to identify trends, proactively providing the GPC Leadership Team with insights for operational course correction.

• Partner with internal and external stakeholders to provide channel forecasts and validate partner outcomes align with Roche performance standards (KPIs).

• Strategic Reporting Liaison: Liaise with global reporting teams to drive close collaboration, ensuring that validated, high-quality data is consistently available for GPC Leaders.

• Data Integrity & Governance: Lead the review and validation of reporting outputs to guarantee the highest level of accuracy and integrity across all operational performance metrics.

• Monitor productivity metrics and global performance to identify and implement opportunities for continuous improvement and process optimization.

• Proactive participation in or management of projects to develop infrastructure and administration processes within the performance area.

• Cultivate an inspiring and inclusive team environment that promotes diversity, cross-functional collaboration, and overcomes the challenges of a multi-location setup.

• Drive the talent acquisition and hiring process, focusing on selecting and retaining top talent while maintaining a positive work environment.

• Provide proactive feedback and coaching to team members, managing performance evaluations, compensation reviews, and succession planning.

• Ensure team adherence to all P&C and compliance policies, fostering a culture of integrity and accountability.

Key skills and Experience

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

• Proven leadership experience, preferably in an international setting and a multi-channel contact center.

• 3-5 years specialization and in-depth knowledge of Service Performance, Forecasting, and Operational Analytics.

• Methodological competence and strong analytical skills with an affinity for complex data an

jobs.title: Deja tu Huella - Communications Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deja tu Huella - Communications & Intern

What do we offer?
To be part of a new cohort of the Roche-CEU San Pablo postgraduate degree as an expert in the Pharmaceutical Industry. 11 months of internships at Roche where you will participate in challenging projects and benefit from pioneering postgraduate training in the market about the pharmaceutical industry.

You will have the opportunity to get on the job training by working on key projects with your designated department from Monday to Thursday and attend in person postgraduate classes at the university on Friday.

Our main location is Madrid , we are open to applications from all over Spain but relocation will be needed as part of the program expectations. Office attendance is expected (with some flexbility) to enjoy the connection to our colleagues, network and get exposure.

Last but not least, you will have mentorship by a Roche tutor who will give you continuous feedback to develop your professional skills. The mentors for the program are Roche's senior and experienced young talent development professionals.

Apply for this offer and follow us at @RocheES to share with your network a unique opportunity in the market to start your professional career in the pharmaceutical sector.

What is the main purpose of this internship?
Ideation, development, and implementation of the positioning plan and corporate narrative of Roche Farma España, both nationally and across ecosystems, as well as planning and development of Corporate Social Responsibility actions in collaboration with Internal Communication.

What are the main responsibilities of the intern?

• Assist in the design and execution of communication plans for specific therapeutic areas (e.g., Neuroscience, Ophthalmology).

• Draft, edit, and adapt high-quality content (press releases, internal news, talking points) related to clinical milestones and product launches.

• Create engaging assets for social media and digital platforms, ensuring that scientific data is communicated clearly and creatively.

• Support the management of press conferences, scientific forums, and patient advocacy initiatives.

• Analyze the impact of our therapeutic area communications and stay ahead of healthcare trends in the Spanish market.

What are we looking for in this position?

• Graduate or currently finishing a degree in one of the branches of Information Sciences (communications, journalism, etc).

• Training and/or experience in health communication is desirable

• High capacity for communication and public relations

• Skill and speed in creating and composing texts, ability to obtain and edit videos and images, and deep knowledge of the main social networks.

• We want proactive and curious candidates that are willing to learn and grow by challenging the status quo.

• We are looking for flexible talents that adapt to changes and are willing to collaborate with teams in a network organization.

• Advanced level of communication in English and Spanish.

• Desirable to have international experience as a student or working abroad.

• Passion for improving the lives of patients and motivation to give the best of yourself in an innovative and challenging environment.

• Commitment to dedicate yourself full time to the program from September 2026 to August 2027.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deja tu Huella - Communications & Intern

What do we offer?
To be part of a new cohort of the Roche-CEU San Pablo postgraduate degree as an expert in the Pharmaceutical Industry. 11 months of internships at Roche where you will participate in challenging projects and benefit from pioneering postgraduate training in the market about the pharmaceutical industry.

You will have the opportunity to get on the job training by working on key projects with your designated department from Monday to Thursday and attend in person postgraduate classes at the university on Friday.

Our main location is Madrid , we are open to applications from all over Spain but relocation will be needed as part of the program expectations. Office attendance is expected (with some flexbility) to enjoy the connection to our colleagues, network and get exposure.

Last but not least, you will have mentorship by a Roche tutor who will give you continuous feedback to develop your professional skills. The mentors for the program are Roche's senior and experienced young talent development professionals.

Apply for this offer and follow us at @RocheES to share with your network a unique opportunity in the market to start your professional career in the pharmaceutical sector.

What is the main purpose of this internship?
Ideation, development, and implementation of the positioning plan and corporate narrative of Roche Farma España, both nationally and across ecosystems, as well as planning and development of Corporate Social Responsibility actions in collaboration with Internal Communication.

What are the main responsibilities of the intern?

• Assist in the design and execution of communication plans for specific therapeutic areas (e.g., Neuroscience, Ophthalmology).

• Draft, edit, and adapt high-quality content (press releases, internal news, talking points) related to clinical milestones and product launches.

• Create engaging assets for social media and digital platforms, ensuring that scientific data is communicated clearly and creatively.

• Support the management of press conferences, scientific forums, and patient advocacy initiatives.

• Analyze the impact of our therapeutic area communications and stay ahead of healthcare trends in the Spanish market.

What are we looking for in this position?

• Graduate or currently finishing a degree in one of the branches of Information Sciences (communications, journalism, etc).

• Training and/or experience in health communication is desirable

• High capacity for communication and public relations

• Skill and speed in creating and composing texts, ability to obtain and edit videos and images, and deep knowledge of the main social networks.

• We want proactive and curious candidates that are willing to learn and grow by challenging the status quo.

• We are looking for flexible talents that adapt to changes and are willing to collaborate with teams in a network organization.

• Advanced level of communication in English and Spanish.

• Desirable to have international experience as a student or working abroad.

• Passion for improving the lives of patients and motivation to give the best of yourself in an innovative and challenging environment.

• Commitment to dedicate yourself full time to the program from September 2026 to August 2027.

For international students, have a valid NIE or work permit in Spain.

And remember, being part of this program offers you:

• Postgraduate University CEU-Roche: "Deja tu Huella" program with great
