jobs.title: Pathologist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche is the world’s #1 provider of companion diagnostics and offers unrivaled experience in developing and commercializing predictive diagnostics that enable personalized treatment strategies for cancer patients. We offer unique opportunities for pathologists interested in playing a role in the development and implementation of new assays critical to our goal of providing more patient access to innovative new therapies. You have an opportunity to work with leading edge technologies, such as Immunohistochemistry, in situ hybridization, immunofluorescence, multiplex assays, digital pathology and more. This position is based onsite in Tucson, AZ

The Opportunity:

• You will provide crucial pathology and slide reading support for assay development, FDA submissions, clinical trials and collaborating with internal and external development teams.

• You will be at the forefront of research and development activities by supporting the development of primary antibodies, detection systems, probes and special stains.

• You will advise on future pathology and medical needs.

• You will be a medical representative on project core teams and contribute to pathology related aspects of specific development projects.

• You will drive continuous improvement in work processes, making a direct impact on the efficiency and effectiveness of our operations.

• You will utilize your expertise to advise on future pathology and medical needs, ensuring that we stay ahead of the curve in our industry

Who you are:

• You have an M.D. or D.O. with US Board Certification in Anatomic Pathology and an active state medical license.

• You are Residency-trained in anatomic pathology with expertise in surgical pathology and a proven ability to assess histopathology, IHC, ISH, and multiplex assays.

• You are experienced in evaluating complex immunohistochemistry assays such as PD-L1, HER2, and Ki-67.

• You are a precision medicine innovator and are Passionate about companion diagnostics (CDx) and the "right drug, right patient, right time" philosophy.

• You are a tech-Forward collaborator: Comfortable utilizing digital pathology scanners, automated algorithms, and advanced staining platforms (VENTANA Benchmark).

• You thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment, working seamlessly with scientists, engineers, and other experts to drive FDA submissions and clinical trial success.

​ Preferred Qualifications:

• Fellowship trained with 1 year of experience in clinical practice or industry.

• Prior experience in immunohistochemistry, cytology, molecular and/or genetics

​
The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Tucson, AZ is 174,000-323,100. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance.

This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

Relocation benefits are available for this posting

jobs.title: Line Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Line Manager at Regional Customer Support Center in Sant Cugat

About the Role

The Sant Cugat Regional Customer Support Center is seeking an experienced, collaborative leader with a strong customer focus to join our Regional Customer Support team.

As a Line Manager, you will lead and empower a team of highly skilled remote specialists providing support across Spain and Portugal customers and to the EMEA-LATAM region. Your mission is to move beyond case resolution to provide proactive support and data-driven insights to improve decision making to attract and retain our customers. You will be a catalyst for a culture of high performance and digital transformation.

In this role, you will be responsible for achieving outstanding team performance and maximizing customer satisfaction, driving remote resolution, overseeing employee and customer training and facilitating local and regional knowledge sharing and escalation support.
You will do this by analyzing results, challenging how support is currently provided, and rapidly incorporating innovations, new digital tools and AI-driven solutions to continuously improve our service. A core priority will be the development of your team members, mentoring them to excel in their current roles while preparing them for the future challenges.

With your experience in Diagnostics or Healthcare, you will put the customer -and ultimately the patient- at the heart of everything we do.

You'll report directly to the Head of the Sant Cugat Regional Customer Support Center and join a team passionate about creating an environment where empowered individuals can flourish and fulfil their potential.

What You'll Own:

Leadership & Talent Development
Coach and empower your team to achieve high performance. You'll manage the full talent lifecycle—from recruiting top talent to performance management and building the capabilities needed for a digital-first organization.

Operational Excellence & Innovation
Lead service delivery by ensuring all processes meet quality and excellence standards sustainably. Leverage AI to shift toward proactive, data-driven support that maximizes system performance and customer value.

Stakeholder Management & Resolution
Connect our remote support team with customers, field and regional/global teams. Serve as the primary escalation point for complex issues, driving them to resolution and delivering first-class service experiences.

Strategic Collaboration
Partner with Sales, Marketing and Service to ensure the technical service offering aligns with broader business goals.

Customer Focus
Maximize customer satisfaction by analyzing feedback and customer relationship management data and turning insights into meaningful actions. Implement innovative approaches to improve service outcomes.

Cross-Regional Leadership
Drive collaboration across Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Latin America by leading regional initiatives. As a change agent, you'll shape network structures and implement global strategies with a focus on local impact and service excellence.

Knowledge Management & Learning

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED) , we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

pRED Cardiovascular & Metabolism, Immunology (CMI), located in Basel, Switzerland, focuses on the discovery and early development of innovative treatments for specific diseases that affect the lives of millions. In the cardiovascular and metabolism area, we are developing cutting-edge therapies to treat metabolic diseases.

We are currently hiring four experienced PhD-level Discovery Scientists to join our Cardiovascular & Metabolic Disease Research team :
These opportunities include two in vivo-focused and two in vitro-focused positions , offering the chance to contribute to innovative preclinical research in metabolic diseases. We are looking for candidates with strong expertise in in vitro and/or in vivo pharmacology, a solid industry background, and a proven track record in executing preclinical projects in metabolic diseases and immunology.

The opportunity
In this role, you will design and execute experiments and lead projects to evaluate the efficacy and safety of novel therapeutic candidates.

• Lead research projects in the area of metabolic diseases (insulin resistance, obesity) from target ideation to entry into clinical development for both small- and large-molecule modalities.

• Drive the positioning and prioritization of novel metabolic and immunological targets, integrating disease biology, translational biomarkers, and therapeutic modality selection to align with Roche’s CVM pipeline.

• Collaboratively design, execute, and interpret complex preclinical in vitro and in vivo experimental studies for the validation and characterization of targets or therapeutic agents

• Direct, execute, and benchmark novel experiments, work together hand in hand with associates, and transfer standardized assays to associates

• Act as a resource in project teams, and demonstrate clear and professional verbal and written communication

Who You Are
You’re someone who wants to influence your own development. You are looking for a company where you receive the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies. Working in a multicultural environment motivates you. As a fast learner, you actively drive the quality of the requirements.

• You possess a PhD degree in Life Sciences ; are specialized in Metabolic diseases (insulin resistance, obesity, muscle-/adipose-physiology)

• You have >5 years of research and project leadership experience in the pharmaceutical industry.

• You have demonstrated ability to effectively present scientific data and concepts to colleagues, teams, and management is essential

• Skillfully able to interact effectively with people, both internally and externally

• Vigorous “can do” mentality to succeed in a dynamic and highly collaborative research team

• Depending on your background, this role is embedded in an in vivo–focused or in vitro-focused research team

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity !

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employee

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you a strategic safety and facilities leader ready to make an impact in a fast-paced biotech environment? We're seeking an experienced Director/Associate Director to join our SBX Technology team as the cornerstone of our site's operational resilience and compliance excellence. In this high-visibility role, you'll lead proactive risk management, oversee critical infrastructure, and drive continuous improvement across safety, facilities, and security—all while maintaining inspection readiness around the clock. If you have 8+ years in large-scale industrial environments, proven management expertise, and the drive to anticipate facility demands, we'd like to hear from you.

The Opportunity

• Manages the SHE, Security, and Facilities maintenance to comply with applicable regulatory and company policies, utilizing industry best practices, and identifying and managing risk.

• Works with building management to maintain critical power systems and emergency generators. Serves as the primary internal lead for building power restoration and temporary generators, ensuring building management and external vendors to maintain 100% operational readiness during extended building outage.

• Works cross-functionally to develop and support facilities projects and implementing new technology processes including remodels, new equipment, and reagents, etc . Manages all moves, construction, upgrades, and maintenance for the site.

• Leads hazard identification - determining and implementing necessary risk assessment programs/processes – as well as related facilities changes.

• Responds to and investigates all SHE, Security and Facility issues. Supports post-incident analysis to determine mitigation strategies to reduce future incident frequency and impact.

• Leads, manages, and continuously improves all relevant safety processes in a large generator environment, including hazardous waste management, dangerous goods shipments, chemical safety assessments, spill safety, exposure monitoring, biosafety programs, etc. Identifies and manages risk and ensures compliance.

• Ensures the site complies with applicable regulatory and company policies and is always “inspection ready”. May lead government and company interactions related to SHE, Security, and Facilities requirements including reporting, notification, facilitating inspections, and ensuring closure of corrective actions.

• Establishes monitoring solutions for critical facilities and lab equipment to enable after-hours monitoring and meaningful alerts.

• Prepares clear response plan documents for safety and facilities scenarios that can be executed by on-site personnel outside of standard business hours. Provides transparent documentation of site fail point areas.

Who you are
Education

• Bachelor or Master’s degree in chemistry, safety, industrial hygiene, or other relevant field.

Experience

• 8 years of progressive experience within a large scale industry such as technical manufacturing, diagnostics, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, oil and gas industry, or other relevant industries.

• 5+ years of management experience.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are working to make next-generation sequencing simple and accessible enough for routine use. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. Our Systems Technology Group, a part of Roche Sequencing Solutions, is focused on creating and advancing technologies to significantly enhance DNA sequencing workflows.

We are seeking a hands-on Chemistry & Fluidic Systems Integration Scientist/Engineer to serve as a Subject Matter Expert in chemistry and biology . Joining our current team of talented scientists and engineers, you will bridge the gap between complex molecular biology, physical chemistry and cutting-edge microfluidic instrumentation and consumables.

The ideal candidate will thrive at this intersection, actively porting and translating complex workflows onto novel systems during the earliest stages of research and development. You will be responsible for rigorously testing new concepts, developing and executing complex assays, troubleshooting integrated subsystems, and optimizing overall performance based on first principles.

Your Role and Responsibilities:

• You will tackle efforts to translate, test, and optimize complex, multi-step chemical and molecular biology workflows (e.g., purification, synthesis, library prep, target enrichment, amplification, and sequencing) on early-stage microfluidic systems. You will successfully navigate the transition of assays from solution-phase to solid-phase environments and quantify reactions on surfaces.

• You will perform the selection, formulation, and optimization of buffers, surfactants, coatings and critical additives. You will leverage your understanding of the distinct purpose of each reagent to maintain efficiency and optimize chemical and enzymatic reactions within microfluidic or closed-system environments.

• You will design and execute rigorous experiments using statistical methods to characterize system performance and troubleshoot issues. You will apply your functional grasp of chemistry to navigate challenges related to chemical compatibility, surface tension, surface passivation, ionic strength, shear forces, and the influence of pH on surface interactions.

• You will conduct early-stage, deep-dive troubleshooting for complex performance issues on novel systems. You will seamlessly connect systemic failures such as leaks, null results, or surface fouling back to first-principles root causes, whether molecular, chemical, material, or physical.

• You will serve as a subject matter expert in molecular biology, sample and library preparation, and sequencing chemistry. You will be a go-to person for explaining complex biological and chemical concepts to a team of talented engineers.

• You will analyze complex, multi-modal data sets and serve as a key technical partner to both assay development scientists and hardware design engineers. You will provide critical, data-driven feedback to guide the co-development of reagents, consumables, and instrument hardware, ensuring chemistry, molecular biology, and engineering are harmonized through iterative feedback cycles.

A cover letter is required for this application. Please outline your relevant experience and explain why you are interested in this role and our company.

This is an on-site position based in Santa Clara, CA.
Relocation benefits are not being offered for this role.

Who You Are (Required):

• You have a PhD in Chemist

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
For over 60 years, Roche has been guided by a profound vision: a future where cancer can be cured. 22.8 million people have been treated with Roche cancer therapy as of 2025. We have had nearly 30 New Molecular Entities (NMEs) approved in our oncology and haematology portfolio. We are committed to developing innovative medicines and diagnostic solutions that help prevent, stop and cure cancer.

Leading with bold moves, while grounded in science and experience, our focus is on turning scientific breakthroughs into better outcomes for people with cancer, healthcare systems and society. We are aiming to deliver seven new transformative cancer medicines by the end of the decade, for those that need them most. To help us achieve this vision we are looking for a dedicated Breast Cancer Specialist Representative to join our dynamic team. If you have a proven track record working in the pharmaceutical industry and a passion for the area of Breast Cancer then we want you to be a part of our success story.

As a Breast Cancer Patient Journey Partner (PJP) , you will play a pivotal role in promoting our exciting portfolio of Breast Cancer treatments to healthcare professionals. You will be responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with key Breast Cancer stakeholders, including oncologist and other respective healthcare professionals/practice staff, to create meaningful solutions that improve patient outcomes.

The territory will focus on key Breast Cancer accounts across NSW and the ACT.

What you will be working on:
You will independently manage territory metrics and targets, showing resilience and confidence when challenging Healthcare Professionals (HCPs). You will work with your team to advance customers through the adoption ladder, drive market growth to meet our patient-focused goals, and contribute to the development of pioneering therapies. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Drive adoption of our Breast Cancer products with healthcare providers across NSW and the ACT.

• Develop and execute territory plans to maximise opportunities to create value for our stakeholders and for Roche to and meet our goals

• Build strong, long-term relationships with oncologist and other healthcare professionals

• Review customer engagement metrics to optimise communication channels ensuring regular engagement with target customers through face to face meetings, virtual calls, dinner presentation meetings, clinic/practice luncheons and participation in industry events

• Provide expert knowledge on the clinical data and benefits of our treatment

• Collaborate internally with cross-functional teams (marketing, medical etc) to drive business growth and great customer experience

• Monitor and analyse territory performance, market trends and competitor activity to adjust strategies/tactics to improve outcomes

• Gather valuable insights from customers and effectively communicate them to the internal team to help validate and define our strategic initiatives.

• Adhere to company policies and industry regulations, maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and ethics.

Who you are:
You are someone who demonstrates a passion for patient outcomes, enterprise-level thinking, and an entrepreneurial mindset with an excellent understanding of the pharmaceutical industry. You have:

• 5+ years or equivalent level of experience as a specialist pharmaceutical representative or in similar capacity

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
For over 60 years, Roche has been guided by a profound vision: a future where cancer can be cured. 22.8 million people have been treated with Roche cancer therapy as of 2025. We have had nearly 30 New Molecular Entities (NMEs) approved in our oncology and haematology portfolio. We are committed to developing innovative medicines and diagnostic solutions that help prevent, stop and cure cancer.

Leading with bold moves, while grounded in science and experience, our focus is on turning scientific breakthroughs into better outcomes for people with cancer, healthcare systems and society. We are aiming to deliver seven new transformative cancer medicines by the end of the decade, for those that need them most. To help us achieve this vision we are looking for a dedicated Breast Cancer Specialist Representative to join our dynamic team. If you have a proven track record working in the pharmaceutical industry and a passion for the area of Breast Cancer then we want you to be a part of our success story.

As a Breast Cancer Patient Journey Partner (PJP) , you will play a pivotal role in promoting our exciting portfolio of Breast Cancer treatments to healthcare professionals. You will be responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with key Breast Cancer stakeholders, including oncologist and other respective healthcare professionals/practice staff, to create meaningful solutions that improve patient outcomes.

The territory will focus on key Breast Cancer accounts across NSW and the ACT.

What you will be working on:
You will independently manage territory metrics and targets, showing resilience and confidence when challenging Healthcare Professionals (HCPs). You will work with your team to advance customers through the adoption ladder, drive market growth to meet our patient-focused goals, and contribute to the development of pioneering therapies. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Drive adoption of our Breast Cancer products with healthcare providers across NSW and the ACT.

• Develop and execute territory plans to maximise opportunities to create value for our stakeholders and for Roche to and meet our goals

• Build strong, long-term relationships with oncologist and other healthcare professionals

• Review customer engagement metrics to optimise communication channels ensuring regular engagement with target customers through face to face meetings, virtual calls, dinner presentation meetings, clinic/practice luncheons and participation in industry events

• Provide expert knowledge on the clinical data and benefits of our treatment

• Collaborate internally with cross-functional teams (marketing, medical etc) to drive business growth and great customer experience

• Monitor and analyse territory performance, market trends and competitor activity to adjust strategies/tactics to improve outcomes

• Gather valuable insights from customers and effectively communicate them to the internal team to help validate and define our strategic initiatives.

• Adhere to company policies and industry regulations, maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and ethics.

Who you are:
You are someone who demonstrates a passion for patient outcomes, enterprise-level thinking, and an entrepreneurial mindset with an excellent understanding of the pharmaceutical industry. You have:

• 5+ years or equivalent level of experience as a specialist pharmaceutical representative or in similar capacity

• In-depth knowledge of the healthcare system

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 1. 职位职责：
• （ 1 ） 协助 在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （ 2 ） 协助 进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训
• （ 3 ） 协助 开展学术会议，向客户介绍产品在不同适应症上的优点
• （ 4 ） 协助 及时收集、提供市场信息并做出适当建议

2. 职位要求：
• （ 1 ）在校大学生
• （ 2 ）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （ 3 ）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （ 4 ）熟练运用 Excel 、 PPT 、 Word 等办公应用软件
• （ 5 ）拥有良好的英语书写能力
• tag#LI-DNI

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist - Submission Management
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Your Opportunity
Operational Excellence

• Ability to execute tasks like document formatting /quality checks /tracking/ publishing/ compiling with supervision while learning project planning and management basics.

• Demonstrates potential to build trustful relationships with colleagues and stakeholders to support submission processes through communication and basic coordination.

• Works effectively within a team by participating in collaborative efforts, contributing ideas, and asking for help as needed to achieve common goals.

• Strong commitment to learning and adapting with guidance, including acquiring familiarity with new systems, tools, and workflows to foster personal and professional growth.

Who You Are
eCTD Expertise

• Foundational understanding of eCTD submission format and regulatory requirements, with a focus on learning NMPA-specific guidelines and terminology in parallel to those of ICH, FDA, EMA, etc.

• Familiarity with documentation assembly and formatting, working under supervision to gain practical experience in eCTD compilation and validation.

• Essential knowledge to eCTD publishing processes, submission software, document management systems, and MS Office and Adobe Acrobat for document preparation; exposure to systems like RIM/Veeva Vault as part of training.

• A proactive, motivated learner eager to understand regulatory changes and contribute to process improvement under guidance.

jobs.title: Finance & Accounting Team Lead (Fixed Asset)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Record to Report Department , often abbreviated as R2R department provides financial services for more than 130 affiliates in the EMEA region . Our main areas covered are: General Ledger Accounting, Management Accounting, Treasury and Accounts Receivable. The department is constantly expanding since our main goal is to perform end-to-end accounting activities in the near future.

As a Finance & Accounting Team Lead, focusing on Fixed Asset accounting you will coordinate complete, stringent, and timely finance and accounting tasks within the department's scope while proactively seeking opportunities to allow more effective cooperation between teams regardless of country or functional assignments.

In this role, you will focus on:

• Leading people management activities, including recruitment, goal setting, and performance evaluations to support both operational excellence and professional growth.

• Ensuring service quality and compliance by overseeing daily Capital and Lease Accounting operations in accordance with SOPs, ICFRs, and agreed service levels.

• Proactively and constructively managing change initiatives , continuous improvement & automation projects and best practice implementations to support business and operational transformation across the EMEA region.

• Fostering strong relationships with stakeholders in the respective business area to ensure a free flow of communication and alignment on regional requirements.

• Providing and organizing assistance to other teams or team members facing workload challenges or requiring specialized expertise.

• Coaching and mentoring team members by identifying knowledge gaps and ensuring the delivery of process training according to official learning paths.

• Maintaining high integrity and safety standards by ensuring full compliance with corporate guidelines, SHE requirements, and applicable laws.

Who you are:
We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• University degree , preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline

• ACCA or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage

• 6+ years of working experience in related field, around 4 years experience in people management , preferably leading team with a large span of control

• Proficiency in relevant accounting software preferably SAP and MS office tools

• Strong communication skills , expressing ideas and expectations in a clear and concise manner

• Ability to work comfortably in a dynamic, changing and growing environment

• Proficiency in English

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility : We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average. We create the opportunity f

jobs.title: Head of Product HI Enterprise Cloud

titleByLocale.en: Head of Product HI Enterprise Cloud

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Head of Product HI Enterprise Cloud (Senior Product Leader) is accountable for the entire product lifecycle, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement of a complex product. This role is pivotal in transforming scientific and business needs into tangible, high-value technology solutions. You will be responsible for defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring it aligns with the overarching goals of our organization and ultimately accelerates the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines to patients. This role demands a distinctive combination of scientific inquisitiveness, technical proficiency, and business insight to successfully navigate the landscape.

Your primary objective is to define the direction for the engineering and service teams to build desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable products that meet the evolving needs of our internal users while maintaining strict compliance with relevant industry standards.

Your main responsabilities:

• Drive the Product Vision: Define and execute the comprehensive strategy and roadmap for the Enterprise Cloud portfolio to accelerate the delivery of life-changing diagnostics.

• Manage the Full Lifecycle: Take accountability for the entire product journey, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to scaling and retirement of complex cloud solutions.

• Lead Cloud Transformation: Orchestrate Roche’s "Cloud-First" strategy by optimizing for speed and release cadence to meet the evolving demands of Enterprise and R&D products.

• Foster Strategic Collaboration: Navigate a broad ecosystem of internal teams, external SaaS vendors, and academic partners to ensure seamless platform integration and API management.

• Ensure Compliance and Excellence: Balance innovation with strict adherence to industry standards, including GxP, while integrating AI capabilities to maintain a competitive advantage.

Who you are:

• Experienced Product Leader: You bring 10+ years in product management or business analysis with a proven history of launching and managing complex technology products.

• Industry Expert: You have 2+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology sector.

• Proven People Manager: You possess 2+ years of experience leading, mentoring, and developing high-performing, multidisciplinary technical teams.

• Technically Proficient: You hold a University Degree and have deep knowledge of modern software architecture, Cloud Hyperscalers, and Container as a Service (CaaS).

• Regulatory and Data Savvy: You are well-versed in GxP, FAIR data principles, and data privacy regulations such as GDPR to ensure secure and compliant foundations.

Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare.

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Madrid. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicine

• Industry Expert: You have 2+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology sector.

• Proven People Manager: You possess 2+ years of experience leading, mentoring, and developing high-performing, multidisciplinary technical teams.

• Technically Proficient: You hold a University Degree and have deep knowledge of modern software architecture, Cloud Hyperscalers, and Container as a Service (CaaS).

• Regulatory and Data Savvy: You are well-versed in GxP, FAIR data principles, and data privacy regulations such as GDPR to ensure secure and compliant foundations.

Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare.

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Madrid. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern- Product Owner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About the role

Are you a natural communicator with an analytical mind? Do you want to understand how a complex medical product is defined before a single line of code is written? Our Instrumentation Development chapter in Sant Cugat (Barcelona) is looking for a Software Product Owner / Requirement Engineer Intern .
In this role, you will support our Product Owners in the vital task of defining "what" we build. You will act as a bridge between high-level business needs and the technical implementation teams, ensuring that every feature is clearly documented and understood. This is a unique opportunity to gain a holistic view of the healthcare business and the lifecycle of medical software.

Main responsibilities

• Requirement Definition: Support the creation and maintenance of Feature Files and Product Requirements that guide our software implementation partners.

• Product Risk Management: Identify product risks in defined features and define appropriate risk control measures to mitigate risks that could cause patient harm.

• Operational Agility: Assist Product Owners in the day-to-day operational tasks, ensuring that requirements are ready for development "sprints" and resolving functional doubts.

• Tool Management: Work directly with our official requirement management tool, Retina (Codebeamer) , to keep documentation organized and updated.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Help gather needs and feedback from different areas, including Business Leaders (IPM), Global Service (GCS), and other cross-functional departments.

• Quality Assurance: Ensure that the defined requirements meet the necessary quality attributes for a regulated medical environment.

• Process optimization: Actively participate in and contribute to the continuous improvement of requirements processes within a SAFe environment.

How would your day-to-day look like?

Your day will involve a lot of interaction within the internal team and stakeholders from other areas and projects. You will participate in meetings with senior Product Owners to understand the strategic roadmap, and then translate those ideas into detailed documentation. You will spend time in Retina , refining feature descriptions, product risks, product requirements and ensuring the "definition of ready" is met for the developers.
Under the guidance of your assigned mentor , you will learn how to balance the needs of different stakeholders while building a strong network across various business areas. It’s a role that combines deep "desk work" (analysis and writing) with constant collaboration and networking.

Who are you?

• Education: Recent graduate in Informatics, Telecommunications, or Biomedical Engineering . We value your understanding of the product domain and logic over coding skills.

• Analytical Skills: You have a knack for breaking down complex problems into clear, logical requirements.

• Communication: You are comfortable talking to people from different backgrounds (technical and non-technical) and have excellent writing skills.

• Organization: You are methodical and detail-oriented, especially when managing documentation and deadlines.

• Languages: Professional proficiency in English (B2/C1 level) is essential, as you will interact with international stakeholders.

This opportunity is part of the START TECH program, you can find more information about the program in the following link.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern - DevOps
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
ABOUT THE ROLE

Are you fascinated by how software is deployed, scaled, and maintained in high-stakes environments? Our Instrumentation Development chapter in Sant Cugat (Barcelona) is looking for a Software Engineer Trainee to join our DevOps and Infrastructure operations.
In this role, you will be the backbone of our development process. You won't just be writing code; you will be ensuring that our software reaches its destination (testing and production environments) smoothly and reliably. This is a unique opportunity to enter the DevOps world, a discipline built on experience and collaboration rather than traditional textbooks.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

• Environment Maintenance: Support the daily operations of our testing environments, ensuring they are ready for the testing team’s deployments.

• Pipeline Optimization: Collaborate with our implementation partners to maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines, ensuring faster and safer software delivery.

• Infrastructure as Code: Assist in managing containerized environments using Docker, kubernetes and cloud resources within Azure and AWS .

• Daily Support: Provide support to the development squads in their day-to-day DevOps needs, troubleshooting deployment issues and monitoring system health.

• Continuous Improvement: Participate in initiatives to automate manual tasks and modernize our current infrastructure.

HOW WOULD YOUR DAY-TO-DAY LOOK LIKE?

Your day will start with a sync meeting to identify any bottlenecks in our deployment pipelines or environments. Under the guidance of your assigned mentor , you will learn how to manage the infrastructure and how to orchestrate services with Kubernetes .
You will work closely with both the testing team (to provide them with stable environments) and our external implementation partners (to learn and improve how we build software). It is a hands-on journey where you will see the immediate impact of your work on the speed and quality of the entire department.

WHO ARE YOU?

• Education: Recent graduate in Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related technical field.

• DevOps Passion: You are naturally curious about cloud technologies, automation, and the "behind the scenes" of software development.

• Tech Interest: While you don't need to be an expert, you have a basic understanding or a strong desire to master Cloud services and Kubernetes .

• Mindset: You are a problem-solver who enjoys technical challenges and thrives in collaborative environments.

• Languages: Professional proficiency in English (B1/B2 or higher).

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

• A Real DevOps School: DevOps is learned by doing. We offer you the environment, the tools, and the team to transform your curiosity into a professional career.

• Mentorship: You will have a dedicated mentor to guide your learning path from day one.

• High-Tech Stack: Gain hands-on experience with industry-standard tools (Azure, Docker, CI/CD).

• Flexibility: A flexible working model in our Sant Cugat office with remote work options.

• Program: This position is part of our START TECH program for young digital talent.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other

• Daily Support: Provide support to the development squads in their day-to-day DevOps needs, troubleshooting deployment issues and monitoring system health.

• Continuous Improvement: Participate in initiatives to automate manual tasks and modernize our current infrastructure.

HOW WOULD YOUR DAY-TO-DAY LOOK LIKE?

Your day will start with a sync meeting to identify any bottlenecks in our deployment pipelines or environments. Under the guidance of your assigned mentor , you will learn how to manage the infrastructure and how to orchestrate services with Kubernetes .
You will work closely with both the testing team (to provide them with stable environments) and our external implementation partners (to learn and improve how we build software). It is a hands-on journey where you will see the immediate impact of your work on the speed and quality of the entire department.

WHO ARE YOU?

• Education: Recent graduate in Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related technical field.

• DevOps Passion: You are naturally curious about cloud technologies, automation, and the "behind the scenes" of software development.

• Tech Interest: While you don't need to be an expert, you have a basic understanding or a strong desire to master Cloud services and Kubernetes .

• Mindset: You are a problem-solver who enjoys technical challenges and thrives in collaborative environments.

• Languages: Professional proficiency in English (B1/B2 or higher).

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

• A Real DevOps School: DevOps is learned by doing. We offer you the environment, the tools, and the team to transform your curiosity into a professional career.

• Mentorship: You will have a dedicated mentor to guide your learning path from day one.

• High-Tech Stack: Gain hands-on experience with industry-standard tools (Azure, Docker, CI/CD).

• Flexibility: A flexible working model in our Sant Cugat office with remote work options.

• Program: This position is part of our START TECH program for young digital talent.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Purpose of the role:

We are looking for a creative, innovative and open-minded intern to join the Global Regulatory Affairs team.
As an Intern in Regulatory Affairs, you have the opportunity to support regulatory and product care activities, and get insights into the IVD/MD industry and the applicable regulations and standards for IVD/MD products.
In Global Regulatory Affairs we work on specific challenges as a team within all areas of the diagnostic business around the globe, to grow together to bring the best products to patients while choosing a work environment that fits our life.
As AI plays an increasing role in our daily lives we are also looking for colleagues who are keen in taking part in high-impact projects that leverage machine learning (ML), natural language processing (NLP), and large language models (LLMs) to optimize how we navigate the complex landscape of global health regulations.
In this intern role, you can clearly demonstrate your creativity and leave a footprint in our products’ lifecycle. You will directly contribute to Roche Diagnostics' vision: innovating diagnostics, shaping healthcare & changing lives.

Your key responsibilities:

After your onboarding program, you will be assigned to tasks or projects. You’ll be mostly spending your time in:

• Assisting in the worldwide registrations and activities for various IVD/MD products, at various stages of their development and lifecycle

• Supporting the preparation and maintenance of global documentation for our IVD/MD products

• Collaborating with other regulatory affairs teams, including local affiliates, for registrational activities

• Coordinating with global interdisciplinary project teams to provide regulatory input to development, submission planning, and documentation needed

• Supporting the global regulatory affairs team members in their non-registrational activities

• Assisting in the design, development, and testing of AI-powered tools and dashboards for regulatory tracking, document analysis, and automated reporting.

• Participating in the training and fine-tuning of ML and NLP models tailored for regulatory use cases, ensuring high accuracy and compliance with internal standards.

• Keep abreast of emerging AI technologies and changing regulatory guidelines regarding AI in the healthcare and pharmaceutical industries.

Who you are:

• You have recently graduated (within the last 3 years) in the field of Biology, Life Sciences, Engineering, or Data Science, Computer Science, Bioinformatics

• You possess facilitation and communications skills and the ability to deal with adversity in a multicultural and international environment

• You are a fast learner, have a proactive attitude to drive solutions, and have a high level of team orientation

• You are curious and attentive to detail with a strong problem-solving capability

• You are fluent in English (written and spoken)

• You have a strong proficiency in Python and its data science ecosystem (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow).

• You have Experience with Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques and frameworks (e.g., Hugging Face, spaCy).

• You have Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs) and prompt engineering.

• Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI, or Matplotlib/Seaborn).

What do we offer?

• Become a Regulatory Affairs professional for IVDs/MDs.

• Develop a Regulatory Mindset and understand the most important regulations and industry standards.

•

jobs.title: (Senior) Medical Science Manager (Immunology, Rheumatology/Nephrology preferred）
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
● A field-based medical expertise for field medical strategy development and execution on the assigned disease area and related biomarker under the leadership of Medical Science Manager Leader.
● Be responsible for data generation activities for assigned disease area and related biomarker.
● Establish long-term, peer-to-peer relationships with TAEs and investigators，including biomarker area experts, in a given therapeutic field and deliver quality interactions and services that bring value to HCPs, and that are aligned with medical strategies.
● Lead implementation of the tactical / field medical plans in collaboration with Country Medical Manager.
● Identify opportunities for collaborations between the company and the TAEs and investigators.
● Ensures strict adherence to the company’s corporate policies, SOP and local regulations for all medical science initiatives for assigned disease area.

Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
(Major functions of the position)
1) A field-based medical expertise for medical science in assigned disease area and related biomarker
● Drive development, implementation and monitoring field medical plan under coaching of MSM Leader and align with country medical strategy.
● Define and execute field medical short term to long term vision includes scientific communications and strategic partnerships through interaction with TAEs.
● Collect field TAE insights and determine TAE interest in ongoing research and educational events; Develop and regularly update TAE profile to better understand TAE’s clinical practices, needs, preferences and views of new data.
● Provide scientific support for cross functional partners in medical training, scientific query handling, speaker material preparation.
● Lead the local innovative business model developing, implementation and further optimization, such as the establishment of regional pathology referral center with synergy from Roche diagnostic company and other external diagnostic related company or medical society.
● Contribute to the execution of advisory boards.
2) Data Generation
● Translate insights on local stakeholder needs and value decision drivers into an effective medical strategy, prioritize gaps and hurdles related to the local patient journey.
● Ensure excellence in access evidence planning and generation as part of the medical strategy, incorporating RWE, clinical studies and data inputs for local economic models etc.
● Receive IISs request, work with country medical manager to review of IISs within the company, and following-up with investigators, in accordance to all local laws and regulations.
● Support site feasibility assessments, site development plan, patients enrollment in trials and investigator engagement of Phase I-IIIa clinical studies under the direction of PD of Phase IIIb-IV Medical Affairs clinical studies in collaboration with clinical operations
3) Knowledge exchange
● Translate clinical/scientific evidence into local value messages and communicate those in cross functional collaboration to relevant stakeholders in a tailored manner.
● Exchange scientific data with HCPs; facilitate their needs of up to date scientific data, including but not limited to publications of clinical trials, guidelines, by ensuring they have the best quality vailable information they require.
● Develop and deliver medical training and education program to the target audience.
● Provide inputs to country medical manager on the af

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Purpose of the role:

Your mission is to support the evolution of our operational landscape. You will focus on converting traditional routine processes into agile, AI-enhanced workflows. Additionally, you will provide essential support to our Document Management team, ensuring key project documents are managed and processed accurately within our Electronic Document Management Systems (EDMS), specifically DiaDoc and SAP.

Main responsibilities:

• Process Analysis: Critically evaluate established routine processes to identify specific opportunities for AI-driven optimization and efficiency gains.

• Implementation & Strategy: Support the deployment and maintenance of intelligent solutions while assisting with internal communication strategies to ensure smooth adoption.

• Operational Support: Assist in the daily management of project documentation, ensuring high standards of data integrity and accessibility.

How would your day to day look like?

• Immersive Learning: You will start by integrating into our daily routines, gaining a deep understanding of our workflows and the interdependencies that drive our business.

• Collaborative Problem-Solving : You will work closely with cross-functional team members to understand their pain points and translate their ideas into tangible efficiency gains.

• Technical Innovation: You will spend significant time developing and supporting intelligent, AI-based solutions tailored to our specific organizational needs.

• Hands-on Document Management : You will gain practical experience in an international regulatory environment by processing selected project documents within our professional EDMS.

Who are you?

• Education: You are a recent Bachelor’s or Master’s graduate looking to launch your career in a high-impact environment.

• Technical Agility: You possess a sophisticated understanding of the current AI landscape and have the technical aptitude to integrate smart solutions into a professional corporate infrastructure.

• Solution-Oriented Mindset: You are a motivated problem-solver who is eager to take digital infrastructure to the next level.

• Global Perspective: You are excited to collaborate with international teams and thrive in a fast-paced, world-class diagnostic organization.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Business Solution Management Associate
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Purpose of the role

Roche is the world’s largest biotech company, with truly differentiated medicines in oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, ophthalmology and diseases of the central nervous system. Roche is also the world leader in-vitro diagnostics and tissue-based cancer diagnostics, and a frontrunner in diabetes management.

The Diagnostics Insights Solution Management Team is part of Roche Diagnostics . We focus on developing and commercialising solutions with multiple components (digital, physical, and service offerings) to create value beyond individual products by comprehensively addressing customer needs.

As Business Solution Management Associate , you will support us in addressing the challenges in commercializing these integrated solutions. One of our key initiatives in commercializing integrated solutions with country organizations is the multi-year Stronger Solution Selling (S3) program . You will support the S3 core team in delivering strategic workshops with country organizations and optimizing essential solution-selling assets to help cross-functional affiliate teams better navigate Roche Diagnostic’s physical, digital, and service portfolios. This role offers a blend of project management and process refinement, providing a unique platform to shape how the organization delivers tailored value to its customers worldwide.

Main responsibilities

As a Business Solution Management Associate, you will help us in bridging the gap between strategic methodology and operational execution. Over the course of your one-year assignment, your core responsibilities will include:

• Project Management & Delivery : Take ownership of assigned tasks with a focus on structuring complexity and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality assets.

• Affiliate Support & Collaboration : Directly assist the S3 Core Team in driving activities with country organizations and country clusters.

• Asset & Tool Optimization : Refine existing and develop new solution-selling tools to help teams better navigate Roche’s physical and digital offerings.

• Change Management : Support ongoing activities aimed at sustaining the organizational shift toward effective solution selling.

• Process Improvement : Potentially step up into a process improvement project to refine workflows, systems, or insights that improve the effectiveness of solution selling.

How would your day to day look like?

As Business Solution Management Associate , you'll work closely with team members in the S3 core team, as well as subregional and country teams. This role offers a great opportunity to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders for driving improvements in solution commercialization.

Your day-to-day will be dynamic and diverse, and could begin by coordinating with the S3 Core Team to support global affiliates and manage project deliverables. You might spend the morning organizing workshops or refining assets that help teams navigate Roche's complex solution portfolio. This involves a high degree of ownership, as you structure complex information into clear, high-quality tools for country organizations.

In the afternoon, you shift focus toward process optimization and change management. You might analyze workflows to improve solution-selling insights or collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the S3 methodology is effectively embedded across the region. Each day concludes by ensuring all project milestones are on track, balancing technical learning with a proactive, delivery-f

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Position
The role
​
You’ll work alongside a dynamic team in a fast paced environment shaping how AI can enhance the strategic capabilities of Business Development. This is an opportunity to blend business insight, creativity, and technical curiosity to help build a next-generation partnership and insights platform within Roche.

Responsibilities

• Collaborate closely with stakeholders across multiple departments to clearly define project requirements, implement use cases, and validate AI-driven applications.

jobs.title: Service Design Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You will join the Customer Experience, Research & Strategy team at Roche Diagnostics in Sant Cugat. This team sits at the heart of how Roche understands and designs for the people who rely on diagnostic solutions — from lab professionals to clinicians and patients. The team combines rigorous research with strategic design to shape services and experiences across digital and physical touchpoints.

About the role

As a Service Design intern you will contribute to real research and design projects from day one. Working alongside senior designers and researchers, you will help map the end-to-end experiences of Roche's customers, conduct user research, and explore how conversational interfaces — chatbots, voice assistants, and AI-powered agents — can better serve the needs of healthcare professionals.
Over the course of a full year you will move through the entire design cycle — from discovery and research through to prototyping and delivery — building a rich, evidence-based portfolio in one of the most complex and meaningful design contexts there is.

What you'll do

Research support

• Assist in planning and facilitating user interviews, contextual enquiries, and usability sessions with healthcare professionals

• Help synthesise qualitative findings through affinity mapping and insight frameworks

• Contribute to personas, journey maps, and mental model documentation

• Support the team in maintaining research repositories and knowledge assets

Service design

• Contribute to service blueprints and experience maps that reveal systemic friction

• Participate in co-design workshops with internal teams and external stakeholders

• Help build and iterate on prototypes for concept testing

• Document design decisions and produce artefacts that communicate intent clearly

Conversational design

• Support the design of dialogue flows and conversation scripts for chat and voice interfaces

• Help define tone of voice guidelines for automated interactions in a healthcare context

• Assist in evaluating conversational prototypes with real users and documenting findings

• Research best practices in NLP, intent design, and accessible conversational UX

Collaboration

• Work in cross-functional squads alongside product managers, engineers, and clinical experts

• Present work-in-progress in team reviews and design critiques

• Contribute to team rituals: stand-ups, retrospectives, and design community sessions

• Bring fresh perspective and curiosity to a team that values diverse viewpoints

Who we're looking for

• Currently enrolled in a degree in Service Design, Interaction Design, HCI, UX, or a related field

• Genuine interest in human-centred research — you are curious about people and why they behave as they do

• Exposure to conversational design, dialogue writing, or NLP through coursework or personal projects

• Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to ask good questions in complex environments

• Clear communication in English (working language of the team); Spanish is a plus

• A portfolio or project work demonstrating research and/or design thinking

Nice to have

• Familiarity with tools such as Figma, FigJam, Miro, or Dovetail

• Interest in healthcare, diagnostics, or life sciences

• Exposure to systems thinking, service blueprinting, or design research methods

• Any experience with chatbot platforms or voice assistant design

• Strong visual communication skills — the ability to make complexity legible

What we offer: The internship experience

• A full

Our team is responsible for developing connectivity solutions which are enabling interoperability of all components part of the Diagnostics of our clients (instruments, Network integrators, IT solutions, LIS…). The position will support this ambition by covering activities related to gain understanding of requirements at business and technical level so that they can support on the component, E2E and field validation of functionality, testing activities and integration with other solutions. The role will also provide technical requirements to development teams when appropriate.

How would your day to day look like?

You will be part of a development team based in Sant Cugat and as part of it, you will join their Agile ceremonies (SAFE Framework). You will work in some activities from your team backlog related to your role. You will be in the office an average of 1 to 2 days per week together with the rest of the team for specific testing needs. In addition, you will need to travel 3-4 times per year to Switzerland or other client locations.

Who are you?

You are a recent graduate (max 3 years after graduation) in the fields of Informatics, Telecommunications and Biotech.
You are a person with high curiosity and willingness to learn from other domains. You try to find autonomy in your work and are able to ask for help or advice in order to ensure you are doing valuable work. You are authentic, tell the truth and explain the why, strive for excellence and continuously improve and live our values of Integrity, Courage and Passion.

What do we offer?

We offer a learning environment and opportunities to develop quickly yourself both on our domains and on your personal growth and leadership. 
• We offer you a mature organization with Innovative and passionate people, very customer centric and open to change and continuously improving and delivering value fast. You also will be trained on the basic competencies you need to work with us and will feel safe for failing and learning as the essence to growing with us.

This opportunity is part of the START TECH program, you can find more information about the program in the following link .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Simulation Specialist Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position

At the heart of this internship, you will collaborate with our Simulation Teams to architect the future of System & Solution Design. As a key contributor, you will help build and validate ‘Digital Twins’ for our next-generation core lab solutions. Your work won’t just be theoretical, it will directly shape the physical architecture and the logical “brain” of cutting-edge, end-to-end laboratory systems.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Model & Maintain: Create and maintain complex scenarios for software and hardware simulations.

• Execute & Analyze: Run simulations and perform deep-dive analyses of the results to identify system behaviors.

• Evolutionary Support: Provide status updates and issue notifications to support the continuous evolution of our simulators.

• Collaborate: Work alongside multidisciplinary teams to improve departmental operations and project delivery.

What You Will Learn & Develop

• Advanced Simulation: Gain hands-on experience with Discrete Event Simulation (DES) using tools like Simio or AnyLogic.

• Systems Engineering: Understand the "big picture" of how hardware, software, and logistics integrate into massive diagnostic solutions.

• Algorithmic Thinking: Design and implement efficient heuristics for real-time decision-making in robotics.

• Data Science: Use Python to transform raw simulation outputs into powerful, data-driven visual stories.

• Software Development: Level up your OOP (C# or Java ) skills by extending simulation logic.

• Global Collaboration: Experience working across borders with engineers and product owners in an international environment.

Who You Are

You are a methodical, responsible team player who is eager to take ownership of technical challenges.

• Education: Mechanical Engineering, SW Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or Industrial Engineering.

• Programming: Solid foundation in Object-Oriented Programming (C# or Java).

• Data Tools: Knowledge of SQL, Python, and Pandas for data management.

• Simulation: Familiarity with Discrete Event Simulations and statistical modeling.

• Communication: Fluent in English; able to present complex data with clarity.

• Mindset: You are a methodical, responsible team player who is eager to take ownership of technical challenges.A strong willingness to learn and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. jobs.title: Clinical Quality Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Main tasks and duties:

• Support Roche clinical studies and play a role in the development of new diagnostic tests, helping to ensure the quality and safety of our products.

• Perform quality review of clinical study documents (study protocols, investigator brochures and

• reports) to ensure that clinical studies of IVDs are planned, conducted, and documented in

• compliance with regulations, internal procedures and product specification documents.

• Support GCP inspection readiness activities, including through study file reviews.

• Support team initiatives, including process improvement/harmonization.

• Support project teams with Good Clinical Practice expertise.

Additional tasks, duties and responsibilities:
● Additional tasks as required.

Requirements:

• Preferred Education: Recent graduates from University degree or Master in scientific or technological discipline, ideally in Biomedicine, Biotechnology field.

• No previous experience needed.

• Fluent command of English.

• Interest in clinical studies, medical devices, quality management systems and software development processes. Knowledge of quality and regulatory standards is a plus but not

• mandatory: Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ISO 13485, ISO 20916,

• FDA QSR, IVDR, GDPR

• This position is only available for candidates who have never worked in a company in Spain or used a "contrato de prácticas" before.

Who We Are

At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients. At Roche, we believe diversity and inclusion are essential values for our success. We have a special interest in integrating people with disabilities into our teams. If you have a disability, we see it as a plus and offer you special benefits.

• reports) to ensure that clinical studies of IVDs are planned, conducted, and documented in

• compliance with regulations, internal procedures and product specification documents.

• Support GCP inspection readiness activities, including through study file reviews.

• Support team initiatives, including process improvement/harmonization.

• Support project teams with Good Clinical Practice expertise.

• mandatory: Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ISO 13485, ISO 20916,

• FDA QSR, IVDR, GDPR
