jobs.title: Software Engineer in Test Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Purpose of the role

At Diagnostics Insights Software, we are collaborating in digitalizing diagnostics and revolutionizing how data is accessed and utilized in Laboratories and Point of Care settings.

Building software products is great, but working on software with a purpose is even better! As a Software Engineer in Test, you’ll work on a product that helps people with the most precious thing they have — their health. In collaborative teams of engineers, designers, product owners, and UX experts, you’ll experience best-in-class software engineering practices daily and contribute to software that meets the highest expectations — we do not put our users’ lives at risk!

Main responsibilities:

• Confirm the correctness of requirements-driven tests, utilizing diverse testing approaches such as exploratory, white box, and black box testing.

• Execute tests across multiple testing levels , including end-to-end, system, integration, and unit testing.

• Perform various testing types , such as functional, performance, resiliency, and scalability testing, to ensure robust product quality.

• Automate and execute front-end and back-end tests for platforms and web applications .

• Develop and automate deployment and testing pipelines, supporting multiple project branches and stages.

• Track and report quality metrics , contributing to the maintenance and improvement of quality dashboards .

• Conduct root cause analyses of defects and newly discovered issues to continuously improve testing practices.

• Design and implement automation frameworks and validate toolchains to support testing processes.

• Ensure compliance with regulatory standards for all quality engineering deliverables.

• Collaborate closely with Test Architects, Test Leads, Test Managers, as well as designers, architects, and developers.

• Share, coach, and train the built-in quality mindset throughout the organization.

How would your day to day look like?
You will work closely with developers, product owners, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality software in a fast-paced, iterative environment.
You will deep dive on ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products by performing thorough testing activities throughout the development lifecycle. We are committed to quality, dedicating time to design reviews, thorough test coverage, focused quality days and CI/CD principles. If this resonates with you, we would love to hear from you

Who are you?

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

• You are familiar with integration of automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline to ensure continuous testing.

• You are familiar with the testing processes: design, plan, execution and reporting.

• Great written and verbal communication in English.

• Technologies & Tools: Kubernetes-based applications, AWS, Java, Cucumber (Behavior-Driven Development), Typescript, Javascript, Playwright, Cypress, Jira, GitHub/GitLab, Confluence, Google Suite, macOS/Linux.

This opportunity is part of the START TECH program, you can find more information about the program in the following link.

jobs.title: Penetration Tester Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Department Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated professional with experience in Security and Privacy to join our dynamic team. As a Junior Penetration Tester, your main responsibilities will include supporting and assisting in penetration testing activities to ensure the security of Roche products and solutions. This role involves collaborating with Product Teams, executing predefined test strategies, and documenting the results. You will play a crucial role in identifying vulnerabilities and aiding in the reporting process.

The Opportunity

• Work closely with Product Teams to understand and determine testing requirements and assist in the development, planning, scoping and execution of testing activities (both in physical and cloud products).

• Conduct cybersecurity penetration testing activities across various technology layers, assessing the criticality of vulnerabilities for adequate prioritization, and providing suitable remediation recommendations to product teams.

• Maintain and utilize the repository of penetration testing methods and tools to ensure consistency and standardization in testing practices.

• Create detailed reports and present findings, associated risks, and recommendations to product teams and management.

• Participate in planning and managing red team exercises to assess the cyber resilience of products and solutions.

• Support the Incident Response team during incidents.

• Contribute to initiatives aimed at integrating defense capabilities into products in collaboration with other PSPO colleagues.

• Develop, maintain, and continuously optimize processes, playbooks, and tools to enhance penetration testing efficiency and effectiveness.

Program Highlights

• Intensive 1 year intern graduate program (Contrato en prácticas).

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Location in Sant Cugat del Valles, On Site.

• Access to training and development opportunities.

• Work with some of the most talented people in the biotechnology industry.

Who You Are (Required)

• Must have graduated from a University degree program.

• Must have attained a Bachelor's degree.

• Experience or familiarity with cloud computing technologies, vulnerability assessment, and penetration testing.

• Knowledge of automating security controls through scripting languages such as shell scripting and Python.

• Understanding of information security and privacy risks.

• Problem solving abilities, communication, teamwork, flexibility and adaptability.

• Team player, proactive, self-driven, solution-oriented, and hands-on.

Required Majors: Information Systems, Computer Science or a related relevant area of study.

This opportunity is part of the START TECH program.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

• Work closely with Product Teams to understand and determine testing requirements and assist in the development, planning, scoping and execution of testing activities (both in physical and cloud products).

• Conduct cybersecurity penetration testing activities across various technology layers, assessing the criticality of vulnerabilities for adequate prioritization, and providing suitable remediation recommendations to product teams.

• Maintain and utilize the repository of penetration testing methods and tools to ensure consistency and standardization in testing practices.

• Create detailed reports and present findings, associated risks, and recommendations to product teams and management.

• Participate in planning and managing red team exercises to assess the cyber resilience of products and solutions.

• Support the Incident Response team during incidents.

• Contribute to initiatives aimed at integrating defense capabilities into products in collaboration with other PSPO colleagues.

• Develop, maintain, and continuously optimize processes, playbooks, and tools to enhance penetration testing efficiency and effectiveness.

Program Highlights

• Intensive 1 year intern graduate program (Contrato en prácticas).

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Location in Sant Cugat del Valles, On Site.

• Access to training and development opportunities.

• Work with some of the most talented people in the biotechnology industry.

Who You Are (Required)

• Must have graduated from a University degree program.

• Must have attained a Bachelor's degree.

• Experience or familiarity with cloud computing technologies, vulnerability assessment, and penetration testing.

• Knowledge of automating security controls through scripting languages such as shell scripting and Python.

• Understanding of information security and privacy risks.

• Problem solving abilities, communication, teamwork, flexibility and adaptability.

• Team player, proactive, self-driven, solution-oriented, and hands-on.

Required Majors: Information Systems, Computer Science or a related relevant area of study.

This opportunity is part of the START TECH program.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Digital Campaign Delivery Intern in the Global Digital Hub, you support the successful delivery of digital campaigns content creation projects within the Digital Campaigns Chapter. The role plays a role in ensuring timely and high-quality digital campaigns content creation coordination and completion.

The Digital Campaign Delivery Intern will collaborate closely with the Campaign Delivery Specialists to support affiliate business teams or brand teams, third-party-vendors, campaign and global campaign coordinators in the organization, related to project requirements, objectives, and timelines.

Responsibilities

• Manage the affiliate or global digital campaigns content creation and delivery process, ensuring timely and successful completion of any projects from initiation to final implementation, while ensuring delivery standards are met.

• Incorporate feedback from stakeholders and revise digital campaigns content requests accordingly to ensure alignment with their expectations.

• Incorporates feedback on new process or requirements that would increase efficiency in the ways of working in subject matter area

• Adoption and Center of Excellence: follow existing processes, establish process governance principles and maintain proper documentation and implementation within the scope of responsibility

Who you are
You are a person with high interest and ability in project coordination with understanding of digital marketing principles and content creation processes. Your excellent organizational and communication skills enable you to manage multiple projects efficiently, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery. You excel at collaborating with diverse teams and adapting to their feedback to meet their needs and expectations.

Further requirements

• Proficient in English and German language

• You have ongoing studies at any Hungarian University/college

• You are available at least 20-25 hours per week

• You are passionate about project management

• You're organized, detail-oriented, self-motivated, with the ability to easily transition between multiple tasks and problem solve thoughtfully

• You have highly developed interpersonal and communication skills

• You are a quick learner, proactive, flexible and curious with an an innovative mind

• You are a strong team player with ability to work in a virtual team environment

In exchange we provide you with:

Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

A global community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Explore what the Global Digital Hub is about.

Discover the Roche Services & Solutions Center and how we work together as a truly global team!

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/budapest-data-privacy-notice-candidate

jobs.title: R&D Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives through innovation in diagnostics. As part of our Start Tech Program , we are looking for a motivated recent graduate to join our team in Sant Cugat and contribute to cutting-edge diagnostic development.
This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic laboratory environment while working alongside experienced professionals in the field.

Your Responsibilities

As a Start Tech Graduate Intern, you will support the development of diagnostic solutions and contribute to laboratory operations. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Participating in the development of diagnostic assays, including clotting, enzymatic, and immunological methods

• Independently supporting the execution of analytical experiments, including data analysis, interpretation, and presentation of results

• Assisting in the planning, implementation, evaluation, and documentation of development activities, including literature research

• Contributing to general laboratory tasks to ensure smooth day-to-day operations

• Taking responsibility for the proper use and maintenance of assigned laboratory equipment

What We Are Looking For

• Recent graduate in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or a related field

• Strong interest in diagnostics and laboratory-based research

• Analytical mindset with attention to detail and problem-solving skills

• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment

• Good communication skills and willingness to learn

What We Offer

• Hands-on experience in a leading global healthcare company

• Exposure to innovative diagnostic technologies and methodologies

• A collaborative and international work environment

• Opportunities for learning, growth, and future career development within Roche

If you are eager to start your career in diagnostics and want to make a meaningful impact, we would love to hear from you.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Process Technician
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:
We are currently looking for two Process Technicians to join our Process Engineering team on a 12-month contract , with the possibility of extension. Both positions will involve the same day-to-day responsibilities outlined below; however, one of the roles will also require working at our Dumyat location.

As a Process Technician you will work closely with the sensor manufacture and packaging teams and will become highly skilled and competent in all aspects of manufacturing (e.g. line operation & packaging, processes and procedures). Be able to diagnose product and process issues quickly and effectively using a logical approach. Support and drive continuous improvement initiatives while ensuring the highest levels of quality and productivity are maintained. Analyse manufacturing data and conduct product / process testing to ensure CTQs are met. Update documentation such as standard operating procedures, work instructions and bills of material.

This is an on-site role based at our Athena Motherwell location. Please note that you will spend approximately 70% of your time working from our Bathgate site, however, one of the roles will also require working at our Dumyat location.

Responsibilities:
Technical:

• Work in close collaboration with manufacturing technicians and engineers to become highly competent in sensor manufacture line operation, processes and procedures

• Support monitoring of product and process data using statistical analysis techniques

• Quick and effective diagnosis and troubleshooting of problems using a methodical approach and report progress in a structured way

• Conduct CTQ testing and material / product analysis techniques

• Investigate and resolve non-conformances and help develop robust OCAP’s and preventative measures

• Support NPD projects through transfer of pilot work to high volume manufacture

• Support validation activities and completion of validation documentation in line with business needs

• Help drive continuous improvement initiatives through engagement of production team on shift

• Ensures highest levels of quality and compliance are maintained

• Lead/support change control updates to manufacturing documentation.

Who you are:

Essential Education/ Qualifications:

• Process Excellence Yellow or Green belt additional advantage.

• Preferably Degree qualified or relevant experience.

• Experience in rotary converting and / or reel to reel printing (rotary screen / flexographic etc.) additional advantage

• Knowledge of Statistical Analysis methods / techniques

Requirements (incl. Key Skills):

• GMP experience

• A hands-on Process Technician with a good level of relevant industry experience (preferably medical device related)

• Experience of optimising product and processes

• High level of computer literacy

• Team player and takes accountability for any manufacturing challenges

• Analyse production data and conduct process / product analysis to ensure CTQs are met

• Strong problem-solving skills and sense of urgency

• Detail orientated and ensures highest levels of quality and productivity are maintained on a daily basis

Recruitment process

Phase I:

• Submission of Cover Letter & CV: Evaluation of technical skills and motivation.

Phase II:

• In-person interview in Athena Motherwell (will be shared with the shortlisted candidates later)

jobs.title: GPC Global Compliance Assurance Lead

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile Globale per l'Assicurazione della Conformità GPC

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Mission

As a GPC Global Compliance Assurance Lead, you will play a key role in ensuring the GPC - Global Patient Care Organization has the highest quality standards and remains compliant at all times.

You will lead and manage a team of GPC Compliance Assurance Leads, Compliance Assurance Specialists and PRI & Case Monitoring Specialists. You will ensure Roche and partners' products and solutions meet global regulations, corporate standards, and expectations by overseeing the monitoring, reviewing, and timely reporting on the quality of interactions. You will help maintain an effective quality management system and governance, globally, and continually improve the governance to meet evolving business and compliance needs.
Together with your team, you will implement a common quality framework across the GPC Hubs. You will analyze results regularly, conceive corrective and preventive measures in case of findings, and collaborate in the design of training concepts to overcome identified knowledge gaps.

You will ensure the GPC Organization complies with regulatory requirements and corporate standards. You will communicate significant quality, or regulatory issues and risks that may impact operations or regulatory compliance to local, regional or global management. In addition, you will be accountable for the preparation, coordination, and conduct of audits, ensuring the GPC Organization operates in an “inspection ready” manner and that audit measures are strictly implemented.

Key Accountabilities

• Effectively lead and develop a team of GPC Compliance Assurance Leads, Specialists and PRI & Case Monitoring Specialists.

• Design, implement, and continuously improve the Global Compliance Governance Model and related monitoring standards.

• Accountable for the end-to-end audit process, including preparation work, managing the audit schedule, and ensuring the timely implementation of audit-related measures.

• Implement and follow up on measures to continuously maintain or optimize the overall compliance of GPC in the processing and documentation of customer concerns.

• Act as a contact person and expert with the different interfaces for all quality and compliance topics, proactively and in an advisory manner.

• Main responsible for auditing and analyzing the compliance levels of the cases handled by GPC Advisors.

• Close collaboration with global safety and post-market quality teams to ensure end-to-end compliance in the complaint handling process.

• Foster a culture of excellence, inclusivity, and collaboration while driving team and individual performance.

• Cultivate an inspiring team environment that promotes diversity, overcoming the challenges of a multi-location setup.

• Ensure the team delivers exceptional service while optimizing efficiency and effectiveness through continuous improvement.

• Drive the talent acquisition and hiring process, focusing on retaining top talent and maintaining a positive work environment.

• Provide proactive feedback and coaching to team members, managing performance and contributing to succession planning and talent management.

Key skills and Experience

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

• A fluent command of English is a must; any other language is a plus.

• Proven leadership experience, preferably in an international setting in a medical regulated environment.

• Knowledge of Roche products, solutions, and systems is recommended.

• Minimum 4 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Comp

The Position
Mission

As a GPC Global Compliance Assurance Lead, you will play a key role in ensuring the GPC - Global Patient Care Organization has the highest quality standards and remains compliant at all times.

You will lead and manage a team of GPC Compliance Assurance Leads, Compliance Assurance Specialists and PRI & Case Monitoring Specialists. You will ensure Roche and partners' products and solutions meet global regulations, corporate standards, and expectations by overseeing the monitoring, reviewing, and timely reporting on the quality of interactions. You will help maintain an effective quality management system and governance, globally, and continually improve the governance to meet evolving business and compliance needs.
Together with your team, you will implement a common quality framework across the GPC Hubs. You will analyze results regularly, conceive corrective and preventive measures in case of findings, and collaborate in the design of training concepts to overcome identified knowledge gaps.

You will ensure the GPC Organization complies with regulatory requirements and corporate standards. You will communicate significant quality, or regulatory issues and risks that may impact operations or regulatory compliance to local, regional or global management. In addition, you will be accountable for the preparation, coordination, and conduct of audits, ensuring the GPC Organization operates in an “inspection ready” manner and that audit measures are strictly implemented.

Key Accountabilities

• Effectively lead and develop a team of GPC Compliance Assurance Leads, Specialists and PRI & Case Monitoring Specialists.

• Design, implement, and continuously improve the Global Compliance Governance Model and related monitoring standards.

• Accountable for the end-to-end audit process, including preparation work, managing the audit schedule, and ensuring the timely implementation of audit-related measures.

• Implement and follow up on measures to continuously maintain or optimize the overall compliance of GPC in the processing and documentation of customer concerns.

• Act as a contact person and expert with the different interfaces for all quality and compliance topics, proactively and in an advisory manner.

• Main responsible for auditing and analyzing the compliance levels of the cases handled by GPC Advisors.

• Close collaboration with global safety and post-market quality teams to ensure end-to-end compliance in the complaint handling process.

• Foster a culture of excellence, inclusivity, and collaboration while driving team and individual performance.

• Cultivate an inspiring team environment that promotes diversity, overcoming the challenges of a multi-location setup.

• Ensure the team delivers exceptional service while optimizing efficiency and effectiveness through continuous improvement.

• Drive the talent acquisition and hiring process, focusing on retaining top talent and maintaining a positive work environment.

• Provide proactive feedback and coaching to team members, managing performance and contributing to succession planning and talent management.

Key skills and Experience

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

• A fluent command of English is a must; any other language is a plus.

• Proven leadership experience, preferably in an international setting in a medical regulated environment.

• Knowledge of Roche products, solutions, and systems is recommended.

• Minimum 4 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Comp

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Scientist in Pharmaceutical Development, you are part of the Department “Pharmaceutical Development” in Pharma Technical Development (PTD) in Basel, Switzerland. The department Pharmaceutical Development is responsible for the development of parenteral drug products (Synthetic molecules and Biologics) from Phase 1 through Launch. Activities encompass formulation and manufacturing process development for parenteral drug products for all clinical stages and the market launch, the transfer of product and process to commercial manufacturing sites, commercial product support and line extension development.

The opportunity

• Leading development: Pharmaceutical development of parenteral formulations for clinical development and market (including line extensions). Understanding stability behavior (e.g. biophysics, chemical degradation)

• Management of Data: Ensure seamless integration of structured and unstructured data across the department.

• Data Mining & Pattern Discovery: Utilize advanced statistical and machine learning techniques to perform deep-dive Data Mining. Identify trends and correlations associated with scientific data.

• Functional expertise as project management: Representation of Pharmaceutical Development as pharmaceutical project leader in global CMC teams, functional representative in cross-functional teams and global committees within Roche.

• Regulatory submissions: Authoring drug product sections for clinical IND/IMPDs and MAAs.

Who you are
As the successful candidate you hold a Ph.D. degree in chemical/process/bioprocess engineering or related fields Or you hold a masters degree in chemical/process/bioprocess engineering or related fields with a minimum of 3 years of professional (industry) experience in a pharmaceutical company.

• Proven experience of establishing and managing large data sets, including exposure to scripting associated with data analysis.

• Deep understanding of statistical modeling including linear/logistic regression, cluster analysis, time-series forecasting, longitudinal study data analysis, and multivariate testing.

• Knowledge of pharmaceutical product development and associated requirements.

• Understanding of regulatory requirements for different clinical and commercial stages of development.

• Excellent communication skills and collaborative behaviors, with end-to-end and global thinking, as well as excellent stakeholder management skills

Are you ready to make a difference for our patients? We are looking forward to your application – join us now and become part of our journey!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Solution Architect - Commercial Content Supply Chain

Roche Digital Technology (RDT ) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, w e offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

Be part of the revolution in our commercial content ecosystem. You will spearhead the adoption of Generative AI (GenAI) and Automation solutions, building robust technical foundations and seamless integrations that empower bespoke customer experiences at scale.

Serving as a Lead Architect and Strategist , you will orchestrate the technology roadmap and direct the comprehensive deployment of systems designed to achieve measurable business impact.

The opportunity:

• Defining the Vision and Strategy by serving as the lead architect for our future-state digital supply chain ecosystem.

• Curating the Technology Stack through the selection and integration of modern tools at the crossroads of artificial intelligence and automated workflows.

• Providing Implementation Oversight by directing technical execution and deployment phases to guarantee consistent alignment with our strategic business objectives.

• Driving Personalization at Scale by engineering robust frameworks that facilitate highly.

Who you are:

• Substantial Professional Background including at least a decade in software engineering, with a minimum of five years focused on architectural leadership.

• Strategic Domain Expertise in the architectural design and large-scale deployment of Commercial Content Supply Chains .

• Adobe Platform Mastery , specifically regarding technical proficiency across AEM and AEP integrated technology stacks.

• Engineering Excellence in crafting tailor-made applications through advanced Java , Python , and JavaScript development.

• AI-Driven Innovation demonstrated through the successful execution of GenAI implementations that catalyze significant business value and ROI.

• Life Sciences Insight with a nuanced perspective on Pharma customer journeys and highly regulated industry workflows.

What you get:

• Salary range 19 075-35 425 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subsidy available.

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice).

• Private healthcare (LuxMed pack

jobs.title: Technical Solution Management Associate
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Purpose of the role

Roche is the world’s largest biotech company, with truly differentiated medicines in oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, ophthalmology and diseases of the central nervous system. Roche is also the world leader in-vitro diagnostics and tissue-based cancer diagnostics, and a frontrunner in diabetes management.

The Diagnostics Insights Solutions Team is part of Roche Diagnostics . We focus on developing and commercialising larger solutions with multiple components (digital products, physical products, and service offerings) to create value beyond individual products by comprehensively addressing customer needs.

As a Technical Solution Management Associate you will act as a bridge between business needs and technical implementation of our solutions portfolio. You will work hand in hand with our team and different Solution Teams in the organization to support them with the automation of processes, contributing to the alignment with organizational objectives. Your main area of responsibility will be the application of Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence technologies to design and develop tailored tools to bring the end-to-end management of digital solutions to the next level.

Main responsibilities

As a Technical Solution Management Associate, your core responsibilities will include:

• Contribution to Ideation and Design: Actively participate in the ideation, analysis, and evaluation of solutions within the team's scope with the objective of optimizing processes and augmenting transparency and traceability with data.

• Process Optimization Tool Development: Identify opportunities for improvement and enhance solution management by leveraging data analytics and AI tools for diverse stakeholder groups (e.g., solution teams, affiliate members, or the broader organization). Additionally, identify inefficient processes and create tools to automate or streamline them.

• Team management (e.g. lean portfolio management, Aha! Automation, etc.)

• Technical solution management (e.g. requirements, version control,...)

• End-to-End solution management (e.g. coordination of solutions portfolio, traceability,...)

• Solution Lifecycle Management Support: Assisting with the administrative and documentation tasks related to the different stages of the lifecycle of complex software solutions.

• Reporting and Metrics Creation: Supporting the creation of data-driven tools to track the performance and adoption of key organizational solutions.

• Sustainable Development: Define the necessary maintenance and sustainability tasks to ensure the continued relevance and accuracy of the developed tools by e.g. enabling seamless retraining with new or updated training data.

How would your day to day look like?
As Technical Solution Management Associate in the Diagnostics Insights Solutions team, you'll work closely with our team members (Business Solution Managers and Technical Solution Managers) as well as cross-functional partners from across the organization. This role offers a great opportunity to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders, including product managers, marketing leads, definition teams, engineering teams and subject matter experts.

The successful candidate will play a dual role, handling management and administrative support tasks related to organizational solutions, while also developing and implementing tools to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our internal processes. jobs.title: Application Specialist - Molecular Solutions

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The application specialist is responsible for responding to customers’ needs and expectations with high quality scientific answers, to contribute to customer long term loyalty, ensuring immediate and proper scientific support to customers (incl. providing instrument training and troubleshooting, settlement of scientific problems and timely update on new methods, techniques and Product Bulletins), and documenting all calls, activities on the CRM System.

This is a field-based role.

Key Responsibilities:

• Provide high-level scientific support and operator training to customers.

• Handle all calls received from customers that relate to CPS and troubleshoot them to provide instant solutions to reagent and software problems due to customer complaints.

• Escalate unsolved cases to 2nd level support CIR, and/or GCS with complete case explanation.

• Ensure follow-up until the issue has been resolved and the customer is satisfied.

• Provide scientific documentation to customers.

• Document all his activities in Rexis/Lightning/ NFSS.

• Deliver best in class support utilizing appropriate systems and processes and providing a consistent and high level of support to customers.

• Continuing development of application skills to ensure resilience in the support of all CPS products.

• Proactively propose and implement activities aligned with customer satisfaction surveys and on-going customer and business area feedback.

• Ensure that all administration is completed in a timely and accurate manner and guarantee the activity reporting at the CRM (Rexis) software and appropriate escalation of product issues to management center and ensure that all administration is completed in a timely and accurate manner.

Who you are:

• B.S. Medical Laboratory Sciences, Chemistry, Histopathology, Biology or Biochemistry or work-related experience.

• Good knowledge and experience in pathology/molecular solutions - an advantage.

• Fluent in English (oral and written).

• Technical vocabulary & terminology.

• Advanced computer skills (Windows and Microsoft Office).

• Experience in laboratory practice and/or experience in the use of automated laboratory equipment (Roche instruments preferably).

• Experience in laboratory manual practice and chemicals handling.

• Verbal and written communication skills.

• Planning, administration and decision making.

• Work well in a team environment.

• Service/Customer oriented.

• Creativity & well critical thinking with a proactive mindset.

Who we are

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Analytics and Insights Lead - Partnering
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are driven by a shared ambition: to create a healthier future through continuous innovation, advancing science, and expanding access to healthcare for people worldwide. Our purpose is to help build a world where people can spend more time with those who matter most.

As healthcare continues to evolve, Global Procurement is transforming to deliver greater strategic value—enhancing supplier partnerships, driving innovation, and improving outcomes for patients and healthcare systems globally. By actively managing a complex supplier ecosystem, we ensure we meet today’s needs while anticipating those of tomorrow.

The Opportunity

As Analytics & Insights Business Partnering Lead , you will lead the strategic direction of Analytics within the Procurement Enablement chapter. This function is central to building a best-in-class Procurement organization through data-driven insights, governance, capability development, and digital innovation.

You will shape how data is leveraged across Global Procurement, unlocking its full potential to inform decision-making, drive performance, and create tangible business impact. Operating in a highly dynamic, global environment, you will guide teams to apply structured thinking, advanced Analytics, and actionable insights to complex business challenges.

Your Impact

In this leadership role, you will act as a strategic advisor and capability builder, working across Procurement, Finance, and cross-functional Analytics teams. You will lead, coach, and inspire others while delivering high-impact Analytics solutions and fostering a strong data-driven culture.

Key areas of accountability include:

• Setting the vision and strategy for Analytics and insights within business partnering, aligning with broader Global Procurement objectives

• Acting as a senior subject matter expert, guiding best practices in data strategy, Analytics, visualization, and insight generation

• Leading the development and continuous improvement of Analytics products, frameworks, and scalable solutions

• Influencing senior stakeholders to embed data-driven decision-making and improve data quality across the organization

• Building and developing high-performing teams, while contributing to cross-functional initiatives, squads, and enterprise-wide programs

• Championing innovation by identifying opportunities to leverage new technologies, methodologies, and ways of working

Who You Are

You are an experienced leader with a strong track record in Analytics, Procurement, and account management within complex, matrixed organizations. You bring both strategic vision and hands-on expertise, along with the ability to influence at the highest levels.

You will typically bring:

• A university degree (business, Analytics, or life sciences preferred)

• 10+ years of experience in Procurement, Analytics, business analysis, or management consulting

• Proven experience translating complex business challenges into scalable analytical solutions

• Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to influence and drive adoption of new strategies and technologies

• Deep expertise in data, visualization, and insight generation, combined with experience leading teams and initiatives

• Category management experience is highly advantageous

• Previous account management experience also desirable

• Fluency in English

• Leadership Mindset

You embody an enterprise mindset, thinking beyond functional boundaries to create integrated, customer-centric solu

jobs.title: Digital Measures Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED ) , we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

The Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence (CoE) is a global organisation enabling Roche’s Research and Early Development units (pRED and gRED) to become more data-driven, more digitally adept, and better prepared for the challenges of the future. Within the CoE, Computational Medicine focuses on developing and applying innovative data analysis solutions to support clinical development — furthering our understanding of disease, disease progression, and individual patient response to treatment. In partnership with our scientists across pRED and gRED, we create better medicines by augmenting every part of R&D through our data-driven culture.

As Digital Measures Lead , you will play a pivotal role in embedding sensor-based digital health technologies into the heart of our pRED and gRED drug development programs. jobs.title: Technical Development Leader (TDL) Large Molecules
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) is the organization that manufactures and delivers Roche’s groundbreaking therapies to 127 million patients around the world. PT is involved in producing every Roche medicine – from the development process through clinical trials – and continuing to product maturity. Our organization coordinates all aspects of production of Roche medicines in all disease areas and dosage forms.

Pharma Technical Development (PTD) is integral to Roche’s mission to develop innovative and transformative meaningful medicines for patients by applying leading technical expertise to design, develop, supply, and register clinical stage products globally.

The Opportunity
As a TDL, you will lead Technical Development Teams (TDTs) to develop and drive Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Control (CMC) strategies for clinical drug candidates from early human trials through product launch ensuring technical integrity and proactive risk mitigation.

• Leadership: Lead technical teams throughout the product lifecycle, from preclinical development to product launch, ensuring the scientific integrity of the CMC strategy.

• Strategy & Execution: Designs and implements multifaceted technical strategies - encompassing manufacturing processes, drug product and device configurations, and global supply chains - to ensure seamless regulatory approval and commercial success.

• Enterprise Alignment & Governance: Provides enterprise-level perspectives to ensure deliverables remain patient- and customer-focused; serves as a primary liaison to asset teams, senior management and governance committees, delivering transparent updates that facilitate informed decision-making.

• Operational Excellence: Oversees end-to-end CMC development, including financial stewardship, resource forecasting, and milestone tracking to ensure flawless execution.

• Risk & Decision Management: Drives informed decision-making for CMC investments and risk mitigation, developing robust contingency plans and proactively communicating potential impacts to relevant leadership and governance bodies.

Who You Are

• You are a recognized thought leader in CMC/product development with a proven ability to lead complex, high-stakes pharmaceutical projects.

• Education: B.S./M.S./Ph.D. in Chemistry, Pharmaceutics, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Technical Expertise: Extensive pharmaceutical industry experience, including a strong background in biologics process development and CMC team leadership.

• Strategic and Critical Thinking: Advanced understanding of the full drug development process with a history of successful innovation. Business acumen is a plus

• Program Management: Demonstrated ability to handle complex cross-functional programs while thinking strategically and proactively.

• Communication & Influence: Exceptional negotiation and verbal/written communication skills, with a track record of influencing senior management and third parties.

.
Are you ready to make a difference for our patients? We are looking forward to your application – join us now and become part of our journey!

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Basel. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.

jobs.title: Principal / Senior Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and life-changing medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CS CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organization leads the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems by integrating digital technologies across Research and Early Development to empower stakeholders, advance data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

The Solutions team within the DDC Organization develops modernized and interconnected computational and data ecosystems. The Data Ecosystem is foundational to building solutions that accelerate the work done by our Computational and Bench Scientists and enable ML/AI tool creation and adoption. Our team specializes in building Data Pipelines and Applications for data acquisition, collection, storage, transformation, linkage and sharing.

Join our Data and Digital Catalyst team as a Software Engineer, where you will develop the modernized and interconnected computational and data ecosystems that are foundational to our research. You'll build robust and scalable systems that unlock the potential of our diverse scientific data, directly accelerating the discovery and development of life-changing treatments for patients. This is a unique opportunity to empower our scientists and advance data-driven science through innovative technology.

The Opportunity

• Build and enhance a modern, scalable ecosystem of applications and tools to capture, move, and prepare scientific data for analysis.

• Design and deliver complex, user-friendly data applications and pipelines that integrate diverse data sets across key scientific domains.

jobs.title: PRACTICANTE DE TALLER
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras.

Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos.

Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

Como Practicante de taller , te unirás a nuestro equipo técnico para aprender sobre el mantenimiento de equipos de diagnóstico médico de vanguardia . Esta es una oportunidad única para desarrollar tus habilidades técnicas en un entorno ágil, colaborativo y con un impacto real en la salud de los pacientes .

Oportunidad

• Apoyas las actividades del taller, adquiriendo conocimientos profundos sobre equipos de diagnóstico médico y procesos de gestión .

• Realizas mantenimientos preventivos y correctivos bajo la supervisión del responsable del taller .

• Colaboras con los Ingenieros de Servicio de Campo (FSE) en la instalación y puesta a punto de analizadores Roche (Cobas y Sysmex) .

• Desarrollas aplicaciones para la mejora y automatización de proyectos y actividades internas del taller .

• Gestionas el soporte documentario para los procesos de importación de repuestos y materiales operativos .

• Aseguras el cumplimiento de procedimientos administrativos técnicos, incluyendo la preparación de reportes y manejo de software CRM .

• Participas activamente en los entrenamientos técnicos y sesiones de capacitación impartidas en el taller .

• Contribuyes a la organización de materiales, reactivos y periféricos necesarios para la continuidad del servicio al cliente .

Quien eres

• Eres egresado/a de las carreras de Ingeniería Electrónica, Mecatrónica, Biomédica o afines .

• Cuentas con un nivel de inglés intermedio que te permite comprender manuales técnicos .

• Posees un manejo intermedio de MS Office, con énfasis en el uso de Excel para gestión de datos .

• Te caracterizas por tu proactividad, capacidad de aprendizaje rápido y orientación al detalle .

• Eres una persona con habilidades para el trabajo en equipo y una fuerte ética profesional .

• Experiencia previa o conocimientos en gestión de laboratorios clínicos sería preferible mas no requerido.

Beneficios de reubicación no disponibles.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Es directamente responsable de entregar los mejores resultados para los pacientes, su comunidad, el ecosistema y la organización de una manera más rápida.

El objetivo de esta función es también colaborar con la comunidad científica y médica externa para proporcionar información clara, científicamente sólida, coherente y oportuna sobre nuestros productos, servicios y áreas de enfermedad, y recopilar información externa relevante para la estrategia general.

La Oportunidad

• El MEP es un rol clave dentro de la afiliada, que tiene las habilidades para identificar y superar barreras de acceso con el fin de tener un mayor impacto en el viaje del paciente.

• El MEP se enfoca en la importancia de traer y compartir insights trabajando de cerca con nuestros clientes para descubrir las oportunidades potenciales para transformar los resultados en salud para los pacientes, de forma más rápida. Comparte la experiencia, la ciencia y el conocimiento de Roche a los diferentes ecosistemas de salud.

• Participa y promueve el trabajo en red (Network) para agilizar, colaborar e innovar, así como atraer experiencia y recursos a nivel local.

• Procesa , analiza y proporciona información médica valiosa, tanto interna como externamente, de forma proactiva o basada en solicitudes.

• Trabajar de cerca con todos los actores que intervienen directamente en el manejo de la enfermedad (en un área terapéutica determinada), compartiendo con los Expertos de Áreas Terapéuticas (TAEs) un profundo y actualizado conocimiento sobre el manejo de la patología, información relacionada con los productos con FOCO EN PIPELINE acorde a los estándares de Roche y de las regulaciones locales, así como asociaciones de pacientes y otras partes interesadas.

• Comunica propuestas de valor a los diferentes grupos de interés para acelerar soluciones de acceso “One Roche”

• Brinda apoyo como experto en los ecosistemas locales, fomentando el trabajo multidisciplinario y el desarrollo de iniciativas OneRoche que apoyen el desarrollo de la estrategia de una Medicina Integral y Personalizada.

• Asegura de que las consultas de información médica cumplan con los estándares de calidad, las políticas y los SOP de Roche, y satisfagan las necesidades del cliente.

• Asegura de que los departamentos de Farmacovigilancia y Calidad tengan información oportuna sobre los informes de eventos adversos y quejas de calidad, y realizar las conciliaciones requeridas por estos departamentos.

• Participa de forma significativa con las comunidades globales y regionales pertinentes, participando activamente (compartiendo experiencias y participando en grupos de trabajo) y defendiendo el valor de las redes y la colaboración.

• Trabaja en conjunto con el Squad y el área de RWE en la identificación de Gaps de evidencia local para co-crear con los actores de los ecosistemas soluciones que puedan cubrir los gaps para mejorar el acceso y la atención personalizada de los pacientes y lograr que se generen publicaciones

• Cuenta con entendimiento profundo del ecosistema médico (médico tratante, tomadores de decisión en instituciones públicas y privadas, asociaciones médicas y de pacientes) para encontrar oportunidades y moldearlo, facilitando que más pacientes reciban mejores solucion

titleByLocale.it: Scientist/Ingegnere - Chemistry & Fluidic Systems Integration, Next-Gen Sequencing Workflows, Ricerca & Early Development

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are working to make next-generation sequencing simple and accessible enough for routine use. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. Our Systems Technology Group, a part of Roche Sequencing Solutions, is focused on creating and advancing technologies to significantly enhance DNA sequencing workflows.

We are seeking a hands-on Chemistry & Fluidic Systems Integration Scientist/Engineer to serve as a key contributor in chemistry and biology. Joining our current team of talented scientists and engineers, you will help bridge the gap between complex molecular biology, physical chemistry and cutting-edge microfluidic instrumentation and consumables.

The ideal candidate will thrive at this intersection, actively porting and translating complex workflows onto novel systems during the earliest stages of research and development. You will be responsible for rigorously testing new concepts, performing complex assays, troubleshooting integrated subsystems, and optimizing overall performance based on first principles.

Your Role and Responsibilities:

• You will contribute to efforts to translate, test, and optimize complex, multi-step chemical and molecular biology workflows (e.g., purification, synthesis, library prep, target enrichment, amplification, and sequencing) on early-stage microfluidic systems.

• You will support the selection, formulation, and optimization of buffers, surfactants, coatings and critical additives. You will leverage your understanding of the distinct purpose of each reagent to maintain efficiency and optimize chemical and enzymatic reactions within microfluidic or closed-system environments.

• You will design and execute rigorous experiments using statistical methods to characterize system performance, solving potentially complex problems by analyzing possible solutions using experience, judgment, and precedents.

• You will conduct early-stage troubleshooting for complex performance issues on novel systems. You will connect systemic failures such as leaks, null results, or surface fouling back to first-principles root causes, whether molecular, chemical, material, or physical.

• You will act as a technical resource for colleagues with less experience, serving as a go-to person for explaining complex molecular biology and sequencing chemistry concepts to a team of talented engineers.

• You will analyze complex, multi-modal data sets and serve as a key technical partner to both assay development scientists and hardware design engineers. You will provide data-driven feedback to guide the co-development of reagents, consumables, and instrument hardware.

A cover letter is required for this application. Please outline your relevant experience and explain why you are interested in this role and our company.

This is an on-site position based in Santa Clara, CA.
Relocation benefits are not being offered for this role.

Who You Are (Required):

• You have a PhD in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biophysics, Molecular Biology, Bioengineering, Biomedical Engineering (or a closely related discipline) with 3+ years of relevant industry experience; OR a Master's degree in one of the above disciplines with 5+ years of relevant industry experience; OR a Bachelor's degree with 7+ years of relevant industry experience.

Joining our current team of talented scientists and engineers, you will help bridge the gap between complex molecular biology, physical chemistry and cutting-edge microfluidic instrumentation and consumables.

The ideal candidate will thrive at this intersection, actively porting and translating complex workflows onto novel systems during the earliest stages of research and development. You will be responsible for rigorously testing new concepts, performing complex assays, troubleshooting integrated subsystems, and optimizing overall performance based on first principles.

• You will analyze complex, multi-modal data sets and serve as a key technical partner to both assay development scientists and hardware design engineers. You will provide data-driven feedback to guide the co-development of reagents, consumables, and instrument hardware.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst - Quote Management
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Business Analyst , you will independently manage end-to-end workstreams, tackling complex business problems with emerging ambiguity to drive Quote Management initiatives and Diagnostics commercial launches . You will act as a trusted advisor to leadership and Diagnostics affiliate commercial teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives and translating requirements into strategic implementation plans . Join us to lead the design of effective solutions and shape best practices within our global digital landscape .

Description of the area
The Quote Management team is part of DIA Commercial Operations, a strategic global function within Roche Digital Technology (RDT) and is at the heart of our Diagnostics digital landscape. We are responsible for developing, globally rolling out, and continuously evolving technology solutions that enhance the experience of healthcare providers and patients. Serving as a link between global business units - such as Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), Roche Information Solutions (RIS), and Commercial Enablement - and their operational goals, we design the digital architecture that enables Roche to scale its impact across APAC, EMEA/LATAM, and NAM.

The Opportunity:

• Drive Strategic Delivery : Act as the RDT delivery lead for Quote Management initiatives and enable high-impact commercial product launches across global markets .

• Orchestrate End-to-End Workstreams : Autonomously manage complex BA workstreams from discovery to implementation while navigating high-ambiguity environments .

• Translate Business Needs : Gather complex requirements and translate them into clear, actionable user stories and robust technical solution designs in partnership with Architects .

• Execute System Rollouts : Take ownership of system functional definitions and execute complex configurations to drive successful regional rollouts .

• Serve as a Trusted Advisor : Facilitate high-level workshops to shape strategy and resolve complex stakeholder conflicts, aligning regional expectations with global roadmaps .

• Optimize Solution Value : Contribute to long-term solution roadmaps and ensure every initiative delivers demonstrable business value and technical scalability .

• Bridge Technical Gaps : Act as the direct technical liaison between affiliate business stakeholders and offshore managed services to ensure seamless execution .

• Ensure Quality Excellence : Define clear acceptance criteria and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate that solutions meet rigorous business standards .

Who you are:

• Experienced Professional : Proven track record of managing complex BA workstreams independently, driving regional rollouts in the APAC region, and making localization system configurations. You bring 7+ years of Business Analysis experience managing end-to-end IT workstreams, including 4+ years in MedTech or Healthcare Life Sciences .

• Domain Expert : You possess deep functional and technical knowledge of the Quote-to-Contract (Q2C) and Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) commercial sales domains .

• Technically Proficient : You have hands-on experience with Conga CPQ and Salesforce (SFDC) , with familiarity in Jira and SAP S/4HANA (ASPIRE) .

• Academic Background : You hold a Bachelor’s or Advanced Degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field .

• Agile Practitioner : You have practical knowledge of Agile frameworks (Scrum/SAFe); professional certifications like CBAP or IIBA AAC are highly preferre

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You will be :

• Process Account receivable, treasury and inter-company task as per Service level Agreement. Process all cash application and remittance reconciliation for assigned countries accurately and within specific timescales. Prepare and follow up unidentified open items in clearing account when execute daily/monthly bank reconciliation.

• Liaise with the stakeholder for preparation and transaction posting of Inter-company non trade related debit and credit notes. Preparation of monthly reconciliation, highlight and rectify anomalies encountered. Generate statement of accounts to the customers. Track and resolve disputes and route to local affiliates as and when required

• Attend to all matters requested for accounts receivable when required. Initiate the dunning process and generate reminders for overdue accounts. Prepare regularly the details of unallocated and unidentified receipts for stakeholder further actions. Execute month end, quarter end and year end closing activities for countries assigned. Manage Cash pool account reconciliation

• Prepare preliminary and final Inter-company Account Receivable balances to reconcile against counterparty balances. Ensure timely and accurate deal settlement and posting of treasury related transactions including Inter-company foreign exchange, loan, accrual and actual interest, bank charges and etc.Creation and maintenance of the customer master data records in system. Credit management – Perform and responsible for credit analysis on customer according to company credit policy and procedures. Reviewing credit risk for new and existing customers by carry out credit worthless checks and make credit limit recommendation.

• Collection management – Ensure customers pay within agreed payment terms, contacting sales team and customer on collection activities if necessary as per company’s debt collection procedure.. Demonstrated good customer service skills while initiating outbound calls and received inbound calls with customer. Handling of AR bad debt allowance and write off management. First point of contact for operational support and issue solving Liaise with customer for balance confirmation and monitoring of daily sales order status.

Who you are

• Ensure all work documentation and work processes are updated and meet with Internal Control Financial Reporting (ICFR), group policies and guidelines, local statutory and legal requirements within agreed service timelines.

• Perform back up function and other duties, including job rotation to other functional teams as and when required. Participate in internal and external compliance audit queries

• Transformation/ Continuous Improvement Implementations : Work collaboratively with Country Chief Accountant and stakeholders. Engage and support the teams in the implementation of continuous improvement project

• Proactively to identify, recommend and implement solutions in consultation with the management for continuous improvement opportunities in the areas of operation

• Assist to ensure effective knowledge transfer as for sustainable development knowledge and sharing of best practices within the team

​

Thank you for your application. Please take note that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Bei Roche können Sie so sein, wie Sie sind – mit all den einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönliche Entfaltung, offene Dialoge und aufrichtige Beziehungen. Hier werden Sie für die Person, die Sie sind, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert, sodass Sie sich persönlich und beruflich entfalten können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Mensch heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werde Teil von DS Clinical & Commercial Supply, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position:

• Die Abstimmung des Projektportfolios mit den Kapazitäten und Fähigkeiten von DS Clinical & Commercial Supply ist die Kernaufgabe

• Als Projekt-Liaison sind Sie die primäre Kontaktperson für Projekte aus Forschung und Entwicklung (REDs), Einlizensierungen sowie für lokale und globale Planungsrollen und -gremien. In Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholdern wie Synthetic Molecule Technical Development, Galenik, Regulatory und Quality gewährleisten Sie, dass die jeweiligen Projektziele abgestimmt sind.

• Sie übernehmen die Leitung für strategische Projektplanung & Machbarkeit und führen somit die langfristige strategische Planung aus, insbesondere eine 5-Jahres-Ausblicks für Betriebsanlagen und Personal, sowie Durchführung von Machbarkeitsstudien sowie Kapazitätsbewertungen.

• In der Rolle des Ressourcenkoordinators stimmen Sie Ressourcen in Kollaboration mit den Sektionen innerhalb von DS Clinical & Commercial Supply ab und überwachen die Planung innerhalb der Abteilung.

• Sie fungieren als Fachexperte und Berater für Herstellungsprozesse und/oder -anlagen und stellen Ihr Fachwissen zur Lösung komplexer technischer Probleme sowie strategischer Fragestellungen bereit. Sie leiten komplexe Untersuchungen, identifizieren Ursachen und implementieren wirksame Korrektur- und Vorbeugemaßnahmen.

• Als Mentor und Coach unterstützen Sie unsere Mitarbeiter bei deren kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung ihrer beruflichen Fähigkeiten und Kenntnisse.

• Treten Sie als treibende Kraft für kontinuierliche Verbesserung auf , indem Sie innovative Lösungen zur Prozessoptimierung und Produktivitätssteigerung identifizieren, Lean-Prinzipien und digitale Lösungen zur Verbesserung der Abläufe nutzen und implementieren.

• Fungieren Sie als Matrix-Lead , welcher die strategische Planung und Zielsetzung der Abteilung gestaltet und der einen starken Teamgeist und eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit, Dringlichkeit sowie der hohen Motivation fördert, um diese Ziele zu erreichen.

Wer Sie sind:

• Sie haben einen Abschluss in Chemie oder Chemieingenieurwesen und mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung in der Prozesschemie für synthetische Moleküle.

• Sie besitzen fundierte Kenntnisse in der chemischen Synthese, chemischen Prozesstechnologien und der Produktion in einer cGMP-Umgebung.

• Als technischer Experte verstehen Sie es, Teams in einer Matrixorganisation zu motivieren und einen starken Zusammenhalt zu schaffen, um gemeinsam erfolgreich zu sein.

• Ihre Stärken liegen in der Zusammenarbeit: Sie pflegen ausgezeichnete Beziehungen zu Stakeholdern und navigieren geschickt durch Verhandlungen und funktionsübergreifende Projekte.

• Sie sind ein aktiver Impulsgeber für den Wandel, der eine flexible und offene Kultur für neue Möglichkeiten schafft.

• Sie sind eine treibende Kraft für kontinuierliche Verbesserung und packen neue Herausforderungen mit Leidenschaft an.

• Sie kommunizieren fliessend in Deuts
