jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:

• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:

•
• M.D. Required

• Therapeutic knowledge within metabolism, obesity, and diabetes with relevant clinical, scientific, and clinical trial/development experience required

• Academic/teaching background is a plus

• Experience working with the principles and techniques of data analysis, interpretation, and clinical relevance

• Experience publishing results of a scientific study in a peer-reviewed journal is preferred

• Regulatory: Knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA, and other relevant guidelines and regulations is preferred

• Duration of Experience: 2 or more years of post-graduate academic or clinical experience

• Up to 30% global travel

Key Skills and Behaviours

• Ethics: Has impeccable ethics. Demonstrates, or proven ability to demonstrate, Roche Values

• Attention to detail: Outstanding attention to detail

• Business Acumen: Has working knowledge of the pharma/biotech industry, the multiple functions and roles involved in the drug development process. Regularly leads development of disease strategies and plans

• Organization: Can prioritize multiple tasks and goals on time, on target, and within budget

• Interpersonal skills : Good interpersonal, verbal communication and influencing skills: can influence without authority

• Writing: Strong written communication skills

• Presentation skills: Good business presentation skills; is comfortable and effective when presenting to others, internally or externally.Confident and competent when interacting with others internally and externally: stays focused and on-point, is able to raise problems or challenges in a productive and mature manner

• Negotiation Skills : Good negotiation skills: knows how to complete deliverables by working effectively with others internally and externally

• Decision Making: Knows how to make trade-off decisions while balancing ethics and efficacy

• Teamwork: Strong orientation to teamwork

CDP Strategy and Planning

• Participates in development of the CD plan for assigned molecule(s)/indication(s)

• Gathers and analyzes data and information necessary to create the CD plan

• Works with other CST members and relevant sub-teams to develop CD plan components (e.g., analytics/data strategy, KOL development, publications strategy, etc.)

jobs.title: Instandhaltungsplaner (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Der Bereich “Pharma Site Services“ der Roche Pharma ist am Standort Basel/Kaiseraugst der zentraler Partner für die unterschiedlichsten Funktionen: von Group Functions über Forschung, Entwicklung bis zu Produktion und Versand. Wir erbringen Services die unseren Standort pulsierend und attraktiv machen, die zeigen, dass wir das inspirierendste Unternehmen in der Schweiz sind. Wir gestalten massgeschneiderte Lösungen und betreiben Gebäude, Infrastruktur, Anlagen und halten diese Instand.

Wir haben diese Services in Kreisen (Circles) organisiert. Der Circle «Asset Lifecycle Management - Concepts & Strategies » gestaltet am Standort Basel und Kaiseraugst das Umfeld für eine maximale Wertschöpfung von Anlagen mit dem Ziel eine möglichst hohe „Anlagenrendite“ zu erwirtschaften.

Als Instandhaltungsplaner entwickelst Du gemeinsam mit dem Betreiber und dem Projekt Engineering Instandhaltungsstrategien, -konzepte und bildest diese in unseren Systemen SAP S/4 Hana ab.

Du bist maßgeblich für die Standardisierung, Einhaltung von Methoden und die Pflege von Instandhaltungs- und Kalibrier-Stammdaten zuständig. Du sicherst und förderst eine hohe Datenqualität, behebst Probleme mit Daten und ihren Quellen.

Die Möglichkeit:

• Du agierst als Key User und Hauptverantwortlicher für die Stammdaten. Du pflegst und genehmigst Anlagenstammdaten im SAP S/4 Hana (inklusive Tasklisten und Prüfplänen) und prüfst als letzte Instanz die Einhaltung der vereinbarten Standards und Naming Conventions.

• Du bist der primäre Ansprechpartner für Instandhaltungs- und Kalibrierprozesse und berätst mit Deiner Fachexpertise für Instandhaltung und Datenmanagement die unterschiedlichen Kundengruppen in Produktion, Forschung und Infrastruktur am Standort Basel und Kaiseraugst.

• Du prüfst die Qualität der Daten und behebst Datenintegritäts- oder -konsistenzprobleme gezielt in den Workflows.

• Du analysierst Daten aus unterschiedlichen Quellen und leitest kontinuierliche Verbesserungsmaßnahmen zur Datenqualität ab. So schaffst Du die Basis verlässlicher Daten, um lokale und globale Asset Lifecycle Management Initiativen voranzutreiben.

• Du entwickelst Instandhaltungsstrategien, legst diese fest und bildest sie in den Systemen ab.

• Du hinterfragst den Status Quo sachlich-kritisch und gehst neue Wege in der Instandhaltung.

Wer Du bist
Du bist eine positiv denkende, integre und selbstreflektierende Persönlichkeit mit starken Team-Fähigkeiten. In diesem Sinne bringst du eine offene und kollaborative Einstellung und Denkweise mit, die es für die erfolgreiche Arbeit in deinem Team und bereichsübergreifend benötigt. Du vertraust dir und anderen, übernimmst Verantwortung und lebst eine offene Speak-Up- und Fehlerkultur. Deine lösungsorientierte Grundhaltung und Can-Do Einstellung bestimmt dein tägliches Handeln und stellt den Kunden in den Mittelpunkt.

Als Instandhaltungsplaner und Experte für Stammdaten hast Du bereits fundierte Berufserfahrung mit der Instandhaltung von verfahrenstechnischen Anlagen und Packaged Units sammeln können, idealerweise in der pharmazeutischen (GxP-regulierten) oder einer ähnlich streng regulierten Industrie..

Du verstehst die Konzepte der Datenmodellierung, gehst sicher mit mit dem Data Warehouse um und hast gute technische Dokumentationsfähigkeiten. Die hohe Qualität von Daten ist das Fundament robuster Instandhaltungs- und Kalibrierprozesse. Du lebst kontinuierliche Verbesserung, Erfahrung mit SAP S/4 Hana runden Dein Profil ab.

Im Umgang mit globalen Schnittstellen

jobs.title: Logistics Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Logistics Engineer / Project Manager leads the technical evolution and modernization of our 10,000m2 self-operated distribution center. This role is the strategic architect responsible for transforming a complex, legacy-automated environment into a flexible, next-generation fulfillment hub using AMR and advanced robotics.
You will bridge the gap between physical hardware and digital systems, managing the transition from a legacy software stack (WMS/WCS/MFC) to a modern SAP eWM environment. Reporting directly to the Head of Supply Chain, you will own the technical roadmap, from ROI analysis and vendor selection participation to on-site project execution lead, ensuring our automation strategy aligns with future business scalability.

Your Main Responsibilities

• Creation of holistic view of warehouse operations in terms of automation technology, system landscape and warehouse operator needs. Full understanding & documentation of current bottlenecks in terms of throughput and storage capacity. Create suitable measurements (KPIs) where needed in order to translate requirements and current capacities.

• Automation Transformation & Strategy: Assess and lead the transition from rigid legacy automation to flexible technologies (AMRs, Humanoids, etc.) where required. Take full stock of existing hardware capabilities and map them against future business requirements and market-leading solutions.

• Systems Architecture & Integration: Fully master the current system landscape (WMS, WCS, MFC). Design the integration strategy to link the physical world with the digital world, acting as the lead for the upcoming SAP eWM implementation.

• Financial Stewardship & ROI: Drive rigorous ROI analysis for all automation projects collaborating with finance and site management. Have clear visibility for throughput, storage density, and FTE optimization.

• Material Flow & Process Optimization: Analyze and redesign internal material flows to eliminate bottlenecks. Use data-driven insights to optimize picking strategies, replenishment cycles, and packing efficiency. Processes are redesigned considering sustainability, quality and safety aspects.

• Project Governance: Act as the on-site Project Lead for major technical and system shifts. Manage the end-to-end lifecycle—from concept and vendor assessment to commissioning and structured handover—ensuring minimal disruption to active operations. Interact with global and local project teams.

• Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Partner with site management to assess new vendors and technologies. Navigate the complex relationship between legacy hardware providers and modern robotics OEMs, ensuring system interoperability.

• Technical Communication: Adapt complex technical concepts for different audiences (“zoom in & out”). Clearly articulate the "why" behind automation shifts to senior leadership while providing granular technical direction to on-site maintenance and IT teams.

• Performance Tracking: Define and monitor KPIs for automated systems, including uptime, cycle times, and error rates. Lead corrective actions when performance gaps occur in the automated flow.

Who You Are

• An Analytical Problem Solver: You enjoy the challenge of making legacy systems perform in a modern context. You take ambiguity and uncertainty as an opportunity to bring up proposals.

• A Strategic Executor: You can design a 3-year automation roadmap but are equally willing to be on the warehouse floor during a "Go-Live" to troubleshoot o

jobs.title: Territory Manager | Individual Contributor (Bangalore)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Territory Manager based in Bangalore , you will play a crucial role in driving sales, Doctor Promotion, retail promotion, managing distribution networks, and executing sales promotion plans for your territory. You will ensure our products penetration in the assigned market effectively by supporting distributors, gathering market insights, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM) to achieve our business goals.

The Opportunity

• Promote pharmaceutical products to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) through scientific communication, relationship building, product detailing, and ethical marketing to increase product awareness and prescriptions.

• You assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials.

• You prepare and execute monthly sales promotion plans—including field activation and merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy.

• You ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the market.

• You manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones.

• You motivate distributors and dealers through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes.

• You organize distributor and dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies, and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups.

• You act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your customer visits.

Who You Are

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field.

• You have proven practical experience in field sales, distribution management, or a territory management role.

• You have a strong interest in driving market growth, with a focus on relationship building, demand generation, and executing marketing strategies.

• You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Doctors, Chemist & dealer interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings.

• You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/Weekly/Monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections.

• You are comfortable with field travel within the Bangalore territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other

jobs.title: Instandhaltungsplaner & Master Data Quality Steward (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Der Bereich “Pharma Site Services“ der Roche Pharma ist am Standort Basel/Kaiseraugst der zentraler Partner für die unterschiedlichsten Funktionen: von Group Functions über Forschung, Entwicklung bis zu Produktion und Versand. Wir erbringen Services die unseren Standort pulsierend und attraktiv machen, die zeigen, dass wir das inspirierendste Unternehmen in der Schweiz sind. Wir gestalten massgeschneiderte Lösungen und betreiben Gebäude, Infrastruktur, Anlagen und halten diese Instand.

Wir haben diese Services in Kreisen (Circles) organisiert. Der Circle «Asset Lifecycle Management - Concepts & Strategies » gestaltet am Standort Basel und Kaiseraugst das Umfeld für eine maximale Wertschöpfung von Anlagen mit dem Ziel eine möglichst hohe „Anlagenrendite“ zu erwirtschaften.

Als Instandhaltungsplaner entwickelst Du gemeinsam mit dem Betreiber und dem Projekt Engineering Instandhaltungsstrategien, -konzepte und bildest diese in unseren Systemen SAP S/4 Hana ab.

Als Master Data Quality Steward liegt Deine Hauptverantwortung im Bereich der Kalibrierung. Du bist maßgeblich für die Standardisierung, Einhaltung von Methoden und die prozessuale Qualitätssicherung der Kalibrierstammdaten zuständig. Du sicherst und förderst eine hohe Datenqualität, behebst Probleme mit Daten und ihren Quellen und gewährleistest effiziente, standardisierte sowie integrative Prozesse für kalibrierrelevante Stammdaten (Master Data Management).

Die Möglichkeit:

• Du agierst als Key User und Hauptverantwortlicher für die Kalibrierstammdaten. Du pflegst und genehmigst Anlagenstammdaten im SAP S/4 Hana (inklusive Kalibrier-Tasklisten und Prüfplänen) und prüfst als letzte Instanz die Einhaltung der vereinbarten Standards und Naming Conventions.

• Du bist der primäre Ansprechpartner für Kalibrierprozesse und berätst mit Deiner Fachexpertise für Kalibrieren und Datenmanagement die unterschiedlichen Kundengruppen in Produktion, Forschung und Infrastruktur am Standort Basel und Kaiseraugst.

• Du stellst die systemtechnische Abgrenzung im Kalibrierbereich sicher, identifizierst Datenquellen, prüfst die Qualität der Daten und behebst Datenintegritäts- oder -konsistenzprobleme gezielt in den Kalibrier-Workflows.

• Du dokumentierst Datenquellen, verknüpfst Informationen, betreibst dediziertes Qualitätsreporting für den Kalibrierbereich und pflegst relevante KPIs.

• Du analysierst Daten aus unterschiedlichen Quellen und leitest kontinuierliche Verbesserungsmaßnahmen zur Datenqualität ab. So schaffst Du die Basis verlässlicher Daten, um lokale und globale Asset Lifecycle Management Initiativen voranzutreiben.

• Du entwickelst Kalibrierstrategien, legst diese fest und bildest sie in den Systemen ab.

• Du hinterfragst den Status Quo sachlich-kritisch und gehst neue Wege in der Kalibrierung.

Wer Du bist
Du bist eine positiv denkende, integre und selbstreflektierende Persönlichkeit mit starken Team-Fähigkeiten. In diesem Sinne bringst du eine offene und kollaborative Einstellung und Denkweise mit, die es für die erfolgreiche Arbeit in deinem Team und bereichsübergreifend benötigt. Du vertraust dir und anderen, übernimmst Verantwortung und lebst eine offene Speak-Up- und Fehlerkultur. Deine lösungsorientierte Grundhaltung und Can-Do Einstellung bestimmt dein tägliches Handeln und stellt den Kunden in den Mittelpunkt.

Als Instandhaltungsplaner und Experte für Stammdaten hast Du bereits fundierte Berufserfahrung mit der Instandhaltung und Kalibrierung von verfahrenstechnischen Anlagen und Packaged Uni

jobs.title: (Lead/Senior) Medical Director - Neurodegeneration
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
GENERAL POSITION SUMMARY AND PURPOSE:
Roche’s Clinical Development organization is structured by therapeutic area and is responsible for developing and executing the late development (Phase II – III) clinical strategies and plans that deliver medically-differentiated therapies that provide meaningful improvement to patients.
The Lead Medical Director leads or makes major contributions to development of the Clinical Development (CD) strategy and plan and is responsible for effective and efficient execution for the assigned molecule(s)/indication(s).
Lead Medical Directors are expected to perform their responsibilities with more independence by comparison to Medical Directors.
EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:

• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:

• M.D. Required

• Relevant clinical, scientific, or clinical trial/development experience in same/similar therapeutic area required

• Academic/teaching background is a plus

• Significant experience working with the principles and techniques of data analysis, interpretation, and clinical relevance

• Experience publishing results of a scientific study in a peer-reviewed journal is preferred

• Significant pharma/biotech industry experience OR is a recognized expert in the field

• Significant experience designing and conducting clinical trials (i.e. one or more trials)

• Experience authoring a global development plan is preferred

• Understanding of Phase II – III drug development

• Knowledge and understanding of Phase I & IV drug development is a plus

• Understanding of product and safety profiles

• Regulatory: Knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA, and other relevant guidelines and regulations is required

• 4 or more years pharma/biotech industry experience OR is a recognized local expert in the field (e.g Assistant Professor or equivalent)

• Up to 30% global travel

Key Skills and Behaviours

• Ethics: Has impeccable ethics. Demonstrates, or proven ability to demonstrate, Roche Values

• Attention to detail: Outstanding attention to detail

• Is regarded as knowledgeable in his/her field, is respected by others, can effectively contribute to longer-range drug development, and can lead cross-functional teams to successful results

• Business Acumen: Has sound knowledge of the pharma/biotech industry, the multiple functions and roles involved in the drug development process.

• Organization: Can prioritize multiple tasks and goals on time, on target, and within budget

• Interpersonal skills: Strong interpersonal, verbal communication and influencing skills: can influence without authority and has proven experience building and cultivating relationships with key partners and stakeholders, both internally and externally

• Writing: Outstanding written communication skills

• Presentation skills: Strong business presentation skills: effective at summarizing and presenting the key considerations and decision-points.Confident and competent when interacting with others internally and externally: stays focused and on-point, is able to raise problems or challenges in a productive and mature manner

• Negotiation Skills: Strong negotiation skills: can effectively drive discussions and decisions toward desired end-results

• Decision Making: Makes good business decisions and exercises sound judgment. Balances decisions with imperatives for ethics and efficacy. Able to mak

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

Are you a visionary leader passionate about shaping the future of Patient Safety? In this pivotal role, you will lead and manage the PV Regional Center, ensuring the delivery of high-quality pharmacovigilance (PV) and Device Vigilance activities across the Europe, Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EEMEA) region. You will be at the forefront of driving operational excellence, upholding regulatory compliance, and integrating regional clinical safety activities in a complex, global environment.
Working in partnership with Affiliate Patient Safety and Global Leadership, you will contribute to the broader Patient Safety Operations (PSO) strategy. Your leadership will ensure that our safety processes are not only compliant but also innovative, leveraging data-driven insights and digital transformation to protect patients worldwide.

• Lead and inspire a multi-site regional team , acting as a catalyst for a quality- and customer-centric culture.

• Oversee the operationalization of safety processes to ensure full compliance with global Roche standards and local regulations.

• Drive continuous improvement and innovation by embedding technological advances like AI and digital analytics into safety operations.

• Ensure inspection and audit readiness for all regional activities, maintaining a robust business continuity plan.

• Collaborate with cross-functional partners to integrate regionalized clinical safety activities and achieve shared global objectives.

• Foster a culture of growth and empowerment , adopting the VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) leadership style to develop future talent.

• Represent the PV function with external parties, including regulators, ensuring Roche’s reputation for excellence remains unmatched.

Who You Are
You are a strategic thinker and a servant leader who thrives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. You possess a deep understanding of the pharmaceutical landscape and are motivated by the opportunity to lead large-scale operational changes that have a real impact on patient lives.

• You hold a Health Care Professional Degree (Medical, Pharmacy, or equivalent professional experience).

• You bring 10+ years of pharmaceutical experience , with at least 5 years in significant PV leadership roles.

• You have a proven track record in managing multi-country or regional operations within a large, complex organization.

• You are a VACC leader , committed to inclusive behaviors and developing high-performing, diverse teams.

• You possess deep technical expertise in GVP, ICH-GCP, and global regulatory requirements (FDA/EMA).

• You are an exceptional communicator , able to influence stakeholders and convey complex information clearly in English.

• You have a growth mindset , eager to experiment with new technologies and take smart risks to improve operational efficiency.

Location: This position is based in Budapest. Relocation Assistance is not available

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s

• Formation niveau Bac +3 ou équivalent en spécialisation informatique et réseaux.

• Double compétence « biologie / informatique médicale » ou une expérience professionnelle dans l’environnement du laboratoire d’analyses médicales ou d’un éditeur de logiciel SIL (Système Informatique de Laboratoire), Middleware, Application médicale est un atout.

• Capacité à installer et configurer les différents composants (systèmes d’exploitation, réseaux, applicatif) des infrastructures informatiques.

• Anglais professionnel

• Permis B (mobilité territoriale indispensable).

jobs.title: R&D AI Transformation Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Overview

Are you interested in how software R&D organizations evolve to integrate AI and stay ahead in a changing technological landscape? We are looking for a high-energy, detail-oriented R&D AI Transformation Intern to join our strategy team.
You won't just be fetching coffee; you’ll be behind the scenes of major structural, cultural, and digital shifts as we embed AI into our engineering DNA, helping us bridge the gap between "traditional development" and "AI-augmented innovation."

Key Responsibilities

• Data Analysis & Insights: Gather and analyze R&D performance metrics and AI tool adoption rates to identify bottlenecks and track the progress of ongoing AI transformation initiatives.

• Stakeholder Communication: Assist in drafting internal memos, newsletters, and presentation decks that translate complex AI strategies and LLM implementations into "human" language for our developers and engineers.

• Project Management Support: Maintain project timelines (Gantt charts) and follow up on action items from cross-functional workshops focused on AI integration and automated workflows.

• Research: Conduct competitive benchmarking and research best practices in AI-assisted coding, machine learning operations (MLOps), and organizational design for AI-first R&D teams.

• Workshop Facilitation: Help organize and document brainstorming sessions aimed at improving software delivery pipelines through AI and boosting developer engagement with new intelligent tools.

What We’re Looking For

• Curiosity: A genuine interest in the intersection of software business strategy, AI ethics, and engineering culture.

• Communication: The ability to explain a complex technical AI concept or strategic shift simply and clearly.

• Agility: Comfort with ambiguity—navigating the rapid evolution of AI in R&D is rarely a straight line!

• Tech Savvy: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (data visualization) and PowerPoint (storytelling), with an interest in exploring AI productivity tools.

• Academic Background: Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.

Why Join Us?

This isn't your typical administrative internship. You will gain a "bird's-eye view" of how a software R&D organization operates at scale and learn the methodologies used to drive meaningful change in the age of AI.
If you're a problem-solver who loves to see the big picture in a high-tech environment, we’d love to have you on board.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

한국로슈진단은 고객 중심의 영업 활동 을 통해 진단 분야의 혁신적인 가치를 전달하며, 시장 리더십을 강화할 영업 전문가를 찾고 있습니다.

Responsibilities

1. 고객 관리

• 기존 고객사를 관리하고 유지하며 매출 증대

• 신규 고객사 발굴 및 개발

2. 대리점 관리

• 대리점과 협력하여 매출 목표 달성

• 대리점 재고 모니터링 및 관리

• 제품 교육 실시

• 대리점 영업 활동 지원

3. 마케팅 및 영업 활동

• 월별/분기별 및 연간 매출 목표 달성

• 신규 장비 설치

• 기존 장비에 신규 제품 추가

4. 기술 지원

• 장비 및 시약 관련 고객 문의 및 요청사항 응대

Who you are

• 학사 학위 이상 또는 이에 준하는 학력 (신입 ~ 경력 7년 이하 선호)

• 체외진단(IVD)에 대한 이해 및 지식 보유 선호

• 고객지향적 사고 및 커뮤니케이션 능력

• 비지니스 영어 구사 능력

Submission
자유 양식의 국/영문 이력서 및 국/영문 자기소개서 (하나의 MS Word 혹은 PDF 파일로 제출)
※ 이력서 상단에 반드시 현재 연봉과 희망 연봉을 표기하시기 바랍니다. 누락 시 이력서가 검토되지 않습니다.
※ 이력서 내 이메일 주소와 서류전형 지원 사이트의 입력하시는 이메일 주소를 반드시 동일하게 작성해주시기 바랍니다.
※ 국가보훈대상 및 장애인은 관련 서류 제출시 관련 법규에 의거 우대합니다.
※ 이력서에 개인민감정보 (신체적 조건, 출신 지역, 혼인 여부, 가족관계 등)는 기재하지 말아주십시오.
※ 입사 지원 서류에 허위 사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후 라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.

Process
서류 전형▶ 면접 전형 ▶ 종합 심사 ▶ 최종 합격 통지
※ 면접은 서류전형 합격자에 한해 개별 통보합니다.
※ 면접 일정 안내 및 조율을 위해 해외 번호(중국)로 연락이 갈 수 있는 점 미리 안내드립니다.
※채용이 유력한 후보자에 대해서 이력 검증 및 평판 조회, 건강검진 등의 종합심사를 진행하여 최종 합격자를 선정합니다.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Eine gesündere Zukunft. Mit dieser Vision im Blick leistet Roche Pionierarbeit im Gesundheitswesen. Dabei gründet sich unser Erfolg auf Innovation, Neugier und Vielfalt – und darauf, dass wir unsere Unterschiede als Vorteil betrachten, um das Gesundheitswesen durch Innovationen voranzutreiben. Auch im Bereich People Relations leben wir diese Kultur - um sie gemeinsam mit uns in den Arbeitsweisen der gesamten Organisation zu verankern, suchen wir Dich.

Dein neues Team
Als Teil des People & Culture Teams bei Roche, ist es unser Bestreben, das Potenzial unserer Mitarbeiter:innen zu entfalten. Als globale Funktion schaffen wir eine Kultur und ein Umfeld, das Eigenverantwortung fördert und den Fokus auf das Wesentliche richtet. Dafür arbeiten wir auf lokaler und globaler Ebene eng mit Arbeitnehmervertretungen, unseren Kunden aus der gesamten Roche Wertschöpfungskette sowie anderen internen und externen Partner:innen zusammen. Gemeinsam mit ihnen stellen wir sicher, dass sowohl Unternehmens- als auch Mitarbeitendeninteressen gleichermaßen gefördert werden. Mit unseren vielfältigen Themen und Projekten bieten wir ausgewogene Perspektiven und proaktive Lösungen in arbeitsrechtlichen Fragen, um Geschäfts- und Personalstrategien erfolgreich voranzubringen.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In der dynamischen Rolle bei Roche begleitest und gestaltest Du Veränderungsprozesse. Du bringst Deine Expertise im Arbeitsrecht ein, agierst vermittelnd als (strategischer) Partner und treibst Projekte voran. Um maßgeblich zum Erfolg von Roche und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung beizutragen, übernimmst Du folgende Aufgaben:

• Du leitest komplexe P&C- relevante Projekte, einschließlich Restrukturierungen und Verhandlungen mit Arbeitnehmervertretungen, unter Berücksichtigung globaler Rahmenbedingungen und lokaler arbeitsrechtlicher Anforderungen.

• Du pflegst vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu den Arbeitnehmervertretungen an all unseren deutschen Standorten und stellst mit lösungsorientierten Ansätzen den geschäftlichen Erfolg sicher.

• Du agierst als Expert:in und Berater:in für individuelle und kollektive Arbeitsrechtsthemen und unterstützt die Organisation in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Strategien, die den rechtlichen Standards und unseren Unternehmenswerten entsprechen.

• Du optimierst Prozesse und Lösungen in Deinem Fachbereich, um die organisatorische Effizienz zu steigern und die Einhaltung aktueller Regularien sicherzustellen.

• Du baust ein professionelles Netzwerk nach innen und außen auf und bist in der Lage, neue Trends zu bewerten und in die Prozessgestaltung einzubeziehen, um die Relevanz und Wirksamkeit von P&C-Initiativen zu erhöhen.

• Du berätst und unterstützt die Führungsebene mit fundierten Analysen und Handlungsempfehlungen zu kritischen P&C-Themen und trägst so zur strategischen Entscheidungsfindung bei.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Nach Abschluss Deines juristischen oder (personal)wirtschaftlichen Studiums und mindestens 5 Jahren einschlägiger Berufserfahrung bringst Du die nötige Seniorität und Empathie mit. Du besitzt umfassende Kompetenzen in der erfolgreichen Umsetzung von Projekten in Transformationsumgebungen.

• Du verfügst über Expertise in der Zusammenarbeit mit Arbeitnehmervertretungen, wodurch Du versiert mit der Gestaltung und Pflege von Beziehungen umgehst.

• Deine vielseitigen Kenntnisse im Arbeitsrecht (sowohl individuell als auch kollektiv) und im Projektmanagement bilden das Fundament für die Beratung und Strategieentwi

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner, Ophthalmology (East Java)

titleByLocale.it: Partner del viaggio paziente, oftalmologia (East Java)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Patient Journey Partner, Ophthalmology (East Java)

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the new Roche organization, directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organization, faster. The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions.

Your Opportunity

• The PJP acts as a trusted partner and is the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche involved in the patient journey. As the local face of Roche, PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.

• The PJP is responsible for creating exponential impacts for patients and the community and bringing us closer to our vision. Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community.

• By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, the PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem. Stewards Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner.

• Resource Planning, the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster. PJP is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally (affiliate) and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other PJPs, HSPs and enabling functions.

• Ensuring great experiences whenever stakeholders in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services. Owner of the customer engagement strategy based on the customer insights (planning until implementation) together with other PJPs.

Who you are

• You should hold a university degree (scientific, economic, or business degree) or an advanced degree in Life science and/or MBA is a plus with practical understanding of digital innovation methodologies as well as deep understanding of patient journey(s) and related treatments in defined disease area(s), enabling engagement at the specialist level.

• You should have broad understanding of Roche’s present portfolio and future pipeline, such that they can work on future-based solutions and robust understanding of medical affairs strategies and tactics including clinical research

• You should have an in-depth understanding of the Indonesia healthcare system and the role of multiple stakeholders within this. Also, In-depth knowledge of Indonesia Pharmaceutical Code of Conduct and other relevant standards and guidelines

• You should have excellent experience in customer and stakeholder engagement in healthcare system.

The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions.

Your Opportunity

• The PJP acts as a trusted partner and is the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche involved in the patient journey. As the local face of Roche, PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.

• The PJP is responsible for creating exponential impacts for patients and the community and bringing us closer to our vision. Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community.

• By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, the PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem. Stewards Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner.

• Resource Planning, the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster. PJP is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally (affiliate) and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other PJPs, HSPs and enabling functions.

• Ensuring great experiences whenever stakeholders in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services. Owner of the customer engagement strategy based on the customer insights (planning until implementation) together with other PJPs.

Who you are

• You should hold a university degree (scientific, economic, or business degree) or an advanced degree in Life science and/or MBA is a plus with practical understanding of digital innovation methodologies as well as deep understanding of patient journey(s) and related treatments in defined disease area(s), enabling engagement at the specialist level.

• You should have broad understanding of Roche’s present portfolio and future pipeline, such that they can work on future-based solutions and robust understanding of medical affairs strategies and tactics including clinical research

• You should have an in-depth understanding of the Indonesia healthcare system and the role of multiple stakeholders within this. Also, In-depth knowledge of Indonesia Pharmaceutical Code of Conduct and other relevant standards and guidelines

• You should have excellent experience in customer and stakeholder engagement in healthcare system.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This role is based in the Regional Customer Support Center which is dedicated to providing excellence while helping laboratory personnel using our products. We operate with a holistic approach, which means that we take care of our product portfolio from the idea through development and market launch to phase-out. The outstanding variety of technologies applied in this area offers you great learning opportunities.

Technical Support Specialist ( Slovak & Czech language)

Locations: Warsaw, Prague or Bratislava (Your choice!)

Are you ready to transition from technical expertise to life-changing impact? Our Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC) is the intellectual engine behind laboratory excellence in Central Europe. We are looking for a Czech and/or Slovak-speaking talent who is hungry for knowledge, enjoys problem-solving, and is ready to master the world’s most advanced diagnostic technologies.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity:

More Than Just Support This isn't a typical helpdesk role. This is an engineering and application consultancy position where you become the "guardian" of diagnostic accuracy.

• Master the Complexity: You will work with high-end IVD (In-Vitro Diagnostics) systems that combine robotics, complex biochemistry, and advanced IT.

• Continuous Growth: We provide an intensive, world-class training program. We don’t expect you to know everything on day one, but we expect you to be the one who never stops asking "why?".

• Agile Impact: Join a team where your proactivity isn't just welcomed – it's required. You will prevent issues before they happen, using digital twins and remote diagnostic tools.

Who You Are:

• Education: You have a degree in Engineering, IT, Biochemistry, Lab Diagnostics or equivalent. More importantly, you have a "detective’s mind" for troubleshooting.

• Language Power: You are a native or C1/C2 speaker of Czech and/or Slovak . Your English is strong enough to lead you through international trainings and global technical forums.

• The "Lab-to-Office" Bridge: If you’ve worked in a clinical lab and feel you’ve outgrown your current walls, we want your diagnostic logic. We will teach you the engineering; you bring the passion for science.

• Resilience & Ambition: You are someone who sees a complex technical error not as a problem, but as a challenge to be conquered.

What Roche Offers You:

• Autonomy: A hybrid work model in Warsaw, Prague, or Bratislava.

• Unmatched Portfolio: Access to technologies that are setting the standard for the next decade of healthcare.

The role is an 18 - month contract via an external agency.

For the Bratislava location the salary starts from 1 600 EUR gross / month. For the Prague location, the salary starts from 48 300 CZK / month. Final salary depends on the successful candidate's level of experience, skills and qualifications.

jobs.title: Director, Head of Facilities & Engineering
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you a visionary leader with a passion for transforming facilities operations to support cutting-edge science and patient care? Join Roche Diagnostics as the Director of Facilities & Engineering for our Bay Area sites, where you'll take charge of shaping the strategic direction and operational excellence of our Pleasanton and Santa Clara campuses. This pivotal role offers the opportunity to oversee large-scale capital projects, optimize site master plans, and drive continuous improvements in reliability, safety, and efficiency. As a key member of the Site Leadership Team, you will inspire and develop a high-performing team, foster a culture of innovation, and ensure our facilities meet the highest standards of compliance and performance—empowering Roche’s mission to deliver extraordinary outcomes for patients around the world.

This role is responsible for the strategic leadership of all Facilities & Engineering initiatives across the Bay Area sites ( Pleasanton and Santa Clara ). This includes directing operations and maintenance, campus master planning, capital investment strategies and execution, asset lifecycle management, and reliability engineering. The Director is ultimately accountable for ensuring facilities operations are compliant, reliable, fiscally responsible and directly support the organization's overarching business objectives. This leader inspires and empowers a culture of operational excellence where every employee can achieve extraordinary outcomes for customers and patients every day.

The Opportunity
Responsibilities

• Oversees the curation and management of the Facilities CAPEX portfolio for Roche Diagnostics Sites in the Bay Area. Directs all facility related capital projects in support of the Facility Master Plan. Capital projects range from 100,000 USD to 100,000,000 USD with the following responsibilities: project scope, cost and schedule development, funding documentation development and presentation to senior management, construction, move coordination and project close-out. May direct capital project planning and execution for sites outside the Bay Area based on need and available resources.

• Develops and executes annual and long range strategic Facility Master Plans based on Site Business Plans. Plan development and execution requires interaction across all functional areas of the business and senior management, with strong negotiation skills to solve complex problems affecting nearly all employees at Roche sites.

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner (Contract)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharmaceuticals

The Mission

• Health care is changing: Radical innovation, increased openness to change, increasing patient empowerment, multiple sources of medical information, and pressure on public spending. As a result of all this, the needs of our stakeholders continue to evolve.

• The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering world-class medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption. By doing so the PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organisation, faster.

• The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche Hong Kong and Macau. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions.

• The PJP will deliver better outcomes for patients, better community value and better commercial results, the latter being the consequence of the first two. Committing to improving better care outcomes for patients is good business.

• This role is locally embedded in the Hong Kong ecosystem, it is an integrated role, primary point of contact, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs)

• It has no profitability, sales objectives or incentives

• All Roche Hong Kong & Macau employees are to lead by example, in the network way of working. This is where solutions are sourced from the internal and external network first, to avoid duplications, and to achieve better patient outcomes faster.

• All Roche Hong Kong & Macau employees are to lead by example in accelerating the digital maturity of Roche internally and in the external healthcare environment, aligned with the long term Roche vision of Personalized Health Care.

Major Accountabilities

• All Roche employees are expected to effectively contribute to cross-functional collaboration and coordination and comply with all laws, regulations, policies & procedures that govern our business.

• This position profile serves only to give a broad outline of the duties required and will be renewed and amended at periodic intervals in the consultation with the incumbent.

• The PJP is a senior level role within the affiliate, who has decision making authority to request resources of Roche (both within the affiliate and broader network) in order to have improved impact on the patient journey

• With regards to the ecosystems of Hong Kong and Macau, the PJP will continue to evolve the collaboration within the ecosystem of HA clusters, public and private partnerships and the smooth rolling out of healthcare system changes in which the HSPs will be shaping.

Details:

• The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with both Hong Kong and Macau partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.

• Acts as trusted partner and is the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche; the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster.

• Partners with patient

jobs.title: Country Chief Accountant
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity.

The opportunity

As a Country Chief Accountant you will be accountable for the financial statements prepared for the affiliate and will coordinate with RSS (Roche Services & Solutions) Budapest Finance teams (Demand to Pay, Record to Report, Travel and Expense, Compliance) and execute month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with the month-end close checklist.

R2R

• Overseeing financial accuracy and internal controls, including ICFR documentation and tools management.

• Conducting balance sheet reconciliation, anomaly rectification, and ensuring timely and quality financial statement reporting / month-end closing, yearly reporting

• Managing accounting aspects such as IFRS 16 Leasing, manual journal entries, and management accounting activities.

• Supervising Accounts Receivables, including billings approval, debtors aging, and sales reporting accuracy.

• Handling cash flow management and treasury matters, including fund forecasting, transfers, and banking transactions.

DtP

• Handling all accounts payable related matters

Master Data

• Managing master data - Chart of Accounts, Cost Center, Profit Center. WBS, vendor & customer master data, UCI, etc.

Other

• Overseeing statutory tax calculations, reconciliation, reporting, and Tax Consultant liaison, alongside managing external financial audits

• Managing financial compliance, internal controls on financial reporting

• Serving as central contact for RSS Budapest Finance teams and Finance Managers in the affiliates, addressing financial issues, requests, and advisory needs

Who you are:

• University education; preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline, ACCA or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage

• 8 years of experience in a related field and at least 5 years in accountant / audit role and people management experience

• Knowledge of accounting principles and practices; financial reporting, audit, and taxation, including local accounting principles as advantage

• Proficiency in accounting software, preferably SAP and MS Office

• Demonstrates effective leadership abilities and advocacy, while empowering colleagues in decision-making

• Proven track record in relationship and stakeholder management across diverse groups, with strong negotiation and influencing skills

• Proficiency in English, Arabic is advantage

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity.

The opportunity

As a Country Chief Accountant you will be accountable for the financial statements prepared for the affiliate and will coordinate with RSS (Roche Services & Solutions) Budapest Finance teams (Demand to Pay, Record to Report, Travel and Expense, Compliance) and execute month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with the month-end close checklist.

R2R

• Overseeing financial accuracy and internal controls, including ICFR documentation and tools management.

• Conducting balance sheet reconciliation, anomaly rectification, and ensuring timely and quality financial statement reporting / month-end closing, yearly reporting

• Managing accounting aspects such as IFRS 16 Leasing, manual journal entries, and management accounting activities.

• Supervising Accounts Receivables, including billings approval, debtors aging, and sales reporting accuracy.

• Handling cash flow management and treasury matters, including fund forecasting, transfers, and banking transactions.

DtP

• Handling all accounts payable related matters

Master Data

• Managing master data - Chart of Accounts, Cost Center, Profit Center. WBS, vendor & customer master data, UCI, etc.

Other

• Overseeing statutory tax calculations, reconciliation, reporting, and Tax Consultant liaison, alongside managing external financial audits

• Managing financial compliance, internal controls on financial reporting

• Serving as central contact for RSS Budapest Finance teams and Finance Managers in the affiliates, addressing financial issues, requests, and advisory needs

• University education; preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline, ACCA or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage

• 8 years of experience in a related field and at least 5 years in accountant / audit role and people management experience

• Knowledge of accounting principles and practices; financial reporting, audit, and taxation, including local accounting principles as advantage

• Proficiency in accounting software, preferably SAP and MS Office

• Demonstrates effective leadership abilities and advocacy, while empowering colleagues in decision-making

• Proven track record in relationship and stakeholder management across diverse groups, with strong negotiation and influencing skills

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
工作职责

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域相关科学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案。

• 运用专业知识，传递诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升。

• 拜访临床及病理医生，维护客户关系，按时按质的完成相关客户洞见，尤其重点专家对于疾病领域洞见的收集并进行总结/分析/反馈。

• 组织/协调/整合各类疾病领域学术会议，推动建立疾病领域治疗规范。

• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力。

能力要求

• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识

• 良好学习能力和业务敏锐度

• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力

• 多产品资源整合能力

• ​3年以上医药行业工作经验，医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking an experienced SAP EWM Specialist who independently leads EWM solution delivery, proactively solves product issues, and contributes to the architecture for the global Roche ASPIRE EWM System.

In this role, you will guide product developments, champion accountability, and effectively communicate with all stakeholders. You will solve complex problems, make independent product-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report at the product level. By bringing advanced EWM knowledge, expertise within GxP environments, and strong analytical skills, you will actively contribute to continuous improvement and the evolution of our warehouse processes across Roche.

Description of the area:
Job Responsibilities

• Scope: Works and leads independently to deliver solution design with increased complexity (e.g., technical, scope, stakeholders) in the EWM area that meet product requirements and business priorities. Proactively identifies issues at the product level, proposes ideas on how to tackle them, and keeps applying a continuous improvement mindset. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the EWM product life cycle, and leads the development of medium to complex changes. Evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new business processes while providing technical oversight and consultation. Supports larger initiatives as a single point of contact for the EWM system as needed.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Determines methods and procedures on assignments and coordinates or guides the activities of others in the team. Champions accountability by example (such as taking tech lead and/or product owner roles) and helps drive the successful completion of major product milestones. Solves complex problems which require the regular use of ingenuity and creativity, taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information. Independently makes decisions with impact at the product level under limited direction. Analyzes current warehouse processes and recommends SAP EWM enhancements to improve efficiency, accuracy, and compliance. Manages interfaces between SAP EWM and other systems, like e.g. MES and troubleshoot data flow issues.

• Stakeholder Management: Interacts within and across multiple product teams within a domain, working directly with all stakeholders from the business and within IT. Communicates information, issues, and potential solutions to the product team or squad and to external stakeholders. Proactively communicates across work-streams, taking responsibility for fostering teamwork, resolving confusion or miscommunication, and facilitating discussions.

• Impact/Strategy: Makes an impact that is typically limited to the EWM system and its interfaces. Identifies opportunities and improves existing solutions to enhance value and business processes, providing technical oversight and guidance for the product teams.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• A minimum of five years of experience is required in independently leading and delivering complex solution designs and products within the Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) domain.

• Background in logistics or supply chain.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams.

• Experience working within a validated environment, including the creation and execution of test scripts and solution documentation.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

ERP Solution Consultant - SAP EWM

We are seeking an experienced Senior SAP EWM Specialist & Developer with MFS experience to join our team and take ownership of a highly complex, validated warehouse management solution. This warehouse is one of the biggest ones of the Roche Pharma division with a high degree of automation. You guide product teams, champion accountability, and effectively communicate with all stakeholders. You will solve complex problems, make independent product-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report at the product level.

The Opportunity

• Design & Implementation : Develop and implement complex enhancements to our SAP EWM solution, including MFS and WebDynpro user interfaces

• Independent Problem-Solving : Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical solutions; troubleshoot issues at the code level without requiring constant guidance

• Technical Deep-Dive : Investigate complex technical challenges, debug code, and optimize system performance

• Stakeholder Collaboration : Work closely with business teams to understand requirements, manage expectations, and communicate technical constraints and timelines

• Validated Environment Management : Execute changes in compliance with our regulated environment, including documentation, test cases, and validation requirements

• Knowledge Transfer : Document solutions and share expertise with team members to build organizational capability

• Travel to Switzerland as needed for on-site support, workshops, and client engagement

Required Qualifications

• Extensive SAP EWM Experience : Minimum 5+ years working with SAP EWM in production environments, including complex configurations and customizations

• MFS Expertise : Proven hands-on experience implementing and maintaining SAP MFS

• ABAP Development Skills : Solid programming background with ability to debug, and optimize ABAP code

• Validated Environment Experience : Demonstrated familiarity with regulated environments, change management processes, and compliance documentation

• SAFe Framework Knowledge : Working understanding of Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) principles and practices

• Fluent English : Strong verbal and written communication skills (essential)

• German Language (Preferred) : Fluency in German is a significant plus

Who you are:

• Salary range 14,175 - 26,325 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance (target 15%).

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subsidy available.

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice).

• Private healthcare (LuxMed packages), group life insurance (UNUM) and Multisport.

• Stock share purchase additions.

• Yearly sales of company laptops and cars and many more!

Apply directly and join us in shaping the future of healthcare.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche Near Patient Care , we create the tools that help people with diabetes think less about their daily routine and more about their lives. Our Indianapolis site is a global hub for blood glucose strip manufacturing and the future home of our next-generation continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) sensors.

The Opportunity
As a Controls Engineer , you are the technical backbone of our automated production lines. You won’t just be sitting at a desk; you’ll be hands-on with high-speed equipment, ensuring our manufacturing processes are stable, validated, and constantly improving.

What You’ll Do

• Optimize & Innovate: Lead the evolution of our automation and electromechanical processes. You’ll use data and operator feedback to make our lines faster, smarter, and more reliable.

• Launch New Tech: Partner with R&D and Process Development to bridge the gap between design and high-volume manufacturing for new product launches.

• Own the Controls: Program, modify, and troubleshoot the "brains" of our machines, ensuring every sensor, motor, and PLC is performing at peak efficiency.

• Manage Quality & Validation: Lead equipment qualifications (IQ/OQ/PQ) and ensure all process changes meet strict regulatory standards without sacrificing production speed.

• Strategic Leadership: Manage multiple project lifecycles, mentor junior staff, and provide expert on-call support to keep our 24/7 operations running smoothly.

• On-Site: Engineers are dedicated to the Indianapolis site. Travel typically < 10%.

What You’ll Bring

• PLC & HMI Proficiency: Deep experience with Allen Bradley (RSLogix/Studio 5000) and FactoryTalk View. You are comfortable modifying code to drive continuous improvement.

• The "Troubleshooter" Mindset: Strong knowledge of electromechanical systems, motion controls (Servos/VFDs), Distributed I/O, sensors, and Cognex/Keyence Vision Systems.

• Validation Expertise: Proven ability to develop and execute equipment qualification protocols and write clear, technical documentation.

• Vendor Management: Experience collaborating with external partners to source specialized solutions or navigate component obsolescence.

• Analytical Drive: A highly logical approach to problem-solving, with the ability to run simulations and use test data to make informed decisions.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or closely related discipline with a minimum of 2 years of related experience; advanced degree may substitute for previous experience or equivalent experience

• Related experience must include troubleshooting, modifying, and/or developing industrial equipment controls systems (PLCs, HMIs, Motion Control, etc.)

Preferred:

• Familiar with GMP in a regulated environment (Medical Device or Pharmaceutical).

• Strong electro-mechanical skills that can look at the machine from all engineering aspects: mechanical, electrical, and controls.

• Previous experience troubleshooting controls systems of high volume/speed manufacturing equipment.

• Previous training or experience in Process Improvement Methodologies (e.g. LSS, PDCA, etc.).

• Demonstrates excellent interpersonal, communication, and teamwork skills.

• Strong ability to teach and educate key stakeholders and other colleagues.

• Deep commitment to cross-functional collaboration and breaking down silos to achieve the best results for the organization.

This is an onsite role in Indianapolis. Relocation benefits are not available.

jobs.title: Principal Software Development Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

At Roche, we are working to make next-generation sequencing simple and accessible enough for routine use. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. From robust sample isolation and preparation tools to novel sequencing technology and advanced bioinformatics, we are developing differentiated, highly integrated end-to-end solutions for next-generation sequencing, resulting in a sample in, result out workflow.

Our Verification and Validation team, a part of Roche Sequencing Solutions, is responsible for ensuring a software product meets its specified requirements and performs as intended by rigorously testing and analyzing the software throughout its development lifecycle.

As a Principal Software Developer in Test, you will be responsible for test design, development, automation, deployment, execution, and reporting. Specifically, you will develop an integrated hardware-software framework for end-to-end test automation that leverages a third-party Hardware-in-the-Loop solution. In this role, you will represent quality engineering and verification on behalf of your team in all events and activities related to this effort, working closely with software and hardware engineers across multiple global locations.

The Opportunity

• You develop solutions for Hardware-in-the-Loop testing for end-to-end testing of embedded instrument software

• You author and confirm correctness of requirements-driven tests, covering aspects including:

• Testing approaches (exploratory, white box, black box, etc.)

• Testing level (end-to-end, system, integration, unit, etc.)

• Testing types (functional, performance, scalability, etc.)

• You automate and execute front-end and back-end tests, covering for:

• Instrument software

• Web applications

• You automate deployment and testing pipelines across branches and stages

• You report quality metrics and enhancing quality dashboards

• You perform root cause analysis of defects and discoveries

• You develop automation frameworks and validate automation toolchains

• You ensure regulatory compliance of quality engineering deliverables

• You partner with Test Architects, Test Leads, and Verification & Validation Leads on practices

• You collaborate with designers, architects, developers, system engineers and testers on product development

• You participate in all development events, and activities and guide junior testing team members as needed

• Technologies which may be utilized : C++, Java, Cucumber (Behavior-Driven Development), Gherkin, Playwright, Windows, Cypress/JDI/Selenium/WebDriver/TestNG, Typescript/Javascript, Angular, Docker, Jenkins, Groovy, Bash, Jira, Github, Confluence, Google Suite, macOS/Linux, MS SQL, Vector HIL Solutions

Who You Are

• You have a Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or related. Advanced degree preferred. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered, with three years of experience for each year of missing education

• You have 10+ years related experience or equivalent combination of education and experience with Jav
