jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:

• Project Undertaking and Delivery: Assist and take ownership of key projects from various teams (MWA/OMSS/CB); responsible for decomposing strategic objectives into specific action plans. Lead project progress control, resource coordination, and cross-functional communication to ensure on-time and high-quality delivery.

• Project Implementation: Collaborate with Product Managers to develop effective promotion tools; ensure product strategies and marketing activities are efficiently executed and implemented at the sales terminal.

• AI Technology Empowerment: Act as the department's AI application expert; guide and assist product groups in building AI-based product management tools and intelligent workflows to drive digital transformation. Precisely identify business pain points within the ML department; develop and promote AI solutions to enhance the quality and efficiency of content generation.

• Team Productivity Enhancement: Leverage AI technology to deeply optimize internal approval processes, online operating systems, and user-facing business material preparation, significantly reducing the time investment of Product Managers in repetitive and administrative tasks.

• Large-scale Event Management: Oversee the planning and execution of major internal and external conferences (both online and offline) and brand promotion activities; responsible for vendor management and on-site operations.

• Omni-channel Media Operations: Optimize and maintain departmental marketing communication channels (e.g., WeChat, webinar platforms, and 3rd party professional media); ensure published content is highly aligned with corporate branding and compliance requirements.

• Vendor and Budget Management: Manage vendors to ensure projects meet departmental KPIs and compliance policies; monitor project implementation and strictly control budgets following the ROI principle.

Who you are:

• Bachelor’s degree or above in Clinical Medicine, Biological Engineering, Marketing, Business Management, or a related discipline.

• Proficiency in both spoken and written English

• Deep expertise in AI application tools (e.g., LLMs, Workflow Automation) and digital marketing; ability to translate business needs into technical AI solutions.

• Expertise in MS Office Suite and project management software (e.g., MS Project, Trello, or Jira). PMP or equivalent certification is a significant plus.

• At least 5 years working experience in a similar capacity and in a similar industry.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer | Laboratory Diagnostics
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It is what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That is what makes us Roche.

• Global reputable company | Career growth opportunities

• Full time permanent position | Annual Bonus and Car Allowance

• Base salary between $100,000-$120,000

• Supportive and dynamic team | Agile ways of working

Roche Diagnostics New Zealand (RDNZ) has just opened an exciting opportunity for the position of Field Service Engineer to be based in Wellington. The key purpose of this position is to carry out the engineering service function for the assigned Squad, but the responsibilities may flex across the other squads as per business requirements. There is a requirement of training and continuing education on the portfolio, instrument and product troubleshooting, instrument installation and commissioning, instrument maintenance procedures and all manufacturer modifications, and other issues of instrument aftersales services to the satisfaction of the RDNZ customer base and in line with our organisational SOPs and policies.

Leveraging your Laboratory Diagnostics engineering experience, responsibilities of this role include but are not limited to;

• Ensure existing and new customer base are supported with quality after-sales service.

• Participate in an on-call roster to ensure customers are supported 24 hours 7 days.

• Instrument trouble-shooting service is provided, is efficient and fulfils the needs of our customers.

• Ensure RD maintains Service Level Agreements (SLA) conditions with regards response times for phone support and onsite customer visits.

• Chapter Lead Service, relevant Marketing Managers and Strategic Key Account Managers are kept aware of all product issues.

• Participate in Account Management Strategies.

• Spare parts stock are organized and maintained to avoid excess stock accumulation in consignment and are returned to 3PL warehouse.

• To complete all documentation required within the required timeline requested.

• Business opportunities are identified and implemented in accordance with internal and external stakeholders.

• To keep CRM (Rexis/\NFSS) customer records up to date, relevant and accurate.

• Ensure Service Contract information is followed for all service activities / work orders.

• Provide cover and travel as required for territories where engineering resources are required to meet business demands and customer needs.

• Complete timely pre-installation inspections and installation of new and refurbished RD and other analytical systems within areas of responsibility.

• Displays an understanding of, and adhere to, all SHE policies and principles to ensure the health and safety of all at the workplace.

Who You Are:

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You are looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies and where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point.

To be successful in this position, you will be an experienced engineer, and will be able to demonstrate the following:

• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar role with tertiary qualification in Engineering (Electrical / Mechanical) or Science is desired

• Understanding of Diagnostic & Research Laboratories environment

• Appropriate work-r

The key purpose of this position is to carry out the engineering service function for the assigned Squad, but the responsibilities may flex across the other squads as per business requirements. There is a requirement of training and continuing education on the portfolio, instrument and product troubleshooting, instrument installation and commissioning, instrument maintenance procedures and all manufacturer modifications, and other issues of instrument aftersales services to the satisfaction of the RDNZ customer base and in line with our organisational SOPs and policies.

• Participate in Account Management Strategies.

• Spare parts stock are organized and maintained to avoid excess stock accumulation in consignment and are returned to 3PL warehouse.

• Understanding of Diagnostic & Research Laboratories environment

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The team provides timely, accurate and decision-relevant information to support the Head of Group Controlling and Accounting, Head of Strategic Finance, Pharma CFO and ultimately the CEO, the Corporate Executive Committee and the Board of Directors in value creation and financial performance management. In addition, it provides timely, accurate and decision-relevant information and analysis of actual and planned financial performance of the Pharmaceutical Division management units.

The Opportunity

The Enterprise Center of Excellence (eCoE) focuses on three areas: delivering a high-level of financial expertise, innovative insights, and an entrepreneurial mindset that enables agility and flexibility for stakeholders.
This role involves preparing presentations for the Pharma Leadership Team and Pharma Finance Leadership Team, alongside supporting the compilation of critical management reports for the Corporate Executive Committee, Board of Directors, and other key decision-makers. You will also assist in analyzing the performance of the Roche Pharma Division, generating valuable insights, and contributing to various ad-hoc financial projects, ensuring all reports are updated and continuously enhanced. Furthermore, you will assist in the preparation of evidence and supporting documents to back-up the reported financial results.

Who You are:

• You are currently enrolled at University studying Finance / Economics or a similar degree, or you completed your degree within the past 12 months prior to the start date.

• You are someone who wants to influence your own development and you are an enthusiastic team player who enjoys working in a global and dynamic environment.

• You are looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions.

• Exceptional Analytical and Technical Proficiency: Possess strong analytical skills, quick perception, and a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail. This includes advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VBA is a plus) and PowerPoint, as well as Google Sheets and Google Slides.

• Adaptability and Resilience: Demonstrate an accurate working style and the ability to perform effectively under pressure and within tight timelines, coupled with an open-minded and flexible attitude.

• Strong Communication and Language Skills: Exhibit excellent command of English, enabling clear and effective communication within a global environment.

• High Motivation and Continuous Learning Mindset: Show outstanding motivation and a strong willingness to continuously learn and develop, reflecting a genuine interest in Finance.

• Proactive and Improvement-Oriented Approach: A growth mindset with a passion for improving the status quo is highly valued, as are IT skills for introducing automation.

Application process:

• Please upload your current CV and a Motivation Letter, where you indicate your preferred start date of the internship.

Additional Information:

• Please note, due to regulations, non-EU/EFTA citizens must provide a certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory as part of the application documents, and must be continuously enrolled in their university for the whole duration of this internship.

• Part-time employment is not possible.

• Earliest start date: 1 August 2026 or upon availability

• Duration: 12 months, full- time (40 hours/ week)

• Location: Basel

jobs.title: Commercial Finance Partner(Demand Management)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Purpose
This role acts as a "T-shaped" Value Orchestrator. The primary mission is to break down traditional silos between procurement and finance by autonomously leading procurement strategies and end-to-end (E2E) processes. Crucially, this role ensures that the "savings" and "cash flow optimizations" generated from procurement activities are directly reflected in the affiliate's financial planning and budgeting (P&L), thereby maximizing enterprise business value.

Key Responsibilities
1. Procurement Strategy & Vendor Management

• Develop and implement procurement strategies and savings plans to support business objectives and financial targets.

• Execute comprehensive Vendor Management, which includes coordinating supplier selection, onboarding, regular performance evaluations, and maintaining strong, strategic vendor relationships.

• Lead supplier negotiations to secure favorable commercial terms.

• Optimize payment terms to significantly reduce deposit/advance invoices and improve company cash flows.

2. Budgeting & Financial Planning

• Integrate procurement savings and cost optimization plans directly into the affiliate's planning events, including Business Plan (BP), T0, T3, Baseline, as well as Period cost, and M&D budgets.

• Ensure procurement savings initiatives are tightly aligned with and realized in the company’s financial targets and P&L.

3. E2E Process, Governance & SOPs

• Create, maintain, and regularly update Procurement Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and formalized purchasing policies to ensure operational efficiency and compliance across all departments.

• Establish and maintain governance frameworks for the full procurement lifecycle and internal controls.

• Continuously evaluate and enhance procurement processes and controls to ensure scalability and effectiveness.

4. Collaboration & Network Orchestration

• Act as the bridge between Finance and Procurement, and collaborate closely with the Supply Chain team to align procurement processes with operational needs.

• Work with the Roche network (other affiliates and global) to find better solutions and share best practices.

5. Compliance & Risk Management

• Perform risk management on supply contracts, proactively identifying and resolving supply or quality issues.

• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and external regulations.

Key Requirements

• Education: Bachelor’s Degree or above, preferably in Business Administration, Finance, or related.

• Experience: 5+ years of experience in procurement, supply chain management, or financial planning in Multinational Companies (MNCs).

• Professional Skills: Strong negotiation, analytical, and financial acumen (understanding of budgeting and P&L). Expertise in vendor management, procurement governance, SOP creation, and E2E processes. Familiarity with financial systems (e.g., SAP) is required.

• Attributes & Languages: Proven ability to solve problems, influence cross-functional teams, and build stakeholder relationships. Fluent in both oral and written English and Mandarin. Good compliance track record.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicin

The Position
Job Purpose
This role acts as a "T-shaped" Value Orchestrator. The primary mission is to break down traditional silos between procurement and finance by autonomously leading procurement strategies and end-to-end (E2E) processes. Crucially, this role ensures that the "savings" and "cash flow optimizations" generated from procurement activities are directly reflected in the affiliate's financial planning and budgeting (P&L), thereby maximizing enterprise business value.

Key Responsibilities
1. Procurement Strategy & Vendor Management

• Develop and implement procurement strategies and savings plans to support business objectives and financial targets.

• Execute comprehensive Vendor Management, which includes coordinating supplier selection, onboarding, regular performance evaluations, and maintaining strong, strategic vendor relationships.

• Lead supplier negotiations to secure favorable commercial terms.

• Optimize payment terms to significantly reduce deposit/advance invoices and improve company cash flows.

2. Budgeting & Financial Planning

• Integrate procurement savings and cost optimization plans directly into the affiliate's planning events, including Business Plan (BP), T0, T3, Baseline, as well as Period cost, and M&D budgets.

• Ensure procurement savings initiatives are tightly aligned with and realized in the company’s financial targets and P&L.

3. E2E Process, Governance & SOPs

• Create, maintain, and regularly update Procurement Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and formalized purchasing policies to ensure operational efficiency and compliance across all departments.

• Establish and maintain governance frameworks for the full procurement lifecycle and internal controls.

• Continuously evaluate and enhance procurement processes and controls to ensure scalability and effectiveness.

4. Collaboration & Network Orchestration

• Act as the bridge between Finance and Procurement, and collaborate closely with the Supply Chain team to align procurement processes with operational needs.

• Work with the Roche network (other affiliates and global) to find better solutions and share best practices.

5. Compliance & Risk Management

• Perform risk management on supply contracts, proactively identifying and resolving supply or quality issues.

• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and external regulations.

Key Requirements

• Education: Bachelor’s Degree or above, preferably in Business Administration, Finance, or related.

• Experience: 5+ years of experience in procurement, supply chain management, or financial planning in Multinational Companies (MNCs).

• Professional Skills: Strong negotiation, analytical, and financial acumen (understanding of budgeting and P&L). Expertise in vendor management, procurement governance, SOP creation, and E2E processes. Familiarity with financial systems (e.g., SAP) is required.

• Attributes & Languages: Proven ability to solve problems, influence cross-functional teams, and build stakeholder relationships. Fluent in both oral and written English and Mandarin. Good compliance track record.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Accountant - Talent Pool
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This posting is for Talent Pool purposes and may not correspond to a current vacancy with an active recruitment process. However, it reflects a role for which we regularly recruit or anticipate having openings in the near future for permanent or fixed term opportunities.

The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Financial Accountant you will perform day-to-day and closing activities in cooperation with cross-functional departments, according to predefined deadlines with full ownership of their tasks and in compliance with the Process Documentations of the respective business sub-process. In this position in close collaboration with the Country Chief Accountant, you will focus on:

• Leased assets, fixed asset and CAPEX accounting activities

• Taxes, GL journals and accruals/ provisions, reconciling BS accounts

• Clearing customer accounts and bank suspense accounts, collecting direct debit, daily bank posting, posting and reconciling treasury transactions

• Calculating and issuing AR manual invoices

• Defining and calculating cost and revenue allocation in controlling

• Conducting product closing in the Material Management module of SAP

• Performing Month-end Closing and Reporting for Consolidation and for Divisions

• Preparing audit documentation and participating in internal and external audits

Who you are
We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:
University degree, preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline

• 2-4 years of experience in a relevant position

• Excellent communication and analytical skills

• Outstanding customer orientation and service focus

• Strong interpersonal skills and team player attitude

• Proficiency in English

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits : Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance

jobs.title: Global Policy Lead, Disease Area Policy

titleByLocale.en: Global Policy Lead, Disease Area Policy
titleByLocale.it: Politica globale Piombo, Politica Area Malattia
titleByLocale.de: Global Policy Lead, Disease Area Policy
titleByLocale.fr: Global Policy Lead, Disease Area Policy

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
External Affairs International (EAi), part of the Roche Pharma CEO Office, ensures the company can shape the policies, funding decisions, and market conditions that determine how healthcare innovation is valued and rewarded. We influence globally where strategic priorities are defined and enable locally where business impact is delivered. Through focused advocacy and a connected global network, EAi builds trusted relationships with governments, multilateral institutions, and global partners, develops third-party advocates, and forges alliances that protect and grow Roche’s business while improving patient access to innovation.

The Opportunity
The Global Policy Lead, Disease Area Policy is a high-impact strategic expert responsible for designing and driving Roche’s policy strategies across priority Therapeutic Areas (TAs). Reporting to the Global Disease Area Policy Team Lead, you serve as the definitive policy expert, ensuring that the external policy environment and healthcare systems deliver rapid and sustainable access to innovation. This role requires a unique blend of technical policy mastery, commercial acumen and strategic diplomacy to navigate complex supra-national environments, influence senior stakeholders, and orchestrate global-to-local disease area policy alignment without the need for direct hierarchical authority.

Key Responsibilities

• Drive the development and implementation of the global policy strategy portfolio and performance metrics across priority TAs, ensuring full alignment with global, regional, and affiliate functions.

• Define the long-term global disease area policy vision, strategy, objectives and crafting sophisticated policy projects, evidence, tools and positioning that addresses the needs of patients, medical professionals, and the business.

• Act as a primary catalyst for shaping policy environments by architecting external engagement and advocacy frameworks for a broad cross-section of disease area policy and health system stakeholders, while identifying and mitigating barriers to access among governments and NGOs.

• Serve as the primary global point-of-contact for disease area policy, providing timely and expert direction to the business

• Partner strategically across Roche regions and affiliates to ensure consistent application of health policy expertise, enabling local implementation of disease area policy strategies, and to drive the External Affairs mission through the organization.

• Lead the development of portfolio-wide content, analytical tools, and disease area policy strategies that translate complex external policy and healthcare challenges into actionable business insights and tactics.

• Manage high-impact global strategic policy initiatives and project workstreams, ensuring resource transparency and evidence-based recommendations to enable high-level business decision-making.

• Support organizational growth by sharing global health policy expertise and educating cross-functional peers to foster a culture of functional excellence and innovation.

Who You Are

• You hold a Master’s degree, MBA, or equivalent in Political Science, Public Policy, Public Health, Healthcare Management, or a related field.

• 8+ years of experience in health policy or public affairs within the life sciences sector or government,with a deep mastery and knowledge of disease area policy, health system and access environments.

• A recognized leader with a demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and policymakers

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
External Affairs International (EAi), part of the Roche Pharma CEO Office, ensures the company can shape the policies, funding decisions, and market conditions that determine how healthcare innovation is valued and rewarded. We influence globally where strategic priorities are defined and enable locally where business impact is delivered. Through focused advocacy and a connected global network, EAi builds trusted relationships with governments, multilateral institutions, and global partners, develops third-party advocates, and forges alliances that protect and grow Roche’s business while improving patient access to innovation.

The Opportunity
The Global Policy Lead, Disease Area Policy is a high-impact strategic expert responsible for designing and driving Roche’s policy strategies across priority Therapeutic Areas (TAs). Reporting to the Global Disease Area Policy Team Lead, you serve as the definitive policy expert, ensuring that the external policy environment and healthcare systems deliver rapid and sustainable access to innovation. This role requires a unique blend of technical policy mastery, commercial acumen and strategic diplomacy to navigate complex supra-national environments, influence senior stakeholders, and orchestrate global-to-local disease area policy alignment without the need for direct hierarchical authority.

Key Responsibilities

• Drive the development and implementation of the global policy strategy portfolio and performance metrics across priority TAs, ensuring full alignment with global, regional, and affiliate functions.

• Define the long-term global disease area policy vision, strategy, objectives and crafting sophisticated policy projects, evidence, tools and positioning that addresses the needs of patients, medical professionals, and the business.

• Act as a primary catalyst for shaping policy environments by architecting external engagement and advocacy frameworks for a broad cross-section of disease area policy and health system stakeholders, while identifying and mitigating barriers to access among governments and NGOs.

• Serve as the primary global point-of-contact for disease area policy, providing timely and expert direction to the business

• Partner strategically across Roche regions and affiliates to ensure consistent application of health policy expertise, enabling local implementation of disease area policy strategies, and to drive the External Affairs mission through the organization.

• Lead the development of portfolio-wide content, analytical tools, and disease area policy strategies that translate complex external policy and healthcare challenges into actionable business insights and tactics.

• Manage high-impact global strategic policy initiatives and project workstreams, ensuring resource transparency and evidence-based recommendations to enable high-level business decision-making.

• Support organizational growth by sharing global health policy expertise and educating cross-functional peers to foster a culture of functional excellence and innovation.

Who You Are

• You hold a Master’s degree, MBA, or equivalent in Political Science, Public Policy, Public Health, Healthcare Management, or a related field.

• 8+ years of experience in health policy or public affairs within the life sciences sector or government,with a deep mastery and knowledge of disease area policy, health system and access environments.

• A recognized leader with a demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and policymakers

jobs.title: IT Workplace Services Professional
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Be part of our inclusive team at Roche Informatics, where we're driven by a shared passion for technological novelties and optimal IT solutions. As an IT Workplace Services Professional you continuously evaluate and improve the employee experience through subject matter expertise in the digital workplace, focusing on efficiency, employee satisfaction, and ensuring business continuity. This is a varied role and can give you a springboard into other careers in Informatics and beyond.

The Opportunity

• You will act as a digital enabler for our business colleagues & functions

• You act as the owner of the digital employee experience for the respective site

• You drive employee productivity through consultancy, provide intimacy and site proximity at the sites, and ensure a personalized Roche employee experience.

• You leverage available data (e.g.: Nexthink, SNOW) for proactive support

• You support and manage the Incident/ Request management processes to ensure SLAs are met and drive continuous improvement through trend analysis.

• You manage IT hardware lifecycle management & deskside support processes/managed services for the site

• You provide support & guidance for onsite services (e.g. events and meetings) by leveraging from internal and external providers. Drive the user experience and promote best practices.

• You drive and enable standard workplace infrastructure, global/local projects, and deployments in collaboration with product teams.

• You proactively address and follow through on process-improvement ideas

• You support & drive budgeting process related to the respective site

• You support local audit, inspection and certification requirements

• You support local Business Continuity and IT Disaster Recovery planning activities

Who you are:

• Exhibits a Lean-Agile Mindset

• Manages risks progressively and in a way that leads to opportunity

• Enterprise mindset that can break down silos. Focus on delivery through collaboration, and bringing people together to work towards the same purpose across organizational boundaries.

• Exhibits intellectual curiosity and integrity and has a strong passion for innovation

• Understanding of Roche-supported operating systems, devices and applications, including the Google Suite of Applications, MS Office, etc.

• Experience with ticketing systems and troubleshooting hardware, software and mobile devices.

• Excellent working knowledge of the ITIL v3 processes in an IT service delivery

• Solid written and oral communication skills in German and English.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Sr. specialist, Lab Support
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责/责任
● Ensure that the following works are effectively executed to support LS and QC related business
确保如下工作被有效执行，以支持QC相关业务
⮚ Roche Global digital system aspect, including but not limit to
罗氏全球数字化系统相关，包括但不限于
● Responsible for the deployment of the end-to-end process for BIOVIA (Electronic Lab Notebook). Drive the implementation of QC electronic analytical records and system integration in a project management approach, including formula development, formula testing, formula validation, formula optimization and integration, as well as system interaction testing and application.
负责BIOVIA (Electronic Lab Notebook) 端到端流程的部署。以项目管理的方式逐步推进QC电子分析记录和系统交互建立，包括配方开发，配方测试，配方确认，配方优化和融合，系统交互测试和应用等
● Utilize QbD thinking to ensure end-to-end compliance of Roche's global digital systems. This includes eliminating GMP and Data Integrity risks, simplifying and optimizing processes, and improving Right-First-Time performance.
运用QbD思维，确保罗氏全球数字化系统端到端流程全面合规。包括消除GMP和Data Integrity风险，简化&优化流程，提高Right-First-Time。
● Roche global digital systems directly associated with testing such as BIOVIA, SingleLIMS，Labx, Empower, SAP. Including creation of user processes, using and maintenance; Creation of Master Data/Method and it's processes, using and maintenance etc.
其他罗氏全球数字化系统，如LIMS，Labx，Empower，SAP等的使用和维护等

⮚ Laboratory testing and related work, including but not limited to:
实验室检测及相关工作，包括但不限于
● Inspect and examine samples from processes such as packaging, excipients, finished product manufacturing, in-process control, environmental monitoring, change control, and customer complaints, providing timely and accurate analytical results and reports, as well as supporting trend analysis.
对包装，辅料，成品生产制造、制程控制，环境监测、变更控制和客户投诉等过程中的样品进行检验和检查，提供及时、准确的分析结果和报告以及支持趋势分析。
● Execute and support laboratory investigations of OOS, OOT, OOE, and other production-related issues, ensuring all analytical processes remain in a controlled state.
执行和支持实验室对OOS, OOT, OOE 及其它生产相关问题的调查，确保所有分析过程处于受控状态。
● Assist the laboratory manager in daily sample management, reference standard management, and stability sample management.
协助实验室经理处理日常样品管理、标准品管理、稳定性样品管理。
● Assist in laboratory GMP self-inspections, audits, and related inspection activities. Track the implementation of improvement plans to ensure the laboratory remains compliant with the latest GMP and DI regulations and Roche requirements.
协助实验室GMP 自查、审计等相关检查活动。跟踪改进实施计划，确保维护实验室满足最新GMP和DI法规和Roche要求。

⮚ Local instrument/equipment aspect, including but not limit to
本地仪器/设备相关，包括但不限于
● Management of the lifecycle process for instrument/equipment and execution of related business operations, including verification/validation of instrument/equipment, periodic review, backup/archive/recovery, internal and external calibration and testing, decommissioning, maintenance and repair, contracts and orders, etc.
仪器/设备生命周期流程的管理和相关业务的执行，如仪器/设备的确认和验证，周期性回顾，备份/归档/恢复，内外部的校准和测试，退役，维护和维修，合同和订单等。

● Complete the other tasks assigned by the leader.
完成上级领导布置的其他任务

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/
• Qualifications教育程度/所获资格证书
● Bachelor of Science Degree or above
理学士及以上学位
● Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biochemistry, microbiology and equivalent
药学、化学、生物化学、微生物及相关学科
● At least 4 years of relevant experience in laboratory analysis and/or QC dig

jobs.title: Learning Intern - German speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Learning Intern , you will join our Global Learning Services (GLS) team within the People Support Solutions (PSS) organization in Roche. In this role, you will assist with executing routine administrative and system data maintenance activities in our Learning Management System ( Cornerstone ). You will gain hands-on learning experience in a shared service environment, supporting learning processes and ensuring high-quality, customer-focused support for our global learning community.

Your Key Responsibilities

• System Administration : Execute routine data maintenance and system administrative tasks within Cornerstone and other relevant learning systems in a timely and accurate manner.

• Process Support : Assist with the administrative coordination of various training events, including new employee orientation, leadership training, professional training, and other training requests.

• Customer Support : Help provide customer service and troubleshooting support regarding training records, learning processes, and system inquiries to internal HR experts and business partners.

• Documentation : Assist in keeping team knowledge up to date by contributing to and updating Standard Work Instructions (SWIs) and local Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

• Continuous Improvement : Actively participate in team meetings, workshops, and work-related events to help identify process improvements and support new ways of learning.

• Compliance & Integrity : Perform daily duties with high integrity, adhering to global and local guidelines, including strict data privacy rules and safety, security, and environmental (SHE) regulations.

Who You Are
We are looking for an analytical, proactive and collaborative university students who bring the following skills and competencies:

• Education : Currently enrolled in a university program with active/passive full-time student status in Hungary (studies in HR, Business, or Social Sciences are preferred).

• Able to work 25-30 hrs/week .

• Languages: Fluent English (C1) is required. German (B2-C1) also required.

• System & IT Skills : Experience with standard IT applications (Google Suite or Microsoft) and an eagerness to learn cloud-based learning management software (like Cornerstone).

• Growth Mindset : An agile learner who is open to seeking and giving feedback, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, and capable of navigating complex data.

• Customer Centricity : Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a focus on delivering reliable support and managing customer expectations.

• Collaboration : A supportive team player who enjoys working in a multicultural, cross-border matrix environment.

What We Offer

• Hands-on experience operating Cornerstone and various other tools.

• Deep exposure to a global Shared Service Center environment.

• Competitive salary.

• A collaborative and supportive team environment that values your development and continuous learning.

• Flexible working hours according to your studies.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changi

jobs.title: Medical Affairs Advisor
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose
Roche Diagnostics provides integrated solutions for diagnostics testing in commercial and hospital labs, medical centers and laboratory networks. Our products and solutions support healthcare professionals in clinical decision making in a wide field of indications .
Within the Healthcare Transformation and Access Department, we are seeking a Medical Affairs Advisor Advisor to provide medical and scientific support for our solutions with an initial core focus on Oncology diseases. The Medical Affairs Partner is a field-based medical expert in one or more therapeutic areas, responsible for developing and maintaining relationships with healthcare professionals (HCPs) in order to create a better understanding of products and increase disease/product awareness, providing clinical and scientific support for HCPs, and providing medical information for our products to patients, caregivers, and the general public.

Role scope:

Key responsibilities

• Drives business-aligned medical strategy by leading annual and ongoing medical planning, including inputs on situational analyses and strategies

• Plan and implement medical tactics and activities for assigned therapeutic areas

• Plan and handle medical budgets

• Communicate, drive, and handle clinical research/study for medical evidence generation that helps practitioners, patients and payers make good health care decisions

• Establish and maintain relationships with healthcare professionals (HCPs) to create a better understanding of the company’s products and increase disease/product awareness

• Provide clinical and scientific support for HCPs, including answering questions about products and other related issues

• Prepare and deliver presentations on the therapeutic areas and company products, and participate in panel discussions

• Keep up to date on scientific and clinical developments in the therapeutic areas, and provide medical information to internal and external customers

• Review of non-, and promotional materials

• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and Roche Safety, Security, Health, and Environmental Protection policies, while demonstrating a solid understanding of compliance requirements and upholding the high standard of integrity.

Additional task, duties and responsibilities:

• Responsible for acting in line with legal, regulatory and company standards and codes of practice (such as Roche Code of Conduct and any other Roche directives and guidelines)

• Work in a cross functional setup applying agile working methodology

• Ensure compliance with HCP interaction guidelines (e.g. iHCP) , and other guidelines from Roche quality and compliance groups

Requirements:
Education and experience

• Master’s degree or higher in science or related fields

• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in the life sciences industry (diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, or biotechnology).

• Hands-on experience in medical affairs, clinical development, scientific communication, or product strategy .

• Prior experience in Oncology diseases is highly preferred.

• Good Compliance track record. No material Compliance violation is identified in the past 5 years

Required skills and qualifications

• Good knowledge of Compliance requirements and clear understanding of high standards of Integrity

• Scientific and commercial understanding of diagnostic products, knowledge of product development and tri

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose
Roche Diagnostics provides integrated solutions for diagnostics testing in commercial and hospital labs, medical centers and laboratory networks. Our products and solutions support healthcare professionals in clinical decision making in a wide field of indications .
Within the Healthcare Transformation and Access Department, we are seeking a Medical Affairs Advisor Advisor to provide medical and scientific support for our solutions with an initial core focus on Oncology diseases. The Medical Affairs Partner is a field-based medical expert in one or more therapeutic areas, responsible for developing and maintaining relationships with healthcare professionals (HCPs) in order to create a better understanding of products and increase disease/product awareness, providing clinical and scientific support for HCPs, and providing medical information for our products to patients, caregivers, and the general public.

Role scope:

Key responsibilities

• Drives business-aligned medical strategy by leading annual and ongoing medical planning, including inputs on situational analyses and strategies

• Plan and implement medical tactics and activities for assigned therapeutic areas

• Plan and handle medical budgets

• Communicate, drive, and handle clinical research/study for medical evidence generation that helps practitioners, patients and payers make good health care decisions

• Establish and maintain relationships with healthcare professionals (HCPs) to create a better understanding of the company’s products and increase disease/product awareness

• Provide clinical and scientific support for HCPs, including answering questions about products and other related issues

• Prepare and deliver presentations on the therapeutic areas and company products, and participate in panel discussions

• Keep up to date on scientific and clinical developments in the therapeutic areas, and provide medical information to internal and external customers

• Review of non-, and promotional materials

• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and Roche Safety, Security, Health, and Environmental Protection policies, while demonstrating a solid understanding of compliance requirements and upholding the high standard of integrity.

Additional task, duties and responsibilities:

• Responsible for acting in line with legal, regulatory and company standards and codes of practice (such as Roche Code of Conduct and any other Roche directives and guidelines)

• Work in a cross functional setup applying agile working methodology

• Ensure compliance with HCP interaction guidelines (e.g. iHCP) , and other guidelines from Roche quality and compliance groups

Requirements:
Education and experience

• Master’s degree or higher in science or related fields

• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in the life sciences industry (diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, or biotechnology).

• Hands-on experience in medical affairs, clinical development, scientific communication, or product strategy .

• Prior experience in Oncology diseases is highly preferred.

• Good Compliance track record. No material Compliance violation is identified in the past 5 years

Required skills and qualifications

• Good knowledge of Compliance requirements and clear understanding of high standards of Integrity

• Scientific and commercial understanding of diagnostic products, knowledge of product development and tri

titleByLocale.it: Guida del catalizzatore del valore di AI

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
This role serves as a strategic leader driving the scaling and value acceleration of Roche’s AI and digital healthcare solutions from “10 to 100.” You will lead a hybrid team of AI Solution Catalyst Managers and Incubator & Partnership Managers to expand application scenarios, accelerate ecosystem adoption, and strengthen Roche’s leadership positioning in AI & Digital
healthcare through ecosystem collaboration and innovation initiatives. The mandate is anchored in two core pillars:
1. AI Solution Value Amplification & Scaling
Accelerating the adoption, expansion, and measurable value realization of Roche’s established AI and digital solutions across internal and external healthcare ecosystems.
2. Ecosystem Architecture & Policy Shaping
Building strategic partnerships, influencing healthcare innovation dialogue, and shaping policy and ecosystem mechanisms that enable sustainable AI healthcare transformation.

Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. AI Solution Value Amplification & Scaling
Lead the strategic scaling and value acceleration of Roche AI and digital healthcare solutions by expanding application scenarios, accelerating ecosystem adoption, and establishing scalable value realization models.
➢ Scaling Strategy, Scenario Expansion & Product Generalization:
Drive the “10 to 100” scaling strategy for Roche AI and digital solutions by identifying scalable application scenarios, healthcare customer groups, and ecosystem opportunities, while translating successful pilots into reusable healthcare solution models.
➢ Customer Adoption & Value Realization:
Drive the adoption and integration of Roche AI solutions across hospitals, HCPs, and ecosystem partners through effective deployment strategies, value demonstration frameworks, and measurable clinical and business impact validation.
➢ Strategic Storytelling & Scaling Optimization:
Translate complex AI capabilities into compelling healthcare and business narratives while leveraging real-world insights and ecosystem feedback to continuously optimize solution positioning and scaling strategy.
2. Ecosystem Architecture, Policy Shaping & Healthcare Value Acceleration
Architect and orchestrate a sustainable healthcare innovation ecosystem that accelerates AI solution value release through strategic partnerships, ecosystem collaboration, innovation platforms, and policy engagement.
➢ Healthcare Ecosystem Architecture & Digital Intelligence Incubator Leadership:
Build strategic collaborations with hospitals, academic institutions and other ecosystem stakeholders. Through the Digital Intelligence Incubator, connect healthcare scenarios, validation resources, ecosystem partners to accelerate solution maturation and value realization.
➢ Healthcare Value Model Exploration & Policy Shaping:
Explore innovative healthcare value frameworks, collaboration mechanisms, reimbursement pathways, and policy engagement opportunities that unlock sustainable value creation for patients and healthcare systems.
➢ Innovation Platform, External Engagement & Thought Leadership:
Lead ecosystem collaborations, and strategic engagement initiatives [e.g., WAIC, CIIE…] to strengthen Roche’s leadership positioning in AI & Digital healthcare and identify future ecosystem opportunities.
3. Team Leadership & Capability Development
Manage and mentor a hybrid team composed of AI Solution Catalyst Managers and Incubator & Partnership Managers to accelerate AI solution scaling, ecosystem collabor

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst - Monitoring & Incident Response
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Cybersecurity Analyst (Incident Response Operations)

The Global Security Monitoring and Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche strives to keep our networks and users safe from constantly evolving threats. As a CyberSecurity Analyst, you will help protect proprietary information, patient data, keep computer systems clean, and provide a safe information environment for our users. Combing through massive amounts of signals, you will have to identify signs of abuse or compromise of on-premise as well as cloud resources. All team members share a set of core responsibilities, handling incidents, requests from experts, as well as enquiries from end users. CyberSecurity Analysts are responsible for monitoring security information, identifying threats, and showing initiative to defend all Roche information systems.

As an incident responder, you are expected to take part in an on call rotation during weekends and can be mobilized during major incidents.

Responsibilities:

• Monitoring and Incident Response for a global environment

• Take decisions, often under pressure, given partial information

• Contribute to proactive threat detection efforts

• Lead containment and remediation efforts during active security incidents

• Perform forensic analysis of relevant artifacts to support investigations

• Contribute to detection engineering activities across a global team

• Brief team members and leadership on relevant threats to the Roche group

• Communicate information security concepts and situations to senior management

• Contribute operational feedback to continuously strengthen detection and response processes

• Mentor newer team members

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in a technical field and 7+ years of experience in information security, including at least 3 years in a SOC/CERT/CSIRT environment

• Familiarity with TLP and information sharing best practices

• Ability to communicate information security-related concepts and situations to a non-technical audience

• Demonstrated ability to analyze, triage, and escalate information security incidents

• Knowledge of detection engineering and threat-hunting concepts

• Scripting and programming skills (Python, Javascript, Go, Rust, …)

• Demonstrated knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOs)

• Excellent organization and communication skills.

• Fluent spoken and written English

Preferred Qualifications:

• Network and Endpoint security monitoring experience in a large complex environment

• Prior exposure to privacy frameworks in the context of IT security monitoring

• Knowledge of modern IAM controls and concepts (Zero Trust, Identity Aware Proxies, Active Directory Security, …)

• Knowledge of Cloud security concepts (multi-cloud environments, CSPM, …)

• A passion for the field of computer and network security

• Familiarity with various defensive AND offensive security toolsets

• Public speaking or mentoring experience

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build

As a CyberSecurity Analyst, you will help protect proprietary information, patient data, keep computer systems clean, and provide a safe information environment for our users. Combing through massive amounts of signals, you will have to identify signs of abuse or compromise of on-premise as well as cloud resources. All team members share a set of core responsibilities, handling incidents, requests from experts, as well as enquiries from end users. CyberSecurity Analysts are responsible for monitoring security information, identifying threats, and showing initiative to defend all Roche information systems.

As an incident responder, you are expected to take part in an on call rotation during weekends and can be mobilized during major incidents.

Responsibilities:

• Monitoring and Incident Response for a global environment

• Take decisions, often under pressure, given partial information

• Contribute to proactive threat detection efforts

• Lead containment and remediation efforts during active security incidents

• Perform forensic analysis of relevant artifacts to support investigations

• Contribute to detection engineering activities across a global team

• Brief team members and leadership on relevant threats to the Roche group

• Communicate information security concepts and situations to senior management

• Contribute operational feedback to continuously strengthen detection and response processes

• Mentor newer team members

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in a technical field and 7+ years of experience in information security, including at least 3 years in a SOC/CERT/CSIRT environment

• Familiarity with TLP and information sharing best practices

• Ability to communicate information security-related concepts and situations to a non-technical audience

• Demonstrated ability to analyze, triage, and escalate information security incidents

• Knowledge of detection engineering and threat-hunting concepts

• Scripting and programming skills (Python, Javascript, Go, Rust, …)

• Demonstrated knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOs)

• Excellent organization and communication skills.

• Fluent spoken and written English

Preferred Qualifications:

• Network and Endpoint security monitoring experience in a large complex environment

• Prior exposure to privacy frameworks in the context of IT security monitoring

• Knowledge of modern IAM controls and concepts (Zero Trust, Identity Aware Proxies, Active Directory Security, …)

• Knowledge of Cloud security concepts (multi-cloud environments, CSPM, …)

• A passion for the field of computer and network security

• Familiarity with various defensive AND offensive security toolsets

• Public speaking or mentoring experience

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

jobs.title: Medical Communication Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
This role serves as a hybrid strategic leader, combining the leadership of a composite team (comprising Medical Information & Medical Review and AI Product) with the development of a data- and AI-driven medical communication strategy.
The mandate is anchored in establishing a "data-driven medical communication flywheel": leveraging AI to proactively capture customer perception insights, building personalized content generation platforms, and developing localized digital education platforms to empower strategic business decisions. Furthermore, the role drives the transformation of traditional MI and MR business models through the introduction of Agent technologies, forging a new paradigm of human-machine collaboration in medical inquiries and automated pre-approvals to accelerate internal process efficiencies and support high-quality business growth under strict compliance standards.

Principal Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. AI-Driven Strategy & Flywheel Construction Development and execution of a long-term, data-centric medical communication strategy, ensuring strict alignment with overarching business goals.

• Proactive Insight Generation: Leadership in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Social Listening) to proactively capture and analyze customer behaviors and perceptions, identifying market trends and opportunities to provide data-backed support for business decisions.

• Content Generation Platform & Impact: Establishment of a robust content generation platform to significantly accelerate the production speed of high-quality medical education materials. Leadership in the rapid construction of core scientific messaging and educational content derived from AI-driven insights to effectively influence and transform customer perceptions and clinical behaviors.

• Personalized Platform Development: Oversight of the construction of personalized content generation platforms and localized digital education platforms to ensure the medical value proposition is delivered precisely and efficiently based on targeted user personas.

2. Digital Product & Solution Leadership Lead the development, evolution, and ecosystem cooperation for strategic digital assets, ensuring they deliver measurable value to patients and the healthcare system.

• Portfolio Lifecycle Management: Oversee the roadmap and execution of key AI solutions, specifically, Social Listening, Content Generation, Digital Communication, MI Agent, and MR Agent.

• Agile Iteration: Driving the continuous iteration of cutting-edge technologies, such as Large Language Models (LLMs), within medical communication scenarios to optimize product performance in an evolving market landscape.

3. AI Agent Innovation & Human-Machine Collaboration

• Traditional Business Transformation: Leading the introduction and deployment of MI Agents and MR Agents to fundamentally revolutionize traditional medical information inquiries and compliance review workflows.

• Model Innovation: Establishment of a human-machine collaboration model for medical Q&A (MI Agent) and automated pre-approvals (MR Agent) to achieve a quantum leap in business responsiveness while ensuring 100% adherence to regulatory and compliance requirements.

4. Team Leadership & Capability Development Management and mentorship of a hybrid team of MI/MR and AI Product.

• Team Synergy: Elimination of functional barrier between traditional medical communication operations and technical product management

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Position
Wir suchen innerhalb der Funktion QC Packaging Material & Devices als Teil der Qualitätskontrolle BS/KAU ein neues Teammitglied für die Unit Packaging Speed Testing. Das Team Packaging Speed Testing überprüft die Qualität der Packmaterialien (z.B. Faltschachteln, Spritzen, Autoinjektoren), bevor diese im Verpackungsbetrieb, Entwicklung, Clinical Supply oder in den Abfüllbetrieben eingesetzt werden können.

Die Möglichkeit

• Durchführung von Packmittel Prüfungen gemäss Prüfvorschriften und Prüfmethoden

• Anwendung physikalischer Prüfmethoden nach Vorgaben in Prüfvorschriften

• Sicherstellung der strikten Einhaltung der guten Herstellungspraxis (cGMP)

• Bedienung einfacher Geräte sowie Initialisierung von Musterzügen

• Dokumentation der Prüfergebnisse im SAP. System. Vergleich von Messwerten mit der Spezifikation und Dokumentation der Ergebnisse.

• Durchführen von Chargenreview

• Projektleitung: Verbesserungsprojekte, Selbstorganisation, 5S, Prozessoptimierungen, Innovationen und Investitionen

• Weiterentwicklung der Selbstorganisation beider Circles

• Organisationsentwicklung durch “out of the box” thinking

Wer du bist

• Technische Ausbildung mit mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung sowie Berufserfahrung im GxP-Bereich

• Interesse, neue technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen

• Kommunikative und entscheidungsfreudige Persönlichkeit mit Überzeugungskraft und Durchsetzungsvermögen, Freude an einer selbständigen und initiativen Tätigkeit

• Gute Kenntnisse in Qualitätssystemen und cGMP

• Deutsch fliessend in Wort und Schrift

jobs.title: Medical Director (MD), Multiple Sclerosis
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche's Clinical Development organization is structured by therapeutic area and is responsible for developing and executing late-stage development (Phase II–III) clinical strategies that deliver medically differentiated therapies for patients. We are seeking a highly motivated Medical Director (grading commensurate with experience) to join our Neuroimmunology team, specifically focusing on Multiple Sclerosis (MS).

The Opportunity

As a Medical Director, you will participate in or lead the development of Clinical Development (CD) plans, ensuring the effective execution of strategies for assigned molecules and indications. This is a junior to mid-level individual contributor position without people management responsibilities. The Opportunity
To help us deliver life-changing therapies to patients, you will take on a vital role in our Neuroimmunology team and drive the following key responsibilities:

• CDP Strategy and Planning: Lead or contribute to the creation of the Clinical Development Plan (CDP), gathering data to ensure strategic alignment with long-term lifecycle plans.

• Study Design and Execution: Lead the design and execution of Phase II and III clinical studies, collaborating with cross-functional teams on study analytics, data management, and safety profiles.

• Scientific Leadership: Maintain the highest levels of scientific and clinical knowledge within the MS and Neuroimmunology therapeutic areas.

• Regulatory Engagement: Take an active role in Health Authority (HA) interactions and provide clinical expertise for regulatory filings, briefing packages, and labeling.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Build and cultivate relationships with clinical investigators, Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), and internal partners across research, commercial operations, and legal.

• Medical Monitoring: Act as a medical monitor for assigned studies, ensuring the correct interpretation of medical and scientific data.

Who You Are

We are looking for a resilient, scientifically driven expert who brings a blend of advanced clinical knowledge and collaborative leadership to our team:

• Academic & Clinical Expertise: M.D. required with relevant clinical experience as a Neurologist, including specialized training or a significant background working with Multiple Sclerosis patients.

• Scientific & Industry Experience: Strong scientific background (publishing in peer-reviewed journals, academic, or teaching background is a plus) alongside preferred prior industry experience in MS clinical development (>2 years) or recognition as an MS field expert (e.g., Assistant Professor).

• Clinical Trials & Regulatory Knowledge: Significant experience designing/conducting clinical trials, a strong understanding of Phase II–III drug development, and required knowledge of GCP, ICH, FDA, and EMA guidelines (preferred for entry-level candidates).

• Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills to present complex data, paired with the ability to build relationships and influence without authority in a complex, cross-functional environment.

• Strategic Leadership & Mobility: Sound judgment for ethical and business decision-making, strong cross-functional leadership acumen, and the ability to travel globally up to 30%.

Ready for the next step? We look forward to hearing from you. Apply now to discover this exciting opportunity!

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Regional Account Specialist - Mass Spectrometry

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity:
The Regional Account Specialist - Mass Spectrometry is specialized in launching, selling and promoting our breakthrough Mass Spectrometry solution to customers in the territory. Implements sales plans designed to achieve established revenue and financial goals. Accounts are key, highly strategic, and have complex requirements.

Responsible for significant key partner relationship management and development strategy for strategic accounts and ensures the strategy is executed. Sells the company's products or services to new accounts and/or expands existing accounts. Responsible for the development of new business opportunities or emerging areas. Focuses on critical, large, complex, highly visible, strategic or tactically important accounts. Develops and presents comprehensive financial proposals and contracts which enhance profitability and protect margins. Works in coordination with Account Managers to call on prospective and current customers. Conducts demonstration sessions on product characteristics. Involves technical personnel to resolve customer issues and problems as needed. May participate in the establishment of sales targets and design of the territory's sales plan, manages sales expenses.

Has broad expertise or unique knowledge in the lab testing segment and specific LC/MS experience is preferred. Uses skills to contribute to development of company objectives and principles and to achieve goals in creative and effective ways. Viewed as an expert by the company and in the field. Has complete knowledge of all Mass Spectrometry products and services and may be tasked with sales/development of new or strategic products. Works on significant and unique issues where analysis of situations or data requires an evaluation of intangibles. Exercises independent judgment in methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Creates formal networks involving coordination among groups.

This is a field based role. The territory is Midwest US.

Job Facts:

• Manages and leads the development and implementation of capital equipment sales strategies to attain assigned sales objectives for highly strategic accounts

• Provides professional leadership in planning, organizing, and controlling balanced sales growth, continued account penetration, and customer satisfaction.

• Utilizes strong product/market knowledge and sales experience to manage complex sales and resolve customer questions and concerns.

• Retains, extends, and acquires customers through effective identification of opportunities and the creation and implementation of solutions.

• Establishes and builds strong client relationships that allow for growth, profitability and predictability. Communicates with other relevant Roche functions to ensure needed sales support and delivery of programs/products.

• Overnight travel as needed, including short notice, to most effectively and efficiently cover territory while maximizing customer facing time.

• Navigates the financial landscape of complex health systems, helping them to maximize their capital budget cycles to achieve growth goals

Who you are:

• Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

• 7+
