jobs.title: P&C Business Partner (Advisory) - German speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
What we do:
The People Support Solutions (PSS) organization brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated HR solutions tailored to their needs. We are a team that works very closely together to ensure good employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions. Join us now and be part of our unique transformational journey: we are building a global People & Culture (P&C/HR) Center of Excellence by bringing in talented HR professionals in order to cover complex and challenging HR functions and areas.

The Opportunity:
As a German speaking People & Culture (P&C) Business Partner (Advisory) you partner flexibly and mostly virtually with leaders across the globe, offering on-demand, ad-hoc support on Business Partnering topics that need more immediate or short-term guidance and value creation. With a good understanding of the business needs and the business context and an excellent ability to apply key P&C concepts, policies and processes, you provide coaching, guidance and support to leaders to help them diagnose and translate their business needs into immediate P&C approaches and ensure effective implementation of solutions in partnership with other chapters. You are a trusted member of the Business Partner Chapter and closely integrated into the PSS organization.
Your day to day responsibilities are:

• Strategic Guidance: Provide on-demand coaching and advisory to global leaders on critical P&C topics, including talent management, succession planning, performance management, and organizational design.

• Transformation Support: Lead and advise on complex organizational changes, transformations, and employee representation topics, ensuring risk-based decision-making and compliance with established policies.

• Global Rollouts: Deliver first-class support and coaching during the implementation of new global processes and projects, such as global grading systems or new system launches.

• Data-Driven Insights: Analyze P&C metrics and business data to recommend innovative solutions and provide insights that support our culture and strategic direction.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with global/regional squads and PSS chapters to ensure the seamless execution of P&C initiatives and consistent policy application.

​
Who You Are:

• Experienced HR Professional: You bring 3–7 years of experience in similar roles such as HR Business Partnering, People Relations, or Labor Law.

• Bilingual Expert: You possess an excellent written and spoken command of both English and German, enabling you to support the DACH region and global stakeholders effectively.

• Skilled Coach & Communicator: You have a proven ability to provide difficult feedback, resolve conflicts, and influence leaders at all levels of management.

• Strategic Thinker: You can thoughtfully diagnose business needs, weigh the risks and benefits of various options, and propose fit-for-purpose HR approaches.

• You demonstrate strong knowledge in interpreting employment laws and policies, ensuring all solutions are legally sound and culturally sensitive.

• Agile Mindset: You thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, demonstrating high customer centricity, end-to-end accountability, and a passion for continuous learning.

• Relationship Builder: You are a natural networker who excels at navigating complex, matrixed reporting relationships across multiple cultures.

In Exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Are you seeking an exciting challenge in a critical support role that directly contributes to the vital NHS Pathology services, where your work truly matters and makes a meaningful impact?

Does the prospect of a rewarding career with a progressive, high-tech organisation inspire you?

Key Information

• Supporting Southern Counties Pathology Network (South 6)

• Ideal for experienced field engineers, with strong diagnostic service/support background

• Primary focus support for electro-mechanical hardware, including routine proactive and reactive maintenance.

• Additional responsibilities in applications support, IT support, and customer training

• Must reside in or be willing to relocate to the Hampshire/Dorset area

About the Role

Roche Diagnostics is seeking an experienced Electro-Mechanical Engineer to join our team as a Field Service Representative in the South region (Hampshire/Dorset area) directly supporting customers in NHS pathology laboratories.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide frontline support across various Roche product portfolio at customer sites.

• Troubleshoot and taking ownership of technical faults

• Minimise unplanned downtime of laboratory equipment

• Use of digital tools for proactive preventative measures

• Conduct training for laboratory staff

Required Qualifications and Skills

• Ideally, degree-educated in Life Sciences OR qualified to HNC/HND level in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or with equivalent demonstrable experience - you will bring a current and comprehensive understanding of the IVD industry, paired with strong experience in delivering world-class support

• E xcellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

• Strong communication and teamwork abilities

• Resilient and tenacious, able to thrive under pressure

• Growth mindset

For this position, the location is in the Hampshire/Dorset area.

You will be expected to collaborate with the wider team and all other areas of Roche to provide best-in-class service to our customers. Amongst other duties, this will involve attending customer review meetings to outline key achievements and objectives attained.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity.

The opportunity

As a Country Chief Accountant you will be accountable for the financial statements prepared for the affiliate and will coordinate with RSS (Roche Services & Solutions) Budapest Finance teams (Demand to Pay, Record to Report, Travel and Expense, Compliance) and execute month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with the month-end close checklist.

R2R

• Overseeing financial accuracy and internal controls, including ICFR documentation and tools management.

• Conducting balance sheet reconciliation, anomaly rectification, and ensuring timely and quality financial statement reporting / month-end closing, yearly reporting

• Managing accounting aspects such as IFRS 16 Leasing, manual journal entries, and management accounting activities.

• Supervising Accounts Receivables, including billings approval, debtors aging, and sales reporting accuracy.

• Handling cash flow management and treasury matters, including fund forecasting, transfers, and banking transactions.

DtP

• Handling all accounts payable related matters

Master Data

• Managing master data - Chart of Accounts, Cost Center, Profit Center. WBS, vendor & customer master data, UCI, etc.

Other

• Overseeing statutory tax calculations, reconciliation, reporting, and Tax Consultant liaison, alongside managing external financial audits

• Managing financial compliance, internal controls on financial reporting

• Serving as central contact for RSS Budapest Finance teams and Finance Managers in the affiliates, addressing financial issues, requests, and advisory needs

Who you are:

• University education; preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline, ACCA or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage

• 8 years of experience in a related field and at least 5 years in accountant / audit role and people management experience

• Knowledge of accounting principles and practices; financial reporting, audit, and taxation, including local accounting principles as advantage

• Proficiency in accounting software, preferably SAP and MS Office

• Demonstrates effective leadership abilities and advocacy, while empowering colleagues in decision-making

• Proven track record in relationship and stakeholder management across diverse groups, with strong negotiation and influencing skills

• Proficiency in English and Bulgarian

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support fle

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior Solution Architect will design business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions to enable Roche’s omnichannel orchestration capabilities. This role focuses on building and scaling an integrated ecosystem leveraging Adobe Experience Platform (RT-CDP, AJO, CJA), ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, data strategy, and governance standards.
You will operate within a complex, multi-solution environment, driving the architecture vision across data, platforms, and activation use cases. The role requires balancing current delivery needs with long-term scalability, while ensuring robust handling of non-functional requirements (NFRs), data privacy, and system performance.

Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

Architecture & Design

• Define end-to-end omnichannel architecture aligned with business and enterprise standards

• Establish data models, identity frameworks, and integration patterns

• Manage NFRs (performance, scalability, security, compliance)

Data & Integration

• Integrate CRM, MDM, consent, and web/app event data
Enable unified customer profiles and audience segmentation

• Ensure data quality, governance, and privacy compliance

Platform (Adobe Stack)

• Architect and guide implementation of RT-CDP, AJO, and CJA

• Enable real-time segmentation, journey orchestration, and activation

• Ensure seamless integration with enterprise systems

Real-time & Orchestration

• Design event-driven and streaming architectures

• Enable multi-channel activation (email, paid media, others)

• Establish reusable audience and journey frameworks

Strategy & Delivery

• Define architecture roadmap and support delivery across use cases

• Identify risks, dependencies, and optimization opportunities

• Drive adoption of best practices, patterns, and new technologies

Stakeholder Management

• Collaborate across business, product, and tech teams

• Communicate complex concepts clearly and drive alignment

Qualifications

Experience

• Proven experience in solution architecture within data and martech ecosystems

• Experience with CDPs and omnichannel platforms (Adobe preferred)

• Experience working in global, cross-functional teams

• Certifications on Adobe stack - (AJO, CJA and RT-CDP)

Technical Skills

• Strong understanding of:

• Customer data platforms, identity resolution, segmentation

• Event-driven / streaming architectures

• Integration with CRM, MDM, consent systems

• Experience with APIs, cloud data platforms, and data governance concepts (GDPR)

What Success Looks Like

• Scalable omnichannel architecture aligned with enterprise standards

• Reliable data foundation enabling unified profiles and segmentation

• Real-time orchestration and activation across channels

• Measurable business impact through improved customer engagement

• Strong stakeholder alignment through clear communication and effective translation of complex concepts into business value

• Ability to influence and drive adoption of architectural decisions across cross-functional teams

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so w

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for you to join Roche and our Services & Solutions Center in Budapest.

Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. This is the reason why we are continuously expanding, looking for new talents join our transforming Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework (2 office days/week on average).

What your key responsibilities will be:

• Vendor creation/maintenance in SAP

• Bank maintenance in SAP

• Vendor Request validation and approval

• Participation in data cleansing activities

• Replication monitoring

What you should bring to our company:

• Ongoing Hungarian University studies

• Able to work at least 30 hours per week

• Fluent English

• Knowledge of MS Office

• SAP knowledge is a plus

Why you should join us:

• Valuable professional experience

• Competitive salary

• Flexible working hours according to your studies

• Support for university thesis writing

• Training opportunities

• Free language courses

• Good, accessible location

• Great, people-focused company culture

• Social events & team-building opportunities

• Opportunity for full time role after graduation

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Spécialiste du service client
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Spécialiste du service client
Lieu: Campus Roche Diagnostics (Laval) - Hybride
Durée : contrat d'un an

Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. À faire progresser continuellement la science et à garantir à tous l'accès aux soins de santé dont ils ont besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les personnes que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche.

Nous recherchons un(e) spécialiste du service client pour rejoindre notre équipe et avoir un impact significatif sur notre organisation. En tant que spécialiste du service client, vous aurez l'occasion de développer des relations de confiance solides avec nos précieux clients, en veillant à une expérience d'approvisionnement positive.

En identifiant proactivement les besoins des clients et en collaborant avec notre équipe, vous contribuerez à améliorer et à adapter l'expérience globale du client. Vos solides compétences en leadership et en influence vous permettront de remettre en question le statu quo et de rechercher l'efficacité, en faisant des recommandations qui garantissent un service fiable et constant. Par-dessus tout, vos compétences exceptionnelles en communication et votre capacité d'écoute active seront la clé de la réussite dans ce rôle.
Rejoignez notre équipe et saisissez cette opportunité passionnante pour une croissance personnelle et professionnelle. Postulez maintenant et laissez votre passion pour des expériences client exceptionnelles briller en tant que spécialiste du service client.

L'opportunité

• Vous gérez les solutions de lots réservés pour tous les clients du Canada, en veillant au respect des politiques et des procédures de Roche. En collaboration étroite avec l'équipe de planification de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, vous vous assurez de l'exactitude des données et de la gestion des demandes des clients, des renouvellements et de la maintenance des contrats pour assurer un flux de commandes efficace.

• Vous êtes responsable de l'analyse et de la communication avec les clients concernant les problèmes de lots réservés, ainsi que de la transmission des besoins des clients à l'équipe de planification.

• Vous gérez des comptes spécialisés avec des exceptions logistiques, en maintenant et en gérant des "accords planifiés" pour tous les clients/territoires afin d'assurer des niveaux élevés d'exactitude des données.

• Vous prenez les appels des clients et apportez un soutien à leurs demandes, en collaborant avec les équipes régionales pour offrir une expérience d'approvisionnement exceptionnelle.

• Vous comprenez les plaintes logistiques des clients et vous efforcez de trouver des solutions satisfaisantes. Vous identifiez et proposez des améliorations aux processus manuels et aux tâches de service client sans valeur ajoutée.

• Vous êtes responsable des ajustements de facture (crédits/débits) conformément aux procédures, le cas échéant.

• Vous analysez les rapports quotidiens, élaborez des plans d'action pour traiter les commandes en cours et communiquez tout retard ou changement de délai de livraison et de traitement aux clients à des fins de planification.

Qui vous êtes

• Vous possédez un diplôme collégial ou un diplôme universitaire (administration ou commerce préférable).

• Vous possédez au moins 3 ans d'expérience en service à la clientèle dans le domaine des soins de santé ou des sciences de la vie.

• Vous faites preuve de compétences en leadership et avez une passion pour la collab

Lieu: Campus Roche Diagnostics (Laval) - Hybride
Durée : contrat d'un an

Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. À faire progresser continuellement la science et à garantir à tous l'accès aux soins de santé dont ils ont besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les personnes que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche.

Nous recherchons un(e) spécialiste du service client pour rejoindre notre équipe et avoir un impact significatif sur notre organisation. En tant que spécialiste du service client, vous aurez l'occasion de développer des relations de confiance solides avec nos précieux clients, en veillant à une expérience d'approvisionnement positive.

En identifiant proactivement les besoins des clients et en collaborant avec notre équipe, vous contribuerez à améliorer et à adapter l'expérience globale du client. Vos solides compétences en leadership et en influence vous permettront de remettre en question le statu quo et de rechercher l'efficacité, en faisant des recommandations qui garantissent un service fiable et constant. Par-dessus tout, vos compétences exceptionnelles en communication et votre capacité d'écoute active seront la clé de la réussite dans ce rôle.
Rejoignez notre équipe et saisissez cette opportunité passionnante pour une croissance personnelle et professionnelle. Postulez maintenant et laissez votre passion pour des expériences client exceptionnelles briller en tant que spécialiste du service client.

L'opportunité

• Vous gérez les solutions de lots réservés pour tous les clients du Canada, en veillant au respect des politiques et des procédures de Roche. En collaboration étroite avec l'équipe de planification de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, vous vous assurez de l'exactitude des données et de la gestion des demandes des clients, des renouvellements et de la maintenance des contrats pour assurer un flux de commandes efficace.

• Vous êtes responsable de l'analyse et de la communication avec les clients concernant les problèmes de lots réservés, ainsi que de la transmission des besoins des clients à l'équipe de planification.

• Vous gérez des comptes spécialisés avec des exceptions logistiques, en maintenant et en gérant des "accords planifiés" pour tous les clients/territoires afin d'assurer des niveaux élevés d'exactitude des données.

• Vous prenez les appels des clients et apportez un soutien à leurs demandes, en collaborant avec les équipes régionales pour offrir une expérience d'approvisionnement exceptionnelle.

• Vous comprenez les plaintes logistiques des clients et vous efforcez de trouver des solutions satisfaisantes. Vous identifiez et proposez des améliorations aux processus manuels et aux tâches de service client sans valeur ajoutée.

• Vous êtes responsable des ajustements de facture (crédits/débits) conformément aux procédures, le cas échéant.

• Vous analysez les rapports quotidiens, élaborez des plans d'action pour traiter les commandes en cours et communiquez tout retard ou changement de délai de livraison et de traitement aux clients à des fins de planification.

Qui vous êtes

• Vous possédez un diplôme collégial ou un diplôme universitaire (administration ou commerce préférable).

• Vous possédez au moins 3 ans d'expérience en service à la clientèle dans le domaine des soins de santé ou des sciences de la vie.

• Vous faites preuve de compétences en leadership et avez une passion pour la collab

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

This role offers the opportunity to support our Donor Screening business, which plays a critical role in detecting antibodies and antigens to aid in diagnosing infections, ensuring blood safety, and monitoring immune responses.

The Opportunity:
Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist you will:

• Showcase your expertise in technical repair for Roche assigned product lines.

• Offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• Provide routine technical support, on-site service and repair of Roche products.

• Serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• Diagnose and resolve mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• Document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

This field-based role requires up to 25% travel. This person will support Hoover, AL.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or equivalent work experience

• 5 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking OR a Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or related field plus 1-2 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing complex mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking

• Successfully training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy

• Ability to travel, including some overnight travel, is required

Preferred Qualifications:

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Hoover, AL is 71,100.00 - 132,000.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower ea

jobs.title: Head of Customer Engagement & Marketing
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

• The Head of Customer Engagement & Marketing is a pivotal executive role within the Roche Turkey Leadership Team, entrusted with holistically architecting, leading, and executing the commercial vision and go-to-market strategies for the company's entire pharmaceutical portfolio.

This role functions as the "Chief Commercial Conductor," orchestrating and unifying both the strategic business units (Disease Area Teams) and the central marketing capabilities that serve them (Marketing Leads / Marketing Chapter) under a single, cohesive vision.

This leader directly manages and develops two distinct leadership groups: the Disease Area (DA) Leads and the Marketing Leads. Through the DA Leads, they hold ultimate accountability for the therapeutic area strategies and full P&L outcomes. Concurrently, through the Marketing Leads, they are responsible for embedding marketing excellence, fostering state-of-the-art capabilities, and ensuring the agile, strategic allocation of marketing resources across the entire Organization.

The fundamental purpose of this role is to build a seamless bridge between high-level strategy and flawless execution. By leveraging a deep strategic partnership with the Medical, Access, Regulatory & Government affairs, as well as the Business Excellence Division, this leader will ensure Roche achieves its ambitious market leadership and patient impact goals.

Core Responsibilities and Accountabilities

1. Integrated Commercial, Access, Medical, and Government Affairs strategy & execution:

• Architect and drive the overarching commercial strategy for all Disease Areas, ensuring the creation of integrated, omnichannel marketing and sales plans that are executed with excellence in the field.

• Lead portfolio-level strategic planning, including lifecycle management, competitive readiness, and new asset launch sequencing to maximize the long-term commercial value and patient impact of Roche’s portfolio.

• Assume ultimate ownership of commercial forecasting in partnership with finance, resource allocation, and budget management to ensure financial targets are met, and investments yield maximum ROI.

•
2. Disease Area (DA) P&L and Performance Leadership:

• Provide strategic direction, coaching, and empowerment to the DA Leads, holding full P&L accountability for the entire commercial organization. Drive the achievement of ambitious revenue growth, market share, and profitability targets.

• Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, and urgency within the DA teams, ensuring they remain laser-focused on overcoming obstacles and achieving their strategic objectives.

• Ensure DA teams have the necessary resources, capabilities, and cross-functional support to win in their respective markets.

•
3. Marketing Capability & Excellence (Marketing Lead) Leadership:

• Lead and cultivate the central Marketing Leads (Marketing Chapter) team, acting as the chief steward of marketing talent and capability within the organization.

• Take direct responsibility for the professional development, career progression, performance management, and succession planning for the marketing talent pool.

• Implement a dynamic resource allocation model, ensuring marketing expertise is deployed fluidly and effectively to the highest-priority strategic initiatives within the DA teams.

• Champion and embed a culture of marketing excellence across the organization, setting the gold standard for brand planning, digital marketing, data analytics, customer journey mapping,

jobs.title: Patient Solution Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
职位名称：患者解决方案经理

您是谁：
患者解决方案经理是相应疾病领域 HCP(医疗专业人士)的主要接触点,负责制定患者整体解决方案相关的策略和相关项目的支持和执行工作,包含但不限于患者全程管理、创新支付解决方案、疾病认知(患者教育)、准入及安全运营以及上市前后产品的学术平台搭建等,从而提升标准化诊疗水平,提高患者知晓率和可及性,从而实现患者获益。

您的机会：
患者全程管理
1.在生态圈内绘制患者就医流转图,从而更好的推动全程管理在医院内/间的落地。
2.协助生态圈内医院及相关科室推进和打造会诊通道,协助上下层医院间衔接流转,助力绿色转诊通道的建立,最终实现患者获益。
3.管理生态圈内患者全程管理项目的各项落地实施,并确保其合规性。

支付方案
与准入团队合作,协助整合罗氏相关支付方案,传递完整支付解决方案信息。

疾病认知(患者教育)
与第三方机构协作,针对相关疾病领域区域现状及整体策略,协助开展患者教育,提升疾病认知,促进患者获益。

我们期待这样的您加入：
• 成长性思维和快速学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 优秀的沟和资源整合能力
• 5年以上医药行业工作经验,有管理经验者优先
• 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

患者解决方案经理是相应疾病领域 HCP(医疗专业人士)的主要接触点,负责制定患者整体解决方案相关的策略和相关项目的支持和执行工作,包含但不限于患者全程管理、创新支付解决方案、疾病认知(患者教育)、准入及安全运营以及上市前后产品的学术平台搭建等,从而提升标准化诊疗水平,提高患者知晓率和可及性,从而实现患者获益。

您的机会：
患者全程管理
1.在生态圈内绘制患者就医流转图,从而更好的推动全程管理在医院内/间的落地。
2.协助生态圈内医院及相关科室推进和打造会诊通道,协助上下层医院间衔接流转,助力绿色转诊通道的建立,最终实现患者获益。
3.管理生态圈内患者全程管理项目的各项落地实施,并确保其合规性。

支付方案
与准入团队合作,协助整合罗氏相关支付方案,传递完整支付解决方案信息。

疾病认知(患者教育)
与第三方机构协作,针对相关疾病领域区域现状及整体策略,协助开展患者教育,提升疾病认知,促进患者获益。

我们期待这样的您加入：
• 成长性思维和快速学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 优秀的沟和资源整合能力
• 5年以上医药行业工作经验,有管理经验者优先
• 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

jobs.title: (Senior) Biostatistician for Clinical Algorithms
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Your Department
We are a global team of 100+ biostatisticians and data scientists united by the ambition to advance diagnostic assays and elevate their use in clinical practice. Located across Roche Diagnostics sites in Penzberg, Mannheim, Indianapolis, and Sant Cugat del Vallès, our mission is to provide robust quantitative methods for all stages of the product lifecycle—from early research to market registration. By combining our statistical expertise with a profound understanding of the clinical questions at hand, we extract actionable information from data and deliver customer-tailored insights.

Your Team
Our team thrives on creating innovative solutions for both novel and traditional challenges in data analysis. We are heavily involved in early biomarker discovery projects, aiming to identify new biomarkers and develop clinical algorithms that solve unmet medical needs. To achieve our goals, we leverage data from clinical trials as well as real-world data. Collaboration is at our core; we work in close partnership with colleagues across clinical science, clinical operations, business, and assay development.

Your Main Objectives and Tasks

• Conduct exploratory data analysis of clinical data and develop clinical algorithms by applying state-of-the-art statistical and machine learning methods.

• Perform statistical analysis for clinical studies and real world data, generate analysis reports, and present findings to stakeholders.

• Analyze data from biomarker discovery experiments using multivariate and machine learning techniques.

• Support peer-reviewed publications that demonstrate the clinical utility of your results.

• Proactively contribute to and support cross-functional project teams.

Who You Are

• You hold a university degree (Master’s) in (Bio-)Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, (Bio-)Informatics, or a comparable field; a Ph.D. is a plus.

• You possess proven expertise in applying biostatistical and machine learning methods to clinical data, ideally in the context of biomarker evaluation or similar research tasks.

• You have excellent knowledge of R or a comparable programming language.

• You bring exceptional communication and analytical skills, with a strong desire to continuously expand your knowledge and apply new quantitative methodologies.

• You are fluent in English, both spoken and written.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
In this role, you join the global Talent Marketing team which aims to position Roche as the employer of choice for key candidates with targeted and innovative approaches to meet & address hiring and market needs.

• Shape our global brand by creating engaging video, social media, and visual content that showcases Roche as an employer of choice to talent worldwide.

• Gain experience through the support of high-impact content campaigns across LinkedIn, Instagram, and our global careers webpage.

• Master content management at scale by gaining hands-on experience with our global platforms, ensuring brand quality stays consistent across all channels.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Recruiting, Communications, and creative teams to bring authentic employer storytelling to life.

• D rive engagement by producing content that authentically represents Roche culture, helping to inspire and increase candidate applications.

• Innovate with new formats by experimenting with emerging digital trends and tools to keep our visual language at the cutting edge.

• Experience a culture of trust where your creative ideas are valued and you are empowered to take ownership of your projects.

Who you are
We are looking for a creative storyteller who is passionate about digital media and global collaboration.

• Visual Storyteller: You have demonstrable experience with video filming and editing , whether through academic projects, a personal portfolio, or professional work. Familiarity with tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects) or similar platforms is an advantage.

• Brand-Aware: You understand how consistent visual language strengthens a message and enjoy working within brand guidelines to ensure quality.

• Curious and Self-Driven: You take initiative, enjoy experimenting with new content formats, and thrive in an environment that encourages continuous growth.

• Strong Communicator: You are fluent in English and feel comfortable collaborating with diverse, international teams across different time zones.

• Educational Background: You are a student or recent graduate in Communications, Marketing, Media, or a related creative field. Please note that your graduation date must not be more than 12 months prior to your start date.

Application process:
Please upload a current CV and a Motivation Letter, where you indicate your preferred start date of the internship.

Additional Information:
Please note, due to regulations, non-EU/EFTA citizens must provide a certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory as part of the application documents, and must be continuously enrolled in their university for the whole duration of this internship.

If you are eager to contribute and feel you have the dedication to teamwork and innovation that we are seeking, then Roche is the organization for you. Every role at Roche plays a part in making a difference to patients’ lives. If you want to work in a passionate team, make your mark & improve lives, apply now!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Stell Dir vor, Du bist der Architekt hinter den Kulissen, der die Vision einer vollautomatisierten Gesundheitsversorgung Realität werden lässt. Bei Roche Diagnostics treiben wir die Wissenschaft voran, damit jeder Mensch die bestmögliche Behandlung erhält. Als Projektmanager bist Du die treibende Kraft, die komplexe Laborsysteme zum Leben erweckt und so einen direkten Einfluss auf die Schnelligkeit und Präzision von Diagnosen für Millionen von Patient:innen weltweit nimmt.

Dein neues Team:
Du wirst Teil unseres Teams Field Force Workflow Solutions im Customer Service Außendienst. Wir sind eine dynamische Gemeinschaft aus Spezialist:innen, die technische Exzellenz, Erfahrung mit Laborprozessen mit einer großen Portion Teamgeist verbindet.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In dieser Rolle gestaltest Du die Zukunft der Labordiagnostik durch professionelles Projektmanagement und Workflow-Optimierung:

• Du leitest überregionale Implementierungsprojekte für Automatisierungslösungen und behältst dabei Planung, Steuerung und Kontrolle fest im Griff.

• Du koordinierst Teilprojektleiter:innen sowie externe Partner, um Projektziele termingerecht und in höchster Qualität zu erreichen.

• Du steuerst die Kommunikation zu unseren Kunden und internen Stakeholdern und begleitest Veränderungsprozesse durch aktives Change Management.

• Du wirkst bei technischen Installationen mit, führst Testläufe durch und trainierst Kunden, um ihre Workflows perfekt auf ihre Bedürfnisse abzustimmen.

• Du analysierst abgeschlossene Projekte ("Lessons Learned"), optimierst unsere Prozesse und berätst Kunden als Spezialist:in für Prozessoptimierung.

• Du unterstützt internationale Länderorganisationen bei der Weiterentwicklung interner Standards und Best Practices.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
Du verstehst es, Menschen für technische Innovationen zu begeistern und behältst auch in komplexen Situationen den Überblick:

• Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen (z. B. Medizintechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Elektrotechnik), Biologie, IT oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

• Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Projekte sowie sichere Kenntnisse in modernen Projektmanagement-Methoden und -Tools mit.

• Umfangreiche Führungserfahrungen in Matrix-Organisationen helfen Dir dabei, Teams zu motivieren und gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern.

• Du hast ein Verständnis für Abläufe in medizinischen Laboren und begeisterst Dich für Software- sowie Netzwerktechnik.

• Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch, auch auf Management-Ebene (C-Level), und überzeugst durch ein souveränes Auftreten.

• Ein Führerschein Klasse B sowie die Bereitschaft zu (internationalen) Dienstreisen und gelegentlichen Rufbereitschaften sind für Dich selbstverständlich.

Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser.

Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. Finde hier mehr heraus: https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DE

Bewerbungszeitraum bis mindestens: 10.06.2026
(Bewerbung möglich, solange die Stelle ausgeschrieben ist)

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf oder Workday-Profil

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugniss

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Stell Dir vor, Du bist der Architekt hinter den Kulissen, der die Vision einer vollautomatisierten Gesundheitsversorgung Realität werden lässt. Bei Roche Diagnostics treiben wir die Wissenschaft voran, damit jeder Mensch die bestmögliche Behandlung erhält. Als Projektmanager bist Du die treibende Kraft, die komplexe Laborsysteme zum Leben erweckt und so einen direkten Einfluss auf die Schnelligkeit und Präzision von Diagnosen für Millionen von Patient:innen weltweit nimmt.

Dein neues Team:
Du wirst Teil unseres Teams Field Force Workflow Solutions im Customer Service Außendienst. Wir sind eine dynamische Gemeinschaft aus Spezialist:innen, die technische Exzellenz, Erfahrung mit Laborprozessen mit einer großen Portion Teamgeist verbindet.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In dieser Rolle gestaltest Du die Zukunft der Labordiagnostik durch professionelles Projektmanagement und Workflow-Optimierung:

• Du leitest überregionale Implementierungsprojekte für Automatisierungslösungen und behältst dabei Planung, Steuerung und Kontrolle fest im Griff.

• Du koordinierst Teilprojektleiter:innen sowie externe Partner, um Projektziele termingerecht und in höchster Qualität zu erreichen.

• Du steuerst die Kommunikation zu unseren Kunden und internen Stakeholdern und begleitest Veränderungsprozesse durch aktives Change Management.

• Du wirkst bei technischen Installationen mit, führst Testläufe durch und trainierst Kunden, um ihre Workflows perfekt auf ihre Bedürfnisse abzustimmen.

• Du analysierst abgeschlossene Projekte ("Lessons Learned"), optimierst unsere Prozesse und berätst Kunden als Spezialist:in für Prozessoptimierung.

• Du unterstützt internationale Länderorganisationen bei der Weiterentwicklung interner Standards und Best Practices.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
Du verstehst es, Menschen für technische Innovationen zu begeistern und behältst auch in komplexen Situationen den Überblick:

• Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen (z. B. Medizintechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Elektrotechnik), Biologie, IT oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

• Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Projekte sowie sichere Kenntnisse in modernen Projektmanagement-Methoden und -Tools mit.

• Umfangreiche Führungserfahrungen in Matrix-Organisationen helfen Dir dabei, Teams zu motivieren und gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern.

• Du hast ein Verständnis für Abläufe in medizinischen Laboren und begeisterst Dich für Software- sowie Netzwerktechnik.

• Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch, auch auf Management-Ebene (C-Level), und überzeugst durch ein souveränes Auftreten.

• Ein Führerschein Klasse B sowie die Bereitschaft zu (internationalen) Dienstreisen und gelegentlichen Rufbereitschaften sind für Dich selbstverständlich.

Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser.

Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. jobs.title: P&C Enabling Support Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
People & Culture Enabling Support Specialist

The Opportunity

The P&C Enabling Support Network (ESN) is a global network of P&C professionals supporting the People & Culture organization through operational excellence, collaboration, coordination, and organizational enablement activities. As a member of the Enabling Support Network, you will contribute to and benefit from a broader ecosystem of enabling support functions across the P&C organisation in Roche, strengthening organizational capabilities and cross-functional alignment at scale.The P&C Enabling Support Specialist acts as a key connector across local and global P&C teams, Organizational Enablement teams, business stakeholders, and chapter organizations. The role supports alignment across the matrix organization by enabling collaboration, supporting follow-ups, coordinating actions, and helping ensure smooth communication and execution across teams.
The role also supports the operational effectiveness of the RSS P&C Leadership Team through coordination, communication, follow-up, and organizational enablement activities across cross-location initiatives and stakeholder groups.
This position is ideal for a proactive, organized, and collaborative professional who enjoys working in a dynamic global environment, connecting stakeholders, and enabling teams to operate effectively together.

• Act as the central coordination point between RSS P&C teams, global P&C stakeholders, Organizational Enablement teams, and business partners, serving as the primary contact point for cross-functional alignment and information flow

• Orchestrate and facilitate all collaborative forums and events including coordination of meetings, workshops, governance forums, and cross-functional discussions with full lifecycle support (agenda preparation, documentation, action tracking, and follow-up)

• Drive alignment and follow-through across RSS P&C leadership and cross-location initiatives by facilitating communication, collaboration, and coordination to ensure organizational and P&C priorities are understood and executed consistently

• Maintain comprehensive visibility and tracking of priorities, timelines, deliverables, and agreed next steps, proactively identifying and escalating dependencies, potential blockers, and risks to relevant stakeholders

• Identify and support operational improvements and continuous enhancement by partnering with P&C teams to surface alignment opportunities, streamline processes, and support transformation activities across local and global stakeholders

• Prepare and consolidate all supporting materials and insights including presentations, dashboards, reports, and stakeholder updates that enable informed leadership discussions and support organizational initiatives

• Execute administrative and coordination activities with excellence in a fast-paced global matrix environment, ensuring all work adheres to company guidelines, SOPs, and compliance expectations

Who You Are

• Formal education and relevant professional background: University degree or commercial diploma (or equivalent work experience) with demonstrated experience in People & Culture, business support, professional assistance, event management, dynamic project coordination, or organizational enablement

• Foundation for success in matrix and global environments: Proven ability to navigate complex matrix organizations, connect stakeholders across different reporting lines and geographies, and work effectively in global and/or cross-fun

jobs.title: Data/Information Architect - Data Platforms
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Data/Information Architect - Data Platforms

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

We are seeking a visionary Data/Information Architect within the RDT Data Platforms function to lead the strategic design and implementation of our AI-driven Master Data Management (MDM) solutions. In this role, you will be the core architect enabling artificial intelligence across our MDM ecosystem, transforming legacy relational master records into intelligent, context-aware, and AI-ready data assets.

The first key priority of this architectural roadmap will focus on the modernization of Healthcare Professional (HCP) and Healthcare Organisation (HCO) master data programs , with a broader scaling strategy across alternative master data domains in future waves. A defining focus of your architectural design will be bridging the gap between traditional MDM platforms and advanced enterprise semantic layers, seamlessly transitioning master datasets into unified knowledge graphs that fuel cutting-edge Generative AI applications.

The Data Management and Data Quality Platforms area serves as the foundational intelligence engine of our global digital enterprise. Our mission is to scale a harmonized, FAIR-compliant master data framework that integrates heavily with an automated, AI-enabled Semantic Layer . By injecting contextual meaning, ontology standards, and relationship graphs into raw master data, we provide the enterprise with a single, high-trust, and discoverable view of our network. Joining this area means taking a leading role in ensuring that healthcare-specific data models remain contextually accurate, highly secure, compliant with global regulatory standards, and completely optimized for state-of-the-art machine learning deployment.

The opportunity:

• AI-Enabled MDM Architecture: Architect, design, and lead the technical execution of modernizing enterprise Master Data Management systems by integrating AI/ML capabilities for data matching, entity resolution, and data enrichment.

• HCP & HCO Program Leadership: Act as the primary technical architect for the foundational Healthcare Professional (HCP), Healthcare Organisation (HCO), and Business Partner/Vendor master data initiatives, ensuring high-fidelity modeling and scalability for subsequent domains.

• Semantic Layer Integration: Define the blueprints and mapping rules required to connect transactional master data with unified semantic layers, ontologies, and enterprise knowledge graphs.

• AI-Ready Data Engineering: Ensure that master data models are fully machine-readable and explicitly struct

The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

We are seeking a visionary Data/Information Architect within the RDT Data Platforms function to lead the strategic design and implementation of our AI-driven Master Data Management (MDM) solutions. In this role, you will be the core architect enabling artificial intelligence across our MDM ecosystem, transforming legacy relational master records into intelligent, context-aware, and AI-ready data assets.

The first key priority of this architectural roadmap will focus on the modernization of Healthcare Professional (HCP) and Healthcare Organisation (HCO) master data programs , with a broader scaling strategy across alternative master data domains in future waves. A defining focus of your architectural design will be bridging the gap between traditional MDM platforms and advanced enterprise semantic layers, seamlessly transitioning master datasets into unified knowledge graphs that fuel cutting-edge Generative AI applications.

The Data Management and Data Quality Platforms area serves as the foundational intelligence engine of our global digital enterprise. Our mission is to scale a harmonized, FAIR-compliant master data framework that integrates heavily with an automated, AI-enabled Semantic Layer . By injecting contextual meaning, ontology standards, and relationship graphs into raw master data, we provide the enterprise with a single, high-trust, and discoverable view of our network. Joining this area means taking a leading role in ensuring that healthcare-specific data models remain contextually accurate, highly secure, compliant with global regulatory standards, and completely optimized for state-of-the-art machine learning deployment.

The opportunity:

• AI-Enabled MDM Architecture: Architect, design, and lead the technical execution of modernizing enterprise Master Data Management systems by integrating AI/ML capabilities for data matching, entity resolution, and data enrichment.

• HCP & HCO Program Leadership: Act as the primary technical architect for the foundational Healthcare Professional (HCP), Healthcare Organisation (HCO), and Business Partner/Vendor master data initiatives, ensuring high-fidelity modeling and scalability for subsequent domains.

• Semantic Layer Integration: Define the blueprints and mapping rules required to connect transactional master data with unified semantic layers, ontologies, and enterprise knowledge graphs.

• AI-Ready Data Engineering: Ensure that master data models are fully machine-readable and explicitly struct

jobs.title: China Biomarker Studies Asset Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
YOUR TEAM
You will report to the HGR Officer and partner closely with the global biosample operations teams across the enterprise. You will be recognized as a leader and work autonomously in both local as well as global cross functional study teams.
ROLE PURPOSE
As a China Biosample Operations Asset Lead, you will provide biosample operational expertise to one or more cross-functional local or global study teams through all phases and stages in accordance with the appropriate quality standards and applicable local regulations.
WHAT YOU WILL DO

• PROVIDE BIOSAMPLE OPERATIONS GUIDANCE TO CLINICAL CHINA STUDY TEAMS AND GLOBAL STUDY TEAMS FOR CHINA RELATED ACTIVITIES by planning, coordinating, and overseeing all operational activities required to manage the lifecycle of study samples (collection, processing, analysis, data delivery and final disposition).

• LEAD THE DEVELOPMENT OF A CHINA SPECIFIC BIOMARKER MANAGEMENT PLAN WITHIN CLINICAL STUDIES based on input from scientific and operational stakeholders to execute biosample operational strategies in China

• PROVIDE INPUT TO HGRAC APPLICATION to support Country Study Managers - when applicable - and within Biosample Operations’ remit.

• PARTNER CLOSELY WITH BIOMARKER SCIENTISTS AND BIOSAMPLE OPERATIONS PROGRAM LEADS LOCALLY AND GLOBALLY to align study specific activities with program sample collection strategies. Evaluate the operational feasibility of specific testing in China and provide input to global program teams.

• PROVIDE OPERATIONAL INPUT AND RECOMMENDATIONS INTO STUDY RELATED DOCUMENTATION AND PROCESSES (e.g. protocol, ICF, HGRAC applications)

• PRESENT CHINA STUDY SAMPLE COLLECTION STRATEGY AT OPERATIONS TEAM MEETINGS AND CHINA INVESTIGATOR MEETINGS

• CONTRIBUTE TO LOCAL LAB/ REGIONAL VENDOR SELECTION FOR SPECIFIC TESTING in collaboration with Biosample Ops Lead, biomarker scientist, Procurement and based on technology expertise, performance and compliance.

• ESTABLISH BIOSAMPLE ANALYSIS AND DATA DELIVERY MILESTONES AND ENSURE ACCURATE TRACKING AND REPORTING OF BIOSAMPLE METRICS (sample collection, assay status, analyses updates). Provide study level updates to the study and global biomarker teams. Support study teams in addressing local vendor/site sample queries. Actively partner with Data Management to oversee and coordinate data format, and delivery timelines.

• PROVIDE DAY TO DAY OPERATIONAL MANAGEMENT OF CHINA BIOSAMPLE VENDORS. Partner with internal/external stakeholders in the central lab set up, providing sample collection and processing instructions. Review central lab documents to ensure alignment with protocol and HGRAC submissions. Perform ongoing biomarker vendor management including development and oversight of scope of work, budget and performance management. Interact with vendors to help evaluate data size for compliance, plan sample shipments, export, storage, define data retention, ensure samples are analysed and data are transferred.

• IDENTIFY AREAS OF BEST PRACTICE AND PROCESS IMPROVEMENTS. Contribute to the development of internal guidelines within Biosample Operations’ remit, based on HGRAC process and local regulations as well as program needs. Partner with relevant stakeholders, both locally and globally, to optimize processes for sample management in China.

• DEMONSTRATE AGILITY AND ABILITY TO PERFORM IN A HIGHLY FAST-PACED, MATRIX ENVIRONMENT WHERE CROSS-TEAM COLLABORATION IS CRUCIAL. Leverage excellent verbal and written communication skills to motivate teams, neg

jobs.title: Disease Area Lead (Oncology / Lung)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Disease Area Lead (Oncology / Lung) is an empowered leader responsible for the respective DA business in Roche Turkiye, leveraging the global Roche network as an active catalyst. In this role, you will report to the Leadership Team Member responsible for all disease areas and develop a clear business strategy for identifying, leveraging, scaling, adapting, and executing the business by providing launch and commercial excellence for the DA portfolio. DA experience is required for this role.

Key Responsibilities
Establish strategic direction and lead the execution of the Strategy

• Responsible for setting the DA vision, high ambitions, and outcomes for the squad by harnessing insights from Primary Point of Contacts (PPOCs) and other key stakeholders across the enterprise. Holding overall accountability for delivering market leadership and the P&L, whilst working in the context of shared responsibility.

• Responsible for developing effective strategies to manage the lifecycle and the financial and resource planning for the products.

• Promote innovation and the development of projects and pull in resources from the broader Roche network to deliver value-added solutions.

• Maximize opportunities and synergize across other disease areas and establish a strong collaboration within the affiliate and cross-affiliates within Pharma International.

• Closely collaborate with stakeholders and customer-facing teams to translate disease area needs into clear execution.

• Ensure Cross-Functional Leadership by inspiring teams to meet ambitious outcomes, fostering an environment where cross-functional teams can collaborate, develop, and achieve outcomes

• Manage DA Members by embracing the role of recruiter, coach, and retainer of talent & performance, sharing the responsibility with leaders in other disciplines.

• Ensure the right resource prioritization, with an enterprise mindset, taking into account the affiliate strategy and portfolio priorities. Within this context, effectively prioritize DA outcomes and ensure resource requirements are met to deliver outcomes

• In collaboration with the PPOCs, ensure that key stakeholders are well-supported and view us as their preferred partner. Mobilize the network with speed when necessary to meet the urgent needs of these key stakeholders.

People Leadership & Mindset

• Provide Inspirational leadership by uniting people around a shared vision and a common purpose, inspiring them to achieve squad-aligned outcomes. Ensure individuals and teams are developing and growing in line with the needs of the organization

• Build High-Performing Teams that deliver business outcomes by promoting a collaborative, innovative & creative environment

• Stay at the leading edge of learning & adapting according to external insights (strategy, outcomes & execution) for impact

• Ensure clarification of outcomes for the team so everyone is aligned on their role in delivering ambitious outcomes, and play an active role in execution as required.

• Act as a People Manager of Patient Journey Partners (PJP), and you are a thought partner for all DA members and others in the DA to bring perspective as a matrix lead. The role embraces the performance dynamics of all members.

• Have a very strong Entrepreneurial Mindset (We before Me) with outstanding partnering & leadership capabilities (coaching, consulting, ability to deeply listen, question, and understand).

• A catalyst and mobilize appropriate resources around common goals/outcomes to genera

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Mit der Zukunft im Blick gestalten wir den Standort von Roche in Rotkreuz aktiv weiter. Einen wichtigen Beitrag hierzu leistet die Abteilung Engineering & Project: Hier liegt die Verantwortung für die strategische Weiterentwicklung des Standortes und sämtliche Investitionen in Gebäude und Anlagen. Dazu gehören Bauprojekte im Bereich Produktion, Forschung und Infrastruktur. Dabei legen wir besonderen Wert auf Nachhaltigkeit, Sicherheit, Mitarbeiterzufriedenheit und Wirtschaftlichkeit.

In dieser anspruchsvollen Schlüsselfunktion bist du die zentrale Instanz für die operative Exzellenz und die baurechtliche Strategie auf dem Areal Rotkreuz. Du vereinst tiefgreifendes technisches Verständnis mit strategischem Prozessmanagement und repräsentierst das Unternehmen gegenüber Behörden und Partnern.

Die Möglichkeit
Strategisches Construction Management

• Standardisierung: Definition und Überwachung globaler Standards für die Auswahl, das Onboarding und die Steuerung von CM-Partnern, Generalplanern und Unternehmern.

• Schnittstellenmanagement: Agieren als entscheidendes Bindeglied zwischen Vendor Management und Projektleitung zur Sicherstellung prozesskonformer Projektabläufe.

• Beratung: Fachspezifischer Input bei komplexen Ausschreibungen und strategische Beratung der Projektleiter in allen Belangen des Construction Managements.

Bebauungsplanung & Bewilligungsmanagement

• Arealstrategie: Verantwortung für die Einhaltung und strategische Weiterentwicklung bestehender Bebauungspläne in enger Abstimmung mit internen und externen Stakeholdern.

• Process Ownership: Zentrale Steuerung sämtlicher Baubewilligungsprozesse sowie Definition standortweiter Bewilligungsstrategien für alle Investitionsprojekte.

• Behördenmanagement: Repräsentation der Unternehmensinteressen in städtebaulichen Gremien und erste Ansprechperson für Ämter und Behörden im Bereich Baurecht.

Areal-Koordination & Safety (SHE)

• Sicherheitsstrategie: Implementierung von SHE-Standards (Safety, Health, Environment) und Befähigung der Projektteams zur sicheren Durchführung komplexer Bauvorhaben.

• Logistiksteuerung: Strategische Koordination der zeitlichen und logistischen Abfolgen aller Baustellen, um einen unterbrechungsfreien Betrieb der Kernprozesse am Standort zu garantieren.

Capex-Projekt Manager

• Projektsteuerung (End-to-End): Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Erreichung der Projektziele (Termine, Kosten, Qualität, Sicherheit) von der Initiierung bis zum Projektabschluss.

• Anforderungs- & Scope-Management: Gemeinsame Definition der Projektanforderungen mit den internen Nutzern, Aufzeigen von Lösungsalternativen sowie konsequentes Risiko- und Change-Management.

• Teamführung & Stakeholder Management: Fachliche Anleitung des (agilen) Projektteams sowie zielgerichtete Kommunikation und Interessenvertretung gegenüber internen Schnittstellen und externen Partnern.

• Governance & Reporting: Strukturierte Fortschrittsverfolgung, regelmässiges Berichten an das Steering Committee und proaktives Herbeiführen von notwendigen Entscheidungen.

Wer Du bist

• Abgeschlossenes Studium der Architektur, des Bauingenieurwesens oder eine vergleichbare Expertise (z. B. MAS Baumanagement, eidg. Diplom als Bauleiter/Techniker HF) mit langjähriger Praxis.

• Fundierte Erfolgsbilanz in der Bau- oder Projektleitung von Hochbauprojekten innerhalb der Schweizer Baubranche.

• Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Teams innerhalb komplexer Matrixorganisationen.

• Ausgeprägtes unternehmerisches Denken, Verhandlungsgeschi

Du vereinst tiefgreifendes technisches Verständnis mit strategischem Prozessmanagement und repräsentierst das Unternehmen gegenüber Behörden und Partnern.

Die Möglichkeit
Strategisches Construction Management

• Standardisierung: Definition und Überwachung globaler Standards für die Auswahl, das Onboarding und die Steuerung von CM-Partnern, Generalplanern und Unternehmern.

• Schnittstellenmanagement: Agieren als entscheidendes Bindeglied zwischen Vendor Management und Projektleitung zur Sicherstellung prozesskonformer Projektabläufe.

• Beratung: Fachspezifischer Input bei komplexen Ausschreibungen und strategische Beratung der Projektleiter in allen Belangen des Construction Managements.

Bebauungsplanung & Bewilligungsmanagement

• Arealstrategie: Verantwortung für die Einhaltung und strategische Weiterentwicklung bestehender Bebauungspläne in enger Abstimmung mit internen und externen Stakeholdern.

• Process Ownership: Zentrale Steuerung sämtlicher Baubewilligungsprozesse sowie Definition standortweiter Bewilligungsstrategien für alle Investitionsprojekte.

• Behördenmanagement: Repräsentation der Unternehmensinteressen in städtebaulichen Gremien und erste Ansprechperson für Ämter und Behörden im Bereich Baurecht.

Areal-Koordination & Safety (SHE)

• Sicherheitsstrategie: Implementierung von SHE-Standards (Safety, Health, Environment) und Befähigung der Projektteams zur sicheren Durchführung komplexer Bauvorhaben.

• Logistiksteuerung: Strategische Koordination der zeitlichen und logistischen Abfolgen aller Baustellen, um einen unterbrechungsfreien Betrieb der Kernprozesse am Standort zu garantieren.

Capex-Projekt Manager

• Projektsteuerung (End-to-End): Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Erreichung der Projektziele (Termine, Kosten, Qualität, Sicherheit) von der Initiierung bis zum Projektabschluss.

• Anforderungs- & Scope-Management: Gemeinsame Definition der Projektanforderungen mit den internen Nutzern, Aufzeigen von Lösungsalternativen sowie konsequentes Risiko- und Change-Management.

• Teamführung & Stakeholder Management: Fachliche Anleitung des (agilen) Projektteams sowie zielgerichtete Kommunikation und Interessenvertretung gegenüber internen Schnittstellen und externen Partnern.

• Governance & Reporting: Strukturierte Fortschrittsverfolgung, regelmässiges Berichten an das Steering Committee und proaktives Herbeiführen von notwendigen Entscheidungen.

Wer Du bist

• Abgeschlossenes Studium der Architektur, des Bauingenieurwesens oder eine vergleichbare Expertise (z. B. MAS Baumanagement, eidg. Diplom als Bauleiter/Techniker HF) mit langjähriger Praxis.

• Fundierte Erfolgsbilanz in der Bau- oder Projektleitung von Hochbauprojekten innerhalb der Schweizer Baubranche.

• Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Teams innerhalb komplexer Matrixorganisationen.

• Ausgeprägtes unternehmerisches Denken, Verhandlungsgeschi

jobs.title: Facharbeiter Ansatz/Abfüllung
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Als Pharmafacharbeiter Ansatz / Abfüllung (m/w/d) bist Du für die Vorbereitung, Überwachung, Reinigung und Desinfizierung der Abfüllmaschine, der Gefriertrocknungsanlage und den optischen Kontrollmaschinen verantwortlich.

Verantwortlichkeiten
In dieser Rolle bist Du für die sichere Durchführung von Standardaufgaben und komplexen Prozessen in der Wirkstoffverarbeitung verantwortlich:

• Du gewährleistest den reibungslosen Ablauf der Abfüllung von sterilen Lösungen in Vials unter Berücksichtigung aseptischer Arbeitsweise nach Herstellanweisung und Einhaltung von GMP- und Hygienevorschriften

• Du führst mikrobiologische Umgebungskontrollen durch und bist verantwortlich für die Störungsbeseitigung auch von schwierigen Störungen an der Abfüll- und Gefriertrocknungsanlage

• Ein wichtiger Bestandteil Deiner Aufgabe besteht zudem in der GMP-gerechten Dokumentation und Kontrolle der durchgeführten Arbeiten in Herstellprotokollen (zukünftig elektronisch), elektronischen Logbüchern sowie Belegbüchern etc.

• Im Rahmen der Arbeitsvorbereitung reinigst, desinfizierst und sterilisierst Du Geräte und Kleinteile

• Du bist für die kontinuierliche Pflege und Aktualisierung von SOPs im Arbeitsbereich zuständig und unterstützen bei der Erstellung von GMP-Dokumenten (SOPs, Formulare)

• Darüber hinaus engagierst Du dich im Rahmen unseres KVP-Prozesses zur Verbesserung unsere Arbeitsabläufe

• Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und verfügst generell über ausgezeichnete kommunikative Fähigkeiten. Als Teamplayer bist du in der Lage, effektiv mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern zusammenzuarbeiten und komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich zu vermitteln.

Das bringst du mit

• Du hast idealerweise eine dreijährige abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Chemikant, Pharmakant oder Pharmazeutisch-technischer Assistent (PTA) (m/w/d).

• Deine mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Produktion, ggf. Berufserfahrung in der Parenteralia-Herstellung zeichnet Dich aus.

• Fundierte Kenntnisse im Hygienebereich und in der Einhaltung der GMP-Richtlinien sind für Dich selbstverständlich.

• Du bist routiniert im Umgang mit Dokumentationsarbeiten und gängigen IT-Anwendungen (insbesondere MS Office, MES, Unilab).

• Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis für die Bedienung und Kenntnis von Produktionsanlagen und Maschinen.

• Du arbeitest gerne im Team und überzeugst durch deine zuverlässige Arbeitsweise.

• Fähigkeit und Offenheit, die Chancen und die Vorteile von Veränderungen zu erkennen und das Warum zu vermitteln.

• Du begegnest allen Mitarbeitenden offen mit Respekt und Wertschätzung.

• Es besteht die Bereitschaft, in flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodellen eingesetzt zu werden. Darüber hinaus bist Du bereit, in Schichtsystemen mit Früh/Spät/Nacht zu arbeiten. Bei der Schichtplanung ist uns Deine Gesundheit wichtig und wir achten ebenso auf faire Zulagen
