Hier können Sie sich selbst sein, für Ihre Einzigartigkeit geschätzt und ermutigt, sich persönlich auszudrücken, offen Dialog und echte Verbindungen zu schaffen. Unsere Kulturwerte, akzeptiert und respektiert jedes Individuum und ermöglicht es Ihnen, sowohl auf persönlicher als auch auf professioneller Ebene zu leben. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen, den Zugang zur Pflege heute und für zukünftige Generationen gewährleisten. Begleiten Sie Roche und helfen, einen Unterschied zu machen. Die Lage Bei Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) ist unsere Mission klar: zuerst diagnostizieren, schneller entwickeln und die Behandlung anpassen, weil jeder Patient einzigartig ist. Unser Team von Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) leitet Innovationen, um die Gesundheitsergebnisse weltweit zu verbessern. Wir betrachten uns als ein Team, das sein volles Potenzial nur durch die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden erreichen kann. Wenn wir Patienten und Ärzte aufmerksam zuhören und die Digitalisierung und neue Technologien nutzen, nähern wir uns ihren wirklichen Bedürfnissen. Dieser kollaborative Geist schafft eine Umgebung, in der Ideen wachsen können, und Sie können neue Wege versuchen, Dinge zu tun - mit dem Ergebnis von wettbewerbsfähigen Produkten, die zu Patienten schneller kommen. Unsere Arbeit deckt den gesamten Lebenszyklus des Produktes ab, von der Entdeckung bis zum Post-Lunch. In Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams, externen Partnern und Patienten bietet das CDMA-Kapitel wertvolle medizinische Informationen, Designs und führt klinische Studien durch und bietet Marktunterstützung. Schließlich generieren wir komplette klinische Studien, die die Sicherheit, Wirksamkeit und wissenschaftliche Gültigkeit des Produktes demonstrieren - die Registrierung, Annahme und Erstattung von Produkten weltweit, um Leben zu retten und die Qualität des Patientenlebens zu verbessern. Die Chance In Roche glauben wir, dass die Behandlung beginnen sollte, bevor sich die Krankheit manifestiert. Als Senior Clinical Data Specialist in unserem Klinischen Operations-Team werden Sie kompetente Datenmanagement-Aktivitäten durchführen, die Innovationen, datenbasierte Erkenntnisse und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen in unseren klinischen und Entwicklungsprojekten direkt ermöglichen. In dieser Schlüsselrolle stellen Sie sicher, dass vollständige und genaue Daten für die regulatorische Analyse und Präsentation bereit sind und helfen uns, Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern, die das Leben schneller und effizienter verändern. Schlüsselverantwortung - Guide Complex Projects: Es arbeitet als Lead Data Manager (LDM) und Hauptkontaktpunkt für klinische Datenmanagement-Probleme, führt Datenmanagement-Teams zu großen Programmen und verwaltet Zeit- und Ressourcenplanung. - Definition von Data Architecture: Benutzen Sie Ihre Berufserfahrung, um studienspezifische Daten-Workflows, klinische Datenbankanforderungen zu definieren und eine vollständige Datenverwaltungsdokumentation zu erstellen (einschließlich CRF-Module, Datenmanagementpläne, Datenbankspezifikationen und Datentransferspezifikationen). - Datenschutz-Exzellenz: Es überwacht die Qualität der Daten durch Definition von Leistungsmetriken, Analyse von Trends und Durchführung von Expertendaten-Revisionen, um unvollständige oder diskrete Daten zu identifizieren und zu lösen. - Cross-Function-Kollaboration: Es stellt das Data Management in den Sitzungen des funktionsübergreifenden Studienteams dar und bietet technische Klärung und Förderung starker Partnerschaften zwischen den Abteilungen. - Mentoring and Coaching: Fördern Sie die Exzellenz der Abteilung durch lügende Teammitglieder, teilen Sie die besten Praktiken und unterstützen Sie die Umsetzung neuer Technologien. Wer sind Sie? Sie sind ein analytischer Mitarbeiter, der Probleme und Drives in einem dynamischen Umfeld löst und sich in der Übersetzung komplexer technischer Datenkonzepte für nichttechnische Kollegen auszeichnet. Bringen Sie ein starkes professionelles Urteil, Engagement für die Datenqualität und eine Leidenschaft für Mentoring andere, um ihr volles Potenzial zu erreichen. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringen Sie: - Akademische Ausbildung: Master-Abschluss oder Abschluss in einer wissenschaftlichen Disziplin. - Erfahrung im klinischen Datenmanagement: Umfangreiche und fortschrittliche Erfahrung im klinischen Datenmanagement mit einem vollständigen Verständnis der klinischen Studie. - Regelmäßiges Wissen: Ein fundiertes Wissen über internationale Vorschriften und Richtlinien für die Verwaltung von klinischen Daten. Kontakt Für weitere Informationen oder um sich zu bewerben, besuchen Sie unsere Website oder kontaktieren Sie unser Personalteam.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Chez Roche, chaque voix compte. Ici vous pouvez être vous-même, apprécié pour votre unicité et encouragé à vous exprimer personnellement, dialoguer ouvertement et créer de véritables connexions. Nos valeurs culturelles, accepte et respecte chaque individu, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois au niveau personnel et professionnel. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies, en assurant l'accès aux soins aujourd'hui et pour les générations futures. Rejoignez Roche et aidez à faire la différence. Position Chez Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), notre mission est claire : diagnostiquer d'abord, développer plus rapidement et personnaliser le traitement car chaque patient est unique. Notre équipe Développement clinique et affaires médicales (CDMA) guide l'innovation pour améliorer les résultats de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale. Nous nous considérons comme une équipe qui ne peut atteindre son plein potentiel qu'en travaillant avec nos clients. En écoutant attentivement les patients et les médecins et en profitant de la numérisation et des nouvelles technologies, nous abordons leurs besoins réels. Cet esprit de collaboration crée un environnement où les idées peuvent grandir et vous pouvez essayer de nouvelles façons de faire - avec le résultat de produits compétitifs qui arrivent aux patients plus rapidement. Notre travail couvre tout le cycle de vie du produit, de la découverte à la post-lancement. En collaboration avec des équipes internes, des partenaires externes et des patients, le chapitre CDMA fournit des informations médicales précieuses, conçoit et réalise des études cliniques et offre un soutien commercial. Enfin, nous produisons des essais cliniques complets qui démontrent l'innocuité, l'efficacité et la validité scientifique du produit - facilitant l'enregistrement, l'adoption et le remboursement des produits dans le monde entier pour sauver des vies et améliorer la qualité de vie des patients. Possibilités À Roche, nous pensons que les soins devraient commencer avant que la maladie ne se manifeste. En tant que spécialiste principal des données cliniques au sein de notre équipe des opérations cliniques, vous effectuerez des activités de gestion des données d'experts qui permettent directement l'innovation, les idées fondées sur les données et l'amélioration continue de nos projets cliniques et de développement. Dans ce rôle clé, vous veillerez à ce que des données complètes et précises soient prêtes pour l'analyse et la présentation réglementaires, nous aidant à fournir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie plus rapidement et efficacement. Key Responsibility - Guida Progetti Complessi: Il fonctionne comme gestionnaire de données principal (DND) et principal point de contact pour les questions de gestion des données cliniques, guide les équipes de gestion des données sur les grands programmes et gère la planification du temps et des ressources. - Définition de l'architecture des données : Utilisez votre expérience professionnelle pour définir les flux de données spécifiques à l'étude, les besoins des bases de données cliniques et créer une documentation complète de gestion des données (y compris les modules CRF, les plans de gestion des données, les spécifications des bases de données et les spécifications de transfert de données). - Assurer l'excellence des données : Il supervise la qualité des données en définissant des paramètres de rendement, en analysant les tendances et en effectuant des révisions de données d'experts pour identifier et résoudre des données incomplètes ou discordantes. - Collaboration interfonctions : Représente la gestion des données aux réunions de l'équipe d'étude interfonctionnelle, fournissant des éclaircissements techniques et favorisant des partenariats solides entre les ministères. - Mentorat et coaching : Promouvoir l'excellence du département en faisant partie de l'équipe, en partageant les meilleures pratiques et en appuyant la mise en oeuvre de nouvelles technologies. Qui êtes-vous un collaborateur analytique qui résout les problèmes et prospère dans un environnement dynamique, excellent dans la traduction de concepts de données techniques complexes pour les collègues non techniques. Apportez un jugement professionnel fort, un dévouement à la qualité des données et une passion pour le mentorat afin d'atteindre leur plein potentiel. Pour y arriver, vous devrez : - Formation académique : Maîtrise ou diplôme dans une discipline scientifique. - Expérience en gestion des données cliniques: Expérience étendue et progressive en gestion des données cliniques avec une compréhension complète de l'essai clinique. - Connaissances régulières : Une connaissance solide des règlements et lignes directrices internationaux pour la gestion des données cliniques. Contact Pour plus d'informations ou pour postuler, visitez notre site Web ou contactez notre équipe de ressources humaines.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption, and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life .

The Opportunity

As a Lead Clinical Site Manager specialising in IVDR and Study Start-Up, you will be responsible for designing, planning, coordinating, and independently conducting all activities involved in initiating, monitoring, and completing clinical research studies. You will play a vital role in ensuring studies are delivered, recorded, and reported in accordance with protocols, standard operating procedures, and global regulatory guidelines
In this role, you will:

• Lead end-to-end study start-up activities , driving site selection, activation, and qualification assessments to ensure clinical trials launch efficiently and are compliance-ready.

• Manage Ethics Committee (EC) and Competent Authority (CA) submissions , ensuring all trial documentation, local contracts, and institutional approvals meet stringent regulatory timelines.

• Provide robust CRO oversight , monitoring external partner deliverables, tracking milestones, and ensuring vendor performance aligns with Roche quality standards.

• Act as the primary contact and clinical trial expert for assigned study site personnel, providing training, technical assistance, and coordinating necessary certifications.

• Develop critical study documentation , including Study Monitoring Plans, informed consent documents, patient instruction guides, and case report forms tailored to diagnostic protocols.

• Deliver comprehensive site monitoring and data validation activities, executing site visits throughout all study phases from early start-up to final close-out.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with global, local, and virtual teams, across Research & Development, Study Management, and Biometrics to deliver top-tier clinical diagnostic solutions.

• Leadership & Coaching : You will dedicate time to coaching colleagues, helping others develop their skills, and acting as a resource for less-experienced team members.

Who You Are

You are a proactive, collaborative, and highly organised clinical research professional who thrives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. You possess strong problem-solving skills, make sound independent decisions, and excel at managing external vendor relationships. To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Education & Experience : A degree in a scientific discipline o

Questo è il modo in cui miriamo a comandare, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alle cure sanitarie oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. L'Opportunità Come Lead Clinical Site Manager specializzato in IVDR e Study Start-Up, sarai responsabile della progettazione, pianificazione, coordinamento e conduzione indipendente di tutte le attività necessarie nell'avvio, monitoraggio e dimostrazione degli studi di ricerca clinica. Giocarai un ruolo fondamentale nell'assicurarti che gli studi siano consegnati, registrati e segnalati in conformità ai protocolli, alle procedure operative standard e alle linee guida normative globali. In questo ruolo, preoccupatevi: - Guidare le attività di avvio dello studio dall'inizio alla fine, guidando la selezione del sito, l'attivazione e le probabilità di qualifica per garantire il lancio efficiente e il rispetto dei requisiti normativi degli studi clinici. - Gestire le presentazioni alla Commissione Etica (EC) e all'autorità Competente (CA), assicurando che tutta la documentazione degli studi, i contratti locali e le approvazioni istituzionali rispettino i rigorosi tempi normativi. - Fornire una robusta vigilanza sui fornitori esterni, monitorando i loro risultati, tracciando i progressi e assicurando che le prestazioni dei fornitori siano in linea con gli standard di qualità di Roche. - Fare da punto di contatto principale e esperto di studio per il personale del sito assegnato, formazione, assistenza tecnica e coordinamento le certificazioni necessarie. - Piattaformare la documentazione critica dello studio, inclusi i piani di monitoraggio dello studio, i documenti di consenso informato, le guide per l'istruzione del paziente e i moduli di registrazione dei boss per i protocolli diagnostici. - Eseguire attività di monitoraggio del sito e convalida dei dati, eseguendo visite al sito in tutte le fasi dello studio, dalla fase di avvio alla chiusura finale. - Collaborare con team globale, locali e virtuali, attraverso Ricerca e Sviluppo, Gestione dello Studio e Biometria per rilevazione clinica soluzionihe di primo livello. - Leadership & Coaching: Dedicherai del tempo a coachare i allenatori, aiuta gli altri a sviluppare le loro competenze e agendo come risorsa per i membri del team meno esperti.
• Requisiti Chi sei? Sei un professionista di ricerca clinica proattivo, collaborativo e altamente organizzato che prospera in un ambiente di matrice veloce. Possiedi forti competenze di risoluzione dei problemi, prendi decisioni indipendenti e eccelli nella gestione dei rapporti con i fornitori esterni. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, porti con te: - Istruzione & Esperienza: Un titolo di studio in un campo scientifico

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chez Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), notre mission est claire : diagnostiquer plus tôt, développer plus rapidement et personnaliser le traitement car chaque patient est unique. Notre équipe du développement clinique et des affaires médicales (CDMA) stimule l'innovation pour améliorer les résultats en matière de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale. Nous nous voyons nous-mêmes et nos clients comme une équipe qui ne peut atteindre son plein potentiel ensemble. En écoutant attentivement les patients et les médecins, en tirant parti de la numérisation et des nouvelles technologies, nous nous rapprochons de leurs besoins réels. Cet esprit de collaboration crée un environnement où les idées peuvent croître et de nouvelles façons de faire peuvent être essayées - ce qui donne lieu à des produits compétitifs qui parviennent plus rapidement aux patients. Notre travail couvre tout le cycle de vie du produit, de la découverte à la post-lancement. En collaborant avec des équipes internes, des partenaires externes et des patients, le chapitre CDMA fournit des informations médicales cruciales, conçoit et exécute des études cliniques et offre un soutien sur le marché. En fin de compte, nous produisons les preuves cliniques complètes qui démontrent l'innocuité, l'efficacité et la validité scientifique des produits - en facilitant l'enregistrement, l'adoption et le remboursement des produits à l'échelle mondiale afin que nous puissions sauver des vies et améliorer la qualité de vie des patients. L'opportunité En tant que responsable de l'étude mondiale, vous serez pleinement responsable de la conception, de la planification et de l'exécution d'essais cliniques parrainés à l'échelle mondiale, depuis l'élaboration de protocoles jusqu'à la clôture. En vous joignant à une équipe dynamique et matricielle au sein de nos communautés de développement clinique et d'affaires médicales, vous superviserez divers portefeuilles d'études, y compris des diagnostics complémentaires, des programmes d'adoption précoce et des collaborations de recherche, assurant l'excellence opérationnelle, le contrôle budgétaire et la préparation absolue à l'inspection.
• L'excellence de l'étude : Dirigez l'équipe mondiale d'étude interfonctionnelle avec une responsabilité totale pour les études de haute qualité, les résultats cliniques, les budgets et les délais.
• Stratégies de mise en forme des données probantes : partenariat avec le leadership du programme pour définir des scénarios novateurs pour la production de données probantes à l'échelle mondiale, la collaboration entre les équipes des Affaires réglementaires, de la R-D et des projets médicaux.
• Author Core Study Documentation : Élaborer des documents cliniques critiques à impact élevé incluant des protocoles d'étude, des plans de validation de conception, des formulaires d'étude et des rapports d'étude approfondie.
• Champion Partenariats stratégiques : Superviser les fournisseurs de services externes et les organismes de recherche sous contrat (ORC), qui conduisent les performances des fournisseurs, la sélection et la gestion des relations au niveau de l'étude.
• Advance Diagnostics Innovation : Diriger les aspects opérationnels des études de diagnostics complémentaires parrainées par des partenaires externes, ainsi que les portefeuilles de collaborations d'accès et de recherche précoces.
• Cultiver les réseaux d'experts : Collaborer étroitement avec les leaders internationaux de l'opinion médicale, les chercheurs et les principales parties prenantes externes afin d'apporter des informations externes avancées à l'interne. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un professionnel proactif et analytique des opérations cliniques qui prospère dans des environnements rapides et mondiaux. Vous apportez un état d'esprit collaboratif, d'excellentes compétences en communication et une passion pour fournir des perspectives cliniques changeantes.
• Un diplôme en sciences de la vie, santé, ou un domaine scientifique connexe (un diplôme avancé est un plus).
• Expérience solide et progressive de la gestion des essais cliniques ou de l'exécution au niveau de l'étude dans les secteurs des soins de santé, des produits pharmaceutiques ou des biotechnologies. De préférence, l'expérience d'une étude portant sur la gestion des essais cliniques de DIV moléculaires.
• Bonne connaissance pratique des normes de recherche clinique

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life .

We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Global Study Lead to join our team. In this pivotal role, you will lead global study teams to ensure the successful execution of clinical studies. You will be responsible for delivering high-quality study designs, adhering to timelines and budgets, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to support evidence generation strategies.

If you have a passion for advancing clinical trials in the cardiovascular/metabolic disease area (CVMD), specifically in Core Lab SWA (Serum Work Area) Systems and Automation, we would love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities :

• Lead and oversee the global study team, ensuring full accountability for study deliverables including quality, budget, and timelines.

• Collaborate with Program Leadership to prepare different scenarios for evidence generation (e.g., study, real-world evidence) and ensure cross-functional cooperation with Regulatory Affairs, R&D,Biostatistics, Data Management and CDMA Project Teams.

• Develop key study documents such as Design Validation Plans, study protocols, training materials, study forms, templates, and study reports.

• Maintain responsibility for the study-level budget of assigned studies.

• Ensure compliance with regulations, guidelines, and standard operating procedures, while ensuring audit/inspection readiness.

• Oversee execution of sponsored studies for registrational and non-registrational purposes through all study phases (planning, start-up, conduct, and close-out).

• Manage study activities outsourced to service providers, including CROs, ensuring timely and quality execution.

• Work with the Publication Team to ensure study results are effectively published.

• Track project performance and ensure that projects are completed on time, within scope, and within budget.

• Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including cross-functional teams, CROs, opinion leaders, investigators, and key customers.

Who are you:

• Strong experience in clinical trial management, particularly in the cardiovascular/metabolic indication. Experience with IVD clinical and analytical system studies in the Core Lab Serum Work Area setting is a plus.

• You have a degree in Life Sciences, Healthc

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mansioni A Roche, puoi mostrare il tuo vero io, apprezzato per le tue unicità. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni genuina, dove sei valorizzato, previsto e rispettato per chi sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. Questo è come noi miriamo a comandare, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti hanno paura alle cure oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Descrizione Al Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), la nostra missione è chiara: diagnosticare prima, sviluppare più velocemente e personalizzare il trattamento perché ogni paziente è unico. Il nostro team di Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) guida l'innovazione per migliorare i risultati sanitari a livello globale. Ci consideriamo una squadra che può raggiungere il suo pieno potenziale solo lavorando insieme ai nostri clienti. Ascoltando attentamente i pazienti e i medici e sfruttando la digitalizzazione e le nuove tecnologie, ci avviciniamo alle loro esigenze reali. Questo spirito collaborativo crea un ambiente in cui le idee possono crescere e provare nuovi modi di fare le cose - con il risultato di prodotti competitivi che arrivano ai pazienti più velocemente. Il nostro lavoro copre l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto, dalla scoperta al lancio post. Collaborando con interni team, partner esterni e pazienti, il capitolo CDMA fornisce informazioni preziose mediche, pianifica ed esegue studi clinici e offre supporto sul mercato. In definitiva, generiamo le prove cliniche complete che visualizza la sicurezza, l'efficacia e la validità scientifica dei prodotti - facilitando la registrazione, l'adozione e il rimborso dei prodotti a livello globale per salvare vite e migliorare la qualità della vita dei pazienti.
• Stiamo cercando un Global Study Lead e esperto da unire al nostro team. In questo ruolo chiave, guiderai i team di studio globale per garantire l'esecuzione degli studi clinici. Sarai responsabile della consegna di progetti di studio di alta qualità, dell'aderenza ai tempi e ai budget e della collaborazione con i team funzionali trasversali per supportare le strategie di generazione delle prove. Se hai una passione per lontano avanzare gli studi clinici nell'area delle malattie cardiovascolari/metaboliche (CVMD), predisposti nei sistemi e nell'automazione dell'area di lavoro del siero di laboratorio centrale (Core Lab SWA), impossibilitati di sentirti! Responsabilità chiave - Guidare e supervisionare il team di studio globale, garantito la piena responsabilità per le consegne dello studio, inclusi qualità, budget e tempi. - Collaborare con la direzione del programma per preparare diversi scenari per la generazione delle prove (ad esempio, studio, prove del mondo reale) e garantire la cooperazione funzionale con gli Affari Regolatori, R&D, Biostatistica, Gestione dei Dati e i Team di Progetto CDMA. - Sviluppare documenti chiave dello studio, come i Piani di Validazione del Design, i protocolli dello studio, i materiali di formazione, i moduli dello studio, i template e i rapporti dello studio. - Mantenere la responsabilità del budget dello studio assegnato. - Garantire il rispetto delle normative, delle linee guida e delle procedure operative standard, mentre si garantisce la prontezza all'audit/ispezione. - Supervisionare l'esecuzione degli studi finanziati per scopi registrativi e non registrativi attraverso tutte le fasi dello studio (pianificazione, avvio, condotta e chiusura). - Gestire le attività dello studio delegato ai fornitori di servizi, inclusi i CRO, garanzia l'esecuzione tempestiva e di qualità. -re con il team di pubblicazione per garantire che i risultati dello studio siano pubblicati. - Monitorare le prestazioni del progetto e garantire che i progetti si completano nei tempi, nella portata e nel budget. - Costruire e mantenere relazioni collaborative forti con i stakeholder interni ed esterni, inclusi i team funzionali trasversali, i CRO, i leader del settore, gli investigatori e i principali clienti. Chi sei? - Esperienza significativa nella gestione degli studi clinici, in particolare nell'indicazione cardiovascolare/metabolica. L'esperienza con gli studi clinici e analitici IVD nell'ambito del laboratorio centrale del siero è un plus. - Hai un titolo di studio in Scienze della Vita, Sanità o affine.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life .

The Opportunity

As a Clinical Site Manager specialising in IVDR and Study Start-Up, you will be responsible for designing, planning, coordinating, and conducting all activities involved in initiating, monitoring, and completing clinical research studies at assigned sites. You will work independently to ensure studies are delivered, recorded, and reported in accordance with protocols, standard operating procedures, and global regulatory guidelines.
In this role, you will:

• Lead end-to-end study start-up activities , driving site selection, activation, and qualification assessments to ensure clinical trials launch efficiently and are compliance-ready.

• Manage Ethics Committee (EC) and Competent Authority (CA) submissions , ensuring all trial documentation is available, local contracts, Ethics Committee and Competent Authority approvals meet stringent regulatory requirements.

• Provide robust CRO oversight , monitoring external partner deliverables, tracking milestones, and escalation of any issues..

• Act as the primary contact and clinical trial expert for assigned study site personnel, for execution of the study - including training and coordinating certification of study site personnel, and provide technical assistance, as necessary.

• Develop critical study documentation , including informed consent documents, patient instruction guides, and key documents for EC/CA submissions

• Collaborate cross-functionally with global, local, and virtual teams, demonstrating diversity, cultural awareness, and fostering strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional team members, internal stakeholders, and external partners to achieve business goals and ensure operational excellence.

Who You Are

You are a proactive, collaborative, and highly organised clinical research professional who thrives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. You possess strong problem-solving skills, make sound independent decisions, and excel at managing external vendor relationships.
To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Education & Experience : A degree in a scientific discipline or related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience) combined with a proven track record in clinical operations or clinical trial coordination.

• Study Start-Up & Sub

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life .

The Opportunity

As a Clinical Site Manager specialising in our molecular lab portfolio, you will be responsible for designing, planning, coordinating, and conducting clinical research studies across assigned sites. Working independently, you will serve as the primary clinical trial expert, ensuring data generation methodologies are delivered in alignment with global quality protocols. This role offers an exciting opportunity to validate product performance claims, supply crucial data for regulatory submissions, and directly help deliver innovative diagnostic solutions to patients worldwide.

Key Responsibilities :

• Lead Site Execution : Act as the primary contact and clinical trial expert for assigned study site personnel, delivering technical assistance and coordinating necessary training.

• Conduct Site Assessments : Perform comprehensive site assessments and qualification visits to drive informed site selection decisions.

• Manage Site Activation : Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure investigational sites properly obtain and maintain institutional approvals and meet all regulatory compliance needs before trial initiation.

• Develop Essential Documentation : Author and review key study site documents, including Study Monitoring Plans, informed consent forms, and case report forms, while contributing technical expertise to study protocols.

• Deliver End-to-End Monitoring : Execute all data generation, data validation, and comprehensive site visits across all study phases, from start-up through to close-out.

• Partner Cross-Functionally : Work dynamically within local, global, and virtual study teams, collaborating with R&D, Field Service, Study Management, and Biometrics to deliver top-tier solutions.

• Support Process Optimisation : Contribute to continuous improvement and change management activities to bring fresh perspectives to existing diagnostic testing solutions.

Who You Are

You are a proactive, adaptable professional who thrives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. You bring strong analytical and problem-solving skills, make independent, sound choices, and possess a natural ability to build consensus across diverse teams.

La nostra missione è di prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a noi e fai la differenza. Opportunità Come responsabile del sito clinico specializzato nel nostro portafoglio di laboratorio molecolare, Lei: - Esecuzione del sito di piombo: agire come il contatto primario e esperto di prova clinica per il personale del sito di studio assegnato, fornire assistenza tecnica e coordinare la formazione necessaria. - Condurre le valutazioni del sito: Eseguire valutazioni complete del sito e visite di qualificazione per guidare le decisioni di selezione del sito informate. - Gestire l'Attivazione del Sito: collaborare in modo trasversale per garantire che i siti investigativi ottengano correttamente e mantengano le approvazioni istituzionali e soddisfino tutte le esigenze di conformità regolamentare prima dell'avvio del processo. - Sviluppa Documentazione Essenziale: Autore e rivedere i documenti chiave del sito di studio, compresi i piani di monitoraggio degli studi, i moduli di consenso informati e i moduli di relazione dei casi, contribuendo al contempo a competenze tecniche per studiare i protocolli. - Consegnere il monitoraggio end-to-End: Eseguire tutta la generazione di dati, la convalida dei dati e le visite complete del sito in tutte le fasi di studio, dall'avvio alla chiusura. - Partner Cross-Functionally: Lavorare dinamicamente all'interno di team di studio locali, globali e virtuali, collaborando con R&D, Field Service, Study Management e Biometrics per fornire soluzioni di livello superiore. - Ottimizzazione del processo di supporto: Contribuire a attività di miglioramento continuo e di gestione dei cambiamenti per portare nuove prospettive alle soluzioni di test diagnostici esistenti. Chi sei?
• Requisiti - Istruzione & Lab Familiarity: Laurea in una disciplina scientifica o in un campo correlato (o una combinazione equivalente di istruzione ed esperienza). - Proattività & Adaptability: Un professionista proattivo e adattabile che prospera in un ambiente a matrice veloce. - Analitica & Problem-Solving Competenze: Forte capacità analitiche e problem solving, con la capacità di fare scelte sonore indipendenti. - Consensus Building: una naturale capacità di costruire il consenso tra diverse squadre. Cosa? Vantaggi A Roche, offriamo un pacchetto di vantaggi competitivi che include: - Servizi sanitari: copertura sanitaria completa per i dipendenti e le loro famiglie. - Risparmio di pensione: piani di risparmio di pensione competitivi con contributi aziendali. - Equilibrio vita-lavoro: accordi di lavoro flessibili e politiche time-off per sostenere un sano equilibrio di vita-lavoro. - Sviluppo professionale: Opportunità per la crescita e lo sviluppo professionale attraverso la formazione, il mentoring e l'avanzamento della carriera. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life .

As a Clinical Site Manager for the Study Delivery CVMD Core Lab SWA Systems & Automation team, you are designing, planning, coordinating, and conducting all activities involved in initiating, monitoring, and completing clinical research studies in the clinical study sites. You are delivering other data generation methodologies, working independently to ensure studies are delivered, recorded, and reported in accordance with protocol, standard operating procedures, good clinical practices, and other applicable regulatory requirements.

The Opportunity

• Acting as the primary contact and clinical trial expert for assigned study site personnel, coordinating training, certification, and providing technical assistance to ensure successful study execution.

• Performing site assessments and qualification visits to support the site selection decision process and site activation activities, including contracting and obtaining IRB/EC/Health Authority approvals in compliance with regulatory requirements.

• Developing and managing key study site documentation, such as Study Monitoring Plans, informed consent documents, source documents, patient instruction guides, and case report forms, while contributing technical expertise to review study protocols, data management plans, reports, and manuscripts.

• Participating in and overseeing CRO delivery of site management activities, including training CRO CRAs, escalating issues, and collaborating with international investigators and key customers while mentoring and supporting colleagues to enhance their skills and expertise.

• Validating product performance claims, supplying data for critical regulatory submissions, defining the functional and clinical utility of products, and gathering feedback and opinions from laboratories or customers regarding the products.

• Executing site management activities for sponsored studies in assigned focus areas across all phases of study (start-up, conduct, and close-out) for both registrational and non-registrational purposes.

• Working in local and global study teams, including virtual teams, demonstrating diversity, cultural awareness, and fostering strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional team members, internal stakeholders, and external partners to achieve busi

jobs.title: Clinical Development Lead (Neuroscience)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life .

The Opportunity

Are you ready to shape the future of healthcare by leading the clinical development strategy for next-generation diagnostic solutions? As a Clinical Development Lead, Neuroscience within our Clinical and Medical Affairs organisation in Diagnostics, you will play a pivotal role in planning and implementing clinical development activities that bring medically-differentiated solutions to patients globally. In this role, you will act as a senior strategic voice and trusted advisor, fostering an environment where science and collaboration thrive.

Key Responsibilities :

• Drive Clinical Strategy : Lead the clinical development strategy for clinical diagnostic studies and complex programs, in the Neuroscience area, defining clinical utility, intended use, and claim extensions across our portfolio.

• Lead Health Authority Interactions : Work closely with Global Regulatory Affairs in the completion and submission of global regulatory filings, authoring critical sections of meeting packages and reviewing clinical documents for international regulatory submissions.

• Forge Stakeholder Partnerships : Act as the clinical lead in external interactions with health authorities, build strategic relationships with international Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), and drive development partnerships across industry and academia.

• Foster Communication Excellence : Oversee the implementation of communication strategies for clinical studies, representing the organisation at major medical congresses, advisory boards, and in key publications.

• Champion Innovation & Excellence : Act as a key driver for competitive differentiation, innovation, and early pipeline activities while developing intellectual property strategies and optimising clinical processes.

• Coach and Mentor : Act as a dedicated coach for team members, nurturing confidence and helping colleagues develop their skills and expertise.

Who You Are

You are an analytical, strategic thinker who thrives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. You are passionate about customer and patient-centricity, and you excel at integrating multiple cross-functional perspectives into a unified clinical strategy.

• Education : Medical degree (MD) or an advanced degree (PhD) in Neuroscience or related fields.

• Experien

Chi sei? Sei un pensatore strategico e analitico che prospera in un ambiente veloce e matriciale. Sei appassionato alla concentrazione sul cliente e sul paziente e eccelli nell'integrare le prospettive multifunzionali in una strategia clinica unificata.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally.

We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life .

The Opportunity

Are you ready to shape the future of healthcare by leading the clinical development strategy for next-generation diagnostic solutions? As a Clinical Development Lead, Cardiovascular and metabolic diseases (CVMD) within our Clinical and Medical Affairs organisation in Diagnostics, you will play a pivotal role in planning and implementing clinical development activities that bring medically-differentiated solutions to patients globally. In this role, you will act as a senior strategic voice and trusted advisor, fostering an environment where science and collaboration thrive.

Key Responsibilities :

• Drive Clinical Strategy : Lead the clinical development strategy for large-scale studies and complex programs, in the CVMD area, defining clinical utility, intended use, and claim extensions across our portfolio.

• Lead Health Authority Interactions : Work closely with Global Regulatory Affairs in the completion and submission of global regulatory filings, authoring critical sections of meeting packages and reviewing clinical documents for international regulatory submissions.

• Forge Stakeholder Partnerships : Act as the medical lead in external interactions with health authorities, build strategic relationships with international Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), and drive development partnerships across industry and academia.

• Foster Communication Excellence : Oversee the implementation of communication strategies for clinical studies, representing the organisation at major medical congresses, advisory boards, and in key publications.

• Champion Innovation & Excellence : Act as a key driver for competitive differentiation, innovation, and early pipeline activities while developing intellectual property strategies and optimising clinical processes.

• Coach and Mentor : Act as a dedicated coach for team members, nurturing confidence and helping colleagues develop their skills and expertise.

Who You Are

You are an analytical, strategic thinker who thrives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. You are passionate about customer and patient-centricity, and you excel at integrating multiple cross-functional perspectives into a unified clinical strategy.

Qualifications & Experience :

• Medical degree (MD) or an advanced degree (PhD) in cardiolo

descriptionByLocale.de: Mansion Klinische Entwicklung Blei-, Herz- und Stoffwechselerkrankungen (CVMD) Beschreibung del lavoro Bei Roche können Sie persönlich und professionell in einer Kultur sein, die die Individualität wertet und respektiert. Begleiten Sie uns und machen Sie einen Unterschied in der Gesundheitsversorgung. Mansion RDS Klinische Entwicklung und Medizin (CDMA) Team Bei Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) ist unsere Mission, früher zu diagnostizieren, schneller zu entwickeln und die Behandlung zu personalisieren, da jeder Patient einzigartig ist. Das CDMA-Team treibt Innovationen an, um die Gesundheitsergebnisse weltweit zu verbessern, indem es mit Kunden, Patienten und externen Partnern zusammenarbeitet. L'opportunità Sind Sie bereit, die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung zu gestalten, indem Sie die klinische Entwicklungsstrategie für diagnostische Lösungen der nächsten Generation vorantreiben? Als klinische Entwicklung führen, Herz-Kreislauf- und Stoffwechselerkrankungen (CVMD) in unserer klinischen und medizinischen Organisation in der Diagnostik: - Drive Clinical Strategy: Führen Sie die klinische Entwicklungsstrategie für Großstudien und komplexe Programme im Bereich CVMD, die Definition von klinischen Nutzen, Verwendungszweck und Anspruchserweiterungen in unserem Portfolio. - Lead Health Authority Interactions: Arbeiten Sie eng mit Global Regulatory Affairs bei der Fertigstellung und Einreichung globaler regulatorischer Einreichungen zusammen, indem Sie kritische Abschnitte von Meeting-Paketen und die Überprüfung von klinischen Dokumenten für internationale regulatorische Einreichungen erstellen. - Forge Stakeholder Partnerships: Act as the medical Lead in externen Interaktionen mit Gesundheitsbehörden, strategische Beziehungen zu internationalen Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) aufbauen und Entwicklungspartnerschaften in Industrie und Wissenschaft vorantreiben. - Foster Communication Excellence: Übersehen Sie die Umsetzung von Kommunikationsstrategien für klinische Studien, vertreten die Organisation auf großen medizinischen Kongressen, beratenden Gremien und in Schlüsselveröffentlichungen. - Champion Innovation & Excellence: Act als Schlüsseltreiber für wettbewerbsfähige Differenzierung, Innovation und frühe Pipeline-Aktivitäten bei der Entwicklung von Strategien für geistiges Eigentum und der Optimierung von klinischen Prozessen. - Coach und Mentor: Act als engagierter Trainer für Teammitglieder, fördert Vertrauen und hilft Kollegen, ihre Fähigkeiten und ihr Know-how zu entwickeln. Chi sei Sie sind ein analytischer, strategischer Denker, der in einer schnelllebigen, Matrix-Umgebung lebt. Sie sind leidenschaftlich an Kunden- und Patientenzentrierung, und Sie zeichnen sich durch die Integration mehrerer funktionsübergreifender Perspektiven in eine einheitliche klinische Strategie aus. Voraussetzungen Qualifiche e Esperienza - Medizinischer Abschluss (MD) oder fortgeschrittener Abschluss (PhD) in der Kardiologie oder einem verwandten Bereich - Nachweis der klinischen Entwicklung, mit einem starken Fokus auf Herz-Kreislauf- und Stoffwechselerkrankungen - Erfahrung in globalen regulatorischen Absprachen und Interaktionen von Gesundheitsbehörden - Gezeigte Fähigkeit, strategische Beziehungen zu externen Akteuren aufzubauen und zu pflegen - Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeit, mit Erfahrung in der Vertretung von Organisationen auf großen medizinischen Kongressen und in Schlüsselveröffentlichungen - Starke Führungs- und Coaching-Fähigkeiten, mit Erfahrung in Mentoring-Team-Mitgliedern und dem Fahren von Innovation - Fluency in English; Zusatzsprachenkenntnisse sind ein Vermögen Contattoo Per ulteriori informazioni o per candidarsi, visitare il sito web von Roche o contattare il nostro team delle Risorse Umane.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Mansioni Développement clinique du plomb, maladies cardiovasculaires et métaboliques (MCV) Descrizione del lavoro Chez Roche, vous pouvez être vous-même et prospérer personnellement et professionnellement dans une culture qui valorise et respecte l'individualité. Notre mission est de prévenir, d'arrêter et de guérir les maladies, en veillant à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez-nous et faites une différence dans les soins de santé. Mansioni Équipe du développement clinique et des affaires médicales (CDMA) Chez Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), notre mission est de diagnostiquer plus tôt, de développer plus rapidement et de personnaliser le traitement car chaque patient est unique. L'équipe CDMA stimule l'innovation pour améliorer les résultats en matière de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale en collaborant avec les clients, les patients et les partenaires externes. L'entreprise Êtes-vous prêt à façonner l'avenir des soins de santé en dirigeant la stratégie de développement clinique des solutions diagnostiques de nouvelle génération? En tant que responsable du développement clinique, des maladies cardiovasculaires et métaboliques (MCV) au sein de notre organisation des affaires cliniques et médicales en diagnostic, vous: - Diriger la stratégie clinique : Diriger la stratégie de développement clinique pour les études à grande échelle et les programmes complexes dans le domaine de la DMCV, définir l'utilité clinique, l'utilisation prévue et les extensions de revendications dans l'ensemble de notre portefeuille. - Interactions avec les autorités sanitaires principales : Collaborer étroitement avec les Affaires réglementaires mondiales à l'achèvement et à la soumission des dossiers réglementaires mondiaux, à la rédaction de sections critiques des dossiers de réunion et à l'examen des documents cliniques pour les présentations réglementaires internationales. - Forge Partnerships: Agir comme chef de file médical dans les interactions externes avec les autorités de la santé, établir des relations stratégiques avec les leaders internationaux de l'opinion clé (KOL) et stimuler les partenariats de développement entre l'industrie et le milieu universitaire. - Favoriser l'excellence en matière de communication : Superviser la mise en oeuvre de stratégies de communication pour les études cliniques, représenter l'organisation aux grands congrès médicaux, aux conseils consultatifs et dans des publications clés. - Champion Innovation & Excellence : agir comme moteur clé de la différenciation concurrentielle, de l'innovation et des premières activités de pipeline, tout en développant des stratégies de propriété intellectuelle et en optimisant les processus cliniques. - Entraîneur et mentor : agir comme entraîneur dévoué pour les membres de l'équipe, entretenir la confiance et aider les collègues à développer leurs compétences et leur expertise. Les Vous êtes un penseur analytique et stratégique qui prospère dans un environnement matriciel rapide. Vous êtes passionné par le client et le patient, et vous excellez dans l'intégration de multiples perspectives interfonctionnelles dans une stratégie clinique unifiée.
• Requisiti Qualifiche e Esperienza - Diplôme médical (MD) ou diplôme de doctorat en cardiologie ou domaine connexe - Antécédents prouvés en développement clinique, avec une forte focalisation sur les maladies cardiovasculaires et métaboliques - Expérience en matière de classements réglementaires mondiaux et d'interactions entre autorités sanitaires - Capacité démontrée d'établir et de maintenir des relations stratégiques avec des intervenants externes - Excellente capacité de communication et de présentation, avec l'expérience de représenter les organisations aux grands congrès médicaux et dans les publications clés - Des compétences solides en leadership et en coaching, avec de l'expérience dans le mentorat des membres de l'équipe et la conduite de l'innovation - La maîtrise de l'anglais; la maîtrise de langues supplémentaires est un atout Contatto Par ulteriori informazioni o per candidarsi, visiter il sito web di Roche o combattre il nostro team delle Risorse Umane.

jobs.title: ERP Business Analyst - Finance
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a ERP Business Analyst - Finance, you will independently manage end-to-end business analysis, tackling complex business problems with emerging ambiguity, strong ability to translate complex business-finance processes into functional specifications. You will demonstrate a full understanding of the business-finance domain, as well as integrate with other domains like commercial, supply chain and procurement, and related technologies, eco-systems and the interdependencies, applying advanced tools and techniques to translate requirements into strategic implementation plans. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives, handling process interdependencies, and significantly contributing to the design and validation of effective solutions. You will also mentor junior analysts and actively shape team processes, methodologies, and best practices within the broader Community of Practice.

Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Independently manages end-to-end business analysis workstreams without guidance, tackling problems with emerging ambiguity. Proficiently adapts a range of standard frameworks, mentors junior and intermediate BAs, and proactively shapes team ways of working and best practices.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of business problems, performs thorough domain research, and drives root cause analysis. Accountable for delivering comprehensive requirements, contributing significantly to solution selection, and proactively identifying needs-solution discrepancies to propose creative improvements.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies a diverse range of cross-functional stakeholders and builds reliance through deep business understanding to act as a trusted advisor. Facilitates workshops, resolves conflicts, and proactively shapes stakeholder perspectives to strategically manage expectations and align them with project goals.

• Impact/Strategy: Delivers impact that extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster, contributing to domain goals by ensuring solutions provide demonstrable business value. Translates requirements into strategic implementation plans, influences tactical decisions, and contributes to long-term solution roadmaps.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Works at a solution or product level involving multiple solutions, handling ambiguous requirements and systematically interacting with stakeholders across a broader product environment. Evaluates solution impacts considering both immediate and long-term business implications.

• Business / Technical ability: Demonstrates a deep understanding of business and technical domains, technologies, and their interdependencies. Independently applies tools, principles, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis to manage interconnections and improve overall efficiency.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• 2+ years of solid finance experience with SAP S4 and integrated eco-systems, with demonstrated ability to translate complex business-finance processes into functional specifications;

• Rich Business Analysis or project experience in finance and integrate with commercial, supply chain and procurement;

• Proven experience independently managing end-to-end BA workstreams, navigating ambiguous requirements, and evaluating strategic solution options.

• Demonstrated experience in translating requirements into strategic implementation

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Service Engineer

W Roche Diagnostics skupiamy się na wprowadzaniu innowacyjnych rozwiązań w obszarze medycyny laboratoryjnej. W Polsce działamy od kilkudziesięciu lat i należymy do wiodących pracodawców na światowym rynku diagnostycznym. Opracowujemy i wdrażamy rozwiązania diagnostyczne, które odpowiadają dzisiejszym wyzwaniom i są przygotowane na przyszłe potrzeby.

Do naszego zespołu poszukujemy Specjalisty/-ki ds. Serwisu Technicznego z województwa mazowieckiego .

Zatrudnienie przez zewnętrzną agencję na okres 18 miesięcy

Zadania:

• Instalacje i wdrażanie aparatury laboratoryjnej

• Naprawy gwarancyjne i pogwarancyjne sprzętu

• Szkolenia klientów z obsługi aparatury i systemów laboratoryjnych

• Pomoc techniczna dla klientów

• Raportowanie wyników pracy

O Tobie:

• Mieszkasz na terenie województwa mazowieckiego

• Posiadasz wyższe wykształcenie techniczne (preferowane: mechanika precyzyjna, elektronika lub pokrewne)

• Z łatwością potrafisz zrozumieć potrzeby Klienta i efektywnie się komunikować

• Posiadasz prawo jazdy kategorii B

• Dobrze znasz język angielski (min. B2)

• Umiesz priorytetyzować zadania i pracować pod presją czasu

• Doświadczenie w pracy na podobnym stanowisku będzie dodatkowym atutem

Oferujemy:

• Zatrudnienie na podstawie umowy o pracę tymczasową

• Pracę w przyjaznej atmosferze w międzynarodowym środowisku

• Możliwość wdrażania własnych inicjatyw

• Program szkoleniowy i wdrożeniowy

Brzmi interesująco? Nie czekaj - aplikuj!

Administratorem danych osobowych jest spółka Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Warszawie przy ul. Domaniewskiej 28 (02-672). Dane przetwarzane są w celu prowadzenia rekrutacji. Osobom, które zaaplikują przysługuje prawo dostępu do danych, ich sprostowania, usunięcia, ograniczenia przetwarzania, przenoszenia oraz – w sytuacji, gdy są one przetwarzane na podstawie udzielonej zgody – cofnięcia tejże zgody w dowolnym momencie. Kontakt do Inspektora Ochrony Danych: dia.daneosobowe@roche.com. Więcej informacji o zasadach przetwarzania przez Roche danych osobowych pod linkiem: https://www.roche.pl/klauzula-informacyjna-rekrutacja-dia-pl

Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. działa w pełnej zgodności z przepisami prawa i nie toleruje żadnych naruszeń. W Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. obowiązuje Procedura zgłaszania naruszeń prawa. W przypadku chęci zgłoszenia nieprawidłowości związanych z naszą działalnością, wszelkie niezbędne informacje dotyczące zgłaszania naruszeń znajdują się na naszej stronie internetowej: https://www.roche.pl/kontakt/ochrona-sygnalistow-zglaszanie-naruszen .

jobs.title: 医药信息顾问实习生
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 1. 职位职责：
• （ 1） 协助 在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （ 2） 协助 进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训
• （ 3） 协助 开展学术会议，向客户介绍产品在不同适应症上的优点
• （ 4） 协助 及时收集、提供市场信息并做出适当建议

2. 职位要求：
• （ 1）在校大学生
• （ 2）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （ 3）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （ 4）熟练运用 Excel、PPT、Word等办公应用软件
• （ 5）拥有良好的英语书写能力

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Business Analyst Professional - RDT Group Function

We are looking for an experienced Technical Business Analyst and Product Owner to partner with the Business Product Owners in translating compliance requirements into strategic digital solutions. You will drive the strategic vision, roadmap, and delivery of Compliance-related products within Roche . This includes platforms supporting Group Audit and Risk Advisory, Group Compliance spanning global teams across Pharma and Diagnostics. The Technical Business Analyst and Product Owner will play a key role in analyzing complex business processes, identifying optimization opportunities, and enabling automation and digitization of the compliance processes, from review, approval, oversight, to monitoring, review and governance frameworks, ensuring alignment with the "One Roche" philosophy.

Description of the area
About RDT Group Functions Compliance Product in Legal, Compliance & Group Communication sub-function: as a trusted and agile partner, we are empowered to boost global innovative solutions on the group risk, compliance and assurance digital prioritization journey.
The Compliance Product allows Roche to manage global risk, ensure financial and legal compliance and provide assurance of compliant processes and behavior in other words ensuring that the provisions of these regulations are met in practice. As part of the Compliance Product, Roche Digital Technology (RDT) creates, manages and operates solutions which improve processes, efficiency, effectiveness and collaboration especially among Group Compliance communities, Group Audit and Risk Advisory (GA & RA).

The opportunity:

• Drive the detailed discovery, scoping, and analysis of compliance, audit, and risk processes across global teams to target current pain points and maximize optimization opportunities .

• Translate complex business requirements into clear, functional specifications and technical specifications for development teams, bridging the gap between business and tech .

• Develop comprehensive business cases, cost-benefit analyses, and impact assessments for compliance products to systematically quantify and deliver measurable business value .

• Collaborate closely with the Business Product Owner to define compliance product strategies, roadmap priorities, and long-term tech goals like AI-driven solutions .

• Lead vendor selection processes by defining business criteria, conducting fit-for-purpose assessments, and partnering with Procurement to satisfy privacy and data security rules .

• Facilitate global requirements workshops across Compliance, GA&RA, Pharma, and Diagnostics teams to seamlessly harmonize and prioritize cross-functional business needs .

• Own the technical solution definition and requirements management from initial ideation and prototyping through to testing, adoption, and support transitions .

• Ensure all compliance platforms fully align with Roche’s legal, regulatory, data privacy, and security standards while strictly maintaining requirement traceability trails .

Who you are:

• Education & Experience: You possess a Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field, combined with previous experience as a Technical Business Analyst or Product Owner.

• Industry Expertise: You have a proven track record working within compliance, audit, risk, or governance environments, ideally within the global corporate, pharmaceutical, or diagnostics industries.

• Analyt

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Business Analyst Professional - Funzione Gruppo RDT Siamo alla ricerca di un esperto Analista tecnico e Proprietario del Prodotto per collaborare con i Proprietari del Prodotto Business nel tradurre i requisiti di conformità in soluzioni digitali strategiche. Potrai guidare la visione strategica, roadmap e la consegna di prodotti correlati a conformità all'interno di Roche. Questo include piattaforme che supportano il Gruppo Audit e Risk Advisory, Compliance di Gruppo che spazia tra i team globali di Pharma e Diagnostics. Il Technical Business Analyst e Product Owner svolgeranno un ruolo chiave nell'analisi di processi aziendali complessi, nell'individuazione delle opportunità di ottimizzazione e nell'automazione e nella digitalizzazione dei processi di conformità, dalla revisione, approvazione, supervisione, al monitoraggio, alla revisione e ai quadri di governance, garantendo l'allineamento con la filosofia "One Roche". Descrizione dell'Area Informazioni su RDT Group Functions Compliance Product in Legal, Compliance & Group Communication sotto-funzione: come partner affidabile e agile, siamo autorizzati a rafforzare soluzioni innovative globali sul rischio di gruppo, sulla conformitÃ e sulla garanzia del viaggio di priorizzazione digitale. Il Prodotto di Compliance consente a Roche di gestire il rischio globale, garantire la conformità finanziaria e legale e garantire processi e comportamenti conformi in altre parole assicurando che le disposizioni di queste normative siano soddisfatte in pratica. Nell'ambito del prodotto Compliance, Roche Digital Technology (RDT) crea, gestisce e gestisce soluzioni che migliorano processi, efficienza, efficacia e collaborazione soprattutto tra le comunità di Compliance Group Audit e Risk Advisory (GA & RA). L'Oportunità: - Guidare la scoperta dettagliata, scoping, e l'analisi di conformità, audit e processi di rischio in team globali per individuare i punti di dolore attuali e massimizzare le opportunità di ottimizzazione. - Traduci i complessi requisiti aziendali in specifiche chiare e funzionali e specifiche tecniche per i team di sviluppo, colmare il divario tra business e tecnologia. - Sviluppare casi aziendali completi, analisi dei costi e valutazioni di impatto per i prodotti di conformità per quantificare sistematicamente e fornire un valore commerciale misurabile. - Collaborare a stretto contatto con il proprietario del prodotto aziendale per definire le strategie di conformità del prodotto, le priorità della roadmap e gli obiettivi tecnologici a lungo termine come soluzioni AI-driven. - Processi di selezione dei fornitori di piombo definendo criteri aziendali, conducendo valutazioni fit-for-purpose e collaborando con Procurement per soddisfare le regole di privacy e sicurezza dei dati. - Facilitare i workshop sui requisiti globali attraverso i team di Compliance, GA&RA, Pharma e Diagnostics per armonizzare e dare priorità alle esigenze aziendali interfunzionali. - Proprio la definizione della soluzione tecnica e la gestione dei requisiti da ideazione iniziale e prototipazione fino a test, adozione e transizioni di supporto. - Assicurare tutte le piattaforme di conformità pienamente allineare con gli standard legali, regolamentari, privacy dei dati e sicurezza di Roche, mantenendo rigorosamente i percorsi di tracciabilità dei requisiti. Chi Sei: - Istruzione & Esperienza: Possiedi una laurea o Master in Informatica, Business Administration, o un campo correlato, combinato con l'esperienza precedente come analista tecnico o proprietario del prodotto. - Esperienza Settoriale: Hai una comprovata esperienza nel campo della conformità, dell'audit, del rischio o della governance, idealmente all'interno delle industrie aziendali, farmaceutiche o diagnostiche globali. - Analitico
