Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. La Posizione Business Analyst Professional - RDT Group Function Wir sind auf der Suche nach einem erfahrenen Technical Business Analyst und Product Owner, der mit den Business Product Ownern zusammenarbeitet, um Compliance-
• Anforderungen in strategische digitale Lösungen umzusetzen. Sie werden die strategische Vision, die Roadmap und die Lieferung von Compliance-bezogenen Produkten innerhalb von Roche vorantreiben. Dazu gehören Plattformen, die Group Audit und Risk Advisory unterstützen, Gruppen-Compliance-Teams über Pharma und Diagnostics hinweg. Der Technical Business Analyst und Product Owner wird eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Analyse komplexer Geschäftsprozesse spielen, Optimierungsmöglichkeiten identifizieren und Automatisierung und Digitalisierung der Compliance-Prozesse ermöglichen, von der Überprüfung, Genehmigung, Aufsicht, Überwachung, Überprüfung und Governance-Frameworks bis hin zur Ausrichtung auf die Philosophie "One Roche". Beschreibung dell'Area Über die RDT Group Functions Compliance Product in Legal, Compliance & Group Communication Unterfunktion: Als vertrauenswürdiger und agiler Partner sind wir befugt, globale innovative Lösungen auf der Gruppenrisiko-, Compliance- und Garantie-Digital-Prioritisierungsreise zu fördern. Das Compliance-Produkt ermöglicht es Roche, globales Risiko zu verwalten, die finanzielle und rechtliche Compliance zu gewährleisten und konforme Prozesse und Verhaltensweisen zu gewährleisten, mit anderen Worten, dass die Bestimmungen dieser Vorschriften in der Praxis erfüllt sind. Im Rahmen des Compliance-Produkts schafft, verwaltet und betreibt Roche Digital Technology (RDT) Lösungen, die Prozesse, Effizienz, Effektivität und Zusammenarbeit insbesondere unter den Gruppen Compliance-Communities, Group Audit and Risk Advisory (GA & RA) verbessern. L'Oportunità: - Führen Sie die detaillierte Entdeckung, das Scoping und die Analyse von Compliance-, Audit- und Risikoprozessen in globalen Teams aus, um aktuelle Schmerzpunkte anzusprechen und Optimierungsmöglichkeiten zu maximieren. - Übersetzen Sie komplexe Geschäftsanforderungen in klare, funktionale Spezifikationen und technische Spezifikationen für Entwicklungsteams, überbrücken Sie die Lücke zwischen Business und Tech. - Entwicklung umfassender Geschäftsfälle, Kosten-Nutzen-Analysen und Folgenabschätzungen für Compliance-Produkte, um messbare Unternehmenswerte systematisch zu quantifizieren und zu liefern. - Mit dem Business Product Owner eng zusammenarbeiten, um Compliance-Produktstrategien, Roadmap-Prioritäten und langfristige Tech-Ziele wie AI-getriebene Lösungen zu definieren. - Führen Sie die Auswahlprozesse des Anbieters durch die Festlegung von Geschäftskriterien, die Durchführung von zweckgerechten Bewertungen und die Zusammenarbeit mit der Beschaffung, um die Datenschutz- und Datensicherheitsvorschriften zu erfüllen. - Erleichtern Sie globale
• Anforderungen Workshops über Compliance-, GA&RA-, Pharma- und Diagnostics-Teams, um funktionsübergreifende Geschäftsanforderungen nahtlos zu harmonisieren und zu priorisieren. - Besitzen Sie die technische Lösungsdefinition und das Anforderungsmanagement von der ersten Idee bis zum Testen, Adoption und Support-Übergänge. - Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Compliance-Plattformen vollständig mit den gesetzlichen, regulatorischen, Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsstandards von Roche übereinstimmen, während Sie die Rückverfolgbarkeitspfade streng einhalten. Chi Sei: - Istruzione & Esperienza: Sie besitzen einen Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Informationstechnologie, Business Administration oder ein verwandten Bereich, kombiniert mit vorheriger Erfahrung als Technical Business Analyst oder Product Owner. - Esperienza Settoriale: Sie haben eine bewährte Erfolgsbilanz in Compliance-, Audit-, Risiko- oder Governance-Umgebungen, ideal in der globalen Unternehmens-, Pharma- oder Diagnostikbranche. - Analyt
descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La Posizione Analyste d'affaires professionnel - Fonction de groupe RDT Nous recherchons un analyste technique d'affaires et un propriétaire de produits expérimentés pour nous associer aux propriétaires de produits d'affaires afin de traduire les exigences de conformité en solutions numériques stratégiques. Vous dirigerez la vision stratégique, la feuille de route et la livraison des produits liés à la conformité à Roche. Cela comprend des plateformes d'appui à la vérification de groupe et à l'avis sur les risques, la conformité de groupe couvrant les équipes mondiales à travers Pharma et Diagnostics. L'analyste technique des affaires et le propriétaire du produit joueront un rôle clé dans l'analyse des processus opérationnels complexes, la détermination des possibilités d'optimisation et la facilitation de l'automatisation et de la numérisation des processus de conformité, depuis l'examen, l'approbation, la surveillance, jusqu'aux cadres de surveillance, d'examen et de gouvernance, en passant par l'harmonisation avec la philosophie « One Roche ». Descrizione dell'Area À propos du Groupe RDT Fonctions Conformité Produit dans la sous-fonction juridique, Conformité & Communication du Groupe: en tant que partenaire fiable et agile, nous sommes habilités à stimuler des solutions innovantes au niveau mondial sur le parcours de priorité numérique de risque, de conformité et d'assurance de groupe. Le produit de conformité permet à Roche de gérer le risque mondial, d'assurer la conformité financière et juridique et d'assurer la conformité des processus et des comportements, c'est-à-dire de s'assurer que les dispositions de ces règlements sont respectées dans la pratique. Dans le cadre du produit Conformité, Roche Digital Technology (RDT) crée, gère et exploite des solutions qui améliorent les processus, l'efficience, l'efficacité et la collaboration, en particulier entre les communautés Conformité de Groupe, Audit de Groupe et Avis de Risque (GA & RA). L'Oportunità: - Diriger la découverte détaillée, la détermination de la portée et l'analyse des processus de conformité, d'audit et de risque dans les équipes mondiales afin de cibler les points de douleur actuels et de maximiser les possibilités d'optimisation. - Traduire des exigences opérationnelles complexes en spécifications fonctionnelles claires et techniques pour les équipes de développement, combler l'écart entre les entreprises et les technologies. - Élaborer des analyses de rentabilisation complètes, des analyses coûts-avantages et des analyses d'impact pour les produits de conformité afin de quantifier et de produire systématiquement une valeur opérationnelle mesurable. - Collaborer étroitement avec le propriétaire de produit d'entreprise pour définir les stratégies de conformité des produits, les priorités de la feuille de route et les objectifs technologiques à long terme comme les solutions axées sur l'IA. - Diriger les processus de sélection des fournisseurs en définissant les critères opérationnels, en procédant à des évaluations adaptées à l'usage et en établissant des partenariats avec Approvisionnement pour satisfaire aux règles de confidentialité et de sécurité des données. - Faciliter l'organisation d'ateliers sur les exigences mondiales à l'échelle des équipes Conformité, AG&RA, Pharma et Diagnostics afin d'harmoniser et de prioriser les besoins opérationnels interfonctionnels. - Posséder la définition de la solution technique et la gestion des exigences, de l'idée initiale et du prototypage à l'essai, l'adoption et le soutien des transitions. - Veiller à ce que toutes les plateformes de conformité s'harmonisent pleinement avec les normes légales, réglementaires, de confidentialité des données et de sécurité de Roche, tout en maintenant strictement les pistes de traçabilité des exigences. C'est quoi ? - Istruzione & Esperienza: Vous possédez un baccalauréat ou une maîtrise en technologie de l'information, administration des affaires, ou un domaine connexe, combiné avec une expérience antérieure en tant qu'analyste technique des affaires ou propriétaire de produit. - Esperienza Settoriale: Vous avez une expérience éprouvée de travail dans des environnements de conformité, d'audit, de risque ou de gouvernance, idéalement dans les industries mondiales de l'entreprise, pharmaceutique, ou de diagnostic. - Analyse

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Leadership & People Management

• Exhibit exceptional leadership aligned with the VACC model, demonstrating a capacity to craft and execute forward-thinking strategies. Cultivate a high-impact environment by systematically eliminating barriers, advancing both people and technical capabilities, and enabling individuals to perform at their peak potential.

• Lead and develop a high-performing team, with a strong emphasis on people development, fostering individual growth, and enhancing collective skillsets to meet evolving organizational needs. Champion team building and cohesion to create a collaborative environment where shared success is prioritized.

• Serve as an unwavering advocate for Roche's mission of advancing and boldly championing diversity, equity, and inclusion, shaping an organizational ethos that reflects these pillars in all initiatives.

• Forge and sustain strategic alliances with site leaders to ensure alignment on high-priority initiatives, drive synergy across cross-functional operations, and achieve mutually advantageous relationships that deliver enduring organizational success.

• Oversee the implementation and continuous evolution of site SHE procedures, embedding best-in-class programs to surpass corporate/site SHE KPIs. Lead cultural transformation by embedding SHE principles into the organizational DNA and fostering a proactive employee safety mindset.

• Inspire, mentor, and direct the organization, while driving performance excellence and advancing team members’ development toward achieving both organizational objectives and their personal and professional aspirations.

• Build a strong pipeline of talent and robust succession plans for key positions.

• Spearhead a culture of relentless continuous improvement by embodying and advocating lean leadership principles, driving operational excellence that aligns with global benchmarks.

• Instill a transparent, innovation-driven, and high-performance culture built on empowerment, ownership, and bold thinking, ensuring the organization sustains a competitive edge in a dynamic market environment.

• Acts as a mentor and coach to less experienced colleagues, providing guidance in mastering complex Q&V workflows, troubleshooting technical challenges, and developing skills in MSAT operations.

Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

• Actively contribute to the design and construction of the new facility, encompassing key activities such as IOPQ, APS, and process/cleaning validation for seamless technology transfer, ensuring successful project execution and delivery.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Head of Technology Accounts and Software Asset Management

Head of Technology Accounts and Software Asset Management ( Practice Leader) is accountable for the integrated management of major Technology Accounts (Platform, Cloud, and Software providers) and the Software Asset Management (SAM) practice. You will lead a team responsible for optimizing technology spending, maximizing ROI, and ensuring strict license compliance across the RDT landscape. This role requires a distinctive blend of technical proficiency in modern technology stacks and deep expertise in software licensing and asset governance.

Description of the area

Asset Management & Technology Accounts manages the lifecycle of RDT’s technology assets. This includes the governance of major technology partners (e.g., SAP, AWS, Microsoft) and the execution of SAM processes to ensure compliance and financial optimization. This sub-function ensures that these high-scale partnerships deliver maximum value through structured governance, risk management, and continuous improvement frameworks.

Job Responsibilities

• SAM Governance: Own the functional roadmap for Software Asset Management. Ensure the entire lifecycle of software assets is managed to maintain compliance and minimize risk.

• Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Serves as the main contact for internal partners, actively managing relationships and expectations regarding the (sub-)function's performance and deliverables. Works closely with IT stakeholders and internal users to identify, prioritize, and address the needs for policies, their operationalization, and associated controls.

• Technology Account Strategy: Align technology account roadmaps with modern architecture (Cloud, AI/ML, SaaS) in regulated environments.

• Asset Compliance: Lead enterprise-wide technology risk assessments and ensure timely remediation of findings or licensing deviations.

• Operational Execution: Implement and oversee tools and processes for tracking asset utilization and license entitlement.

• Operational Excellence: Define and monitor KPIs/OKRs to analyze vendor performance. Use data to drive continuous improvement and optimize the service delivery model.

• Team Leadership: Lead and develop a high-performing team of vendor account managers. Mentor staff and ensure alignment of resources with RDT project requirements.

• Influence & Collaboration: Partner closely with Architecture, Security, and Finance to ensure technology platforms support critical business processes efficiently.

Qualifications

• Education/Experience: 10+ years in IT Asset Management, Technology Sourcing, or IT Operations. Leadership experience in global, multidisciplinary teams is required.

• Functional Skills: Strong understanding of modern technology landscapes (Cloud, DevOps, Digital Platforms). Expert knowledge of SAM frameworks and major vendor licensing models.

• Leadership: Ability to lead through influence and partnership. Strong ability to mentor a technical team in a complex, global stakeholder ecosystem.

What you get*:

• Salary range 23,300 - 43,300 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Capo dei conti tecnologici e della gestione dei beni software Responsabile dei conti tecnologici e della gestione patrimoniale software (Practice Leader) è responsabile per la gestione integrata dei principali account tecnologici (Platform, Cloud e fornitori di software) e della pratica Software Asset Management (SAM). Potrai guidare un team responsabile per ottimizzare la spesa tecnologica, massimizzare il ROI e garantire una rigorosa conformità della licenza attraverso il paesaggio RDT. Questo ruolo richiede un mix distintivo di competenza tecnica negli stack tecnologici moderni e una profonda esperienza nel software di licensing e asset governance. Descrizione dell'Area Asset Management & Technology Accounts gestisce il ciclo di vita dei beni tecnologici di RDT. Questo include la governance dei principali partner tecnologici (ad esempio SAP, AWS, Microsoft) e l'esecuzione dei processi SAM per garantire la conformità e l'ottimizzazione finanziaria. Questa sotto-funzione garantisce che queste partnership di alto livello forniscono il massimo valore attraverso la governance strutturata, la gestione dei rischi e i quadri di miglioramento continuo. Mansioni - SAM Governance: proprio la roadmap funzionale per la gestione del patrimonio software. Assicurare l'intero ciclo di vita dei beni software è gestito per mantenere la conformità e minimizzare il rischio. - Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Serve come il principale contatto per i partner interni, gestendo attivamente le relazioni e le aspettative circa le prestazioni e i consegnabili della (sub-)funzione. Funziona a stretto contatto con le parti interessate IT e gli utenti interni per identificare, prioritizzare e affrontare le esigenze delle politiche, la loro operativizzazione e controlli associati. - Strategia dell'account tecnologico: Allineare le roadmap della tecnologia con l'architettura moderna (Cloud, AI/ML, SaaS) in ambienti regolamentati. - Asset Compliance: Guidare le valutazioni di rischio di tecnologia a livello aziendale e garantire una tempestiva bonifica dei risultati o delle deviazioni di licenze. - Esecuzione Operativa: implementare e supervisionare strumenti e processi per il monitoraggio dell'utilizzo e del diritto di licenza. - Eccellenza Operativa: Definire e monitorare i KPI/OKR per analizzare le prestazioni del fornitore. Utilizzare i dati per migliorare continuamente e ottimizzare il modello di consegna del servizio. - Team Leadership: Guidare e sviluppare un team di manager di account fornitori altamente performanti. Personale di mentore e garantire l'allineamento delle risorse con i requisiti di progetto RDT. - Influenza e collaborazione: collaborare a stretto contatto con Architettura, Sicurezza e Finanza per garantire che le piattaforme tecnologiche supportino in modo efficiente i processi aziendali critici.
• Requisiti - Istruzione/Esperienza: 10+ anni in IT Asset Management, Technology Sourcing o IT Operations. È richiesta un'esperienza di leadership in team multidisciplinari globali. - Competenze Funzionali: Forte comprensione dei paesaggi tecnologici moderni (Cloud, DevOps, Piattaforme digitali). Conoscenza esperta delle strutture SAM e dei principali modelli di licenza del fornitore. - Leadership: Capacità di condurre attraverso l'influenza e la partnership. Forte capacità di mentore un team tecnico in un ecosistema di stakeholder complesso e globale. Cosa? - Gamma di insalata 23.300 - 43.300 PLN lordo basato sul contratto di lavoro. - Pagamento bonus annuale in base alle tue prestazioni (target 20%). - Indennità di automobile o di automobile. - Bilancio di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati ecc.). - Ricarica venerdì (2 venerdì per trimestre disponibile). - Prenda tempo Programma (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo). - Sovvenzione per le vacanze disponibile. - Posizione Flex (possibilità) Contatto *(Nessun recapito fornito nel testo originale)*

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

We are looking for an IT senior engineer to join one of our teams in Roche Digital Technology.
In Roche Digital Technology we focus on delivering technology that evolves the practice of medicine and helps patients live longer, better lives.
You will be responsible for the Design and Implementation of Directory Services (mainly Microsoft Active Directory) solutions and tier 2-3 operational support, performance, lifecycle management and continuous improvement of the underlying technologies. You will be part of multiple initiatives or projects with multiple specialists across multiple time zones in order to achieve the organizational objectives.

As a Manufacturing Specialist Directory Services you would be part of a multicultural and global team protecting our information and assets from unauthorized access, security risks and cyber attacks.

Job Responsibilities

• Collaborate in small to medium sized technical teams and contribute to the end to end design of infrastructure solutions producing and maintaining sufficient documentation.

• Interact with senior internal and external partners on significant technical matters and contribute to determining success criteria and evaluation of promising solutions/technologies via Proofs of Concepts (PoC’s) and feasibility studies.

• Providing 2nd and 3rd level support. Operationally manage and support and implement the Directory Services Infrastructure on premises for manufacturing environments and its associated compliments and applications.

• Proactively monitor systems and platforms for performance, availability and capacity management and ensure that the solution and component escalations are minimized.

• Promptly responding to customer requests, resolve incidents and implement changes, ensuring a high level of customer engagement and satisfaction

• Understanding, implementing and following relevant concepts of ITIL, GxP and Project Management. These include Request Management, Incident Management, Change Management, Problem Management, Document Management, Qualification and Validation and Project Management

• Actively focusing on own self-development and creating actionable plans to improve

• Provide 24x7 on-call support. Flexibility regarding working hours

• Occasional international travel is required

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Bachelor's Degree in computer science, engineering or related discipline; or recognition of prior working experience which is equivalent.

• 4+ years experience administering and advance troubleshooting in Active Directory

• Robust experience working in a major global organization, preferably in a regulated industry

Technical Skills

• Strong design and hands-on technical background. Solid experience on Microsoft Active Directory, Lightweight Directory Services (LDAP) and desirable in Entra ID.

• Powershell Scripting skills will be required

• Ability to apply tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis in practical scenarios

• Skill in evaluating change and technology impacts with increasing accuracy, and breaking down complex technical concepts with minimal guidance

Additional Qualifications

• Proven interpersonal skills to interact effectively with individuals in multiple countries and in varying cultures

• Willingness to continually evolve, acquire and maintain the technical and soft skills appropriate to the requirements of this position

• Committing to operational excellence, with a willin

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

Your Opportunity

• Formulate and implement strategic and tactical sales in the assigned territory

• Oversee all necessary commercial activities to fulfill strategic objectives

• Develop relationships with existing clients and maximize revenue potential

• Provide timely and reliable sales reporting via REXIS and in company meetings/ presentations to senior management

• Product Knowledge: Ensure good understanding the product portfolio and competitive advantages of the products

• Develops and leverages relationships with the leadership of key/strategic customers to deliver value-based solutions and achieve business results.

• Tender Management: establishes priorities in the hospitals/groups with product listing for tender submission

• Apply existing marketing activities to ensure awareness of the company among all target groups

• Conduct presentations at small and medium customer sites and work with marketing for key account sites

• Build strong relationships with key accounts and develop a long term strategy how to grow business in key accounts

• Identify and seize opportunities for new business in existing (increase Roche share) and new customers

• Represent Vietnam in regional initiatives, projects and meetings as assigned by senior management

• Work closely with marketing team to ensure accurate forecasting for respective customer segments

• Work closely with Service and Applications to understand potential issues at the customer and work together to ensure high customer satisfaction

• Inform Service and Applications timely about customer needs, e.g. installations, trouble shootings…

• Upskill DSMs and Sales Reps in their team and ensure high performance spirit among the team

Who you are

• Medical Doctor, Pharmaceutical or Biotechnology University Degree

• Multinational companies in a similar industry with sales management at least 5 years is preferred

• Good commercial understanding and understanding of Diagnostics buying cycle

• Sales experience in related industries is required.

• Supervisory/Managerial experience is required

• Languages: Conversant in both English and Vietnamese (conversational & writing)

• Key Account Management Skills

• Effective Communication Skill

• Good Interpersonal Skill

• Creative Problem Solving and Negotiation Skill

• Customer Complaint Handling Skill

• Time Management Skill

• Leadership and Coaching Skill

• Computer skills: <Google WorkSpace, Google Docs Editor, Microsoft Office

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. Your Opportunity
• Formulate and implement strategic and tactical sales in the assigned territory
• Oversee all necessary commercial activities to fulfill strategic objectives
• Develop relationships with existing clients and maximize revenue potential
• Provide timely and reliable sales reporting via REXIS and in company meetings/ presentations to senior management
• Product Knowledge: Ensure good understanding the product portfolio and competitive advantages of the products
• Develops and leverages relationships with the leadership of key/strategic customers to deliver value-based solutions and achieve business results.
• Tender Management: establishes priorities in the hospitals/groups with product listing for tender submission
• Apply existing marketing activities to ensure awareness of the company among all target groups
• Conduct presentations at small and medium customer sites and work with marketing for key account sites
• Build strong relationships with key accounts and develop a long term strategy how to grow business in key accounts
• Identify and seize opportunities for new business in existing (increase Roche share) and new customers
• Represent Vietnam in regional initiatives, projects and meetings as assigned by senior management
• Work closely with marketing team to ensure accurate forecasting for respective customer segments
• Work closely with Service and Applications to understand potential issues at the customer and work together to ensure high customer satisfaction
• Inform Service and Applications timely about customer needs, e.g. installations, trouble shootings…
• Upskill DSMs and Sales Reps in their team and ensure high performance spirit among the team Who you are
• Medical Doctor, Pharmaceutical or Biotechnology University Degree
• Multinational companies in a similar industry with sales management at least 5 years is preferred
• Good commercial understanding and understanding of Diagnostics buying cycle
• Sales experience in related industries is required.
• Supervisory/Managerial experience is required
• Languages: Conversant in both English and Vietnamese (conversational & writing)
• Key Account Management Skills
• Effective Communication Skill
• Good Interpersonal Skill
• Creative Problem Solving and Negotiation Skill
• Customer Complaint Handling Skill
• Time Management Skill
• Leadership and Coaching Skill
• Computer skills: <Google WorkSpace, Google Docs Editor, Microsoft Office Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Procurement Analyst (Japanese Speaker)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

As a Procurement Analyst, you play a key role in performing the day-to-day activities for procurement matters according to the highest standards of financial control, compliance and effective practices.

The Opportunity:
Job Responsibilities:

• Execute the day-to-day activities according to the highest standards of financial control, compliance and best practice. Ensure quality and accurate delivery of services within agreed key performance indicators (KPIs) and as defined in the Service Level Agreement (SLA) and SOPs of the respective business sub-process.

• Follow the instructions of the Managers regarding the daily work coordination.

• Develop knowledge and capability to raise competence to expected levels to meet current and future business needs.

• Contribute process and technical expertise to process improvement initiatives.

• Support on assigned projects or programs.

Key Accountabilities:

• Validate and process (fix & check) Purchase Requisitions to ensure completeness and in compliance with Procurement Policy.

• Convert Purchase Requisitions to Purchase Orders.

• Purchase Order amendment, close and cancellation.

• Manage and resolve internal and external queries.

• Participate in invoice reconciliation process. Work closely with Accounts Payable team to resolve any outstanding invoice reconciliation or mismatch.

• Execute and produce accurate and timely reports.

• Manage and execute the quote collections and multiple source biddings when applicable.

• Review and update SOP, DTP & LP timely.

• Ensure adherence to the Procurement Policy, Directive, Guidelines and Local Procurement SOPs.

• Actively participate in new project, such as ASPIRE/MyBuy and etc. Attend related meetings, trainings, knowledge transfer and etc.

Who you are:

• Degree or Diploma in Business Studies, Finance & Accounting/Commerce, Supply Chain or Procurement equivalent.

• Good communication skill and able to communicate effectively in English and Japanese (N1/N2 level)

• 3-years experience in a centralized purchasing environment and Supply Chain with production planning background.

• Experience of working in a shared service center across a global / large organization will be an added advantage.

• Good negotiation and analytical skills, resourceful in identifying new sources of items requested and results oriented.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Healthcare Systems Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
El Especialista en Sistemas de Salud (Healthcare System Partner - HSP) a nivel central es un líder en Roche que trabaja muy de cerca con hospitales privados, aseguradoras, administradoras de salud y ecosistema general mercado privado. Actúa en los diferentes niveles de su ecosistema y con los diferentes actores del cuidado de la salud privado tales como responsables de formular políticas y procedimientos, tomadores de decisión en los sistemas de aseguradoras, personal administrativo y de finanzas, área médica, etc. Construye relaciones confiables y estratégicas con los directivos y administradores en el sector y pueda anticipar las barreras de acceso y cumplir con las agendas, planes y objetivos en este mercado.

Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:
Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen:

• Gestiona, administra, genera, prioriza y ejerce los recursos, para impulsar soluciones que entreguen resultados más rápidamente en su ecosistema.

• El Especialista en Sistemas de Salud (HSP) a nivel central para el sector privado, actúa de conformidad con el modelo del líder Visionario, Arquitecto, Coach, Catalizador (VACC), es catalizador y coach interna y externamente.

• Colabora estrechamente y reúne la experiencia de diferentes áreas a nivel local y en la red de Roche, según sea necesario, incluyendo a otros Especialistas en Sistemas de Salud (HSPs) y Especialistas en Experiencia del Paciente (PJPs), MVLs, equipo de economía de la salud, precio, etc.

• Alcanza un profundo entendimiento de su ecosistema, da seguimiento y se actualiza en las tendencias y patrones de los sistemas de salud, particularmente del ecosistema de salud bajo su responsabilidad.

• Provee a Roche del conocimiento de su ecosistema que tiene para trabajar estratégicamente y brindar experiencia, ciencia y conocimiento al Ecosistema bajo su responsabilidad.

• Desarrolla las estrategias y coordina los proyectos de inclusión de los medicamentos e indicaciones terapéuticas nuevas aprobadas por la Cofepris para que el formulario de medicamentos de las aseguradoras cuenten con los medicamentos e indicaciones de Roche así como participar en las licitaciones y concretar los contratos y adjudicaciones para los medicamentos de Roche en este sector.

• Coordina el trabajo estratégico para este sector y junto con el chapter médico y el equipo de economía de la salud y de precios brindar la información médica, económica y de precios que apoyen el rápido acceso de nuestros medicamentos en este sector.

• Trabaja junto con los directivos y administradores para detectar posibles barreras para mejorar la calidad de atención de los pacientes y junto con ellas busca posibles soluciones para mejorar los ecosistemas del sector para beneficio de los pacientes a nivel público. Trabaja en forma coordinada con los equipos de Roche en la entrega de los mensajes médicos y FE que sustentan el uso de nuestros medicamentos.

• Participa con los squads para definir y alinear las estrategias de acceso para este sector bajo su responsabilidad, así como la detección de obstáculos y oportunidades para que los medicamentos e indicaciones de Roche se incluyan para beneficio lo más rápidamente posible de los pacientes en este sector.

Tu perfil:

La persona en esta posición tiene la capacidad de colaborar y construir relaciones con diversos actores en el ecosistema de atención médica. Excelentes habilidades de comunicación e interpersonales.

jobs.title: Internship | Medical & Health Policy Chapter
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Internship | Medical & Health Policy Chapter
Roche Diagnostics, Portugal

The Opportunity
We are looking for a dedicated and self-motivated talent to join Roche Diagnostics Portugal for a 1-year professional internship with the Medical Affairs and Health Policy team, ideally starting in September 2026.

As part of a dynamic team, during the internship you will have the opportunity to collaborate with experienced business partners and stakeholders on meaningful projects related to Roche high medical value areas, offering you the opportunity to gain valuable experience in the diagnostics industry! Your role will allow you to develop your skills and grow in the following areas:

• Provide support in medical review for materials like brochures, websites, learning centers, etc. Ensure these materials, targeted at Healthcare Professionals (HCPs), are scientifically and medically accurate, balanced, and compliant.

• Assist in the planning of educational events by providing support for both logistical and content-related elements, ensuring adherence to defined procedures and guidelines and the smooth execution of these events.

• Assist the Medical & Health Policy chapter by supporting the preparation of Advisory Boards and Focus Groups. This involves coordinating and supporting interactions with experts to gather valuable insights that will be used to refine our strategy and tactics, which is crucial for strategic decision-making.

• Assist in creating educational content for internal and external audiences, including webinars, training materials (slides and presentations), e-learning modules, infographics, fact sheets, etc.

• Support internal training activities, ensuring our teams have the required knowledge and resources, and are properly equipped.

• Understand local clinical and economic evidence needs and how to translate those into action, driving the implementation of local studies and initiatives to close the evidence gaps.

• Participate in the development of disease awareness and patient advocacy campaigns

Who you are

You excel in building successful working relationships with colleagues and external partners, and you demonstrate curiosity, eagerness to learn, strategic thinking, and a strong enthusiasm for how science can lead to improved outcomes for patients:

• You recently completed your Medical Degree (MD) or a master in Public Health (MPH) and have an healthcare related background.

• You are passionate about health innovation

• You enjoy collaborating with others, thriving in a fast-paced team environment.

• You embrace challenges in a positive way and feel confident and comfortable in sharing your views and ideas.

• Your ability to communicate in both Portuguese and English, combined with your interpersonal skills, makes you a highly effective communicator.

• Your strong analytical skills allow you to turn data into actionable insights.

• You are proficient in Google workspace.

If you are eager to start your career in Roche, have a look at this opportunity to join us! Applications close by 16th June, 2026.

What we offer:
Hybrid and flexible work practices, competitive internship subsidy, meal allowance, health insurance, life and personal accident insurance, subsidised restaurant in the office and free access to Roche gym and wellbeing program, among many other, in a highly dynamic, collaborative, agile and innovative environment.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Solution Architect (Demand to Pay, Travel & Expense Management) focuses on designing, implementing, and optimizing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a complex enterprise context. In this role, you will play a critical role in translating complex business requirements into technical designs for the T&E solutions which includes the Concur platform and other systems, ensuring seamless integration with other enterprise systems and driving continuous improvement. You will lead others to solve complex problems, maintain the vision and roadmap for the T&E landscape, and serve as a key leader and point of escalation for Concur-related issues within the organization.

Your Responsibilities

• Design T&E solutions that meet product requirements and enterprise standards across a multiple-solution context, managing non-functional requirements (NFRs) and fitness functions while ensuring configurations adhere to data privacy (GDPR/CCPA) and audit requirements.

• Define and drive reference architectures, ensuring that Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), taxonomies, ontologies, and integration pathways are documented and published for the T&E product.

• Develop comprehensive architecture documentation and manage data flows between Concur and other enterprise systems, including Workday, SAP ERP, ServiceNow (EPP), IQVIA, and Oversight.

• Lead the design and management of non-standard integrations utilizing RESTful APIs, WebServices, and secure SFTP, leveraging middleware platforms such as Mulesoft and Denodo.

• Optimize system performance and business objectives by utilizing reporting systems and data platforms, including Concur Intelligence, Snowflake, and standard reporting configurations.

• Proactively contribute to the development of global Architecture Practices and provide technical oversight and mentoring to product teams.

• Maintain the roadmap for T&E solutions, evaluating external technology trends—such as AI-driven expense categorization and RPA— to enhance value and manage technical debt.

Who You Are

• You have a minimum of 10 years of experience in designing and implementing solutions within the Concur platform, with at least 5 years focused on integration enhancements to and from Concur Intelligence, Travel, and Expense.

• You possess expert-level knowledge of the Concur modules and a proven track record of integrating them with SAP ERP, HR systems (Workday), and other enterprise applications.

• You are experienced in RESTful API consumption, data transformation via middleware (Mulesoft/Denodo), and creating conceptual and logical data models.

• You are capable of maintaining a vision for multiple solutions and assessing the impacts of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape.

• You bring exceptional negotiation skills and the ability to communicate difficult concepts, influencing stakeholders to adopt different points of view or innovative solutions.

• You have a strong understanding of database concepts, SQL, web services, and XML/JSON data formats.

• You understand financial accounting principles and industry-specific T&E best practices; experience with pharmaceutical industry regulations is a significant plus.

• You hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field; a "Certified Professional - Expense Configuration" credential is preferred.

Compensation & Benefits
The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Warsaw Grafit is 228

jobs.title: Legal & Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:
As the Legal & Compliance Manager at Roche Latvia Pharma Division , you will play a critical role in ensuring that our operations and business interactions comply with all relevant requirements and internal Roche policies, and will also support the organization in day-to-day legal matters.
As the Legal & Compliance Manager at Roche Latvia Pharma Division, you will be:

• Strategic Partner: Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the fulfillment of all Roche divisional and local requirements.

• Role Model: Serve as a role model in ethical behavior and decision-making, promoting a culture of integrity and compliance across the organization.

• Strategic Influence: Drive compliance integration into business processes and decision-making.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Work proactively with various departments to help them achieve their business goals in compliance with Roche policies and guidelines.

• Culture Building: Lead the development and nurturing of a robust compliance culture within the Roche Latvia Pharma organization to ensure business processes align with legal requirements and internal policies.

Legal support: support Roche Latvia Pharma organization and Director Legal & Compliance Pharma Baltics Cluster with day to day legal matters, which includes legal advice, drafting and reviewing contracts, etc.
Compliance support to Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) Riga: you will extend, scale and apply compliance work done for Pharma also to the Roche Services & Solutions site in Riga (e.g. joint SOPs & training). Serve as Compliance Officer for RSS Riga and report to the Head of RSS Riga in this capacity.

Key Compliance Responsibilities
Under the oversight of and in collaboration with the Director Legal & Compliance Pharma Baltics Cluster, perform the following tasks in the Compliance Manager capacity:

• Guidance and Support: With a solution-oriented mindset, provide clear and actionable guidance to other departments to enable them to achieve their business goals in a compliant manner and in accordance with policies and guidelines. Escalate more complex inquiries to, and work with, the Director Legal & Compliance Pharma Baltics Cluster to address these.

• Global Standardization: Ensure adherence to Roche global standards such as the Code of Conduct and all Pharma Compliance-related Directives and guidelines, relevant Latvian legislation and local industry association Code of Ethics and any other relevant global and local regulations.

• Process Enhancement: Identify opportunities for efficiency in the compliance function and implement improvement initiatives. Develop compliance SOPs or policies and provide targeted training to employees. Strive for simplification & user-friendliness while maintaining a robust compliance system that adequately protects the organization’s license to operate and reputation.

• Strategic Risk Assessment: Identify, assess, and manage compliance risks associated with business operations, products, and services using data-driven approaches.

• Monitoring Activities: Conduct periodic monitoring activities, including spot checks and approvals, to confirm compliance with company policies.

• Comprehensive Training Programs: Design and deliver training on directives, guidelines, standards, and industry regulations. Customize training for different organizational levels. Conduct compliance onboarding training for new employees, tailored to their function and role.

• Promoting Compliance

• Guidance and Support: With a solution-oriented mindset, provide clear and actionable guidance to other departments to enable them to achieve their business goals in a compliant manner and in accordance with policies and guidelines. Escalate more complex inquiries to, and work with, the Director Legal & Compliance Pharma Baltics Cluster to address these.
• Global Standardization: Ensure adherence to Roche global standards such as the Code of Conduct and all Pharma Compliance-related Directives and guidelines, relevant Latvian legislation and local industry association Code of Ethics and any other relevant global and local regulations.
• Process Enhancement: Identify opportunities for efficiency in the compliance function and implement improvement initiatives. Develop compliance SOPs or policies and provide targeted training to employees. Strive for simplification & user-friendliness while maintaining a robust compliance system that adequately protects the organization’s license to operate and reputation.
• Strategic Risk Assessment: Identify, assess, and manage compliance risks associated with business operations, products, and services using data-driven approaches.
• Monitoring Activities: Conduct periodic monitoring activities, including spot checks and approvals, to confirm compliance with company policies.
• Comprehensive Training Programs: Design and deliver training on directives, guidelines, standards, and industry regulations. Customize training for different organizational levels. Conduct compliance onboarding training for new employees, tailored to their function and role.
• Promoting Compliance

jobs.title: Senior Patient Safety Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join Our Team: Senior Patient Safety Partner
Are you a pharmacovigilance (PV) professional looking to make a strategic impact on patient safety? We are looking for a Senior Patient Safety Partner to drive excellence in our local PV systems and help shape the future of patient care.

Job Purpose
In this role, you will be the guardian of our local PV system for Spain. Your mission is to ensure we remain fully compliant with Roche global standards and local regulatory requirements, safeguarding our License to Operate. You will lead the execution of International Patient Safety (IPS) strategies, turning global solutions into high-quality local results.

Key Responsibilities

• PV System Excellence: Partner with global and local teams to monitor safety profiles of Roche Products and manage their risks effectively.

• Operational Oversight: Manage critical PV activities including individual case safety reports, Pharmacovigilance Agreements (e.g. Safety Data Exchange Agreement), Risk Management and Safety Communication, Local Studies, Programs and other projects with PV implications (e.g., Interventional Clinical Trials, Non-interventional studies, Market Research Programs, Patient Support Programs, Compassionate Use Programs, Post Trial Access Programs, Digital Activities).

• Local Safety Risk Management

• Identify, analyze and share safety insights by understanding disease areas (Roche portfolio, patient journey), engaging with key stakeholders, and ensuring timely, proactive integration into Affiliate and global strategies.

• Implementation of safety solutions and launch readiness activities: Implement global safety solutions locally within the integrated therapeutic strategy, and execute product safety launch readiness activities.

• Risk management and safety communication: Support the country-level risk management strategy to optimize patient outcomes in collaboration within relevant networks and ensure compliant and transparent PV communications (e.g., DHPCs) to healthcare professionals, patients, and external partners in collaboration with Medical Affairs and the cross-functional team.

• Strengthen cross-functional and cross-country collaboration: Foster strong cross-functional partnerships and represent affiliate safety interests in IPS forums, strategically influencing cross-country initiatives and implementing global solutions into local clinical practice

• Regulatory Influence: Actively shape local PV regulations and ecosystems by collaborating with industry associations and health authorities.

What You Bring

• Education: A degree in life sciences or a healthcare-related field (e.g., PharmD, Medical Doctor, Bachelor in Life Sciences, or Nursing).

• Experience:

• At least 5 years experience in pharmacovigilance, ideally in an affiliate setting

• PV Compliance Expertise: In-depth knowledge of global & local PV regulations and the ability to oversee comprehensive compliance monitoring systems.

• Decision-making ability in the local & global PV ecosystem

• Experienced in collaborating within global and local matrix environments, including proven ability in stakeholder management and influencing

• Advantage : Experience in other affiliate medical functions (e.g., Regulatory, Medical Affairs, Clinical Operations, Medical Information) or global functions such as Clinical Safety

Core Competencies & Skills
1. Strategic Leadership & Big-Picture Thinking

• Strategic Planning: Ability to align complex projects with the company’s long-term goals.

• Syst

jobs.title: Medical Software Engineer - Complaint Handling
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS) , medical data networks, middleware solutions, data communication, apps, and algorithms.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software.

Your core mission will be to act as a focused investigative detective . Supported by senior experts, you will dive into code and logs to untangle software issues, growing your expertise in both cutting-edge IT and medical compliance frameworks. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement.

The Opportunity:

• You are accountable for handling medical software complaints, safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).

• You independently manage standard cases through their lifecycle, while partnering with senior colleagues to navigate complex or critical safety issues. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of transfering to the development department.

• You act as a technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand source code to identify the root cause factor of software malfunctions. You can reference the Roche internal process confidently in discussions to justify decisions. You will consult with senior experts on technical and process-related aspects as needed.

• You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives to stakeholders in close collaboration with senior colleagues

• You use your automation and data analytics skills to enhance the case handling process and proactively monitor product performance data

Who you are:

• A degree in computer science or an IT related field.

• 2+ years of work experience in the area of Software engineering or IT support related functions is desired

• Solid IT skills, especially the strong foundational ability to navigate and read source code in multiple languages, with an eagerness to learn complex system dependencies quickly

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

• Automation skills and experience with data analytics are a plus

What you get:

• Employment contract (Umowa o pracę),

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance;

• Private healthcare ( LuxMed packages) and group life insurance (UNUM);

• Training, language courses, and diversified career paths are available

• Recharge Days (2 days off per quarter)

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose)

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time)

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice)

• Stock share purchase additions;

• Yearly sales of company equipment and many more!

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in

As a Principal Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS), medical data networks, middleware solutions, data communication, apps, and algorithms.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software.

While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where you encourage your team to innovative ideas, evaluate and support their proposals, shaping a high performing team.

The Opportunity:

• You will be accountable for handling complex medical software complaints, safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).

• You will independently manage the entire case lifecycle, from initial creation and classification to in-depth investigation, collaboration with the on-site trouble-shooting team, documentation and final resolution. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of escalating to the development department.

• You will act as the most senior technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand complex source code to identify the root cause factor of software malfunctions.

• You will be able to propose process changes, following your knowledge of quality processes and how they fit together as an integrated system.

• You will coach and support more junior team members in technical and process aspects.

• You will be the main interface with Affiliates and Country Organizations. You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives that enhance our regional partnerships.

• You will orchestrate work distribution, manage internal alignments, and ensure the team consistently meets its performance and compliance KPIs. Furthermore you coach your team members to systematically elevate the debugging and automation skillsets of the entire team

Who you are:

• A degree in computer science or an IT related field

• 7+ years of proven track records of working in the area of Software engineering or IT support related functions showcasing strong lateral leadership, a passion for coaching people and develop agile processes

• Excellent ability to work independently even when faced with uncertainty, pressure and ambiguous information.

• Strong resilience and proven ability to steer a team smoothly through high-pressure, uncertain, and highly visible product quality crises.

• Excellent ability to interact with stakeholders, influence and negotiate to push initiatives forwards

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

What you get:

• Employment contract (Umowa o pracę),

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance;

• Private healthcare ( LuxMed packages) and group life insurance (UNUM);

• Training, language courses, and diversified career paths are available

• Recharge

jobs.title: Gerente de Producto
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Diseñar, desarrollar e implementar estrategias/ tácticas de marketing de las líneas y/o soluciones Roche, que permitan incrementar la adopción de los productos que están a su cargo, así como aquellas ligadas a condiciones de salud, otras soluciones, plataformas y equipos comercializados por Roche Diagnóstica, dirigidas a instituciones de salud (laboratorios / hospitales y/u otros), alcanzando metas de ventas y rentabilidad establecidas.

Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:

Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen:

• Desarrollar estrategias de mercadeo para el portafolio de productos a su cargo.

• Diseñar, implementar y medir el impacto de tácticas de mercadeo, incluyendo: Congresos promocionales, Nuevas herramientas y/o recursos promocionales, Interacciones estratégicas con clientes , Advisory boards sobre temas comerciales, entre otros

• Administra el presupuesto de promoción del producto

• Optimizar la disponibilidad de producto para la venta

• Capacitar al área de de ventas en la estrategia y tácticas de las líneas y/o soluciones de Roche a su cargo

• Trabajar en conjunto con el área de acceso para que más pacientes se beneficien de las ventajas del portafolio a su cargo

• Contribuir al éxito del nuevo modelo organizacional y marcos de trabajo Agile de RD México

Tu perfil:

La persona en este puesto tiene excelentes habilidades de colaboración, posee la capacidad de establecer relaciones e interactuar con partes interesadas médicas, jefes de laboratorio, asociaciones profesionales y responsables de la toma de decisiones en instituciones, entre otras partes interesadas.

• Estudios Universitarios completos en Mercadotecnia, Negocios, Económico Administrativa, o a fin, Ingeniería (Titulado)

• Experiencia relevante en marketing o gestión de productos dentro de las industrias de diagnóstico, dispositivos médicos o farmacéutica con una trayectoria comprobada en lanzamientos exitosos de productos y gestión estratégica de proyectos.

• Competencia en Microsoft Office, sistemas CRM y conocimiento profundo del mercado de diagnóstico mexicano/regional.

• Conocimiento de metodologías ágiles, marketing digital y ventas estratégicas es un diferencial

• Conocimiento avanzado del idioma inglés es un requisito.

Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• 1. 职位职责：

• （4 ）熟练运用Excel、PPT、Word等办公应用软件

jobs.description:

The Position
Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición.

Generar proyectos, establecer y mantener una relación de estrecho contacto académico, profesionales de la salud y tomadores de decisión, en todo el país, con el objeto de facilitar el acceso de los pacientes y la diseminación de evidencia relacionada con las áreas diagnósticas de Oncología y Neurología.
Ser punto de contacto para resolver dudas de la comunidad médica y científica que requieran de información sustentada en evidencia, mediante el desarrollo e implementación de programas educativos específicos y medibles. Ser parte de un equipo estratégico para el desarrollo de planes que mejoren la penetración al sistema de salud de los productos de Alto Valor Médico.

Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:

• Diseñar y ejecutar, junto a las Unidades de Negocio, estrategias de acceso y educación médica en Oncología y Neurología, liderando su implementación en centros estratégicos a nivel nacional.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
(Major functions of the position)
1. Act as PPoC to CE-I2, which consists of 2 Franchises Anti-Infectious and Immunology.
2. Take lead the identification of business pain points, root cause, and lead to take business actions, via strong business insight based on analysis
3. Coordinate bi-annual FFE business planning (including HC, Territory and objective setting) across all TA’s both of CE-O, CE-ON, as well as CE-I2
4. Proactively work together with Commercial Excellence internal team, especially BDC (Business Data Center) team, to ensure successful implementation of business initiatives
5. Work closely with Finance partner, HR partner to manage HC and resource
6. Integrate internal and external stakeholders to build end-to-end business solutions
7. Explore business opportunities and business models to sustain growth
8. Drive business initiatives via strong interpersonal skills as well as hard skills, with sense of ownership.
9. Coach team members to accommodate business requests with high efficiency and effectiveness
10. Healthcare experience is mandatory, strong analysis and presentation skills are mandatory, MBA and consulting background is preferred

Qualification and Experience

Education/Qualifications

• Bachelor degree is mandatory, and MBA or consulting experience is highly preferred.

Leadership Competencies

• Open-minded, optimistic and think in a win-win way

• Happy to collaborate with other team members and cross-functional colleagues

Job Required Competencies

• More than 10 years pharmaceutical industry experience or >3 years management/strategy consulting background

• Strong business analytical and interpretation skills

• Good at communication and manage complicated cases

• English verbal & written skills are preferred

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
生态圈负责人负责管理生态圈资源，并率领区域生态圈团队服务客户，建立内外部合作，把罗氏产品的关键信息准确及时的传达给客户，实现区域生态圈罗氏对应疾病领域策略目标，最终提高患者获益。

A. 目标与计划管理

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile del team SAP Global Project Management
titleByLocale.en: Team Lead SAP Global Project Management
titleByLocale.fr: Chef d'équipe Gestion de projet globale SAP

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe it’s urgent to deliver medical solutions right now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are fearless in both decision-making and taking action.

You will be the primary operational anchor and practitioner-leader for our delivery organization, bridging the gap between strategic intent and technical execution. This role offers a unique opportunity to lead engineering teams in building sustainable products that accelerate the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines.

Description of the Area
We are seeking a hands-on leader, ideally with experience as an STE, RTE, Program Manager or Initiative Owner, to guide a diverse delivery team, including Senior Project/Program Managers, Deployment Leads, RTEs, and STEs. You will operate as a practitioner-leader, balancing deep mentorship with Network Execution. Success in this role relies on establishing absolute trust with Business and IT leaders through constant communication and active partnership.
The Opportunity:

• Drive Product Strategy: Accountable for setting the product direction, ensuring all features and roadmaps align with defined financial objectives and organizational goals.

• Lead Cross-Functional Excellence: Orchestrate the continuous flow of the Agile Value Stream while simultaneously driving distinct programs and projects to successful completion.

• Foster Trusted Partnerships: Build deep alliances with Business and IT executives through transparent communication to bridge the gap between strategy and execution.

• Champion Customer-Centricity: Act as the primary owner of the customer's problem, prioritizing internal user needs to deliver solutions that provide tangible value.

• Execute End-to-End Lifecycle Management: Lead the entire product lifecycle from initial ideation and strategic planning through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement.

• Innovate with AI: Proactively integrate relevant Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities into the product roadmap to maintain a competitive and future-ready portfolio.

• Optimize Performance: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and user satisfaction metrics to inform data-driven product iterations and optimizations.

• Nurture Team Development: Act as a practitioner-coach, mentoring your team to master SAFe facilitation and navigate complex hybrid (Agile/Waterfall) landscapes.

Who you are:

• Experienced Product Leader: You bring 5+ years of experience in product management or business analysis with a proven track record of launching technology products.

• Industry Specialist: You possess 2+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry.

• Proven People Lead: You have 1+ years of experience in a leadership role managing multidisciplinary technical teams and holding people authority.

• Technically Proficient: You have a strong understanding of software architecture (APIs, cloud) and the product development lifecycle, including GxP and GDPR.

• Strategic Communicator: You excel at translating high-level scientific goals into concrete roadmaps and influencing diverse groups toward a common vision.

• Agile Expert: You are skilled in SAFe facilitation and capable of removing systemic impediments to maintain operational excellence and flow.

• Academic Foundation: You are highly educated in a relevant scientific, technical, or business field, supporting your ability

descriptionByLocale.it: # Mansioni - **Product Manager - Delivery Organization Primary Operational Anchor and Practitioner-Leader** # Descrizione dell'Area - Guida una squadra di consegna diversificata, composta da Senior Project/Program Managers, Deployment Leads, RTEs e STEs. - Opera come un leader praticante, bilanciando la mentorship approfondita con l'esecuzione della rete. - Stabilisce una fiducia assoluta con i leader aziendali e IT attraverso una comunicazione costante e una partnership attiva. # Opportunità: - **Guida la Strategia del Prodotto:** Responsabile della direzione del prodotto, garantendo che tutte le funzionalità e le roadmap si allineino con gli obiettivi finanziari e gli obiettivi organizzativi definiti. - **Dirige l'Eccellenza Cross-Funzionale:** Orchestra il flusso continuo del flusso di valore Agile mentre guida distinti programmi e progetti verso il completamento riuscito. - **Favorisce Partnerships Fiduciarie:** Costruisce alleanze profonde con i dirigenti aziendali e IT attraverso una comunicazione trasparente per colmare il divario tra strategia ed esecuzione. - **Promuove la Centralità del Cliente:** Funziona come il proprietario principale del problema del cliente, priorizzando i bisogni interni degli utenti per consegnare soluzioni che forniscono un valore tangibile. - **Esegue la Gestione del Ciclo di Vita End-to-End:** Guida l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto, dalla pianificazione strategica iniziale all'ideazione, al lancio, all'espansione e alla fine al pensionamento. - **Innova con l'IA:** Integra proattivamente le capacità rilevanti dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) nella roadmap del prodotto per mantenere un portafoglio competitivo e pronto per il futuro. - **Ottimizza le Prestazioni:** Definisce e traccia gli indicatori chiave delle prestazioni (KPI) e le metriche di soddisfazione dell'utente per informare le iterazioni e le ottimizzazioni del prodotto basate sui dati. - **Nurture Team Development:** Funziona come un coach praticante, mentor della squadra per padroneggiare la facilitazione SAFe e navigare paesaggi ibridi complessi (Agile/Waterfall). # Chi sei: - **Leader Esperto del Prodotto:** Porti 5+ anni di esperienza in gestione del prodotto o analisi aziendale con un track record comprovato di lancio di prodotti tecnologici. - **Specialista del Settore:** Possiedi 2+ anni di esperienza nel settore farmaceutico, biotecnologico o nella tecnologia regolamentata del settore sanitario. - **Leader Esperto:** Possiedi 1+ anni di esperienza in una posizione di leadership nella gestione di squadre tecniche multidisciplinary e nell'esercizio dell'autorità sulle persone. - **Tecnicamente Proficuo:** Hai una forte comprensione dell'architettura del software (API, cloud) e del ciclo di vita dello sviluppo del prodotto, compresi GxP e GDPR. - **Comunicatore Strategico:** Eccelli nella traduzione degli obiettivi scientifici di alto livello in roadmap concrete e nell'influenzare gruppi diversi verso una visione comune. - **Esperto di Agile:** Sei esperto nella facilitazione SAFe e sei in grado di rimuovere gli ostacoli sistemici per mantenere l'eccellenza operativa e il flusso. - **Fondamento Accademico:** Sei altamente istruito in un campo scientifico, tecnico o aziendale rilevante, che sostiene la tua capacità. # Contatto - Per ulteriori informazioni o per candidarsi, visita il sito web di Roche o contatta il tuo recruiter dedicato.
