jobs.title: Qualification Engineer/Qualifizierungsingenieur (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Unsere Pharma-Vision
Medikamente schnell zu den Patienten zu bringen und das beste Ergebnis für unsere Kunden zu schaffen. Das ist es, was uns in Sterile Drug Product Manufacturing (SDPM) in Mannheim antreibt. So tragen wir auch dazu bei, bis 2029 unser Ziel zu erreichen: 20 bahnbrechende Medikamente zur Behandlung der Krankheiten mit der größten gesellschaftlichen Belastung bereitzustellen. Unsere Arbeit, unser täglicher Einsatz und unser Engagement bedeuten für sehr viele Menschen große Hoffnung und Zuversicht und deswegen müssen wir anders denken und arbeiten. Mit dem Patient im Fokus setzen wir auf eine neue Organisation und zwar #WIRGEMEINSAM in SDPM! ​

Was Dich erwartet:

Als Qualification Engineer/Qualifizierungsingenieur (m/w/d) bist Du Teil des Teams MSAT und sorgst gemeinsam mit den Kollegen*innen dafür, dass unsere pharmazeutischen Anlagen reibungslos laufen und alle gesetzlichen und GMP -Vorgaben eingehalten werden. Werde Teil eines Teams, das nicht nur die Einhaltung höchster Standards sicherstellt, sondern auch aktiv eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit, des Lean Managements und der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung
(#WIRGEMEINSAM) vorlebt.

Darüber hinaus übernimmst Du folgende spannende Aufgaben:

• Du erstellst selbstständig und verantwortest Qualifizierungs- und
Requalifizierungsdokumente wie Pläne, Berichte und Risikoanalysen für Produktionsanlagen und Equipment anhand der geltenden Anforderungen, regulatorischen Vorgaben und Validierung skonzepten.

• Du vertrittst deine Arbeit souverän bei internen und externen Inspektionen und Audits gegenüber Behörden wie der EMA und FDA.

• Du unterstützt die Weiterentwicklung von Qualifizierungskonzepten hin zu einer kontinuierlichen, datenbasierten Qualifizierung, um die Effizienz zu steigern.

• Du steuerst, beauftragst und kontrollierst externe Dienstleister und interne Schnittstellenabteilungen effizient.

• Du tauschst dich proaktiv mit anderen Standorten aus, um das Fachgebiet weiterzuentwickeln und Best Practices zu etablieren.

Wer Du bist:

• Du hast ein abgeschlossenes technisches Studium (Bachelor, Master) in Pharmatechnik, Biotechnologie , Verfahrenstechnik oder eine einschlägige Berufsausbildung mit mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung.

• Du hast ausgeprägte Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Industrie, insbesondere im Bereich der Sterilproduktion und Qualifizierung.

• Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse der pharmazeutischen Herstellungsverfahren und Technologien sowie der GMP , EU und FDA Richtlinien und relevanten Arzneibüchern.

• Du überzeugst mit deinen fließenden Sprachkenntnissen und deinem Ausdrucksvermögen in Deutsch und Englisch (in Wort und Schrift).

• Du besitzt ein hohes Maß an Teamfähigkeit und Verantwortungsbereitschaft.

• Die Fähigkeit zu interdisziplinärem Denken, Konfliktbewältigung sowie Integrations- und Überzeugungsfähigkeit runden dein Profil ab.

Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser. Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. Finde hier mehr heraus:
https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DE

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf oder Workday-Profil

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse & Nachweise

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend

jobs.title: PostDoc Position in Bioorganic Chemistry (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you interested in developing novel reagents and workflows for next generation sequencing?
We are looking for a highly talented and motivated postdoctoral fellow (m/f/d) to join our team on
this mission.

The Chemistry Technologies department provides the full spectrum of chemical diagnostic
reagents, ranging from small molecules to biooligomers and polymers. Leveraging modern
synthetic and analytical methods we design and develop tailor-made molecules to find the right
solutions for diagnostic questions and beyond. We work as a team, are driven by passion for
science and commitment to continuous learning to stay at the forefront of research.

Our culture is defined by trust, transparency, and a strong collaborative spirit. We are looking for
a proactive colleague who balances independent critical thinking with team spirit and the
flexibility to collaborate across diverse departments and interdisciplinary teams.

Your tasks

• Design and synthesize complex oligonucleotide-conjugates by contemporary bioconjugation techniques and small molecular entities by chemical synthesis

• Establish DNA templated proximity reactions for initial testing of your new reagent classes

• Collaborate proactively with project partners from biology, analytics and the sequencing test development teams to gain a deep insight into the relationship of structural design and assay performance

• Independently plan, execute and analyze experiments to effectively advance the projects

• Present scientific progress through internal meetings and visit scientific conferences to ensure the state-of-the-art knowledge in the field of bioorganic synthesis, chemical biology and surface chemistry

• Be part of a highly motivated and cross-functional team

Your profile

• You hold a PhD in the field of (bio)organic chemistry, chemical biology or life science.

• You possess profound knowledge in the synthesis of oligonucleotide-conjugates, preferably in context of biomolecules (proteins, peptides, nucleic acids)

• You are well experienced in organic synthesis

• Hands-on experience in the field of DNA-templated reactions, proximity reactions and nucleic acid detection completes your profile.

• Your qualification should be clearly demonstrated by at least one first author paper published or accepted in a high impact journal.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are your strength. You are sensitive to intercultural and interdisciplinary matters - working in a team comes natural to you.

• You are a proactive individual with passion and commitment to innovate healthcare through our Roche Diagnostics Postdoc Program.

• Excellent English skills are required, German is not mandatory.

When does it start?
This position will be filled with effect Septmber 2026 and is limited to 2 years.

Have we aroused your interest?
# If we are convinced, a virtual interview will take place
# If you also manage to convince us here, the last step is an interview and presentation in the
Penzberg area

Your application
Please submit your application by sending an updated CV (including publication list and
references) together with your latest certificates. Before sending your application, please note
that no further documents can be added subsequently.

We are looking forward to your application!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives u

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Developing enzymes for Roche internally as well as externally means for us the development of tailor-made biocatalysts and biological targets for creating the best-in-class molecules for Roche and our clients. Combining several biotechnological methods such as expression profiling, cell cultivation, enzyme purification portfolio, enzyme engineering and biochemical investigations, we always try to improve, to maintain or to design new enzymes. Mandatory, the complete value chain as a platform thought of Roche is given. We are working cross-functional for both the diagnostic and pharma division of Roche worldwide. Being an R&D function we always try to keep close contacts with our clients as with our production for ensuring a fast, but qualitatively high development which should result in functional Roche products finally. As a Post-Doc Position in Novel Enzymes (m/f/d) , you actively shape the development of new enzymes using biotechnological and bioinformatic methods. Become part of an innovative research team that consolidates a platform from dry-lab to wet-lab to develop customized enzymes for our diagnostics. We offer you a unique opportunity to translate your scientific ideas into practice and thus contribute to the improvement of patient health. The opportunity
• You ensure the development of new enzymes using a combination of biotechnological and bioinformatic methods
• You are responsible for the independent production of tailored proteins/enzymes using molecular biological methods or the establishment of new production and screening methods for protein variants
• You support the consolidation of a platform from dry-lab to wet-lab, suitable for the protein engineering of novel enzymes
• You implement new biochemical and biophysical readouts suitable for the screening and development of tailored enzymes
• You pursue scientific and technical education by continuously following and reading the relevant scientific literature Who you are
• You possess a university degree (Dr. / Ph.D.) in a relevant field
• You have specialized knowledge in the areas of protein engineering, bioinformatics, and molecular biology
• Experience in microbiology, downstream and upstream processing, as well as chemistry, is an advantage
• You demonstrate knowledge and expertise in recombinant protein expression, protein purification, and the development of protein analytical methods for protein characterization
• You are willing to provide consultation and troubleshooting regarding enzyme challenges in Research & Development and Production This position is limited to 2 years. Application documents To make the application process as convenient as possible for you please add only a motivation letter and your updated CV . References and certificates are not required at this stage. We look forward to receiving your application! Your contact to us! With people. For people. Do you need further support? Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver

As a Post-Doc Position in Novel Enzymes (m/f/d) , you actively shape the development of new enzymes using biotechnological and bioinformatic methods. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Global MSAT & Engineering function is undergoing a strategic modernization initiative to introduce innovative, efficient, and sustainable manufacturing technologies across our global device manufacturing footprint. As the Group Lead for Device Process Engineering, you will be the architect of our technical talent and process excellence. This is a dual-impact leadership role: you will serve as a senior technical authority for our most complex device programs and lead a world-class chapter of Process Engineers, ensuring they have the skills, tools, and standardized methodologies to deliver next-generation medical devices and drug-device combination products to patients worldwide.

The Opportunity

• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of process engineers, setting clear expectations for technical excellence and functional capability.

• Define and drive the global process-engineering strategy for device and combination product assembly, packaging, and sterilization across the entire product lifecycle.

• Act as the senior technical authority for complex engineering decisions, balancing quality, compliance, supply, and speed-to-market.

• Drive structured process characterization using DOE and statistical tools to define operating windows and ensure process understanding.

• Establish methodologies for identifying critical process parameters (CPPs) and material attributes to ensure robust control strategies.

• Own design transfer activities, translating design outputs into production specifications, equipment requirements, and manufacturing work instructions.

• Define and govern risk-based validation strategies for manufacturing processes, equipment qualification, and sterilization.

• Manage the process-engineering framework for continued process verification, investigation support, and lifecycle optimization.

• Ensure all engineering practices comply with global regulatory requirements, including FDA QMSR, ISO 13485, and EU MDR.

Who you are
You are a strategic and technically credible leader who moves fluently between executive decision-making and deep engineering problem-solving. You have the ability to explain complex validation decisions to diverse audiences, translating technical risks into clear business impacts. You are a dedicated coach and talent developer who sets high standards for technical rigor while empowering your team to act. As an effective communicator and resilient collaborator, you build trust across matrixed organizations and remain focused on shared objectives even during periods of ambiguity or change.

Further you have the following qualifications and experiences:

• Degree (B.S., M.S., or Ph.D.) in Mechanical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Engineering, or a related technical field.

• 12-15+ years of experience in process engineering or technical operations within regulated medical device or pharma environments.

• Proven track record in formal people leadership and influencing across a matrixed global organization.

• Deep expertise in device assembly, packaging, sterilization, and automated manufacturing from development to commercial scale.

• Strong knowledge of design controls, risk management (ISO 14971), DfM, and technical transfer processes.

• Experience working with global external manufacturing partners and supplier networks.

Are you ready to make a difference for our patients? We are looking forward to your application – join us now and become part of our journey!

Who we are
A healthier future drives u

descriptionByLocale.it: Roche - Opportunità di lavoro Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Mansioni La funzione Global MSAT & Engineering sta subendo un'iniziativa di modernizzazione strategica per introdurre tecnologie di produzione innovative, efficienti e sostenibili attraverso la nostra impronta globale di produzione di dispositivi. In qualità di Gruppo Lead for Device Process Engineering, sarai l'architetto del nostro talento tecnico e dell'eccellenza del processo. Questo è un ruolo di leadership dual-impact: servirai come autorità tecnica senior per i nostri programmi di dispositivo più complessi e condurre un capitolo di livello mondiale di ingegneri di processo, assicurando loro di avere le competenze, gli strumenti e metodologie standardizzate per fornire dispositivi medici di prossima generazione e prodotti combinati droga-dispositivi a pazienti in tutto il mondo. Opportunità - Lead, coach e sviluppare un team di ingegneri di processo altamente performanti, ponendo chiare aspettative per l'eccellenza tecnica e la funzionalità. - Definire e guidare la strategia globale di ingegneria del processo per l'assemblaggio, l'imballaggio e la sterilizzazione del prodotto di dispositivo e combinazione in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. - Agire come autorità tecnica senior per decisioni di ingegneria complesse, bilanciare la qualità, la conformità, la fornitura e la velocità di mercato. - Guidare la caratterizzazione del processo strutturato utilizzando DOE e strumenti statistici per definire le finestre operative e garantire la comprensione del processo. - Stabilire metodologie per identificare i parametri di processo critici (CPP) e gli attributi materiali per garantire strategie di controllo robuste. - Attività di trasferimento di progettazione proprie, traducendo uscite di progettazione in specifiche di produzione, requisiti di attrezzature e istruzioni di lavoro di fabbricazione. - Definire e governare strategie di validazione basate sui rischi per processi di produzione, qualificazione delle attrezzature e sterilizzazione. - Gestire il quadro di ingegneria del processo per la verifica continua del processo, il supporto di indagine e l'ottimizzazione del ciclo di vita. - Assicurarsi che tutte le pratiche ingegneristiche siano conformi ai requisiti normativi globali, tra cui FDA QMSR, ISO 13485 e EU MDR. Chi sei? Sei un leader strategico e tecnicamente credibile che si muove fluentemente tra il processo decisionale esecutivo e la risoluzione dei problemi di ingegneria profonda. Hai la capacità di spiegare complesse decisioni di validazione a diversi pubblico, traducendo i rischi tecnici in chiari impatti aziendali. Sei un allenatore dedicato e sviluppatore di talenti che stabilisce standard elevati per il rigore tecnico, consentendo al tuo team di agire. Come un efficace comunicatore e collaboratore resiliente, si costruisce fiducia tra le organizzazioni matrici e si concentrano su obiettivi condivisi anche durante i periodi di ambiguità o cambiamento. Inoltre, hai le seguenti qualifiche ed esperienze: - Laurea (B.S., M.S. o Ph.D.) in Ingegneria Meccanica, Ingegneria Farmaceutica, o un campo tecnico correlato. - 12-15 anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria dei processi o nelle operazioni tecniche all'interno di dispositivi medici regolamentati o in ambienti farmaci. - Provato record di traccia nella leadership delle persone formali e influenzando attraverso un'organizzazione globale matrice. - Profonda competenza nel montaggio, imballaggio, sterilizzazione e produzione automatizzata da sviluppo a scala commerciale. - Forte conoscenza dei controlli di progettazione, gestione dei rischi (ISO 14971), DfM e processi di trasferimento tecnico. - Esperienza di lavoro con partner di produzione esterni globali e reti di fornitori. Contatto Sei pronto a fare la differenza per i nostri pazienti? Non vediamo l'ora della tua applicazione – unisciti a noi ora e diventi parte del nostro viaggio! descriptionByLocale.de: Roche - Stellenangebote Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Mansion Die globale MSAT & Engineering-Funktion unternimmt eine strategische Modernisierungsinitiative zur Einführung innovativer, effizienter und nachhaltiger Fertigungstechnologien in unserem weltweiten Fertigungs-Fußabdruck. Als Group Lead for Device Process Engineering werden Sie der Architekt unseres technischen Talents und Prozess-Exzellenz sein. Dies ist eine dual-impact-Führungsrolle: Sie werden als leitende technische Behörde für unsere komplexesten Geräteprogramme dienen und ein erstklassiges Kapitel der Prozessingenieure führen, um sicherzustellen, dass sie die Fähigkeiten, Werkzeuge und standardisierten Methoden haben, um medizinische Geräte der nächsten Generation und Arzneimittel-Geräte-Kombinationsprodukte an Patienten weltweit zu liefern. Zur Übersicht - Führen, Coach und entwickeln ein hochperformierendes Team von Prozessingenieuren, das klare Erwartungen an technische Exzellenz und Funktionsfähigkeit legt. - Definieren und treiben Sie die globale Prozess-Engineering-Strategie für Geräte- und Kombinationsproduktmontage, Verpackung und Sterilisation über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus hinweg. - Gesetz als leitende technische Behörde für komplexe technische Entscheidungen, Balance von Qualität, Compliance, Angebot und Geschwindigkeit zu Markt. - Führen Sie die strukturierte Prozesscharakterisierung mithilfe von DOE und statistischen Tools aus, um Bedienfenster zu definieren und das Prozessverständnis zu gewährleisten. - Methoden zur Identifizierung kritischer Prozessparameter (CPPs) und Materialattribute, um robuste Steuerungsstrategien zu gewährleisten. - Eigene Design-Transfer-Aktivitäten, Übersetzen von Design-Ausgängen in Produktionsspezifikationen, Geräteanforderungen und Fertigungsaufträge. - Festlegung und Regelung von risikobasierten Validierungsstrategien für Fertigungsprozesse, Gerätequalifikation und Sterilisation. - Verwalten Sie den Prozess-Engineering-Rahmen für die kontinuierliche Prozessprüfung, Untersuchungsunterstützung und Lifecycle-Optimierung. - Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle technischen Praktiken den globalen Regulierungsanforderungen entsprechen, einschließlich FDA QMSR, ISO 13485 und EU MDR. Chi sei Sie sind ein strategischer und technisch glaubwürdiger Anführer, der sich fließend zwischen der Entscheidungsfindung und der Problemlösung im Tiefbau bewegt. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, komplexe Validierungsentscheidungen für unterschiedliche Publikum zu erklären und technische Risiken in klare geschäftliche Auswirkungen zu übersetzen. Sie sind ein engagierter Coach und Talent-Entwickler, der hohe Standards für technische Rigor setzt und Ihr Team befähigen, zu handeln. Als effektiver Kommunikator und widerstandsfähiger Mitarbeiter bauen Sie Vertrauen in Matrix-Organisationen und bleiben auf gemeinsame Ziele auch während Perioden von Mehrdeutigkeit oder Veränderung konzentriert. Darüber hinaus haben Sie folgende Qualifikationen und Erfahrungen: - Grad (B.S., M.S. oder Ph.D.) in Maschinenbau, Pharmatechnik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich. - 12-15+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Verfahrenstechnik oder im technischen Betrieb in regulierten Medizinprodukten oder Pharmaumgebungen. - Bewiesene Erfolgsbilanzen in der förmlichen Menschenführung und Einflussnahme auf eine weltweite Matrix. - Tiefes Know-how in der Gerätemontage, Verpackung, Sterilisation und automatisierten Fertigung von der Entwicklung bis zum kommerziellen Maßstab. - Starkes Wissen über Designsteuerungen, Risikomanagement (ISO 14971), DfM und technische Transferprozesse. - Erleben Sie die Zusammenarbeit mit globalen externen Fertigungspartnern und Lieferantennetzwerken. Contattoo Sind Sie bereit, einen Unterschied für unsere Patienten zu machen? Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung – jetzt beitreten und Teil unserer Reise werden! Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. En tant que chef de groupe pour l'ingénierie des procédés d'appareils, vous serez l'architecte de notre talent technique et de l'excellence des procédés. Les Vous êtes un leader stratégique et techniquement crédible qui se déplace couramment entre la prise de décision exécutive et la résolution de problèmes en ingénierie profonde. Vous avez la capacité d'expliquer des décisions de validation complexes à divers publics, transformant les risques techniques en impacts commerciaux clairs. Vous êtes un entraîneur et développeur de talents dédié qui fixe des normes élevées pour la rigueur technique tout en donnant à votre équipe les moyens d'agir. En tant que communicateur efficace et collaborateur résilient, vous renforcez la confiance entre les organisations matricielles et demeurez concentré sur des objectifs communs, même en période d'ambiguïté ou de changement. De plus, vous avez les qualifications et expériences suivantes: - Degré (B.S., M.S. ou Ph.D.) en génie mécanique, en génie pharmaceutique ou dans un domaine technique connexe. - 12 à 15 ans d'expérience en génie des procédés ou en opérations techniques dans des environnements réglementés d'instruments médicaux ou pharmaceutiques. - Expérience éprouvée en matière de leadership formel et d'influence dans une organisation mondiale matricielle. - Une expertise approfondie dans l'assemblage, l'emballage, la stérilisation et la fabrication automatisée, du développement à l'échelle commerciale. - Bonne connaissance des contrôles de conception, de la gestion des risques (ISO 14971), du DfM et des processus de transfert technique. - Expérience de travail avec des partenaires de fabrication et des réseaux de fournisseurs extérieurs. Contatto Êtes-vous prêt à faire la différence pour nos patients ? Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature – rejoignez-nous maintenant et faites partie de notre voyage! jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At the heart of our digital security is the trust we build through encrypted communication. As a PKI Engineer, you will join our Identity and Access Management (IAM) team to help manage the core certificate infrastructure. You’ll be instrumental in ensuring that our digital certificates are issued, tracked, and renewed without a hitch. This is a growth-oriented role where you will learn to navigate complex security infrastructures while contributing to the automation of high-volume security tasks.

Job Responsibilities

Scope

• Support the day-to-day administration of Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), including basic template management and standard troubleshooting.

• Use Keyfactor Command to monitor certificate health, identify expiring assets, and assist in bringing untracked certificates into compliance.

• Support the deployment of ACME clients (like Certbot) for automated certificate issuance across web server environments.

• Participate in the automation of routine certificate tasks using Version Control systems and scripting as required (PowerShell or Python).

• Collaborate with senior engineers to orchestrate certificate distribution to load balancers, firewalls, and application servers.

Impact/Strategy

• Collaborate in the automation of routine certificate tasks using basic scripting (PowerShell or Python) and maintain scripts using version control systems.

• Assist in maintaining team internal wikis, standard operating procedures, and runbooks for certificate lifecycle management.

• Collaborate with senior engineers to route, distribute, and install certificates to load balancers, firewalls, and application servers .

​
Complexity

• Focuses primarily on executing defined procedures, troubleshooting routine issues, and escalating complex anomalies to senior team members.

• Contributes to team agility by identifying operational inefficiencies and proposing minor process improvements within immediate daily tasks.

• Demonstrates growing autonomy within the specific domain by translating daily requirements into structured tasks under direct supervision.

​
Business/Technical ability

• Possesses a working knowledge of the relevant business domain and supporting technologies

• Understands sources of influence, comprehending internal and external factors affecting the problem space, and is capable of identifying and analyzing basic business problems or opportunities holistically

​
Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Experience: 1–2 years of experience in an IT Helpdesk, Systems Administration, or junior Security Operations (SOC) role. An internship focused on infrastructure or security is highly valued.

• Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, or equivalent practical experience.

• Working knowledge of relevant business domains and supporting cybersecurity technologies

• Demonstrated ability to independently handle defined tasks and contribute to various stages of the security and business analysis lifecycle

​
Technical Skills

• Understanding of Zero Trust principles, authentication factors and cryptography.

• A solid understanding of cryptography basics (Symmetric vs. Asymmetric, Hashing, Digital Signatures).

• Experience with Windows Server and Active Directory. Exposure to web servers like IIS, Apache, or Nginx. Comfortable using Git for basic file management and collaboration.

• Knowledge of the ACME protocol or experience using tools like Certbot.

• Familiarity with PowerShell o

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At the heart of our digital security is the trust we build through encrypted communication. As a PKI Engineer, you will join our Identity and Access Management (IAM) team to help manage the core certificate infrastructure. You’ll be instrumental in ensuring that our digital certificates are issued, tracked, and renewed without a hitch. This is a growth-oriented role where you will learn to navigate complex security infrastructures while contributing to the automation of high-volume security tasks. Job Responsibilities Scope
• Support the day-to-day administration of Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), including basic template management and standard troubleshooting.
• Use Keyfactor Command to monitor certificate health, identify expiring assets, and assist in bringing untracked certificates into compliance.
• Support the deployment of ACME clients (like Certbot) for automated certificate issuance across web server environments.
• Participate in the automation of routine certificate tasks using Version Control systems and scripting as required (PowerShell or Python).
• Collaborate with senior engineers to orchestrate certificate distribution to load balancers, firewalls, and application servers. Impact/Strategy
• Collaborate in the automation of routine certificate tasks using basic scripting (PowerShell or Python) and maintain scripts using version control systems.
• Assist in maintaining team internal wikis, standard operating procedures, and runbooks for certificate lifecycle management.
• Collaborate with senior engineers to route, distribute, and install certificates to load balancers, firewalls, and application servers . ​ Complexity
• Focuses primarily on executing defined procedures, troubleshooting routine issues, and escalating complex anomalies to senior team members.
• Contributes to team agility by identifying operational inefficiencies and proposing minor process improvements within immediate daily tasks.
• Demonstrates growing autonomy within the specific domain by translating daily requirements into structured tasks under direct supervision. ​ Business/Technical ability
• Possesses a working knowledge of the relevant business domain and supporting technologies
• Understands sources of influence, comprehending internal and external factors affecting the problem space, and is capable of identifying and analyzing basic business problems or opportunities holistically ​ Qualifications Education / Experience
• Experience: 1–2 years of experience in an IT Helpdesk, Systems Administration, or junior Security Operations (SOC) role. An internship focused on infrastructure or security is highly valued.
• Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, or equivalent practical experience.
• Working knowledge of relevant business domains and supporting cybersecurity technologies
• Demonstrated ability to independently handle defined tasks and contribute to various stages of the security and business analysis lifecycle ​ Technical Skills
• Understanding of Zero Trust principles, authentication factors and cryptography.
• A solid understanding of cryptography basics (Symmetric vs. Asymmetric, Hashing, Digital Signatures).
• Experience with Windows Server and Active Directory. Exposure to web servers like IIS, Apache, or Nginx. Comfortable using Git for basic file management and collaboration.
• Knowledge of the ACME protocol or experience using tools like Certbot.
• Familiarity with PowerShell o

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer for Network Security
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Network Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate network-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee egress/ingress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are primarily instantiated through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. We work closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s network security posture.

You’ll be working within the Network Security Product area. This area is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of solutions—designing, building, and maintaining the technologies that protect Roche networks and the Internet, whether on-prem or cloud-based. This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection , Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN) , Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape.

As the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Network Security, you will lead the Design, Build, and Improvement of critical security infrastructures, specifically focusing on Cisco ISE, Wired Access Control (WAC), and Palo Alto Networks. This is a dual-impact role: you are the technical authority for the secure access layer, while simultaneously leading the engineering of a custom observability framework. You will develop the front-end, back-end, and integration logic required to provide deep visibility into the security product health and asset inventory.

Job Responsibilities

1. SME:
Secure Access (ISE, WAC, Palo Alto)

• Design & Architecture: Lead the high-level and low-level design (HLD/LLD) for global Cisco ISE deployments and Wired Access Control (WAC) strategies to ensure seamless, identity-based security.

• Palo Alto SME: Serve as the primary engineer for Palo Alto NGFW architectures, including advanced threat prevention, decryption, and secure egress/ingress traffic management.

• Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify gaps in the current security posture and implement technical enhancements to NAC policies, SGT (TrustSec) propagation, and firewall rule-sets.

• Build & Implementation: Act as the lead "implementer" for complex global migrations and new feature rollouts across the network security stack.

​
2. Observability Framework Engineering

• Full-Stack Development: Architect and develop a custom framework (front-end and back-end) to provide a "single pane of glass" for infrastructure health.

• Inventory & Integration: Build automated integrations with external data sources (CMDB, IPAM, etc.) to maintain a real-time, dynamic inventory of all network assets and security nodes.

• Telemetry Logic: Design custom logic to ingest and visualize telemetry from ISE, WAC, and Palo Alto using APIs, SNMP, and Syslog.

​
3. Operational Excellence & Visibility

• Technical Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the lead engineer for complex network security escalations, providing root-cause analysis and implementing long-term, automated architectural fixes.

• Security Observability: Develop dashboards and reporting to provide real-time visibility into the "connected landscape," identifying insecure nodes or unauthorized devices before they can affect the network.

• Automation & Orchestration: Manage security policies as code while continuously improving automation workflows and cross-platform orchest

The Position
Pharma Technical Operations (PT) is responsible for manufacturing, supply chain, and quality across the pharmaceutical network. Within PT, PTT (MSAT & Engineering) is responsible for ensuring that PT stays at the forefront of technology in our facilities and supports our robust processes & efficient operations. We focus on integrating product health, process health with equipment fit for purpose, and facility readiness in support of the manufacturing network.
Global Device, Packaging and Distribution MSAT ensures our device-related products including platforms and packaging systems are robustly engineered, efficiently manufactured, and safely delivered and maintained.
The medical device platform team at Roche advances innovative drug delivery systems supporting Roche’s therapeutic, eye care and incretin portfolios. We are seeking a highly skilled Medical Device Platform Design Engineer to contribute to the design and maintenance of Autoinjector and/or PFS-Needle Safety Device platforms utilized in drug-device combination products.

The Opportunity

The successful candidate is a hands-on problem solver, a strategic thinker, and a trusted technical advisor who can both dive deep into engineering challenges and provide actionable guidance and feedback across Roche’s development and sustaining engineering lifecycles.

• Act as technical product design expert supporting product development and sustaining engineering teams throughout the platform-based combination product lifecycle.

• Provide professional mechanical engineering design expertise on multiple products, from concept generation and engineering analysis to both internally and externally utilized device design platform technologies.

• Interface with external suppliers and partners to provide technical oversight on the mechanical design of components and subassemblies used in combination products (prefilled syringes and autoinjectors), driving performance, accountability, and innovation.

• Lead reliability engineering assessments including edge-of-failure testing, variance management activities, tolerance sensitivity assessments, and creation/maintenance of Computer Aided Engineering models and digital twins for virtual analytical data collection.

• Actively seek out, anticipate, and solve significant functional and assembly related technical challenges of platform based Autoinjector and PFS-NSD combination products.

• Lead technical investigations, both within Roche as well as at third party manufacturers, for technical challenges related to design, manufacturing, and scale-up processes, to resolve device and assembly issues timely and effectively.

• Lead and participate in writing product and customer requirements, design and design phase reviews, product and process risk assessments, root cause investigations, and corrective action planning.

Who you are

This role is ideal for a versatile, self-motivated engineer with a broad technical design foundation and the ability to adapt quickly across disciplines, projects, and challenges.

Within PT, PTT (MSAT & Engineering) is responsible for ensuring that PT stays at the forefront of technology in our facilities and supports our robust processes & efficient operations. We focus on integrating product health, process health with equipment fit for purpose, and facility readiness in support of the manufacturing network. Global Device, Packaging and Distribution MSAT ensures our device-related products including platforms and packaging systems are robustly engineered, efficiently manufactured, and safely delivered and maintained. The medical device platform team at Roche advances innovative drug delivery systems supporting Roche’s therapeutic, eye care and incretin portfolios. We are seeking a highly skilled Medical Device Platform Design Engineer to contribute to the design and maintenance of Autoinjector and/or PFS-Needle Safety Device platforms utilized in drug-device combination products. The Opportunity The successful candidate is a hands-on problem solver, a strategic thinker, and a trusted technical advisor who can both dive deep into engineering challenges and provide actionable guidance and feedback across Roche’s development and sustaining engineering lifecycles.
• Act as technical product design expert supporting product development and sustaining engineering teams throughout the platform-based combination product lifecycle.
• Provide professional mechanical engineering design expertise on multiple products, from concept generation and engineering analysis to both internally and externally utilized device design platform technologies.
• Interface with external suppliers and partners to provide technical oversight on the mechanical design of components and subassemblies used in combination products (prefilled syringes and autoinjectors), driving performance, accountability, and innovation.
• Lead reliability engineering assessments including edge-of-failure testing, variance management activities, tolerance sensitivity assessments, and creation/maintenance of Computer Aided Engineering models and digital twins for virtual analytical data collection.
• Actively seek out, anticipate, and solve significant functional and assembly related technical challenges of platform based Autoinjector and PFS-NSD combination products.
• Lead technical investigations, both within Roche as well as at third party manufacturers, for technical challenges related to design, manufacturing, and scale-up processes, to resolve device and assembly issues timely and effectively.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
IT Business Analyst - Pharma R&D

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

As a Senior Business Analyst , you will independently manage end-to-end business analysis workstreams, tackling complex business problems with emerging ambiguity. You will demonstrate a strong understanding of the business domain, related technologies, and their interdependencies, applying advanced tools and techniques to translate requirements into strategic implementation plans. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives, handling process interdependencies, and significantly contributing to the design and validation of effective solutions. You will also mentor junior analysts and actively shape team processes, methodologies, and best practices within the broader Community of Practice.

The opportunity:

Within the Pharma Organisation Medical Affairs serves as the bridge between clinical development and the commercialization of medicines. The domain is increasingly focused on External Stakeholder Engagement, aiming to derive deep insights into unmet medical needs, treatment barriers, and patient perceptions of data. By synthesizing these insights, Medical Affairs shapes the organization’s overall strategic direction. As an IT Business Analyst in this space, you will support the digital transformation of how scientific evidence is generated , managed, and communicated to the global medical community.

• Scope/(Content Leadership) : Independently manages end-to-end business analysis workstreams, tackling problems with emerging ambiguity. Proficiently adapts a range of standard frameworks, mentors junior and intermediate BAs, and proactively shapes team ways of working and best practices.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of business problems, performs thorough domain research, and drives root cause analysis. Accountable for delivering comprehensive requirements, contributing significantly to solution selection, and proactively identifying needs-solution discrepancies to propose creative improvements.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies a diverse range of cross-functional stakeholders and builds reliance through deep business understanding to act as a trusted advisor. Facilitates workshops, resolves conflicts, and proactively shapes stakeholder perspectives to strategically manage expectations and align them with project goals.

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Modalità di lavoro Roche offre un modello di lavoro ibrido che abbina flessibilità con la collaborazione in presenza. Al momento, richiediamo ai nostri dipendenti di essere nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici in ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, riunioni di squadra e altri eventi collaborativi. Responsabilità Mansioni - Gestisce in modo indipendente i flussi di lavoro dell'analisi aziendale dall'inizio alla fine, affrontando problemi con ambiguità emergente. - Adatta con disinvoltura una serie di framework standard, mentor analisti junior e intermedi e plasma in modo proattivo i modi di lavorare della squadra e le migliori pratiche. Responsabilità/Problem Solving - Guida l'analisi dei problemi aziendali, esegue ricerche approfondite nel dominio e guida l'analisi delle cause fondamentali. - È responsabile della consegna di requisizione completa, significativamente alla selezione della soluzione e identifica proattivamente le discrepanze tra esigenze e soluzioni per arrivare creativi. Gestione degli Stakeholder - Identifica una vasta gamma di stakeholder cross-functionali e costruite la fiducia attraverso una profonda comprensione del business per agire come un consulente affidabile. - Organizza workshop, risolve e plasma proattivamente le prospettive degli stakeholder per gestire strategicamente le aspettative e allinearle con gli obiettivi del progetto. Impatto/Strategia - Indicare un impatto su un prodotto, un'iniziativa o un cluster specifico, contribuendo agli obiettivi del dominio garantito che le soluzioni aggiuntive valore. Opportunità All'interno dell'Organizzazione Farmaceutica, la Medical Affairs fa da ponte tra lo sviluppo clinico e la commercializzazione dei medicinali. Il dominio si concentra sempre di più sull'impegno con gli stakeholder esterni, con l'obiettivo di derivare approfondite informazioni sulle esigenze mediche non soddisfatte, sulle barriere terapeutiche e sulle percezioni dei pazienti sui dati. Sintetizzando queste informazioni, la Medical Affairs plasma la direzione strategica dell'organizzazione. In qualità di IT Business Analyst in questo spazio, supporterai la trasformazione digitale di come le prove scientifiche vengono genera, gestite e comunicate alla comunità medica globale.
• Requisiti Esperienza - Esperienza dimostrata nella gestione di progetti complessi e nella collaborazione con team cross-functionali. - Esperienza nella gestione di progetti IT e nella definizione di requisizione. - Esperienza nella gestione di progetti di trasformazione digitale. Condividi su Twitter - Conoscenza approfondita delle migliori pratiche nell'analisi aziendale e nella gestione dei progetti. - Conoscenza delle tecnologie IT e delle loro interrelazioni. - Conoscenza del dominio farmaceutico e della ricerca medica. Competenze - Capacità di analisi e risoluzione dei problemi. - Capacità di gestione dei progetti e dei team. - Capacità di comunicazione efficace e di gestione degli stakeholder. - Capacità di adattamento e di apprendimento rapido. Cosa? Benefici - Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo e rispettoso. - L'opportunità di lavorare su progetti che hanno un impatto significativo sulla salute delle persone in tutto il mondo. - Un pacchetto di beneficio competitivo, tra cui una equa e vantaggiosa, programmi di formazione e sviluppo professionale, e un'ampia gamma di beneficio per la salute e il benessere. Contatto Per ulteriori informazioni o per candidarsi, visita il nostro sito web o contatta il nostro team delle Risorse Umane.

Mansioni Analyste des affaires en TI - R-D en pharmacie Descrizione Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassés pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Modalità di Lavoro Roche offre un modelo di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaboration in presenza. Al momento, richiediamo ai nostri dipendenti di essere nei nostri uffici dans les médias dus giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici in ufficiopossono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, ven workshop, conferenze, riunioni di scoulara e altri eventi collatorivi. Responsabilité Mansioni - Gestise in modo indipendente i flussi di lavoro dell'analisi aziendale dall'inizio alla fine, affrontando problemi con ambiguità emergenente. - Adatta con disinvoltura una serie di framework standard, mentor analisti junior e intermed e plasma in modo proattivo i modi di lavorare della squadra e le migliori pratiche. Responsabilità/Résoudre les problèmes - Guida l'analisi dei problemi aziendali, esegue ricerche approfondite nel dominio e guida l'analisi delle cause fondamentali. - È responsabile della consegna di requisiti completi, contribuisce significativamente alla selezione della soluzione e identifica proattivamente le discretanze tra esigenze e soluzioni per proporre miglioramenti creativi. Gestione dei Intervenant - Identifica una vasta gamma di interfonctionaliti e costruisce la fiducia attraverso una profonda comprensione del business per agire come un consulente affidabile. - Organizza workshop, risolve conflitti e plasma proattivamente le prospetive degli partner per gestire strategicamente le aspetative e allinale con gli obiettivi del progetto. Impatto/Stratégie - Fornisce un impatto su un prodotto, un'iniziativa o un cluster specico, contribuendo agli obiettivi del dominio garantendo che le soluzioni forniscono valore. Annexe All'interno dell'Organizzazione Farmaceutica, la Medical Affairs fa da ponte tra lo sviluppo clinico e la commercializzazione dei medicini. Il dominio si concentra sempre di più sull'impegno con gli partnership esterni, con l'obiettivo di derivare approfondite informazioni sulle esigenze mediche non soddisfatte, sulle barrière terapeutiche e sulle percezioni dei pazienti sui dati. Sintetizzando queste informazioni, la Medical Affairs plasma la direzione strategica dell'organizzazione. Dans qualità di IT Business Analyste in questo spazio, supporterai la trasformazione digitale di come le proverishhe vengono gener, gestite e comunicate alla comunità medica globale.
• Requisiti Espagne - Esperienza dimostrata nella gestione di progetti complessi e nella collazione con team cross-fonctionni. - Esperienza nella gestione di progetti IT e nella definizione di requisiti. - Esperienza nella gestione di progetti di trasformazione digitale. Conoscenze - Conoscenza approfondita delle best practice nell'analisi aziendale e nella gestione dei progetti. - Conoscenza delle tecnologie IT e delle loro interrelazioni. - Conoscenza del dominio farmaceutico e della ricerca medica. Competenze - Capacità di analisi e risoluzione dei problemi. - Capacità di gestione dei progetti e dei team. - Capacità di comunicazione efficace e di gestione degli partie prenante. - Capacità di adattamento e di apprendimento rapido. Cosa
• Offriamo Prestations - Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo e rispettoso. - L'opportunità di lavorare su progetti che hanno un impatto significativo sulla salue delle persone in tutto il mondo. - Un achat di benefit competivo, tra cui una retribuzione equa e vantaggiosa, programmi di formazione e sviluppo professionale, e un'ampia gamma di benefit per la saluant e il benessere. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description

As a Cloud DevOps Infrastructure Engineer at the SE6 level, you will be responsible for solving unusually complex business problems with innovative DevOps solutions across the entire infrastructure landscape. Possessing deep knowledge of the impact of DevOps practices on business infrastructure, you will make critical technical decisions across multiple product lines with considerable independence. In this role, you will proactively influence technology strategy, mentor teams, and ensure alignment with organizational objectives and regulatory standards.

Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Establishes technical direction to the whole lifecycle of platforms and services—from inception and design through deployment, operation, and retirement. Applies software engineering principles to build and manage large-scale IT infrastructure products and services, abstracting away the complexity of infrastructure to provide self-service tools and APIs for developers. Designs complex CI/CD pipelines, designs and develops self-healing features, and leads Disaster Recovery design and execution plans.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Strategically applies advanced problem-solving and decision-making skills to address highly complex issues spanning multiple product lines within a domain. Leads the maintenance of live services by designing metrics to measure availability, latency, and system health, and is responsible for identifying critical metrics used to establish SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs. Proactively plans for IT Infrastructure capacity, performance, and scalability, and leads large initiatives aimed at optimizing inter-related platforms. Accountable for availability, tuning, efficiency, change and configuration management, and emergency response.

• Stakeholder Management: Demonstrates exceptional customer and delivery focus by proactively leading partnership and collaboration with developers, Managed Services suppliers, and vendors to continuously improve application development velocity and optimize services reliability. Works closely with development teams to ensure new features are rolled out with a strategic understanding of reliability. Provides direction, guidance, and priority setting, acting as a senior analyst to transform customer and developer needs into specific requirements.

• Impact/Strategy: Ensures implemented solutions comply with Quality/Regulatory standards and is responsible for implementing and updating cost, compliance, and security best practices. Leads complex audit exercises, providing required evidence to audit teams, and leads audit remediation plans. Manages ITSM processes, challenges requirements to scale systems sustainably, and applies innovation to foster business strategy.

• Complexity/ (Product Size): Demonstrates proven ability to collaborate effectively with diverse virtual teams globally, driving success across multiple product lines within a domain. Leads geo-distributed teams through influence and mentorship, providing specialized guidance to optimize performance and innovation.

• Business/Technical ability: Utilizes wide experience applying Software Engineering principles, automated testing, and CI/CD tools to define technical computing infrastructure entirely under the control of software with no human intervention. Implements and maintains Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) and CI/CD pipelines. Applies design thinking, lean, prioritization, and agile methodologies to evo

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
F
ield Application Specialist (Molecular Biology & Pathology) – Castilla y León

¿Te apasiona la intersección entre la ciencia de vanguardia y la tecnología de diagnóstico? En Roche, no solo trabajamos; somos pioneros en biotecnología para mejorar la salud y el bienestar en todo el mundo. Buscamos un Field Application Specialist con base en Valladolid (valorando otras zonas de Castilla y León) para liderar nuestras líneas de Biología Molecular y Anatomía Patológica .

Tu Misión: Transformar el Diagnóstico
Tu rol será el motor que garantice que nuestras soluciones operen con la máxima excelencia. Serás el referente científico y técnico para nuestros clientes, asegurando que cada sistema instalado se convierta en una ventaja competitiva que mejore la vida de los pacientes.
¿Qué harás en tu día a día?

• Excelencia Operativa: Ejecutarás instalaciones, configuraciones y mantenimientos (preventivos y correctivos) de nuestros analizadores y software.

• Empoderamiento del Cliente: Capacitarás y entrenarás a los usuarios en el manejo de soluciones de alta tecnología.

• Consultoría Científica: Proporcionarás información técnica profunda y apoyo en la implementación de nuevos protocolos y controles de calidad.

• Socio Estratégico: Colaborarás estrechamente con el equipo de Ventas y Marketing para identificar necesidades y respaldar nuevas oportunidades comerciales.

• Gestión Digital: Reportarás tu actividad en CRM, asegurando que toda la documentación técnica esté siempre al día y bajo los más altos estándares.
¿Quién eres?

• Formación: Grado en Ciencias de la Salud (Biología, Biomedicina, Biotecnología o similar) o Ingeniería.

• Experiencia: Se valorará muy positivamente contar con experiencia previa en el sector del diagnóstico in vitro o laboratorios clínicos , así como conocimiento en flujos de trabajo automatizados.

• Especialización: Conocimiento o especialización en Biología Molecular y/o Anatomía Patológica .

• Idiomas: Nivel fluido de español e inglés (capacidad para interactuar con referentes globales).

• Habilidades: Eres una persona curiosa, con gran capacidad de comunicación, liderazgo y una clara vocación de servicio al cliente.

• Movilidad: Tienes carnet de conducir B1 y disponibilidad para viajar por el territorio nacional e internacional cuando sea necesario.

• Residencia: Preferiblemente en Valladolid u otras zonas de Castilla y León.
¿Qué te ofrecemos?

• Impacto Real: Participar en un proyecto donde tu trabajo mejora directamente la calidad de las decisiones clínicas.

• Entorno de Innovación: Trabajar con la cartera de pruebas de diagnóstico in vitro más completa del sector.

• Crecimiento Profesional: Desarrollo continuo en una empresa líder, con un entorno de trabajo inclusivo, colaborativo y dinámico .

• Paquete Competitivo: Salario y beneficios sociales

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. jobs.title: Digital Sales Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Digital Sales Specialist

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity

Come join the Roche Digital Solutions sales organization as a Digital Central Lab Consultant where you will be responsible for selling the Roche navify digital portfolio to IHN, hospital, and reference laboratory customers. This field-based position requires consultative sales experience and expertise in lab workflow, IT infrastructure, data flow, informatics, laboratory medicine, laboratory operations, digital applications (i.e. middleware, business intelligence tools, etc.), and Laboratory Information Systems (LIS) to effectively consult with clinical laboratory stakeholders on customized Roche digital solutions and provide strategic recommendations on digital processes. This position engages early in the sales cycle to understand customer needs, deliver customized demos, and design customized digital solutions in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders across Roche’s and customers’ teams.

Responsibilities

• Generates new customer demand across the full portfolio of Core Lab and Molecular navify products (middleware, connectivity, informatics, apps, etc).

• Engage in strategic digital discussions with key customer buying influences, from technical end users to executive level decision makers.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders across sales and implementation teams to define and align on total solution sales strategies to consistently meet and exceed sales targets.

• Conduct laboratory process analysis, develop solution proposal presentations, and deliver recommendations to customers in close alignment with internal stakeholders.

• Deliver software demos and tailored technical presentations to internal and external audiences.

• Adept at translating customer needs into internal action to meet those needs while balancing key business priorities and goals.

• Strong clinical and financial acumen with a demonstrated ability to understand and translate customer needs to effectively position the value of Roche digital solutions.

• Effectively qualify leads and utilize outcomes from workflow analysis and impact studies to provide competitive differentiation and value to the overall customer solution.

• Provides in-depth technical expertise regarding assigned product lines.

• Work cross functionally with internal stakeholders to share information and best practices while remaining actively informed on industry/customer trends that impact business.

• Follow a standardized end-to-end approach that creates evidence-based, differentiated value for the solution portfolio, both inside and outside the walls of the laboratory.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s Degree in a related field (i.e. Information Technology, Medical Technology, Life Sciences) or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years relevant or equivalent experience (i.e. healthcare digital solutions sales, laboratory diagnostics sales)

• Must be autonomous and organized with effective communication, negotiation, and problem solving skills

• Familiarity with digital solutions, laboratory middleware solutions and hospital LIS systems

• Experience with presenting technical information to large external and internal audiences

Preferred Qualifications

• Preferred experience in the chem

descriptionByLocale.it: Mansioni Specialista di vendita digitale Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Specialista di vendita digitale Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. L'opportunità Unisciti all'organizzazione di vendita Roche Digital Solutions come Digital Central Lab Consultant dove sarai responsabile della vendita del portafoglio digitale Roche Navify ai clienti di IHN, ospedale e laboratorio di riferimento. Questa posizione basata sul campo richiede esperienza di vendita consultiva e competenza nel flusso di lavoro di laboratorio, infrastrutture IT, flusso di dati, informatica, medicina di laboratorio, operazioni di laboratorio, applicazioni digitali (cioè middleware, strumenti di business intelligence, ecc.), e Sistemi Informativi di laboratorio (LIS) per consultare efficacemente gli stakeholder di laboratorio clinici sulle soluzioni digitali Roche personalizzate e fornire raccomandazioni strategiche sui processi digitali. Questa posizione si impegna presto nel ciclo di vendita per comprendere le esigenze dei clienti, fornire demo personalizzati e progettare soluzioni digitali personalizzate in collaborazione con gli stakeholder interfunzionali tra i team di Roche e i clienti. Responsabilità - Genera la nuova domanda del cliente attraverso il portafoglio completo dei prodotti Core Lab e Molecular Navify (middleware, connettività, informatica, applicazioni, ecc). - Impegnarsi nelle discussioni strategiche digitali con influenze chiave di acquisto dei clienti, dagli utenti finali tecnici ai decisori di livello esecutivo. - Collabora con gli stakeholder interni tra i team di vendita e implementazione per definire e allineare le strategie di vendita di soluzioni totali per soddisfare e superare costantemente gli obiettivi di vendita. - Condurre analisi di processo di laboratorio, sviluppare presentazioni di proposte di soluzione e fornire raccomandazioni ai clienti in stretta allineamento con gli stakeholder interni. - Fornire demo software e presentazioni tecniche su misura per il pubblico interno ed esterno. - Adept per tradurre le esigenze del cliente in azione interna per soddisfare tali esigenze, mentre bilanciare le priorità e gli obiettivi aziendali chiave. - Forte acume clinico e finanziario con una capacità dimostrata di comprendere e tradurre le esigenze del cliente per posizionare efficacemente il valore delle soluzioni digitali Roche. - Efficacemente qualificare i cavi e utilizzare i risultati dell'analisi del flusso di lavoro e gli studi di impatto per fornire differenziazione e valore competitivi alla soluzione globale del cliente. - Fornisce competenze tecniche approfondite per quanto riguarda le linee di prodotto assegnate. - Il lavoro intercorre in modo funzionale con gli stakeholder interni per condividere informazioni e migliori pratiche, pur rimanendo attivamente informati sulle tendenze del settore/cliente che influiscono sul business. - Seguire un approccio end-to-end standardizzato che crea valori differenziati e basati su prove per il portafoglio soluzioni, sia all'interno che all'esterno delle pareti del laboratorio. Chi sei? - Corso di laurea in un campo relativo (ossia tecnologia dell'informazione, tecnologia medica, scienze della vita) o esperienza equivalente. - 5+ anni di esperienza rilevante o equivalente (ad es. vendite di soluzioni digitali sanitarie, vendita di diagnostica di laboratorio) - Deve essere autonomo e organizzato con efficaci capacità di comunicazione, negoziazione e problem solving - Familiarità con soluzioni digitali, soluzioni di middleware di laboratorio e sistemi LIS ospedalieri - Esperienza con la presentazione di informazioni tecniche a grandi pubblico esterno e interno Qualifiche Preferite - Esperienza preferenziale nella chem

descriptionByLocale.de: Mansion Digital Sales Spezialist Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Digital Sales Spezialist Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche. Die Chance Kommen Sie als Digital Central Lab Consultant bei der Roche Digital Solutions-Verkaufsorganisation, wo Sie für den Verkauf des digitalen Portfolios von Roche an IHN, Krankenhaus und Referenzlaborkunden verantwortlich sind. Diese feldbasierte Position erfordert konsultierende Vertriebserfahrung und Expertise im Labor-Workflow, IT-Infrastruktur, Datenfluss, Informatik, Labormedizin, Labor-Operationen, Digital-Anwendungen (d.h. Middleware, Business Intelligence Tools, etc.) und Laborinformationssysteme (LIS), um effektiv mit klinischen Labor-Stakeholdern auf maßgeschneiderte Roche-digitale Lösungen zu konsultieren und strategische Empfehlungen zu digitalen Prozessen bereitzustellen. Diese Position beschäftigt sich früh im Verkaufszyklus, um Kundenbedürfnisse zu verstehen, maßgeschneiderte Demos zu liefern und maßgeschneiderte digitale Lösungen in Partnerschaft mit funktionsübergreifenden Interessenvertretern in den Teams von Roche und Kunden zu entwickeln. In den Warenkorb - Erstellt neue Kundennachfrage im gesamten Portfolio von Core Lab und Molecular navify Produkten (Middleware, Konnektivität, Informatik, Apps, etc.). - Engagieren Sie in strategischen digitalen Diskussionen mit wichtigen Kundenkaufeinflüssen, von technischen Endnutzern bis hin zu Führungskräften. - Mit internen Stakeholdern über Vertriebs- und Implementierungsteams zusammenarbeiten, um die Gesamtlösungsverkaufsstrategien zu definieren und auszurichten, um die Vertriebsziele konsequent zu erreichen und zu übertreffen. - Durchführung von Laborprozessanalysen, Entwicklung von Lösungsvorschlägen und Empfehlungen an Kunden in enger Abstimmung mit internen Interessenvertretern. - Liefern Sie Software-Demos und maßgeschneiderte technische Präsentationen auf interne und externe Publikum. - Adept bei der Umsetzung von Kundenbedürfnissen in interne Maßnahmen, um diese Bedürfnisse zu erfüllen, während die wichtigsten Geschäftsprioritäten und Ziele ausgleichen. - Starker klinischer und finanzieller Aufwand mit einer nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, den Kunden zu verstehen und zu übersetzen, muss den Wert von Roche Digitallösungen effektiv positionieren. - Effektiv qualifizieren Leads und nutzen Ergebnisse von Workflow-Analysen und Folgenstudien, um wettbewerbsfähige Differenzierung und Wert für die gesamte Kundenlösung zu bieten. - Bietet fundiertes technisches Know-how in Bezug auf zugeordnete Produktlinien. - Arbeiten Sie funktionell mit internen Stakeholdern zusammen, um Informationen und bewährte Praktiken zu teilen und weiterhin aktiv über Trends in der Industrie/Kunden zu informieren, die das Geschäft beeinflussen. - Folgen Sie einem standardisierten End-to-End-Ansatz, der einen evidenzbasierten, differenzierten Wert für das Lösungsportfolio schafft, sowohl innerhalb als auch außerhalb der Laborwände. Chi Sei - Bachelor-Abschluss in einem verwandten Bereich (d.h. Informationstechnologie, Medizintechnik, Life Sciences) oder gleichwertige Erfahrung. - 5+ Jahre relevante oder gleichwertige Erfahrung (d.h.
