descriptionByLocale.fr: Mansioni Spécialiste des ventes numériques Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Spécialiste des ventes numériques Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. L'opportunité Venez rejoindre l'organisation de vente de Roche Digital Solutions en tant que consultant de Digital Central Lab où vous serez responsable de la vente du portefeuille numérique de Roche navify à des clients IHN, hôpital et laboratoire de référence. Ce poste sur le terrain exige de l'expérience et de l'expertise en matière de ventes consultatives dans les domaines suivants : flux de travail en laboratoire, infrastructure informatique, flux de données, informatique, médecine de laboratoire, opérations de laboratoire, applications numériques (c.-à-d. intergiciels, outils d'intelligence d'affaires, etc.) et systèmes d'information de laboratoire (SIL) afin de consulter efficacement les intervenants des laboratoires cliniques sur les solutions numériques Roche personnalisées et de formuler des recommandations stratégiques sur les processus numériques. Cette position s'engage dès le début du cycle de vente pour comprendre les besoins des clients, fournir des démos personnalisées et concevoir des solutions numériques personnalisées en partenariat avec des intervenants interfonctionnels dans les équipes de Roche et de clients. Responsabilité - Génére une nouvelle demande cliente dans l'ensemble du portefeuille de produits Core Lab et Molecular navify (milieux, connectivité, informatique, applications, etc.). - S'engager dans des discussions numériques stratégiques avec des influences clés sur l'achat des clients, des utilisateurs techniques aux décideurs de niveau exécutif. - Collaborer avec les intervenants internes des équipes de vente et de mise en oeuvre afin de définir et d'aligner les stratégies de vente de solutions totales pour atteindre et dépasser systématiquement les objectifs de vente. - Effectuer des analyses de processus en laboratoire, élaborer des propositions de solutions et présenter des recommandations aux clients en étroite harmonie avec les intervenants internes. - Fournir des démos logicielles et des présentations techniques adaptées aux publics internes et externes. - Aider à traduire les besoins des clients en actions internes pour répondre à ces besoins tout en conciliant les priorités et les objectifs opérationnels clés. - Forte concentration clinique et financière avec une capacité démontrée de comprendre et de traduire les besoins des clients pour positionner efficacement la valeur des solutions numériques Roche. - Qualifier efficacement les pistes et utiliser les résultats de l'analyse de flux de travail et des études d'impact pour fournir une différenciation concurrentielle et de la valeur à la solution globale du client. - Fournit une expertise technique approfondie concernant les gammes de produits attribuées. - Travailler de concert avec les intervenants internes pour partager l'information et les pratiques exemplaires tout en restant activement informé des tendances de l'industrie et des clients qui ont une incidence sur les entreprises. - Suivre une approche standard de bout en bout qui crée une valeur factuelle différenciée pour le portefeuille de solutions, tant à l'intérieur qu'à l'extérieur des murs du laboratoire. Chi Sei - Baccalauréat Diplôme dans un domaine connexe (p. ex. technologie de l'information, technologie médicale, sciences de la vie) ou expérience équivalente. - 5 ans d'expérience pertinente ou équivalente (vente de solutions numériques de soins de santé, ventes de diagnostics de laboratoire) - Doit être autonome et organisé avec des compétences de communication, de négociation et de résolution de problèmes efficaces - Familiarité avec les solutions numériques, les solutions intermédiaires de laboratoire et les systèmes LIS hospitaliers - Expérience de la présentation de l'information technique à un large public externe et interne Qualifiche Preferite - Expérience préférée dans la chimie

jobs.title: Supply Chain Maintenance Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Supply Chain Maintenance Specialist, you will be able to contribute to shape the future of the Roche Global Supply Chain organization by maintaining the reliability and performance of the equipment utilized within the Hub Operations Americas group located in Indianapolis.

Your Opportunity

Position’s most important individual tasks:

• Complete preventative maintenance tasks according to detailed procedures and schedules.

• Perform electrical or mechanical troubleshooting to determine problems in non-functioning equipment, used within warehousing areas.

• Dismantle, adjust, repair, and assemble equipment according to layout plans, blueprints, operating or repair manuals, rough sketches, or drawings.

• Use test and diagnostic equipment to perform checkouts & rebuild equipment as required.

• Perform equipment modifications including installation, validation support and start-up of new equipment, as well as decommissioning activities as directed by engineers

• Use predictive maintenance technologies and techniques in order to improve operational efficiencies.

• Apply advanced knowledge and skills to complete assignments requiring judgment and initiative. You will understand the implications of work and make recommendations for solutions. You will receive little instruction on daily assignments and may determine methods and procedures on new assignments.

Who you are:

Minimum qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalency

• 2+ years of related experience in maintenance experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Associates degree, journeyman’s card or equivalent military training related to maintenance of equipment in an industrial setting.

• At least 5 years of experience in technical support and maintenance roles.

• Preferred credentials: CMRT, CRL, CMRP, etc

• Strong technical knowledge and hands-on experience with electrical, mechanical and pneumatic systems. Preferred experience: familiar with conveyor systems and other equipment used within warehouse operations.

• Proficiency in troubleshooting and diagnosing technical issues, using diagnostic tools, and interpreting equipment manuals and schematics.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

• Familiarity with preventive maintenance programs, spare parts management, and relevant safety regulations.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, managing multiple priorities and adapting to changing circumstances.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Pay transparency
The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Tucson is 54,300.00 - 100,800.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore ne

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Opportunity:

As a R2R Period-End Close Senior Analyst based in San José, Costa Rica, you will be an integral part of our Global Shared Services organization. This role serves as a subject matter expert, delivering advanced accounting support and complex financial analysis while driving process improvements and automation initiatives. You will act as a key point of contact for accounting and reporting matters, serving as a trusted advisor for our supported affiliates.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Accounting Expertise & Audit Leadership: Lead complex accounting analyses and audit activities for assigned areas. You will serve as a subject matter expert for affiliates and internal stakeholders, ensuring technical accounting excellence.

• Financial Reporting & Close Activities: Prepare and review complex financial statements and reports. You will manage month-end close activities, including journal entries, cost allocations, and reconciliations, while maintaining a proper audit trail and compliance with standards.

• Analysis, Commentary & Advisory: Analyze financial results to investigate variances and provide clear, actionable insights to management. You will interpret and communicate financial data effectively to both internal and external stakeholders.

• Compliance & Governance: Ensure strict compliance with company policies, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements.

• Team Development: Support the growth of the team through coaching, reviewing work, and contributing to cross-functional initiatives and global projects.

• Continuous Improvement: Drive process improvements and support automation initiatives to increase the efficiency of the Record-to-Report flow.

Who you are:

You are a highly analytical finance professional with a strong attention to detail, capable of working independently in a fast-paced environment to meet tight deadlines.
Requirements and Qualifications:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance , or a related field. A professional certification ( CPA, ACCA , or equivalent) is preferred.

• Experience: Minimum of 4+ years of experience in accounting or finance. Prior experience in a Finance Shared Services environment is preferred. Experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry is a plus.

• Technical Skills: * Strong knowledge of US GAAP and/or IFRS .

• Experience with ERP systems, specifically SAP (FI, CO/PA, MM, FA, FCC) and BlackLine is highly desirable.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Workspace.

• Languages: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; fluent in English and Spanish . Portuguese and or French is preferred.

• Core Competencies: * Strong stakeholder management and collaboration abilities.

• Problem-solving mindset with a focus on process automation and continuous improvement.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

You will act as a key point of contact for accounting and reporting matters, serving as a trusted advisor for our supported affiliates. Your key responsibilities will include:

jobs.title: Facilities Technician II
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

Work shift: M-F 2:00pm - 10:30pm

The Facilities Technician II at GenMark Diagnostics, A Member of the Roche Group, is responsible for the overall maintenance, upkeep, and cleanliness of the designated facility, preventative or otherwise. In this position, you are

• Preventative Maintenance & Operations – Perform routine maintenance on HVAC and central plant equipment, conduct daily facility tours, monitor all rooftop and building systems, and make necessary operational adjustments
• Work Request Management & Response – Handle internal customer facility work requests, respond to alarm system alerts 24/7, investigate and document process alarms, and provide on-call coverage
• Equipment & Inventory Support – Maintain spare parts inventory, manage repair parts for work requests, conduct maintenance on specialized systems (water purification, heating/cooling, humidity control, building controls), and support validation protocols
• Quality & Compliance – Ensure all duties comply with ISO, FDA, and regulatory requirements; demonstrate awareness of quality consequences and potential device defects; support Quality Management System implementation
• Coordination & Professional Development – Coordinate contractor/vendor site escorts and training, support cross-functional staff training, collaborate with technicians on daily tasks, and maintain professionalism with internal and external stakeholders

Who you are

• You possess a High School Diploma, or Technical Education with 2 to 4 years of maintenance experience preferably in Biotech, cGMP, medical or health related environment or equivalent.

• You must be available to work any shift and be “on call” via pager and/or cell phone.

• You possess a clean & valid CA driver’s license

Behaviors, Competencies, and Qualities of the ideal applicant.

• Proficiency with power tools and machine shop equipment, knowledge of HVAC systems, refrigeration systems, and plumbing; ability to read schematics and drawings.

• Experience in high-paced manufacturing environments, routine building and grounds maintenance, and familiarity with welding and precision tools (drill press, hand tools).

• Excellent understanding and application of safety procedures; knowledge of federal regulations including QSR, ISO, and ISO 13485 standards; CMDR familiarity preferred.

• Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and work independently; basic computer skills (MS Word, Excel, Access, Google); excellent documentation and record-keeping abilities.

• Strong interpersonal, communication, and cooperation skills; ability to work effectively with diverse teams in regulated environments.

Work Environment
The essential functions of the job are usually performed in an environmentally controlled facility where the noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. This position may involve a combination of office and biotechnology laboratory environments. You may be exposed to hazardous chemicals, blood-borne, pathogens and automated equipment.

While performing the job duties, you are regularly required to sit; reach with hands and arms and talk or hear. You are frequently required to stand and walk. You may sometimes be required to lift and/or move up to 35 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

Relocation benefits are not offered for this job posting

The expected salary range for this position based on California is 53,800.00 - 99,800

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future is what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love, that is what makes us Roche.

Reporting to the Engineering Manager, Roche Diagnostics Australia is looking for a Field Service Engineer, ideally with specific experience working with Mass Spectrometry. As a Field Service Engineer, you are responsible to perform the field service activities for all our Diagnostics portfolios with a primary focus on Mass Spectrometry, by provision and coordination of all activities relating to instrument installation, instrument preventative maintenance, instrument troubleshooting, software and hardware modifications, relating to both pre, during, and post sales requirements. Service will need to be performed locally, interstate, and including travel overseas to support Roche Diagnostics New Zealand when needed.

This service is provided on the basis of hours of employment typically being from 9 am to 5 pm Monday to Friday. In addition, you will be asked to participate in an on-call roster to cover the out of hours’ service requirements from 5 pm to 9 am Monday to Friday and 24 hours Saturday and Sunday.
Field Service Engineers are required to actively collaborate with the local account management teams and to participate in local and national team meetings.

We are looking for an experienced engineer with a proactive mindset, who enjoys working collaboratively in a close team environment, and is capable of working fully independently.

Key responsibilities include:

• Provide outstanding quality instrument service and support, in a timely manner, to meet the high standards expected by our customers of Roche and the products we supply and support.

• Responsible for the timely pre-installation inspection and installation of Roche and other analytical systems working with Regional Engineering Manager, Application Specialist, Project Lead, Solutions Manager, and Local Account Management Team to ensure successful installations occur.

• Ensure all Preventative Maintenance is carried out in a timely manner as per the manufacturer's guidelines.

• Ensure any ongoing instrument problems or issues are communicated to Regional Engineering Manager, Head of Service & Support, Local Account Manager, Solutions Team and or manufacturer.

• Accurately capture and report all field activities undertaken, including all labour and travel incurred via CRM system in a timely manner.

• Compliance with all Roche processes as documented in policies and procedures- complete all mandatory training by the due date.

• Ensures compliance and promotion of all safety, health, and environmental policies and procedures to ensure the safety, health and wellbeing of all employees and visitors.

Who You Are:

• Tertiary biomedical engineering or equivalent qualification with 3+ years of experience in field services engineering, ideally with specialist Mass Spectrometry knowledge and hands-on experience.

• Experience with Lab IT and middleware systems.

• Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple projects.

• Availability to travel locally, regionally, nationally and internationally as required.

• Able to build and maintain strong internal and external partnerships

• Exhibit a passion for digital transformation and process enhancem

As a Field Service Engineer, you are responsible to perform the field service activities for all our Diagnostics portfolios with a primary focus on Mass Spectrometry, by provision and coordination of all activities relating to instrument installation, instrument preventative maintenance, instrument troubleshooting, software and hardware modifications, relating to both pre, during, and post sales requirements. Service will need to be performed locally, interstate, and including travel overseas to support Roche Diagnostics New Zealand when needed. This service is provided on the basis of hours of employment typically being from 9 am to 5 pm Monday to Friday. In addition, you will be asked to participate in an on-call roster to cover the out of hours’ service requirements from 5 pm to 9 am Monday to Friday and 24 hours Saturday and Sunday. Field Service Engineers are required to actively collaborate with the local account management teams and to participate in local and national team meetings. We are looking for an experienced engineer with a proactive mindset, who enjoys working collaboratively in a close team environment, and is capable of working fully independently. Key responsibilities include:
• Provide outstanding quality instrument service and support, in a timely manner, to meet the high standards expected by our customers of Roche and the products we supply and support.
• Responsible for the timely pre-installation inspection and installation of Roche and other analytical systems working with Regional Engineering Manager, Application Specialist, Project Lead, Solutions Manager, and Local Account Management Team to ensure successful installations occur.
• Ensure all Preventative Maintenance is carried out in a timely manner as per the manufacturer's guidelines.
• Ensure any ongoing instrument problems or issues are communicated to Regional Engineering Manager, Head of Service & Support, Local Account Manager, Solutions Team and or manufacturer.
• Accurately capture and report all field activities undertaken, including all labour and travel incurred via CRM system in a timely manner.
• Compliance with all Roche processes as documented in policies and procedures- complete all mandatory training by the due date.
• Ensures compliance and promotion of all safety, health, and environmental policies and procedures to ensure the safety, health and wellbeing of all employees and visitors. Who You Are:
• Tertiary biomedical engineering or equivalent qualification with 3+ years of experience in field services engineering, ideally with specialist Mass Spectrometry knowledge and hands-on experience.
• Experience with Lab IT and middleware systems.
• Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple projects.
• Availability to travel locally, regionally, nationally and internationally as required.
• Able to build and maintain strong internal and external partnerships
• Exhibit a passion for digital transformation and process enhancem

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
客户管理
• 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道 , 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（ HCP ）观念、学术需求 传递专业化医学 / 疾病 / 产品信息
• 传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案
• 传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
• 传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设
• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生 / 科室教育 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
• 规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。
• 组织和支持区域专家会议
• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈
• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作
• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持
• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力

岗位所需胜任力
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• 正确的思维和行为 ( 使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维 )

工作年限
• 3 年以上医药行业工作经验
• 既往有学术推广 / 市场 / 医学经验
• 跨职能工作经验为佳

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

主要职责

目标管理

动

• 和准入团队合作保证区域内治疗药物的可及性

•打造一个绩效和影响为先的团队氛围，以实现公司愿景和创新的工作模式

财务和合规管理
•分配并管理公司资源以实现生态圈目标
•确保业务开展符合公司和国家合规要求，通过必要的合规培训，以身作则和监管，打造一个合规的工作环境

自我管理

能力与经验

• 思维方式和能力：使命驱动，协作，成长思维

• 领导力特质：系统思维，成长思维，真诚无畏，协作共赢，辅导培养
• 业务及资源规划能力
• 较高的沟通能力
• 高效整合资源能力

教育程度 /所获资格证书

• ​ 1. 职位职责：

• （ 3 ）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （ 4 ）熟练运用 Excel 、 PPT 、 Word 等办公应用软件

• 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息

• 传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案

• 传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈

• 传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设

• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程

• 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点

• 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生/科室教育

• 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理

• 规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。

• 组织和支持区域专家会议

• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈

• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理

• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗

• 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作

• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家

• 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持

• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力。

能力与经验
岗位所需胜任力

• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识

• 良好学习能力

• 业务敏锐度

• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力

• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)

工作年限

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书

• 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

• 在试用期内通过RDPAC考试

• 在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Diagnostics Korea
Division: Core Lab&POC
Work location: Seoul, South Korea

Your key responsibilities
1. Define and execute clinical chemistry and related product marketing plans and perform daily product management tasks.

• Develop and execute product marketing plans and plan of actions

• Develop product key message and sales tools such as brochure, master presentations, advertising films and gimmicks

• Prepare new product launch and manage the product lifecycle from phase in to phase out.

• Price management: distributor prices and delivery prices

• Stock management such as forecast, ordering and allocation during bottleneck

• Manage all regulatory and reimbursement tasks involved during phase in and out

• Support quality issues with S&S and QA

• Monitor and analyze sales performance monthly and yearly

• Coordinate and conduct congress, product seminars and conferences

• Update marketing activities reports regularly

2. Gather market insights through regular customer visits, competitor and market trends monitoring and incorporate these insights into product strategy.

• Conduct market survey

• Gather information about competitors' activities and price strategies to set up counter-proposals

• Visit KOLs and major customers regularly: workshop, product presentation, proposals etc.

3, Align and collaborate with all stakeholders within/outside RDK

• Coordinate training for sales, distributors and all relevant stakeholders

• Cooperate with sales, S&S, SCM, Q&R & MA, DMS, finance etc. regularly

• Liaise with regional and global colleague

• Cooperation with distributors and other business partners.

4. Conduct business in full compliance.

• 100% completion on compliance training

• Well know about updated regulation and compliance information and share to my team

• Meet compliance for all external activities

Who you are

Bachelor Degree in Health/Science disciplines
At least 3 years’ experience as commercial roles(sales or marketing) in healthcare industry
Proficiency in both spoken and written English
Good command of MS office software application and google document, slides, sheet

Submission
자유 양식의 국/영문 이력서 및 국/영문 자기소개서 (하나의 MS Word 혹은 PDF 파일로 제출)
※ 이력서 상단에 반드시 현재 연봉과 희망 연봉을 표기하시기 바랍니다. 누락 시 이력서가 검토되지 않습니다.
※ 이력서 내 이메일 주소와 서류전형 지원 사이트의 입력하시는 이메일 주소를 반드시 동일하게 작성해주시기 바랍니다.
※ 국가보훈대상 및 장애인은 관련 서류 제출시 관련 법규에 의거 우대합니다.
※ 이력서에 개인민감정보 (신체적 조건, 출신 지역, 혼인 여부, 가족관계 등)는 기재하지 말아주십시오.
※ 입사 지원 서류에 허위 사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후 라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.

Process
서류 전형▶ 면접 전형 ▶ 종합 심사 ▶ 최종 합격 통지
※ 면접은 서류전형 합격자에 한해 개별 통보합니다.
※ 면접 일정 안내 및 조율을 위해 해외 번호(중국)로 연락이 갈 수 있는 점 미리 안내드립니다.
※채용이 유력한 후보자에 대해서 이력 검증 및 평판 조회, 건강검진 등의 종합심사를 진행하여 최종 합격자를 선정합니다.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 1. 职位职责：
• （ 1 ） 协助 在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （ 2 ） 协助 进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训
• （ 3 ） 协助 开展学术会议，向客户介绍产品在不同适应症上的优点
• （ 4 ） 协助 及时收集、提供市场信息并做出适当建议

2. 职位要求：
• （ 1 ）在校大学生
• （ 2 ）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （ 3 ）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （ 4 ）熟练运用 Excel 、 PPT 、 Word 等办公应用软件
• （ 5 ）拥有良好的英语书写能力

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Your Opportunity
Core Responsibilities:

• Calls on physicians, clinics and other organizations that require diagnostic products or services that focus on the monitoring and testing of specialized therapeutic and/or specialized patient care.

• Responsible for the sale of the company’s diagnostic products within an assigned territory or geographic region.

• Provides expertise and customer service to accounts.

• May provide expertise to physicians and other medical/therapeutic clients.

Compliance & Ethical Responsibilities:

• Complies with applicable laws in providing physicians with literature.

Market & Competitive Insights:

• May gather data on marketing trends, competitive products and pricing to capitalize on selling opportunities.

Stakeholder Engagement:

• Builds relationships with physicians and key thought leaders to influence the acceptance and use of company’s products.

Who You Are

• Typically requires a university degree in a scientific or related field and/or equivalent related experience.

Preferred

• May include individuals selling diagnostic laboratory services. CRO/CMO companies, match to S681 - S685 - Sales Account Manager - Consulting Services.

• Individuals selling directly to physicians or other medical staff should select Channel 1 - Direct/End User.

• Use channel-specific Field Sales Management job codes to match the managers of these incumbents (e.g., Field Sales Management - S3X3 - S3X6).

jobs.title: Personalized Healthcare (PHC) Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Scope

I. Team Leadership and People Development

• Lead and Coach : Provide direct line management, coaching, mentorship, development to a team of PHC Partners, fostering a culture of high performance, accountability, and entrepreneurial thinking.

• Performance Management : Set clear performance objectives, conduct regular reviews, and manage the goals/sales performance of the team, ensuring goals/sales and profitability targets are met or exceeded.

• Recruitment and Onboarding : Participate in the recruitment and development of talent

II. Commercial Strategy Execution & Business Results

• Strategic Planning : Translate the overall business strategy into actionable, time-bound business plans and sales/account strategies for your team and territory to drive adoption of high medical value assays and utilization of hospital point-of-care solutions. Closely collaborate with Diagnostics Value Team (Marketing) and other relevant teams to define and review product marketing strategies.

• Sales/Account Strategy Execution : Oversee and drive the execution of the account strategies across the designated hospital accounts, drive cross-functional collaboration in particular with Customer Success Partners for Hospital and Lab, other field colleagues and external stakeholders to ensure cohesive execution and maximize account opportunities.

• Medical Value Delivery: Ensure that the team's strategies deliver demonstrable medical value of high medical value assays to healthcare systems, clinicians, and patients, enabling optimal disease management to achieve better patient outcomes.

• Account and Territory Management: Manage the overall territory plan and key accounts, allocate resources effectively.

• Forecasting and Reporting: Ensure accurate sales forecasting, pipeline visibility, and timely reporting on business performance

• Distributor Management: As distributor owner, collaborate with Strategic Planning, Business and Commercial Excellence Team to drive distributor strategies which enable sales growth

III. Customer Experience Excellence

• KOL (clinicians) Engagement: Working together with Diagnostic Value Team and Medical Team, maintain a high level of market intelligence and a close liaison with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and clinical experts in the industry to gather insights and drive changes in respective hospitals and the Taiwan healthcare ecosystem.

• Customer Advocacy: C hampion customer needs internally, ensuring seamless collaboration with Diagnostics Value (Marketing), Customer Experience Team, Global Service Team (FMI APAC and Global teams) and other functions to improve, resolve issues and enhance the end-to-end customer journey.

IV. Compliance and Integrity

• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and Roche Safety, Security, Health, and Environmental Protection policies, while demonstrating a solid understanding of compliance requirements and upholding the high standard of integrity.

Requirements

Qualifications:

• Good Compliance track record. No material Compliance violation is identified in the past 5 years

Education:

• A bachelor’s degree in medical/pharmaceutical/Life Sciences/marketing related field. An advanced (master’s or doctorate) degree is preferred.

Working Experience:

• > 7 years of progressive experience in IHC/FMI/NGS/Oncology related field, with a proven track of driving customer centric ways of working.

• > 2 year

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job Scope I. Team Leadership and People Development
• Lead and Coach : Provide direct line management, coaching, mentorship, development to a team of PHC Partners, fostering a culture of high performance, accountability, and entrepreneurial thinking.
• Performance Management : Set clear performance objectives, conduct regular reviews, and manage the goals/sales performance of the team, ensuring goals/sales and profitability targets are met or exceeded.
• Recruitment and Onboarding : Participate in the recruitment and development of talent II. Commercial Strategy Execution & Business Results
• Strategic Planning : Translate the overall business strategy into actionable, time-bound business plans and sales/account strategies for your team and territory to drive adoption of high medical value assays and utilization of hospital point-of-care solutions. Closely collaborate with Diagnostics Value Team (Marketing) and other relevant teams to define and review product marketing strategies.
• Sales/Account Strategy Execution : Oversee and drive the execution of the account strategies across the designated hospital accounts, drive cross-functional collaboration in particular with Customer Success Partners for Hospital and Lab, other field colleagues and external stakeholders to ensure cohesive execution and maximize account opportunities.
• Medical Value Delivery: Ensure that the team's strategies deliver demonstrable medical value of high medical value assays to healthcare systems, clinicians, and patients, enabling optimal disease management to achieve better patient outcomes.
• Account and Territory Management: Manage the overall territory plan and key accounts, allocate resources effectively.
• Forecasting and Reporting: Ensure accurate sales forecasting, pipeline visibility, and timely reporting on business performance
• Distributor Management: As distributor owner, collaborate with Strategic Planning, Business and Commercial Excellence Team to drive distributor strategies which enable sales growth III. Customer Experience Excellence
• KOL (clinicians) Engagement: Working together with Diagnostic Value Team and Medical Team, maintain a high level of market intelligence and a close liaison with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and clinical experts in the industry to gather insights and drive changes in respective hospitals and the Taiwan healthcare ecosystem.
• Customer Advocacy: C hampion customer needs internally, ensuring seamless collaboration with Diagnostics Value (Marketing), Customer Experience Team, Global Service Team (FMI APAC and Global teams) and other functions to improve, resolve issues and enhance the end-to-end customer journey. IV. Compliance and Integrity
• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and Roche Safety, Security, Health, and Environmental Protection policies, while demonstrating a solid understanding of compliance requirements and upholding the high standard of integrity. Requirements Qualifications:
• Good Compliance track record. No material Compliance violation is identified in the past 5 years Education:
• A bachelor’s degree in medical/pharmaceutical/Life Sciences/marketing related field. An advanced (master’s or doctorate) degree is preferred. Working Experience:
• > 7 years of progressive experience in IHC/FMI/NGS/Oncology related field, with a proven track of driving customer centric ways of working.
• > 2 year

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
患者解决方案负责人，负责制定患者整体解决方案相关的策略和团队管理工作，包含但不限于助力和规划疾病教育、支持创新支付解决方案、准入及安全运营，以及上市前后产品的学术平台搭建等活动和项目。通过敏捷工作方式融动跨部门资源，给予团队必要的支持和辅导。通过实现团队工作有效性和合作有效性的提升，最终实现对外部客户、患者及合作机构的更多获益。

A.洞察与策略

• 进行数据整理及分析，洞察业务机会和风险

• 协助区域生态群负责人制定属地化策略，包括：学术平台的搭建和资源布局、准入与安全运营、创新平台和患者可支付性的提升等，所有和提升诊疗水平和患者全程管理相关的举措

B.平台和项目协同

• 确保资源的有效实施和整合，最大化资源使用效率

• 合理布局团队的工作重点，支持生态圈负责人的各项关键任务的落地实施

C.跨部门沟通及合作

• 对接圈外（总部）的医学、法务合规、准入、市场、培训等部门，确保生态圈内外部的信息及时、精准的传递

D.团队管理和人员辅导

• 不断促进团队的工作效能，打造敏捷的工作氛围和方式

我们期待这样的您加入：

• 8年以上医药行业工作经验，有管理经验者优先

• 成长性思维和快速学习能力

• 具备业务敏锐度和市场洞察、规划能力

• 优秀的沟通，合作和资源整合能力

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

工作职责
目标管理

• 根据公司产品管线的整体策略，因地制宜地制定生态群发展目标，并负责实施计划和跟进有效性

区域合作与客户管理

• 与客户及合作伙伴建立广泛的合作和信任，并共同为罗氏产品组合相关领域的规范诊疗水平提高而积极采取行动

• 发展管理区域生态圈合作伙伴，提高当地生态圈医疗质量，提升患者获益

• 和准入团队合作保证区域内治疗药物的可及性

• 对接支持部门，建立沟通机制，确保生态圈内外部信息一致统一

团队管理

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
IT Business Analyst - RDT Biometrics and Clinical Evidence

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Principal Business Analyst is a senior, high-impact role that sits at the crossroads of clinical science, product strategy, and technology delivery. While positioned as a Business Analyst, this role operates with the breadth, depth, and strategic influence of a seasoned analyst owning the vision, innovation pipeline, and feature delivery of the Study Designer, a flagship product enabling clinical trial teams to design smarter, faster, and more impactful studies.This individual brings a rare combination of deep scientific credibility, product leadership, and technical fluency - capable of earning the trust of Clinical Scientists in one meeting and driving an engineering sprint in the next. They are relentlessly curious, innovation-driven, and passionate about using technology to transform how clinical trials are conceived and executed - ultimately accelerating therapies to patients.

The Opportunity

• Clinical & Scientific Collaboration : Act as the primary link between clinical/scientific teams and product engineering, building long-term relationships and facilitating discovery workshops with medical experts to deeply understand trial design and represent the clinical user's voice.

• Product Feature Innovation: Define and own the feature roadmap by balancing business, scientific, and technical needs; foster innovation through design thinking sprints to identify new opportunities, create compelling business cases, and track feature success metrics/KPIs post-release.

• Feature Design & Requirements Excellence: Author precise, actionable user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria; partner with UX to create wireframes and prototypes, ruthlessly filter requests based on value, and maintain a living product specification traceable to user needs.

• Technology & Engineering Partnership: Act as a technical translator by converting complex clinical workflows into structured requirements, leveraging strong literacy in architecture, data modeling, and APIs to collaborate with engineers on technical risks, dependencies, and solutions.

• Quality Assurance & UAT Support: Partner with architects, senior engineers, and QA leads throughout the development build cycle to ensure feature scalability and quality, while supporting UAT design and execution to meet scientific intent and usability standards.

• Agile Leadership & Delivery: Drive iterative delivery, rapid feedback, and hypothesis-driven development; own and groom a sprint-ready product backl

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione IT Business Analyst - RDT Biometrics e la prova clinica Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. Il Principal Business Analyst è un ruolo senior, ad alto impatto che siede al crocevia della scienza clinica, della strategia del prodotto e della consegna della tecnologia. Mentre si posiziona come Business Analyst, questo ruolo opera con l'ampiezza, la profondità e l'influenza strategica di un analista esperto che possiede la visione, l'innovazione pipeline, e la consegna caratteristica dello Studio Designer, un prodotto di punta che consente ai team di prova clinici di progettare studi più intelligenti, più veloci e più efficaci. Questo individuo porta una rara combinazione di profonda credibilità scientifica, leadership di prodotto e fluidità tecnica - in grado di guadagnare la fiducia degli scienziati clinici in un incontro e di guidare uno sprint di ingegneria nel prossimo. Sono instancabilmente curiosi, orientati all'innovazione e appassionati di utilizzare la tecnologia per trasformare come le sperimentazioni cliniche sono concepite e eseguite - alla fine accelerando le terapie ai pazienti. L'opportunità
• Collaborazione clinica e scientifica: agire come collegamento primario tra team clinici/scientifici e ingegneria dei prodotti, costruire relazioni a lungo termine e facilitare i laboratori di scoperta con esperti medici per comprendere profondamente il design di prova e rappresentare la voce dell'utente clinico.
• Innovazione di funzionalità del prodotto: Definire e possedere la roadmap caratteristica bilanciando le esigenze aziendali, scientifiche e tecniche; promuovere l'innovazione attraverso progetti di pensiero di progettazione per identificare nuove opportunità, creare casi aziendali convincenti, e tracciare metriche di successo / KPI post-release. Eccellenza: Autore storie utente precise e attuabili, epici e criteri di accettazione; partner con UX per creare wireframe e prototipi, filtrare senza scrupoli richieste basate sul valore, e mantenere una specifica di prodotto vivente tracciabile alle esigenze dell'utente.
• Technology & Engineering Partnership: Agire come traduttore tecnico convertendo complessi flussi di lavoro clinici in requisiti strutturati, sfruttando una forte alfabetizzazione in architettura, modellazione dei dati e API per collaborare con gli ingegneri sui rischi tecnici, dipendenze e soluzioni.
• Quality Assurance & UAT Support: Partner con architetti, ingegneri senior e QA porta in tutto il ciclo di costruzione dello sviluppo per garantire scalabilità e qualità delle funzionalità, supportando al contempo la progettazione e l'esecuzione UAT per soddisfare gli standard di intenti scientifici e di usabilità.
• Leadership Agile & Delivery: consegna iterativa di guida, feedback rapido e sviluppo basato su ipotesi; proprio e sposo un backl prodotto pronto sprint

jobs.title: Medical Enabler, APAC Rare Diseases
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharmaceutical

At Roche, we are driven by an urgent commitment to delivering medical solutions today while innovating for tomorrow. Our bold new A2 operating model leverages collective capabilities across the enterprise to create rapid, impactful solutions for patients globally. We believe in personalized, sustainable healthcare and are uniquely positioned to integrate pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, digital health, and big data.

We are seeking a passionate Medical Enabler to join our dynamic APAC Rare Diseases team. This permanent, full-time role is an above-country pooled resource position, requiring an 80-100% FTE above country commitment within our network .

Ideally, we are seeking someone who has extensive experience working healthcare systems across Asia and will be located in Hong Kong or Taiwan, however this role offers a thrilling opportunity to focus on cross-border work packages and enablement, collaborating across various regional and Global networks to drive meaningful change.

What You'll be working on:
As a Medical Enabler, (APAC) Rare Diseases, you will:

• Provide strategic input and operational support for late-stage development/near-launch therapies in Rare Diseases.

• Act as a scientific expert for our medicines and solutions throughout their product life cycles.

• Work in virtual, cross-border, cross-functional teams to realize and scale country, regional and Global outcomes.

• Foster meaningful scientific collaborations and value-based partnerships with Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs), healthcare professionals, patient organizations across multiple healthcare systems.

• Contribute to understanding data gaps and support data generation plans (e.g., Phase IV studies, registries).

• Build high-value continuing medical education programs for external stakeholders.

• Provide strategic medical review and approval for materials and communications.

• ​Liaise closely with global medical colleagues and teams to ensure coordination and consistency to our data dissemination

Who you are:
You are a passionate Medical Affairs professional ready to make a significant impact on Rare Disease health across Asia. As a subject matter expert with the potential for future leadership roles you have an entrepreneurial spirit, identify opportunities, are comfortable with ambiguity and challenge the status quo.

You have:

• Relevant experience in a Medical Affairs role within Pharmaceutical, Diagnostics, Health Sciences, Biotechnology, or related fields.

• Experience of working in Rare Diseases would be very desirable.

• Strong data comprehension, critical appraisal, synthesis, and delivery skills.

• A "System Thinker" mindset, able to build strong internal/external collaborations to drive change.

• Customer-Centric approach, co-creating solutions to address needs and transform clinical practice.

• A culture of humanity, curiosity, and responsibility, thriving in an empowered, dynamic, and agile working environment.

• Proven track record of building, leading, and contributing to high-performing, diverse, agile / matrix teams.

• MD degree; PhD or Bachelor’s degree in science, biology, immunology, neuroscience, or equivalent preferred. Clinical experience in Rare Diseases is a plus.

This is an incredible development opportunity to apply your scientific expertise, collaborate with colleagues and customers from across the globe, and contribute to innovation that will impact families living with rare diseases across Asia and beyond.

Where

Idéalement, nous recherchons quelqu'un qui possède une vaste expérience des systèmes de soins de santé en Asie et qui sera situé à Hong Kong ou à Taïwan, mais ce rôle offre une occasion passionnante de se concentrer sur les paquets de travail transfrontaliers et de permettre, en collaborant à travers divers réseaux régionaux et mondiaux pour conduire un changement significatif. Vous allez travailler sur : En tant que catalyseur médical des maladies rares (PACA), vous :
• Apporter une contribution stratégique et un soutien opérationnel aux thérapies de développement et de lancement précoce des maladies rares.
• Agir en tant qu'expert scientifique pour nos médicaments et solutions tout au long de leur cycle de vie.
• Travailler dans des équipes virtuelles, transfrontalières et transfonctionnelles afin de réaliser et d'élargir les résultats nationaux, régionaux et mondiaux.
• Favoriser des collaborations scientifiques significatives et des partenariats fondés sur la valeur avec des experts des domaines thérapeutiques, des professionnels de la santé, des organisations de patients dans plusieurs systèmes de santé.
• Contribuer à la compréhension des lacunes dans les données et appuyer les plans de production de données (par exemple, études de phase IV, registres).
• Élaborer des programmes de formation médicale continue de grande valeur à l'intention des intervenants externes.
• Fournir un examen médical stratégique et l'approbation des documents et des communications.
• Assurer une liaison étroite avec les équipes et collègues médicaux mondiaux pour assurer la coordination et la cohérence de notre diffusion des données Qui vous êtes : Vous êtes un professionnel passionné des affaires médicales prêt à avoir un impact significatif sur la santé des maladies rares en Asie. En tant qu'expert en matière de leadership potentiel, vous avez un esprit d'entreprise, identifiez les possibilités, êtes à l'aise avec l'ambiguïté et contestez le statu quo. Vous avez :
• Expérience pertinente dans le domaine des affaires médicales dans le domaine des produits pharmaceutiques, des diagnostics, des sciences de la santé, de la biotechnologie ou dans des domaines connexes.
• L'expérience du travail dans les maladies rares serait très souhaitable.
• Une bonne compréhension des données, une évaluation critique, une synthèse et des compétences d'exécution.
• Un état d'esprit "System Thinker", capable de construire de solides collaborations internes/externes pour stimuler le changement.
• Approche client-centre, co-créant des solutions pour répondre aux besoins et transformer la pratique clinique.
• Une culture de l'humanité, de la curiosité et de la responsabilité, prospère dans un environnement de travail dynamique, dynamique et agile.
• Expérience éprouvée de la construction, de la direction et de la contribution à des équipes de haute performance, diversifiées, agiles et matricielles.
• Diplôme MD; doctorat ou baccalauréat en sciences, biologie, immunologie, neurosciences ou équivalent préféré. L'expérience clinique dans les maladies rares est un plus. C'est une occasion incroyable de développer votre expertise scientifique, de collaborer avec des collègues et des clients du monde entier et de contribuer à l'innovation qui touchera les familles vivant avec des maladies rares en Asie et au-delà. jobs.title: Order Process Associate - French speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Opportunity:

• You create, process, maintain, modify and close Purchase Orders

• You review and approve shopping carts for Policy compliance

• You support purchase invoice reconciliation and liaise with the accounts payable department in connection with invoicing procedures

• You make reports on the given activities

• You assist with processing of returns for the Procurement Department as needed

• You are responsible for Order Acknowledgement handling and contact the suppliers in case of need

Who you are:

• You have college or university degree in finance or a related economics subject

• You have a general understanding of finance processes and standards. Experience in procurement processes and using SAP is an advantage

• You have strong communication and advisory skills and you are able to deal with complex issues

• You have end-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• You have proficiency in English and French

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• 职位职责：
• （1） 协助 在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息

职位要求：
• （1）在校大学生
• （2）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （3）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （4）熟练运用Excel、PPT、Word等办公应用软件

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position
1. Support the daily work of the registration operations team
- Assist in the preparation (translation/proofreading) and archiving of registration operations materials

2. Assist in managing and optimizing operational systems, information platforms and tools

- Assist in data analysis work
- Assist in designing and developing new work platforms or tools
3. Assist in completing logistical work for the registration operations department
- Coordinate and arrange meetings, book meeting rooms, mailing and printing, etc.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Your department

Your internship will take place in the Biostatistics & Data Science Core Lab & Near Patient Care department, which is part of our organization R&D Roche Diagnostic.
This development unit focuses on Biostatistics & Data Science. During your internship, you will work in the CC HET Biostatistics & Biophysics group.

Your tasks

• Develop machine learning models for anomaly detection in time-series data to identify infrastructure issues proactively

• Design and develop multi-agent systems for automated infrastructure monitoring and troubleshooting

• Build agentic workflows using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen

jobs.title: Strategic Programs Manager (Procurement Enhancement Programs)

titleByLocale.it: Gestione dei programmi strategici (Programmi di potenziamento degli appalti)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Strategic Programs Manager (Procurement Enhancement Programs)

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity:

This role sits within the Strategic Programs Execution team in the Strategy and Solutions Chapter. Our purpose is to guide strategic priorities, advance value delivery through solutions and digital excellence, govern compliance and drive sustainability to deliver continuous improvement and strengthen Global Procurement’s impact on the wider Roche organization. The Strategic Programs Execution team is dedicated to driving complex procurement-led programs that deliver high impact benefits for Roche and result in a step change in how we work with suppliers, use technology, partner with the business or collaborate with each other in Procurement.

As a Strategic Programs Manager (Procurement Enhancement Programs), you will work in partnership with teams from Global Procurement and other Roche functions to accelerate and enhance the delivery of GP led strategic programs. You will have a strong focus on Procurement Enhancement Programs, with the aim to enhance the overall level of effectiveness, efficiency and customer experience of Global Procurement.

• You utilise your expertise and in-depth knowledge in project management methodologies to lead and facilitate the execution of strategic procurement-led programs, focusing on transformative initiatives such as Operating Model Design and Implementation, Technology Deployment and Adoption, and Procurement Strategy Realization.

• You work closely with procurement, business stakeholders, and other relevant colleagues in a matrix setup either as a peer, coach, project / workstream lead, or subject matter lead, to align on needs, create the business case for change, prioritize, execute, and realize project goals.

• You develop change management strategies and integrate change management activities in project execution to drive transformational changes in the organisation. You manage the people-side of the change to drive behavioral changes and adoption.

• You contribute to the further development of project management and change management capabilities in the team, advocate and accelerate the advancement of best practices methodologies.

• You act as a practitioner and catalyst, applying GP’s core procurement capabilities and approaches in the programs you work on, and contribute to continuous enhancement of procurement excellence.

• You act as a role model, demonstrating curiosity, passion, an entrepreneurial spirit, enterprise thinking, inclusive collaboration, and desire for continuous learning.

Who you are:

• You hold a university degree, preferably in business, engineering or technology.

• You have 5+ years procurement, project management, or management consulting experience, ideally within a matrix o

The Indirect Procurement Delivery group comprises many communities grouping categories of the same value chain or having commonality, including Research & Development, Commercial and Corporate Services, Digital & Technology, and Facilities. The communities are key enablers of strong category expertise while allowing flexibility in the procurement delivery response to the evolving needs of our customers.

As a Senior Procurement Manager in IT Services, you will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Using your specialized knowledge and in-depth expertise in a specific category or spend areas and procurement overall, you will proactively identify and drive strategies and approaches for managing and sourcing third party spend requirements. You can also play the role of Category strategy owner in charge of driving, coordinating and signing the category strategy.

You will collaborate with internal procurement (such as Customer Excellence, Insights, Analytics, Contracting, etc.) and business stakeholders to build and implement comprehensive category sourcing and spend management strategies that are aligned to business needs and functional objectives.

You will work closely with other team members, as a peer coach, project, or workstream lead to identify opportunities to aggregate customer demand, drive buying channel automation, deliver on day-to day activities, and provide capacity, expertise, and oversight to productivity and other customer oriented projects/solutions.

As a Senior Procurement Manager in IT Services, you will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and general business requirements, including but not limited to:

• You are a Category and sourcing subject matter expert in IT Services conducting market and internal analysis to develop strategies, best practices, and guidance on tactical plans for how Roche should source and negotiate for third party goods and services in order to satisfy stakeholder requirements and maximize the value for Roche.

• You are a Procurement delivery practitioner delivering and executing sourcing strategies and major initiatives by leveraging spend, category know-how, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, supplier management methodologies and project management skills, and/or supporting team members by coaching them and enhancing their skills and knowledge.

Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Les soins de santé évoluent, et Global Approvisionnement répond en s'efforçant constamment d'obtenir les meilleurs résultats possibles, en adoptant des approches novatrices et stratégiques pour les partenariats avec les entreprises et les fournisseurs. Global Approvisionnement gère de manière proactive l'ensemble de l'écosystème fournisseur, contribuant de façon essentielle à améliorer les résultats en matière de santé, réduisant les coûts pour les patients et les systèmes de santé mondiaux, et faisant en sorte que Roche continue de faire maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. La possibilité : Ce rôle fait partie du groupe chargé de la prestation des achats indirects, qui couvre les principales activités d'approvisionnement liées à la gestion des catégories, à l'approvisionnement stratégique et opérationnel, à la gestion des fournisseurs, à la passation de marchés, à la définition de la stratégie de contenu et à l'exécution. Le groupe de la prestation d'approvisionnements indirects comprend de nombreuses collectivités regroupant des catégories de la même chaîne de valeur ou ayant des points communs, y compris la recherche et le développement, les services commerciaux et ministériels, le numérique et la technologie et les installations. Les collectivités sont des catalyseurs clés d'une solide expertise de catégorie tout en permettant de répondre avec souplesse aux besoins changeants de nos clients. En tant que gestionnaire principal des approvisionnements dans les services de TI, vous ferez appel à la réflexion analytique, à la planification, à l'exécution et à la concentration dans le domaine des capacités d'approvisionnement et de prestation. À l'aide de vos connaissances spécialisées et de votre expertise approfondie dans une catégorie particulière ou dans des domaines de dépense et d'approvisionnement en général, vous définirez et dirigerez de façon proactive des stratégies et des approches pour gérer et acheminer les dépenses de tiers. Vous pouvez également jouer le rôle de propriétaire de la stratégie de catégorie en charge de la conduite, la coordination et la signature de la stratégie de catégorie. Vous collaborerez avec l'approvisionnement interne (telle que l'excellence client, Insights, Analytics, Contracting, etc.) et les intervenants commerciaux afin d'élaborer et de mettre en oeuvre des stratégies complètes de gestion de l'approvisionnement et des dépenses de catégorie qui correspondent aux besoins opérationnels et aux objectifs fonctionnels. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec d'autres membres de l'équipe, en tant qu'entraîneur par les pairs, qu'un projet ou qu'un volet de travail mène pour cerner les possibilités d'agréger la demande des clients, de stimuler l'automatisation des canaux d'achat, de mener des activités quotidiennes et de fournir une capacité, une expertise et une surveillance à la productivité et à d'autres projets/solutions axés sur les clients. En tant que gestionnaire principal des approvisionnements dans les services de TI, vous jouerez divers rôles en fonction de votre expérience, de vos connaissances et de vos besoins opérationnels généraux, notamment :
• Vous êtes un expert en matière de catégorie et d'approvisionnement dans les services informatiques qui mène des analyses de marché et internes pour élaborer des stratégies, des pratiques exemplaires et des conseils sur les plans tactiques pour la façon dont Roche devrait trouver et négocier des biens et services tiers afin de satisfaire les exigences des parties prenantes et maximiser la valeur pour Roche.
• Vous êtes un praticien de l'approvisionnement qui fournit et exécute des stratégies d'approvisionnement et des initiatives majeures en mettant à profit les dépenses, le savoir-faire de la catégorie, l'approvisionnement robuste, la négociation, la passation de marchés, les méthodes de gestion des fournisseurs et les compétences en gestion de projet, et/ou en appuyant les membres de l'équipe en les coachant et en améliorant leurs compétences et leurs connaissances.
