jobs.title: Territory Manager- Vadodara
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Territory Manager - Vadodara

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche .

As a Territory Manager - Vadodara , you are responsible for managing the sale of the organization’s products through distribution and retail channels across the Vadodara geographic area. You serve as a strategic partner to the Area Sales Manager (ASM), providing critical market insights to estimate product demand and drive the organization’s growth. You apply new approaches to merchandising and field activation to increase brand visibility and ensure that our life-changing products reach the customers and patients who need them. You work collaboratively with distributors and dealers to break down barriers to access, ensuring that our sales plans are executed with precision and operational excellence.

Your Opportunity

• Territory Planning & Execution: You drive business results by providing information on the market environment to help estimate yearly product demand. You ensure the monthly achievement of SKU-wise sales plans and targets by generating secondary sales in the market.

• Distribution Management: You monitor distributor performance, reviewing the existing network to propose the appointment of new partners or the termination of non-performing ones. You motivate distributors and dealers through regular communication, sorting out issues regarding accounts, pricing, and schemes.

• Sales Promotion & Merchandising: You prepare and execute sales promotion plans through field activation and merchandising activities designed by the Marketing Team. You maintain rigorous records of these activities, tracking expenses and sales generated to provide feedback on program efficacy.

• Market Intelligence: You monitor competitor information and feedback within your category. You provide regular reports to the ASM on competitor activities and stock availability of promotional materials to ensure Roche remains competitive in the landscape.

• Customer Excellence: You address all complaints and suggestions from distributors and customers by coordinating with customer care. You organize dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies to ensure brand consistency and strong partnerships.

• Financial Oversight: You ensure timely monthly collections through continuous follow-ups and submit inventory requirements at the distributor level as per the sales plan. You maintain disciplined daily reporting of customer visits as per established work norms.

Who You Are

• Qualified Professional: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Science or Pharmacy . A post-graduate qualification is considered an additional advantage.

• Industry Experience: You have a minimum of 2-3 years of experience with a proven track record in FMCG, OTC, or Retail sales .

• Regional Expert: You possess a deep understanding of the Vadodara/Surat market environment and have experience managing independent representatives, distributors, or agents.

• Strategic Partner: You have demonstrated the ability to assist leadership in planning and executing complex sales promotion plans with a focus on productivity and efficiency.

• Analytical & Disciplined: You rely on data to track sales performance and inventory, with a high degree of accountability for daily reporting and meeting monthly sales targets.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Territorio Manager - Vadodara Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Ecco cosa ci rende Roche . Come Territorio Manager - Vadodara , si è responsabili della gestione della vendita dei prodotti dell'organizzazione attraverso la distribuzione e i canali di vendita al dettaglio attraverso l'area geografica di Vadodara. Sei un partner strategico per l’Area Sales Manager (ASM), fornendo informazioni di mercato critiche per valutare la domanda del prodotto e guidare la crescita dell’organizzazione. Si applicano nuovi approcci alla merchandising e all'attivazione del campo per aumentare la visibilità del marchio e garantire che i nostri prodotti in continua evoluzione raggiungano clienti e pazienti che ne hanno bisogno. Lavori in collaborazione con distributori e rivenditori per abbattere le barriere all'accesso, assicurando che i nostri piani di vendita siano eseguiti con precisione e eccellenza operativa. Mansioni - Pianificazione e esecuzione del territorio: Guida i risultati aziendali fornendo informazioni sull'ambiente di mercato per aiutare a valutare la domanda annuale del prodotto. Si garantisce il raggiungimento mensile dei piani di vendita e obiettivi SKU-wise generando vendite secondarie sul mercato. - Gestione della distribuzione: monitori le prestazioni del distributore, riesamina la rete esistente per proporre la nomina di nuovi partner o la cessazione di quelli non performanti. Si motiva distributori e rivenditori attraverso la comunicazione regolare, risolvere questioni riguardanti conti, prezzi e schemi. - Promozione di vendita & Merchandising: Lei prepara ed esegue i piani di promozione delle vendite attraverso l'attivazione del campo e le attività di merchandising progettate dal Team Marketing. Si mantiene registri rigorosi di queste attività, le spese di monitoraggio e le vendite generate per fornire feedback sull'efficacia del programma. - Market Intelligence: monitori le informazioni e i feedback dei concorrenti nella tua categoria. L'ASM fornisce rapporti regolari sulle attività concorrenti e la disponibilità di materiali promozionali per garantire che Roche rimanga competitiva nel paesaggio. - Eccellenza del cliente: Rivolgiti a tutte le denunce e suggerimenti dei distributori e dei clienti coordinandoti con l'assistenza clienti. Si organizzano incontri di dealer in allineamento con le strategie di marketing per garantire la coerenza del marchio e partnership forti. - Supervisione finanziaria: Garantisci collezioni mensili tempestive attraverso continui follow-up e presenti requisiti di inventario a livello di distributore secondo il piano di vendita. Mantenete la segnalazione quotidiana disciplinata delle visite dei clienti secondo le norme di lavoro stabilite.
• Requisiti - Professionista qualificato: si tiene una laurea in Scienza o Farmacia . Una qualifica post-laurea è considerato un ulteriore vantaggio. - Industry Experience: Hai un minimo di 2-3 anni di esperienza con una comprovata esperienza in FMCG, OTC, o vendite al dettaglio . - Esperto Regionale: Lei possiede una profonda comprensione dell'ambiente di mercato di Vadodara/Surat e ha esperienza nella gestione di rappresentanti, distributori o agenti indipendenti. - Partner Strategico: Hai dimostrato la capacità di assistere la leadership nella pianificazione e nell'esecuzione di piani di promozione di vendite complessi con un focus sulla produttività e sull'efficienza. - Analitico & Disciplinato: Si affida ai dati per monitorare le prestazioni di vendita e l'inventario, con un alto grado di responsabilitÃ per la segnalazione quotidiana e soddisfare gli obiettivi di vendita mensili.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Territory Manager - Vadodara A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche . As a Territory Manager - Vadodara , you are responsible for managing the sale of the organization’s products through distribution and retail channels across the Vadodara geographic area. You serve as a strategic partner to the Area Sales Manager (ASM), providing critical market insights to estimate product demand and drive the organization’s growth. You apply new approaches to merchandising and field activation to increase brand visibility and ensure that our life-changing products reach the customers and patients who need them. You work collaboratively with distributors and dealers to break down barriers to access, ensuring that our sales plans are executed with precision and operational excellence. Your Opportunity
• Territory Planning & Execution: You drive business results by providing information on the market environment to help estimate yearly product demand. You ensure the monthly achievement of SKU-wise sales plans and targets by generating secondary sales in the market.
• Distribution Management: You monitor distributor performance, reviewing the existing network to propose the appointment of new partners or the termination of non-performing ones. You motivate distributors and dealers through regular communication, sorting out issues regarding accounts, pricing, and schemes.
• Sales Promotion & Merchandising: You prepare and execute sales promotion plans through field activation and merchandising activities designed by the Marketing Team. You maintain rigorous records of these activities, tracking expenses and sales generated to provide feedback on program efficacy.
• Market Intelligence: You monitor competitor information and feedback within your category. You provide regular reports to the ASM on competitor activities and stock availability of promotional materials to ensure Roche remains competitive in the landscape.
• Customer Excellence: You address all complaints and suggestions from distributors and customers by coordinating with customer care. You organize dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies to ensure brand consistency and strong partnerships.
• Financial Oversight: You ensure timely monthly collections through continuous follow-ups and submit inventory requirements at the distributor level as per the sales plan. You maintain disciplined daily reporting of customer visits as per established work norms. Who You Are
• Qualified Professional: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Science or Pharmacy . A post-graduate qualification is considered an additional advantage.
• Industry Experience: You have a minimum of 2-3 years of experience with a proven track record in FMCG, OTC, or Retail sales .
• Regional Expert: You possess a deep understanding of the Vadodara/Surat market environment and have experience managing independent representatives, distributors, or agents.
• Strategic Partner: You have demonstrated the ability to assist leadership in planning and executing complex sales promotion plans with a focus on productivity and efficiency.
• Analytical & Disciplined: You rely on data to track sales performance and inventory, with a high degree of accountability for daily reporting and meeting monthly sales targets.
descriptionByLocale.de: Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Territory Manager - Vadodara Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche . Als Territory Manager - Vadodara , Sie sind verantwortlich für den Verkauf der Produkte der Organisation durch Vertrieb und Einzelhandel Kanäle über die Vadodara geographischen Bereich. Sie dienen als strategischer Partner des Area Sales Managers (ASM) und bieten kritische Markteinsichten, um die Produktnachfrage abzuschätzen und das Wachstum des Unternehmens zu steigern. Sie wenden neue Ansätze für die Merchandising- und Feldaktivierung an, um die Markensicht zu erhöhen und sicherzustellen, dass unsere lebensverändernden Produkte die Kunden und Patienten erreichen, die sie benötigen. Sie arbeiten mit Händlern und Händlern zusammen, um Barrieren für den Zugang zu brechen, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Verkaufspläne mit Präzision und operativer Exzellenz ausgeführt werden. Mansion - Territory Planning & Execution: Sie treiben Geschäftsergebnisse durch die Bereitstellung von Informationen über das Marktumfeld, um die jährliche Produktnachfrage abzuschätzen. Sie gewährleisten die monatliche Errungenschaft von SKU-weise Verkaufsplänen und -Zielen durch die Erzeugung von Sekundärverkäufen auf dem Markt. - Distributionsmanagement: Sie überwachen die Distributionsleistung, überprüfen das bestehende Netzwerk, um die Ernennung neuer Partner oder die Beendigung von nicht-performierenden vorzuschlagen. Sie motivieren Händler und Händler durch regelmäßige Kommunikation, Sortierung von Problemen in Bezug auf Konten, Preise und Systeme. - Sales Promotion & Merchandising: Sie bereiten Verkaufsförderungspläne durch Feldaktivierung und Merchandising-Aktivitäten vor, die vom Marketingteam entworfen wurden. Sie halten strenge Aufzeichnungen über diese Aktivitäten, Tracking-Kosten und Verkäufe generiert, um Feedback zu Programm Wirksamkeit zu liefern. - Market Intelligence: Sie überwachen Konkurrenteninformationen und Feedback in Ihrer Kategorie. Sie geben dem ASM regelmäßig Berichte über die Konkurrenzaktivitäten und die Verfügbarkeit von Werbematerialien, um sicherzustellen, dass Roche in der Landschaft wettbewerbsfähig bleibt. - Customer Excellence: Sie behandeln alle Beschwerden und Anregungen von Händlern und Kunden durch die Koordination mit der Kundenbetreuung. Sie organisieren Händlertreffen in Abstimmung mit Marketingstrategien, um Markenkonsistenz und starke Partnerschaften zu gewährleisten. - Financial Oversight: Sie sorgen für zeitnahe monatliche Abholungen durch kontinuierliche Follow-ups und stellen Bestandsanforderungen auf der Verteilerebene gemäß dem Verkaufsplan vor. Sie halten disziplinierte tägliche Berichterstattung über Kundenbesuche nach etablierten Arbeitsnormen. Voraussetzungen - Qualified Professional: Sie halten einen Bachelor-Abschluss in Wissenschaft oder Pharmazie . Eine postgraduale Qualifikation gilt als zusätzlicher Vorteil. - Branchenerfahrung: Sie haben mindestens 2-3 Jahre Erfahrung mit einem bewährten Track Record in FMCG, OTC oder Retail-Vertrieb . - Regional Expert: Sie besitzen ein tiefes Verständnis der Vadodara/Surat Marktumgebung und haben Erfahrung, unabhängige Vertreter, Händler oder Agenten zu verwalten. - Strategischer Partner: Sie haben die Möglichkeit gezeigt, die Führung bei der Planung und Durchführung komplexer Verkaufsförderungspläne mit dem Fokus auf Produktivität und Effizienz zu unterstützen. - Analytical & Disciplined: Sie verlassen sich auf Daten, um Umsatzleistung und Inventar zu verfolgen, mit einer hohen Rechenschaftspflicht für die tägliche Berichterstattung und die Erfüllung monatlicher Verkaufsziele.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Gestionnaire de territoire - Vadodara Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui nous fait Roche. En tant que gestionnaire de territoire - Vadodara , vous êtes responsable de la gestion de la vente des produits de l'organisation par les canaux de distribution et de détail dans la zone géographique de Vadodara. Vous servez de partenaire stratégique au Gestionnaire des ventes de secteur (ASM), fournissant des perspectives de marché essentielles pour estimer la demande de produits et stimuler la croissance de l'organisation. Vous appliquez de nouvelles approches de merchandising et d'activation sur le terrain pour augmenter la visibilité de la marque et faire en sorte que nos produits changent la vie des clients et des patients qui en ont besoin. Vous travaillez en collaboration avec les distributeurs et les concessionnaires pour éliminer les obstacles à l'accès, vous assurant que nos plans de vente sont exécutés avec précision et excellence opérationnelle. Mansioni - Planification et exécution du territoire: Vous conduisez les résultats commerciaux en fournissant des informations sur l'environnement du marché pour aider à estimer la demande annuelle de produits. Vous veillez à la réalisation mensuelle des plans et des objectifs de vente par UGS en générant des ventes secondaires sur le marché. - Gestion de la distribution : vous surveillez les performances des distributeurs, examinez le réseau existant pour proposer la nomination de nouveaux partenaires ou la cessation de ceux qui ne sont pas performants. Vous motivez les distributeurs et les concessionnaires par la communication régulière, le tri des questions concernant les comptes, les prix et les régimes. - Promotion des ventes & Marchandisation: Vous préparez et exécutez des plans de promotion des ventes par le biais d'activités d'activation sur le terrain et de merchandising conçues par l'équipe marketing. Vous conservez des registres rigoureux de ces activités, du suivi des dépenses et des ventes générées pour fournir des commentaires sur l'efficacité du programme. - Intelligence de marché: Vous surveillez les informations et les commentaires des concurrents dans votre catégorie. Vous fournissez régulièrement des rapports à l'ASM sur les activités des concurrents et la disponibilité des stocks de matériel promotionnel pour assurer que Roche reste compétitive dans le paysage. - Excellence client: Vous répondez à toutes les plaintes et suggestions des distributeurs et des clients en coordonnant avec le service client. Vous organisez des réunions de concessionnaires en accord avec les stratégies de marketing pour assurer la cohérence de la marque et des partenariats solides. - Surveillance financière : Vous assurez des collectes mensuelles en temps opportun grâce à des suivis continus et soumettez les exigences d'inventaire au niveau du distributeur conformément au plan de vente. Vous maintenez un rapport quotidien discipliné sur les visites des clients selon les normes de travail établies.
• Requisiti - Professionnel qualifié: Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat en sciences ou en pharmacie . Une qualification postdoctorale est considérée comme un avantage supplémentaire. - Expérience de l'industrie: Vous avez un minimum de 2-3 ans d'expérience avec une expérience éprouvée en FMCG, en OTC ou au détail. - Expert régional: Vous possédez une connaissance approfondie de l'environnement du marché de Vadodara/Surat et avez de l'expérience en gestion de représentants indépendants, distributeurs ou agents. - Partenaire stratégique: Vous avez démontré la capacité d'aider le leadership dans la planification et l'exécution de plans de promotion des ventes complexes en mettant l'accent sur la productivité et l'efficacité. - Analyse & Discipline : Vous comptez sur les données pour suivre les performances et les stocks des ventes, avec un haut degré de responsabilité pour les rapports quotidiens et atteindre les objectifs de ventes mensuels.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Dein neues Team
Du verstärkst unseren Bereich Vertrieb Service in der Region Augsburg/Landsberg a. Lech. Gemeinsam mit den Kolleg:innen aus dem Verkauf und anderen Vertriebseinheiten verfolgen wir das Ziel, eine langfristige Kundenbindung sicherzustellen und den Verkauf unserer Roche-Systeme aktiv zu unterstützen. Dabei verantworten wir den technischen und applikativen Kundenservice unter anderem für Analysensysteme und Reagenzien der Molekularen/Gewebediagnostik und IT-Lösungen.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
Als Junior Systembetreuer (m/w/d) bist du das Gesicht von Roche vor Ort. Du stellst die Verfügbarkeit und Sicherheit unserer Roche-Standardgeräte sicher und trägst so maßgeblich zur Kundenzufriedenheit bei. Deine Aufgaben erledigst du sowohl im direkten Kundenkontakt als auch in enger Abstimmung mit deinem Team:

• Du führst fachgerechte technische Fehlerdiagnosen durch und reparierst Roche-Standardgeräte – meist vor Ort beim Kunden, teilweise auch per Remote-Support. Dabei übernimmst du auch die sorgfältige Dokumentation im CRM-System, um nachhaltige Problemlösungen sicherzustellen und die Fakturierung.

• Du bist verantwortlich für die Installation neuer Systeme, führst Testläufe durch und übergibst die Geräte betriebsbereit an den Kunden.

• Du erledigst Wartungen und Modifikationen termingerecht und unter Berücksichtigung wirtschaftlicher Aspekte, basierend auf Serviceverträgen oder Einzelaufträgen.

• Als technischer Ansprechpartner vor Ort erkennst du die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden frühzeitig. Du weist Kunden technisch ein, berätst zu Serviceverträgen oder präventiven Maßnahmen und arbeitest eng mit dem Vertrieb zusammen, um Verkaufschancen für Systemgeschäfte oder Dienstleistungen zu identifizieren.

• Du organisierst deine Einsätze in der Region effizient und eigenverantwortlich. Um die kontinuierliche Versorgung der Patienten sicherzustellen

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
Neben einer erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Ausbildung als staatlich geprüfte:r Techniker:in oder ein Studium (z.B. FH) in Elektrotechnik, Elektronik, Mechatronik oder einer ähnlichen Fachrichtung bringst Du idealerweise erste praktische Berufserfahrung (z.B. durch Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeit oder eine technische Ausbildung) im Umgang mit komplexen technischen Systemen mit. Folgende Punkte runden Dein Profil ab:

• Aufgrund der regionalen Einsatzplanung und der Fahrzeiten lebst Du im idealerweise in der Region Augsburg/Landsberg a. Lech. Zudem besitzt du einen gültigen Führerschein und bringst eine hohe Reisebereitschaft mit, um unsere Kund:innen in der Region zu betreuen.

• Du bringst Erfahrung im Umgang mit technischen Systemen mit, insbesondere in den Bereichen Hydraulik, Elektronik und Messtechnik.

• Du besitzt Kenntnisse in der Anwendung von Steuerungs- und Betriebssoftware, verstehst die IT-Anbindung moderner IT-Anbindungen und hast idealerweise chemisches Basiswissen.

• Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und besitzt gute fach- und allgemeinsprachliche Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mindestens Niveau B1/B2).

• Du arbeitest eigenständig, ergebnisorientiert nach Zielvorgaben und bringst eine hohe Kundenorientierung mit. Als Teil eines deutschlandweiten Teams schätzt du den kollegialen Austausch und bist bereit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

• Du arbeitest ergebnisorientiert nach Zielvereinbarungen und bist bereit, Verantwortung im Rahmen von Not- und Bereitschaftsdiensten zu übernehmen.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

IT GRC Expert - RDT Quality, Risk & Compliance

As an IT GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) Expert - RDT (Roche Digital Technology) Quality, Risk & Compliance you design and implement comprehensive IT resilience, risk management, and compliance strategies aligned with business objectives. You lead complex risk assessments, develop refined audit and continuity programs, and establish best practices for handling critical disruptions and regulatory compliance. Acting as an expert advisor to high-level stakeholders, you lead responses to critical incidents and ensure the scalability and future-proofing of enterprise-wide risk and continuity solutions.

The Opportunity:

• You will develop and refine enterprise-wide risk management, compliance, and continuity strategies to enhance our global recovery plans.

• Lead the response to critical IT risk, audit, and continuity events while establishing global best practices for handling disruptions.

• Conduct post-incident reviews and "deep-dives" to identify systemic failures and implement continuous improvement frameworks.

• Manage high-level stakeholder relationships, acting as a strategic advisor to align risk policies with evolving business needs.

• Provide strategic insights based on industry best practices to ensure our compliance frameworks remain world-class.

• Oversee the scalability of IT resilience solutions, integrating complex policies with existing enterprise systems.

• Evaluate and select advanced tools for enterprise management to future-proof our technical resilience landscape.

• Facilitate advanced training sessions for cross-functional teams on BCM best practices and advanced problem-solving techniques.

Who you are:

• You possess extensive experience in architecting enterprise-wide IT resilience and risk management strategies at a strategic level.

• Expert in Life Sciences regulations, including GxP, SOX, and HIPAA, with a deep understanding of computer systems validation (CSV).

• Highly knowledgeable in IT General Controls (ITGC) and frameworks such as SOC2, ISO 27001, NIS2, and DORA.

• Technically proficient in AWS and Azure environments, specifically regarding shared responsibility models and cloud-native DR orchestration.

• Proven ability to establish governance guardrails for emerging technologies like Generative AI, RPA, and SaaS.

• Skilled in secure SDLC and DevOps stacks (Jira, Jenkins, Bitbucket) with the ability to implement Compliance-as-Code.

• Holder of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT or Cybersecurity, and at least one active credential: CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP, or ISO 22301.

What you get:

• Salary range 19 000 - 35 400PLN g ross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subsidy available.

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice).

• Private healthcare (LuxMed packages), group life insurance (UNUM) and Multisport.

• Stock share purchase additions.

• Yearly sales of company laptops and cars and many more!

Apply directly and join us in shaping the future of healthcare.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Posizione IT GRC Expert - Qualità RDT, Rischio e conformità In qualità di IT GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) Expert - RDT (Roche Digital Technology) Qualità, Risk & Compliance progetta e implementa una resilienza IT completa, gestione del rischio e strategie di conformità allineate agli obiettivi aziendali. Conduci valutazioni di rischio complesse, sviluppi programmi di audit e continuità raffinati, e stabilisci le migliori pratiche per gestire le interruzioni critiche e la conformità alle normative. Facendo da consulente esperto per gli stakeholder di alto livello, si guidano le risposte agli incidenti critici e assicurano la scalabilità e la protezione futura delle soluzioni di rischio e continuità a livello aziendale. Opportunità - svilupperai e raffinerai strategie di gestione, conformità e continuità a livello aziendale per migliorare i nostri piani di recupero globale. - Guidare la risposta agli eventi critici relativi al rischio IT, all'audit e alla continuità, stabilendo le migliori pratiche globali per la gestione delle interruzioni. - Condurre revisioni post-incidenti e "deep-dives" per identificare guasti sistemici e implementare quadri di miglioramento continuo. - Gestire relazioni di stakeholder di alto livello, agendo come consulente strategico per allineare le politiche di rischio con le esigenze aziendali in evoluzione. - Fornire informazioni strategiche basate sulle best practice del settore per garantire che i nostri quadri di conformità rimangano di livello mondiale. - supervisionare la scalabilità delle soluzioni di resilienza IT, integrando politiche complesse con sistemi enterprise esistenti. - Valutare e selezionare strumenti avanzati per la gestione aziendale a prova di futuro il nostro paesaggio di resilienza tecnica. - Facilitare sessioni di formazione avanzate per team interfunzionali sulle best practice BCM e tecniche avanzate di problem solving. Chi sei? - Possiedi un'ampia esperienza nell'archiviare le strategie di resilienza IT a livello aziendale e di gestione dei rischi a livello strategico. - Esperto nelle normative Life Sciences, tra cui GxP, SOX e HIPAA, con una profonda comprensione della convalida dei sistemi informatici (CSV). - Altamente conoscibile in IT General Controls (ITGC) e strutture come SOC2, ISO 27001, NIS2, e DORA. - Tecnicamente competente in ambienti AWS e Azure, in particolare per quanto riguarda i modelli di responsabilità condivisa e l'orchestrazione DR nativo cloud. - Prove capacità di stabilire guardrails di governance per le tecnologie emergenti come AI Generativo, RPA e SaaS. - Compliance-as-Code. - Titolare di un Bachelor o Master in IT o Cybersecurity, e almeno una credenziale attiva: CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP, o ISO 22301. Cosa? - Campo d'insalatura 19 000 - 35 400PLN g ross basato sul contratto di lavoro. - Pagamento bonus annuale basato sulle tue prestazioni. - Bilancio di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati ecc.). - Ricarica venerdì (2 venerdì per trimestre disponibile). - Prenda tempo Programma (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo). - Sovvenzione per le vacanze disponibile. - Flex Location (possibilità di eseguire il nostro lavoro da diversi luoghi del mondo per un certo periodo di tempo). - Prendere Tempo per la Carità ( congedo a pagamento aggiuntivo di massimo 2 settimane per impegnarsi nell'azione di carità di vostra scelta). - Assistenza sanitaria privata (pacchetti LuxMed), assicurazione vita di gruppo (UNUM) e Multisport. - Aggiunti di acquisto azionario. - Vendita annuale di computer portatili aziendali e automobili e molti altri! Contatto Applicare direttamente e unirsi a noi per plasmare il futuro della salute. Se lo sentite fuori

Chi sei - Sie verfügen über umfangreiche Erfahrung in der betriebsweiten IT-Belastung und Risikomanagementstrategien auf strategischer Ebene. - Experte für Life Sciences Vorschriften, einschließlich GxP, SOX und HIPAA, mit einem tiefen Verständnis der Computersysteme Validierung (CSV). - Hochqualifiziert in IT General Controls (ITGC) und Frameworks wie SOC2, ISO 27001, NIS2 und DORA. - Technisch kompetent in AWS und Azure Umgebungen, speziell in Bezug auf gemeinsame Verantwortungsmodelle und cloud-native DR-Orchestrierung. - Bewiesene Fähigkeit, Governance-Guardrails für aufstrebende Technologien wie Generative AI, RPA und SaaS zu etablieren. - Skilled in sicheren SDLC und DevOps Stacks (Jira, Jenkins, Bitbucket) mit der Fähigkeit, Compliance-as-Code implementieren. - Inhaber eines Bachelor- oder Master-Abschlusses in IT oder Cybersecurity und mindestens eines aktiven Anmelders: CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP oder ISO 22301.

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Posizione Expert en TI GRC - RDT Qualité, risque et conformité En tant qu'expert en TI GRC (Gouvernance, Risque et Conformité) - RDT (Roche Digital Technology) Qualité, Risque et Conformité, vous concevez et implémentez des stratégies complètes de résilience, de gestion des risques et de conformité conformes aux objectifs opérationnels. Vous dirigez des évaluations des risques complexes, élaborez des programmes de vérification et de continuité améliorés et établissez des pratiques exemplaires pour gérer les perturbations critiques et la conformité réglementaire. En tant que conseiller expert auprès des intervenants de haut niveau, vous dirigez les interventions en cas d'incident critique et vous assurez l'évolutivité et la protection future des solutions de risque et de continuité à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Annexe - Vous développerez et affinerez des stratégies de gestion des risques, de conformité et de continuité à l'échelle de l'entreprise afin d'améliorer nos plans de redressement mondiaux. - Diriger la réponse aux risques critiques liés aux TI, à la vérification et à la continuité tout en établissant les meilleures pratiques mondiales pour gérer les perturbations. - Procéder à des examens post-incident et à des « directives profondes » pour déceler les défaillances systémiques et mettre en place des cadres d'amélioration continue. - Gérer les relations de haut niveau avec les intervenants, agir à titre de conseiller stratégique pour harmoniser les politiques sur les risques avec l'évolution des besoins opérationnels. - Fournir des renseignements stratégiques fondés sur les meilleures pratiques de l'industrie pour s'assurer que nos cadres de conformité demeurent de calibre mondial. - Surveiller l'évolutivité des solutions de résilience informatique, en intégrant des politiques complexes aux systèmes d'entreprise existants. - Évaluer et sélectionner des outils avancés pour la gestion d'entreprise pour mettre à l'épreuve notre paysage de résilience technique. - Faciliter les séances de formation avancée à l'intention des équipes interfonctionnelles sur les meilleures pratiques de la BCM et les techniques avancées de résolution de problèmes. Les - Vous possédez une vaste expérience dans l'architecture de stratégies de résilience informatique et de gestion des risques à l'échelle de l'entreprise au niveau stratégique. - Expert en sciences de la vie, y compris GxP, SOX et HIPAA, avec une compréhension approfondie de la validation des systèmes informatiques (CSV). - Haute connaissance des contrôles généraux des TI (ITGC) et des cadres tels que SOC2, ISO 27001, NIS2 et DORA. - Techniquement compétent dans les environnements AWS et Azure, en particulier en ce qui concerne les modèles de responsabilité partagée et l'orchestration de RD native en nuage. - Capacité éprouvée d'établir des garde-corps de gouvernance pour les technologies émergentes telles que Generative AI, RPA et SaaS. - Compétence dans les piles SDLC et DevOps sécurisées (Jira, Jenkins, Bitbucket) avec la capacité de mettre en œuvre la conformité comme code. - Titulaire d'un baccalauréat ou d'une maîtrise en informatique ou cybersécurité, et au moins un titre actif : CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP ou ISO 22301.
• Cosa offriamo - Barème des salaires 19 000 - 35 400 PLN g ross sur la base du contrat de travail. - Paiement de bonus annuel en fonction de votre performance. - Budget dédié à la formation (formation, certifications, conférences, parcours professionnels diversifiés, etc.). - Recharger les vendredis (2 vendredis par trimestre disponible). - Prendre du temps Programme (jusqu'à 3 mois de congé à utiliser à n'importe quelle fin). - Allocation de vacances disponible. - Flex Location (possibilité d'effectuer notre travail à partir de différents endroits du monde pour une certaine période de temps). - Prenez du temps pour l'organisme de bienfaisance (un congé payé supplémentaire de 2 semaines maximum pour participer à l'action de bienfaisance de votre choix). - Soins de santé privés (paquets LuxMed), assurance-vie collective (UNUM) et multisports. - Ajouts d'actions. - Ventes annuelles d'ordinateurs portables et de voitures d'entreprise et beaucoup plus! jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
TAM 治疗领域经理

治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案，运用专业知识，协助合理使用药品，助力生态圈内诊断准确度和治疗规范度的提升

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集，并进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

客户管理
• 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道 , 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（ HCP ）观念、学术需求 传递专业化医学 / 疾病 / 产品信息

• 传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
• 传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设
• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生 / 科室教育 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
• 规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。
• 组织和支持区域专家会议
• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈
• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作
• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持
• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力

岗位所需胜任力
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• 正确的思维和行为 ( 使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维 )

• 3 年以上医药行业工作经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

jobs.title: Data & Insights Enablement - Lead Analyst (UI/UX)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Data & Insights Enablement - Lead Analyst (UI/UX)
Roche India - Roche Services & Solutions
Chennai / Hyderabad

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) in India to drive analytics & technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe. All Roche employees are expected to effectively contribute to cross-functional collaboration and coordination and comply with all laws, regulations, policies & procedures that govern our business.

As a Data & Insights Enablement - Lead Analyst (UI/UX), you will work closely with product teams and other stakeholders to design and improve dashboards and digital experiences. Your role will focus on understanding user needs, shaping features, and testing designs to ensure they are intuitive, useful, and deliver a smooth user experience.

Your Opportunity

• Identify and frame user-centered problems effectively

• Create wireframes and mock-ups to visualize concepts and facilitate usability testing with end users

• Collaborate with product, analytics, and technology teams throughout planning, design, and development to ensure design intent is met

• Work closely within the stakeholder teams to uphold quality standards for UI/UX design

• Present design concepts and rationale to stakeholders, gather feedback, and incorporate it into iterations

• Conduct 'Data Discovery' sessions to understand what questions users are trying to answer before beginning the design phase. Define and maintain a 'Dashboard Design System' (components, color tokens, typography) to ensure a consistent look and feel across all analytics products

Behaviours & Abilities Required

• Design simple, effective, and elegant interactions between users and products

• Create strong problem statements and metrics to ensure design solutions are achieving the right business and user outcomes

• Forge strong relationships and work collaboratively with a multi-disciplinary team

Nice To Have

• Provide sound rationale for recommendations to gain support and commitment

• Manage ambiguity, change and uncertainty effectively, making timely decisions to keep work moving forward

• Adapt to dynamic business needs with flexibility and willingness to contribute across tasks

• Prior exposure to healthcare, clinical terminologies, therapeutic areas.

Who are you

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Visual Communication, or a related field with 7 plus years of experience in UI and UX design with a strong focus on dashboards and data products

• Candidates from Computer Science or Engineering backgrounds with strong UX design experience are also welcome

• Strong portfolio demonstrating UX thinking and problem solving is required

• Experience designing internal tools and external web applications for data driven use cases

• Strong ability to simplify complex data into clear and intuitive user experiences

• Hands on experience with Tableau and a strong understanding of data visualization best practices

• Experience working closely with product, analytics, and engineering teams to define requirements and design solutions

• Ability to design for different user groups such as analysts

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Data & Insights Abilitazione - Lead Analyst (UI/UX) Roche India - Roche Services & Solutions Chennai / Hyderabad Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Roche ha stabilito Global Analytics e Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) in India per guidare le soluzioni analitiche e tecnologiche, collaborando con gli affiliati Roche in tutto il mondo. Tutti i dipendenti di Roche dovrebbero contribuire efficacemente alla collaborazione e al coordinamento interfunzionali e rispettare tutte le leggi, regolamenti, politiche e procedure che governano il nostro business. In qualità di Data & Insights Enablement - Lead Analyst (UI/UX), lavorerai a stretto contatto con team di prodotti e altri stakeholder per progettare e migliorare dashboard e esperienze digitali. Il tuo ruolo si concentrerà sulla comprensione delle esigenze degli utenti, la modellazione delle funzionalità e i progetti di test per garantire che siano intuitivi, utili e forniscono un'esperienza utente fluida. Mansioni - Identificare e inquadrare i problemi incentrati sull'utente in modo efficace - Creare wireframe e mock-up per visualizzare i concetti e facilitare il test di usabilità con gli utenti finali - Collaborare con i team di prodotti, analisi e tecnologia durante la pianificazione, progettazione e sviluppo per garantire l'intento di progettazione - Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team delle parti interessate per rispettare gli standard di qualità per il design UI/UX - Concetti di design attuali e razionalità per gli stakeholder, raccogliere feedback e incorporarlo in iterazioni - Condurre sessioni 'Data Discovery' per capire quali domande gli utenti stanno cercando di rispondere prima di iniziare la fase di progettazione. Definire e mantenere un 'Dashboard Design System' (componenti, token di colore, tipografia) per garantire un look coerente e sentire in tutti i prodotti di analisi Comportamenti e abilità necessarie - Progettare interazioni semplici, efficaci ed eleganti tra utenti e prodotti - Creare forti dichiarazioni di problemi e metriche per garantire soluzioni di progettazione stanno raggiungendo i giusti risultati aziendali e degli utenti - Forge relazioni forti e lavorare in collaborazione con un team multidisciplinare Bello da avere - Fornire una solida motivazione per le raccomandazioni per ottenere sostegno e impegno - Gestire efficacemente l'ambiguità, il cambiamento e l'incertezza, prendere decisioni tempestive per continuare a lavorare - Adapt alle esigenze aziendali dinamiche con flessibilità e disponibilità a contribuire attraverso i compiti - Prima esposizione alla salute, terminologie cliniche, aree terapeutiche. Chi sei - Hai una laurea in Design, Human Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Comunicazione visiva, o un campo correlato con 7 anni di esperienza nel design UI e UX con una forte attenzione su dashboard e prodotti di dati - I candidati da Computer Science o Ingegneria sfondi con forte esperienza di progettazione UX sono anche benvenuti - È richiesto un portafoglio forte che dimostra il pensiero UX e la risoluzione dei problemi - Esperienza nella progettazione di strumenti interni e applicazioni web esterne per i casi di utilizzo - Forte capacità di semplificare i dati complessi in esperienze utente chiare e intuitive - Mani sull'esperienza con Tableau e una forte comprensione delle best practice di visualizzazione dei dati - Esperienza di lavoro a stretto contatto con i team di prodotti, analisi e ingegneria per definire i requisiti e le soluzioni di progettazione - Capacità di progettare per diversi gruppi di utenti come analisti

jobs.title: Analytics & Intelligence - Senior Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Analytics & Intelligence - Senior Analyst
Roche India - Roche Services & Solutions
Chennai / Hyderabad

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) in India to drive analytics & technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe. All Roche employees are expected to effectively contribute to cross-functional collaboration and coordination and comply with all laws, regulations, policies & procedures that govern our business.

As a Analytics & Intelligence - Senior Analyst ( Digital Marketing Analyst) , you will support the marketing team by building and maintaining reports and dashboards within Adobe Experience Platform and the Adobe Experience Cloud. You will focus on organizing data, tracking key metrics, and delivering clear insights that help teams monitor performance and make informed decisions across digital channels.

Your Opportunity

• Build and maintain dashboards and reports within Adobe Experience Platform and Adobe Experience Cloud

• Work with marketing teams to translate business requirements into clear reporting and visualization outputs

• Collect, organize, and validate customer and campaign data across digital channels (web, email, paid media)

• Support KPI definition and ensure proper tracking is implemented across campaigns

• Analyze email campaign performance (open rate, CTR, bounce, conversions) and provide actionable recommendations to improve engagement and effectiveness

• Analyze performance data to identify trends and provide actionable insights

• Ensure data accuracy by validating tracking and resolving issues using debugging tools

• Support A/B testing analysis and share performance insights with stakeholders

• Collaborate with marketing, product, and tech teams to improve data capture and reporting

• Mentor junior analysts and guide stakeholders on reporting best practices

Who you are

• You have a Bachelor’s Degree (computer science, engineering or other technical disciplines) with 4–7 years of experience in digital analytics or marketing analytics. Preferably, you have a Master's degree

• Strong hands-on experience with:

• Adobe Experience Platform

• Adobe Analytics

• Adobe Experience Manager

• Solid understanding of digital marketing channels and performance metrics

• Experience analyzing email campaign performance (open rate, CTR, bounce rate, conversions) and deriving actionable insights

• Experience analyzing campaign performance (CTR, conversion, engagement, etc.)

• Familiarity with:

• Google Tag Manager

• Adobe Launch

• Strong SQL skills and proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets

• Strong attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy

• Good communication skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams

• Experience in healthcare/life sciences is a plus

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibil

jobs.title: Technical Support Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The opportunity
As a Technical Support Partner for Lab-IT, you are responsible for carrying out field service functions for Roche Diagnostics Digital Products. Your primary duties include digital product troubleshooting, installation, commissioning, and performing preventive maintenance procedures. Reporting to the Technical Support Lead for Lab-IT, you will respond promptly to all service calls and handle various after-sales service issues to ensure customer satisfaction and optimal instrument performance.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented, proactive, service-minded with strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively across functions.
You will be responsible for

• Perform digital product installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting for all Roche Diagnostics digital Products.

• Respond promptly and effectively to all service calls from customers.

• Conduct preventive maintenance according to the established schedule to ensure instrument & digital product reliability.

• Manage and resolve other issues related to digital solution after-sales service to maintain high levels of customer support.

Who you are
Experience and Competencies:

• Strong in analytical and troubleshooting skills.

• Able to drive and travel in upcountry areas and be flexible to work outside of normal working hours.

• Independent, a team player, flexible, and solution-driven with an agile mindset.

• Good command of spoken and written English.

• Good communication skills.

• Demonstrates a desire to influence your own development and pursue interests across functions.

• Industry Experience:

• Bachelors or Masters in IT or related fields.

• Minimum of 1 year of work experience as a IT Specialist in the healthcare business is preferred.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Bei der Roche Pharma AG arbeiten wir täglich an der Vision, die Gesundheitsversorgung der Zukunft zu gestalten. Als Customer Partnering Manager (d/w/m) für Multiple Sklerose (RRMS) bist Du das Bindeglied zwischen medizinischer Innovation und der realen Versorgung in Deiner Region. Du verstehst die Patient Journey wie eine Landkarte und setzt Deine Energie dort ein, wo Du echten Mehrwert für Menschen, das Gesundheitssystem und unser Portfolio schaffen kannst.

Dein neues Team:
Du wirst Teil einer dynamischen EcoUnit, in der wir Silos hinter uns lassen und gemeinsam an einem Strang ziehen. Unser Team besteht aus Expert:innen, die eine offene Feedbackkultur leben und sich gegenseitig inspirieren. Hier triffst Du auf Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und die Freiheit schätzen, neue Wege in der Kundeninteraktion zu gehen.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In dieser Rolle bist Du der/die Regisseur:in für regionale Strategien und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Lösungen genau dort ankommen, wo sie gebraucht werden.

• Patient Journey Navigator: Du analysierst Hürden in der Diagnose und Behandlung und leitest daraus mutige Handlungsoptionen ab.

• Wissenschaftlicher Partner: Du berätst medizinisches Fachpersonal auf Augenhöhe und stellst eine transparente, rechtmäßige Anwendung unserer Produkte sicher.

• Event-Gestalter: Du planst und moderierst Fortbildungsveranstaltungen sowie wissenschaftliche Produktschulungen, um Wissen direkt erlebbar zu machen.

• Beziehungs-Architekt: Du bist der primäre Ansprechpartner für Deine Stakeholder und baust ein starkes, crossfunktionales Netzwerk auf.

• Impulsgeber: Du bringst Markttrends proaktiv ins Team ein und gestaltest die Disease Area Strategie aktiv mit.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
Du bist eine kommunikationsstarke Persönlichkeit, die es liebt, komplexe Netzwerke zu knüpfen und durch Fachwissen zu überzeugen.

• Hintergrund: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Medizin, Naturwissenschaften oder BWL) und bringst Erfahrung aus der Pharmaindustrie mit.

• Expertise: Du besitzt tiefes Wissen im Bereich der Neuroscience sowie Kenntnisse zur Gesundheits Regulatorik, Gesundheitswesen und -organisationen (inkl. Krankenhausmanagement)

• Digitaler Mindset: Der Umgang mit digitalen Kommunikationstools (z.B. Zoom, Google Suite) ist für Dich so natürlich wie das Atmen.

• Persönlichkeit: Du denkst unternehmerisch, triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Mehrwert und sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

• Zulassung: Du erfüllst die Voraussetzungen als Pharmaberater:in nach AMG und besitzt einen gültigen Führerschein.

Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser. Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. Finde hier mehr heraus: https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DE

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf oder Workday-Profil

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse & Nachweise

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

Bewirb Dich jetzt – wir freuen uns!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you wi

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are Roche, committed to advancing science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

Our Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) team is the heartbeat of Pharma, setting the rhythm for Pharma — shaping Roche’s strategic direction, ensuring our portfolio delivers meaningful innovation to patients worldwide. By integrating scientific, commercial, and market insights, GPS drives enterprise-wide strategy, portfolio prioritization, and business model innovation to advance Roche’s leadership in the evolving healthcare landscape.

As part of the Portfolio, Strategy, and Insights (PSI) team within GPS, you will serve as a strategic thought partner and trusted advisor, guiding Roche’s product, disease area, pharma, and corporate strategy. The PSI team, composed of Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, and Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, delivers consistent, targeted, and technology-enabled insights that drive quality decision-making across the enterprise, providing unbiased, expertly curated intelligence to inform lifecycle management, commercialization excellence, and portfolio strategies.

The Global Ecosystem Insights (EI) team is looking for a Beyond Therapeutic Area (TA) Market Insights Leader to join us in shaping Roche's Pharma strategy through market, portfolio and customer-centric insights. This role functions as an internal consultant and strategist, partnering with commercial and cross-functional leaders to generate insights that span Therapeutic Areas and shape cross-portfolio decisions.

The Opportunity

The Beyond TA Market Insights Leader is responsible for operationalizing industry-leading methodologies in primary and secondary market research to guide strategic decisions. In this role, you will lead innovative projects and workstreams that pioneer new methodologies, apply new technologies and create analyses that shape development and commercial strategy. You will partner extensively within EI and other PSI teams to drive engagement, embed enhancements, and realize the full value of solutions developed. You will navigate a complex global matrix to align cross-functional partners around high-impact, insight-driven deliverables. You will report to the EI Beyond TA Enabling Leader.

Focus areas and responsibilities

• Insights excellence: Elevate the quality and impact of EI deliverables by advancing research practices across primary and secondary sources. You will ensure our research remains best-in-class by implementing high-impact methodologies and tools that allow insights to directly inform and accelerate strategic business decisions.

• Future-ready roadmap: Design and execute a multi-year roadmap to evolve Primary Market Research and secondary insights capabilities. You will lead pilots for innovative research engines and scale successful methodologies globally, ensuring our insights infrastructure is agile, scalable, and ahead of industry trends.

• Cross-portfolio insights: Lead the generation of strategic insights on themes with multi-TA impact, such as Digital Health, Drug Delivery, and next-generation commercialization models. You will connect the dots across the portfolio to unlock business value

• Upskilling and training: Define the gold standard for Market Research within EI. You will design and deliver a comprehensive curriculum to ensure our capabilities remain industry-leading and future proof

• Strategic vendor & compliance oversight

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Siamo Roche, impegnati a promuovere la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Il nostro team Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) è il battito cardiaco di Pharma, impostando il ritmo per Pharma - modellando la direzione strategica di Roche, assicurando che il nostro portafoglio offre innovazione significativa ai pazienti in tutto il mondo. Integrando intuizioni scientifiche, commerciali e di mercato, il GPS guida la strategia aziendale, la priorità del portafoglio e l’innovazione del modello di business per far progredire la leadership di Roche nel panorama sanitario in evoluzione. Nell'ambito del team Portfolio, Strategy e Insights (PSI) all'interno del GPS, servirai come partner di pensiero strategico e consulente di fiducia, guidando il prodotto di Roche, l'area malattia, la farmaco e la strategia aziendale. Il team PSI, composto da Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, and Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, offre intuizioni coerenti, mirate e tecnologicamente abilitate che guidano il processo decisionale di qualità in tutta l'azienda, fornendo informazioni imparziali e curate per informare la gestione del ciclo di vita, l'eccellenza della commercializzazione e le strategie di portafoglio. Il team Global Ecosystem Insights (EI) sta cercando un Beyond Therapeutic Area (TA) Market Insights Leader per unirsi a noi nella definizione della strategia di Roche Pharma attraverso il mercato, il portafoglio e le intuizioni customer-centric. Questo ruolo funziona come consulente interno e stratega, collaborando con leader commerciali e cross-funzionali per generare intuizioni che abbracciano Aree terapeutiche e modellano le decisioni cross-portfolio. L'opportunità The Beyond TA Market Insights Leader è responsabile per l'operatività delle metodologie leader del settore nella ricerca primaria e secondaria di mercato per guidare le decisioni strategiche. In questo ruolo, guiderai progetti innovativi e flussi di lavoro che pionierizzano nuove metodologie, applichino nuove tecnologie e creeranno analisi che modellano lo sviluppo e la strategia commerciale. Potrai collaborare ampiamente all'interno di EI e altri team PSI per guidare il coinvolgimento, incorporare miglioramenti, e realizzare il valore completo delle soluzioni sviluppate. Potrai navigare in una matrice globale complessa per allineare i partner interfunzionali intorno ai prodotti ad alto impatto e orientati agli insight. Ti riferirai all'EI Beyond TA Eable Leader. Mansioni - Insights eccellenza: Elevate la qualità e l'impatto dei prodotti EI incrementando le pratiche di ricerca tra fonti primarie e secondarie. Garantirai che la nostra ricerca rimanga al meglio in classe implementando metodologie e strumenti ad alto impatto che consentono di informare e accelerare direttamente le decisioni strategiche di business. - Roadmap pronta per il futuro: Progettare ed eseguire una roadmap pluriennale per evolvere le capacità di Primary Market Research e secondaria insights. Potrai guidare i piloti per i motori di ricerca innovativi e scalare metodologie di successo a livello globale, assicurando la nostra infrastruttura di insight è agile, scalabile, e davanti alle tendenze del settore. - Intuizioni cross-portfolio: guidare la generazione di insight strategici su temi con impatto multi-TA, come la salute digitale, la consegna delle droghe e modelli di commercializzazione di nuova generazione. Connetterai i punti in tutto il portafoglio per sbloccare il valore aziendale - Upskilling e formazione: Definire lo standard oro per la ricerca di mercato in EI. Potrai progettare e fornire un curriculum completo per garantire le nostre capacità rimanere leader del settore e la prova futura - Supervisione della conformità e del fornitore strategico Contatto (Non fornito)

descriptionByLocale.de: Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Wir sind Roche, verpflichtet, die Wissenschaft voranzubringen, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Unser Team von Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) ist das Herzstück von Pharma, das den Rhythmus für Pharma festlegt – die strategische Ausrichtung von Roche zu prägen und sicherzustellen, dass unser Portfolio weltweit sinnvolle Innovationen für Patienten liefert. Durch die Integration von wissenschaftlichen, kommerziellen und Markteinblicken treibt GPS unternehmensweite Strategie, Portfoliopriorisierung und Unternehmensmodellinnovation an, um Roches Führung in der sich entwickelnden Gesundheitslandschaft voranzubringen. Im Rahmen des Portfolio-, Strategie- und Insights (PSI)-Teams im GPS-Bereich werden Sie als strategischer Denkpartner und vertrauenswürdiger Berater tätig sein, der das Produkt, den Krankheitsbereich, die Pharma- und die Unternehmensstrategie von Roche leitet. Das PSI-Team, bestehend aus Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads und Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, bietet konsistente, gezielte und technologiefähige Erkenntnisse, die die Qualitätsentscheidungsfindung im gesamten Unternehmen vorantreiben und unvoreingenommene, fachkundig kuratierte Intelligenz bereitstellen, um Lifecycle Management, Commercialization Excellence und Portfoliostrategien zu informieren. Das Global Ecosystem Insights (EI)-Team sucht nach einem Beyond Therapeutic Area (TA) Market Insights Leader, der uns bei der Gestaltung der Pharma-Strategie von Roche durch Markt-, Portfolio- und kundenzentrierte Erkenntnisse beitritt. Diese Rolle fungiert als interner Berater und Stratege und arbeitet mit kommerziellen und funktionsübergreifenden Führungskräften zusammen, um Erkenntnisse zu generieren, die sich auf Therapeutische Bereiche erstrecken und Cross-Portfolio-Entscheidungen formen. Die Chance Der Beyond TA Market Insights Leader ist für die operative Abwicklung branchenführender Methoden in der Primär- und Sekundärmarktforschung verantwortlich, um strategische Entscheidungen zu leiten. In dieser Rolle werden Sie innovative Projekte und Workstreams leiten, die neue Methoden wegweisen, neue Technologien anwenden und Analysen erstellen, die Entwicklung und kommerzielle Strategie prägen. Sie werden in EI und anderen PSI-Teams umfassend zusammenarbeiten, um das Engagement, die Embed-Erweiterungen zu fördern und den vollen Wert der entwickelten Lösungen zu realisieren. Sie navigieren eine komplexe globale Matrix, um funktionsübergreifende Partner rund um wirkungsstarke, einsichtsorientierte Lieferungen auszurichten. Sie werden dem EI Beyond TA Enabling Leader melden. Mansion - Insights Excellence: Erhöhen Sie die Qualität und Wirkung von EI-Leistungen durch die Förderung von Forschungspraktiken in Primär- und Sekundärquellen. Sie stellen sicher, dass unsere Forschung in bester Klasse bleibt, indem Sie hocheffiziente Methoden und Tools implementieren, die Einblicke ermöglichen, strategische Geschäftsentscheidungen direkt zu informieren und zu beschleunigen. - Zukunftsbereite Roadmap: Entwerfen und führen Sie eine mehrjährige Roadmap zur Entwicklung von Primary Market Research und sekundären Erkenntnissen. Sie führen Piloten für innovative Forschungsmotoren und skalieren erfolgreiche Methoden weltweit, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Einsichtsinfrastruktur agil, skalierbar und vor Branchentrends ist. - Cross-Portfolio-Einsichten: Führen Sie die Generierung strategischer Erkenntnisse zu Themen mit Multi-TA-Wirkung, wie Digital Health, Drug Delivery und Next-Generation-Marketing-Modellen. Sie verbinden die Punkte über das Portfolio, um den Geschäftswert zu entsperren - Upskilling and Training: Definieren Sie den Goldstandard für Marktforschung innerhalb der EI. Sie entwerfen und liefern einen umfassenden Lehrplan, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Fähigkeiten branchenführend und zukunftssicher bleiben - Strategischer Anbieter und Compliance-Übersicht Contattoo (Non fornito)
descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous sommes Roche, engagés à faire avancer la science afin que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Notre équipe de Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) est le cœur de Pharma, fixant le rythme de Pharma — façonnant l'orientation stratégique de Roche, assurant notre portefeuille offre une innovation significative aux patients du monde entier. En intégrant les connaissances scientifiques, commerciales et commerciales, le GPS stimule la stratégie à l'échelle de l'entreprise, la priorisation des portefeuilles et l'innovation de modèles d'affaires pour faire progresser Roches dans le paysage des soins de santé en évolution. Dans le cadre de l'équipe Portefeuille, Stratégie et Perspectives (PSI) au sein du GPS, vous servirez de partenaire de réflexion stratégique et de conseiller de confiance, guidant Roches produit, domaine de la maladie, pharmaceutique et stratégie d'entreprise. L'équipe de l'ISP, composée de Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, et Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, fournit des informations cohérentes, ciblées et axées sur la technologie qui stimulent la prise de décisions de qualité dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise, fournissant des renseignements impartiaux et spécialisés pour éclairer la gestion du cycle de vie, l'excellence en matière de commercialisation et les stratégies de portefeuille. L'équipe de Global Ecosystem Insights (EI) est à la recherche d'un chef de file de l'Espace Thérapeutique (TA) pour se joindre à nous pour façonner la stratégie Pharma de Roche par le biais de perspectives axées sur le marché, le portefeuille et la clientèle. Ce rôle joue le rôle de consultant et de stratège interne, en partenariat avec des leaders commerciaux et interfonctionnels pour générer des idées qui couvrent les domaines thérapeutiques et façonner les décisions interportfolio. L'opportunité Au-delà de l'AT Market Insights Leader est chargé de rendre opérationnelles les méthodes de pointe de l'industrie dans les études de marché primaires et secondaires pour guider les décisions stratégiques. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez des projets innovateurs et des flux de travail qui sont les pionniers de nouvelles méthodologies, appliqueront de nouvelles technologies et créeront des analyses qui façonneront le développement et la stratégie commerciale. Vous travaillerez en partenariat avec les équipes de l'IE et d'autres PSI pour stimuler l'engagement, intégrer des améliorations et réaliser la pleine valeur des solutions développées. Vous naviguerez sur une matrice mondiale complexe pour aligner les partenaires interfonctionnels autour de produits livrables à impact élevé et axés sur les idées. Vous ferez rapport à l'IE au-delà du chef habilitant de l'AT. Mansioni - Insights excellence: Accroître la qualité et l'impact des produits livrables de l'AE en faisant progresser les pratiques de recherche dans les sources primaires et secondaires.
