jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are Roche, committed to advancing science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

Our Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) team is the heartbeat of Pharma, setting the rhythm for Pharma — shaping Roche’s strategic direction, ensuring our portfolio delivers meaningful innovation to patients worldwide. By integrating scientific, commercial, and market insights, GPS drives enterprise-wide strategy, portfolio prioritization, and business model innovation to advance Roche’s leadership in the evolving healthcare landscape.

As part of the Portfolio, Strategy, and Insights (PSI) team within GPS, you will serve as a strategic thought partner and trusted advisor, guiding Roche’s product, disease area, pharma, and corporate strategy. The PSI team, composed of Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, and Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, delivers consistent, targeted, and technology-enabled insights that drive quality decision-making across the enterprise, providing unbiased, expertly curated intelligence to inform lifecycle management, commercialization excellence, and portfolio strategies.

The Global Ecosystem Insights (EI) team is looking for a Beyond Therapeutic Area (TA) Insights Product Enablement Leader to join us in shaping Roche's Pharma strategy through market, portfolio and customer-centric insights. This role functions as an internal consultant and strategist, partnering with commercial and cross-functional leaders to generate insights that span Therapeutic Areas and shape cross-portfolio decisions.

The Opportunity

The Beyond TA Insights Product Enablement Leader is responsible for harnessing next-gen AI and digital solutions in Primary Market Research, secondary data sources, and forecasting to deliver superior quality insights with increased speed and cost-efficiency. In this role, you will lead innovative projects and workstreams that pioneer new methodologies, apply new technologies and create analyses that shape development and commercial strategy. You will partner extensively within EI and other PSI teams including ABBI to drive engagement, embed enhancements, and realize the full value of solutions developed. You will navigate a complex global matrix to align cross-functional partners around high-impact, insight-driven deliverables. You will report to the EI Beyond TA Enabling Leader.

Focus areas and responsibilities

• AI capability building: Establish the framework for integrating Artificial Intelligence and advanced analytics into the core of Primary Market Research, secondary insights, and forecasting. You will put in place tech-augmented approaches that unlock insights and create a distinct competitive advantage for our TAs

• Process optimization: Streamline insights workflows through technology solutions. You will enable the team to pivot from data analysis to strategic advisory, ensuring focus on the highest-value business challenges

• Solution integration: Identify, pilot, deploy, and manage a suite of internal and external technology solutions. You will partner with AABI to curate the Ecosystem Tool Stack, including GenAI and synthesis platforms, to deliver high quality insights faster and more cost-effectively

• Workflow: Drive the successful adoption of new technologies by bridging the gap between technical capabilities and daily research workflows. You will ensure that AI and digital tools are not just deployed, but deeply integrat

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Siamo Roche, impegnati a promuovere la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Il nostro team Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) è il battito cardiaco di Pharma, impostando il ritmo per Pharma - modellando la direzione strategica di Roche, assicurando che il nostro portafoglio offre innovazione significativa ai pazienti in tutto il mondo. Integrando intuizioni scientifiche, commerciali e di mercato, il GPS guida la strategia aziendale, la priorità del portafoglio e l’innovazione del modello di business per far progredire la leadership di Roche nel panorama sanitario in evoluzione. Nell'ambito del team Portfolio, Strategy e Insights (PSI) all'interno del GPS, servirai come partner di pensiero strategico e consulente di fiducia, guidando il prodotto di Roche, l'area malattia, la farmaco e la strategia aziendale. Il team PSI, composto da Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, and Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, offre intuizioni coerenti, mirate e tecnologicamente abilitate che guidano il processo decisionale di qualità in tutta l'azienda, fornendo informazioni imparziali e curate per informare la gestione del ciclo di vita, l'eccellenza della commercializzazione e le strategie di portafoglio. Il team Global Ecosystem Insights (EI) sta cercando un Beyond Therapeutic Area (TA) Insights Product Enablement Leader per unirsi a noi nella definizione della strategia di Roche Pharma attraverso il mercato, il portafoglio e le intuizioni customer-centric. Questo ruolo funziona come consulente interno e stratega, collaborando con leader commerciali e cross-funzionali per generare intuizioni che abbracciano Aree terapeutiche e modellano le decisioni cross-portfolio. L'opportunità The Beyond TA Insights Product Enablement Leader è responsabile dell'imbragatura di soluzioni AI e digitali di prossima generazione in Primary Market Research, fonti di dati secondarie e della previsione per fornire informazioni di qualità superiori con maggiore velocità e efficienza dei costi. In questo ruolo, guiderai progetti innovativi e flussi di lavoro che pionierizzano nuove metodologie, applichino nuove tecnologie e creeranno analisi che modellano lo sviluppo e la strategia commerciale. Potrai collaborare ampiamente all'interno di EI e altri team PSI, tra cui ABBI per guidare il coinvolgimento, incorporare miglioramenti, e realizzare il pieno valore delle soluzioni sviluppate. Potrai navigare in una matrice globale complessa per allineare i partner interfunzionali intorno ai prodotti ad alto impatto e orientati agli insight. Ti riferirai all'EI Beyond TA Eable Leader. Aree di messa a fuoco e responsabilità
• Realizzazione delle capacità di AI: Stabilire il quadro per integrare l'Intelligenza Artificiale e l'analisi avanzata nel nucleo della Ricerca di Mercato Primario, intuizioni secondarie e previsioni. Si metterà in atto approcci tecno-agmentati che sbloccano intuizioni e creano un vantaggio competitivo distinta per i nostri TA
• Ottimizzazione dei processi: semplifica i flussi di lavoro attraverso soluzioni tecnologiche. Permetterai al team di ruotare dall'analisi dei dati alla consulenza strategica, garantendo attenzione alle sfide aziendali di maggior valore
• Integrazione della soluzione: Identificare, pilotare, distribuire e gestire una suite di soluzioni tecnologiche interne ed esterne. Potrai collaborare con AABI per curare l'Ecosystem Tool Stack, tra cui GenAI e piattaforme di sintesi, per fornire informazioni di alta qualità più veloce e più conveniente
• Flusso di lavoro: guidare l'adozione di nuove tecnologie, colmare il divario tra capacità tecniche e flussi di lavoro di ricerca giornalieri. Ti assicurerai che l'IA e gli strumenti digitali non siano solo implementati, ma profondamente integrati

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Wir sind Roche, verpflichtet, die Wissenschaft voranzubringen, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Unser Team von Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) ist das Herzstück von Pharma, das den Rhythmus für Pharma festlegt – die strategische Ausrichtung von Roche zu prägen und sicherzustellen, dass unser Portfolio weltweit sinnvolle Innovationen für Patienten liefert. Durch die Integration von wissenschaftlichen, kommerziellen und Markteinblicken treibt GPS unternehmensweite Strategie, Portfoliopriorisierung und Unternehmensmodellinnovation an, um Roches Führung in der sich entwickelnden Gesundheitslandschaft voranzubringen. Im Rahmen des Portfolio-, Strategie- und Insights (PSI)-Teams im GPS-Bereich werden Sie als strategischer Denkpartner und vertrauenswürdiger Berater tätig sein, der das Produkt, den Krankheitsbereich, die Pharma- und die Unternehmensstrategie von Roche leitet. Das PSI-Team, bestehend aus Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads und Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, bietet konsistente, gezielte und technologiefähige Erkenntnisse, die die Qualitätsentscheidungsfindung im gesamten Unternehmen vorantreiben und unvoreingenommene, fachkundig kuratierte Intelligenz bereitstellen, um Lifecycle Management, Commercialization Excellence und Portfoliostrategien zu informieren. Das Global Ecosystem Insights (EI)-Team sucht nach einem Beyond Therapeutic Area (TA) Insights Product Enablement Leader, um uns bei der Gestaltung der Pharma-Strategie von Roche durch Markt-, Portfolio- und kundenzentrierte Erkenntnisse zu unterstützen. Diese Rolle fungiert als interner Berater und Stratege und arbeitet mit kommerziellen und funktionsübergreifenden Führungskräften zusammen, um Erkenntnisse zu generieren, die sich auf Therapeutische Bereiche erstrecken und Cross-Portfolio-Entscheidungen formen. Die Chance Der Beyond TA Insights Product Enablement Leader ist verantwortlich für die Nutzung von Next-Gen AI und digitalen Lösungen in Primärmarktforschung, Sekundärdatenquellen und Prognosen, um qualitativ hochwertige Erkenntnisse mit erhöhter Geschwindigkeit und Kosteneffizienz zu liefern. In dieser Rolle werden Sie innovative Projekte und Workstreams leiten, die neue Methoden wegweisen, neue Technologien anwenden und Analysen erstellen, die Entwicklung und kommerzielle Strategie prägen. Sie werden in EI und anderen PSI-Teams, einschließlich ABBI, umfassend zusammenarbeiten, um Engagement, Embed-Erweiterungen zu treiben und den vollen Wert der entwickelten Lösungen zu realisieren. Sie navigieren eine komplexe globale Matrix, um funktionsübergreifende Partner rund um wirkungsstarke, einsichtsorientierte Lieferungen auszurichten. Sie werden dem EI Beyond TA Enabling Leader melden. Schwerpunkte und Zuständigkeiten
• KI-Fähigkeitsaufbau: Aufbau des Rahmens für die Integration von Künstlicher Intelligenz und fortgeschrittener Analytik in den Kern der Primärmarktforschung, sekundäre Erkenntnisse und Prognosen. Sie werden tech-augmented Ansätze setzen, die Einblicke freischalten und einen deutlichen Wettbewerbsvorteil für unsere TAs schaffen
• Prozessoptimierung: Optimieren Sie Einblicke in Workflows durch Technologielösungen. Sie werden es dem Team ermöglichen, von der Datenanalyse bis zur strategischen Beratung zu schwenken und den Fokus auf die höchsten geschäftlichen Herausforderungen zu stellen
• Lösungsintegration: Identifikation, Pilot, Bereitstellung und Verwaltung einer Suite von internen und externen Technologielösungen. Sie werden mit AABI zusammenarbeiten, um den Ecosystem Tool Stack, einschließlich GenAI und Syntheseplattformen, zu kuratieren, um qualitativ hochwertige Erkenntnisse schneller und kostengünstiger zu liefern
• Workflow: Führen Sie die erfolgreiche Einführung neuer Technologien durch Überbrückung der Lücke zwischen technischen Fähigkeiten und täglichen Forschungsabläufen. Sie werden sicherstellen, dass KI- und digitale Werkzeuge nicht nur eingesetzt werden, sondern tief integriert werden

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous sommes Roche, engagés à faire avancer la science afin que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Notre équipe de Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) est le cœur de Pharma, fixant le rythme de Pharma — façonnant l'orientation stratégique de Roche, assurant notre portefeuille offre une innovation significative aux patients du monde entier. En intégrant les connaissances scientifiques, commerciales et commerciales, le GPS stimule la stratégie à l'échelle de l'entreprise, la priorisation des portefeuilles et l'innovation de modèles d'affaires pour faire progresser Roches dans le paysage des soins de santé en évolution. Dans le cadre de l'équipe Portefeuille, Stratégie et Perspectives (PSI) au sein du GPS, vous servirez de partenaire de réflexion stratégique et de conseiller de confiance, guidant Roches produit, domaine de la maladie, pharmaceutique et stratégie d'entreprise. L'équipe de l'ISP, composée de Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, et Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, fournit des informations cohérentes, ciblées et axées sur la technologie qui stimulent la prise de décisions de qualité dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise, fournissant des renseignements impartiaux et spécialisés pour éclairer la gestion du cycle de vie, l'excellence en matière de commercialisation et les stratégies de portefeuille. L'équipe de Global Ecosystem Insights (EI) est à la recherche d'un chef de file en habilitation de produits Beyond Therapeutical Area (TA) Insights pour se joindre à nous dans l'élaboration de la stratégie Pharma de Roche par le biais de perspectives de marché, de portefeuille et de clients. Ce rôle joue le rôle de consultant et de stratège interne, en partenariat avec des leaders commerciaux et interfonctionnels pour générer des idées qui couvrent les domaines thérapeutiques et façonner les décisions interportfolio. L'opportunité Le responsable de l'activation des produits Beyond TA Insights est chargé d'exploiter les solutions numériques et d'IA next-gen dans les études de marché primaires, les sources de données secondaires et les prévisions afin de fournir des informations de qualité supérieures avec une rapidité et une rentabilité accrues. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez des projets innovateurs et des flux de travail qui sont les pionniers de nouvelles méthodologies, appliqueront de nouvelles technologies et créeront des analyses qui façonneront le développement et la stratégie commerciale. Vous travaillerez en partenariat avec d'autres équipes de l'IE et d'autres PSI, dont ABBI, pour stimuler l'engagement, intégrer des améliorations et réaliser la pleine valeur des solutions développées. Vous naviguerez sur une matrice mondiale complexe pour aligner les partenaires interfonctionnels autour de produits livrables à impact élevé et axés sur les idées. Vous ferez rapport à l'IE au-delà du chef habilitant de l'AT. Domaines d ' intervention et responsabilités
• Renforcement des capacités en matière d'IA : établir le cadre d'intégration de l'intelligence artificielle et de l'analyse avancée au cœur de la recherche de marché primaire, des connaissances secondaires et des prévisions. Vous mettrez en place des approches tech-augmentées qui libèrent les idées et créent un avantage concurrentiel distinct pour nos AT
• Optimisation des processus : Rationaliser les flux de connaissances grâce à des solutions technologiques. Vous permettrez à l'équipe de pivoter de l'analyse de données à l'avis stratégique, en veillant à se concentrer sur les défis commerciaux de la plus haute valeur
• Intégration des solutions: Identifier, piloter, déployer et gérer une série de solutions technologiques internes et externes. Vous travaillerez en partenariat avec AABI pour la mise en place de l'Ecosystem Tool Stack, y compris les plateformes GenAI et de synthèse, afin de fournir des informations de haute qualité plus rapidement et de manière plus rentable.
• Flux de travail: Conduire l'adoption réussie de nouvelles technologies en comblant l'écart entre les capacités techniques et les flux de recherche quotidiens. Vous vous assurerez que l'IA et les outils numériques ne sont pas simplement déployés, mais profondément intégrés

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Global Supply Chain and Product Strategy Organization (PTS) seamlessly connects markets to the global manufacturing network by managing inventory, supply, and replenishment planning. We orchestrate the value streams between sites and affiliates by balancing demand and supply, and ensure right-first-time order fulfillment and delivery of medicines across the global network. In addition, we are also accountable for product strategies, leading in the design of products and supply chains in line with go-to-market strategies and ensuring the health of our products.
We are an agile organization with clear accountabilities and a purpose-driven culture that is built on trust and collaboration, where people are inspired to co-create solutions and develop the capabilities required to deliver our mission.
The Supply Chain Insights and Performance organization within PTS is established to drive enterprise-wide orchestration, benchmark best practices, and accelerate performance optimization across our end-to-end value streams. Operating as a core pillar within this department, the Supply Chain Excellence team focuses on embedding a permanent culture of continuous improvement, data-driven decision-making, and organizational capability building.

The Opportunity
As a Supply Chain Excellence Lead, you will report directly to the Head of Supply Chain Excellence. In this role, you will act as a key change agent, identifying operational challenges and deploying sustainable, high-impact improvements across the global supply chain.

Your specific accountabilities include:

• Spearheading continuous improvement initiatives and driving operational efficiency across end-to-end supply chain processes using Lean and Six Sigma methodologies.

• Fostering a culture of continuous improvement and learning while orchestrating operational excellence capability building across the supply chain.

• Identifying and prioritizing improvement opportunities, leading business performance initiatives using the DMAIC framework, and embedding those improvements cleanly into supply chain processes and systems.

• Developing and implementing supply chain KPIs to measure and control performance across various reporting levels, defining clear accountability in collaboration with Business Capability Owners.

• Utilizing end-to-end system thinking to capture, integrate, and analyze data for process and performance optimization.

• Continuously assessing and interpreting internal and external variables impacting supply chain performance, identifying and deploying appropriate systems and technologies to achieve goals.

• Developing and implementing business rules, procedures, and policies to ensure consistent operational performance and proactively managing risks.

• Defining and sustaining resiliency measures to maintain high service levels and anticipating, mitigating, and monitoring supply chain risks.

• Definire e sostenere misure di resilienza per mantenere alti livelli di servizio e anticipare, mitigare e monitorare i rischi della supply chain. Sei abile nel bilanciare le priorità funzionali concorrenti di vari stakeholder per identificare un percorso di azione che serve al meglio i processi della supply chain end-to-end. Sei esperto nella navigazione di ambienti di matrice interculturale, nella negoziazione e nell'influenza dei risultati, e nell'escelling in interazioni faccia a faccia e virtuali. Sei un esperto nella creazione di forti relazioni collaborative, nell'affrontare e risolvere i conflitti

In addition, we are also accountable for product strategies, leading in the design of products and supply chains in line with go-to-market strategies and ensuring the health of our products. We are an agile organization with clear accountabilities and a purpose-driven culture that is built on trust and collaboration, where people are inspired to co-create solutions and develop the capabilities required to deliver our mission. Operating as a core pillar within this department, the Supply Chain Excellence team focuses on embedding a permanent culture of continuous improvement, data-driven decision-making, and organizational capability building. In this role, you will act as a key change agent, identifying operational challenges and deploying sustainable, high-impact improvements across the global supply chain. Your specific accountabilities include:
• Spearheading continuous improvement initiatives and driving operational efficiency across end-to-end supply chain processes using Lean and Six Sigma methodologies.
• Fostering a culture of continuous improvement and learning while orchestrating operational excellence capability building across the supply chain.

titleByLocale.it: Engagement Marketing Manager - Oncologia e Nefrologia

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Engagement Marketing Manager – Oncology & Nephrology
Roche Nederland B.V. – Woerden

Ben jij op zoek naar een nieuwe uitdaging op het vlak van omnichannel marketing in een leuk team van marketing & digital professionals? Ben jij een expert in marketingexecutie die energie krijgt van het vertalen van strategie naar tastbare impact? Bij Roche Nederland werk je in een agile omgeving aan onze missie: de beste zorg voor de patiënt in Nederland.

Functieomschrijving
Als Engagement Marketing Manager maak je deel uit van het Marketing & Digital Team en ben je de regisseur van onze marketingplannen. Je slaat de brug tussen strategie en uitvoering voor de teams Oncologie en Nefrologie & Reumatologie. Door slimme omnichannel-campagnes (zowel fysiek als digitaal) te lanceren en de impact daarvan direct te meten, optimaliseer je de klantervaring. Jouw doel? Met een mix van creativiteit en een resultaatgerichte mindset zet jij je in voor de beste zorgoplossingen voor de patiënt, de zorgverlener en Roche.

Wat ga je doen?

• Omnichannel Orchestratie : Je ontwerpt en optimaliseert de klanten-touchpoint-journey, waarbij je persoonlijke en niet-persoonlijke interacties integreert om onze klanten te overtuigen van de waarde van onze geneesmiddelen voor oncologie en nefrologie en reumatologie.

• Tactische Executie: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de volledige 'pull-through' van het omnichannel marketingplan, inclusief de ontwikkeling van gepersonaliseerde content op basis van diepe klantinzichten.

• Content & Campaign Management : In afstemming met ons digital team creëer je impactvolle content die aansluit bij de klanten touchpoint-journey, waarbij je zorgt voor een snelle en compliant marktintroductie via o.a. Veeva PromoMats, rekening houdend met CGR.

• Impactmeting & Optimalisatie: Je kiest en monitort KPI’s en analyseert de effectiviteit van campagnes om datagedreven beslissingen te nemen en lopende tactieken continu te verbeteren.

• Cross-functionele samenwerking: Je werkt nauw samen met collega's van onder andere Medical, Access en Customer Engagement om ervoor te zorgen dat tactieken naadloos aansluiten op de behoeften in het regionale ecosysteem.

• Financieel Beheer: Je draagt bij aan het beheer van het marketingbudget en waarborgt een sterke financiële verantwoording van de uitgevoerde initiatieven.

Wat breng je mee?

• Ervaring: Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in digital/non-digital marketing binnen de farmaceutische industrie. Ervaring in een fieldfunctie is een plus.

• Omnichannel Expertise : Een diepgaande kennis van het executeren van omnichannel campagnes, meten van impact en het vertalen van strategie naar implementatie van taktieken.

• Data-gedrevenheid: Bewezen kennis en kunde in het faciliteren en nemen van beslissingen op basis van data en inzichten op tactisch en uitvoerend niveau.

• Technische & Analytische vaardigheden: Geavanceerde kennis van CRM-systemen (zoals Veeva/Salesforce), marketing automation, digitale tools en AI-oplossingen voor marketing.

• Mindset: Je hebt een passie voor digitale en persoonlijke interactie met onze klanten, een ondernemende 'can-do' mentaliteit, plezier in executie, een sterke focus op de klantervaring en het meten van impact plus het vermogen om te gedijen in een dynamische, agile- cross functionele omgeving.

• Opleiding & Taal: Een afgeronde HBO- of universitaire opleiding (bijv. Business of Science) en uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels bij het schrijven van teksten.

Waarom Roche?
Bij Roche maak je deel

jobs.title: Customer Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description
Customer Partner

Role Purpose
As the Customer Partner, you will be responsible for growing the market share and achieving sales goals for the assigned territory. You will be responsible for executing the sales process, ensure operation effectiveness and efficiency, with proficient interpersonal and communication skills, and providing effective solutions to establish and maintain relationships that result in customer satisfaction, retention and acquisition.

You demonstrate personal purpose around improving the healthcare ecosystem thinking from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, to bring the best possible outcomes to the health environment; creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, and by bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities.

In this role, you will
Account Management

• Responsible in solution/technical/consultative selling.

• Leads sales process including prospecting, qualification, quantification, needs assessment, competitive differentiation, presentation, closing, contracting and implementation and ensuring after sales support is maintained and of the highest standard.

• Build long-term value-based relationships through continuously uncovering customers’ changing needs, improving customer experience, anticipating new opportunities for their business in the future and adding values through creative solutions / products

• Build credibility with customers and other stakeholders at different levels through demonstrating business acumen and professional expertise, confidence and effective communication.

• Develop and build strategic engagement and partnering with KOLs and relevant stakeholders in key accounts. Be a partner/consultant in shaping their plans, decisions and supporting their professional objectives to achieve RDMY business strategy and goals.

• Understand the customers’ working / communication styles and flex one’s style to adapt to that.

• Identify and develop business opportunities within the area of responsibility and collaborate across teams to ensure attainment.

• Implement a sales management process to assist the team in identifying and prioritizing customers and prospects.

• Responsible for developing and leading implementation of annual territorial plans with the goal of achieving sales objectives and future growth.

• Identify new accounts in line with the marketing strategy.

• Retain, extend and acquire customers and accounts through effective identification of opportunities and the creation and implementation of solutions.

• Responsible for profiling accounts, placing RDMY in the strongest position to win tenders and new accounts.

• Update Accounts and contacts in Salesforce regularly to ensure accuracy of data

• Ensure Salesforce activities, business opportunities are entered in REXIS on a weekly basis.

• Monitor all Opportunities to ensure they are up to date.

• Able to conduct Basic troubleshooting.

• Proficient in Global Deal Calculator (GDC) in preparing sales proposal.

• Participation in relevant marketing events/exhibition/trade.

• Responsible for arranging and conducting relevant training or presentation sessions for customers.

Product Knowledge

• Strong knowledge of assigned product portfolio to manage sales process, involving cross function team’s expertise, as needed

• Promote co-positioning of cross-BA products, where applicable, with the objective to maximize RDMY total revenues and profitability

Teamwork

•

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and life-changing medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CS CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organization leads the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems by integrating digital technologies across Research and Early Development to empower stakeholders, advance data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

The Solutions team within the DDC Organization develops modernized and interconnected computational and data ecosystems. The Data Ecosystem is foundational to building solutions that accelerate the work done by our Computational and Bench Scientists and enable ML/AI tool creation and adoption. Our team specializes in building Data Pipelines and Applications for data acquisition, collection, storage, transformation, linkage and sharing.

Join our Data and Digital Catalyst team as a Software Engineer, where you will develop the modernized and interconnected computational and data ecosystems that are foundational to our research. You'll build robust and scalable systems that unlock the potential of our diverse scientific data, directly accelerating the discovery and development of life-changing treatments for patients. This is a unique opportunity to empower our scientists and advance data-driven science through innovative technology.

The Opportunity

• Build and enhance a modern, scalable ecosystem of applications and tools to capture, move, and prepare scientific data for analysis.

• Design and deliver complex, user-friendly data applications and pipelines that integrate diverse data sets across key scientific domains.

• Leverage standard patterns like microservices and event-driven architecture to improve our data workflows and application ecosystem.

• Champion technical excellence by ensuring our solutions are innovative, best-in-class, and seamlessly integrated.

• Integrate diverse data sets to power Artificial Intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and Natural Language Search capabilities.

• Collaborate directly with computational and research scientists to understand their challenges and translate them into effective technology solutions.

• Provide technical leadership on ongoing initiatives and identify new opportunities to build common, reusable solutions.

• Mentor junior developers, fostering their professional growth and upholding high engineering standards.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. I progressi in AI, i dati e le scienze computazionali stanno trasformando la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Le organizzazioni di ricerca e sviluppo precoce di Roche a Genentech (gRED) e Pharma (pRED) hanno dimostrato come queste tecnologie accelerano la R&D, sfruttando i dati e i nuovi modelli computazionali per guidare l'impatto. La condivisione e l'accesso dei dati senza cuciture ai modelli in GRED e pRED sono essenziali per massimizzare queste opportunità. Il Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza (CS CoE) è un gruppo strategico e unificato il cui obiettivo è quello di sfruttare il potere trasformativo dei dati e dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) per aiutare i nostri scienziati sia in pRED che in GRED a fornire farmaci più innovativi e mutevoli per la vita per i pazienti in tutto il mondo. All'interno dell'organizzazione CS CoE, l'organizzazione Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) conduce l'ammodernamento dei nostri ecosistemi computazionali e dati integrando le tecnologie digitali attraverso la ricerca e lo sviluppo precoce per potenziare gli stakeholder, promuovere la scienza dei dati e accelerare il processo decisionale. Il team Solutions all'interno dell'Organizzazione DDC sviluppa ecosistemi computazionali e dati modernizzati e interconnessi. Il Data Ecosystem è fondamentale per costruire soluzioni che accelerano il lavoro svolto dai nostri scienziati Computazionali e Bench e consentono la creazione e l'adozione di strumenti ML/AI. Il nostro team è specializzato nella costruzione di Data Pipelines e Applicazioni per l'acquisizione, la raccolta, lo stoccaggio, la trasformazione, il collegamento e la condivisione dei dati. Unisciti al nostro team Data e Digital Catalyst come Software Engineer, dove svilupperai gli ecosistemi computazionali e dati modernizzati e interconnessi che sono fondamentali per la nostra ricerca. Costruirete sistemi robusti e scalabili che sbloccano il potenziale dei nostri diversi dati scientifici, accelerando direttamente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di trattamenti per il cambiamento della vita per i pazienti. Questa è un'opportunità unica per potenziare i nostri scienziati e promuovere la scienza dei dati attraverso la tecnologia innovativa. L'opportunità
• Costruire e migliorare un ecosistema moderno e scalabile di applicazioni e strumenti per catturare, spostare e preparare i dati scientifici per l'analisi.
• Progettare e fornire applicazioni e tubazioni di dati complesse e facili da usare che integrano diversi set di dati in ambiti scientifici chiave.
• Levare modelli standard come microservizi e architettura orientata agli eventi per migliorare i nostri flussi di lavoro dati e l'ecosistema delle applicazioni.
• Campione di eccellenza tecnica assicurando che le nostre soluzioni siano innovative, di classe migliore e perfettamente integrate.
• Integrare diversi set di dati per alimentare l'intelligenza artificiale (AI), l'apprendimento automatico (ML), e le capacità di ricerca della lingua naturale.
• Collaborare direttamente con gli scienziati computazionali e di ricerca per comprendere le loro sfide e tradurli in soluzioni tecnologiche efficaci.
• Fornire leadership tecnica sulle iniziative in corso e identificare nuove opportunità per costruire soluzioni comuni e riutilizzabili.
• Mentor junior sviluppatori, promuovendo la loro crescita professionale e mantenendo elevati standard di ingegneria. Vous allez construire des systèmes robustes et évolutives qui libèrent le potentiel de nos diverses données scientifiques, accélérant directement la découverte et le développement de traitements qui changent la vie des patients. • Tirer parti des modèles standard comme les microservices et l'architecture événementielle pour améliorer nos flux de données et l'écosystème d'application.
• Championne l'excellence technique en s'assurant que nos solutions sont innovantes, de qualité supérieure et parfaitement intégrées.

• Fournir un leadership technique sur les initiatives en cours et identifier de nouvelles possibilités d'élaborer des solutions communes et réutilisables.

jobs.title: Information Security Governance Expert
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As an Expert within the Information Security & Privacy Advisory (ISPA) team, you move beyond "checking boxes" to become a strategic partner for global Engineering hubs. You will lead high-impact security and privacy risk assessments, ensuring Roche’s most ambitious digital projects—from GenAI to cloud-native platforms—are resilient, "Secure by Design," and compliant with global regulations.

The Team
The Information Security & Privacy Advisory (ISPA) team serves as the strategic bridge between IT, business, and legal functions at Roche. Our mission is to ensure that Roche’s digital landscape—from cutting-edge GenAI platforms to global enterprise solutions—is secure by design and compliant with international standards. We act as a global center of excellence that translates complex regulatory requirements into actionable security architecture, providing the expert guidance necessary to navigate a rapidly evolving global risk landscape.

Key Responsibilities

• High-Risk Advisory: Lead Security Expert Reviews (SER) for complex architectures, performing deep-dive technical and privacy evaluations to identify and mitigate residual risks.

• Privacy: Bridge the gap between IT, Legal, and Data Protection Officers. Translate complex legal mandates (GDPR, CCPA etc.) into actionable technical and organizational controls.

• Information Security: Contribute to Security Design Patterns and Technical Baselines for emerging technologies like Generative AI and Cloud-native ecosystems.

• Risk Governance: Utilize ServiceNow IRM to ensure the integrity and traceability of security advisory, delivering data-driven, consistent, and audit-ready results.

• Peer Excellence: Foster a "Four-Eye" quality culture through peer reviews and collective knowledge exchange within a global team of experts.

Who You Are

Our Ideal Mindset: A proactive Expert & Influencer who brings deep industry experience to an established team. You have the confidence to lead initiatives independently while thriving in an environment of collective knowledge exchange.

Qualifications:

• Experience: 5–10 years in Information Security/GRC, with a proven track record in Information Risk Assessments and DPIAs in complex, global environments.

• Technical Savvy: Deep understanding of Security Architecture and the ability to translate "Legal-speak" into "Engineering-speak."

• Regulatory Mastery: Expert knowledge of international privacy frameworks (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, etc.) and security standards (ISO 27001, NIST).

• System Proficiency: Experienced in using ServiceNow IRM to execute and document risk assessments, utilizing the platform to ensure consistent, high-quality, and transparent security guidance.

• Education: Degree in Computer Science or Legal. Certifications like CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CIPP/E, CIPM or ISO27001 Lead Auditor are highly valued.

• C ommunication: Exceptional stakeholder management skills with the ability to drive consensus across a global organization.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthca

jobs.title: Procurement Manager – Research & Lab Materials
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Procurement Manager – Research & Lab Materials
Roche India - Roche Services & Solutions
Hyderabad

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity
This role sits within the Materials, Manufacturing & CAPEX Procurement Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. The Materials, Manufacturing & CAPEX Procurement Delivery group comprises many communities grouping categories of the same value chain or having commonality, including Raw Materials, External Manufacturing Services, Logistics, Research & Laboratory Materials, and Engineering (CAPEX).

Within Research & Laboratory Materials, we cover two categories:

• Lab Chemicals & Consumables (LCC)

• Lab Equipment & Maintenance (LEM)

This structure enables strong category expertise while allowing flexibility in the procurement delivery response to the evolving needs of our customers.

As a Procurement Manager, you will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Using your specialized knowledge and in-depth expertise in project management and procurement overall, you will proactively identify and drive strategies and approaches for managing and sourcing third-party spend requirements. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Bei Roche arbeiten 94’000 Mitarbeitende in 100 Ländern daran, den Begriff Healthcare neu zu definieren. Am Standort Basel Drug Substance Manufacturing der F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG bekommen Sie einen einzigartigen Einblick in die Produktion von chemischen und biologischen aktiven pharmazeutischen Wirkstoffen für die kommerzielle und klinische Versorgung. Unser Standort besteht aus drei Produktionseinheiten (sogenannten Value Streams) und fünf unterstützenden Einheiten (sogenannten Units), in denen sich insgesamt 650 Mitarbeitende darauf fokussieren, Patienten mit Medikamenten zu versorgen.

Die Möglichkeit

Am Standort Basel Drug Substance produzieren wir in drei Value Streams (Monoclonal Antibody (MAB), Antibody Drug Conjugate (ADC) und Single Use Technology (SUT). Die drei Value Streams werden von fünf Units plus Quality unterstützt (Process & Technology, Material Science & Support, Materials Management, Facilities Management & SHE, Business Operations, Quality).

An unserem Standort in Basel bieten wir im Bereich Master Data Excellence & Materials Management eine spannende Praktikumsmöglichkeit an. Auf dich warten abwechslungsreiche wie anspruchsvolle Aufgaben in einem biologischen Produktionsumfeld.

Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

• Unterstützung der produzierenden Betriebe im Supply Chain Management

• Mitarbeit in den Abteilungen Master Data, Planning, Launch & Transfer Management, Logistics, und Compliance Team

• Selbstständige Begleitung und Umsetzung von Verbesserungen mittels Lean Management Methoden

• Technische und inhaltliche Weiterentwicklung der bestehenden Performance Boards zur Performance-Steuerung

• Prozessdokumentation und -mapping

• Aktive Unterstützung des Leitungsteams

• Organisation von Workshops

• Analyse von Prozessen, Kennzahlen und betrieblichen Schwachstellen sowie Einleitung von Verbesserungsmaßnahmen

• Anpassung, Optimierung und Pflege von Kennzahlensystemen und entsprechender Visualisierung sowie Erstellung von Workflows

• Allgemeine administrative Unterstützung des Teams

• Unterstützung bei Datenanalysen, Datenaufbereitung sowie deren Visualisierungen

Wer Du Bist

• Du bist aktuell an einer Universität immatrikuliert oder hast innerhalb von 12 Monaten vor Praktikumsbeginn dein Masterstudium abgeschlossen.

• Sehr gute Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse

• Sehr Gute Google Workspace und gute MS Office Kenntnisse

• Gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit AI-Tools wie Gemini und Chat GPT

• Teamfähigkeit, Flexibilität und Entscheidungsfreudigkeit

• SAP bzw. SAP S/4HANA Kenntnisse sind ein Plus

• Bereitschaft und Motivation, sich schnell in potenziell neue Systeme und Themenfelder einzuarbeiten

Zusätzliche Information

• Der Standort ist Basel.

• Bevorzugter Start des Praktikums zum 01. Juli diesen Jahres, oder nach Vereinbarung, mit einer Praktikumsdauer von 12 Monaten. Das Praktikum ist in Vollzeit (40 Stunden pro Woche) und Teilzeit (32 Stunden pro Woche) möglich.

• Dieses Praktikum ist nicht für eine Masterarbeit geeignet.

• Nicht-EU/EFTA Bürger (m/w/n) müssen eine Bestätigung der Universität, dass ein Pflichtpraktikum Teil der Ausbildung ist, den Bewerbungsunterlagen beilegen.

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören. Bewirb dich jetzt, um diese spannende Möglichkeit zu entdecken!

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for gener

jobs.title: Software Engineer / Senior Software Engineer

titleByLocale.it: Ingegnere di software / Ingegnere di software senior

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and life-changing medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CS CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organization leads the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems by integrating digital technologies across Research and Early Development to empower stakeholders, advance data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

The Solutions team within DDC Organization develops modernized and interconnected computational and data ecosystems. The Data Ecosystem is foundational to building solutions that accelerate the work done by our Computational and Bench Scientists and enable ML/AI tool creation and adoption. Our team specializes in building Data Pipelines and Applications for data acquisition, collection, storage, transformation, linkage and sharing.

As a Software Engineer on our Solutions Engineering team, you will build robust, scalable, and reusable capabilities for our shared data platform. You will work closely with Data Engineers, Product Leaders, and scientific partners to design and implement systems that unlock the potential of our diverse scientific data. Your work will directly contribute to accelerating the discovery and development of life-changing treatments for patients by building the modern ecosystem that captures, moves, and prepares scientific data for analysis.

The Opportunity

• Ensure technical excellence by delivering innovative, best-in-class data flows and pipelines across key scientific domains.

• Promote the adoption of key trends and technologies by applying an Open Source, Cloud First, API First, and AI First approach to problem-solving.

• Improve our data workflows and application architecture by leveraging standard patterns like microservices and event-driven design.

• Integrate diverse data sets to power AI/ML, Natural Language Search, and downstream visualization and analytics tools.

• Facilitate the implementation of cutting-edge AI models that take advantage of advances in machine learning.

• Influence technical decisions around data workflows and application development in collaboration with key partners.

• Learn and deeply understand our Data Ecosystem to drive continuous improvement and innovation.

Who You Are

You are a passionate engineer who cares about technical and product excellence, with a drive to build highly usable solutions. You thrive in a collaborative environment, leveraging modern development practices to translate complex challenges into effective technology solutions.

• A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a similar technica

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. I progressi in AI, i dati e le scienze computazionali stanno trasformando la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Le organizzazioni di ricerca e sviluppo precoce di Roche a Genentech (gRED) e Pharma (pRED) hanno dimostrato come queste tecnologie accelerano la R&D, sfruttando i dati e i nuovi modelli computazionali per guidare l'impatto. La condivisione e l'accesso dei dati senza cuciture ai modelli in GRED e pRED sono essenziali per massimizzare queste opportunità. Il Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza (CS CoE) è un gruppo strategico e unificato il cui obiettivo è quello di sfruttare il potere trasformativo dei dati e dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) per aiutare i nostri scienziati sia in pRED che in GRED a fornire farmaci più innovativi e mutevoli per la vita per i pazienti in tutto il mondo. All'interno dell'organizzazione CS CoE, l'organizzazione Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) conduce l'ammodernamento dei nostri ecosistemi computazionali e dati integrando le tecnologie digitali attraverso la ricerca e lo sviluppo precoce per potenziare gli stakeholder, promuovere la scienza dei dati e accelerare il processo decisionale. Il team Solutions all'interno dell'Organizzazione DDC sviluppa ecosistemi computazionali e dati modernizzati e interconnessi. Il Data Ecosystem è fondamentale per costruire soluzioni che accelerano il lavoro svolto dai nostri scienziati Computazionali e Bench e consentono la creazione e l'adozione di strumenti ML/AI. Il nostro team è specializzato nella costruzione di Data Pipelines e Applicazioni per l'acquisizione, la raccolta, lo stoccaggio, la trasformazione, il collegamento e la condivisione dei dati. In qualità di Ingegnere software del nostro team di Ingegneria Soluzioni, costruirai funzionalità robuste, scalabili e riutilizzabili per la nostra piattaforma dati condivisa. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con Data Engineers, Product Leaders e partner scientifici per progettare e implementare sistemi che sbloccano il potenziale dei nostri diversi dati scientifici. Il vostro lavoro contribuirà direttamente ad accelerare la scoperta e lo sviluppo di trattamenti per il cambiamento di vita per i pazienti costruendo l'ecosistema moderno che cattura, si muove e prepara i dati scientifici per l'analisi. L'opportunità
• Assicurare l'eccellenza tecnica offrendo flussi di dati innovativi e di alta qualità e tubazioni in ambiti scientifici chiave.
• Promuovere l'adozione di tendenze e tecnologie chiave applicando un approccio Open Source, Cloud First, API First e AI First alla risoluzione dei problemi.
• Migliorare i nostri flussi di lavoro dati e l'architettura delle applicazioni sfruttando modelli standard come microservizi e design orientato agli eventi.
• Integra diversi set di dati per alimentare AI/ML, Natural Language Search e strumenti di visualizzazione e analisi a valle.
• Facilitare l'implementazione di modelli AI all'avanguardia che sfruttano i progressi nell'apprendimento automatico.
• Influenza delle decisioni tecniche sui flussi di lavoro dei dati e sullo sviluppo delle applicazioni in collaborazione con partner chiave.
• Imparare e comprendere profondamente il nostro Data Ecosystem per promuovere un miglioramento continuo e un'innovazione. Chi sei Sei un ingegnere appassionato che si preoccupa dell'eccellenza tecnica e del prodotto, con l'obiettivo di costruire soluzioni altamente utilizzabili. Si prospera in un ambiente collaborativo, sfruttando le pratiche di sviluppo moderne per tradurre sfide complesse in soluzioni tecnologiche efficaci.
• Una laurea in Informatica o una tecnica simile

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche. Fortschritte in der KI, Daten und rechnerische Wissenschaften transformieren die Entdeckung und Entwicklung von Drogen. Roches Forschungs- und Frühentwicklungsorganisationen von Genentech (gRED) und Pharma (pRED) haben gezeigt, wie diese Technologien die FuE beschleunigen, Daten nutzen und neue Rechenmodelle nutzen, um Auswirkungen zu erzielen. Der nahtlose Datenaustausch und der Zugriff auf Modelle über gRED und pRED sind unerlässlich, um diese Möglichkeiten zu maximieren. Das Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) ist eine strategische, einheitliche Gruppe, deren Ziel es ist, die transformative Kraft von Daten und Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) zu nutzen, um unseren Wissenschaftlern sowohl pRED als auch gRED zu helfen, innovativere und lebensverändernde Medikamente für Patienten weltweit zu liefern. Innerhalb der CS CoE-Organisation führt die Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC)-Organisation die Modernisierung unserer Rechen- und Datenökosysteme durch die Integration digitaler Technologien in Forschung und Frühentwicklung, um Stakeholder zu stärken, datenorientierte Wissenschaft zu fördern und die Entscheidungsfindung zu beschleunigen. Das Solutions-Team innerhalb der DDC-Organisation entwickelt modernisierte und vernetzte Rechen- und Datenökosysteme. Das Data Ecosystem ist ein Fundament für den Aufbau von Lösungen, die die Arbeit unserer Computational- und Bench-Wissenschaftler beschleunigen und die Erstellung und Annahme von ML/AI-Tools ermöglichen. Unser Team ist spezialisiert auf den Aufbau von Data Pipelines und Applikationen für Datenerfassung, Sammlung, Speicherung, Transformation, Verknüpfung und Weitergabe. Als Software Engineer auf unserem Solutions Engineering Team bauen Sie robuste, skalierbare und wiederverwendbare Fähigkeiten für unsere gemeinsame Datenplattform. Sie arbeiten eng mit Data Engineers, Product Leaders und wissenschaftlichen Partnern zusammen, um Systeme zu entwickeln und zu implementieren, die das Potenzial unserer vielfältigen wissenschaftlichen Daten entschlüsseln. Ihre Arbeit wird direkt dazu beitragen, die Entdeckung und Entwicklung von lebensverändernden Behandlungen für Patienten zu beschleunigen, indem Sie das moderne Ökosystem aufbauen, das erfasst, bewegt und wissenschaftliche Daten für die Analyse bereitstellt. Die Chance
• Gewährleistung technischer Exzellenz durch die Bereitstellung innovativer, erstklassiger Datenflüsse und -pipelines in Schlüsselbereichen der Wissenschaft.
• Förderung der Einführung von Schlüsseltrends und Technologien durch die Anwendung eines Open Source, Cloud First, API First und AI First Ansatz zur Problemlösung.
• Verbessern Sie unsere Daten-Workflows und Anwendungsarchitektur, indem Sie Standardmuster wie Mikroservices und ereignisgesteuertes Design nutzen.
• Integrieren Sie verschiedene Datensätze zur Leistung von AI/ML, Natural Language Search und nachgeschalteten Visualisierungs- und Analysetools.
• Erleichterung der Implementierung moderner KI-Modelle, die Fortschritte beim maschinellen Lernen nutzen.
• Einfluss auf technische Entscheidungen über Daten-Workflows und Anwendungsentwicklung in Zusammenarbeit mit Schlüsselpartnern.
• Lernen und verstehen Sie unser Data Ecosystem, um kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Innovation voranzutreiben. Wer bist du? Sie sind ein leidenschaftlicher Ingenieur, der sich um technische und Produktqualität kümmert, mit einem Antrieb, um hoch nutzbare Lösungen zu entwickeln. Sie beleben in einem kollaborativen Umfeld und nutzen moderne Entwicklungspraktiken, um komplexe Herausforderungen in effektive Technologielösungen umzusetzen.
• Ein Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik oder eine ähnliche Technologie
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Les progrès de l'IA, des données et des sciences informatiques transforment la découverte et le développement de médicaments. Les organismes de recherche et de développement précoce de Genentech (GRED) et de Pharma (PRED) ont démontré comment ces technologies accélèrent la R-D, tirent parti des données et de nouveaux modèles de calcul pour produire des effets. Le partage de données sans soudure et l'accès aux modèles à travers gRED et pRED sont essentiels pour maximiser ces opportunités. Le Centre d'excellence en sciences computationnelles (CS CoE) est un groupe stratégique unifié dont l'objectif est d'exploiter la puissance transformatrice des données et de l'intelligence artificielle (IA) pour aider nos scientifiques dans les domaines pRED et gRED à fournir des médicaments plus innovants et changeants pour les patients du monde entier. Au sein de l'organisation du Conseil de l'Europe, l'organisation Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) dirige la modernisation de nos écosystèmes informatiques et de données en intégrant les technologies numériques dans la recherche et le développement précoce pour autonomiser les parties prenantes, faire progresser la science axée sur les données et accélérer la prise de décisions. L'équipe Solutions de l'organisation DDC développe des écosystèmes informatiques et de données modernisés et interconnectés. L'écosystème des données est fondamental pour construire des solutions qui accélèrent le travail de nos chercheurs en informatique et en banque et permettent la création et l'adoption d'outils ML/AI. Notre équipe est spécialisée dans la construction de pipelines de données et applications pour l'acquisition, la collecte, le stockage, la transformation, le couplage et le partage de données. En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel de notre équipe Solutions Engineering, vous allez construire des capacités robustes, évolutives et réutilisables pour notre plateforme de données partagée. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec Data Engineers, Product Leaders et des partenaires scientifiques pour concevoir et mettre en œuvre des systèmes qui libèrent le potentiel de nos diverses données scientifiques. Votre travail contribuera directement à accélérer la découverte et le développement de traitements qui changent la vie des patients en construisant l'écosystème moderne qui capture, déplace et prépare des données scientifiques à analyser. L'opportunité
• Assurer l'excellence technique en fournissant des flux de données et des pipelines innovants et de qualité supérieure dans des domaines scientifiques clés.
• Promouvoir l'adoption de tendances et de technologies clés en appliquant une approche Open Source, Cloud First, API First et AI First à la résolution de problèmes.
• Améliorer nos flux de travail de données et l'architecture d'application en tirant parti des modèles standard tels que les microservices et la conception d'événements.
• Intégrer divers ensembles de données pour alimenter l'IA/ML, la recherche en langage naturel et les outils de visualisation et d'analyse en aval.
• Faciliter la mise en œuvre de modèles d'intelligence artificielle de pointe qui tirent parti des progrès de l'apprentissage automatique.
• Influencer les décisions techniques sur les flux de données et le développement des applications en collaboration avec les principaux partenaires.
• Apprenez et comprenez profondément notre écosystème de données pour stimuler l'amélioration continue et l'innovation. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un ingénieur passionné qui se soucie de l'excellence technique et des produits, avec un moteur pour construire des solutions hautement utilisables. Vous prospèrez dans un environnement collaboratif, en tirant parti des pratiques de développement modernes pour traduire les défis complexes en solutions technologiques efficaces.
• Baccalauréat en informatique ou technica similaire

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose
The chapter lead of business excellence serves as the core person for bridging high-level corporate strategy with on-the-ground commercial execution. The Chapter Lead translates the company's strategic vision into tangible commercial projects, manages the strategic initiatives, and ensures cross-functional alignment to deliver measurable business outcomes and drive sustainable revenue growth.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities:
I. Strategic Planning and development

• Strategy Formulation: Partner with senior leaders to support the annual and long-range company strategy planning process

• Strategic Roadmap: Translate approved corporate and commercial strategies into a defined, prioritized roadmap of projects and initiatives

• Business Case Development: Lead the development of robust business cases for strategic commercial investments, defining expected financial return (ROI), resource requirements, and measurable success criteria.

II. Project Management Office (PMO) Leadership

• Project Execution Oversight: Act as the lead or co-lead for high-priority, complex strategic projects, driving accountability, managing interdependencies, identifying risks, and ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.

• Performance Reporting: Develop and maintain a comprehensive portfolio dashboard for executive leadership, providing clear, concise status updates on project health, key milestones, budget adherence, and projected impact realization.

III. Commercial Excellence Oversight
A. Channel & Distributor Management:

• Focus on maximizing revenue growth and profitability through the optimization of go-to-market channels and the professional management of distributors and business partners.

• Direct the design, implementation, and governance of sales incentive compensation (IC) plans for the direct sales force and partner reward programs.

• Ensure the implementation of a robust performance review framework and regular commercial compliance audit programs for distributors, reviewing anti-bribery, data privacy, and ethical selling practices.

B. Customer Experience & Operational Processes:

• Lead the function responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing seamless service journeys for clinicians and patients across the product lifecycle.

• Ensure the establishment, documentation, and socialization of robust Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for all critical customer-facing and back-office processes, ensuring compliance and efficiency.

• Manage the governance model for external partners , defining and enforcing strict SLAs and KPIs for third-party vendors (e.g., tech support, specialty pharmacies).

C. Sales Analytics & Performance Management :

• Oversee the entire process of sales target setting and management (annual, quarterly, regional, individual).

• Direct the design and maintenance of optimal sales territory structures to maximize market coverage and ensure fair opportunity distribution.

• Drive the development and dissemination of actionable Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and dashboards for sales pipeline health and performance.

• Lead the successful execution of the Objectives and Key Results (OKR) framework within the sales organization, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.

D.Customer Relationship Management & Digital Adoption:

jobs.title: Country Medical Director
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Country Medical Director is a senior leader who easily navigates between science, data and business in service of our vision at Roche. You are an experienced professional with a solid scientific background. You are confident in playing a key role in developing the local medical strategy to enable future success of the organization and you have experience in transforming complex healthcare challenges into clear and compelling actions that benefit patients.

Building relationships and scientific partnerships with our stakeholders is your second nature. Considering the nature of Bosnia and Herzegovina healthcare system, the Medical Director will bring understanding of the operating environment (or comparable market) and its challenges. You come with a strong vision on evidence generation and data enabled healthcare. You are passionate about innovation and can envision how healthcare data and science can have a sustainable impact on the healthcare system.

As a member of the Roche Bosnia and Herzegovina Enabling/Leadership Team, you will be responsible for setting the strategic direction and achieving company objectives within the Affiliate and Medical Chapter, including strategic decision making and empowering teams. You will serve as a role model to the entire organization, lead the functional chapter, and focus on upskilling and coaching team members, while also co-creating organizational strategies and fostering agility and cultural change. Additionally, you will collaborate with other Country Medical Directors, Chapter Heads and Squad Leads to allocate resources and support professional development within the Network, Affiliate and Chapter.

Who are we looking for?

Beyond strong focus on external engagement, strategic partnerships, data and science you have the following responsibilities:

• Shape and develop the overall affiliate medical strategy based on external insights and Roche’s product portfolio developments

• Drive above-brand medical strategy and alignment

• Represents Roche medical authority with key external stakeholders

• As a member of the Enabling /Leadership Team, develop and implement the vision, mission and overarching strategy for Roche Bosnia and Herzegovina and ensure it adheres to the highest scientific and ethical standards and fulfills all regulatory and compliance requirements.

• Ensure excellence in scientific consulting with stakeholders, patient safety, quality, compliance, regulatory, evidence generation and medical information

• Establish and maintain local medical and scientific independence and assurance of medical compliance acting as the local delegate of authority of Roche`s Pharma CMO ensuring business integrity and company reputation.

• Drive early health data gap identification, prioritization and integrated evidence planning inclusion by being actively involved and by collaborating with strong medical enablers

• Bring clinical practice perspective and act as a sparring partner to decide how (and which) data should be used / generated to build the medical narrative in the respective disease areas

• Work closely with local, cross-country and global compliance networks, strong cross-functional partnership with other affiliate (and network) functions and actively engage with Roche global functions and group members.

• Being a servant leader to the entire affiliate and network acting with courage and integrity. Role model creative leadership and network mindset supporting transparency across the organization.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Position - Lead Digital Pathology & Sequencing

Your Opportunity

This position is responsible for P&L management of the Commercial Operations Business Area for Digital Pathology & Sequencing in India and for developing, directing, and ensuring successful development and execution of its vision and strategy. This position is responsible for driving organic top line growth, leading new business development opportunities, and achieving efficient business performance in addition to demonstrating and instilling leadership values across team. This position partners with Roche Diagnostics colleagues nationally and to secure the long-term success of the business. Direct report to the Head Pathology Sales- India.

Provides people direction and mentorship for team. Sets strategic vision and direction; develops and implements strategic plans and objectives for the function in alignment with RDIN strategy. Typically has overall control of planning, staffing, budgeting, managing expense priorities, and approving changes to methods and practices for assigned business area. Decisions impact the entire Division.

Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

Role Responsibilities:
Business Development

• Establish Roche Digital Pathology & Sequencing leadership and business in India, through business development, Partnerships and building relationship with Key Opinion Leaders in field of Digital Pathology & Sequencing.

• Market development & conversion of prospects and opportunities, to help sales achieve targeted sales growth

Strategic Planning

• Establish Roche DP experience curves in customer needs, competitive positioning, & business economics, commercial modelling & clinical evidence in India

Solution Architecture

• Develop customer-specific strategies for Roche Digital pathology & Sequencing adoption; working closely with Histopathology laboratory/administrative leadership and pathology staff to develop and scope their Digital Pathology & Sequencing transformation.

• Provide subject matter expertise in pre and post sales capacity.

Project Management & Implementation

• Establish new & effective operation approaches & interfaces within Roche functional groups (Sales/marketing, Service, Workflow) & external service provider for achieving desired Implementation.

• Work closely with sales team on presales engagements, drive turnkey solution package proposals, including workflow design (Histopathology & Sequencing set ups), and associated external requirement on network, IP, storage etc.

You will have a successful and considerable proven track record in leading people, preferably acquired in the healthcare industry.
