jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Technical Reward Analyst - Compensation is responsible for providing essential services to the People Reward and Recognition (PR&R) chapter independently, focusing on Workday configuration, data analysis, and administrative processes for all Roche positions. This role requires a deep understanding of global reward processes and timelines , with the ability to clearly articulate them. The Reward Analyst will also offer guidance on recurring reward inquiries and have a firm grasp of Roche Rewards policies and procedures.

The opportunity:

• Collaborate with Reward Partners to understand organizational structures and roles.

• Perform system configuration activities in Workday.

• Contribute to the Annual Compensation review cycle management, including system preparation and resolving incoming queries.

• Conduct system testing activities prior release.

• Support the introduction and development of innovative technologies.

• Conduct audits and analysis on programs, policies, and procedures to recommend enhancements or changes that improve existing practices.

• Contribute to the continual improvement of work processes within the PR&R chapter to create a more streamlined and efficient organization.

Who You Are:

• Experience in HR support, Customer Service, or Payroll roles

• Strong analytical skills with advanced critical thinking and the ability to turn data into actionable insights.

• Expertise in analysis tools (e.g., Excel, Access, Smartsheet) and HR systems, with prior experience in data management and system updates.

• Customer-centric mindset , with the ability to anticipate needs, demonstrate cultural mindset awareness, and provide clear, effective responses.

• Fluency in written and spoken English .

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities : Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits : Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility : We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average).

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/dpn4candidates

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Position
• This role is for a temporary one-year contract with the possibility of extension.
• The successful candidate will be employed by a third-party agency on behalf of Roche.

Hlavním cílem a úkolem této pozice je zajišťovat servisní podporu zákazníkům v rámci České republiky ,převážně v regionu Čechy (instalace, pravidelnou údržbu, opravy, softwarové modifikace) analyzátorů a systémů Roche řady cobas, umístěných v laboratořích nemocnic a komerčních laboratoří. Budete úzce spolupracovat s ostatními odděleními Roche Diagnostics při přípravě a implementacích komplexních projektů laboratorních řešení. Preferované bydliště Praha/Střední Čechy

Hlavní odpovědnosti
• ● Provozovat rutinní servisní podporu na analytických přístrojích Roche v úzké spolupráci s centrem zákaznické podpory a dalšími týmy Professional Services.
• To zahrnuje:
• o Instalace přístrojů v laboratořích nemocnic a komerčních laboratoří
• o Provádění periodické údržby přístrojů - opravovat přístroje na základě požadavků zákazníků
• o Provádění výrobcem předepsané modifikace přístrojů
• o Poslední fází veškerých servisních služeb je konečná zkouška příslušného analyzátoru a potvrzení jeho plné funkčnosti.
• ● Provádět příslušnou dokumentaci v digitální formě (dokumentace servisních aktivit, reportování v globálním CRM systému)
• ● Sledovat servisní bulletiny za účelem zajištění co nejlepší přípravy na servisní proces a zajištění kvalitních služeb
• ● Samostatně si plánovat aktivity, zajišťovat objednávky potřebných náhradních dílů ve spolupráci se servisním zázemím
• ● Dodržovat všechny zákonné normy a interní pravidla společnosti
• Vhodný/á kandidát/ka:
• ● Absolvent/ka vysoké školy technického směru (zaměření na elektroniku nebo IT)
• ● Absolvent/ka střední školy se zaměřením na elektroniku a 3 roky praxe v oblasti zdravotnických přístrojů atp.
• ● Zvládání anglického jazyka na úrovni potřebné pro studium technické dokumentace a absolvování školení v anglickém jazyce
• ● Schopnost plánování a provádění samostatné práce u zákazníků v laboratořích a ochota přizpůsobit se časově
• ● Ochota cestování v rámci regionu
• ● Schopnost týmové spolupráce v rámci oddělení Professional Services a spolupráce s kolegy/němi z jiných oddělení
• ● Řidičský průkaz kat.B podmínkou
• ● Kvalifikační stupeň osoby pro samostatnou činnost dle NV 194/2022 Sb.(dříve §6 vyhl.50)
• ● Prozákaznický přístup, schopnost porozumět potřebám zákazníkům a být jim partnerem
• ● Předchozí pracovní zkušenost v oblasti technické podpory zdravotnických přístrojů je výhodou, ale není podmínkou

jobs.title: Senior Lab Manager Dia R&D (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche in 50 Worten
Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns an, innovativ zu sein. Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit alle die Gesundheitsversorgung erhalten, die benötigt wird.
Wir schaffen eine Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen können, die wir lieben.
Das macht uns zu Roche.

Beschreibung Abteilung/Team
Der/Die Labormanager/in gewährleistet die Sicherheit, Einhaltung der Compliance und den reibungslosen Betrieb der zugeordneten Forschungs- und Entwicklungslabore.
Diese Rolle dient als primäre Schnittstelle zwischen wissenschaftlichem Personal, Standortdiensten und externen Anbietern. Zu den Kernaufgaben gehört die Steuerung und Instandhaltung der Laborinfrastruktur, um sicherzustellen, dass dem wissenschaftlichen Personal alle erforderlichen Dienste zur Verfügung stehen. Zudem werden die Arbeitsprozesse und der Betrieb der zugewiesenen Laborbereiche überwacht und koordiniert, um die Einhaltung der Qualitätssysteme und Sicherheitsvorschriften sowie ein ordnungsgemäßes Gerätemanagement zu garantieren.
Die Rolle repräsentiert das Labormanagement-Team als Fachexpert:in für Labor- und Gerätefragen, baut professionelle Beziehungen zu funktionsübergreifenden Teams auf und fungiert als Kommunikationsschnittstelle für Labornutzer:innen, Management-Stakeholder und Auditor:innen.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten/Position

• Labororganisation & reibungslose Abläufe: Du übernimmst die Verwaltung und Überwachung der zugewiesenen R&D-Labore im Hinblick auf allgemeine Laborabläufe (z.B. Zugangskontrolle, Geräte, Reinigung und Wartung) und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Alltag.

• Sicherheit & Compliance: Du stellst die Einhaltung aller gesetzlichen, behördlichen und SHE-relevanten Vorschriften sicher. Dabei setzt du unsere Laborstandards konsequent durch – inklusive bei Verstößen externen Nutzer:innen oder Besucher:innen den Zutritt zu verweigern oder verpflichtende Nachschulungen anzuordnen.

• Sicherheit & Gefahrstoffmanagement: Du stellst sicher, dass alle Gefahrstoffe in den Laboren nach den bestehenden Vorgaben ordnungsgemäß gekennzeichnet und gelagert werden.

• Equipment Management & Stakeholder-Kommunikation:
Du fungierst als primäre Ansprechperson zwischen dem wissenschaftlichen Personal, dem internen Gerätemanagement und den Site Services.
Du steuerst die Prozesse rund um Installation, Kalibrierung, Qualifizierung, Wartungen, Reparaturen, Umzügen und Außerbetriebnahmen von Neu- und Bestandsgeräten, um Ausfallzeiten in der Forschung auf ein absolutes Minimum zu reduzieren.
Zudem stellst du sicher, dass die wissenschaftlichen Teams stets rechtzeitig über geplante Infrastrukturmaßnahmen (wie Stromausfälle oder Umbauarbeiten) informiert sind. Dazu leitest oder nimmst Du an regelmäßigen Labor-User Runden teil.

• Audit-Readiness & Repräsentation: Du stellst GxP-konforme Labordokumentation sicher und vertrittst die Labore souverän bei internen wie externen Audits und führst professionelle Laborrundgänge sowie Sicherheitseinweisungen für Besucher:innen durch.

• Prozessoptimierung: Du identifizierst und implementierst proaktiv Optimierungen von Prozessen im R&D-Labormanagement (z. B. bei Wartungsplänen oder der Freezer-Nutzung) und gießt diese Best Practices in nachhaltige Prozesse, Leitfäden und SOPs.

• Coaching & Wissensvermittlung: Du bist nicht nur operativ tätig, sondern gibst dein Wissen auch weiter, indem du andere LabManager:innen fachlich betreust, coachst und zielgruppengerechte Schulungen anbietest.

Wer bist Du

• Background: Abgesch

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Présentation de l'équipe
Au sein du Département de la Communication, de la RSE et du Site, et rattaché au Responsable de l’équipe administrative, vous occuperez un poste d'assistante administrative.

Vos Missions:

Expertise Compliance & Médicale (Focus majeur)

Garant(e) de notre intégrité vis-à-vis des réglementations françaises, vous assurez un suivi rigoureux des relations avec les professionnels de santé :

• Gestion contractuelle : Élaboration et suivi des contrats avec les experts et professionnels de santé en conformité avec la loi "Encadrement des Avantages" (Loi Anti-Cadeaux).

• Gestion de l'activité médicale : Pilotage avec les parties prenantes des contrats et suivi rigoureux des expertises et études médicales avec le déclenchement des engagements financiers.

• Interface privilégiée : Gestion des échanges avec les experts et coordination des process administratifs liés à leurs interventions.

Business Partner & Soutien Opérationnel

• Accompagnement de proximité : Support administratif sur-mesure pour les collaborateurs et People Leaders de différents services.

• Garant des process : Diffusion et contrôle du respect des procédures administratives internes au sein de la filiale.

• Soutien logistique : Participation active à l’organisation et à la tenue d’événements internes ou externes.

​

Votre Profil :
Vous êtes la candidate (ou le candidat) idéal(e) si :

• La rigueur est votre seconde nature : Vous avez le souci du détail, indispensable pour la gestion des dossiers de compliance où chaque virgule compte.

• Vous êtes un "Caméléon" relationnel : Capable de passer d’un sujet complexe avec le service compliance à un soutien logistique et administratif.

• L’esprit d'équipe vous anime : Pour vous, la réussite est avant tout collective.

• (connaissance des réglementations DMOS/Loi Anti-Cadeaux).

• Industrie Pharmaceutique ou de l' Santé Une expérience dans le secteur de la

• Le + qui fait la différence. Une expérience dans le secteur de la Santé ou de l' Industrie Pharmaceutique (connaissance des réglementations DMOS/Loi Anti-Cadeaux).

​ Postulez dès maintenant pour construire la santé de demain! ​

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The RiSE program (Roche Internships for Scientific Exchange) is a highly competitive student research program at Roche. It offers the most talented graduate and medical degree students the opportunity to be fully integrated into our interdisciplinary and international industry R&D environment. As a RiSE student, you will enhance your competencies, gain valuable work experience with us, and eventually become part of a worldwide network of RiSE Alumni.

The Neuroscience and Rare Diseases Discovery and Translational Area (NRD DTA) is developing medicines for a range of serious neurological diseases, including multiple sclerosis, Alzheimer’s disease, Parkinson’s disease, autism, spinal muscular atrophy, and Huntington’s disease.

As a RiSE student in the NRD DTA you will join our group in the Neuromuscular Disorders (NMD) lab group, situated within the Neurotechnologies Section at the Roche Innovation Center Basel, Switzerland. Our multidisciplinary team brings together expertise in neuromuscular biology, vectorized genomic medicine, genetic engineering, and complex 3D models.

The Opportunity
In your role as a RiSE student, you will have the opportunity to:

• Tissue culture and maintenance of 2D models (e.g. HEK-blue cells, immortalized and hiPSC-derived myoblasts, etc.), 3D neuromuscular junction organoids, and engineered human muscle tissues

• Actively plan, design, perform, and analyze pharmacological assays of interest (e.g. small molecule treatments, reporter expression, cellular bioenergetics with Agilent’s Seahorse system, 3D twitch/tetanic force assessments with CuriBio’s Mantarray setup, live imaging and contractility recordings of 3D organoids, etc.)

• Work closely within a team composed of 3-4 scientists, research associates, other students, and coordinate with internal core facilities (e.g. imaging) and cross-functional teams (e.g. neurogenomics and muscle metabolism groups)

• Maintain a detailed electronic lab notebook (ELN) and data records

• Present research findings at internal meetings

• Summarize work and draft a scientific manuscript

• You will be hosted and mentored by Roche scientists who will provide comprehensive guidance.

Who You Are

• You graduated from a Master's program within the last year or you are enrolled in a PhD or medical degree program at a university and you bring demonstrable experience in one or more of the following areas:

• Culturing complex cell models and/or organoids (e.g. patient-derived cells, human iPSCs, etc.)

• In vitro electrophysiology (e.g. in vitro force measurements using CuriBio’s Mantarray equipment)

• In vitro live cell techniques/assays (e.g. Agilent Seahorse platform, fluorescence microscopy, calcium indicators, contractility, etc.)

• Basic molecular biology techniques (e.g. secreted reporter activity, qPCR/dPCR, WB, immunofluorescence, DNA/RNA/protein isolation)

• A strong interest in expanding your muscle biology skills, particularly using small molecule-based technologies in 2D and 3D model systems.

La Neuroscienza e Malattie Rare Discovery and Translational Area (NRD DTA) sta sviluppando farmaci per una serie di gravi malattie neurologiche, tra cui sclerosi multipla, malattia di Alzheimer, malattia di Parkinson, autismo, atrofia muscolare spinale, e la malattia di Huntington. Come studente di RiSE nel NRD DTA vi unirete al nostro gruppo nel gruppo di laboratorio Neuromuscular Disorders (NMD), situato all'interno della sezione Neurotechnologies presso il Roche Innovation Center di Basilea, Svizzera. • I risultati attuali della ricerca nelle riunioni interne

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le programme RiSE (Roche Stages for Scientific Exchange) est un programme de recherche étudiant hautement compétitif à Roche. Il offre aux étudiants diplômés et aux étudiants en médecine les plus talentueux la possibilité d'être pleinement intégrés dans notre environnement de R-D interdisciplinaire et international. En tant qu'étudiant RiSE, vous améliorerez vos compétences, gagnerez une expérience de travail précieuse avec nous et finirez par faire partie d'un réseau mondial d'anciens RiSE. La zone de découverte et de traduction des neurosciences et des maladies rares (DNT) met au point des médicaments pour diverses maladies neurologiques graves, dont la sclérose en plaques, la maladie d'Alzheimer, la maladie de Parkinson, l'autisme, l'atrophie musculaire de la colonne vertébrale et la maladie de Huntington. En tant qu'étudiant RiSE au NRD DTA, vous rejoindrez notre groupe au sein du groupe de laboratoire des troubles neuromusculaires (NMD), situé au sein de la Section des neurotechnologies du Roche Innovation Center Basel, Suisse. Notre équipe multidisciplinaire réunit une expertise en biologie neuromusculaire, en médecine génomique vectorielle, en génie génétique et en modèles 3D complexes. L'opportunité Dans votre rôle d'étudiant RiSE, vous aurez la possibilité :
• Culture tissulaire et entretien des modèles 2D (par exemple cellules bleues HEK, myoblastes immortalisés et dérivés du hiPSC, etc.), organoïdes de jonction neuromusculaires 3D et tissus musculaires artificiels humains
• Planifier, concevoir, exécuter et analyser activement des tests pharmacologiques d'intérêt (p. ex. traitements à petites molécules, expression des reporters, bioénergétique cellulaire avec le système de Seahorse Agilent, évaluations de la force 3D avec la configuration de Mantarray CuriBio, imagerie en direct et enregistrements de contractilité d'organoïdes 3D, etc.)
• Travailler en étroite collaboration au sein d'une équipe composée de 3-4 scientifiques, d'associés de recherche, d'autres étudiants, et coordonner avec les installations centrales internes (par exemple l'imagerie) et les équipes interfonctionnelles (par exemple les groupes neurogénomiques et métaboliques musculaires)
• Tenir un carnet de laboratoire électronique détaillé (ELN) et des dossiers de données
• Présenter les résultats de la recherche lors des réunions internes
• Résumer les travaux et rédiger un manuscrit scientifique
• Vous serez accueilli et encadré par des scientifiques de Roche qui vous fourniront des conseils complets. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes diplômé d'un programme de maîtrise au cours de la dernière année ou vous êtes inscrit à un programme de doctorat ou de diplôme médical dans une université et vous apportez une expérience démontrable dans un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants:
• Culturation de modèles cellulaires complexes et/ou d'organoïdes (par exemple cellules dérivées du patient, iPSC humains, etc.)
• Électrophysiologie in vitro (par exemple mesures de force in vitro à l'aide de l'équipement de Mantarray de CuriBio)
• Techniques/essais in vitro de cellules vivantes (p. ex. plate-forme Agilent Seahorse, microscopie à fluorescence, indicateurs de calcium, contractilité, etc.)
• Familiarité avec les logiciels avancés d'analyse d'images (par exemple Harmony, FIJI/ImageJ, MuscleMotion, Pulse métriques fonctionnelles, ou similaires)
• Techniques de biologie moléculaire de base (p. ex. activité des reporters sécrétés, qPCR/dPCR, WB, immunofluorescence, isolation ADN/ARN/protéine)
• Compétence en logiciels statistiques (par exemple R, R et/ou GraphPad) pour l'analyse des ensembles de données biologiques, y compris les courbes dose-réponse et la production d'électrophysiologie
• Un vif intérêt à développer vos compétences en biologie musculaire, en particulier en utilisant des technologies à base de petites molécules dans les systèmes de modèles 2D et 3D. Informations complémentaires Le stage peut commencer entre août 2026 et octobre 2026 – veuillez indiquer clairement votre date de départ préférée dans votre lettre de motivation. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Field Engineering Specialist

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem-solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

The Opportunity

The Roche Support Network group is committed to providing industry-defining support to its customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will have the opportunity to travel and demonstrate your expertise as a technical repair and/or installation specialist for Roche assigned product lines and provide valued service to your laboratory customers in an assigned territory. This position serves as a technical repair or installation specialist for Roche products for assigned product lines and geographies.

• Provides routine technical support to customers on operational and maintenance aspects of system equipment.

• Performs on-site service, repair and/or installation of company product(s). This may include any aspect of field support and is not limited to mechanical/system hardware and software, networking/wireless networking.

• Serves as customer contact on routine technical and service-related problems. Receives training and delivers service within the normal scope of the position. Follows documented practices, policies and procedures in providing repair and installation support.

• Diagnoses mechanical, hardware, software and system failure, using established procedures. Determines the most cost-effective repair/resolution to minimize customer downtime.

• Provides analysis, feedback and recommendations on product failure trends and serviceability issues. Documents all activity in a manner compliant with the company's quality procedures. Specialized knowledge generally of a particular area, system or equipment. Requires specific training and certification.

• Applies some advanced skills to the position or specialization. May adapt procedures, processes, tools, equipment and techniques to meet the more complex requirements of the position. Duties are generally routine, but may include non-routine tasks.

• Resolves most questions and problems and refers only the most complex issues to higher levels.

• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

This is a field-based role that requires daily travel and up to 25% overnight travel. Our ideal candidate would reside in Connecticut.

Who You Are

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.
• 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 1-2 years of progressive experience will suffice.
• Successful completion of training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy is mandatory.

jobs.title: Commissioning & Qualification Manager (m/f/d)

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de la mise en service et des qualifications (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Global Engineering executes projects in Pharma Technical Operations (PT), and other divisions within Roche on demand. Within Global Engineering, the Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) Manager has overall responsibility for the compliant, in time and in budget delivery of Commissioning & Qualification deliverables. The Commissioning & Qualification Manager reports to the PTT Regional Head of C&Q. Work is self-directed in nature. Projects / initiatives can vary in both length of time and complexity, requiring extensive cross-functional collaboration and agile execution strategies in support of GMP manufacturing operations, affiliates and CMOs. The position requires excellent internal and external collaboration and influencing skills and the ability to lead diverse, cross-functional teams.

Are you ready to lead large-scale engineering projects that deliver life-saving medicines to patients worldwide? Join our Global Engineering team and take overall responsibility for the compliant and timely delivery of Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) for our pharmaceutical technical operations

The Opportunity
As a C&Q Manager, you will act as a Sub-Project Manager within Global Engineering, driving excellence in a dynamic and collaborative team environment.
You will:

• Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Motivate and inspire diverse teams during the C&Q phase, setting clear expectations and fostering a "one team" culture.

• Drive Project Success: Manage C&Q project scope to ensure deliverables are met within the approved budget and schedule.

• Ensure Global Compliance: Execute all deliverables in full alignment with the Roche Pharmaceutical Quality Management System (PQS) and international regulatory standards.

• Innovate and Challenge: Identify better ways to accomplish objectives by introducing best practices and innovation for C&Q Capex project management.

• Partner Strategically: Proactively build trustful relationships with key stakeholders and customers to support Roche’s strategic business goals.

Who you are

You bring:

• A University Degree in Engineering, Science, or a related discipline.

• Bachelor with 6-8 years experience, Master with 5-7 years experience in the (bio)pharmaceutical industry, specifically in sterile drug product manufacturing or qualification.

• You have gained particular experience in leading a drug product sterile filling facility commissioning and qualification, leading the commissioning and qualification of packaging and autoinjector assembly, as well as in the commissioning and qualification of cleanroom systems.

• Deep knowledge of C&Q strategies (ASTM E2500), risk-based approaches, and global regulations (FDA, EMA, ICH).

• Proficient in both German and English (written and spoken) with the ability to adjust your style to various audiences.

• Travel (20%) may be required to meet the business need, in order to lead the team at the project site/location. Expectation if assigned to a specific project during design or construction it is required to spend most of the time on site.

This is a 100% full time role and locally based in potential future EU sites and / or Mannheim / Penzberg.

Application documents - very pragmatic:
We ask you for a current CV in English and your official (educational) certificates/credentials. Further documents are not mandatory at the moment. Please note before sending your application that no further documents can be added afterwards.
Apply now - we are looking forward to it!

Your contact to us! Wit

All'interno di Global Engineering, il Manager di Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) ha la responsabilità generale per la conformità, nel tempo e nella consegna di bilancio dei consegnabili Commissioning & Qualification. Il Commissioning & Qualification Manager riporta al PTT Regional Head of C&Q. Il lavoro è autodiretto in natura. Progetti / iniziative possono variare sia in termini di durata che di complessità, richiedendo ampie strategie di collaborazione interfunzionale e di esecuzione agile a supporto delle operazioni di produzione GMP, affiliati e CMO. La posizione richiede un'eccellente collaborazione interna ed esterna e influenza le competenze e la capacità di guidare squadre diverse e interfunzionali. Siete pronti a condurre progetti di ingegneria su larga scala che forniscono farmaci salvavita ai pazienti in tutto il mondo? Unisciti al nostro team di Global Engineering e assumi la responsabilità generale per la fornitura conforme e tempestiva di Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) per le nostre operazioni tecniche farmaceutiche L'opportunità Come C&Q Manager, agirai come Sub-Project Manager all'interno di Global Engineering, guidando l'eccellenza in un ambiente di team dinamico e collaborativo. Lo farai:
• Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Motivate e ispira diverse squadre durante la fase C&Q, ponendo chiare aspettative e promuovendo una cultura "una squadra".
• Drive Project Success: Gestisci lo scopo del progetto C&Q per garantire che i responsabili siano soddisfatti all'interno del budget approvato e del calendario.
• Assicurare il Compliance Globale: Eseguire tutti i prodotti in pieno allineamento con il sistema di gestione della qualità farmaceutica Roche (PQS) e gli standard normativi internazionali.
• Innovare e sfida: Identificare modi migliori per raggiungere gli obiettivi introducendo best practice e innovazione per la gestione dei progetti C&Q Capex.
• Partner Strategicamente: Proattivamente costruire relazioni fiduciose con i principali stakeholder e clienti per sostenere gli obiettivi strategici di Roche. Chi sei Tu porti:
• Una laurea in Ingegneria, Scienza o una disciplina relativa.
• Corso di laurea con 6-8 anni di esperienza, Master con 5-7 anni di esperienza nell'industria farmaceutica (bio), in particolare nella produzione o nella qualificazione di prodotti di droga sterili.
• Hai acquisito una particolare esperienza nella guida di un impianto di riempimento sterile del prodotto di droga che commissiona e qualifica, conducendo la messa in servizio e la qualificazione di imballaggio e assemblaggio di autoiniettori, così come nella messa in servizio e nella qualificazione dei sistemi di cleanroom.
• Conoscenza profonda delle strategie C&Q (ASTM E2500), approcci basati sui rischi e normative globali (FDA, EMA, ICH).
• Proficiente sia in tedesco che in inglese (scritto e parlato) con la capacità di regolare il vostro stile a vari pubblico.
• Il viaggio (20%) può essere richiesto per soddisfare le esigenze aziendali, al fine di guidare il team presso il sito/location del progetto. L'aspettativa se assegnata a un progetto specifico durante la progettazione o la costruzione è tenuto a trascorrere la maggior parte del tempo in loco. Questo è un ruolo a tempo pieno al 100% e localmente basato in potenziali futuri siti UE e / o Mannheim / Penzberg. Documenti di applicazione - molto pragmatico: Vi chiediamo un CV corrente in inglese e i vostri certificati/credential ufficiali (educativi). Ulteriori documenti non sono obbligatori al momento. Si prega di notare prima di inviare la domanda che nessun ulteriore documento può essere aggiunto in seguito. Applica ora - non vediamo l'ora! Il tuo contatto con noi! Wit

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche .

At Roche Diagnostics, we are driven by our vision: innovating diagnostics, shaping healthcare, and changing lives. We are excited to see this vision come to life.

The opportunity
Join our team as the Global Strategic Pricing leader in the Diagnostics Global Access & Policy (GA&P) team. You'll play a vital role in developing strategic global pricing guidance for our products and solutions, collaborating closely with global, regional, and local teams to optimize revenues and ensure sustainable access. Be part of shaping our global pricing strategy and policy for a brighter future.
Your impact:

• Lead the design and implementation of global value-based pricing strategies for prioritized pipeline and on-market products, utilizing analytics to assess elasticity, forecast trends, and manage profitability.

• Co-lead the roll-out of pricing strategies, including innovative pricing and contracting solutions, in collaboration with access and commercial stakeholders to drive market access and profitability.

• Act as the main responsible for exception management, providing clear guidance and supporting affiliates with local strategy development to address access barriers.

• Be the key responsible for price monitoring and insights generation using internal databases (e.g., DIAprice, sCORE), delivering actionable insights to affiliates, regions, and IBTs.

• Establish and lead pricing committee meetings, issue price memos, and drive pricing governance, including the maintenance and monitoring of pricing policies, controls, and KPIs (e.g., floor price).

• Conduct and leverage primary and secondary payer, reimbursement, and pricing research to inform global strategy and provide consolidated pricing and reimbursement advice to relevant product teams.

• Partner cross-functionally to inform IBTs and their Product Managers on recommended price setting, ensuring adherence to relevant governance processes.

Who You Are

• Minimum 8-10 years of professional experience with recognized expertise in pricing and reimbursement, preferably in the diagnostics, medical device, or pharmaceutical industry. Affiliate and/or regional experience is a plus.

• Possess a Bachelor's Degree in a relevant field such as business, finance, economics, health economics, life sciences, or public health. An MBA or other Graduate/higher-level Degree is beneficial.

• Deep financial and commercial understanding with in-depth knowledge of the global reimbursement environment, competitive intelligence, and market segmentation for effective global price setting.

• Demonstrated Strategic & Analytical Acumen with strong influencing, negotiation, and Agile leadership skills to excel in a global matrix organization and lead diverse multicultural teams.

• Committed to permanently optimizing processes to increase quality and efficiency standards and implement pricing competence and awareness across the organization through training and support.

Essential Skills

• Strategic & Analytical Acumen: Must be able to design and implement global value-based pricing strategies, utilizing analytics to assess elasticity, forecast trends, and manage profitability. Deep financial and commercial understanding is critical.

Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Ecco cosa ci rende Roche . A Roche Diagnostics, siamo guidati dalla nostra visione: innovare la diagnostica, plasmare la salute e cambiare la vita. Siamo entusiasti di vedere questa visione nascere. L'opportunità Unisciti al nostro team come leader Global Strategic Pricing nel team Diagnostics Global Access & Policy (GA&P). Potrai svolgere un ruolo vitale nello sviluppo di una guida strategica globale dei prezzi per i nostri prodotti e le nostre soluzioni, collaborando a stretto contatto con i team globali, regionali e locali per ottimizzare i ricavi e garantire un accesso sostenibile. Essere parte di modellare la nostra strategia globale dei prezzi e la politica per un futuro più luminoso. Il tuo impatto:
• Guidare la progettazione e l'implementazione di strategie globali di prezzi basati sul valore per le pipeline prioritarie e i prodotti on-market, utilizzando analisi per valutare l'elasticità, le tendenze di previsione e gestire la redditività.
• Co-promuovere il roll-out delle strategie di pricing, comprese le soluzioni innovative di pricing e contracting, in collaborazione con gli stakeholder di accesso e commerciali per guidare l'accesso al mercato e la redditività.
• Agire come principale responsabile della gestione delle eccezioni, fornire una chiara guida e sostenere gli affiliati con lo sviluppo di strategia locale per affrontare le barriere di accesso.
• Essere la chiave responsabile per il monitoraggio dei prezzi e la generazione di insight utilizzando database interni (ad esempio, DIAprice, sCORE), fornendo informazioni attuabili a affiliati, regioni e IBT.
• Stabilire e condurre riunioni dei comitati di prezzi, emettere i memo dei prezzi, e guidare la governance dei prezzi, compreso il mantenimento e il monitoraggio delle politiche dei prezzi, dei controlli e dei KPI (ad esempio, prezzo del pavimento).
• Condurre e sfruttare il payer primario e secondario, il rimborso e la ricerca sui prezzi per informare la strategia globale e fornire consulenza consolidata sui prezzi e sui rimborsi ai rispettivi team di prodotto.
• Partner interfunzionalmente per informare gli IBT e i loro Product Manager sull'impostazione dei prezzi consigliati, garantendo l'adesione ai processi di governance rilevanti. Chi sei
• Minimo 8-10 anni di esperienza professionale con competenze riconosciute nei prezzi e nel rimborso, preferibilmente nella diagnostica, dispositivo medico, o industria farmaceutica. Affiliazione e/o esperienza regionale è un plus.
• Possedere una laurea in un campo rilevante come affari, finanza, economia, economia sanitaria, scienze della vita, o la salute pubblica. Un MBA o un altro laureato / diploma di livello superiore è vantaggioso.
• Profonda comprensione finanziaria e commerciale con una conoscenza approfondita dell'ambiente di rimborso globale, dell'intelligenza competitiva e della segmentazione di mercato per un'efficace impostazione dei prezzi globale.
• Acumen Strategico e Analitico Dimostrato con forti influenze, negoziazioni e capacità di leadership Agile per eccellere in un'organizzazione di matrice globale e condurre diverse squadre multiculturali.
• Impegnati a ottimizzare in modo permanente i processi per aumentare gli standard di qualità ed efficienza e implementare le competenze e la consapevolezza dei prezzi in tutta l'organizzazione attraverso la formazione e il supporto. Abilità essenziali
• Acumen strategico e analitico: deve essere in grado di progettare e implementare strategie di prezzi basate sul valore globale, utilizzando analisi per valutare l'elasticità, le tendenze delle previsioni e gestire la redditività. La profonda comprensione finanziaria e commerciale è critica.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche . At Roche Diagnostics, we are driven by our vision: innovating diagnostics, shaping healthcare, and changing lives. We are excited to see this vision come to life. The opportunity Join our team as the Global Strategic Pricing leader in the Diagnostics Global Access & Policy (GA&P) team. You'll play a vital role in developing strategic global pricing guidance for our products and solutions, collaborating closely with global, regional, and local teams to optimize revenues and ensure sustainable access. Be part of shaping our global pricing strategy and policy for a brighter future. Your impact:
• Lead the design and implementation of global value-based pricing strategies for prioritized pipeline and on-market products, utilizing analytics to assess elasticity, forecast trends, and manage profitability.
• Co-lead the roll-out of pricing strategies, including innovative pricing and contracting solutions, in collaboration with access and commercial stakeholders to drive market access and profitability.
• Act as the main responsible for exception management, providing clear guidance and supporting affiliates with local strategy development to address access barriers.
• Be the key responsible for price monitoring and insights generation using internal databases (e.g., DIAprice, sCORE), delivering actionable insights to affiliates, regions, and IBTs.
• Establish and lead pricing committee meetings, issue price memos, and drive pricing governance, including the maintenance and monitoring of pricing policies, controls, and KPIs (e.g., floor price).
• Conduct and leverage primary and secondary payer, reimbursement, and pricing research to inform global strategy and provide consolidated pricing and reimbursement advice to relevant product teams.
• Partner cross-functionally to inform IBTs and their Product Managers on recommended price setting, ensuring adherence to relevant governance processes. Who You Are
• Minimum 8-10 years of professional experience with recognized expertise in pricing and reimbursement, preferably in the diagnostics, medical device, or pharmaceutical industry. Affiliate and/or regional experience is a plus.
• Possess a Bachelor's Degree in a relevant field such as business, finance, economics, health economics, life sciences, or public health. An MBA or other Graduate/higher-level Degree is beneficial.
• Deep financial and commercial understanding with in-depth knowledge of the global reimbursement environment, competitive intelligence, and market segmentation for effective global price setting.
• Demonstrated Strategic & Analytical Acumen with strong influencing, negotiation, and Agile leadership skills to excel in a global matrix organization and lead diverse multicultural teams.
• Committed to permanently optimizing processes to increase quality and efficiency standards and implement pricing competence and awareness across the organization through training and support. Essential Skills
• Strategic & Analytical Acumen: Must be able to design and implement global value-based pricing strategies, utilizing analytics to assess elasticity, forecast trends, and manage profitability. Deep financial and commercial understanding is critical.

• Aktivieren Sie als Hauptverantwortlicher für das Ausnahmemanagement, bieten klare Anleitungen und unterstützende Partner mit der lokalen Strategieentwicklung, um die Zugangsbarrieren anzusprechen.

• Einrichtung und Leitung von Sitzungen des Preisausschusses, Ausgabe von Preis-Memos und treiben die Preis-Governance, einschließlich der Wartung und Überwachung von Preispolitiken, Kontrollen und KPIs (z.B. Bodenpreis).
• Führen und nutzen primäre und sekundäre Zahler, Rückerstattung und Preisforschung, um die globale Strategie zu informieren und konsolidierte Preis- und Erstattungsberatung an relevante Produktteams zu bieten.
• Partner interfunktional, um IBTs und ihre Produktmanager über die empfohlene Preiseinstellung zu informieren, um die Einhaltung relevanter Governance-Prozesse zu gewährleisten. Wer bist du?

• Besteht einen Bachelor-Abschluss in einem relevanten Bereich wie Wirtschaft, Finanzen, Wirtschaft, Gesundheitsökonomie, Life Sciences oder öffentliche Gesundheit. Ein MBA oder ein anderer Graduierten/Hochgrad ist vorteilhaft.
• Tiefes finanzielles und kommerzielles Verständnis mit fundierten Kenntnissen über das globale Rückerstattungsumfeld, wettbewerbsfähige Intelligenz und Marktsegmentierung für eine effektive globale Preisgestaltung.
• Demonstrated Strategic & Analytical Acumen mit starken Einfluss-, Verhandlungs- und Agile-Führungsfähigkeiten, um in einer globalen Matrix-Organisation zu exceln und verschiedene multikulturelle Teams zu führen.
• Es wird darauf hingewiesen, die Prozesse permanent zu optimieren, um Qualitäts- und Effizienzstandards zu erhöhen und Preiskompetenz und Bewusstsein in der gesamten Organisation durch Schulung und Unterstützung zu implementieren. Grundlegende Fähigkeiten
• Strategic & Analytical Acumen: Muss in der Lage sein, globale wertebasierte Preisstrategien zu entwerfen und umzusetzen, Analytik zur Beurteilung von Elastizität, Prognosetrends und Rentabilität zu nutzen. Ein tiefes finanzielles und kommerzielles Verständnis ist entscheidend.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui nous fait Roche. Chez Roche Diagnostics, nous sommes animés par notre vision : innover le diagnostic, façonner les soins de santé et changer les vies. Nous sommes heureux de voir cette vision prendre vie. L'opportunité Rejoignez notre équipe en tant que leader de la tarification stratégique mondiale dans l'équipe Diagnostics Global Access & Policy (GA&P). Vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans le développement d'orientations stratégiques de tarification mondiale pour nos produits et solutions, en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes mondiales, régionales et locales pour optimiser les revenus et assurer un accès durable. Faites partie de l'élaboration de notre stratégie de tarification mondiale et de notre politique pour un avenir meilleur. Votre impact :
• Diriger la conception et la mise en oeuvre de stratégies mondiales de fixation des prix fondées sur la valeur pour les pipelines prioritaires et les produits sur le marché, en utilisant l'analyse pour évaluer l'élasticité, prévoir les tendances et gérer la rentabilité.
• Codiriger le déploiement de stratégies de tarification, y compris des solutions de tarification et de passation de marchés innovantes, en collaboration avec les acteurs de l'accès et du commerce pour stimuler l'accès au marché et la rentabilité.
• Agir en tant que principal responsable de la gestion des exceptions, fournir des orientations claires et aider les affiliés à élaborer une stratégie locale pour surmonter les obstacles à l'accès.
• Être la principale responsable du suivi des prix et de la production d'informations à l'aide de bases de données internes (par exemple DIAprice, sCORE), fournir des informations exploitables aux filiales, aux régions et aux IBT.
• Établir et diriger les réunions du comité des prix, publier des notes de prix et encourager la gouvernance des prix, y compris le maintien et le suivi des politiques de prix, des contrôles et des KPI (par exemple, le prix plancher).
• Mener et exploiter des recherches sur le payeur primaire et secondaire, le remboursement et les prix pour éclairer la stratégie globale et fournir des conseils consolidés en matière de prix et de remboursement aux équipes de produits concernées.
• Partenaire interfonctionnel pour informer les IBT et leurs responsables de produits sur la fixation des prix recommandée, en assurant le respect des processus de gouvernance pertinents. Qui vous êtes
• Au moins 8 à 10 ans d'expérience professionnelle avec une expertise reconnue en matière de prix et de remboursement, de préférence dans l'industrie du diagnostic, du matériel médical ou pharmaceutique. L'expérience d'affiliation et/ou régionale est un plus.
• Avoir un baccalauréat dans un domaine pertinent comme les affaires, les finances, l'économie, l'économie de la santé, les sciences de la vie ou la santé publique. Un MBA ou un autre diplôme d'études supérieures est bénéfique.
• Compréhension financière et commerciale approfondie avec une connaissance approfondie de l'environnement de remboursement mondial, de l'intelligence concurrentielle et de la segmentation du marché pour une fixation efficace des prix mondiaux.
• L'Acumen Stratégique et analytique démontré avec une forte influence, la négociation et Agile compétences de leadership pour exceller dans une organisation matricielle mondiale et diriger diverses équipes multiculturelles.
• S'engage à optimiser en permanence les processus afin d'améliorer les normes de qualité et d'efficacité et de mettre en œuvre les compétences et la sensibilisation en matière de tarification dans l'ensemble de l'organisation par la formation et le soutien. Compétences essentielles
• Strategic & Analytical Acumen: Doit être en mesure de concevoir et de mettre en œuvre des stratégies globales de tarification basées sur la valeur, en utilisant l'analyse pour évaluer l'élasticité, les tendances prévisionnelles et gérer la rentabilité. Une compréhension financière et commerciale approfondie est essentielle.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary:
As the Operations Quality Site Head for Suzhou, you are fully accountable for the quality of the products manufactured at the site and for ensuring end-to-end compliance with global specifications, local Health Authority regulations, and corporate quality standards. You serve as a key member of the Global perations
Quality Leadership Team (GOQLT) and the Site Leadership Team, modeling Agile behaviors and driving operational excellence.

Main Tasks & 
• Responsibilities:
Drive business results and customer value
a) Responsible for ensuring that manufactured products in Suzhou meet Health Authority regulations, Notified Body requirements, Company standards and expectations. Establish and support inspection readiness to ensure successful outcomes. Prepare adequate and timely responses to any inspection
observations and implement appropriate and thorough corrections, as necessary.
b) Engage and influence the organization to ensure that Product Quality is our focus by ensuring that products manufactured in Suzhou meet regulatory requirements and product specifications. Works directly in a complex, global environment with the chapters and the other Network Leads to deliver high quality
products, ensure our right to operate and continuously improve.
c) Provide leadership and guidance to staff directing Quality functions, manage performance and development of direct reports to ensure achievement of organizational, and departmental goals and a productive environment.
d) Maintain an effective Quality governance and continually improve the governance to meet business and compliance needs. Communicate significant quality or regulatory issues and risks that may impact product quality or regulatory compliance in a timely manner to Executive Management.
e) Develop annual budget, revise forecasts to meet business needs and monitor/control expenditures to assure efficient use of company resources.
f) Appointed as the Site Management Representative and Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC) equivalent under China Medical Device GMP regulations and international standards (e.g., ISO 13485:2016). Accountable for ensuring the site’s technical documentation, quality management systems,
and regulatory filings are meticulously drawn up, maintained up-to-date, and fully aligned with NMPA, FDA, and European regulations to safeguard our right to operate.

2. Advance the work of the Network, making tradeoffs and breaking silos
a) Partner with the Operations Site Head on strategic business direction and decisions. Break down silos and improve working effectiveness as an “integrator” across the organization as needed; in particular through collaboration with other Networks Leaders and stakeholders to resolve escalated bottlenecks and
dependencies, as well as rebalance work & help in line with greater strategic priorities.
b) Build and maintain strong partnerships with other site and network leaders to assure alignment around strategic projects and day-to-day activities and to assure mutually successful working relationships.
c) Coordinate with Functional Partners to aggregate upcoming LCTs’ needs and upcoming priorities, to better understand upcoming resource demands on the Network.

Empower and enable the Network
a) Develop and communicate organizational strategies, which ensure the GMP compliance of the site, continuous improvements and achievement of long-term goals.
b) Negotiate with Senior Leadership across the organization to influence decision making.
c) Lead,

jobs.title: Production Expert (befristet auf 2 Jahre)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Mit seinen 1400 Mitarbeitenden stellt das Produktionszentrum Kaiseraugst die ununterbrochene Patientenversorgung mit qualitativ hochwertigen Medikamenten sicher.

Werde Teil unseres Teams und trage als Production Expert dazu bei, dass wir die höchsten Standards in der pharmazeutischen Herstellung und Versorgung von über 120 Ländern mit qualitativ hochwertigen, sterilen Biologika-Produkten erfüllen!

Die Möglichkeit

Als Production Expert trägst du gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen die fachliche Verantwortung für den Produktionsbereich Filling Services (Compounding, Raw Materials, Equipment) innerhalb des Sterile Filling und trägst die Verantwortung für folgende Aufgaben:

• Verantwortlich für die zeitgerechte Herstellung von Produktlösungen, die zur Produktion kommerzieller, steriler Biologika-Produkte, beispielsweise Flüssigvials und -spritzen verwendet werden

• Bedienen der Produktionsanlagen, sowie Wiegen und Kontrollieren der Rohstoffe, um sicherzustellen, dass die hergestellten Chargen die richtigen Inhaltsstoffe und Mengen enthalten

• Durchführen prozessbegleitender Prüfungen der hergestellten Produktlösung (IPC), um sicherzustellen, dass die Chargen den Spezifikationen entsprechen

• Unterstützen bei der Validierung von Prozessen, die direkt mit der Herstellung verknüpft sind, einschliesslich Reinigung und Sterilisation

• Dokumentieren der Tätigkeiten gemäss GMP-Anforderungen

• Sorgen für eine Reinraumumgebung, die den behördlichen Anforderungen, der guten Herstellungspraxis (GMP) sowie den Standardbetriebsverfahren entspricht

• Ausführung von Prozessverbesserungen und Anpassung von Vorgabedokumenten unter Anwendung von LPS Tools.

Wer Du Bist
Für diese Stelle bringst du folgende Qualifikationen mit:

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Pharma- oder Chemietechnologe oder vergleichbare Ausbildung (Pharma/Technik/Mechanik/Automation)

• Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Herstellung steriler Arzneimittel und Erfahrung im GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice)-Umfeld (Arbeiten / Dokumentation)

• Gutes technisches Verständnis und Fähigkeiten im Umgang mit hochautomatisierten Produktionsanlagen beziehungsweise sicherer und routinierter Umgang mit IT-Systemen (MES, Google-Anwendungen, Lagerverwaltungssysteme, SAP, Anlagensteuerungssystemen)

• Bereitschaft in einem Schicht-Modell zu arbeiten

• Fließende Deutsch-Kenntnisse in Wort und Schrift gelten als Voraussetzung.

Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem aktuellen Lebenslauf und releventen Zeugnissen und werde Teil unseres Teams, um gemeinsam die Zukunft zu gestalten!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Con i suoi 1400 dipendenti, il centro di produzione Kaiseraugst garantisce una cura continua dei pazienti con farmaci di alta qualità. Diventa parte del nostro team e contribuisce come esperto di produzione per soddisfare i più elevati standard di produzione farmaceutica e fornitura di oltre 120 paesi con prodotti biologici sterili di alta qualità! In qualità di esperto di produzione, voi e i vostri colleghi assumete la responsabilità tecnica per i servizi di riempimento (Compounding, Raw Materials, Equipment) nell'ambito del riempimento sterile e assumete la responsabilità dei seguenti compiti:

• impianti di produzione operativi, pesando e controllando materie prime per garantire che i lotti prodotti fabbricati correttamente

• Buona comprensione tecnica e competenze nella gestione di impianti di produzione altamente automatizzati o gestione sicura e ordinaria di sistemi IT (MES, applicazioni Google, sistemi di gestione del magazzino, SAP, sistemi di controllo degli impianti)
• Pronto a lavorare in un modello a turni

jobs.title: Product Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:

At Roche Diagnostics, we understand that behind every test result is a patient. Our Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC) is looking for a Hungarian-speaking Product Specialist who wants to transition from the laboratory bench to a regional expert role. Whether you are an engineer or a lab professional, your expertise can help shape the future of diagnostics.

Please note that this is a CONTRACTOR/CONTINGENT POSITION. You will be employed by our 3rd party service provider.

Special Focus: Are you a Lab Professional looking for a career shift?

• Tired of shift work? Join us for a structured, professional office/hybrid environment.

• Ready to drop the lab coat but keep the expertise? Your hands-on experience with analyzers, reagents, and daily lab challenges is exactly what our customers need.

• Want to see the bigger picture? Move from running tests to mastering the entire diagnostic ecosystem, including IT integrations and cutting-edge software.

Your Impact:

• Technical & Application Support: Provide expert remote guidance for Hungarian laboratories and hospitals on IVD systems.

• Agile Problem Solving: Use your diagnostic "gut feeling" and our remote tools to prevent system downtimes.

• Knowledge Sharing: Be the bridge between complex technology and the people who use it every day.

• Professional Travel: Combine a structured office/hybrid setup with occasional customer site visits - using them as perfect opportunities for hands-on learning and staying connected to the lab reality

Who You Are:

• Background: Degree in Biochemistry, Medical Biology, Laboratory Diagnostics, IT, or Engineering .

• Language: Native-level Hungarian is essential; strong English for international training and collaboration.

• Experience: If you have worked in a clinical laboratory (Biochemist, Lab Technician) or in technical support, you have a head start!

• Mindset: You are empathetic to customer needs, curious about how things work "under the hood," and enjoy a collaborative "Agile" culture.

• Mobility: You possess a valid driving license and are ready to hit the road when duty calls, turning occasional customer visits into a change of scenery

What’s in it for you?

• A prestigious career path in a global healthcare leader.

• Comprehensive technical training (we teach you the engineering part; you bring the lab logic).

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Information Security & Privacy By Design team is the engine behind Roche’s security governance. We design, deliver, and support the digital frameworks that protect our organization, including IRAAM (Information Risk Assessment And Mitigation), PETRA (Policy Exceptions Tool for Risk Asse ssment ), OIA ( Outsourcing Impact Assessment), and our cutting-edge GenAI security agents.

As a Process Operations Coordinator , you are the "Chef d’Orchestre" of our technical execution. Your mission is to facilitate the seamless flow of our security frameworks, ensuring that process deliverables are triggered on time, users are supported, and reporting is accurate. You are the operational backbone that ensures our security processes are not just defined, but are actively understood, automated, and data-driven.
You are a proactive facilitator who enjoys "connecting the dots" between complex technical systems and human workflows. You believe that security governance only works when the user experience is smooth and the data is reliable.

Description of the Area

The Information Security & Privacy By Design team makes Roche’s information security governance accessible through actionable processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate information risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee third-party and personal data processing risks. Our processes are primarily instantiated in the ServiceNow IRM Platform . We work closely with Information Security, Privacy, Risk & Compliance, and IT teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s information risk posture.
You’ll be working within the Information Security Governance (ISG) area. ISG is responsible for defining the strategic agenda for information security and privacy topics at the Roche Group level. This is realized within the global Information Security Management System (ISMS) which aligns business and IT strategies, business and technical projects, policies, standards, directives, procedures, governance, legal / regulatory, compliance, and other requirements at a global level.
The Information Security & Privacy by Design area is accountable for co-developing, in collaboration with key stakeholders, and stewardship of the strategic direction of the Information Risk Assessment processes based on organizational objectives, industry practices and legal / regulatory requirements - e.g IRAAM, PETRA, OIA. This includes oversight, awareness, direction and continuous improvement to the end-to-end processes and their relevant risk modules in alignment with the global ISMS, corporate directives and Roche management systems (e.g. privacy, quality, risk).

Job Responsibilities

1. Operational Facilitation & Workflow Orchestration

• IRAAM Fulfillment: Actively "chase" and monitor the delivery of critical artifacts, such as control attestations, to ensure the process flow remains uninterrupted.

• SER Triage Management: Facilitate the Security Expert Review (SER) Triage process, prioritizing and coordinating the assignment of Information Security & Privacy Advisors (ISPA) to execute reviews.

• Process Lifecycle Oversight: Monitor the end-to-end execution of IRAAM, PETRA and OIA processes, ensuring milestones are met and bottlenecks are addressed proactively.

​
2. Request Management & Platform Support

• ServiceNow Orchestration: Manage and maintain the service request management tool and its related artifacts within ServiceNow.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Within People & Culture (P&C), People Insights & Technology (PI&T) unleashes exponential people and business impact through data-driven decision-making, actionable insights, and embracing people-centric technology.

We are looking for a motivated and curious intern to join our People Insights Area of Practice for a 6 months internship based in Basel, Switzerland, starting August. In this role, you will collaborate closely with Organisational Scientists on applied research and people analytics initiatives. In this role, you will support the team by conducting literature reviews, collecting and analyzing employee data, uncovering actionable insights, and supporting evidence-based decisions that improve employee experience and organizational effectiveness.

The Opportunity
Literature Review & Knowledge Synthesis

• Conduct targeted literature searches and synthesize evidence on key topics (e.g., impact of AI on workforce and leadership, employee experience)

• Maintain and update shared literature repositories for ongoing team use

Research Design & Execution

• Support design and execution of research approaches (e.g., surveys, experiments), including identifying validated measurement scales

• Contribute to hypothesis generation and assess feasibility of research approaches

Data Analysis & Insights Communication

• Support the analysis of people data to uncover meaningful insights

• Summarize and visualize findings for clear stakeholder presentations

Who You Are

• An ambitious Master’s student currently pursuing or having recently completed a degree in Industrial/Organizational Psychology, Organizational Behavior, HR, or related disciplines (within 12 months of the start date). Alternatively, PhD students currently enrolled in a doctoral program are also encouraged to apply.

• You have a solid foundation in research methods (e.g., surveys, experiments, psychometrics) and statistics,developed through academic training, thesis work, or hands-on application; experience with statistical programming (e.g., R, Python) is a plus.

• You are comfortable working with scientific literature and can critically evaluate and translate research findings into clear, practical insights for a business audience

• You are passionate about People & Culture topics (e.g., impact of AI on workforce/leadership; employee experience)

• You bring strong analytical and critical thinking skills, paired with excellent communication and writing abilities in English

• You are able to work independently, manage multiple tasks, and thrive in a dynamic environment

• You have a genuine eagerness to apply scientific thinking in a real-world business context

Additional Information
What We offer:

• Hands-on experience working with experienced Organisational Scientists and People Analytics professionals

• Exposure to real business challenges with opportunities to contribute meaningful impact

• A collaborative, international, and purpose-driven work environment

• Dedicated learning opportunities and professional development

• The chance to apply research and analytical skills in a global healthcare company committed to innovation and people development

Application process

• To be considered, please send us your CV, cover letter and your certificate of enrollment (in case of ongoing studies) with your application.

• Due to regulations, non-EU/EFTA citizens must provide a certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory as part of the application documents, and mus

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione All'interno di People & Culture (P&C), People Insights & Technology (PI&T) scatena le persone esponenziali e l'impatto commerciale attraverso il processo decisionale, le intuizioni attuabili e l'abbracciamento della tecnologia orientata alle persone. Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Au sein de People & Culture (P&C), People Insights & Technology (PI&T) libère des personnes exponentielles et un impact commercial grâce à la prise de décision axée sur les données, à des idées concrètes et à une technologie axée sur les personnes. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un stagiaire motivé et curieux pour rejoindre notre domaine de pratique People Insights pour un stage de 6 mois basé à Bâle, en Suisse, à partir d'août. Dans ce rôle, vous collaborerez étroitement avec les scientifiques de l'Organisation sur les initiatives de recherche appliquée et d'analyse des personnes. Dans ce rôle, vous appuierez l'équipe en procédant à des examens de la documentation, en recueillant et en analysant les données des employés, en découvrant des idées exploitables et en appuyant des décisions fondées sur des données probantes qui améliorent l'expérience des employés et leur efficacité organisationnelle. • Effectuer des recherches documentaires ciblées et synthétiser les données probantes sur des sujets clés (p. ex. impact de l'IA sur les effectifs et le leadership, expérience des employés)
• Maintenir et mettre à jour des répertoires de documentation partagés pour une utilisation en équipe continue Conception et exécution de la recherche

• Contribuer à la production d'hypothèses et évaluer la faisabilité des approches de recherche Analyse de données et perspectives Communication
• Soutenir l'analyse des données sur les personnes afin de découvrir des informations utiles
• Résumer et visualiser les constatations pour des présentations claires des parties prenantes Qui vous êtes
• Un étudiant ambitieux qui poursuit ou a récemment obtenu un diplôme en psychologie industrielle/organisationnelle, comportement organisationnel, RH ou disciplines connexes (dans les 12 mois suivant la date de début). Par ailleurs, les doctorants actuellement inscrits à un programme de doctorat sont également encouragés à postuler.
• Vous avez une base solide dans les méthodes de recherche (p. ex. enquêtes, expériences, psychométrie) et les statistiques, développées par la formation académique, le travail de thèse ou l'application pratique; l'expérience de la programmation statistique (p. ex. R, Python) est un atout.
• Vous êtes à l'aise de travailler avec la littérature scientifique et pouvez évaluer et traduire les résultats de la recherche en idées claires et pratiques pour un public d'affaires
• Vous êtes passionné par les sujets de People & Culture (p. ex. impact de l'IA sur la main-d'œuvre/leadership; expérience des employés)

• Expérience pratique en collaboration avec des scientifiques d'organisations et des professionnels de l'analyse des personnes
