jobs.title: Procurement Manager - Clinical Laboratories
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Procurement Manager - Clinical Laboratories role sits within the Indirect Procurement Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. The Indirect Procurement Delivery group comprises many communities grouping categories of the same value chain or having commonality, including Research & Development, Commercial and Corporate Services, Digital & Technology, and Facilities. The communities are key enablers of strong category expertise while allowing flexibility in the procurement delivery response to the evolving needs of our customers.

The Opportunity:

• You will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Applying both general procurement and specialized knowledge or expertise in a specific commodity or spend area, you will ensure effective and efficient delivery of core procurement services and continuous improvement of automation and content availability.

• You will collaborate closely with internal procurement (i.e. Chapters and capability areas such as customer relationship management, contracting, solutions, analytics, etc.) and business stakeholders to translate business needs into sourcing and spend management activities and content enhancement.

• You will work closely with other team members to support customer demand, improve the customer buying experience, deliver on day-to day operational activities, and provide capacity and expertise to deliver productivity and other customer oriented projects/solutions.

• You are a Category and sourcing subject matter specialist in Clinical Laboratories conducting market and internal analysis to develop strategies and tactical plans for how Roche should source and negotiate for third party goods and services in order to satisfy stakeholder requirements.

• You are a Procurement delivery practitioner delivering and executing sourcing strategies by leveraging spend, category know-how, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, supplier management methodologies and frameworks and project management skills.

• You develop content and automation, translating sourcing outcomes and opportunities into content and automated buying channels that improve business adoption, satisfaction, and overall efficiency.

Who you are:

• You hold a university degree, preferably in business or a scientific related discipline like Biological/Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biochemistry or related field.

• You have proven procurement experience in strategic sourcing, category strategy building and strategic project execution with general contracting understanding and proficiency or relevant related commodity experience, preferably in the Pharmaceutical industry.

• You have experience in procurement systems, processes and skills in project management.

• You possess knowledge and experience in the Clinical Laboratories commodity area (Genomics and Genetics, Bio

jobs.title: R&D Spezialist (m/w/d) HPLC
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Für unseren Bereich Instrumental Analytics - Spectrometry and Separation Science suchen wir Dich als engagierte Persönlichkeit für eine Schlüsselrolle in unserer Forschung und Entwicklung. Der Fokus dieser Position liegt auf der Bearbeitung komplexer analytischer Fragestellungen jenseits der Routine.

Als R&D Spezialist (m/w/d) HPLC bist Du maßgeblich an der Entwicklung und Optimierung robuster Methoden zur Charakterisierung chemischer und biochemischer Einsatzstoffe beteiligt. Bringe Deine exzellente Fachexpertise ein, um die hohen Qualitätsstandards unserer Diagnostik nachhaltig zu sichern und zu prägen.

Das erwartet Dich in der Rolle

• Du verantwortest die Entwicklung und Optimierung neuer und bestehender Analysemethoden (HPLC, UPLC, ESI-MS).

• Planung und selbstständige Durchführung anspruchsvoller chromatographischer und spektrometrischer Analysen.

• Du bist verantwortlich für die Validierung und den Transfer der Analysenmethoden in andere Abteilungen (z.B. QC).

• Auswertung von Rohdaten, Interpretation der Ergebnisse und Erstellung aller notwendigen technischen Dokumente (Berichte, SOPs) in Deutsch und Englisch.

• Die Pflege, Wartung und das Troubleshooting der komplexen Analysegeräte fallen in deinen Aufgabenbereich.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Auftraggebern und aktive Beteiligung an der Arbeitsorganisation und den Sicherheitsfunktionen.

Wer du bist

• Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor, Master oder Diplom) in Chemie, Lebensmittelchemie oder Pharmazie.

• Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung in der instrumentellen Analytik (mindestens 2–4 Jahre, je nach Abschluss).

• Du verfügst über fundierte theoretische und praktische Kenntnisse in HPLC/UPLC/LCMS und Massenspektrometrie, insbesondere in der Methodenentwicklung.

• Vertrautheit mit Anforderungen im regulierten Umfeld (GxP) und relevanten Qualitätsrichtlinien der Pharmaindustrie sowie Prozessaffinität.

• Deine Persönlichkeit zeichnet sich durch hohe Motivation, Flexibilität, eigenständiges Arbeiten und Freude an der Teamarbeit aus.

• Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab.

Diese Position ist auf zwei Jahre befristet.

Deine Bewerbung

Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf und Zeugnissen.
Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt.

Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Senior Talent Acqusition Partner - LATAM

titleByLocale.it: Partner senior per l'acquisizione di talenti - LATAM

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

We have co-created a forward-looking recruitment model designed to secure top-tier talent while prioritizing the needs of our customers and patients. Our services are tailored to organizational requirements, with a commitment to quality and efficiency. As a Talent Acquisition Partner, you will work across borders within an empowered, self-organized environment. You will support team development and deliver exceptional candidate and stakeholder experiences by leveraging diverse talent and specialized expertise.

The Position

• Drive the end-to-end global standardized recruiting process while providing customized talent acquisition strategies, employer branding, and expert candidate selection and offer negotiation.

• Act as a professional consultant and strategic partner to global teams for comprehensive talent acquisition needs, including proactive sourcing and hiring.

• Demonstrate leadership by partnering with hiring managers and senior business leaders to build, develop, and sustain high-performing teams.

• Lead cross-regional recruitment initiatives and manage complex transformation projects, interpreting business challenges to recommend best practices that enhance our ability to attract top-tier talent.

• Collaborate seamlessly with Rewards, People Services, Business Partnering, and People Relations to execute global recruitment strategies.

• Empower and coach team members to drive organizational growth, proficiently mentoring individuals and global teams within the recruiting function.

• Proactively develop talent pipelines using advanced applicant tracking and sourcing tools, while staying at the forefront of global recruitment trends.

Who you are

• University degree with 6+ years of proven recruiting experience in a corporate, biotech, or pharmaceutical environment.

• Fluency in Spanish and English is mandatory; Portuguese language skills are highly desirable.

• Proven recruiting experience across different countries in Latin America

• Superior stakeholder management capabilities, with a focus on effective communication, influencing, and collaborative partnering.

• High learning agility, capable of spotting patterns, processes, and influencing outcomes.

• Technical expertise in diverse sourcing, direct sourcing, web recruitment tools, offer process/systems management, and proactive talent/candidate sourcing with various ATS systems, Workday and Phenom preferred

• Possesses an enterprise mindset, excelling in ambiguous situations, and demonstrating strong business acumen.

• Strong consultative problem-solving skills, an agile mindset, and the ability to champion organizational change.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Missions:
Dans le cadre de l’application de la réglementation Française, des directives du Groupe et des normes, le spécialiste SHE définit et garantit le bon fonctionnement et le suivi des procédures liées à la Santé, la Sécurité, l’Hygiène et l’Environnement (SHE) afin de prévenir et réduire les risques SHE au sein de l’entreprise.
Par ailleurs, le spécialiste SHE fait vivre la politique SHE du Groupe Roche au sein de la filiale.

Principales Responsabilités:

DU et Prévention des Risques Physiques et Psychosociaux au travail

• Il est également responsable de l’analyse et de la prévention des risques inhérents aux postes de travail, que ce soit au siège, en itinérance ou chez nos Clients, en lien avec notre DUERP, afin de mener des actions ciblés (ex : risque routier, geste et posture, EPI, ergonomie, etc)

• Il participe à la détection, la prise en charge et le suivi des potentiels cas de RPS en lien avec les parties prenantes que sont les RH, les élus et le pôle santé

• Il a la responsabilité partagée du suivi de l’accidentologie et la gestion administrative associées (enquête suite à accident, déclaration, tenue des registres, reporting etc…) et d’identifier si besoin les actions correctives immédiates afin de limiter le risque - notamment en lien avec les initiatives groupe

• Il organise des visites périodiques des installations avec les parties prenantes pour s’assurer de la bonne conformité et application des mesures de sécurité du site.

Onboarding des nouveaux collaborateurs et Veille règlementaire

• Organisation des formations SHE : identification des besoins, planification, suivi démarche d'accueil des nouveaux embauchés, mais également suivi et organisation des formations de recyclage (habilitations électriques, SST, etc)

• Est responsable que l’entreprise soit toujours à jour des évolutions réglementaires dans les domaines sécurité des personnes et environnement, dans ses pratiques et procédures ainsi que dans la mise à jour de la plateforme du Groupe.

Gestion des déchets

• Amélioration de nos processus et solutions pour réduire la production de nos déchets sur le site et suivi des déchets chez nos prestataires (notamment DEEE)

Reporting

• Définit et réalise en temps et en heures les reporting associés à son activité

• Participe au comité de pilotage RSE et à l’élaboration du rapport annuel

• Actions de communication sur l’ensemble des activités

• Prépare les sujets CSSCT en lien avec son expertise

Audit SHE et SQB

• Mise en place d’audits auprès des fournisseurs critiques (dans le cadre d’une qualification ou d’un suivi : audit documentaire ou physique)

• Participe au Supplier Quality Board (SQB)

Biosafety Officer

• Evaluation et gestion des risques biologiques et chimiques

• Sensibiliser, former les collaborateurs aux bonnes pratiques

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

he Scientific Comms & Engagement pillar within our global Patient Safety & Medical Affairs (PSMA) organization builds the high-scale digital engines that protect patients and accelerate science. This organization delivers the global platforms essential to modern, data-driven medical affairs, including enterprise scientific communication workflows, global medical information management and AI-enabled content architecture across dozens of global affiliates.

We are seeking an elite, tech-first Head of Product (Senior Product Leader) . This is a high-visibility, executive-level people-leadership position. It is not an administrative business relationship management function. We are looking for a visionary technology executive and organizational leader who can command a room of senior medical executives, manage large scale cross-functional engineering teams, dismantle legacy application silos and architect a modern, scalable product ecosystem.

You will own the end-to-end technology lifecycle and the people ecosystem for this vital portfolio. Your core challenge is driving organizational transformation: converting complex, global business requirements into robust technical specifications, while building the engineering talent, governing the global vendors and managing the cultural change required to execute a modern content and data strategy.

Key Responsibilities & Strategic Objectives

• Enterprise Leadership & Business Partnering: Act as an equal, authoritative technology partner to senior Medical Affairs business executives. Provide the digital thought leadership necessary to push operational boundaries, automate complex workflows and aggressively consolidate fragmented legacy systems.

• In-House Engineering Talent Transformation: Inherit, mentor and actively scale a high-performing global team of product leaders, software engineers and domain experts. Execute a strategy designed to upskill internal talent and strategically insource core software development and configuration capabilities

• Global Vendor & Managed Service Governance: Maintain strict operational and financial accountability for multi-million-dollar budgets. Oversee, evaluate and hold accountable global managed service providers and software vendors, ensuring absolute alignment with our internal software engineering principles.

• Tech Strategy & Landscape Consolidation: Shape the mid-to-long-term technical roadmap for the portfolio. Lead your teams to actively migrate the legacy landscape away from fragmented, aging infrastructure onto a single, modern and highly integrated product ecosystem.

• Architecting the Content "Golden Source": Drive the technical strategy and global implementation for our enterprise content blueprint, anchoring our data architecture in modern cloud frameworks to eliminate operational duplication and ensure seamless asset lifecycle management.

• Advanced AI & Cross-Platform Convergence: Lead the technical evaluation, production scaling and cross-functional alignment for next-generation automation initiatives. This includes directing teams to deploy AI-enabled narratives and intelligent content generation tools globally, while merging early-stage insight platforms onto a unified, high-performing text and data stack.

La posizione lui Scientific Comms & Engagement pilastro all'interno della nostra organizzazione globale per la sicurezza dei pazienti e gli affari medici (PSMA) costruisce i motori digitali di alto livello che proteggono i pazienti e accelerano la scienza. Questa organizzazione fornisce le piattaforme globali essenziali per gli affari medici moderni e basati sui dati, compresi i flussi di lavoro di comunicazione scientifica aziendale, la gestione globale delle informazioni mediche e l'architettura dei contenuti abilitata all'IA in decine di affiliati globali. Siamo alla ricerca di una tecnologia visionaria leader esecutivo e organizzativo che può comandare una stanza di dirigenti medici senior, gestire team di ingegneria cross-functional su larga scala, smantellare applicazioni legacy silos e architetto un ecosistema di prodotto moderno e scalabile. Possiederai il ciclo di vita della tecnologia end-to-end e l'ecosistema delle persone per questo portafoglio vitale. La vostra sfida principale è la trasformazione organizzativa: la conversione di requisiti aziendali complessi e globali in solide specifiche tecniche, mentre la costruzione del talento ingegneristico, il governo dei fornitori globali e la gestione del cambiamento culturale necessario per eseguire una moderna strategia di contenuti e dati. Eseguire una strategia progettata per upskill talento interno e strategicamente insource core software sviluppo e capacità di configurazione
• Global Vendor & Managed Service Governance: Mantenere una rigida responsabilitÃ operativa e finanziaria per i bilanci multimilionari. Superare, valutare e tenere responsabili fornitori di servizi gestiti globali e fornitori di software, garantendo un allineamento assoluto con i nostri principi di ingegneria software interni.
• Strategia Tech & Paesaggio Consolidamento: Formare la roadmap tecnica a medio-lungo termine per il portafoglio. Condurre i vostri team a migrare attivamente il paesaggio legacy lontano da frammentate infrastrutture di invecchiamento su un unico, moderno e altamente integrato ecosistema di prodotti.

titleByLocale.it: Security Ingegnere - RDT Vulnerability & Exposure Management
titleByLocale.en: Security Engineer - RDT Vulnerability & Exposure Management
titleByLocale.de: Security Ingenieur - RDT Vulnerability & Exposure Management

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Security Monitoring and Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche strives to keep our networks and users safe from constantly evolving threats. As a Security Engineer on the Vulnerability and Exposure Management Team, you will help protect sensitive data and defend computer systems and web applications from existing and emerging threats. You will not just be managing scanner output. You will help manage and reduce existing risks, assess and evaluate the weaponization of emerging risks, and act as a core builder of our future capabilities.

The Opportunity
As an integrated part of the Vulnerability and Exposure Management team, your main responsibilities include :

• Triage, investigate, and respond to critical vulnerabilities affecting Roche.

• Evaluate and prioritize vulnerabilities found through our tools, including our bug-bounty program.

• Research emerging vulnerabilities and develop methods to confirm exploitability against our attack surface.

• Communicate risk and work with system owners and other stakeholders to mitigate security vulnerabilities.

• Assess company systems and web applications using both automated and manual tools.

• Maintain, improve, and engineer our scanning, detection, and automation solutions.

• Participating in security monitoring for a global environment.

Who you are

• You hold an Associate Degree in a relevant field or 5+ years of experience in the information security field .

• You possess a demonstrated ability to triage, analyze, and escalate security vulnerabilities.

• You have experience with attack surface management in a large and global environment.

• You bring programming experience (e.g., Python, Node.js, JavaScript) combined with a familiarity with modern, AI-assisted code development and engineering workflows.

• You display a strong emphasis on web application, network, and computer security, along with experience validating vulnerabilities and basic exploit development.

• You have a track record of contributing to open-source security projects and writing custom detection logic/templates/scripts.

• You have hands-on cloud security experience and a genuine passion for the field of computer and network security.

• You exhibit strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex risks to non-technical audiences, balancing operational tasks with research projects.

• You are fluent in English.

Preferred

• Industry certifications in the field of offensive security (e.g., OSCP, GWAPT, OSWE).

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Bereit, die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung aktiv mitzugestalten? Bei Roche verändern wir das Leben von Patient:innen jeden Tag aufs Neue. Für den Bereich Operations Near Patient Care – eine tragende Säule innerhalb der Global Diagnostic Operations – suchen wir ein kluges Köpfchen, das die Analyse, Stabilisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Geschäftsprozessen sowie den zugehörigen Geschäfts- und Logistiksystemen unterstützt. Als funktionale Brücke zwischen Business und IT trägst Du maßgeblich dazu bei, produktionskritische Abläufe zu sichern. Werde Teil unserer Reise innerhalb der Digital Operations und sorge mit Deinem praktischen Wissen für ein starkes Fundament, auf dem nachhaltiges Wachstum entstehen kann.

Dein neues Team:
Unser Team innerhalb der Digital Operations im Bereich Operations Near Patient Care lebt von Vielfalt, gegenseitigem Vertrauen und einer engen, cross-funktionalen Zusammenarbeit. Wir sind ein dynamisches Team, das gemeinsam an zukunftsweisenden Lösungen feilt, Best Practices teilt und sich gegenseitig unterstützt. Hier erwartet Dich ein lebendiges Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Deine Stimme zählt und neue Ideen ausdrücklich erwünscht sind.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich

• Du unterstützt die Bereitstellung und Koordination des lösungsspezifischen Supports für zugewiesene Geschäfts- und Logistiksysteme.

• Du analysierst und behebst funktionale Störungen sowie Prozessunterbrechungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen und der IT.

• Du bearbeitest funktionale System- und Prozessthemen im SAP ECC 6.0 Umfeld, insbesondere in den Bereichen Materialwirtschaft, Produktionsplanung, PP-PI und Fertigungssteuerung.

• Du unterstützt die Identifikation von wiederkehrenden Problemen oder Systemstörungen, um zu nachhaltigen Lösungen für produktionskritische Abläufe wie MES-Schnittstellen, Scan- oder Drucklösungen beizutragen.

• Du begleitest die Definition und Pflege von Standards für die unterstützten Systeme und Prozesse im Rahmen von kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen.

• Du wirkst bei der Bewertung von Geschäftsanforderungen mit, unterstützt die Durchführung von funktionalen Tests sowie Regressionstests und stellst eine nachvollziehbare Dokumentation sicher.

• Du erstellst und pflegst Schulungsunterlagen sowie Systemdokumentationen und führst Wissenstransfers für Key-User und Endanwendende durch.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens, Supply Chain / Operations, der Informatik, des Ingenieurwesens oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

• Relevante Berufserfahrung (3–5 Jahre mit Bachelor bzw. 2–4 Jahre mit Master), idealerweise mit ersten Erfahrungen in der Projektarbeit.

• Fundierte konzeptionelle und praktische Kenntnisse im Geschäftsprozessmanagement sowie im Bereich von Geschäfts- und Logistiksystemen, idealerweise in einem ERP-Umfeld.

• Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung (mindestens 3 Jahre) im SAP ECC 6.0 Support, insbesondere in den Modulen SAP MM, PP und PP-PI (wie Bestandsführung, Fertigungs- und Prozessaufträge oder Chargenmanagement).

• Praktisches Verständnis von Fertigungsumgebungen sowie der Unterstützung von Schnittstellen, MES-Prozessen, IDoc-Verarbeitung oder dem Output-Management.

• Strukturierte Fähigkeiten zur Problemlösung, ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung sowie die Kompetenz zur klaren Kommunikation zwischen technischen Teams und den Fachbereichen.

jobs.title: Finance Enterprise Partner Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Purpose: As the FEP Lead, you will bridge the gap between commercial strategy and financial expertise. Your mission is to partner with the business to drive strategic commercial decisions incorporating an end-to-end view while simplifying how we operate daily and ensuring that every decision supports the sustainable growth of the company.
In this role, you will lead a team of 5 professionals and report directly to the Finance Manager as their strategic sparring partner while collaborating closely with the Sales and Marketing teams.

The Opportunity:

• Coach team members: Mentor the 5 Finance Enterprise Partners in your team to accelerate their professional development and drive high performance.

• Drive operational change: Foster a culture of simplicity and continuous improvement by challenging old habits and refining team processes.

• Strengthen governance and risk: Ensure compliance with financial practices and established processes, maintaining lean, "fit-for-purpose" operational processes.

• Support commercial growth: Partner with the commercial organization on product launches and customer pricing decisions, evaluating individual commercial opportunities to ensure sustainable business outcomes.

• Drive P&L improvements: Propose and scale initiatives to optimize the P&L, focusing on upselling opportunities, efficiency and waste reduction, and risk mitigation.

• Elevate performance management: Lead the sales planning and reporting processes in close collaboration with the Performance Finance Enterprise Partner Lead, monitoring commercial results and advising on corrective actions to meet financial objectives.

Who you are:

• University degree in Finance, Business, Engineering or a related discipline, with 5+ years of relevant professional experience.

• Experience in finance business partnering and proven ability to collaborate beyond the finance function; prior mentoring or guiding of small teams is highly valued (formal leadership not required).

• Fluency in Spanish and English.

• Coaching & empowering leadership style: develops people, elevates performance, and drives a unified, consistent way of working; challenges the status quo with a continuous improvement and process optimization mindset (simplifying, standardizing, and automating with an enterprise view).

• Strategic business partner who connects financial insights with business realities to confidently challenge decisions and advise stakeholders as a trusted partner; shortlisted candidates will be invited to a video assessment.

#LI-DC1

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Regulatory Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This role sits within our Regulatory Affairs division . We operate with a holistic approach to project and product realization, ensuring that we maintain strict compliance while continuously accelerating innovation for our customers and patients .

The Opportunity
As a Regulatory Affairs Project Manager, your day-to-day focus will center on managing stakeholders, navigating complex compliance pathways, and driving product approvals . Your core responsibilities will be distributed across the following key areas:

• Regulatory Submissions : Oversee the development of medium-to-high complexity submission and product registration dossiers; apply a deep understanding of global healthcare regulatory frameworks to secure marketing approvals from health authorities .

• Teamwork & Collaboration: Pull cross-functional groups together around common goals, build on different perspectives to enhance project outcomes, and resolve conflicts by creating an atmosphere of openness and trust .

• Stakeholder Management: Effectively communicate and partner with internal and external teams to understand requirements and deliver optimal solutions, developing relationships that significantly influence the future direction of Roche products .

• Communication & Agile Frameworks: Use agile principles to drive regulatory activities . Foster an open exchange of ideas amongst key stakeholders to shift perspectives, reach common outcomes, and reflect multiple viewpoints on complex issues .

• Decision Making & Leadership: Work day-to-day with minimal guidance to correctly execute scheduled and unscheduled activities . Live the spirit of "We all lead" using VACC principles, persuading and supporting colleagues over whom you have no direct authority .

• Problem Solving & Agile Mindset: Independently troubleshoot operational issues, develop cost-effective solutions to maintain compliance, and actively simplify processes to increase productivity across Q&R .

Who you are

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Science, Data Science, or a related subject (or possess equivalent qualification/completed training as a laboratory technician) .

• You bring at least 5 years of professional experience (5–10 years preferred) working within Regulatory, R&D, Quality, Operations, and/or Clinical environments .

• You have a proven track record handling healthcare regulatory affairs and can confidently manage high-complexity work or global projects .

• You are capable of working independently with minimal supervision, taking the initiative to generate new ideas, try fresh approaches, and present well-formulated solutions .

• You possess strong communication and social competencies, with the ability to navigate direct, open discussions and guide diverse viewpoints to a unified direction .

• You are willing and able to accommodate business travel as required by project demands .

Preferred

• Familiarity and experience with FDA IVD regulations and EU IVDR regulations highly preferred.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

jobs.title: Technical Business Analyst Europe - RDT Identity & Access Management

titleByLocale.it: Technical Business Analista Europe - RDT Identity & Access Management
titleByLocale.en: Technical Business Analyst Europe - RDT Identity & Access Management
titleByLocale.de: Technical Business Analyst Europe - RDT Identity & Access Management
titleByLocale.fr: Technical Business Analyste Europe - RDT Identity & Access Management

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description / Description of the Area
We are seeking a skilled and motivated Technical Business Analyst with experience in Customer Identity & Access Management (CIAM) to support the delivery and continuous improvement of customer identity services.
The successful candidate will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating business needs into clear requirements and ensuring scalable, secure, and user-centric CIAM solutions. This role combines business analysis, technical understanding, stakeholder engagement, and delivery support in a complex enterprise environment.

Key Responsibilities
Business Analysis and Requirements Management

• Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to customer identity, registration, authentication, consent, profile management, and access journeys.

• Translate business needs into functional and technical requirements, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria.

• Challenge and refine requirements to ensure clarity, feasibility, and business value.

• Support prioritization of demand, backlog items, and roadmap initiatives.

Solution Design and Delivery Support

• Work closely with architects, engineers, and product teams to shape fit-for-purpose CIAM solutions.

• Support design discussions by bringing process, customer journey, and business context.

• Ensure requirements are traceable through delivery, testing, and implementation.

• Participate in release planning, change activities, and deployment readiness.

Stakeholder Management and Collaboration

• Engage with business, security, legal, compliance, digital, and IT stakeholders across multiple functions.

• Facilitate workshops, requirement sessions, and decision meetings.

• Communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and options clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.

Governance, Risk, and Compliance

• Support alignment with privacy and regulatory requirements such as GDPR and related frameworks.

• Ensure customer identity processes reflect governance, auditability, and security expectations.

• Contribute to control documentation and evidence gathering where required.

Continuous Improvement

• Identify pain points, inefficiencies, and opportunities to simplify CIAM processes and customer journeys.

• Support KPI tracking, service improvement initiatives, and process optimization.

• Stay informed on CIAM trends, identity standards, and digital customer expectations.

Qualifications
Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is also valued.

Experience

• Proven experience as a Business Analyst, Technical Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role.

• Experience in Identity & Access Management, Customer Identity, digital platforms, or customer-facing systems.

• Experience working in enterprise delivery environments with multiple stakeholders.

Technical Skills

• Strong understanding of CIAM concepts such as registration, authentication, SSO, MFA, consent, profile lifecycle, and access control.

• Familiarity with identity standards such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and SAML.

jobs.title: Becario de crédito y Finanzas
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Sobre Roche
Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

Oportunidad
Esta es una oportunidad de aprendizaje dentro de nuestro departamento de Finanzas , específicamente en los procesos de cobranza y control financiero. Aquí desarrollarás experiencia técnica con capacitación y acompañamiento continuo, en un ambiente profesional, innovador y colaborativo.

Responsabilidades

• Gestión de Cartera: Administrar la recuperación oportuna de la cartera de clientes de acuerdo con la política de crédito y cobranza.

• Control de Pedidos: Ejecutar la liberación de pedidos en el sistema, revisando importes, límites de crédito y vencimientos, gestionando las autorizaciones necesarias.

• Maestro de Datos: Asegurar que la creación y mantenimiento de clientes sea correcta en el sistema, colaborando estrechamente con RSS, área comercial, contratos y squads.

• Procesos Administrativos: Generación de Notas de Crédito (NDC) por descuentos comerciales.

Para integrarte a nuestro equipo de Finanzas , buscamos el siguiente perfil:

• Perfil Académico: Ser estudiante activo de la carrera de Finanzas , Contaduría, Administración o afines.

• Disponibilidad: Capacidad para realizar la pasantía por un periodo mínimo de 1 año y medio (18 meses) .

• Habilidades: Persona organizada, metódica, con atención al detalle y mentalidad innovadora.

• Actitud: Excelente comunicación, actitud proactiva y un alto compromiso con su desarrollo profesional.

•

Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Die Abteilung Pharma Technical Characterization Cell and Genetherapy (PTCG ) ist verantwortlich für die technische Entwicklung von in vivo Gentherapeutika in der präklinischen und klinischen Entwicklungsphase.

Das Team
Die Funktion Gentherapie-Analytik konzentriert sich auf die analytische Charakterisierung, Qualitätskontrolle sowie die Entwicklung und Implementierung neuartiger analytischer Technologien von präklinischen Studien bis zur Marktzulassung (BLA, Biologics License Application) und Markteinführung für gentherapeutische Modalitäten.

Deine Aufgaben
Wir suchen Dich mit speziellem Fokus auf Liquid Handling und Automation analytischer Methoden für die Testung und Charakterisierung von viralen Vektoren und Plasmiden . Zudem übernimmst du Projektverantwortung für Gentherapie Portfolioprojekte in der Entwicklung.

• Automation & Innovation: Scouting, Evaluierung, Entwicklung sowie die Implementierung und routinemäßige Anwendung innovativer vollautomatisierter E2E Lösungen von Methoden für die Charakterisierung von viralen Vektoren (vorwiegend rAAV) und Plasmiden.

• Portfolio Projektverantwortung: Du bist zentraler Ansprechpartner in präklinischen sowie klinischen Phasen für Gentherapie Portfolioprojekte, agierst als Vertreter der Analytischen Entwicklung und Qualitätskontrolle in den Technical Development Teams (TDT) und koordinierst anstehende Aufgaben innerhalb der Teams unter Berücksichtigung der Timelines.

• Funktionelle Analyse : Vorantreiben der Technologien zur Quantifizierung und funktionellen Charakterisierung in einem hochmotivierten, agilen und interdisziplinären Team.

• Praktische Durchführung: Eigenverantwortliche, selbstorganisierte Durchführung von Experimenten, Methodenentwicklung sowie Gerätequalifizierung und Test-Validierung unter GMP-Anforderungen inklusive der Durchführung der Analysen.

• Strategische Mitwirkung: Mitarbeit bei der Entwicklung und Definition von Kontroll- und Prüfstrategien für gentherapeutische Vektorenprodukte.

• Datenmanagement: Selbstständige Interpretation, Bewertung und Dokumentation von Daten sowie Erstellung von Analyseberichten gemäß den geltenden regulatorischen Vorschriften.

Unser Wunschprofil

jobs.title: Enabling Support Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The P&C Enabling Support Network (ESN) is a self-organized global Network of P&C Enabling Support Specialists supporting the P&C world-wide integrated network. The P&C Enabling Support Specialist is a passionate, agile, client focused professional, located in a global support network which is the foundation of the P&C organization and enabler of its success. This position is future-oriented in business support and administration of the worldwide integrated network, connecting the dots across all functions.

Your Opportunity

• Partnering with different stakeholders using agile methodologies, contributing to strategic project management, planning and managing events.

• Providing technology support and continuous improvement of processes, implementation of embedded technology within the network.

• Taking an active role in developing our self-organized P&C Enabling Support Network further, while contributing to network related initiatives and projects.

• Providing support to global, regional & local P&C colleagues on a variety of tasks and levels of complexity. (e.g. complex travel and expense management, support for large events, complex meeting structures,).

• Handle local site/chapter specific requests Line manager can also add any specifics here if appropriate.

• On-site presence is a minimum of 3 days a week.

Who you are

• You hold a university degree/commercial diploma (or equivalent work experience) and a related experience in People & Culture, business support, professional assistance and/or event management, dynamic project coordination/ management and working experience in a team or network.

• Experienced and efficient handling of standard IT-applications, preferably Google suite.

• Fluent in English required, additional languages a plus, based on region (i.e. German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Hungarian, Chinese.

Behaviors, competencies, and qualities of the ideal P&C Enabling Support Network

• Passionate about people and have the ability to build trusted relationships and strong networks in order to connect individuals, teams and chapters.

• Able to work and lead with a creative mindset, high flexibility and adaptability for proactive and professional enabling support.

• Have an open, positive, growth mindset and system thinking, proven ability to work effectively across a matrix environment (P&C chapters, AoPs), global/local teams and networks in a fast paced environment.

• Embracing technology/digital tools for new ways of working to leverage impact within the P&C Enabling Support and for supported partners in the chapters.

• Openly communicating, enabling transparency and empathy amongst all.

• Working with a high degree of confidentiality.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Indianapolis is 53,400.00 - 99,200.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

jobs.title: Field Application Specialist | Clinical Chemistry/Haematology
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It is what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That is what makes us Roche.

This is a post-sales position in which predominant job responsibilities and requirements occur after the sale of the company’s product to the client. This role provides post-sales technical expertise during the installation, implementation and maintenance of company products, and may be involved in implementing detailed customer installation requirements. Key purpose of the role is to ensure that client’s needs have been met and that the product/solution is fully functioning according to specification and provide follow-up support to company sales staff and customer personnel by disseminating technical information on specific applications.

As a member of our Service and Support Community / Field Applications Specialists team, you will be primarily responsible for providing technical support and expertise to existing and potential customers across NSW & ACT, but also occasionally nationally.

In this Sydney based full time permanent position, you will be using your previous experience and training to install, train and provide troubleshooting assistance for Roche instrumentation, software and reagent systems, in hospitals, private pathology and medical research laboratories.

Who you are

You are someone who wants to influence your own development, is passionate about making a difference and comfortable with a constant changing environment. You are looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across the functions and geographies, and where a job title is not considered the final destination of who you are, but the starting point.

You will ideally possess a relevant degree / diploma in Science / Laboratory Science plus minimum 3 years’ experience within a Clinical Chemistry/ Hematology Laboratory . You will have demonstrable ability to diagnose applications and operational issues on analytical systems and to successfully resolve issues in a timely manner.

You will have excellent communication skills with the ability to present to groups. Also required is an ability to work independently or as part of a team, and exceptional planning and organizational skills.

Your strong computer literacy with a working knowledge of MS Office, experience in Laboratory workflow assessment / LIS with desirable experience in Digital Imaging and superior customer service skills are pivotal to the success of Roche, therefore we expect our new team member to be customer focused, self motivated and enjoy working in a team environment.

A valid driver’s license is essential.

In return, you will be provided with a rewarding and challenging role, a supportive work environment in which you can grow and develop your skills, the opportunity to work for a market leading organisation, and a competitive remuneration package.

This role is only open to candidates that have full eligibility to live and work in Australia.

We do not accept any unsolicited resumes or enquiries from recruitment agencies. Roche has a dedicated in-house Talent Acquisition team.

What we offer
Roche offers rewarding growth opportunities, a competitive remuneration package and a collaborative culture where people are united in purpose and will stretch you to be brave, speak up and think differently. Feel emp

jobs.title: Filling Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:
● Participate in new facility design and construction, including but not limited to process design, FAT, SAT, IOPQ, smoke study, VHP, Isolator EMPQ, APS etc. to contribute to project delivery.
● Support the initial development and optimization of aseptic filling processes.
● Participate in the implementation of operation readiness, eg: draft equipment operation procedures and logbook, 5S, machine cleaning according to readiness plan.
● Trained and qualified on equipment operation and aseptic techniques.
● Perform other duties as assigned.

Routine Operation:
● Ensure routine operation in compliance with Roche’s GMP/SHE and regulation requirements.
● Performing the following tasks: e.g. vial washing, filling and stoppering, capping.
● Train new employees and enhance the professional capabilities of the team.
● Support environmental monitoring activities to ensure that the Isolatore environment meets aseptic standards.
● Handle deviations during production and implement CAPA.
● Diagnose and resolve equipment malfunctions promptly with the support of maintenance engineers to minimize downtime.
● Execute regular validation activities, such as APS.
● Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and traceability for the activities in the GMP area.
● Related IT system operations, such as SAP, MES, Veeva, Cornerstone.
● Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualification and Experience
Education/
• Qualifications
● College’s Degree (Pharmaceutical / Biological is preferred) and above.

Job Required Competencies
● 5 or more years’ operation experience in the injection pharmaceutical industry, MNC Bio-pharma preferred.
● Experienced in strategic projects of Aseptic Filling facility including design, commissioning & qualification，Isolator filling line is preferred.
● Strong knowledge of cGMP and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry, especially in the biological industry.
● Fluent communications skills in English is preferred and the ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, and foster positive interactions with team members and stakeholders.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Principle Roles &
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness: ● Participate in new facility design and construction, including but not limited to process design, FAT, SAT, IOPQ, smoke study, VHP, Isolator EMPQ, APS etc. to contribute to project delivery. ● Support the initial development and optimization of aseptic filling processes. ● Participate in the implementation of operation readiness, eg: draft equipment operation procedures and logbook, 5S, machine cleaning according to readiness plan. ● Trained and qualified on equipment operation and aseptic techniques. ● Perform other duties as assigned. Routine Operation: ● Ensure routine operation in compliance with Roche’s GMP/SHE and regulation requirements. ● Performing the following tasks: e.g. vial washing, filling and stoppering, capping. ● Train new employees and enhance the professional capabilities of the team. ● Support environmental monitoring activities to ensure that the Isolatore environment meets aseptic standards. ● Handle deviations during production and implement CAPA. ● Diagnose and resolve equipment malfunctions promptly with the support of maintenance engineers to minimize downtime. ● Execute regular validation activities, such as APS. ● Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and traceability for the activities in the GMP area. ● Related IT system operations, such as SAP, MES, Veeva, Cornerstone. ● Perform other duties as assigned. Qualification and Experience Education/
• Qualifications ● College’s Degree (Pharmaceutical / Biological is preferred) and above. Job Required Competencies ● 5 or more years’ operation experience in the injection pharmaceutical industry, MNC Bio-pharma preferred. ● Experienced in strategic projects of Aseptic Filling facility including design, commissioning & qualification，Isolator filling line is preferred. ● Strong knowledge of cGMP and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry, especially in the biological industry. ● Fluent communications skills in English is preferred and the ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, and foster positive interactions with team members and stakeholders. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Medical Affairs (Field MSL) - Neuro - NSW/QLD
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. Join us in making this happen with:

• Effective customer engagement across NSW and QLD

• Expertise in the field of Neuroscience (Multiple sclerosis)

• Medical Science Liaison (MSL) experience within the healthcare setting

This field based Medical Affairs (MSL) position is internally referred to as the Medical Patient Journey Partner (M-PJP). This is a local customer facing role unlocking value along the patient journey - from mostly offering world-class medicines towards integrated solutions, much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption.

The M-PJP is a medical affairs role with a reporting line culminating with the Country Medical Director; this role has a Quality Use of Medicines (QUM) focus and operates at all times with non-promotional intent.

The M-PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, the ecosystem and the organisation, faster (the “triple win”).

What you will be working on:
The M-PJP is an empowered leader and the local medical affairs face of Roche who has decision making authority to request resources of Roche. In this role, you will be involved in:

• Scientific Leadership: Serve as a scientific expert for the company’s Neuroscience pipeline and marketed products, providing deep expertise to internal teams and external stakeholders.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Build and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), clinical investigators, and academic researchers within the Neuroscience field.

• Education & Training: Provide scientific education and training to healthcare professionals, internal teams, and partners, ensuring accurate, up-to-date information about our products.

• Evidence Generation and Clinical Support: Support clinical trial development by providing scientific insights and collaborating with clinical teams on ongoing and upcoming clinical trials.

• Data Communication: Effectively communicate complex scientific data, including clinical trial results, in a clear, concise manner to a wide range of audiences.

• Field Intelligence: Gather and analyze scientific and clinical insights from the field, and provide feedback to shape product strategy, development, and commercialization efforts.

• Compliance & Documentation: Ensure all interactions comply with industry regulations and ethical standards. Maintain accurate documentation of scientific activities.

Who you are:
As a driven medical affairs professional, you think from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, in order to bring best possible outcomes to both the local health environment, and more broadly, across Roche globally. You have:

• University degree (life sciences) and/or Healthcare professional qualification with practical understanding of digital innovation methodologies. An advanced degree in Life Sciences and/or MBA is a plus

• At least 5 years of demonstrated experience in the medical affairs or related field (e.g. MSL) within in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry with up to date knowledge of Medicines Australia Code of Conduct

• Scientific and Therapy Area expertise in Neuroscience in mapping patient journeys and related treatments in the assigned TA, enabling engagement at the specialist level

• Ro

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) as a Global Business Process Specialist Financial Compliance – Financial Approvals. In this role, you will be an integral part of the RSS Business Process Management Financial Compliance Chapter, reporting directly to the Financial Compliance Chapter Lead. We are looking for an outstanding professional ready to navigate complex global networks, champion process innovation, and safeguard financial compliance. At Roche, you will find a stable yet dynamically expanding environment that offers exceptional career paths, flexible working models, and the opportunity to leave your mark on global operations.

You will be :

As Global Business Process Specialist Financial Compliance – Financial Approvals you will be responsible for the following:

• Process Maintenance & Execution: Support the implementation of the E2E Business Process Management (BPM) strategy across the global Financial Approvals and Delegation of Authority (DoA) domain.

• Multi-Platform Configuration: Ensure the Financial Approvals Engine functions seamlessly across an integrated network of calling systems, including myBuy, SAP S/4HANA, Fieldglass, and MeetingSelect.

• Agile Delivery & Testing: Act as a key business representative within the Agile Release Train (ART). Translate regional business needs into actionable user stories, collaborate closely with IT delivery squads, and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

• Operational Compliance & Governance: Safeguard financial compliance by applying global guardrails to local requirements. Help implement complex legal and tax approval rules (such as regional hub overrides or specific contract-signing logic) without disrupting standard system performance.

• Root-Cause Analysis: Investigate system errors, workflow bottlenecks, and master data discrepancies. Perform root-cause analysis on compliance or operational issues and design practical, sustainable fixes.

• Process Monitoring & Reporting: Regularly review process performance metrics (e.g., system lead times, workflow exceptions) to identify areas for continuous improvement and lean optimization.

Who you are :
What can you bring to our team. We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. In order to provide innovative healthcare solutions to our patients, we need the best talent in our organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you would have:

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Informatics, Engineering or a comparable education . 5-7 years professional experience, preferably in Business Process Management, Information Management / IT, Finance/Procurement, Risk/Internal Control Management, Accounting, Audit

• Solid process knowledge in end-to-end finance and procurement workflows, with hands-on experience or strong technical familiarity with SAP FI/CO or SAP S/4HANA. Proven methodological skills in continuous improvement and process management (e.g., BPM, Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen) and experience working within an Agile framework (SAFe/Scrum).

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Partecipa a Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) come Global Business Process Specialist Financial Compliance – Financial Approvals. In questo ruolo, sarete parte integrante del Capitolo di Compliance Finanziaria di Gestione dei Processi RSS, riportando direttamente al Lead del Capitolo di Compliance Finanziaria. Siamo alla ricerca di un professionista eccezionale pronto a navigare reti globali complesse, innovazione di processo di campione, e salvaguardare la conformità finanziaria. A Roche, troverete un ambiente stabile ma dinamico che offre percorsi di carriera eccezionali, modelli di lavoro flessibili, e l'opportunità di lasciare il segno sulle operazioni globali. Lei sarà: Come Global Business Process Specialist Compliance finanziaria – Finanziaria Approvazioni sarete responsabili per i seguenti:

• Multi-Platform Configuration: Assicurare che il Financial Approvals Engine funzioni senza soluzione di continuità in una rete integrata di sistemi di chiamata, tra cui myBuy, SAP S/4HANA, Fieldglass e MeetingSelect.
• Agile Delivery & Testing: agire come rappresentante chiave del business all'interno del treno di rilascio Agile (ART). Traduci le esigenze di business regionali in storie di utenti attuabili, collabora a stretto contatto con le squadre di consegna IT e coordina il test di accettazione utente (UAT).
• Compliance operativa & Governance: salvaguardare la conformità finanziaria applicando le protezioni globali ai requisiti locali. Aiuta a implementare complesse regole di approvazione legale e fiscale (come i overrides del hub regionale o la logica specifica di contrassegno) senza interrompere le prestazioni del sistema standard.
• Analisi Root-Cause: Indaga errori di sistema, strozzature di flusso di lavoro e discrepanze di dati master. Eseguire l'analisi delle cause root sulle questioni di conformità o operative e progettare soluzioni pratiche e sostenibili.
• Monitoraggio del processo & Reporting: Rivedere regolarmente le metriche delle prestazioni del processo (ad esempio, tempi di guida del sistema, eccezioni del flusso di lavoro) per identificare le aree per il miglioramento continuo e l'ottimizzazione magra. Chi sei? Cosa puoi portare alla nostra squadra. Stiamo cercando qualcuno che è auto motivato, davvero appassionato del suo lavoro e capisce che fornire un servizio di alta qualità è fondamentale per l'organizzazione. Al fine di fornire soluzioni sanitarie innovative ai nostri pazienti, abbiamo bisogno del miglior talento nella nostra organizzazione. Come membro del team ideale siete open-minded, dedicato a fare la differenza e aperto allo sviluppo costante. Inoltre, avresti:
• Corso di laurea in Finanza, Business Administration, Informatica, Ingegneria o una formazione comparabile . 5-7 anni di esperienza professionale, preferibilmente in Business Process Management, Gestione delle informazioni / IT, Finanza / approvvigionamento, Risk/Internal Control Management, Contabilità, Audit
• Conoscenze di processo solide nei flussi di lavoro finanziari e di approvvigionamento end-to-end, con esperienza pratica o una forte familiarità tecnica con SAP FI/CO o SAP S/4HANA. Prove competenze metodologiche nel miglioramento continuo e nella gestione dei processi (ad esempio BPM, Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen) e nell'esperienza di lavoro all'interno di un quadro Agile (SAFe/Scrum).
• Ottima collaborazione, comunicazione e capacità di influenzare in modo efficace le esigenze degli stakeholder della finanza locale, degli stakeholder globali e dei team di template globali. Forte pensiero analitico e una mentalità innovativa per migliorare il processo creativo, abbinato w

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Finanzen, Betriebswirtschaft, Informatik, Ingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung . 5-7 Jahre Berufserfahrung, vorzugsweise in Business Process Management, Information Management / IT, Finanzen / Beschaffung, Risiko/Internal Control Management, Accounting, Audit

jobs.title: Head of Operations, APAC Hub
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Head of Operations, APAC Hub

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

We are looking for a strategic and results-driven Head of Operations APAC HUB to lead and oversee our outsourced Global Distribution HUB based in Singapore, serving the Asia Pacific region. This pivotal role is responsible for ensuring operational excellence, driving continuous performance improvement, and strengthening relationships with third-party logistics and distribution partners. The ideal candidate brings deep operational expertise, strong leadership capabilities, and a collaborative mindset to manage complex supply chain dynamics in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.

The Opportunity

• Strategic & Operational Leadership: Oversee and align end-to-end operations of the APAC Distribution HUB with corporate and regional strategies, contributing to the development and execution of long-term distribution plans.

• Performance & Compliance Management: Define, track, and optimize key performance indicators (KPIs) and service levels, while ensuring full compliance with global trade regulations, regional customs requirements, and contractual agreements with 3PL partners.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with a wide range of internal teams and external partners to streamline processes, enhance customer satisfaction, and manage governance frameworks.

• Financial & Inventory Oversight: Manage a significant annual operating budget (SGD 25M) and an extensive inventory stock (~SGD 200M), balancing cost-effectiveness with service excellence and ensuring accuracy and availability across the region.

• Team Leadership & Talent Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing operations team of more than 3 direct reports, fostering a culture of accountability and building future leadership pipelines.

• Continuous Improvement & Digital Transformation: Champion the adoption of digital tools, automation, and analytics to drive operational visibility, predictive planning, and continuous process improvements.

• Risk Management & Business Continuity: Identify and mitigate operational risks through robust business continuity planning and crisis response strategies.

• Values & Sustainability Champion: Promote a safe, efficient, and inclusive work environment, championing sustainable practices aligned with Roche’s values and ESG goals.

Who you are

• You should possess a minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in operations or supply chain management, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role within a regional or global distribution environment. A Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field is required, while a Master’s degree (e.g., MBA or relevant technical specialization) is preferred.

• Strategic Leadership: Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams while leveraging advanced analytical skills to drive data-driven decisions and contribute to long-term distribution strategies.

• Operational & Financial Oversight: Demonstrated success in managing complex outsourced operations and third-party logistics (3PL) providers, with a strong focus on optimizing financial performance, service levels, and inventor
