jobs.title: Portfolio and Customer Engagement Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As the Portfolio and Customer Engagement Lead, you will hold ultimate accountability for shaping and executing the commercial strategy within your assigned portfolio. You will champion a deep understanding of business drivers, the local market landscape and competitive dynamics to optimize customer experiences and drive long-term strategic success.

The Opportunity

In this role, you will:

• Set the strategic vision, high ambitions and clear outcomes for your teams by leveraging insights from internal and external stakeholders across the wider enterprise.

• Manage full P&L accountability and take ownership of the financial ambitions and investment health of your designated portfolio.

• Deliver exceptional impact and steer the outcomes of cross-functional engagement teams with an enterprise-wide mindset.

• Build, coach and inspire a high-performing community, providing visionary leadership that fosters an environment where cross-functional collaboration thrives.

• Optimize fluid, impact-driven resource allocation and prioritization, carefully balancing customer engagement models with broader portfolio priorities.

• Champion an enterprise growth mindset and show resilience, turning every stone to uncover innovative possibilities for patients, customers and healthcare systems.

Who You Are

You are a visionary leader and a strategic thinker who thrives on turning bold ambitions into reality. You are deeply passionate about customer centricity, healthcare innovation and possess the business acumen required to lead complex, cross-functional ecosystems.

To excel in this role, you bring:

• Advanced Academic Foundation: A Master’s degree in Business, Science, or a related field.

• Strategic & Commercial Expertise: Solid experience (minimum of 10 years) in creating product and portfolio strategies, with a proven track record in the development, launch, or management of products within the pharmaceutical industry.

• Proven Leadership: Demonstrated ability to build trust as a leader and inspire seamless teamwork and collaboration across diverse networks.

• Market & Customer Insights: Extensive experience in strategic planning, product management, or market research—ideally combining local market knowledge with global perspective, supported by a strong background in customer-facing roles.

• Communication & Collaboration Skills: Professional fluency in written and spoken English and Finnish, enabling you to connect authentically with local and international stakeholders.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This is a pivotal leadership role within our UK Pharma Commercial team. You join at a moment of radical healthcare transformation — where market access, government affairs, and health economics converge to determine whether life-changing therapies reach the patients who need them. You lead a multidisciplinary function that shapes the UK's position as a priority destination for global pharmaceutical investment.

The Opportunity:

• Shape the future of UK pricing and reimbursement by leading the organisation's strategy across NICE, SMC, and AWMSG — ensuring our portfolio remains commercially viable and accessible to patients

• Lead high-stakes negotiations for Commercial Access Agreements that protect and grow a billion-pound revenue stream through sustainable, innovative funding models

• Influence government policy at the highest levels maintaining strategic relationships across the Department of Health and Social Care, HM Treasury, and the broader political landscape

• Build a world-class Access engine that serves as the gold standard for our global headquarters — proving that the UK is a priority launch market

• Drive health equity and system transformation by leading initiatives that improve patient outcomes, enhance population health, and reduce per-capita costs in partnership with the NHS

• Pioneer innovative access models including outcome-based agreements, value-based pricing, and real-world evidence frameworks that can be exported globally

Who you are:

• You bring extensive senior leadership in market access, health economics, or government affairs within the pharmaceutical or life sciences sector

• You have deep expertise in UK HTA processes and the commercial mechanics of industry-government pricing frameworks

• You are a proven political advocate, comfortable engaging at ministerial and senior civil servant level to shape policy outcomes

• You are an enterprise thinker who balances access decisions against commercial, medical, and supply chain considerations across a complex portfolio

• You lead with purpose — translating strategic patience into tactical urgency to deliver patient access today while building frameworks for tomorrow

Preferred:

• Experience navigating the post-Brexit regulatory and trade landscape as it impacts pharmaceutical operations

• Background in Real-World Evidence generation and its application to HTA submissions and lifecycle management

• International or global headquarters experience demonstrating cross-market strategic influence

If you're ready to shape the future of patient access in the UK, we'd like to hear from you. Apply today.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Roche:
We believe it’s urgent to deliver medical solutions right now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives. We are courageous in both decision and action. We believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work each day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigour, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.
We are proud of who we are, what we do, and how we do it. We are many, working as one across functions, across companies, and across the world.
We are Roche.

About the Role:

Roche Products (Ireland) Limited is the sales & marketing arm in Ireland of the pharmaceutical division of Roche. We market and sell prescription medicines across a range of therapeutic areas including oncology, neurology, ophthalmology, rheumatology and spinal muscular atrophy. We are an agile organisation that brings together great people who are passionate about innovation, and who thrive in dynamic, cross-functional, and purposeful teams. These teams work together to deliver outstanding value to our business, patients, and customers.

This role is working within the Finance & Business Operations team which includes Finance, Supply Chain, Quality, Procurement, Business Support and Administration. The team provides support across the business and you will be working with multiple stakeholders. This 8 month contract role arises as the incumbent has been seconded to another role within the organisation.

In this role you require a broad set of skills in communication, interpersonal relationships, managing business relationships, managing a diverse workload and an ability to manage your time effectively. Comfortable working both as a part of a team as well as on your own initiative, you will have proven organisational capability & high levels of personal effectiveness. You will have strong intellectual, analytical and thinking skills, good commercial and business acumen and will be experienced working across the MS Windows and Google platforms. Previous experience using SAP would be an advantage.

What you could be working on:

You will act as an enabler within the affiliate carrying out a range of Finance & Business Operations activities, specifically Business Finance and Business Insights, working in a networked way to identify solutions that will help the business to drive towards delivering better outcomes. You work will include the following:

• Validating employee expenses via Concur, both credit card and cash expenses – checking coding, mileage claims, etc.

• Preparation of data on payments to HCPs & HCOs for external reporting in line with EFPIA requirements

• Preparation and circulation of the Daily Sales Report

• Support the Finance Enterprise Partners in tracking and monitoring the business

• Work with the Finance Enterprise Partners to produce regular monthly product and market updates for all promoted products for circulation and presentation

• Editing and amending POs as required

• Maintaining pricing (standard and contracting) in SAP/Vistex

• Maintaining background tables for SAP approvals

• Preparation and submission of monthly Intrastat

• Preparation & submission of quarterly Repak return and CSO returns

• Completion of annual Form 46G to Revenue

• COGS invoices & certification of entry

• Liaising with Country Chief Accountant in the shared services centre on Finance related activities of the affiliate

We are courageous in both decision and action. We believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work each day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigour, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow. We are proud of who we are, what we do, and how we do it. We are many, working as one across functions, across companies, and across the world. We are Roche. About the Role: Roche Products (Ireland) Limited is the sales & marketing arm in Ireland of the pharmaceutical division of Roche. We market and sell prescription medicines across a range of therapeutic areas including oncology, neurology, ophthalmology, rheumatology and spinal muscular atrophy. We are an agile organisation that brings together great people who are passionate about innovation, and who thrive in dynamic, cross-functional, and purposeful teams. These teams work together to deliver outstanding value to our business, patients, and customers. This role is working within the Finance & Business Operations team which includes Finance, Supply Chain, Quality, Procurement, Business Support and Administration. The team provides support across the business and you will be working with multiple stakeholders. This 8 month contract role arises as the incumbent has been seconded to another role within the organisation. In this role you require a broad set of skills in communication, interpersonal relationships, managing business relationships, managing a diverse workload and an ability to manage your time effectively. Comfortable working both as a part of a team as well as on your own initiative, you will have proven organisational capability & high levels of personal effectiveness. You will have strong intellectual, analytical and thinking skills, good commercial and business acumen and will be experienced working across the MS Windows and Google platforms. Previous experience using SAP would be an advantage. What you could be working on: You will act as an enabler within the affiliate carrying out a range of Finance & Business Operations activities, specifically Business Finance and Business Insights, working in a networked way to identify solutions that will help the business to drive towards delivering better outcomes. You work will include the following:
• Validating employee expenses via Concur, both credit card and cash expenses – checking coding, mileage claims, etc.
• Preparation of data on payments to HCPs & HCOs for external reporting in line with EFPIA requirements
• Preparation and circulation of the Daily Sales Report
• Support the Finance Enterprise Partners in tracking and monitoring the business
• Work with the Finance Enterprise Partners to produce regular monthly product and market updates for all promoted products for circulation and presentation
• Editing and amending POs as required
• Maintaining pricing (standard and contracting) in SAP/Vistex
• Maintaining background tables for SAP approvals
• Preparation and submission of monthly Intrastat
• Preparation & submission of quarterly Repak return and CSO returns
• Completion of annual Form 46G to Revenue
• COGS invoices & certification of entry
• Liaising with Country Chief Accountant in the shared services centre on Finance related activities of the affiliate

jobs.title: Access Partner - Specified Purpose (Approx. 18 Months)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:

The Access Partner is an enthusiastic advocate of his/her area of expertise. His/Her mission is to get our medicines to patients as fast as possible for as long as possible. He/she will work as part of the cross-functional team to drive our North Star and lead the Access agenda within the cross functional team (CFT).

In this role you will:

• Lead the development and execution of high-quality P&R strategies and HTA submissions to deliver on the CFTs mission

• Lead CFT engagement with national Access stakeholders i.e. NCPE, NCCP and support the wider squad in value messaging at a regional level

• Build fast and maintain market access for Roche’s specialist products through targeted communication with various stakeholders in the Irish health system: regional and national

• Identifying new ways of working together with our key stakeholders and identification of new projects that support Patient Access to Roche medicines

• Aligns Access strategies with commercial and medical strategies and pricing guidance from HQ

• Development of new strategic initiatives securing Roche’s long term commitment to secure all eligible patients access to Roche products

• Represent Market Access in Squads according to the Agile Operational model acting as the point of contact driving the Market Access agenda

• Work with CFT members to develop and deliver value messaging and engagement plans for all stakeholders throughout the Access journey

• Shape the payer environment and share relevant information to inform and shape opinion regarding the value of our products

• Responsible for own Market Access projects as agreed with The Head of Access

As a member of Roche Products Ireland Limited:
You will contribute to a combination of communities and teams that comprise of the larger Roche Products (Ireland) Limited and/or the wider Roche community. You will also participate in or lead local and/or global work package teams with a focus on delivering value for patients, external stakeholders and Roche via:

• Contributing and enabling the delivery of programmes across the business by providing operational and/or strategic input to the teams as well as helping to architect our ten year ambition that enables a better future for patients.

• Cultivate meaningful peer-to-peer collaborations to drive a deeper understanding of patient and employee needs across RPIL and beyond. In doing so, nurture a culture of curiosity to enable faster, simpler, and more patient-centric ways of working to deliver on high impact work.

• You may serve as a partner to local internal and external stakeholders inside and outside of Ireland and help support local business needs so that Roche operates as one larger community.

• Inspire and empower talent by working with colleagues across RPIL and the Roche family to promote communication, community and networking in a global environment.

• Optimising growth opportunities and capabilities to successfully contribute and operate in a diverse and global environment. Drive new thinking by identifying new opportunities and options to embrace value creation.

Who you are:

• Degree in Economics or Science, Pharmacist or equivalent professional background

• Patient focus

• Ability to apply the key concepts of economic evaluation including economic modeling

• Interest in and knowledge about the Irish health care system

• Ability to work in an agile environment

• Demonstrates Roche Core Values

• Strong strategic thinker

• Good sense of numb

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
International Product Manager – Personalized Healthcare Solutions (PHCS)
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

Who We Are:
Advancing precision medicine through diagnostics for over 25 years.
In collaboration with leading pharmaceutical companies, Roche Personalised Healthcare Solutions (PHCS) identify and develop innovative precision diagnostics to help radically improve the lives of patients.
As the global diagnostic partner of choice, we deliver diagnostic confidence through a broad menu of high medical value assays across Immunohistochemistry (IHC) and In Situ hybridization (ISH), PCR and NGS. We are a global partner of choice in Oncology, including tissue diagnostics, as well as Neurology & Cardiology. Roche PHCS brings unmatched value as a collaborative partner to pharmaceutical organizations developing treatments across critical areas of highest unmet medical need.

The Opportunity:
As an International Product Manager (IPM) within the PHCS Lifecycle Team, you are the primary driver of our mission. You sit at the critical intersection of diagnostics and therapeutics, transforming complex technology into clinical reality.
Your primary responsibility is to drive the global commercialization of our Companion Diagnostics (CDx) portfolio related to Tissue Diagnostics in direct partnership with pharmaceutical customers. Beyond the core product management of the Tissue Diagnostic portfolio, you will act as a strategic leader, driving initiatives that grow the PHCS organization and innovative pipeline, and support the broader Roche Diagnostics network.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

• External Pharmaceutical Partnering: Act as the dedicated commercial lead for pharmaceutical partners. Co-create and align CDx launch plans with drug therapy timelines to ensure seamless "day-one" testing readiness.

• Country & Regional Collaboration: Partner with Roche Diagnostics regional and country stakeholders to drive successful CDx pull-through. You will help markets overcome barriers to adoption, deliver pharmaceutical partner objectives and ultimately drive precision medicine innovation.

• Commercial Strategy Leader: Drive the commercial strategy for IHC-based companion diagnostics, ensuring our value proposition resonates with pathologists, laboratory managers, and pharma stakeholders.

• End-to-End Product Lifecycle Management: Provide technical and strategic guidance throughout early assay development and lead commercial product delivery from concept to commercialization. Responsible for on-market product strategy, supply topics, quality issues, incorporating global regulatory updates, label expansion and end-of-life product management.

• PHCS Strategy Leadership: Lead design and execution of our overarching strategy in collaboration with PHCS leadership and senior stakeholders. Analyze global market trends, customer needs, and competitive landscapes to define long-term strategies.

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Drive high-impact growth projects that define how Roche Diagnostics delivers value beyond the individual test, collaborating closely with lifecycle teams and stakeholders across the organization.

jobs.title: Data & Analytics Specialist (Clinical Operations)

titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste des données et des analyses

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Data & Analytics Specialist, you will sit at the intersection of Forecasting, Advanced Data Analytics, and Product Management. This is a high-impact role designed for a strategic thinker who can provide operational insights with minimal supervision. You you will act as a strategic partner to Clinical Operations, turning complex datasets into narratives that guide the future of our clinical portfolio.

The Opportunity:

• Act as a thought partner to Disease Area Communities (CODACs) and Portfolio Enabling Communities (COPECs) to diagnose business problems and recommend data-driven actions.

• Partner with Franchise Leads, Study Management, and the Late Stage Portfolio Committee (LSPC) to align analytical output with business priorities.

• Openly share perspectives to elevate team thinking, effectively weighing trade-offs and communicating the "why" behind strategic decisions.

• Increase the sophistication of our analytical methods, utilizing machine learning and scalable prototypes to measure study performance at the speed of business.

• Create and manage time-series and patient-based forecasts, incorporating trial design elements, competitor activity, and country/site selection impacts.

• Apply statistical methods to multiple data sources (primary and secondary) to answer complex business questions and optimize the value of clinical investments.

• Manage the lifecycle of analytical solutions from ideation through implementation.

• Stay current with emergent methodologies and tools to ensure our approach remains "fit-for-purpose" and impactful.

Who you are:

• Bachelor’s Degree (Business, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, or Physical Sciences or related field is a plus); MBA or Graduate-level Degree is preferred

• Advanced English

• Mastery in specialized areas such as Patient/Investigator Insights, Forecasting, or Statistics, with a focus on informing clinical and business decisions.

• Proficiency in high-level programming and analytical tools (Python, R, SQL, SAS) to perform autonomous, sophisticated data exploration beyond traditional analysis.

• Proven ability to translate complex datasets into compelling narratives and visualizations that simplify technical concepts for stakeholders.

• Experience navigating international, cross-functional environments (Scientific, Business, Operational) by using influence without authority to drive results.

• Acting as an entrepreneurial consultant to the business, managing outside vendors, and identifying the right analytical methods for specific problems.

• Ability to merge disparate data sources with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring all findings are persuasive, accurate, and actionable.

• Availability to work in a hybrid model based in São Paulo

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Sao Paulo. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each oth

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In qualità di Data & Analytics Specialist, ti siederai all'incrocio tra Forecasting, Advanced Data Analytics e Product Management. Questo è un ruolo di alto impatto progettato per un pensatore strategico che può fornire intuizioni operative con minima supervisione. Si agirà come partner strategico per le operazioni cliniche, trasformando complessi set di dati in narrazioni che guidano il futuro del nostro portafoglio clinico. L'opportunità:
• Agire come partner di pensiero per le Comunità di Area Malattia (CODACs) e le Comunità che abilitano il Portfolio (COPECs) per diagnosticare i problemi aziendali e raccomandare azioni basate sui dati.
• Partner con Franchise Leads, Study Management e il Late Stage Portfolio Committee (LSPC) per allineare la produzione analitica con le priorità aziendali.
• Condividere apertamente le prospettive per elevare il pensiero del team, pesare efficacemente i trade-off e comunicare il "perché" dietro le decisioni strategiche.
• Aumentare la raffinatezza dei nostri metodi analitici, utilizzando prototipi di machine learning e scalabili per misurare le prestazioni di studio alla velocità del business.
• Creare e gestire le serie temporali e le previsioni basate sul paziente, incorporando elementi di progettazione di prova, attività concorrente e impatti di selezione paese/sito.
• Applicare metodi statistici a più fonti di dati (primarie e secondarie) per rispondere a complesse domande aziendali e ottimizzare il valore degli investimenti clinici.
• Gestire il ciclo di vita delle soluzioni analitiche dall'ideazione attraverso l'implementazione.
• Mantenere corrente con metodologie e strumenti emergenti per garantire che il nostro approccio rimanga "adatto allo scopo" e impattante. Chi sei:
• Corso di laurea (Business, Economia, Statistica, Matematica, o Scienze Fisiche o campo correlato è un plus); MBA o Laurea Grado è preferito
• Inglese avanzato
• Mastery in aree specializzate come pazienti/Investigatori Insights, Forecasting o Statistica, con l'obiettivo di informare le decisioni cliniche e aziendali.
• La competenza nella programmazione e negli strumenti analitici di alto livello (Python, R, SQL, SAS) per eseguire l'esplorazione dei dati autonoma e sofisticata oltre l'analisi tradizionale.
• comprovata capacità di tradurre set di dati complessi in narrazioni e visualizzazioni convincenti che semplificano i concetti tecnici per gli stakeholder.
• Esperienza di navigazione in ambienti internazionali, interfunzionali (Scientific, Business, Operativo) utilizzando l'influenza senza autorità per guidare i risultati.
• Agire come consulente imprenditoriale per il business, gestire i fornitori esterni, e identificare i metodi analitici giusti per problemi specifici.
• Capacità di fondere fonti di dati disparate con meticolosa attenzione ai dettagli, assicurando che tutti i risultati siano persuasivi, accurati e fattibili.
• Disponibilità di lavorare in un modello ibrido con sede a San Paolo Le prestazioni di trasferimento non sono disponibili per questa posizione. Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è San Paolo. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo ciascuno

• Partner mit Franchise Leads, Study Management und dem Late Stage Portfolio Committee (LSPC) zur Ausrichtung der analytischen Leistung auf Unternehmensprioritäten.
• Offene Perspektiven teilen, um Teamdenken zu erhöhen, Trade-offs effektiv zu wägen und die "Warum" hinter strategischen Entscheidungen zu kommunizieren.

• Erstellung und Verwaltung von Zeitreihen und geduldigen Prognosen, einschließlich Testdesign-Elemente, Konkurrentenaktivität und Länder-/Siteauswahl-Effekte.
• Statistische Methoden auf mehrere Datenquellen (primär und sekundär) anwenden, um komplexe Geschäftsfragen zu beantworten und den Wert der klinischen Investitionen zu optimieren.
• Verwalten Sie den Lebenszyklus von analytischen Lösungen von der Idee über die Umsetzung.
• Bleiben Sie aktuell mit aufstrebenden Methoden und Werkzeugen, um sicherzustellen, dass unser Ansatz "tauglich" und wirkungsvoll bleibt. Wer du bist:
• Bachelor-Abschluss (Business, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, oder Physical Sciences oder verwandten Bereich ist ein Plus); MBA oder Graduate-Level-Abschluss ist bevorzugt
• Erweitertes Englisch
• Mastery in spezialisierten Bereichen wie Patienten/Untersuchungsinsights, Prognosen oder Statistiken, mit dem Fokus auf die Information von klinischen und geschäftlichen Entscheidungen.
• Effizienz in hochrangigen Programmier- und Analysetools (Python, R, SQL, SAS) zur Durchführung autonomer, anspruchsvoller Datenexploration über die traditionelle Analyse hinaus.
• bewährte Fähigkeit, komplexe Datensätze in überzeugende Erzählungen und Visualisierungen zu übersetzen, die technische Konzepte für Stakeholder vereinfachen.
• Erleben Sie das Navigieren internationaler, funktionsübergreifender Umgebungen (Wissenschaft, Wirtschaft, Betrieb), indem Sie Einfluss ohne Autorität nutzen, um Ergebnisse zu erzielen.
• Als Unternehmerberater für das Unternehmen fungieren, außerhalb von Anbietern verwalten und die richtigen analytischen Methoden für spezifische Probleme identifizieren.
• Fähigkeit, verschiedene Datenquellen mit sorgfältiger Liebe zum Detail zu verschmelzen, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Ergebnisse überzeugend, genau und handlungsfähig sind.
• Verfügbarkeit in einem Hybridmodell mit Sitz in São Paulo Verlagerungsleistungen sind für diese Position nicht verfügbar. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que spécialiste des données et de l'analyse, vous serez à l'intersection de la prévision, de l'analyse avancée des données et de la gestion des produits. Il s'agit d'un rôle à fort impact conçu pour un penseur stratégique qui peut fournir des informations opérationnelles avec une supervision minimale. Vous agirez comme partenaire stratégique des Opérations cliniques, transformant des ensembles de données complexes en récits qui guident l'avenir de notre portefeuille clinique. La possibilité :
• Agir en tant que partenaire de réflexion des communautés de maladies (CODAC) et des communautés habilitantes de portefeuille (COPEC) pour diagnostiquer les problèmes commerciaux et recommander des mesures axées sur les données.
• S'associer aux responsables de franchises, à la gestion des études et au comité du portefeuille en retard pour aligner les résultats analytiques sur les priorités opérationnelles.
• Partager ouvertement des perspectives pour élever la pensée d'équipe, peser efficacement les compromis et communiquer le "pourquoi" derrière les décisions stratégiques.
• Accroître la sophistication de nos méthodes d'analyse, en utilisant l'apprentissage automatique et des prototypes évolutives pour mesurer les performances d'étude à la vitesse des affaires.
• Créer et gérer des séries chronologiques et des prévisions basées sur le patient, intégrant des éléments de conception d'essais, l'activité des concurrents et les impacts de sélection pays/site.
• Appliquer des méthodes statistiques à de multiples sources de données (primaires et secondaires) pour répondre à des questions complexes et optimiser la valeur des investissements cliniques.
• Gérer le cycle de vie des solutions analytiques depuis l'idée jusqu'à la mise en œuvre.
• Restez à jour avec les méthodologies et les outils émergents pour s'assurer que notre approche reste « adaptée à l'usage » et efficace. Qui vous êtes :
• Baccalauréat (Business, Economics, Statistics, Mathématiques, Sciences physiques ou domaine connexe est un plus); MBA ou diplôme de niveau supérieur est préféré
• Anglais avancé
• Maîtrise dans des domaines spécialisés tels que le Patient/Inspection des enquêteurs, la prévision ou les statistiques, en mettant l'accent sur l'information sur les décisions cliniques et commerciales.
• Connaissance des outils de programmation et d'analyse de haut niveau (Python, R, SQL, SAS) pour effectuer une exploration autonome et sophistiquée des données au-delà de l'analyse traditionnelle.
• Capacité éprouvée de traduire des ensembles de données complexes en récits et visualisations convaincants qui simplifient les concepts techniques pour les parties prenantes.
• Expérimentez la navigation dans des environnements internationaux et interfonctionnels (scientifiques, commerciaux, opérationnels) en utilisant l'influence sans autorité pour produire des résultats.
• En tant que consultant en entreprise auprès de l'entreprise, en gérant des fournisseurs extérieurs et en identifiant les méthodes d'analyse appropriées pour des problèmes spécifiques.
• Capacité de fusionner des sources de données disparates avec une attention méticuleuse aux détails, en veillant à ce que toutes les constatations soient convaincantes, précises et réalisables.
• Disponibilité pour travailler dans un modèle hybride basé à São Paulo Les indemnités de réinstallation ne sont pas disponibles pour ce poste. Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'endroit principal est Sao Paulo. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle peut être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents de la rémunération plus tard dans le processus d'embauche. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous responsabilisons chaque oth

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This is an exciting time to join the Roche Support Network. If you are passionate about problem solving then this is the position for you! As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops and provides innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals - from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment and treatment monitoring.

Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience.

As a Field Applications Specialist , you will be a key member of our Customer Support team as the primary scientific and technical representative in the Alabama region for Roche systems in customer laboratories within the Core Lab space. You will be responsible for providing best-in-class on-site customer support, including activities such as, application implementation, operator training, and troubleshooting for diagnostic instrumentation and assays throughout the entire product life cycle.

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Questo è un momento emozionante per aderire alla rete di supporto Roche. Se siete appassionati di problem solving allora questa è la posizione per voi! In qualità di società di assistenza sanitaria focalizzata sulla ricerca, Roche scopre, sviluppa e fornisce prodotti e servizi diagnostici e terapeutici innovativi che forniscono benefici significativi ai pazienti e ai professionisti sanitari - dalla rilevazione precoce e prevenzione delle malattie alla diagnostica, al monitoraggio del trattamento e del trattamento. Roche è una società di successo che può offrire interessanti opportunità di carriera. Incoraggiamo e sosteniamo il vostro sviluppo in aree di vostro interesse che vi preparerà per il prossimo livello nel vostro percorso di carriera. Sappiamo che le persone sono responsabili del nostro successo e apprezziamo i nostri dipendenti. Il nostro impegno è quello di creare un ambiente di lavoro in cui sentirsi valorizzati, rispettati e potenziati è un'esperienza quotidiana. Mansioni In qualità di Field Applications Specialist, sarai un membro chiave del nostro team di assistenza clienti come principale rappresentante scientifico e tecnico nella regione dell'Alabama per i sistemi Roche nei laboratori dei clienti all'interno dello spazio Core Lab. Sarete responsabili di fornire il miglior supporto clienti in loco, tra cui attività come, l'implementazione delle applicazioni, la formazione dell'operatore e la risoluzione dei problemi per la strumentazione diagnostica e le analisi durante tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. - Costruire e mantenere relazioni forti e collaborative con le parti interessate del cliente, garantendo un elevato livello di soddisfazione del cliente e creando valore nelle operazioni di laboratorio del cliente. Consultare i clienti sulle esigenze del laboratorio e agire come partner supportando il cliente durante tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto che potrebbe includere aggiornamenti di prodotto e altre modifiche. - Eseguire e/o assistere con l'installazione di strumenti diagnostici complessi, software e applicazioni reagente nei laboratori del cliente. Convalida le prestazioni del sistema per garantire che soddisfi le specifiche del produttore. Assicurare un'applicazione efficace e coesa delle soluzioni appena installate. - Fornire e, in alcuni casi, sviluppare una formazione completa in loco al personale di laboratorio sul corretto uso e manutenzione dei sistemi Roche, tra cui teoria del funzionamento, flusso di lavoro, controllo della qualità e interpretazione dei dati. - Agire come risorsa principale in loco per risolvere problemi tecnici complessi relativi alla strumentazione, software e prestazioni di analisi. Eseguire l'analisi della causa radice e implementare azioni correttive per ridurre al minimo i tempi di fermo dello strumento. Partner con altri membri del team Roche per implementare e supportare soluzioni totali, come l'automazione, gli strumenti digitali, ecc. - Fornire competenze scientifiche e applicative agli stakeholder di laboratorio (questo potrebbe includere supervisori, manager, direttori, tecnici) e professionisti medici (questo potrebbe includere patologi, medici), aiutandoli a garantire operazioni di laboratorio coesi ottimizzando i flussi di lavoro, implementando nuovi saggi e interpretando i risultati per il portafoglio di Roche. - Servire come collegamento al cliente e raccogliere feedback dai clienti sulle prestazioni, caratteristiche e usabilità del prodotto, e poi relay queste informazioni di supporto e team commerciali, mantenendo un vantaggio competitivo. - Partner con il team di vendita e sfruttare le conoscenze tecniche approfondite durante le attività pre-vendita, tra cui dimostrazioni di prodotto, consultazioni tecniche, ottimizzazione dei menu e altre opportunità post-vendita, generazione di ricavi. - Assicurare un'esperienza clienti coerente seguendo i protocolli e le procedure Roche.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position This is an exciting time to join the Roche Support Network. If you are passionate about problem solving then this is the position for you! As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops and provides innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals - from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment and treatment monitoring. Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience. As a Field Applications Specialist , you will be a key member of our Customer Support team as the primary scientific and technical representative in the Alabama region for Roche systems in customer laboratories within the Core Lab space. You will be responsible for providing best-in-class on-site customer support, including activities such as, application implementation, operator training, and troubleshooting for diagnostic instrumentation and assays throughout the entire product life cycle. The Opportunity:
• Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with customer stakeholders, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction and creating value within the customer’s lab operations. Consult with customers on lab needs and act as a partner by supporting the customer throughout the product lifecycle which could include supporting product upgrades and other changes.
• Perform and/or assist with the installation of complex diagnostic instruments, software, and reagent applications in customer laboratories. Validate system performance to ensure it meets manufacturer specifications. Ensure effective and cohesive application of the newly installed solutions.
• Deliver and, in some cases develop, comprehensive on-site training to laboratory personnel on the proper use and maintenance of Roche systems, including theory of operation, workflow, quality control, and data interpretation.
• Act as the primary on-site resource for resolving complex technical issues related to instrumentation, software, and assay performance. Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions to minimize instrument downtime. Partner with other Roche team members to implement and support total solutions, such as automation, digital tools, etc.
• Provide scientific and applications expertise to laboratory stakeholders (this could include supervisors, managers, directors, technologists) and medical professionals (this could include pathologists, doctors), helping them ensure cohesive lab operations by optimizing workflows, implementing new assays, and interpreting results for Roche's portfolio.
• Serve as the customer liaison and collect feedback from customers on product performance, features, and usability, and then relay this information back to support and commercial teams, maintaining a competitive advantage.
• Partner with the sales team and leverage in-depth technical knowledge during pre-sales activities, including product demonstrations, technical consultations, menu optimization, and other post-sales, revenue-generating opportunities.
• Ensure consistent customer experiences by following Roche protocols and pr
descriptionByLocale.de: Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. La Posizione Dies ist eine aufregende Zeit, sich dem Roche Support Network anzuschließen. Wenn Sie leidenschaftlich über Problemlösung sind, dann ist dies die Position für Sie! Als forschungsorientiertes Healthcare-Unternehmen entdeckt, entwickelt und bietet Roche innovative Diagnostik und therapeutische Produkte und Dienstleistungen, die für Patienten und medizinische Fachkräfte von der Früherkennung und Prävention von Krankheiten bis hin zur Diagnostik, Behandlung und Therapieüberwachung profitieren. Roche ist ein erfolgreiches Unternehmen, das spannende Karrieremöglichkeiten bieten kann. Wir fördern und unterstützen Ihre Entwicklung in Bereichen Ihres Interesses, die Sie auf die nächste Stufe in Ihrem Karriereweg vorbereiten. Wir wissen, dass Menschen für unseren Erfolg verantwortlich sind und wir unsere Mitarbeiter schätzen. Unser Engagement ist es, ein Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem das Gefühl geschätzt, respektiert und gestärkt wird, ein tägliches Erlebnis ist. Mansion Als Field Applications Specialist sind Sie als primärer wissenschaftlicher und technischer Vertreter in der Alabama-Region für Roche-Systeme in Kundenlaboren im Core Lab-Raum ein wichtiger Bestandteil unseres Kundendienstteams. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Bereitstellung erstklassiger Kundenbetreuung vor Ort, einschließlich Aktivitäten wie, Anwendung Implementierung, Bedienertraining und Fehlerbehebung für diagnostische Instrumentierung und Assays während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus. - Erstellen und pflegen Sie starke, kollaborative Beziehungen zu Kundeninteressenten, um ein hohes Maß an Kundenzufriedenheit und Wertschöpfung im Laborbetrieb des Kunden sicherzustellen. Besprechen Sie den Kunden auf den Laborbedarf und handeln Sie als Partner, indem Sie den Kunden während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus unterstützen, der Produkt-Upgrades und andere Änderungen unterstützen könnte. - Führen und/oder unterstützen Sie die Installation komplexer diagnosischer Instrumente, Software und Reagenzanwendungen in Kundenlabors. Gültige Systemleistung, um sicherzustellen, dass es den Herstellerspezifikationen entspricht. Gewährleistung einer effektiven und kohäsiven Anwendung der neu installierten Lösungen. - Liefern und in einigen Fällen entwickeln, umfassende Vor-Ort-Training an Laborpersonal bei der ordnungsgemäßen Nutzung und Wartung von Roche-Systemen, einschließlich der Theorie der Operation, Workflow, Qualitätskontrolle und Dateninterpretation. - Aktivieren Sie als primäre Vor-Ort-Ressource zur Lösung komplexer technischer Probleme im Zusammenhang mit Instrumentierung, Software und Testleistung. Führen Sie Root Ursache Analyse und implementieren Korrekturmaßnahmen, um Instrument Ausfallzeiten zu minimieren. Mit anderen Roche-Team-Mitgliedern werden Gesamtlösungen wie Automatisierung, digitale Werkzeuge etc. implementiert und unterstützt. - Bereitstellung von wissenschaftlichen und Anwendungen Expertise für Labor-Stakeholder (dies könnte unter anderem Aufsichtspersonen, Manager, Direktoren, Technologen) und medizinische Fachkräfte (dies könnte Pathologen, Ärzte umfassen), helfen ihnen, kohäsive Laboroperationen zu gewährleisten, indem sie Workflows optimieren, neue Assays implementieren und Ergebnisse für Roches Portfolio interpretieren. - Servieren Sie als Kundenverbindung und sammeln Sie Feedback von Kunden über Produktleistung, Funktionen und Usability, und übermitteln Sie diese Informationen dann an Support- und Handelsteams, wobei ein Wettbewerbsvorteil erhalten wird. - Partner des Vertriebsteams und nutzen fundiertes technisches Wissen während der Vorverkaufsaktivitäten, darunter Produktdemonstrationen, technische Beratungen, Menüoptimierung und andere Post-Sales, Umsatzerzeugende Möglichkeiten. - Stellen Sie konsequente Kundenerfahrungen nach Roche-Protokollen und -Verfahren sicher.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La Posizione C'est une période passionnante pour rejoindre le réseau de soutien Roche. Si vous êtes passionné par la résolution de problèmes alors c'est la position pour vous! En tant qu'entreprise de soins de santé axée sur la recherche, Roche découvre, développe et fournit des produits et des services diagnostiques et thérapeutiques innovants qui procurent des avantages importants aux patients et aux professionnels de la santé, depuis la détection précoce et la prévention des maladies jusqu'au diagnostic, au traitement et au suivi du traitement. Roche est une entreprise prospère qui peut offrir des opportunités de carrière passionnantes. Nous encourageons et soutenons votre développement dans les domaines qui vous intéressent et qui vous prépareront au prochain niveau de votre parcours professionnel. Nous savons que les gens sont responsables de notre succès et nous apprécions nos employés. Notre engagement est de créer un environnement de travail où le sentiment de valeur, de respect et d'autonomie est une expérience quotidienne. Mansioni En tant que spécialiste des applications sur le terrain, vous serez un membre clé de notre équipe de support client en tant que principal représentant scientifique et technique dans la région de l'Alabama pour les systèmes Roche dans les laboratoires clients de l'espace Core Lab. Vous serez responsable de fournir le meilleur service client en classe sur place, y compris des activités telles que la mise en œuvre d'applications, la formation des opérateurs et le dépannage des instruments de diagnostic et des essais tout au long du cycle de vie du produit. - Établir et maintenir des relations solides et collaboratives avec les intervenants du client, en assurant un niveau élevé de satisfaction du client et en créant de la valeur dans les activités du laboratoire du client. Consulter les clients sur les besoins des laboratoires et agir en tant que partenaire en appuyant le client tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, ce qui pourrait inclure des améliorations du produit et d'autres changements. - Effectuer et/ou aider à installer des instruments de diagnostic complexes, des logiciels et des applications de réactif dans les laboratoires clients. Valider la performance du système pour s'assurer qu'il répond aux spécifications du fabricant. Assurer l'application efficace et cohérente des solutions nouvellement installées. - Fournir et, dans certains cas, développer une formation complète sur place au personnel de laboratoire sur l'utilisation et l'entretien appropriés des systèmes Roche, y compris la théorie de l'exploitation, le flux de travail, le contrôle de la qualité et l'interprétation des données. - Agir comme principale ressource sur place pour résoudre les problèmes techniques complexes liés à l'instrumentation, aux logiciels et aux performances d'essai. Effectuer une analyse des causes profondes et mettre en oeuvre des mesures correctives pour minimiser les temps d'arrêt des instruments. Partenaire avec d'autres membres de l'équipe Roche pour mettre en œuvre et soutenir des solutions complètes, telles que l'automatisation, les outils numériques, etc. - Fournir une expertise scientifique et des applications aux intervenants des laboratoires (ce qui pourrait inclure les superviseurs, les gestionnaires, les directeurs, les technologues) et aux professionnels de la santé (ce qui pourrait inclure les pathologistes, les médecins), les aider à assurer la cohésion des opérations des laboratoires en optimisant les flux de travail, en mettant en oeuvre de nouveaux essais et en interprétant les résultats pour le portefeuille de Roche. - Servir de liaison avec les clients et recueillir les commentaires des clients sur la performance, les caractéristiques et la facilité d'utilisation du produit, puis transmettre ces informations aux équipes de soutien et commerciales, en maintenant un avantage concurrentiel. - S'associer à l'équipe de vente et tirer parti de connaissances techniques approfondies lors des activités préventes, y compris des démonstrations de produits, des consultations techniques, l'optimisation des menus et d'autres occasions de générer des revenus après les ventes. - Assurer une expérience client cohérente en suivant les protocoles et procédures Roche.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
PROPÓSITO DEL PUESTO

Es responsable de asistir a los equipos de estudios clínicos en todas las actividades financieras transaccionales relacionadas con el proceso de pagos de los estudios clínicos gestionados por el Departamento Local de Operaciones Clínicas, en cada uno de los países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Perú, Chile, Colombia, USA, UK, Canadá, Bélgica, Centroamérica y Caribe) y otras tareas de asistencia (de ser requerido).

FUNCIONES O RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPALES

Trabajar en conjunto con los equipos de Estudios clínicos de cada país en la
ejecución de las siguientes actividades:

• Verificar la información de visitas completadas y procedimientos adicionales (Adhocs) en CTMS y plantillas excel por parte del CRA (Monitor) (Para Latam) o Generar los reportes necesarios para consolidar una propuesta de pagos por país, donde se incluya la información del Investigador Centro y Paciente según la frecuencia de pagos de cada uno de los países de Latam, USA, UK, Canadá, Bélgica.

• Cuando se requiera, Confirmar con el Centro de Investigación (para USA) que la información de pagos sea proporcionada de forma exacta y oportuna.

• Gestionar pagos para los Centros de Investigación de Latam, USA, UK, Canadá, Bélgica a través de los sistemas SAP, CCOPS y CTMS al equipo de Cuentas por pagar.

• Asistir a los Centros de Investigación (Latam, USA, UK, Canadá, Bélgica) en caso de solicitudes conciliación de cuentas o dudas en relación con temas de pagos.

• Es responsable de solicitar y verificar la creación de los vendor (SAP) relacionados a estudios clínicos (USA).

• Configurar en CCOPS la información requerida para cada centro de Investigación.

De acuerdo a las tareas que le sean asignadas, podrá:

• Colaborar con el CSM y CSS para asegurar que se obtengan todas las revisiones y autorizaciones internas adecuadas y requeridas para el proceso de pagos relacionado con los estudios.

• Asegurar el registro de información necesarios en sistemas Roche para generar la propuesta de pagos correspondientes.

• Hacer recomendaciones a los equipos locales del estudio en relación con las soluciones nuevas e innovadoras para los procesos de pagos, pronósticos y recursos que podrían incrementar la precisión, eficiencia y productividad del proceso.

• Brindar apoyo a los equipos locales del estudio en relación con las mejores

• prácticas, acompañando a los CSM en las actividades de pronósticos y el manejo de los gastos relacionados con los proyectos.

• Gestionar soporte al proceso de pagos de los departamentos locales de

• Investigación Clínica en Latam USA, UK, Canadá, Bélgica, para asegurar un proceso ágil y eficiente de pago.

• Apoyar en el entrenamiento activo a los miembros del departamento de

• Investigación Clínica sobre uso de herramientas de reporte corporativas y locales desarrolladas por el área de Investigación.

• Asegurar la calidad de la información del sistema manteniendo control de los reportes de discrepancias.

• Mantener los sistemas CTMS/CCOPS actualizados de acuerdo a las fechas calendario clave pre-establecidas para toma de decisiones de los equipos de Investigación clínica de Latam USA, UK, Canadá, Bélgica.

PERFIL DEL PUESTO – REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS Y PROFESIONALES

• Carrera técnica/Universitaria. (Administración, Finanzas, Contabilidad, o carrera a fin.)

• De 2 a 5 años de experiencia en Accounts Payable.

• Inglés Intermedio-Avanzado (B2)

jobs.title: Director, Customer Support Center
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Director, Customer Support Center

The Opportunity:
As the Director of Customer Support Center for Roche Diagnostics USA, you will lead the evolution of our support ecosystem into a next-generation diagnostic hub. Your primary goal is to minimize instrument downtime by championing Remote-First resolution. By integrating AI-assisted troubleshooting tools with our core platforms, you will empower our frontline experts to solve complex clinical and technical issues with unprecedented speed and accuracy. You will serve as a strategic leader who bridges the gap between high-level business objectives and world-class service delivery.

We are seeking a transformational leader who thrives on variety. You don’t just manage a department; you look for ways to help the entire company win. You are as comfortable leading a cross-functional project as you are implementing a new AI-guided troubleshooting tool, all while ensuring your team feels secure, valued, and empowered in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.

Job Facts:

1. Strategic Leadership & Remote Excellence

• Expedited Fix Strategy: Define the roadmap for a proactive support model, utilizing assistive technologies within ServiceMax and Salesforce to increase first-contact resolution and maximize laboratory uptime.

• Operational & Financial Oversight: Direct accountability for expense budgets (P&L), resource planning, and performance data to ensure a cost-effective, high-output operation.

• Omnichannel Innovation: Oversee the optimization of CCaaS platforms (e.g., Genesys) to ensure seamless, data-driven interactions across all customer touchpoints.

2. People-Centric Innovation

• Augmented Support: Oversee the implementation of 'co-pilot' technologies—like predictive error mapping and automated case surfacing—that simplify complex workflows and protect agents from burnout.

• Change Management: Lead with transparency to ensure the team views new digital tools as career-enhancing assets rather than replacements.

• Talent Development: Direct all HR activities, including recruitment, training, and career planning, to build a resilient pipeline of leadership talent.

3. Strategic Business Partnership & Enterprise Impact

• Cross-Functional Synergy: Act as a high-level consultant to internal partners (Sales, Marketing, R&D, and Field Service), aligning support strategies to directly bolster sales objectives and product reliability.

• Commercial Alignment: Partner with Sales leadership to ensure that our service excellence becomes a competitive differentiator and a primary driver of contract renewals.

• Silo-Breaking Leadership: Navigate our matrixed organization to build consensus and lead initiatives that require cooperation across multiple departments to solve systemic customer pain points.

• Dynamic Flexibility: Proactively take on additional responsibilities and pivot resources to support other departments during periods of high demand or special product launches.

4. Compliance & Technical Quality

• Regulatory Stewardship: Ensure every remote-fix protocol and service action strictly adheres to Roche’s quality system and FDA/global regulatory requirements.

• Service Integrity: Maintain a work culture 100% committed to accuracy, ensuring that remote interventions provide the same level of reliability as an on-site visit.

Who You Are (Required Qualifications & Experience):

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Medical Technology, Information Technology, Chemistry, Biology, Clinical Laboratory, Business or rel

jobs.title: Security Analyst - RDT Information Security
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Security Analyst - Penetration Testing

Exp- 4 to 7 yers
Location- Pune
Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Security Analyst to join our cybersecurity team. In this role, you will conduct comprehensive penetration testing and vulnerability assessments across our diverse technology landscape, identifying and documenting security risks to strengthen our overall security posture.

Primary Responsibilities

• Conduct thorough penetration testing of web applications, mobile applications, and AI/LLM system using industry-standard tools and methodologies

• Perform hands-on security assessments and identify vulnerabilities in web-based systems and APIs

• Execute practical penetration tests against target systems, documenting real-world findings and exploitation methods

• Develop and execute custom exploitation payloads and attack scenarios

• Analyze application logic, authentication mechanisms, and access control implementations

• Collaborate with development and infrastructure teams to define scope, validate findings and track remediation efforts

• Maintain detailed testing documentation, evidence of assessments, and proof of concept demonstrations

• Participate in security reviews and contribute to threat modeling exercises

• Stay current with emerging web application security threats and attack vectors

• Quickly adapt to new tools, technologies, and emerging security challenges in the threat landscape

Required Qualifications
Certifications (Mandatory - at least one of the following)

• OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional) or

• CPTS (Certified Penetration Testing Specialist) or

• OSCE (Offensive Security Certified Expert) or

• Equivalent recognized penetration testing certification

Experience & Technical Skills
Primary Expertise (Web Application and LLM - Hands-On Required):

• 3+ years of demonstrated hands-on experience in web application penetration testing

• Proven ability to identify and exploit real-world vulnerabilities in production and pre-production environments

• Practical expertise with OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, including SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF, authentication bypass, and API security flaws

• Proficiency with web security testing tools (Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Postman, etc.)

• Experience bypassing security controls and WAF implementations

• Hands-on experience with API penetration testing (REST, GraphQL, SOAP)

• Practical expertise with LLM security assessments, including prompt injection, model manipulation, and output validation weaknesses.

• Understanding of LLM vulnerabilities including prompt injection, jailbreaking, data leakage, and model poisoning attacks

• Experience evaluating guardrails, content filters, and safety mechanisms in AI systems

• Proficiency with LLM security testing frameworks (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications)

• Familiarity with LLM penetration testing tools (e.g., Claud CLI, PRFU, Garak, promptfoo, etc.)

Required Secondary Skills (Hands-On Demonstrated):

• Mobile Penetration Testing: Practical hands-on experience testing iOS and Android applications, including runtime analysis, reverse engineering, and security assessment of mobile APIs

• Cloud Security: Hands-on experience conducting security assessments on public cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including services like EC2, S3, Lambda, IAM, RDS, and cloud misconfiguration identification.

Core Competencies:

• Strong understanding of networking, encryption, authentication, and authorization mechanisms

jobs.title: Principal DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Principal DevOps Engineer (DevOps Lead)

At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.

Description
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Opportunity
The Principal DevOps​ ​Engineer​ (DevOps Lead) ​is a key member in engineering and DevOps groups and will apply knowledge of design principles, practices in the implementation of complex, enterprise-scale software systems. The Principal engineer is a hands-on leader of the DevOps function. General responsibilities include design concept generation, participating in reviews for components or features, development, and testing of the core software stack, and reliability testing.

Key Responsibilities:

• Software​ ​Development​: This is a software development position to write high quality software that will perform at scale, be supportable, and be extensible

• Process​ ​&​ ​Operations: Ensure the software stack integrates with our existing CI pipeline and contribute to continuous improvement; independently design, plan and deliver high-quality software

• Leadership​: Ensure a culture that values technical excellence together with support and compassion for individuals

• Evangelism: As a key evangelist, you will work to evangelize a healthy DevSecOps software development practice within the Roche Engineering Community

Who You Are:

• BS in Computer Science, or Computer Engineering, or related field.

• 10+ years of hands-on experience in public cloud AWS, Google, or Azure (AWS Preferred) of which at the minimum 5 years of experience in the software industry.

• Scripting experience is required and highly desirable, using shell, python, ruby, or similar languages.

• Experience leading DevOps teams and in building and maturing CI/CD pipelines

• Expertise in overall areas in DevSecOps including CI/CD with build & release, Internal tooling, and production operations.

• Build and operation tools that monitor backend production, Make sure backend services scale economically, Develop tooling framework, Help the dev team resolve production issues

• Hands-on System Administration experience with Unix based systems including experience with system configuration and networking (DNS, DHCP, rout tables and routing).

• Experience automating using infrastructure as code: AWS Cloudformation, Terraform, etc.

• Hands-on automation development using chef or ansible desired

• Experience deploying or managing large scale distributed Unix environments Partake in an on-call rotation alongside the engineers who build our production backends, Comfortable with large scale production systems and technologies, including load balancing, monitoring, distributed systems, and/or configuration management.

• Experience in contemporary platforms extended from cloud such as docker containers, Mesos, and/or Ku

L'ingegnere principale è un leader a mano a funzione DevOps. Cosa? - Una cultura che valorizza l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni genuina, dove sei valorizzato, destinata e rispettato per chi sei, voluti di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. - L'opportunità di lavorare in un ambiente dinamico e innovativo, dove ogni voce conta. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Du bist auf der Suche nach einem vielfältigen und zukunftsorientierten Dualen Studium? Dann erfinde gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung neu. Bei Roche entwickeln wir innovative Diagnostika und Medikamente, um Menschen ein längeres und besseres Leben zu ermöglichen. Werde Teil dieser Mission und leiste von Anfang an einen entscheidenden Beitrag für Patient:innen weltweit.

Welche Aufgaben erwarten Dich?

• Du rotierst durch kaufmännische und technische Bereiche wie IT, Logistik oder Finance und baust dir ein starkes Netzwerk auf.

• Du bildest die direkte Brücke zwischen den Fachbereichen und der IT und koordinierst spannende gemeinsame Projekte.

• Du entwickelst smarte IT-Lösungen von der ersten Idee über die Programmierung bis zur Einführung mit agilen Methoden wie Scrum.

• Du optimierst aktiv betriebswirtschaftliche Prozesse und steuerst Abläufe – sei es in der Logistik, der Produktion oder im Controlling.

Deine praktische Ausbildung findet bei Roche Diagnostics in Mannheim statt. Die Vorlesungen werden an der Dualen Hochschule Baden-Württemberg in Mannheim abgehalten.

Deine Vorteile bei uns:
Wir setzen auf das Modell der Personalisierten Ausbildung : Du gestaltest deine Ausbildungsinhalte in enger Absprache mit deinen Ausbilder:innen aktiv mit.
Das bieten wir dir zusätzlich:

• Finanzen: Attraktive Vergütung sowie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld.

• Work-Life-Balance : 30 Tage Urlaub, Betriebssport und umfassende Gesundheitsvorsorge.

• Entwicklung: Intensive Prüfungsvorbereitung, Fachhochschulreife (optional) und vielfältige Weiterbildungen.
