Descrizione Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous montrer tel que vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l’expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où l’on est valorisé, accepté et respecté pour ce qu’on est, ce qui vous permet de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies, et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La Posizione À notre site de Bâle, nous proposons un poste passionnant en tant qu’agent en équipe dans un environnement de production innovant et à la pointe de la technologie. Dans la division Substance Médicamenteuse de Bâle, nous sommes responsables de la production d’ingrédients actifs salvateurs pour la thérapie du cancer dans nos installations de production hautement automatisées pour la technologie à usage unique (SUT) et les conjugués anticorps-médicament (ADC). Nos procédés de fabrication sophistiqués sont réalisés en stricte conformité avec les bonnes pratiques de fabrication actuelles (cGMP) et combinent des technologies de pointe avec les normes de qualité les plus élevées. Le domaine d’activité comprend la production de milieux de culture et de tampons, la réalisation de la culture cellulaire, la purification des ingrédients actifs biologiques ainsi que la production et le traitement des produits ADC dans un environnement de production fortement réglementé. En tant qu’opérateur, vous travaillerez à travers différentes entreprises au sein des opérations SUT et ADC et contribuerez activement à la fourniture de thérapies innovantes aux patients. Vous exploiterez et surveillerez des systèmes hautement automatisés, veillerez au respect des exigences de qualité et de sécurité et travaillerez au sein d’une équipe dynamique et interdisciplinaire. Mansioni - Mise en œuvre de procédés biotechnologiques de production (amont, aval, ADC) conformément aux spécifications GMP - Production et gestion de milieux, tampons, échantillons ainsi que consommables et matériaux à usage unique - Exploitation, surveillance et maintenance des usines, y compris la gestion des pannes et des alarmes - Garantie de la documentation conforme aux BPF ainsi que du contrôle et de la complétion des documents - Surveillance du statut de l’usine qualifiée et soutien de la Gestion des matériaux - Enregistrement, documentation et rapport des écarts et incidents spéciaux - Formation des employés et garantie de la sécurité, de l’ordre et de la propreté dans le domaine de travail
• Requisiti - Formation professionnelle suivie en tant que technologue chimiste et pharmaceutique ou équivalente - Bonne compréhension des BPF, idéalement avec expérience en production pharmaceutique ou biotechnologie - Bonne connaissance de MS Office (Word, Excel) et idéalement de Veeva et MES - Expérience dans la gestion de systèmes automatisés à l’échelle de la production - Très bon allemand écrit et parlé ; La connaissance de l’anglais est un avantage – la volonté de travailler se relève Chi siamo Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde sont dévoués à faire progresser la science, garantissant à tous l’accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts aboutissent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et à plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous donnons mutuellement les moyens d’explorer de nouvelles possibilités, de favoriser la créativité et de maintenir nos ambitions élevées, afin de pouvoir proposer des solutions de santé qui changent des vies et qui ont un impact mondial. Bâtissons un avenir plus sain, ensemble. Roche est un employeur offrant l’égalité des chances.

jobs.title: Medical Director - CVM
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:

• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:
• M.D. Required

• Therapeutic knowledge within metabolism, obesity, and diabetes with relevant clinical, scientific, and clinical trial/development experience required

• Academic/teaching background is a plus

• Experience working with the principles and techniques of data analysis, interpretation, and clinical relevance

• Experience publishing results of a scientific study in a peer-reviewed journal is preferred

• Regulatory: Knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA, and other relevant guidelines and regulations is preferred

• Duration of Experience: 2 or more years of post-graduate academic or clinical experience

• Up to 30% global travel

Key Skills and Behaviours

• Ethics: Has impeccable ethics. Demonstrates, or proven ability to demonstrate, Roche Values

• Attention to detail: Outstanding attention to detail

• Business Acumen: Has working knowledge of the pharma/biotech industry, the multiple functions and roles involved in the drug development process. Regularly leads development of disease strategies and plans

• Organization: Can prioritize multiple tasks and goals on time, on target, and within budget

• Interpersonal skills : Good interpersonal, verbal communication and influencing skills: can influence without authority

• Writing: Strong written communication skills

• Presentation skills: Good business presentation skills; is comfortable and effective when presenting to others, internally or externally.Confident and competent when interacting with others internally and externally: stays focused and on-point, is able to raise problems or challenges in a productive and mature manner

• Negotiation Skills : Good negotiation skills: knows how to complete deliverables by working effectively with others internally and externally

• Decision Making: Knows how to make trade-off decisions while balancing ethics and efficacy

• Teamwork: Strong orientation to teamwork

SPECIFIC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
CDP Strategy and Planning

• Participates in development of the CD plan for assigned molecule(s)/indication(s)

• Gathers and analyzes data and information necessary to create the CD plan

• Works with other CST members and relevant sub-teams to develop CD plan components (e.g., analytics/data strategy, KOL development, publications strategy, etc.)

• Works with CST and other relevant teams to develop and provide information and input for budget/resource requirements necessary to implement and execute the CD plan

• Stays abreast of internal and external developments, trends and other dynamics relevant to the work of CD to maintain, at all times, a fully current view and perspective of internal/external influences and/or implications for the assigned therapeutic and disease area(s)

• As appropriate, participates in competitive intelligence and/or other market/industry assessment activities and projects

• Maintains the highest standards and levels of scientific and clinical knowledge in the specific therapeutic and disease area(s) of assignment

• Collaborates with a variety of internal and external partners and stakeholders, such as clinical investigators, clinicians, scientists and key opinion leaders (KOLs), as well as multidisciplinary internal groups, including other groups in PD, research, business development, commercial ope

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Die Organisation “Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst”, Teil der globalen Group Function “Corporate Strategy, Sustainability & Sites”, stellt die Infrastruktur und Services für den gesamten Standort Basel und Kaiseraugst bereit und entwickelt diese kontinuierlich und auf innovative Art weiter. Wir arbeiten mit allen Anspruchsgruppen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette zusammen, von der frühen Forschung bis zur Versorgung der Patient:innen. Bei uns kannst du dich auf ein modernes Organisationsmodell freuen, in welchem du in Eigenverantwortung deine Talente in sinnhafter Arbeit einbringen kannst. Wir garantieren Gestaltungsspielraum und Entscheidungsfreiheit in unserer Organisation. Klassische Vorgesetzte suchst du bei uns vergebens.

Das Team «Energien und Medien» stellt am Standort Kaiseraugst die zuverlässige Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung unserer bestehenden und zukünftigen Areal- und Energiesysteme sicher. Wir bieten dir die Gelegenheit, als Praktikant/in aktiv an der Verbesserung und Neugestaltung unserer Infrastruktur mitzuwirken und dabei tiefgreifende GxP-Kenntnisse zu erwerben. In deinem Praktikum bist du an der Schnittstelle zwischen klassischem Ingenieurwesen und modernster Technologie tätig. Dein Ziel ist die Sicherstellung einer konsistenten Datenbasis für unsere Medienanlagen im GMP-Umfeld.

Die Möglichkeit

• KI-gestützte Optimierung: Bei Deiner Evaluierung nutzt Du moderne KI-Tools, um diese Abgleichprozesse effizienter zu gestalten und Dateninkonsistenzen zu identifizieren. Darüber Hinaus unterstützt Du im Einsatz und bei der Etablierung von KI-Tools im Engineering-Bereich.

• Prozessverbesserung: Du arbeitest aktiv bei der Optimierung von Infrastrukturanlagen und Prozessen mit, um die operative Effizienz zu steigern.

• Design-Phasen: Du unterstützt uns bei der Konzeption und Projektabwicklung im Rahmen aller Design Phasen innerhalb des Engineerings.

• Messstellen-Audit & Datenabgleich: Du verifizierst die Messstellenbezeichnungen über verschiedene Dokumentationsebenen hinweg (R&I-Fliessschemata / E-Schemata / Messstellenlisten / Gebäudeleitsystem).

• Lifecycle-Management: Du wirkst bei der Erstellung und Ablage der Engineering Unterlagen (Werksdokumentation) mit.

Wer Du bist
Du bist aktuell immatrikulierte/r Student:in (Bachelor/Master) oder hast dein Studium in den Bereich Ingenieurwesen, Verfahrenstechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung innerhalb der letzten 12 Monate erfolgreich abgeschlossen. Weiterhin hast du

• hohe Affinität zu digitalen Themen und Interesse am praktischen Einsatz von KI-Tools im technischen Umfeld.

• sorgfältige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und ein Auge für Details.

• Begeisterung für innovative Visualisierungslösungen (z. B. 3D-Scanning, Digital Twins).

• gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten für den Austausch in einem interdisziplinären Team.

• fliessende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind zwingend erforderlich; gute Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

Bewerbungsprozess

• Das Startdatum ist 1. September 2026 (100% Pensum), für 6 Monate.

• Damit deine Bewerbung berücksichtigt wird, muss ein aktueller Lebenslauf sowie ein Motivationsschreiben eingereicht werden.

• Nicht-EU/nicht-EFTA Staatler:innen müssen eine Bescheinigung ihrer Universität beilegen, dass das Praktikum obligatorischer Bestandteil des Studiums ist.

• Die angebotene Stelle ist nicht geeignet für die Durchführung einer Thesis oder einer Diplomarbeit.

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören.

Who we a

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Da Roche puoi mostrarti come te stesso, accolto per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, dove sei valorizzato, accettato e rispettato per ciò che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso all'assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. L'organizzazione "Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst", parte della funzione globale di gruppo "Corporate Strategy, Sustainability & Sites", fornisce l'infrastruttura e i servizi per l'intera sede di Basilea e Kaiseraugst e li sviluppa continuamente in modo innovativo. Lavoriamo con tutti gli stakeholder lungo tutta la catena del valore, dalla ricerca iniziale alla cura dei pazienti. Con noi, potrai aspettarti un modello organizzativo moderno in cui potrai mettere a disposizione i tuoi talenti in un lavoro significativo sotto la tua responsabilità. Garantiamo libertà creativa e di scelta nella nostra organizzazione. Non troverai superiori classici con noi. Il team "Energies and Media" garantisce l'implementazione affidabile e lo sviluppo ulteriore dei nostri sistemi esistenti e futuri nel sito di Kaiseraugst. Ti offriamo l'opportunità di partecipare attivamente al miglioramento e alla riprogettazione della nostra infrastruttura come stagista e di acquisire una conoscenza approfondita di GxP nel processo. Durante il tirocinio, lavorerai all'interfaccia tra l'ingegneria classica e la tecnologia all'avanguardia. Il tuo obiettivo è garantire un database coerente per i nostri sistemi multimediali nell'ambiente GMP. Mansioni - Ottimizzazione basata sull'IA: Nella tua valutazione, utilizzerai strumenti moderni di IA per rendere questi processi di abbinamento più efficienti e identificare le incongruenze dei dati. Inoltre, sosterrete l'uso e l'istituzione di strumenti di IA nel settore dell'ingegneria. - Miglioramento dei processi: parteciperai attivamente all'ottimizzazione degli asset infrastrutturali e dei processi per aumentare l'efficienza operativa. - Fasi di progettazione: ci supporterai nella concezione e nell'esecuzione del progetto all'interno di tutte le fasi di progettazione dell'ingegneria. - Audit dei punti di misurazione e confronto dati: Verificherai le designazioni dei punti di misurazione a diversi livelli di documentazione (diagrammi di flusso P&ID / diagrammi E / liste dei punti di misurazione / sistema di gestione degli edifici). - Gestione del ciclo di vita: sarai coinvolto nella creazione e nell'archiviazione di documenti ingegneristici (documentazione di fabbrica).
• Requisiti - Sei attualmente studente/ssa iscritto/a (Bachelor/Master) o hai concluso con successo gli studi in Ingegneria, Ingegneria di processo o discipline affini negli ultimi 12 mesi. - Alta affinità con i temi digitali e interesse per l'applicazione pratica di strumenti KI in ambito tecnico. - Approccio lavorativo accurato, strutturato e attento ai dettagli. - Entusiasmo per soluzioni di visualizzazione innovative (es. 3D-Scanning, Digital Twins). - Buone capacità comunicative per lo scambio in un team interdisciplinare. - Conoscenza fluente della lingua tedesca (scritto e parlato) è requisito indispensabile; Una buona conoscenza dell'inglese è un vantaggio. Processo di Candidatura - La data di inizio è il 1 settembre 2026 (100% del carico lavorativo), per una durata di 6 mesi. - Per essere considerata, la candidatura deve includere un curriculum vitae aggiornato e una lettera di motivazione. - I/le candidati/e non UE/non SEE devono allegare un certificato dell'università che attesti che il tirocinio è parte obbligatoria del percorso di studi. - La posizione offerta non è adatta per lo svolgimento di una tesi o di un lavoro di diploma. Contatto Pronto per il prossimo passo? Non vediamo l'ora di sentirti. Chi siamo Chi siamo

• hohe Affinität zu digitalen Themen und Interesse am praktischen Einsatz von KI-Tools im technischen Umfeld.
• sorgfältige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und ein Auge für Details.
• Begeisterung für innovative Visualisierungslösungen (z. B. 3D-Scanning, Digital Twins).
• gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten für den Austausch in einem interdisziplinären Team.

• Das Startdatum ist 1. September 2026 (100% Pensum), für 6 Monate.

Descrizione Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous montrer tel que vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l’expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où l’on est valorisé, accepté et respecté pour ce qu’on est, ce qui vous permet de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies, et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. L’organisation « Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst », faisant partie de la fonction mondiale du groupe « Stratégie d’entreprise, durabilité & sites », fournit l’infrastructure et les services pour l’ensemble du site de Bâle et de Kaiseraugst et les développe continuellement de manière innovante. Nous travaillons avec toutes les parties prenantes tout au long de la chaîne de valeur, de la recherche précoce aux soins aux patients. Avec nous, vous pouvez vous attendre à un modèle organisationnel moderne dans lequel vous pouvez apporter vos talents dans un travail significatif sur votre propre responsabilité. Nous garantissons la liberté créative et la liberté de choix dans notre organisation. Vous ne trouverez pas de supérieurs classiques chez nous. L’équipe « Énergies et médias » veille à la mise en œuvre fiable et au développement futur de nos systèmes actuels et futurs de site et énergétiques sur le site de Kaiseraugst. Nous vous offrons la possibilité de participer activement à l’amélioration et à la refonte de notre infrastructure en tant que stagiaire et d’acquérir une connaissance approfondie de GxP dans le processus. Pendant votre stage, vous travaillerez à l’interface entre l’ingénierie classique et la technologie de pointe. Votre objectif est d’assurer une base de données cohérente pour nos systèmes médias dans l’environnement GMP. Mansioni - Optimisation alimentée par l’IA : Dans votre évaluation, vous utiliserez des outils d’IA modernes pour rendre ces processus de correspondance plus efficaces et identifier les incohérences des données. De plus, vous soutiendrez l’utilisation et le développement d’outils d’IA dans le secteur de l’ingénierie. - Amélioration des processus : Vous participerez activement à l’optimisation des actifs et processus d’infrastructure afin d’accroître l’efficacité opérationnelle. - Phases de conception : Vous nous accompagnerez dans la conception et l’exécution du projet dans le cadre de toutes les phases de conception au sein de l’ingénierie. - Audit des points de comptage et comparaison des données : Vous vérifierez les désignations des points de mesure à différents niveaux de documentation (diagrammes de flux P&ID / diagrammes électroniques / listes de points de comptage / système de gestion de bâtiment). - Gestion du cycle de vie : Vous serez impliqué dans la création et le stockage des documents d’ingénierie (documentation d’usine).
• Requirements - Sei attualmente studente/ssa iscritto/a (Bachelor/Master) o hai conclu con successo gli studi in Ingegneria, Ingegneria di processo o discipline affini negli ultimi 12 mesi. - Alta affinità con i temi digitali e interesse per l’application pratica di strumenti KI in ambito tecnico. - Approccio lavorativo accurato, strutturato e attento ai dettagli. - Entusiasmo per solutions di visualizzazione innovative (es. 3D-Scanning, Digital Twins). - Buone capacità comunicative per lo scambio in un team interdisciplinare. - Conoscenza fluente della lingua tedesca (scritto e parlato) est requisito indispensabile ; Una buona conoscenza dell’anglais est un avantage. Processo di Candidatura - La data di inizio è il 1 settembre 2026 (100 % del carico lavorativo), per una durata di 6 mesi. - Per être considérée, la candidatura doit inclure un curriculum vitae aggiornato e una lettera di motivazione. - I/le candidati/e non UE/non SEE doivent allegare un certificato dell’università che attesti que il tirocinio est parte obbligatoria del percorso di studi. - La posizione offre non est adatta per lo svolgimento di una tesi o di un lavoro di diploma. Contact, prêt pour la prochaine étape ? Nous avons hâte d’avoir de vos nouvelles avec impatience. Chi Siamo Qui sommes-nous

jobs.title: 治疗领域专员
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
您是谁
您负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

您的机会:
A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:
•3年以上医药行业工作经验
•既往有销售/市场/医学经验
•跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书
•医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Finance Enterprise Partner Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. The Finance Enterprise Partner (FEP) at Roche Diagnostics Denmark will lead serves as a key business partner to the commercial organization. As the FEP Lead, you will act as a trusted thought partner across the entire value chain, leveraging your financial expertise and deep business understanding to drive strategies that deliver value for our customers, the affiliate, and the wider enterprise.

In this pivotal role at Roche Diagnostics Denmark , you will have a team of specialists and experts, specifically overseeing a team of FEPs and Finance Excellence Partners (FxPs), while also holding dotted-line management responsibility for the Tender Manager. In this role, you will be reporting to Head of Finance and Operations.

Your Impact

Leadership & Team Management

• Leads a team of specialists/experts, adapting plans and priorities to address resource and operational challenges.

• Role models the role of a leader as visionary, architect, catalyst and coach (VACC) and lives the Roche operating principles.

• Creates a psychologically safe environment and culture necessary for the team to be successful.

• Supports network building across the organization (including the Finance Excellence Partner) to share best practices and co-create solutions.

• Empowers decision-making at the lowest level, enabling team members to come up with innovative designs and solutions.
Tender Management & Commercial Strategy

• Architects robust process and financial rigor into tenders, acting as a dotted-line manager to the Tender Manager to ensure highly competitive and profitable bids.

• Playsan active part in ensuring sustainable commercial deals by considering risk evaluation, competitor assumptions and implementing sustainable pricing strategies.

• Serves as a key partner for developing a coherent affiliate commercial strategy and commercial business related processes such as business planning and opportunity prioritization.

• Supports the business and customers in co-creating new business models, quantifying value, and providing pricing transparency.

Financial & Operational Rigor

• Acts as a key guide for P&L and financial target achievement. This involves close monitoring of the numbers, from top-line to bottom-line, and providing direction on accounting implications.

• Proposes and drive ideas for P&L improvement, especially upsell opportunities, efficiency/waste improvement, and risk reduction.

• Solves problems autonomously with minimal guidance.

• Balances resource allocation across competing priorities and provide advice on financial implications of proposed business activities.

• Ensures financials are on track to achieve targeted business results and metrics, or advise on deviations and corrective actions.

• Monitors and manages customer performance over the whole contract life cycle with a profitability and outcomes based perspective.

What You Bring

• Experience in leading, developing and coaching individuals in a team.

• An entrepreneurial, commercial, and customer-centric mindset with an ability to put all available financial and operational information into a holistic picture.

• An understanding of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) to be able to guide the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow implications of decisions for the sales affiliate

• Strong business and financial acumen, coupled with experience partnering with stakeholders.

• Strong analytical ski

jobs.title: Medical Director (CVM)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:

• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:

•
• M.D. Required

• Therapeutic knowledge within metabolism, obesity, and diabetes with relevant clinical, scientific, and clinical trial/development experience required

• Academic/teaching background is a plus

• Experience working with the principles and techniques of data analysis, interpretation, and clinical relevance

• Experience publishing results of a scientific study in a peer-reviewed journal is preferred

• Regulatory: Knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA, and other relevant guidelines and regulations is preferred

• Duration of Experience: 2 or more years of post-graduate academic or clinical experience

• Up to 30% global travel

Key Skills and Behaviours

• Ethics: Has impeccable ethics. Demonstrates, or proven ability to demonstrate, Roche Values

• Attention to detail: Outstanding attention to detail

• Business Acumen: Has working knowledge of the pharma/biotech industry, the multiple functions and roles involved in the drug development process. Regularly leads development of disease strategies and plans

• Organization: Can prioritize multiple tasks and goals on time, on target, and within budget

• Interpersonal skills : Good interpersonal, verbal communication and influencing skills: can influence without authority

• Writing: Strong written communication skills

• Presentation skills: Good business presentation skills; is comfortable and effective when presenting to others, internally or externally.Confident and competent when interacting with others internally and externally: stays focused and on-point, is able to raise problems or challenges in a productive and mature manner

• Negotiation Skills : Good negotiation skills: knows how to complete deliverables by working effectively with others internally and externally

• Decision Making: Knows how to make trade-off decisions while balancing ethics and efficacy

• Teamwork: Strong orientation to teamwork

SPECIFIC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
CDP Strategy and Planning

• Participates in development of the CD plan for assigned molecule(s)/indication(s)

• Gathers and analyzes data and information necessary to create the CD plan

• Works with other CST members and relevant sub-teams to develop CD plan components (e.g., analytics/data strategy, KOL development, publications strategy, etc.)

• Works with CST and other relevant teams to develop and provide information and input for budget/resource requirements necessary to implement and execute the CD plan

• Stays abreast of internal and external developments, trends and other dynamics relevant to the work of CD to maintain, at all times, a fully current view and perspective of internal/external influences and/or implications for the assigned therapeutic and disease area(s)

• As appropriate, participates in competitive intelligence and/or other market/industry assessment activities and projects

• Maintains the highest standards and levels of scientific and clinical knowledge in the specific therapeutic and disease area(s) of assignment

• Collaborates with a variety of internal and external partners and stakeholders, such as clinical investigators, clinicians, scientists and key opinion leaders (KOLs), as well as multidisciplinary internal groups, including other groups in PD, research, business development, commercial

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Intern - French speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for you to join Roche and our Services & Solutions Center in Budapest .
Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. This is the reason why we are continuously expanding, looking for new talents to join our transforming Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework (2 office days/week on average).

Your day to day responsibilities are:
We are looking for a pro-active, passionate and talented Talent Acquisition Intern colleague for our team in Budapest. As a Talent Acquisition Intern you will be responsible for supporting the daily work of the Talent Acquisition Partners in the recruitment process for open roles.

We are offering an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on work experience and insights into Recruiting as well as wider HR topics during a very dynamic time at Roche. You will be an integral part of our TA team, managing recruiting activities across various client groups. In addition you will lead and support a range of global initiatives enabling our organisation to adapt to new technologies and new ways of working.

As our trusted Intern colleague, you will:

• Candidate sourcing, application screening, requisitions clean up, scheduling and assessment

• Handling of candidate workflow using our e-recruitment system: Workday

• Partnering with Talent Acquisition Partners, Early in Career Partners,, business departments and People & Culture colleagues globally

• Supporting the team with reports and presentations, as well as actively looking for process improvements

• Supporting one or more of our client group’s global transformation programs

• Other activities related to the role and business needs

We are keen to discover talents who are passionate about learning and show high curiosity in discovering new things.

What can you bring to our team:
You’re someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies. Where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point. Furthermore:

• y​ou have ongoing studies at any Hungarian University/college

• ​y​ou are available at least 30 hours per week

• ​y​ou have a good command of French and English and have outstanding communication skills

• ​y​ou have a customer oriented mind-set and you are creative, enthusiastic, pro-active and​ open to taking over new tasks

• you are open to learn and develop

• you have the passion to find people careers rather than simply jobs

• you are willing to learn and develop and you are open for further career opportunities within Roche.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Valuable professional experience

• Competitive salary

• Flexible working hours according to your studies

• Support for university thesis writing

• Training opportunities

• Good, accessible location

• Great, people-focused company culture

• Young and dynamic environment

• Social events & team-building opportunities

• Opportunity for full time role after graduation

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted usin

jobs.title: Data Management & Governance Senior Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior Data Management & Governance Specialist is a data-minded professional preferable with IT business operations and IT strategy & portfolio experience..
In this role, you're excited about using data governance and quality foundations to unlock the next generation of IT maturity: agentic AI, intelligent automation, and data-driven IT decision-making.
The position involves actively managing data assets, ensuring data quality, lineage, and metadata accuracy, and supporting data stewardship programs. You will work closely with business and technical stakeholders to define data definitions, resolve data issues, and ensure compliance with internal policies and external regulations, contributing significantly to a trusted and well-managed data environment.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership):

• Leads, develops, and enforces data governance policies aligned with IT4IT value streams. Works independently on specific governance projects to ensure organizational alignment and data integrity.

• Accountability/Problem Solving:

• Develop Data Standards and data models for critical IT data entities across the IT4IT value streams.

• Diagnose root cause of poor data quality in IT operations.

• Implement proactive data quality frameworks following Enterprise Data Strategy guidelines.

• Stakeholder Management:

• Collaborates extensively with various departments to ensure compliance. Communicates effectively and clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to build trust and alignment.

• Impact/Strategy:

• Handles big-sized data governance projects. Develops and executes strategies that significantly improve data quality and overall organizational compliance.

• Align data governance with agentic AI readiness: Define data quality, trust, and compliance standards.

• Complexity / (Product Size):

• Oversees more complex data governance systems. Ensures critical data integrity and security across multiple business units.

• Create data lineage and ownership maps for IT operations data across the IT4IT system landscape, establishing clear accountability for data quality and currency.

• Manage data governance across complex IT operations ecosystems including ServiceNow, Data Warehouses, monitoring platforms, asset management tools, and emerging automation/AI systems

• Business / Technical ability:

• Applies high proficiency in data management tools and practices. Demonstrates and leverages a strong, comprehensive knowledge of data privacy laws and regulations to safeguard data assets.

• Apply knowledge of IT service management frameworks (e.g. IT4IT) to contextualize governance within ITSM processes.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Data-first mindset

• Demonstrated experience handling big-sized data governance projects and overseeing complex data governance systems.

• Proven track record of independently leading, developing, and enforcing data governance policies and standards across multiple business units.

• Experience actively managing data assets, ensuring data quality, lineage, and metadata accuracy.

• Familiarity with IT4IT framework and Common Service Data Model (CSDM) - strongly preferred

Technical / Business Skills

• Proficiency in utilizing data management tools and implementing data stewardship practices.

• Strong, in-depth knowledge of data privacy laws, regulatory requirements, and compliance standards.

• Understanding of IT service management frameworks: ITIL, IT4IT, or equivalent; ability to map gover

jobs.title: Business Strategy Praktikantenstelle (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Unser Team

Unser Team ist ein integraler Teil der globalen Sites Networks von Roche und betreut die großen Produktionsstandorte Mannheim und Penzberg (München). Wir gestalten die strategische Ausrichtung und organisatorische Entwicklung dieser Standorte. Mit einer umfangreichen strategischen Agenda treiben wir zahlreiche Initiativen und Projekte im Site Management voran, immer mit dem Ziel, messbaren Fortschritt und Verbesserung zu erreichen. In unserem aufgeschlossenen und ambitionierten Team wirst du in Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen, globalen und Konzernfunktionen standortübergreifend innovative Ideen und Lösungen entwickeln sowie umsetzen.
Deine Rolle
In dieser Schlüsselfunktion bringst du deine eigenen Ideen direkt ein. Durch die enge 1:1 Zusammenarbeit mit dem/der Chief of Staff nimmst du eine aktive Sparringspartner-Rolle ein, um zentrale Managementthemen des Sites Networks erfolgreich mitzugestalten. Als Teil des Stabs der Geschäftsführung unterstützen wir zudem bei allen relevanten Gremien (u.a. Betriebsrat, Wirtschaftsausschuss) und Terminen von Roche Diagnostics.
Deine Aufgaben in unserem Team setzen sich wie folgt zusammen:

• Konzeption und Umsetzung eines Dashboards von Business-relevanten KPIs zur Performancesteuerung im Site Management. Dabei gehört die kontinuierliche Reflektion von Optimierungspotenzialen zu deinen Aufgaben

• Durchführung von verschiedenen Analysen und Auswertungen laufender Initiativen im Site Management, wie beispielsweise Marktanalysen und Stakeholderanalysen

• Analyse der Voraussetzungen und Ausarbeitung eines ganzheitlichen und zielgerichteten Ansatzes für ein unternehmerisches Ökosystem in der Pharmabranche in Deutschland. Hierbei arbeitest du eng mit den Fachbereichen zusammen

• Eigenständige, konzeptionelle Vor- und Nachbereitung von Workshops, Meetings, Reportings und Entscheidungsvorlagen für das Management und Gremiensitzungen

• Mitwirkung bei der Koordination, Konzeption und Umsetzung von strategischen Projekten in direkter Abstimmung mit dem/der Chief of Staff

• Aktive Unterstützung des Managements bei der Weiterentwicklung von Business, Strategie und Innovation

Dein Profil

• Ein Master-Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang

• Relevante praktische Erfahrung durch mindestens zwei Praktika in der Unternehmensberatung, in strategischen Konzernrollen, einem Start-up oder ähnlichen Bereichen, in denen analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten sowie ein ausgeprägtes Organisationsgeschick erfolgreich unter Beweis gestellt wurden

• Zusätzliche Auslandserfahrung ist von Vorteil

• Die Mindestvoraussetzung für diese Rolle sind Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau,fließende Englischkenntnisse sowie ein sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Office-Programmen und Kollaborationstools

• Du überzeugst durch ausgeprägte kommunikative Fähigkeiten, eine gesunde Portion Neugier sowie ein starkes Gespür für Zahlen und Daten

• Eigenverantwortliches Vorantreiben von Themen, hohe Flexibilität bei der Aufgabenerfüllung und das entsprechende Mindset, in einem weltweit agierenden Pharmaunternehmen zu arbeiten

• Spaß an der Kombination aus Strategie und Innovation, kreativer Arbeit und einem hohen Maß an Verantwortung

​
Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung, Home-Office ist möglich

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/ offline)

• Ermäßigte Preise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Weiterbildu

jobs.title: Utilities Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Im Bereich Basel Drug Substance Manufacturing Large Molecules stellen wir mit modernsten Anlagen verschiedene therapeutische Wirkstoffe her.

In der Funktion als Utilities Manager unterstützen Sie den Chapter Utilities der Unit Facility Management (FM) & Safety, Health & Environment (SHE) und seine Kunden bei der Bearbeitung von Abweichungen und Änderungen, um nahtlosen Support für die kommerzielle & klinische Wirkstoffherstellung in den Bauten 91 (ADC/SUT) und 95 (MAB) bereitzustellen.

Die Möglichkeit

• Auslösen und Bearbeiten von Änderungen und Abweichungen als Owner auf lokaler Ebene (Drug Substance)

• Lösungsfindung im eigenen Verantwortungsbereich und darüber hinaus,sowie Mitarbeit bei der Ursachenanalyse

• Bearbeitung / Überprüfung von technischen GMP Dokumente (Vorschriften)

• User Vertretung bei Investitions- und Quality Projekten, sowie Beratung (inkl. Review) für die Unit, sowie Mitarbeit in Fragen der Dokumentation

• Sicherstellen des unterbruchsfreien Betrieb unserer Anlagen und Einhaltung unserer Qualitäts- und SHE Standards

• Aktive Zusammenarbeit mit den FM&SHE Teams (Operators, Kalibrierer, Facility & Monitoring Managers, SHE Beauftragter) und LT, Manufacturing Units (interne Kunden), QA Partnern, andere Support Organization (Pharma Engineering, Technical Compliance) & DS Site Stakeholders

Wer du bist

• Abgeschlossenes Studium an einer Hochschule oder Fachhochschule, idealerweise im Bereich Verfahrens- und Umwelttechnik oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Erstellung und Bearbeitung von GMP-Dokumenten sowie fundiertes cGMP-Verständnis

• Technisches Know-how in Betrieb, Wartung und Qualifizierung hochautomatisierter Pharma-Anlagen sowie Erfahrung mit Clean & Black Utilities

• Kenntnisse in Clean & Black Utilities zugehörigen Prozesse (Biotech), Reinstmedien-Monitoring, LEAN, Data Integrity und von KPIs von Vorteil

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse im technischen Schreiben sowie Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Nel campo di Basel Drug Substance Manufacturing Large Molecules produciamo vari principi attivi terapeutici con sistemi all'avanguardia. Nella funzione Utilities Manager, supporterai il Capitolo Utilities of Unit Facility Management (FM) & Safety, Health & Environment (SHE) e i suoi clienti nel trattamento delle deviazioni e delle modifiche per fornire un supporto senza soluzione di continuità per la produzione di sostanze attive commerciali e cliniche negli edifici 91 (ADC/SUT) e 95 (MAB). Mansioni - attivare e modificare le modifiche e le deviazioni come Proprietario a livello locale (Drug Substance) - trovare soluzioni nelle proprie aree di responsabilità e oltre, nonché cooperazione nell'analisi delle cause - Trattamento / revisione dei documenti tecnici GMP - Rappresentanza degli utenti per progetti di investimento e qualità, nonché consulenza (inclusa la revisione) per l'unità, nonché cooperazione sulla documentazione - Assicurare il funzionamento senza interruzioni dei nostri sistemi e il rispetto della nostra qualità e degli standard SHE - Collaborazione attiva con i team FM&SHE (operatori, calibratori, responsabili delle strutture e dei controlli, funzionari SHE) e LT, Unità di produzione (clienti interni), partner QA, altre organizzazioni di supporto (Pharma Engineering, Technical Compliance) & DS Site Stakeholders
• Requisiti - Studi completi presso un'università o un college, idealmente nel campo della tecnologia di processo e ambientale o in un corso di studio comparabile - Almeno 5 anni di esperienza nella creazione e nella modifica dei documenti GMP e della confessione CGMP - know-how tecnico nel funzionamento, manutenzione e qualificazione di impianti farmaceutici altamente automatizzati e di esperienza con Clean & Black Utilities - Conoscenza dei processi correlati di Clean & Black Utilities (biotech), monitoraggio dei media di pulizia, LEAN, Integrità dei dati e KPI - Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco in scrittura tecnica e inglese in parola e scrittura Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alti i nostri ambiziosi, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

jobs.title: UX / Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are

At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
We are looking for a talented and detail-oriented UX / Frontend Engineer to help build the next generation of our digital products in the life sciences sector. In this role, you will work closely with our Lead UX Designer / Frontend Engineer to implement complex user interfaces and dashboards that empower our Machine Learning and Data Science teams.

You will focus on writing clean, scalable frontend code, translating complex bioinformatics workflows into intuitive web applications, and contributing to a seamless user experience. If you are passionate about Vue.js, clean UI design, and want to help visualize critical scientific data, this is the perfect opportunity to grow your skills in a highly specialized environment.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop, test, and maintain responsive, high-performance web applications using Vue.js and Tailwind CSS frameworks.

• Collaborate directly with senior designers and engineers to translate complex workflows and wireframes into highly functional, user-centric code.

• Develop and optimize interactive data visualizations using D3.js to represent large-scale datasets across complex dashboards.

• Contribute to our internal component design system, ensuring reusable, accessible, and visually consistent UI elements across our platforms.

• Integrate frontend applications seamlessly with backend services via RESTful and GraphQL APIs in a cloud environment.

• Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, working cross-functionally with data scientists, backend engineers, and product managers to deliver features iteratively.

Who You Are
You are a talented, detail-oriented frontend professional who is passionate about clean UI design, modern web technologies, and data visualization. You excel at bridging the gap between design concepts and technical execution, and you thrive in collaborative environments where your work makes critical scientific data accessible.

Qualifications & Skills:

• 2–4 years of hands-on software development experience using modern JavaScript frameworks, with a strong, demonstrable focus on Vue.js.

• Solid proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, SASS, and modern utility-first styling frameworks like Tailwind CSS.

The Nice-to-Haves:

• A background, previous experience, or strong interest in the life sciences domain (e.g., Sequencing, PCR, Bioinformatics, or digital healthcare).

• Experience using design hand-off tools (like Figma or Sketch) and contributing to component librari

You will handle complex data projects alongside cross-functional teams, providing the robust infrastructure and tooling necessary for our Data Scientists to accomplish their research and production goals efficiently.

• A Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

• A very good understanding of complete ML workflows and hands-o

In this role, you will act as a technical lead, driving the long-term planning, architecture, and design of initiatives such as our core ML and Data Platform. You will handle complex data projects alongside cross-functional teams, providing the robust infrastructure and tooling necessary for our Data Scientists to accomplish their research and production goals efficiently. • Act as the central technical liaison between project stakeholders and the Data Science team, taking full ownership of integrating and deploying algorithms and machine learning models into production workflows.
• Design, build, and scale cloud-native and hybrid data and machine learning platforms (MLOps) tailored to the complex, evolving needs of our established Data Science team.
• Plan, architect, and develop long-term enterprise tooling and infrastructure for internal use to accelerate and streamline ML model research, training, and evaluation.
• Take responsibility for the end-to-end software and data architecture within Data Science initiatives, independently driving the specification, implementation, and testing of complex technical assignments.
• Serve as a technical lead and subject matter expert, gathering requirements from data-focused profiles to continuously improve the ML platform while mentoring peers to foster a culture of engineering excellence. • Strict adherence to coding best practices (e.g., TDD, ATDD), rigorous testing strategies, and proper version control.
• A very good understanding of complete ML workflows and hands-on experience provisioning the infrastructure required to support them.
• Significant expe

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deine Abteilung
In unserem Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC) unterstützen wir Kunden aus Diagnostiklaboren und Krankenhäusern in mehreren europäischen Ländern bei technischen, applikativen und IT-nahen Fragestellungen rund um Roche Systeme der in-vitro Diagnostik. In dieser Rolle liegt dein Fokus auf der Schnittstelle von Molekulardiagnostik, Laborprozessen und IT-Systemen. Dabei unterstützt du insbesondere bei Themen wie LIS-Anbindung, Connectivity, Middleware und digitalen Labor-Workflows.

Für unser internationales RCSC suchen wir einen Junior Application Specialist (m/w/d) in Mannheim (DE), Almere (NL) oder Vilvoorde (BE).

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich

• Bearbeitung von applikativen und systembezogenen Kundenanfragen

• Unterstützung bei der Analyse von Problemstellungen im Zusammenspiel von diagnostischen Systemen, Labor-IT und Kundenprozessen

• Mitarbeit an Lösungen zu Connectivity- und Schnittstellenthemen, z. B. im Umfeld von LIS, Middleware und Remote Connectivity

• sorgfältige Dokumentation von Fällen und Lösungen im CRM-System

• Durchführung von Kunden- und Mitarbeiterschulungen

• Aufbereitung und Weitergabe von produkt- und systemrelevanten Informationen

• gelegentliche Unterstützung von Außendienstkollegen:innen bei Einsätzen im Kundenlabor

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Du sprichst und schreibst fließend Niederländisch- und Englisch. Deutsch, Türkisch oder Griechisch sind ein Plus.

• Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium, idealerweise in Molekularbiologie, Biochemie, Medizininformatik, Biomedizintechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. Alternativ verfügst du über eine naturwissenschaftliche oder medizinisch-technische Ausbildung und möchtest dich in einem applikativen und IT-nahen Umfeld weiterentwickeln.

• Du bringst erste Kenntnisse oder ein starkes Interesse im Bereich Molekulardiagnostik mit.

• Du hast Freude an technischen Zusammenhängen und eine ausgeprägte IT-Affinität.

• Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Berührungspunkte mit LIS, Labor-IT, Middleware, Connectivity oder Systemintegrationen gesammelt.

• Du arbeitest gerne mit komplexen Systemen und gehst Fragestellungen strukturiert und lösungsorientiert an.

• Kundenorientierung, Kommunikationsstärke und Teamgeist zeichnen dich aus.

• Du wohnst in der Nähe von Mannheim, Almere oder Vilvoorde und bist bereit, regelmäßig nach Mannheim zu reisen.

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente: Aktueller Lebenslauf. Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt.

Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Dort, wo Entgelttransparenz vorgeschrieben ist, geben wir die Informationen basierend auf dem Hauptstandort der Stelle an. Für diese Position ist der Hauptstandort Mannheim. Falls Du dich für einen anderen Standort interessierst, an denen die Stelle möglicherweise ebenfalls verfügbar ist, geben wir Dir die entsprechenden Entgeltinformationen im weiteren Verlauf des Bewerbungsprozesses.
Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treat

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Da Roche puoi mostrarti come te stesso, accolto per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, dove sei valorizzato, accettato e rispettato per ciò che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso all'assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La Posizione Nel nostro Centro Regionale di Assistenza Clienti (RCSC), supportiamo clienti provenienti da laboratori diagnostici e ospedali in diversi paesi europei con questioni tecniche, applicative e IT relative ai sistemi diagnostici in vitro di Roche. In questo ruolo, il tuo focus sarà sull'interfaccia tra diagnostica molecolare, processi di laboratorio e sistemi IT. In particolare, fornirai supporto in argomenti come la connessione LIS, la connettività, il middleware e i flussi di lavoro di laboratorio digitale. Per il nostro RCSC internazionale cerchiamo un Junior Application Specialist (m/f/d) a Mannheim (DE), Almere (NL) o Vilvoorde (BE). Mansioni - Elaborazione delle richieste di clienti relative ad applicazioni e sistemi - Supporto nell'analisi di problemi nell'interazione tra sistemi diagnostici, IT di laboratorio e processi clienti - Collaborazione su soluzioni per problemi di connettività e interfaccia, ad esempio nell'ambiente di LIS, middleware e connettività remota - Documentazione attenta di casi e soluzioni nel sistema CRM - Implementazione di formazione per clienti e dipendenti - Preparazione e trasferimento di prodotto e comunicazione Informazioni rilevanti per il sistema - Supporto occasionale dei colleghi del servizio sul campo durante incarichi nel laboratorio del cliente
• Requisiti - Parli e scrivi fluentemente in olandese e inglese. Tedesco, turco o greco sono un vantaggio. - Hai una laurea, idealmente in biologia molecolare, biochimica, informatica medica, ingegneria biomedica o una disciplina comparabile. In alternativa, hai una formazione scientifica o medico-tecnica e vorresti svilupparti ulteriormente in un ambiente applicativo e informatico. - Hai conoscenze iniziali o un forte interesse nel campo della diagnostica molecolare. - Ti piacciono i contesti tecnici e hai una forte affinità per l'IT. - Idealmente, hai già ottenuto il primo contatto con LIS, IT di laboratorio, middleware, connettività o integrazioni di sistema. - Ti piace lavorare con sistemi complessi e affrontare le questioni in modo strutturato e orientato alla soluzione. - Sei caratterizzato da orientamento al cliente, forti capacità comunicative e spirito di squadra. - Vivi vicino a Mannheim, Almere o Vilvoorde e sei disposto a viaggiare regolarmente a Mannheim. Candidatura - Vi chiediamo i seguenti documenti: CV attuale. Al momento non sono assolutamente necessari ulteriori documenti. - Prima di inviare la domanda, si prega di notare che non possono essere aggiunti ulteriori documenti successivamente. Informazioni aggiuntive Quando è richiesta trasparenza salariale, forniamo le informazioni in base alla posizione principale del lavoro. La sede principale di questa posizione è Mannheim. Se sei interessato a un'altra sede dove la posizione potrebbe essere disponibile, ti forniremo le informazioni salariali rilevanti nel corso successivo del processo di candidatura. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, oltre 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati a far avanzare la scienza, garantendo a tutti l'accesso all'assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni future. I nostri sforzi portano a oltre 26 milioni di persone curate ogni anno. Contatta: il tuo contatto con noi! Con le persone. Per le persone. - Hai bisogno di ulteriore supporto? Consulta le FAQ su https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Pharma Technical Development Europe Biologics (PTDE) bringt innovative Therapien von der klinischen Phase bis zur Markteinführung. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Entwicklung sicherer und wirksamer Arzneimittel mithilfe modernster Technologien in Herstellung, klinischer Versorgung, Formulierung, Verpackung und Analytik.
Das Drug Product Clinical Supply Center (PTDE-C) in Basel produziert und füllt sterile Darreichungsformen für klinische Studien (Phase I–III) in hochmodernen Anlagen.
Als Praktikant*in unterstützt du das Chapter Manufacturing Compounding & Visual Inspection bei der Herstellung von Lösungen vor der Abfüllung sowie bei der visuellen Kontrolle von Vials und Spritzen. Zudem erhältst du Einblicke in angrenzende Bereiche wie Filling, E2E Manufacturing Support, Science & Technology und Qualitätssicherung.

Die Möglichkeit

• Unterstützung der Kollegen bei der Lösungsherstellung und visuellen Kontrolle

• Identifizierung, Evaluierung und Vorantreiben von Verbesserungen im Rahmen von Operational Excellence (Lean & Six Sigma), cGMP (Planned Events / Changes)

• Technische Bewertung und Implementierung von neuem Equipment

• Unterstützung der Teamkultur (New Ways of Working)

• Erstellen und Optimierung von cGMP Dokumenten, z.B. Arbeits und Bedienungsanweisungen im anwendbaren Quality System (Veeva)

• Sicherstellung der Qualitätsanforderungen nach cGMP

• Erstellen von Prozess- / Durchsatz- / Produkttracking, um Daten-basierter Entscheidungen zu ermöglichen

• Unterstützung bei Selbstinspektionen, Audits, Gemba Walks

Wer Du bist

• Immatrikulation an einer Universität oder Fach-/Hochschule oder abgeschlossenes Studium, dass nicht länger als 12 Monate zurückliegt, vorzugsweise in einem Life Sciences-, Pharmazie-, oder Engineering-Bereich und bringst folgende Fähigkeiten mit

• Erste Erfahrung in der technischen Entwicklung / Herstellung und / oder Kontrolle von parenteralen Arzneiformen

• Erfahrung in der Pharma Industrie (cGMP) oder einem anderen regulierten Umfeld

• Hohe Teamfähigkeit mit sehr guten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Wort und Schrift in Deutsch / Englisch und Offenheit, auf Kollegen aktiv zuzugehen

• Sehr gute Dokumentationsfähigkeiten

• Routinierter Umgang mit IT-Systemen (zb. Google Workspace, gSheet, MS Office, Smartsheet, Tableau, Minitab etc.)

• Engagement, Motivation sowie hohe Bereitschaft selbständig zu arbeiten

Zusätliche Information

• Das Praktikum startet sobald wie möglich. Die Praktikumsdauer ist 9-12 Monate.

• Für die Bewerbung benötigen wir eine gültige Immatrikulationsbestätigung, ein Motivationsschreiben und einen Lebenslauf.

• Nicht-EU / EFTA-Bürger*innen müssen eine Bestätigung der Universität, dass ein Pflichtpraktikum Teil der Ausbildung ist , den Bewerbungsunterlagen beilegen. Bitte erwähne das gewünschte Startdatum und die Dauer in deinem Motivationsschreiben.

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören. Bewerbe dich jetzt, um diese spannende Möglichkeit zu entdecken!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make

Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Pharma Technical Development Europe Biologics (PTDE) porta terapie innovative dalla fase clinica al lancio del mercato. Il nostro obiettivo è lo sviluppo di farmaci sicuri ed efficaci utilizzando tecnologie all'avanguardia nella produzione, nella cura clinica, nella formulazione, nell'imballaggio e nell'analisi. Il Drug Product Clinical Supply Center (PTDE-C) di Basilea produce e riempie forme di dosaggio sterile per gli studi clinici (Phase I-III) in strutture all'avanguardia. In qualità di tirocinante, supporta il Capitolo Manufacturing Compounding & Visual Inspection nella produzione di soluzioni prima di riempire e controllare visiva di flaconi e siringhe. Potrai anche ottenere informazioni in aree adiacenti come Filling, E2E Manufacturing Support, Scienza & Tecnologia e Garanzia di Qualità. Mansioni - Supporto di colleghi nella produzione di soluzioni e controllo visivo - Identificazione, valutazione e avanzamento dei miglioramenti nell'eccellenza operativa (Lean & Six Sigma), cGMP (Planned Events / Changes) - Valutazione tecnica e realizzazione di nuove attrezzature - Supporto per la cultura del team (New Ways of Working) - Creazione e ottimizzazione di documenti cGMP, ad esempio istruzioni di lavoro e utente nel Sistema Qualità applicabile (Veeva) - Garantire requisiti di qualità secondo cGMP - Creare un processo/attraverso il tracciamento del prodotto/per consentire le decisioni basate sui dati - Supporto auto-ispezione, Audit, Passeggiate Gemba
• Requisiti - Immatrikulation in un'università o college o studio completato che non è più di 12 mesi indietro, preferibilmente in un campo di scienze della vita, farmacia o ingegneria e porta le seguenti competenze con - Prima esperienza nello sviluppo tecnico / preparazione e/o controllo delle forme medicinali parenterali - Esperienza nell'industria farmaceutica (cGMP) o in un altro ambiente regolamentato - Alta capacità di squadra con ottime capacità di comunicazione in parola e scrittura in tedesco / inglese e apertura per avvicinarsi attivamente ai colleghi - Molto buone capacità di documentazione - Gestione Routinizzata dei sistemi IT (ad esempio Google Workspace, gSheet, MS Office, Smartsheet, Tableau, Minitab ecc.) - Impegno, motivazione e alta disponibilità a lavorare in modo indipendente Informazioni - Lo stage inizia il prima possibile. La durata dello stage è di 9-12 mesi. - Per l'applicazione abbiamo bisogno di una conferma di iscrizione valida, una lettera di motivazione e un CV. - I cittadini non UE / EFTA devono fornire una conferma dall'università che uno stage obbligatorio fa parte della formazione ai documenti di richiesta. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere il nostro alto ambizioso, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La Posizione Pharma Technical Development Europe Biologics (PTDE) apporte des thérapies innovantes de la phase clinique au lancement du marché. Nous nous concentrons sur le développement de médicaments sûrs et efficaces utilisant des technologies de pointe dans la fabrication, les soins cliniques, la formulation, l'emballage et l'analyse. Le Drug Product Clinical Supply Center (PTDE-C) de Bâle produit et remplit des formes posologiques stériles pour les essais cliniques (phase I-III) dans des installations de pointe. En tant qu'interne, vous soutenez le Chapitre Fabrication Composé & Inspection visuelle dans la production de solutions avant le remplissage et le contrôle visuel des flacons et des seringues. Vous obtiendrez également des informations sur des domaines adjacents tels que le remplissage, le soutien à la fabrication E2E, la science et la technologie et l'assurance de la qualité. Mansioni - Accompagner les collègues dans la production de solutions et le contrôle visuel - Identification, évaluation et avancement des améliorations de l'excellence opérationnelle (Lean et Six Sigma), cGMP (Événements prévus / Changements) - Évaluation technique et mise en œuvre de nouveaux équipements - Soutien à la culture d'équipe (nouveaux modes de travail) - Création et optimisation de documents cGMP, p.ex. instructions de travail et d'utilisation dans le système qualité applicable (Veeva) - Assurer les exigences de qualité selon le GMPc - Créer le suivi des processus/processus/produits pour permettre la prise de décisions fondées sur des données - Soutien à l'auto-inspection, audits, marches de Gemba
• Requisiti - Immatrikulation dans une université ou un collège ou études terminées qui n'a pas plus de 12 mois de retard, de préférence dans un domaine des sciences de la vie, de la pharmacie ou de l'ingénierie et apporte les compétences suivantes - Première expérience dans le développement technique / préparation et/ou contrôle des formes parentérales - Expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique (BPFc) ou dans un autre environnement réglementé - Haute capacité d'équipe avec de très bonnes compétences en communication verbale et écrite en allemand / anglais et ouverture d'approche active des collègues - Très bonnes compétences en documentation - Gestion routinière des systèmes informatiques (par exemple Google Workspace, gSheet, MS Office, Smartsheet, Tableau, Minitab, etc.) - Engagement, motivation et grande volonté de travailler indépendamment Informations complémentaires - Le stage commence dès que possible. La durée du stage est de 9-12 mois. - Pour la demande, nous avons besoin d'une confirmation d'inscription valide, d'une lettre de motivation et d'un CV. - Les citoyens non membres de l'UE/AELE doivent fournir une confirmation de l'université qu'un stage obligatoire fait partie de la formation aux documents de candidature. Veuillez indiquer la date de début et la durée souhaitées dans votre lettre de motivation. Chi siamo Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Stell Dir vor, Du bist der entscheidende Kompass, der uns hilft, die Talente von morgen heute schon zu finden. Bei Roche geht es nicht nur darum, Positionen zu besetzen – es geht darum, die Talente aus unterschiedlichen Professionen für unsere Vision zu gewinnen: Das Leben von Patient:innen weltweit nachhaltig zu verbessern. Als Talent Acquisition Partner:in (“TAP”) bist Du kein Recruiter im klassischen Sinne; Du bist strategische:r Berater:in, Data-Enthusiast:in und Botschafter:in in einem. Du gestaltest die Transformation unserer Arbeitswelt aktiv mit und stellst sicher, dass wir genau die Future Skills an Bord holen, die wir für die Gesundheitsversorgung der Zukunft benötigen.

Dein neues Team:
Wir verstehen uns als Sparringpartner auf Augenhöhe für das Business und agieren als eingespieltes Team, das Wissen teilt und gemeinsam wächst. Bei uns triffst Du auf Expert:innen, die moderne Recruiting-Ansätze leben und Raum für neue Ideen bieten.
Du wirst Teil des oneREC Germany Teams bestehend aus mehr als 40 TAPs aufgeteilt auf unsere deutschen Standorte in Mannheim, Grenzach und Penzberg, sowie unsere Kolleg:innen in Budapest und berichtest an unsere REC Lead für R&D, Commercial, Group Functions & New Business.

• Strategic Partner & Marktexpertise: Du bist der vertrauensvolle Strategic Partner des Business und verantwortest die Talentstrategie Deiner Fachbereiche von der Bedarfsanalyse bis zur Vertragsverhandlung.

• Gestalter der Transformation: Du begleitest die Transformation der Organisation, indem Du Führungskräfte proaktiv zu Future Skills und Mindset-Themen berätst und die "Must-haves" kritisch hinterfragst.

• Datenbasierte Talentakquise: Als Data-Enthusiast:in identifizierst Du Top-Talente proaktiv durch den Einsatz modernster Sourcing-Tools und KI-gestützter Ansätze, um unsere Entscheidungen fundiert zu treffen.

• Excellence in Candidate Experience: Du sorgst für Candidate Experience Excellence und begleitest Bewerber:innen wertschätzend bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss, wobei Du stets faire und attraktive Angebote aushandelst.

• Innovationsmotor & Agile Workflows: Du treibst innovative Projekte voran. Dein Fokus liegt auf der Reduktion von Komplexität und der Gestaltung agiler, schlanker Workflows durch die Implementierung neuester Recruiting-Trends.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Du bist eine:r passionierte:r TAP — für Dich ist diese Rolle eine Berufung, nicht nur der nächste Karriereschritt. Du bringst Erfahrung aus einer modernen, agilen TA-Organisation mit. Dein Talent und Dein Mindset sind uns dabei wichtiger als jahrelange Berufserfahrung.

• Du hast bereits aktiv in den strategischen Säulen der Talentakquise gearbeitet: Alignment, proaktives Sourcing und Data-Driven Decisions.

• Du bist versiert im Umgang mit modernen Technologien (z. B. Workday, Phenom People, AI-Chatbots) und nutzt Künstliche Intelligenz als strategischen Hebel.

• Du verbindest Daten und Empathie meisterhaft: Du triffst Entscheidungen fundiert, verlierst dabei aber nie den Menschen aus dem Blick.

• Du verfügst über, idealerweise profunde, Kenntnisse im Arbeitsrecht und hast Berührungspunkte mit organisationalen Veränderungsprozessen und der Zusammenarbeit mit Arbeitnehmervertretungen.

• Durch regelmäßige Anwesenheit vor Ort in Penzberg arbeitest Du eng mit Kolleg:innen und Stakeholdern zusammen und positionierst Dich so als strategischer Partner
