jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:

As a Senior Accounts Payable Accountant you are responsible for high quality services to Roche suppliers and internal partners. You will be responsible for booking complex invoices in accordance with Roche and local standards so that the supplier receives the funds in time for the goods supplied and the services rendered. You will have the possibility to have full responsibility for the end-to-end AP process and handling both internal and supplier queries received by phone or mail in local language.

• Process and validate PO based and direct invoices and payment requests, manage and run payments

• Manage vendor accounts

• Audit, report and support AP invoice resolution

• Handle affiliate’s internal invoice queries

• Act as a point of contact, promoting strong collaborative relationships between the affiliate’s finance teams and all other internal SSC teams

• Participate in process improvement and ongoing projects, opportunity to take part in knowledge transfer

Who you are:

• University degree in Finance or relevant professional experience

• General understanding of finance processes and standards. Broad experience in accounts payable processes (or related field) and using SAP is an advantage

• Strong communication and advisory skills and you are able to deal with complex issues

• Customer centricity through your day-to-day interactions

• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Proficiency in English and Polish

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deine Abteilung

In der Abteilung Manufacturing, Science & Technology (MSAT) stellen wir die technische und strategische Kompetenz für die Bereitstellung der klinischen Pipeline, die Einführung und die Unterstützung der kommerziellen Produktion sicher. Unser technischer Support, Engineering, Systeme, Daten und Dokumente sind essentiell für die Herstellung, Bewertung und Freigabe hochwertiger Produkte. MSAT Process Science ist u.a. am Troubleshooting von pharmazeutischen Proteinwirkstoffen, bei der Bewertung von Einsatzstoffen sowie an lokalen und globalen Gremien beteiligt.

Dein Team

Wir sind ein souveränes Team aus Biotechnologie-Ingenieuren, Labortechnikern, Labormitarbeitern und Managern im Bereich Aufreinigung (Downstream-Processing). Modernes Aufreinigungsequipment, innovative Analysemethoden und diverse Dokumentations- und Auswerte-Tools stehen uns zur Verfügung. Selbständiges und eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten sind für unsere Aufgaben essentiell, doch der Teamzusammenhalt und der Spaß an der Arbeit sind für uns genauso wichtig. Ein offener und ehrlicher Umgang miteinander, geprägt durch Respekt und Wertschätzung, ist uns besonders wichtig.

Deine Aufgaben

Unterstützung unserer Projektarbeiten im Bereich:

• Fehlersuche, -analyse und -behebung im Umfeld des Downstream Processings

• Planung, Bearbeitung und Auswertung von Laborversuchen zur Optimierung, Skalierung und Validierung von Aufreinigungsverfahren (Downstream Processing)

• Anwendung diverser chromatographischer (ÄKTA, HPLC) und spektroskopischer Verfahren sowie Filtration im Labormaßstab

Dein Profil

• Du aktuell für ein naturwissenschaftliches oder ingenieurwissenschaftliches Studium immatrikuliert bist

• Du das Thema Proteinaufreinigung nicht nur aus der Theorie kennst

• Dir auch die analytischen Anwendungen der Chromatographie und Spektroskopie vertraut sind

• Du sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift hast

• Selbstständiges und eigenverantwortliches Planen und Arbeiten für dich selbstverständlich sind

• Du ein wahrer Teamplayer bist, ein hohes Durchsetzungsvermögen besitzt und auch in Belastungssituationen immer den Überblick behältst und den Spaß an der Arbeit nicht vergisst

• Erfahrung mit statistischen Methoden (z.B. DoE, multivariate Datenauswertung) und dem systematischen Umgang mit großen Datenmengen ist von Vorteil

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/offline)

• Ermäßigte Preise (-50 %) in unserer Kantine

• Fitnessstudio auf dem Roche Campus

• Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und spannende Gastvorträge

• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boardinghaus

• Gut organisierte Verkehrsanbindung nach München mit unserem Roche-Shuttle

Deine Bewerbung

Denke daran, daß sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation während des gesamten Zeitraums des Praktikums richtet oder alternativ an Personen in einem maximal einjährigen Gap-Year (zwischen Bachelor und Master Studium), wo es schriftlich nachgewiesen werden kann, auf welcher Universität/Hochschule und genau wann (Monat/Jahr) innerhalb eines Jahres die Studien fortgesetzt werden.
Beachte bitte, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind.

Zeitraum : ab September oder nach Vereinbarung für die Dauer von 6 Monaten

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Quality Control (QC) Basel/Kaiseraugst consists of approximately 350 employees, organized into 7 departments with subordinate structures. It serves as a central key point for producing high-quality medicines. BS/KAU is responsible for the analytical quality testing of an extensive product portfolio, ranging from drug substances and drug products to medical devices, bulk, finished goods, direct materials, and packaging materials.
As a specialized section within this structure, Analytical Science and Technology (ASAT) is responsible for the strategic implementation of modern testing methods and innovative technologies at the Quality Control (QC) Basel/Kaiseraugst site. We act as a central hub of expertise, not only establishing methods locally but also actively transferring them to other sites. By managing the entire product lifecycle on an end-to-end (E2E) basis, we provide global standardization and technical steering. This ensures our 'Right to Operate', consistent compliance, and the highest quality standards throughout the entire Roche network.

• Lead and coordinate projects in close collaboration with cross-functional interfaces like Pharmaceutical Development, Manufacturing Operations, and Commercial QC.

• Drive network agility by actively participating in global project teams to promote standardization across the Roche network.

• Spearhead technology implementation, serving as the primary point of contact for internal and external partners regarding new analytical technologies.

• Provide strategic support for ASAT objectives while managing specific technical assignments and ensuring seamless method transfers.

• Author GMP documentation, including transfer/validation plans, reports, risk assessments, and SOPs, while managing Change Controls and Deviations as an SME.

• Support audit readiness by preparing for and executing health authority inspections to maintain the site’s Right to Operate.

• Manage lifecycle robustly, ensuring consistent analytical standards and technical steering throughout the product lifecycle.

• Technically proficient: You possess a fundamental understanding of safety and quality systems, backed by a strong analytical background for solving complex issues.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Il Contesto Controllo qualità (QC) Basilea/Kaiseraugst consisteva in circa 350 dipendenti, organizzati in 7 dipartimenti con strutture subordinati. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Clinical Educator brings clinical expertise to their field team. This is a promotional role, working as an integral member of a field based team and will not have direct contact with patients.

Key Responsibilities:

• To assist specialist customers in a secondary care environment, to increase their knowledge, clinical understanding and advocacy of the assigned brands in the relevant therapeutic area/disease state and approved indications (multiple sclerosis)

• To provide education to health care professionals and their staff on the proper administration of designated treatments for assigned disease area

• To support healthcare professionals to provide patients with appropriate information and support informed decision making along the patient journey.

Who you are:

• Nursing background or similar experience required

• Good understanding and working knowledge of the Pharma Market and the local Health Service environment

• Good technical knowledge of Multiple Sclerosis experience strongly preferred

• Effective verbal and written communication skills

• High level of business planning, organisational & problem solving skills

• Ability to conduct face-to-face presentations to customers

• Highly motivated with drive & determination to succeed & willingness to adapt to change

• Dynamic, self-starter with strong influential skills, as well as entrepreneurial spirit

• Ability to develop and maintain strong, professional relationships

• Commercial, Regulatory and technical awareness

• The ability to navigate a large multi-disciplinary geography (which may require travel 50 – 60% of working time)

• Valid driving licence

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Pharma Technical Development brings game-changing therapies from clinical phase I into the market to serve every patient, every day. Our core business is to develop safe, innovative and effective drugs using cutting edge technologies for manufacturing process (Drug Substance and Drug Product), clinical supply, formulation, device, packaging, and analytical development. Our daily work also includes compiling of regulatory documents and the transfer of development projects to commercial manufacturing.

The Opportunity:

• Routine analysis of release and stability samples across several projects as well as extended functional characterization.

• Following a GMP compliant workflow in our analytical landscape within technical development (CMC).

• Development, improvement and validation of analytical methods for the quality assessment of active substances

• Supporting the interfaces to early research and development as well as to marketed QC organization.

Who You Are:

• Lab technician with Apprenticeship (please note: this role is tailored for vocational qualifications; Master’s or PhD degrees are outside the scope of this position) with at least 5 years of experience in an industrial setting working on bioassays, ideally in a QC organization and working according to GMP.

• Hands-on experience in relevant immunological methodologies like ELISA, reporter gene assays, proliferation assays, cell killing assays and cell culture.

• Self-organizing way of working and the ability to interact and cooperate across matrix organizations and departments/functions.

• Good written and spoken English and German language skills.

This position is fixed term for 2 years.

Excited to shape the future with us? We look forward to receiving your application!

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Lo sviluppo tecnico di Pharma porta terapie che cambiano il gioco dalla fase clinica I al mercato per servire ogni paziente, ogni giorno. Il nostro core business è quello di sviluppare farmaci sicuri, innovativi ed efficaci utilizzando tecnologie all'avanguardia per il processo di produzione (Drug Substance and Drug Product), fornitura clinica, formulazione, dispositivo, imballaggio e sviluppo analitico. Il nostro lavoro quotidiano comprende anche la compilazione di documenti normativi e il trasferimento di progetti di sviluppo alla produzione commerciale. Mansioni - Analisi di routine dei campioni di rilascio e stabilità in diversi progetti e caratterizzazione funzionale estesa. - A seguito di un flusso di lavoro conforme a GMP nel nostro paesaggio analitico all'interno dello sviluppo tecnico (CMC). - Sviluppo, miglioramento e convalida dei metodi analitici per la valutazione della qualità delle sostanze attive - Supportare le interfacce per la ricerca e lo sviluppo precoce e per l'organizzazione QC commercializzata.
• Requisiti - Tecnico di laboratorio con Apprenticeship (si prega di notare: questo ruolo è su misura per le qualifiche professionali; Master o PhD gradi sono al di fuori della portata di questa posizione) con almeno 5 anni di esperienza in un ambiente industriale che lavora su bioassay, idealmente in un'organizzazione QC e lavorare secondo GMP. - Esperienza pratica nelle metodologie immunologiche rilevanti come ELISA, saggi di gene reporter, saggi di proliferazione, saggi di uccisione cellulare e cultura cellulare. - Auto-organizzante modo di lavorare e la capacità di interagire e cooperare tra organizzazioni di matrice e dipartimenti/funzioni. - Buone competenze in lingua inglese e tedesca. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Sales Account Manager you will be responsible for achieving regional sales targets for our Near Patient Care (NPC) Roche Diagnostics portfolio. You will manage the full customer lifecycle, from prospecting new clients to maintaining relationships with existing ones through proactive communication.
Key responsibilities include providing demand-driven sales and after-sales support, conducting customer training, and installing NPC products, all while ensuring the highest level of customer satisfaction. You will also monitor market trends and competitor activity.
Our NPC covers healthcare customers such as physicians (General practitioners, ambulatory specialists - diabetologists, internal medicine doctors, cardiologists, pneumologists) and hospitals. The NPC portfolio consists of various POCT devices, professional/hospital and patient blood glucose meters and CGM.

Preferred location: Southern Moravia, e.g. Brno / Olomouc
Readiness to active business trips is required
Employment contract: initially fixed-term 2 years with a possibility to extend, contract with a vendor of service of Roche

The Opportunity

Customer Relationship & Sales Management:

• Proactively engage customers to identify needs, suggest solutions, and resolve issues, ensuring high satisfaction through exceptional after-sales support

• Drive sales growth by negotiating new business, promoting and installing products (instruments, reagents), and expanding the customer portfolio

• Manage the full sales process, including preparing, presenting, and negotiating quotations using designated tools and processes.

Portfolio Promotion & Training:

• Promote NPC portfolio by conducting customer training seminars and representing the company at key conferences

Market Intelligence & Personal Development:

• Monitor and report on regional competitor behavior and market trends

• Proactively engage in continuous self-learning to maintain expert knowledge of relevant publications and industry information

Compliance & Collaboration:

• Ensure strict compliance with all Complaint Management procedures, including accurate and timely reporting in our CRM and other global systems

• Collaborate effectively with colleagues within the NPC team and other departments to achieve shared goals

Who You Are

• Secondary education as a minimum, Natural or Health Sciences field preferred

• Proven customer-facing within commercial functional area experience (1+ years of experience as a minimum)

• Sales experience in the healthcare field of medical devices or In-vitro diagnostics is desired

• Czech language fluent and English at intermediate level

• Demonstrated communication skills to be able to present complex topics in concise and clear manner

• Negotiation and influencing skills with solution-orientated mindset

• Able to handle conflicting priorities with value-generating outlook

• PC Skills (experience working in Google Workplace, MS Office)

• Team player mindset to challenge colleagues but also support them grow in line with achieving common goals

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche is seeking a strategic and collaborative ERP Product Lifecycle Management Business Partner to join the Informatics ERP Team at Roche. In this role, you will partner closely with business stakeholders across Roche Diagnostics and Roche Diabetes Care to drive digital transformation initiatives spanning Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) capabilities.
The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor between business functions and Informatics teams, ensuring that enterprise solutions align with operational, regulatory, product development, and manufacturing objectives across the Diagnostics discipline and Diabetes Care portfolio.

The Opportunity:
This role requires strong cross-functional engagement, business process expertise, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable technology solutions.

Business Partnership & Stakeholder Engagement

• Serve as the primary Informatics business partner for ERP and PLM initiatives within Roche Diagnostics and Roche Diabetes Care.

• Build strong relationships with stakeholders across R&D, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Commercial, and Operations teams.

• Facilitate alignment between business strategy and enterprise technology roadmaps.

• Drive effective communication between business users, solution architects, vendors, and delivery teams.

ERP & PLM Strategy and Delivery

• Lead and support ERP and PLM transformation initiatives across Diagnostics and Diabetes Care.

• Identify opportunities for process optimization, harmonization, and digital innovation.

• Translate business requirements into functional and technical solution designs.

• Support implementation, enhancement, integration, and lifecycle management of ERP and PLM platforms.

• Participate in global PLM initiatives and projects, ensuring consistency and scalability of solutions across Roche divisions.

• Provide support for system testing, validation, and compliance in accordance with regulated industry standards (e.g., GxP).

• Support validation activities and documentation in regulated environments.

• Participate in governance boards, release planning, and portfolio prioritization activities.

• Support organizational change management activities related to ERP and PLM adoption.

• Develop and deliver stakeholder engagement and training strategies.

• Drive continuous improvement through metrics, feedback, and operational excellence practices.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or related discipline.

• 10+ years of experience in ERP, PLM, or enterprise system

jobs.title: Content Editor
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche Services & Solutions, we are looking for skilled and passionate professionals to join our growing medical writing team. As a Content Editor , you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy, clarity, and impact of medical and healthcare content, ranging from articles and blog posts to promotional materials and educational resources for healthcare professionals and patients.

Working within the Global Digital Hub’s specialized content team, you will maintain the highest standards of quality, compliance, and brand alignment while collaborating with global stakeholders and using your expertise to guide the development of impactful digital content.

The Opportunity:

• Review and edit diverse medical content across multiple formats and platforms, including articles, slides, newsletters, social media, websites, and promotional assets, ensuring alignment with brand guidelines, regulatory requirements, and Roche best practices.

• Conduct meticulous fact-checking and reference verification to ensure the accuracy and credibility of content.

• Provide clear, constructive feedback to writers to enhance their work and support their professional growth.

• Optimize content for digital platforms using SEO best practices and digital marketing strategies.

• Manage multiple concurrent projects efficiently, prioritizing tasks while maintaining attention to detail and ensuring timely delivery.

• Collaborate closely with writers, subject matter experts, and marketing teams to ensure high-quality, audience-focused content development.

• Stay up-to-date with trends, industry guidelines, and best practices in digital marketing and medical writing, contributing to process improvements and recommendations.

Who You Are:

• Advanced proficiency in written and spoken English with exceptional attention to detail, clarity, and consistency.

• 2-4 years of proven experience in editing and proofreading, ideally within medical, healthcare, or life science industries.

• A bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, English, life sciences, or a related field (a master’s degree is a plus).

• Experience and familiarity with digital marketing tools, such as content management systems (CMS), SEO practices, and social media platforms.

• Knowledge of medical terminology, scientific research, and regulatory guidelines relevant to healthcare and pharmaceutical content creation.

• A collaborative and customer-service-oriented mindset with the ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams.

• Excellent time management skills, capable of handling multiple deadlines in fast-paced environments.

• Quick learner with a proactive attitude and a passion for technologies and continuous improvement.

Join our mission to drive innovation in healthcare through clear, accurate, and impactful content. Apply today and be part of a dynamic team shaping the future of medical communications!

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. jobs.title: Access & Value Lead/ Pharma Ecuador

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile dell'accesso e del valore/ Ecuador farmaceutico

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
En Roche, nos apasiona transformar la vida de los pacientes . Como Access & Value Lead , reportarás directamente al Gerente General y liderarás el diseño e implementación de estrategias integrales para asegurar el acceso sostenible y oportuno a nuestras soluciones innovadoras en el sistema de salud ecuatoriano . Dirigirás un equipo multidisciplinario enfocado en generar propuestas de valor diferenciadas con un alto impacto clínico, económico y social .

● Estrategia de acceso: Diseñar y liderar la estrategia integral de acceso (precios, reembolso, HTA,acuerdos innovadores), alineada con los objetivos del negocio y las prioridades de salud pública.
● Liderazgo de equipo: Guiar, desarrollar y empoderar al equipo de acceso, asegurando una cultura de altodesempeño, colaboración transversal e innovación constante.
● Gestión del entorno institucional: Construir relaciones estratégicas con entidades regulatorias, aseguradoras públicas y privadas, organismos multilaterales, asociaciones de pacientes y otros actores clave.
● Valor y evidencia: Trabajar en conjunto con Medical y otras áreas para generar evidencia local relevante (real world evidence, PROs, análisis farmacoeconómicos) que sustente las decisiones de acceso.
• ● Participación en políticas públicas: Representar a Roche en espacios de diálogo regulatorio, técnico ypolítico, e influir en la construcción de políticas sanitarias basadas en valor.
• ● Desarrollo de soluciones sostenibles: Impulsar modelos de acceso innovadores como esquemas de riesgo compartido, acuerdos de valor, compra por resultados, entre otros.
• ● Colaboración regional y global: Conectar la realidad local con las estrategias regionales y globales, aportando insights y adaptando mejores prácticas.
• ● Cumplimiento regulatorio y ético: Garantizar que todas las actividades de acceso se realicen en conformidad con las políticas de Roche, el marco legal local y los más altos estándares éticos.
● Desarrollo de personas: responsabilidad de actuar como líder visionario, arquitecto, catalizador y coach en el desarrollo de su equipo, fomentando el crecimiento profesional, y a su vez, el desarrollo de posibles sucesores para el rol.

Tu Perfil

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Location: Vilnius (Artery Business Center, Konstitucijos pr. 18B). We love the office energy, so we’re looking for someone to join us 5 days a week!
Duration: 3-6 months
Type: Paid Internship (Full-time), 925 EUR gross/month

As our Business Support Intern, you aren’t just handling tasks—you’re the heartbeat of our Vilnius office. Working side-by-side with our Site Business Partner, you’ll contribute to making our workplace “great place to work”. You’ll experience how global corporations, operating based on Agile principles, actually function. Your engagement will span from event planning to data governance, all while networking with our Pharma and Diagnostics colleagues in Lithuania and Baltics.

The Mission
By the time you wrap up your internship, you’ll have learnt about document archiving, understood the personal data compliance and GDPR governance in Lithuania, hosted several epic events, and mastered the art of creating an office environment people actually want to show up for.

What You’ll Be Doing:

• Owning front-of-house operations and keeping the daily office flow smooth.

• Curating the pantry & stationery—ensuring the coffee is flowing and the supplies are stocked.

• Being the main point of contact for incoming calls and general emails inbox.

• Logistics wizardry: Managing couriers and making sure every parcel finds its home.

• Being the office guru for parking and general "how-to" questions.

What Will You Learn:

• Organizing internal events and what’s related to operational excellence around event execution (from idea generation to invoice management).

• Implementing and upgrading data governance and archiving frameworks.

• Running wellness initiatives like the Children Walk across the Baltic states.

Is This You?

• You’re a student (Bachelor’s or Master’s) in Business, Marketing, Economics, HR, or similar field.

• You’ve got strong interpersonal skills and an eye for detail.

• You enjoy interacting with people and have a positive attitude.

• You can work independently but also enjoy collaboration with colleagues from cross-functional areas.

• Fluent English is non-negotiable.

Ready to level up? Join us and let’s make an impact together!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Tendering and Contract Partner

titleByLocale.it: Partner per gare d'appalto e contratti

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Tendering & Contract Management Partner , desempeñarás un papel fundamental en nuestra división de Diagnóstica al asegurar nuestra participación efectiva en oportunidades de negocio tanto públicas como privadas. Actuarás como un socio estratégico de back-office , brindando soporte crítico al equipo de ventas durante todo el ciclo de vida del contrato.

La Oportunidad

• Elaboras y consolidas toda la documentación requerida para los procesos de adquisiciones públicas y privadas, garantizando el cumplimiento de las normativas legales y los estándares de la compañía.

• Colaboras estrechamente con el equipo de ventas y áreas transversales para gestionar los procesos comerciales internos de inicio a fin.

• Supervisas la ejecución de los procesos internos de gestión contractual para todos los clientes, asegurando una prestación de servicio sin interrupciones.

• Identificas y alertar sobre posibles riesgos contractuales, desarrollando planes de acción proactivos para mitigar penalidades y mejorar los flujos de trabajo internos.

• Lideras las reuniones de Kick Off de los contratos con clientes públicos, comunicando claramente las responsabilidades contractuales a toda la organización.

• Gestionas adendas, adicionales y reducciones de contratos, asegurando que toda la documentación necesaria sea precisa y esté actualizada.

• Mantienes actualizadas las herramientas comerciales corporativas y los repositorios para garantizar la trazabilidad total e integridad de los datos.

• Gestionas penalidades no imputables a la organización mediante la solicitud de ampliaciones de plazo y exoneraciones para proteger los intereses de la compañía.

Quién eres

• Tú cuentas con un título universitario en Administración, Ingeniería de Negocios, Ingeniería Industrial o carreras afines.

• Tú aportas al menos 3 años de experiencia en compras y contrataciones públicas.

• Tú tienes un mínimo de 2 años de experiencia en servicio al cliente, gestión comercial o gestión de procesos.

• Tú posees un nivel de inglés intermedio, lo que permite tu participación en proyectos y reuniones regionales.

• Tú te caracterizas por una alta atención al detalle, gran capacidad analítica y excelentes habilidades de planificación y organización.

​ Preferible

• Cuentas con un MBA o un postgrado relacionado.

• Tienes experiencia en el desarrollo de presupuestos y un profundo conocimiento de expedientes de licitación pública.

• Demuestras una alta orientación al servicio y capacidad para la toma de decisiones en entornos dinámicos.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Estágio em Supply Chain
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Estagiário(a) de Supply Chain, você fará parte de uma equipe colaborativa focada em otimizar nossos processos de Planejamento de Demanda . Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para aplicar suas habilidades analíticas na prática . Venha se desenvolver profissionalmente em uma cultura que valoriza a inovação e a melhoria contínua .

A Oportunidade

• Você apoia o time de Planejamento de Demanda nas rotinas analíticas e no ciclo de S&OP .

• Você trabalha com um grande volume de dados, realizando o tratamento, a consolidação e a análise constante de informações .

• Você desenvolve dashboards, relatórios e indicadores de performance essenciais para a área .

• Você identifica oportunidades de melhoria contínua nos processos e contribui ativamente para a padronização e otimização de fluxos .

• Você apoia a estruturação e o acompanhamento de projetos estratégicos, expandindo seu impacto na organização .

Quem você é

• Você cursa graduação em Engenharia, Administração, Economia, Estatística, Matemática, Supply Chain ou áreas correlatas, com previsão de conclusão a partir de 2027 e vínculo ativo com a instituição de ensino .

• Você tem disponibilidade para estagiar de 1 a 2 anos, com uma carga horária de 6 horas diárias .

• Você possui Excel avançado e grande facilidade para trabalhar com análise e tratamento de dados .

• Você demonstra forte capacidade analítica, raciocínio lógico e mantém um perfil estruturado, organizado e com visão processual .

• Você se comunica muito bem e tem a habilidade de transformar dados complexos em informações claras e assertivas .

Preferencial

• Você tem conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau ou similares) e noções de S&OP / Planejamento de Demanda .

• Você conhece metodologias de projetos (PMBOK, Agile, Scrum ou similares) .

• Você possui alguma experiência prévia com análise de dados ou iniciativas de melhoria contínua .

*Benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para esta vaga.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: People & Culture OneRoche Trainee
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Esta posición tiene una duración de 6 meses con posibilidad de extensión de hasta 18 meses.

OBJETIVO DEL PUESTO:
Facilitar el camino de transformación de nuestras personas y organización entregando soporte de People & Culture (P&C) a OneRoche a través de la ejecución de diferentes iniciativas de desarrollo, training, performance, comunicaciones, y operaciones que apoyan la agilidad, efectividad y transformación organizacional.
ROLES Y RESPONSABILIDADES:
P&C Operations:

• Simplificar procesos y proponer áreas de mejora y eficiencia para facilitar la transformación organizacional.

• Guiar y prestar apoyo a los People Managers y colaboradores en procesos de Workday, facilitar Workday training on-demand.

• Seguimiento con P&C PSS local y regional, y Workday cuando sea necesario.

• Coordinar nuevos ingresos con equipos locales, IT, y SHE en cuanto a documentación y equipos requeridos.

• Apoyar en actividades de onboarding con la finalidad de que las personas cuenten con todo lo necesario para su efectividad laboral e integración a la organización.

People & Culture Communications:

• Coordinar las comunicaciones de People & Culture de nuevos ingresos, desarrollo de Carrera, transformación, cambios organizacionales, y salidas de OneRoche trabajando en conjunto de la agencia de comunicaciones y stakeholders relevantes.

Training & Development:

• Analizar, identificar, y coordinar soluciones de training enfocadas en las necesidades del business on-demand.

• Preparar, co-facilitar workshops, y dar seguimiento a las acciones de las actividades de training & development.

• Actualizar y administrar participación y coordinación de trainings con proveedores, facilitadores, colaboradores y stakeholders relevantes.

• Apoyar, actualizar, y a dar seguimiento a los procesos de talent (succession plans, talent pools) performance, y development via check-ins y reuniones con people managers y colaboradores, utilizando y actualizando la herramienta de Talent en Workday.

• Participar y trabajar en equipo con el equipo de Calidad en las necesidades de training y auditoria.

REQUERIMIENTOS:
Conocimientos:

• Título Universitario Ingeniería Comercial, Administración de Empresas, Recursos Humanos o carrera afín.

• Experiencia laboral de al menos 2 a 3 años en áreas de Recursos Humanos, Consultoría, o Gestión de Proyectos.

• Nivel de Inglés Avanzado.

Conocimientos específicos (deseable):

• Workday

• Metodologías Ágiles

• Gestión de Proyectos

• Técnicas de facilitación

• Habilidades digitales

• Habilidades de presentación

• Metodologías/técnicas de coaching

• Metodologías/técnicas de feedback

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner Lead

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile partner del viaggio del paziente

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Impacto Sostenible
Nuestra responsabilidad va más allá de innovar. Contribuyes a soluciones que responden a los desafíos más urgentes de la salud mientras reducimos nuestro impacto en el planeta. Juntos construimos un entorno laboral más sano, una sociedad más justa y un futuro mejor para las próximas generaciones.

Líder con visión sistémica y emprendedora, responsable de garantizar que los Patient Journey Partners (PJP) generen resultados extraordinarios, agregando valor al sistema de salud, pacientes y negocio de Roche. Actúa como coach y mentor, fomentando colaboración y buenas prácticas para acelerar el acceso de pacientes.

Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:
Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen:

• Liderar y fomentar la colaboración del equipo PJP, poniendo al paciente en el centro y estimulando co-creaciones con clientes que beneficien la atención médica y aceleren la adopción del modelo operativo.

• Asegurar que las estrategias y planes de los PJPs estén alineados con las prioridades de Roche y el mercado de salud, garantizando resultados estratégicos y tácticos con base en insights.

• Desarrollar talento y fomentar una cultura de alto desempeño a través del liderazgo inspirador, coaching, retroalimentación frecuente e innovación en los enfoques de trabajo.

• Supervisar y optimizar la planificación, ejecución en campo y uso de recursos (segmentación, targeting, KPIs), promoviendo excelencia en interacción científica y persuasión consultiva.

• Identificar brechas de desempeño en los PJPs, diseñar planes correctivos, y garantizar reportes de calidad sobre interacciones e insights para apoyar el desarrollo estratégico.

• Coordinar el trabajo entre PJPs, squads, shaping roles y funciones habilitadoras, asegurando sinergias para maximizar el impacto y productividad con los recursos existentes.

Tu perfil:
La persona en esta posición práctica liderazgo de servicio y abarca el rol de visionario, arquitecto coach y catalizador según la situación lo requiera.
Promueve un modelo de mentalidad de crecimiento y ser partidario de formas de trabajo ágiles y de experimentación, sin miedo a fracasar y celebrando los éxitos y los aprendizajes.

• Educación Universitaria completa.

• 5 años de experiencia como líder de equipos comerciales en la industria farmacéutica o relacionada, impulsando e implementando estrategias de acceso.

• Experiencia comprobada en la interacción profesional con stakeholders externos, incluyendo médicos, tomadores de decisión y otros actores clave del sector.

• Idioma Inglés avanzado oral y escrito.

Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Technical Expert - eDiscovery
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Expert, particularly with eDiscovery expertise, to join our Roche Digital Technology (RDT) Group Functions eDiscovery and Forensics team. In this critical role, you will act as the primary technical bridge between the RDT infrastructure team and the Business Product Owners in Legal and Compliance.

Your primary focus will support the technical aspects of eDiscovery and privacy processes, specializing in Microsoft Purview eDiscovery (Premium) and ensuring the defensible identification, collection, and preservation of electronically stored information (ESI) across a wide range of corporate systems and hardware, with a strong emphasis on Apple mobile ecosystems and mixed-OS laptop environments (macOS and Windows).

The Opportunity:
You will act as a subject matter expert, ensuring that all data is acquired in a legally defensible and forensically sound manner and maintaining a strict chain of custody to support litigation, internal investigations, and regulatory requests. You will also proactively drive and implement prioritized projects that align with business needs.

Description of the area:
About RDT Group Functions Legal, Compliance & Group Communication sub-Function

As a trusted and agile partner, we, as the Legal, Compliance & Group Communication sub-Functions, are empowered to boost global innovative solutions with our business stakeholders in the Legal and Compliance digital prioritization journey.

Job Responsibilities:

• Defensible Data Preservation and Collection: Plan defensible procedures for and execute forensic imaging, end-to-end eDiscovery workflows in Microsoft Purview, and electronic data preservation and collection from company systems and corporate devices, helping to identify, preserve, and retrieve case-critical data globally, specifically focusing on Apple iPhones, iPads, MacBooks, and Windows-based laptops.

• Data Processing: recommend and execute data processing in Relativity and Purview Premium, preparing the data for Legal review by utilizing Boolean searching, culling, and TAR (Technology-Assisted Review) / AI (Artificial Intelligence), preparing productions, and making process and technology recommendations to efficiently and effectively achieve set outcomes.

• Legal Department Support: Act as a trusted IT liaison to internal and external counsel, translating complex technical concepts into clear legal realities and assisting the Legal and Compliance team in scoping preservation and collection efforts based on litigation holds. Develop and maintain trusting relationships with legal stakeholders, IT, and external parties.

• Day-to-Day Operations & Device Management: Handle day-to-day operations by accurately responding to time-sensitive requests. Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for electronic data collections from a wide range of company systems, as well as remote and physical device acquisitions, including the secure storage and retirement of physical evidence.

• Device & Hardware Management: Coordinate the logistics of remote and physical device acquisitions. Manage the intake, secure storage, and return/retirement of physical evidence.

• Chain of Custody & Documentation: Generate and maintain meticulous documentation for all preservation, collection, processing, and production activities, ensuring a verifiable chain of custody and adherence to the Electronic Discovery Reference Model (EDRM). Organize, log, and maintain accurate internal metrics and process f

The Position
As the Global Business Process Specialist (GBPS) – Accounting Tax Integration, you are part of the Global Business Process Management Organization in Roche Service & Solutions. In this position, you report into the Accounting Tax Integration Sub-Chapter Lead within the Finance BPM.

You act as Business Process Specialist for the APAC Regional Deployment team in the Finance/ Tax area. You roll-out the Aspire Global Template to the APAC countries, in particular for Chugai company codes in the area of Taxes, including Tax Localization.

You will work in close collaboration with stakeholders from Finance, Commercials, Demand-to-Pay, Supply Chain and IT, cross divisionally (Pharma and Diagnostics).

You will be :

• Responsible for global, cross divisional state-of-the-art process design within their business process area within the E2E proces. Empowered decision making for their area across divisions and in line with the E2E Business Process Management guardrails from the Global Business Process Manager (GBPM)

• Work closely with the E2E GBPMs & GBPS network to ensure fit-for-purpose solutions. Supports the SAP S4/HANA Template deployment. Actively pursue the implementation of the E2E BPM strategy, according to guardrails set by the E2E GBPO and GBPMs

• Deliver solutions including processes, ICFR, Authorizations, laws and regulations, technology, analytics for own dedicated area, in line with the E2E BPM strategy & guardrails as well as continuous improvements, with support of the GBPM and GBPSs. Support business acceptance globally across divisions and functions on a operating level for the dedicated business process area. Drive and implement the BPM strategy for your own dedicated area

• Roll-out Global template solutions for the area of Finance/ Tax, including solution documentation & implementation, test management, business process operations including integrated training management. Evaluate Local GAP and design localization extensions for the Global Template as part of the deployment activities for the Aspire roll out.

• Safeguard the global template and harmonized processes while collaborating with different project streams and other BPM networks to develop new processes for future releases. You translate local Tax business requirements into IT solutions and manage changes to such specifications. Actively drive and support the project deployment relevant deliverables throughout the full rollout lifecycle.

• Ensuring that all parallel deployments as well as the S/4Hana work package are on track Ensuring, monitoring and optimization of business processes with regards to efficiency and effectiveness. The position may involve a fair amount of travel (up to max. 25%). You liaise with the other stakeholder within the E2E processes. You lead process alignments/solution design with business stakeholders under template governance

Who you are:

• A business or finance degree with 4-5 years of relevant work experience. An SAP FI specialist with solid experience in business process management, SAP ERP, S/4Hana, IT, and ERP transformation programs.

• Extensive experience with SAP Tax solutions, covering Indirect Taxes, Withholding Taxes, and Corporate Income Taxes. Deep knowledge of SAP S/4Hana tax solutions, including SAP country versions, SAP Document and Reporting Compliance, and implementation of SAP systems, particularly S4 Finance.

• Experience with other SAP Tax solutions like Sovos add-on for tax code determination is advantageous.

• Excellent analytica

jobs.title: Alliance Management Principal
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. This is your chance to shape the future of healthcare by leading the development and execution of our evolving Safety sourcing and outsourcing strategy. In this pivotal global role, you will manage external business partner alliances and vendors supporting Pharma Development Safety (PDS) globally, ensuring high-quality oversight of existing services while expanding into automated and augmented delivery through cutting-edge technologies.

In the Alliance Management Principal position, you will be the vital link between internal teams and external partners, providing subject matter expertise and fit-for-purpose governance to ensure optimal delivery in accordance with robust Service Level Agreements. By collaborating across a matrix organisation and partnering with key stakeholders in Procurement, Finance, and Digital Technology, you will drive continuous improvement, manage budgets, and foster a culture of innovation to navigate an shifting safety systems landscape.

The Opportunity:

• Lead the development and implementation of holistic global safety sourcing and outsourcing strategies that maximise value, increase productivity, and reduce operational complexities.

• Define, implement, and maintain robust vendor governance and performance management frameworks across a diverse human resource and technology vendor landscape.

• Partner with vendors and internal teams to design, manage, and adopt automated or augmented solutions, leveraging artificial intelligence and new technologies within an innovation framework.

• Oversee service provider budgets, spend analytics, and forecasting solutions to proactively manage resource and budget demand in partnership with Procurement and Finance.

• Establish effective interface frameworks across PDS functions and technical groups to ensure business requirements are clearly defined, implemented, and aligned.

• Adopt and role-model agile methodologies to drive efficiency, promote adaptive problem-solving, and provide coaching and mentoring to cross-functional squads and team members without direct reporting lines.

• Act as a central point for issue escalation, monitor business risks, and present complex information to senior leadership and governance committees to drive effective decisions.

Who you are:

You are a strategic, forward-thinking leader who thrives in complex, matrix environments and is passionate about driving operational excellence through collaboration and innovation. You inject positive energy into your networks, comfortably influence senior executives, and enjoy mentoring others in a fast-paced, evolving global landscape.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• You bring 7+ years of experience including a Life Science degree (or equivalent industry qualification) paired with significant experience in areas relevant to pharmacovigilance and an expert knowledge of global PV regulatory obligations.

• Strong experience in vendor and business partner management, with a solid understanding of contractual frameworks, SLA management, and budget oversight.

• Familiarity with the PV service provider landscape, including digital outsourcing models, automated/AI systems, and emerging technology solutions.

• Outstanding interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with a proven ability to influence senior leaders and navigate complex cross-functional stakeholder environments.

• Demonstrated experience leading diverse,

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Solution/Platform Architect - Data Platforms
Preferred Location: Pune

The Opportunity:
The Platform Architect for Data Experience & BI Platforms is responsible for the design, development, and oversight of the organization's BI architecture. This role ensures the BI platforms are robust, scalable, secure, and meets the data and analytics needs of the business, enabling actionable insights and strategic decision-making. The Platform Architect would contribute to our mission to deliver a frictionless insight experience by making data easy to discover, understand, and use—through trusted, governed, and conversational access to unified enterprise knowledge for both people and AI agents.

As the Platform Architect - Data Platforms, you are responsible for:

• Platform Strategy and Design: Define the technical vision, strategy, and roadmap for the entire BI ecosystem, including Insights, Reporting Tools and Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, data ingestion pipelines. Select and recommend appropriate BI technologies to meet business requirements and performance standards.

• Architecture Implementation: Oversee the configuration and integration of BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker) with various data sources.

• Innovation and Emerging Technologies: Drive the adoption of AI and conversational analytics into the BI landscape; investigate and evaluate new AI solutions to enhance data experience and platform capabilities

• Performance and Optimization: Monitor the BI platform’s performance, identifying and resolving bottlenecks in data loading, query execution, and reporting. Implement best practices for data governance, security, and access control.

• Collaboration and Guidance: Partner with Product Owners and business stakeholders to understand their data requirements and translate them into technical design specifications. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to BI developers and data engineering teams.

• Standards and Governance: Establish standards and procedures for data quality, data lineage, and metadata management within the BI environment. Stay current with industry trends and emerging BI technologies to continuously improve the platform.

Who You Are:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

• Extensive experience (typically 10+ years) working in business intelligence, data warehousing and data architecture roles, with significant time spent in an architect capacity.

• Proven experience in designing and delivering large-scale, complex BI solutions using cloud-based data platforms (e.g. Snowflake, Redshift).

Technical / Business Skills

• Expertise with one or more major BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Thoughtspot)

• Experience with SaaS Platforms, AWS Platforms

• Understanding of DWH / Data Lakes / RDBMS / OLTPS & OLAPS

• Good understanding of AI integration patterns( LLM integrations, MCP concepts)

• Familiarity with data governance, security principles, and compliance standards including SIEM

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, and influence strategic decisions.

Additional Qualifications

• Exceptional communication, facilitation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to drive consensus on solutions and navigate conflicts to achieve alignment.

• Fluent English due to job nature

Who we are

jobs.title: e-Commerce Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Diagnostics Korea
Division: Diabetes Care
Work location: Seoul, South Korea

Your Key 
• Responsibilities

E-commerce Strategy Planning and Execution
Oversee the day-to-day operations of the e-commerce platform(s) to ensure smooth performance, accuracy, and timely execution of campaigns.
Understand business goals and key priorities to develop an end-to-end e-commerce marketing strategy and campaigns
Monitor inventory, pricing, and product listings to maintain consistency with brand standards and competitive market positioning
Develop strategies to optimize visibility, conversions, and overall performance on owned online platforms
Ensure high-quality customer experience across all digital touchpoints, resolving any operational issues and improving customer satisfaction.
Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Conversion Rate, Average Order Value (AOV), and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV), providing regular data-driven reports.

E-shop and Naver Brand Store Management
Plan and manage to develop the whole scope of owned e-shop and Naver Brand Store
Create strategic action plans to attain consumers connected to the brand
Analyze traffic of e-shop and Naver brand store on a regular basis to understand the trend of online consumer's behavior
Closely work with APAC and global team to enhance owned e commerce shop and unified portal

CRM activation
Plan and execute CRM activities based on SFDC & Commercial website analysis
Plan to expand CRM to customers (retail stores/E-commerce/etc,)
Champion the digital customer journey, leveraging CRM strategies and market insights to foster customer loyalty and retention.

Key stakeholder Management
E-commerce distributor management
Other agencies and partners depending on business situations
Collaborates closely with cross-functional teams, including marketing, supply chain, and IT, to ensure seamless digital operations and efficient inventory management.

Who You Are

Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher
Experience: Minimum of 5 years of proven experience in e-commerce, digital merchandising, or online retail operations
Language Skills: Advanced English proficiency (both written and verbal) required for seamless communication with APAC and global team.
Analytical Skills: Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to interpret complex data (e.g., sales history, search trends, customer buying patterns) to drive actionable insights and optimize product visibility.
Platform & Tech Expertise: Solid understanding of e-commerce platforms and proficiency in web analytics tools.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.

Submission
자유 양식의 국/영문 이력서 및 국/영문 자기소개서 (하나의 MS Word 혹은 PDF 파일로 제출)
※ 이력서 상단에 반드시 현재 연봉과 희망 연봉을 표기하시기 바랍니다. 누락 시 이력서가 검토되지 않습니다.
※ 이력서 내 이메일 주소와 서류전형 지원 사이트의 입력하시는 이메일 주소를 반드시 동일하게 작성해주시기 바랍니다.
※ 국가보훈대상 및 장애인은 관련 서류 제출시 관련 법규에 의거 우대합니다.
※ 이력서에 개인민감정보 (신체적 조건, 출신 지역, 혼인 여부, 가족관계 등)는 기재하지 말아주십시오.
※ 입사 지원 서류에 허위 사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후 라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.

Process
서류 전형▶ 면접 전형 ▶ 종합 심사 ▶ 최종 합격 통지
※ 면접은 서류전형 합격자에 한해 개별 통보합니다.
※ 면접 일정 안내 및 조율을 위해 해외 번호(중국)로 연락이 갈 수 있는 점 미리 안내드립니다.
※채용이 유력한 후보자에 대해서 이력 검증 및 평판 조회, 건강검진 등의 종합심사를 진행하여 최종 합격자를 선정합니다.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 mi

jobs.title: Atölye Servis/Uygulama Personeli
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Diagnostik Atölye Teknik Destek Uzmanı / Atölye Servis Personeli (Workshop Technical Support Specialist):

• Sahadan dönen cihazların fiziksel kontrolünü yapılması

• İkinci el cihazların modül bazında ayrılması, temizlenmesi ve SHE prosedürlerine uygun dekontaminasyon işlemlerinin gerçekleştirilmesi

• Gerektiği durumlarda saha aktivitelerine katılıp , destek olunması

• Cihazların belirlenen kurulum, temel fonksiyon, ayar ve operasyonel yeterlilik (OQ) testlerini yapılması

• İkinci el sistemlerin formatlanmasını ve yeniden yazılım yüklenmesinin sağlanması

• Cihazların gerekirse onarımının ve gerekli testlerinin tamamlanması

• Tüm yapılan aktiviteleri CRM sistemi üzerinde raporlanması

• Gerektiği durumlarda esnek çalışma kapsamında hafta içi akşam/sonu çalışılması

• Cihazların belirlenen şekilde paketlenmesinin ve etiketlenmesinin sağlanması

• Tıbbi Cihazlar Yasası'na göre tıbbi cihaz kalitesinin, regülasyon ve yasal yükümlülüklerine uymasının ve şikâyetlerin uygun şekilde ele alınmasının sağlanması

• Bakım ve onarım süreçlerinde kullanılan ölçüm ve test araçlarının kalibrasyon durumunun düzenli olarak takip edilmesi ve belgelerinin yönetilmesi

• Atölye envanterinde bulunan yedek parçaların ve sarf malzemelerinin fiziksel sayımının (stock-check) yapılması ve stok doğruluğunun sağlanması

• Atölye çalışma ortamının 5S (Sırala, Düzenle, Temizle, Standartlaştır, Sürdür) prensiplerine ve Roche SHE (Güvenlik, Sağlık, Çevre) standartlarına uygunluğun sağlanması

Atölye Aplikasyon Destek Uzmanı:

• Cihazların kalibrasyon kontrol ve test uygulamalarını tamamlayıp , belirlenen performans testlerini yapılması

• Gerektiği durumlarda müşteri eğitimlerinin verilmesi

• CRM sistemi üzerinde cihaz kayıt işlemlerini - WS Pool Repair, Deinstall, Install WO, yedek parça takibinin günlük olarak gerçekleştirilmesi

• Sahadan dönen cihazların deinstall Work Order (WO) kontrollerinin yapılması ve backoffice’e raporlanması

• Atölye içi operasyonel süreçlerin takip edilmesi, güncellenmesi ve raporlanması

• Bakım ve onarım süreçlerinde kullanılan ölçüm ve test araçlarının kalibrasyon durumunu düzenli olarak takip edilmesi ve belgelerinin yönetilmesi

• Atölye çalışma ortamının 5S (Sırala, Düzenle, Temizle, Standartlaştır, Sürdür) prensiplerine ve Roche SHE (Güvenlik, Sağlık, Çevre) standartlarına uygunluğunun sağlanmeası

Aranan Nitelikler

• Üniversitelerin ilgili bölümlerinden lisans derecesi ile mezun olmak (Bilgisayar Mühendisliği, Biyomedikal Mühendisliği, Elektrik / Elektronik Mühendisliği, Elektronik ve Haberleşme Mühendisliği, Fizik Mühendisliği, Makina Mühendisliği, Mekatronik Mühendisliği,Tıp Mühendisliği,Yazılım Mühendisliği)

• Üniversitelerin ilgili bölümlerinden ön lisans derecesi ile mezun olmak

• Bilgisayar Teknolojisi, Biyomedikal Cihaz Teknolojisi, Elektrikli Cihaz Teknolojisi, Elektronik Teknolojisi, Makine, Mekatronik bölümlerinden lise derecesi ile mezun olmak

• Biyokimya, kimya , biyoloji veya benzer bir alanda en az iki yıllık mesleki eğitim veya eşdeğer iş deneyimine sahip olmak

• Tercihen, teknik bir alanda başlangıç düzeyinde profesyonel deneyime sahip olma

jobs.title: QC Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Pharma Korea
Cluster: Access & Policy
Work Location: Hanam City, Gyeonggi-do
Worker Type: Regular
Your key responsibilities

• Advanced QC Testing: Perform QC testing for biological/chemical drug products utilizing various compendial and in-house validated methods (e.g., ID/Purity by CE, HPLC & UPLC, Content by UV/Vis, Cell-based Assays), ensuring strict adherence to SOPs and test protocols.

• QC Material & Cell Bank Management: Manage and maintain critical QC materials including QC/retention samples, critical reagents, and cell banking.

• Method Transfer (SME): Lead or support internal/external analytical method transfer activities, providing technical expertise on key analytical methods as a Subject Matter Expert.

• Investigation & Quality Management: Handling of deviations, OOS/OOT investigations, change controls, CAPA, and risk assessments, identifying root causes and implementing effective actions.

• Audit & QMR Leadership: Act as an internal or external GxP auditor/co-auditor and represent the QC function as a member of the local QMR (Quality Management Review) Meeting.

• Data Integrity & Review: Conduct technical review of QC raw data and analytical results, adhering strictly to the current GxP good documentation practices and data integrity requirements.

• Equipment Lifecycle Management: Execute and coordinate qualification, calibration, and preventive maintenance of QC equipment ensuring intended use.

• Documentation & Regulatory Collaboration: Draft, review, and revise various QC SOPs, work instructions, protocols, and reports. Collaborate closely with RA for the preparation of specifications and test methods for drug product registration.

Who you are

• Basic qualification: Bachelor of Science majoring in biotechnology or related science.

• A minimum of 4 years experience in developing and executing quality control operation, and laboratory experience in pharmaceutical company.

• A strong background and in-depth knowledge in Instrumental analysis (HPLC, UV, CE, Spectrophotometer, Plate Reader, etc.) and cell-based assays.

• Good English written and communication skill.

Submission
자유 양식의 국/영문 이력서 및 국/영문 자기소개서 (하나의 MS Word 혹은 PDF 파일로 제출)
※ 이력서 상단에 반드시 현재 연봉과 희망 연봉을 표기하시기 바랍니다. 누락 시 이력서가 검토되지 않습니다.
※ 이력서 내 이메일 주소와 서류전형 지원 사이트의 입력하시는 이메일 주소를 반드시 동일하게 작성해주시기 바랍니다.
※ 국가보훈대상 및 장애인은 관련 서류 제출시 관련 법규에 의거 우대합니다.
※ 이력서에 개인민감정보 (신체적 조건, 출신 지역, 혼인 여부, 가족관계 등)는 기재하지 말아주십시오.
※ 입사 지원 서류에 허위 사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후 라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.

Process
서류 전형▶ 면접 전형 ▶ 종합 심사 ▶ 최종 합격 통지
※ 면접은 서류전형 합격자에 한해 개별 통보합니다.
※ 면접 일정 안내 및 조율을 위해 해외 번호(중국)로 연락이 갈 수 있는 점 미리 안내드립니다.
※채용이 유력한 후보자에 대해서 이력 검증 및 평판 조회, 건강검진 등의 종합심사를 진행하여 최종 합격자를 선정합니다.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Method Transfer (SME): Lead or support internal/external analytical method transfer activities, providing technical expertise on key analytical methods as a Subject Matter Expert.
• Investigation & Quality Management: Handling of deviations, OOS/OOT investigations, change controls, CAPA, and risk assessments, identifying root causes and implementing effective actions.
• Audit & QMR Leadership: Act as an internal or external GxP auditor/co-auditor and represent the QC function as a member of the local QMR (Quality Management Review) Meeting.
• Data Integrity & Review: Conduct technical review of QC raw data and analytical results, adhering strictly to the current GxP good documentation practices and data integrity requirements.
• Equipment Lifecycle Management: Execute and coordinate qualification, calibration, and preventive maintenance of QC equipment ensuring intended use.
• Documentation & Regulatory Collaboration: Draft, review, and revise various QC SOPs, work instructions, protocols, and reports. Collaborate closely with RA for the preparation of specifications and test methods for drug product registration. Who you are
• Basic qualification: Bachelor of Science majoring in biotechnology or related science.
• A minimum of 4 years experience in developing and executing quality control operation, and laboratory experience in pharmaceutical company.
• A strong background and in-depth knowledge in Instrumental analysis (HPLC, UV, CE, Spectrophotometer, Plate Reader, etc.) and cell-based assays.
• Good English written and communication skill. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
