We are building a global Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team to support critical commercial and internal platforms and applications. As an SRE , you will help design, build, and scale reliable distributed systems that power healthcare innovation worldwide.
This role is focused on reliability, scalability, automation and operational excellence. You will influence system design, define reliability standards and reduce operational toil through engineering solutions.
This role includes participation in a structured on-call rotation.

Who We Are
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.

Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.

Step into the Future of IT with Roche!
As a seasoned Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at Roche, you will leverage your deep software engineering expertise to propel our products to new heights of robustness, scalability and reliability. This isn't just a role—it's an invitation to shape the backbone of technological innovations forward.

Your Mission
Design and maintain cutting-edge tools, scripts and frameworks that automate repetitive tasks, streamline software deployment and manage expansive systems with unparalleled efficiency.

Partner closely with forward-thinking development teams to architect and implement high-performance solutions that elevate system efficiency, optimize resource utilization and enhance deployment processes for superior uptime and user satisfaction.

Your Impact
Lead the charge in incident management and response. Detect system anomalies, troubleshoot swiftly and conduct thorough root cause analyses to prevent recurring issues.

Champion continuous improvement by refining monitoring and alerting mechanisms, conducting insightful post-incident reviews and embedding best practices in software lifecycle management. Your strategic foresight and meticulous planning will ensure our systems are not only reliable but also superlatively performant.

By joining our elite team, you will play a pivotal role in delivering seamless experiences to our end-users, exceeding business and customer demands, and solidifying Roche's reputation as a leader in IT innovation.

Your Core Responsibilities
Reliability Engineering & Architecture

• Define and implement SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets with product and engineering teams

• Conduct reliability reviews for new and existing services

• Design scalable, fault-tolerant architectures in AWS and Azure environments

• Lead capacity planning, performance and cost optimization initiatives

• Improve system resilience through automation and self-healing patterns

• Drive organizational observability maturity (metrics, logs, traces, alert quality)

Incident Management & Continuous Improvement

• Perform complex root cause analysis and drive rapid mitigation

• Participate in blameless postmortems and follow-through

• Improve MTTR, reduce incident frequency, and elevate production standards

• Collaborate seamlessly with engineering teams to enable timely and effe

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

IT Business Analyst - Pharma R&D

The IT Business Analyst possesses in-depth knowledge of the pharma clinical data management business domain and understanding of data engineering & analytics technologies, operating at the intersection of business strategy, data, and technology needs.

In this role, you will apply systems thinking to navigate the complexity of clinical trial data and real-world data (RWD) systems, translating business needs into system requirements, oversee initiatives with full autonomy and lead analysis efforts across highly ambiguous spaces. Acting as a trusted advisor to leadership, you will actively shape long-term roadmaps, drive consensus through persuasive communication, and recommend optimal technology solutions to ensure efficient acquisition and management of clinical trial data.

Who we are:

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. La posizione IT Business Analyst - Pharma R&D L'Analista IT Business possiede una conoscenza approfondita del dominio aziendale della gestione dei dati clinici e della comprensione delle tecnologie dell'ingegneria dei dati e dell'analisi, che operano nell'intersezione della strategia aziendale, dei dati e delle esigenze tecnologiche. In questo ruolo, si applicano sistemi che pensano di navigare la complessità dei dati di prova clinica e sistemi di dati reali (RWD), traducendo le esigenze aziendali in requisiti di sistema, supervisionando iniziative con piena autonomia e sforzi di analisi di piombo in spazi altamente ambigui. Facendo da consulente di fiducia per la leadership, si forma attivamente roadmap a lungo termine, guidare il consenso attraverso la comunicazione persuasiva, e consiglia soluzioni tecnologiche ottimali per garantire l'acquisizione efficiente e la gestione dei dati di prova clinica. Chi siamo: Questo team è responsabile della fornitura di sistemi software per l'acquisizione e il trattamento dei dati di prova clinica Roche, servendo come fonte di verità in Roche Pharma. I sistemi di base in questo settore includono la cattura elettronica dei dati di Roche (EDC) - Medidata Rave, sistemi non-CRF e magazzini di dati clinici. Questi sistemi sono fondamentali per lo sviluppo della droga, l'alimentazione della revisione dei dati clinici, la segnalazione della sicurezza, le intuizioni operative per i team clinici e supportano le attività di sviluppo precoce nei RED. Essi forniscono dati agli ecosistemi di Analytical Data Science per standardizzare e analizzare i dati per le presentazioni normative. Inoltre, i dati clinici standardizzati da questi sistemi sono essenziali per integrare con le piattaforme di modalità dati specializzate di Roche, tra cui omics, imaging clinico e tecnologie per la salute digitale. Un focus fondamentale in questo settore sarà quello di sfruttare le tecnologie AI emergenti per ottimizzare le pipeline di dati di acquisizione di dati clinici. Ciò include l'arricchimento dei metadati e la costruzione di set di dati pronti per l'IA per consentire l'agente autonomo e sistemi AI a ciclo umano-in-the che stanno trasformando il processo di sviluppo della droga. L'opportunità:
• Leadership & Delivery: Analisi aziendale leader per iniziative o flussi di lavoro con autonomia, coordinamento della complessità e della scala. Definisce e conduce gli sforzi di analisi in spazi altamente ambigui, traducendo complessi requisiti di dati in mappe di processo, epici, caratteristiche e storie degli utenti.
• Risolvere i problemi: conduce l'analisi dei problemi aziendali, definendo lo spazio dei problemi e guidando l'analisi completa delle cause radice che possono abbracciare i confini organizzativi. Proattivamente previene lo scopo strisciante, gestisce la complessità di vari ambiti di cambiamento, ed è in definitiva responsabile per i risultati di analisi aziendali garantendo l'allineamento tra funzioni e sistemi dipendenti.
• Gestione degli stakeholder: Identificare e coinvolgere le parti interessate chiave, compresa la gestione, sia attraverso i confini IT che organizzativi aziendali. Forma la strategia come consulente affidabile per la leadership, naviga attivamente i conflitti per raggiungere l'allineamento e potenzia i team nella gestione degli stakeholder.
• Impact & Strategy: Incrementa un impatto significativo su progetti e programmi garantendo la fornitura di soluzioni ad alto valore che si allineano alla strategia aziendale. Conduce la valutazione delle opzioni di soluzione strategica, tra cui analisi del valore avanzato e valutazione del rischio, e forma attivamente roadmap a lungo termine.
• Complessità: Funziona tipicamente su più sistemi attraverso la sotto-funzione, gestire efficacemente i requisiti altamente ambigui ed evolutivi. Dimostra un punto di vista end-to-end per analizzare i problemi, considerando come i dati scorre attraverso

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Analyste des affaires en TI - R-D en pharmacie L'analyste d'affaires en TI possède une connaissance approfondie du domaine commercial de la gestion des données cliniques pharmaceutiques et de la compréhension des technologies d'ingénierie et d'analyse des données, fonctionnant à l'intersection de la stratégie d'entreprise, des données et des besoins technologiques. Dans ce rôle, vous appliquerez la pensée des systèmes pour naviguer dans la complexité des données d'essais cliniques et des systèmes de données du monde réel, traduire les besoins des entreprises en exigences du système, superviser les initiatives avec pleine autonomie et diriger les efforts d'analyse dans des espaces très ambigus. En tant que conseiller de confiance pour le leadership, vous élaborerez activement des feuilles de route à long terme, susciterez un consensus grâce à une communication convaincante et recommanderez des solutions technologiques optimales pour assurer l'acquisition et la gestion efficaces des données des essais cliniques. Qui nous sommes : Cette équipe est chargée de fournir des systèmes logiciels pour l'acquisition et le traitement des données des essais cliniques de Roche, servant de source de vérité à Roche Pharma. Les systèmes fondamentaux dans ce domaine comprennent la saisie électronique des données Roches (EDC) - Medidata Rave, les systèmes non CRF et les entrepôts de données cliniques. Ces systèmes sont essentiels à la mise au point des médicaments, à l'examen des données cliniques, à l'établissement de rapports sur l'innocuité, à l'information opérationnelle des équipes cliniques et au soutien des activités de développement précoce dans les DER. Ils fournissent des données aux écosystèmes de la Science des données analytiques afin de normaliser et d'analyser les données pour les présentations réglementaires. De plus, les données cliniques normalisées de ces systèmes sont essentielles pour s'intégrer aux plateformes de modalités de données spécialisées de Roche, y compris l'omique, l'imagerie clinique et les technologies numériques de la santé. L'un des principaux objectifs dans ce domaine sera de tirer parti des nouvelles technologies d'IA pour optimiser les pipelines de données d'acquisition de données cliniques. Il s'agit notamment d'enrichir les métadonnées et de créer des ensembles de données prêts pour l'IA afin de permettre aux systèmes autonomes d'agents et d'humains dans la boucle de transformer le processus de développement des médicaments. La possibilité :
• Analyse d'entreprise Leadership & Livraison : Diriger l'analyse d'entreprise pour les initiatives ou les flux de travail avec autonomie, coordination de la complexité et de l'échelle. Définit et dirige les efforts d'analyse dans des espaces très ambigus, traduisant les exigences complexes en données en cartes de processus, en épopées, en caractéristiques et en histoires d'utilisateurs.
• Résolution des problèmes : Dirige l'analyse des problèmes d'affaires, la définition de l'espace de problèmes et la conduite d'une analyse globale des causes profondes qui peut couvrir les limites organisationnelles. Prévient de façon proactive l'évolution de la portée, gère la complexité des divers champs de changement et, en bout de ligne, rend compte des résultats de l'analyse opérationnelle en assurant l'harmonisation entre les fonctions et les systèmes dépendants.
• Gestion des parties prenantes : identifie et mobilise les parties prenantes clés, y compris la gestion, au-delà des frontières informatiques et organisationnelles. Forme la stratégie en tant que conseiller de confiance pour le leadership, navigue activement dans les conflits pour atteindre l'alignement, et habilite les équipes dans la gestion des intervenants.
• Impact & Stratégie : Conduit un impact significatif sur les projets et les programmes en assurant la prestation de solutions de grande valeur qui s'harmonisent avec la stratégie opérationnelle. Dirige l'évaluation des options de solutions stratégiques, y compris l'analyse de valeur avancée et l'évaluation des risques, et élabore activement des feuilles de route à long terme.
• Complexité : fonctionne généralement sur plusieurs systèmes à travers la sous-fonction, gérant efficacement des exigences très ambiguës et évolutives. Démontre un point de vue de bout en bout pour analyser les problèmes, en considérant comment les flux de données

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Szukamy zorganizowanej i skrupulatnej osoby, która wesprze nasz zespół w zarządzaniu obiegiem używanego sprzętu medycznego. Będziesz kluczowym ogniwem w procesie procesowania zwrotów – od momentu odebrania paczki, przez jej cyfrową ewidencję, aż po koordynację wysyłki do naszej centrali w Niemczech.

Twoja Rola:

• Obsługa przesyłek przychodzących: Odbieranie oraz fizyczne segregowanie paczek reklamacyjnych trafiających do magazynu.

• Ewidencja cyfrowa: Wprowadzanie danych o przesyłkach do systemów operacyjnych ( SAP / Rexis ).

• Wstępna diagnostyka: Klasyfikacja urządzeń pod kątem zgłoszonych usterek i uszkodzeń aparatury medycznej.

• Logistyka międzynarodowa: Identyfikacja i przygotowanie wysyłki paczek o statusie „krytycznym” do centrali w Mannheim w celu dalszej ewidencji.

• Współpraca z zespołem: Bieżąca komunikacja z działem serwisu i logistyki.

O Tobie:

• Wykształcenie: Minimum średnie (zapraszamy również studentów w trakcie nauki).

• Dyspozycyjność: Możliwość pracy 2 dni w tygodniu (grafik do ustalenia).

• Zdolności analityczne: Umiejętność trafnej klasyfikacji usterki na podstawie dokumentacji i stanu faktycznego.

• Komunikatywność: Jasne przekazywanie informacji i umiejętność pracy w zespole.

• Doskonała organizacja: Umiejętność priorytetyzacji zadań i dbałość o porządek w dokumentacji systemowej.​

Oferujemy:

• Elastyczność: Idealna praca dla osób łączących naukę z życiem zawodowym.

• Cenne doświadczenie: Możliwość pracy w profesjonalnym środowisku opartym na systemie SAP .

• Wpływ na jakość: Realny udział w procesie zapewniania bezpieczeństwa aparatury medycznej.

• Międzynarodowe standardy: Współpraca z centralą w Niemczech i kontakt z nowoczesnymi technologiami medycznymi.

Dodatkowe informacje:

• Miejsce pracy: Magazyn Sprzętu Medycznego (Teresin)

• Typ umowy: Umowa zlecenie (16 godzin tygodniowo)

Administratorem danych osobowych jest spółka Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Warszawie przy ul. Domaniewskiej 28 (02-672). Dane przetwarzane są w celu prowadzenia rekrutacji. Osobom, które zaaplikują przysługuje prawo dostępu do danych, ich sprostowania, usunięcia, ograniczenia przetwarzania, przenoszenia oraz – w sytuacji, gdy są one przetwarzane na podstawie udzielonej zgody – cofnięcia tejże zgody w dowolnym momencie. Kontakt do Inspektora Ochrony Danych: dia.daneosobowe@roche.com. Więcej informacji o zasadach przetwarzania przez Roche danych osobowych pod linkiem: https://www.roche.pl/klauzula-informacyjna-rekrutacja-dia-pl .

Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. działa w pełnej zgodności z przepisami prawa i nie toleruje żadnych naruszeń. W Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. obowiązuje Procedura zgłaszania naruszeń prawa. W przypadku chęci zgłoszenia nieprawidłowości związanych z naszą działalnością, wszelkie niezbędne informacje dotyczące zgłaszania naruszeń znajdują się na naszej stronie internetowej: https://www.roche.pl/kontakt/ochrona-sygnalistow-zglaszanie-naruszen .

Compensation & Benefits
Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Warsaw. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Information about the compensation package for this position will be provided ahead of any interview

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Job Description / Description of the Area

Experience- 7+ years
Work Location- Baner, Pune
We are seeking a skilled and motivated Senior Developer with strong experience in MuleSoft to support the design, development, and continuous improvement of enterprise integration services.
The successful candidate will be responsible for building scalable, secure, and reliable integrations across business-critical systems and platforms. This role combines hands-on development, solution design, API-led connectivity, troubleshooting, stakeholder collaboration, and delivery support within a complex enterprise environment.

Key Responsibilities
Design and Development

• Design, develop, and maintain integration solutions using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform.

• Build reusable System, Process, and Experience APIs following API-led connectivity principles.

• Develop integrations between enterprise platforms, cloud services, SaaS applications, and on-premise systems.

• Create reusable assets, shared templates, and accelerators to improve delivery efficiency.

• Contribute to solution architecture decisions focused on scalability, security, maintainability, and performance.

API and Platform Engineering

• Design and implement REST, SOAP, asynchronous, file-based, and event-driven integration patterns.

• Develop complex transformations using DataWeave for JSON, XML, CSV, flat-file, and canonical data models.

• Configure API policies for authentication, rate limiting, client enforcement, logging, and threat protection.

• Manage deployments through CloudHub, Runtime Fabric, or hybrid runtimes.

• Use Anypoint Exchange, API Manager, Runtime Manager, Monitoring, Secrets Manager, and related platform services.

• Optimize performance, resilience, error handling, retry logic, and observability of integrations.

Support and Operations

• Provide advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis for production incidents and platform issues.

• Support release, deployment, change, and environment management activities.

• Monitor integration platform health and proactively address risks or service degradation.

• Ensure documentation of technical solutions, runbooks, and support procedures.

Collaboration and Delivery Support

• Work closely with architects, analysts, product teams, infrastructure teams, security, and business stakeholders.

• Translate business requirements into robust technical integration solutions.

• Support agile delivery ceremonies, planning sessions, estimations, and technical reviews.

• Mentor junior developers and contribute to team capability growth.

Continuous Improvement

• Identify opportunities for simplification, modernization, automation, and reuse.

• Stay informed on integration trends, cloud-native architectures, and emerging technologies.

• Promote engineering excellence, coding standards, and secure development practices.

Experience

• Proven experience as a Senior Developer, Integration Developer, or similar role.

• Strong hands-on experience delivering solutions on MuleSoft Anypoint Platform.

• Proven experience designing and building APIs in enterprise environments.

• Experience integrating ERP, CRM, identity, data, or other core enterprise platforms.

• Experience working in complex enterprise delivery environments with multiple stakeholders.

• Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare, life sciences, finance, or similar sectors is highly valued.

Technical Skills

• Strong experience with MuleSoft Anypoint Studio, API M

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Gestión global de proyectos relacionados con la instalación, soporte y mantenimiento del software de gestión integral del Tratamiento Anticoagulante Oral (y otros productos POC). El dispositivo informático facilita la gestión integral descentralizada de los pacientes en tratamiento anticoagulante oral, gracias a una aplicación web ágil y flexible (y otros productos POC como CGM y NaPOC Operations. Asimismo facilita la integración de la información con otros sistemas del Área Sanitaria gracias al uso de estándares de comunicación.

Responsabilidades:

• Gestión de instalaciones y actualizaciones.

• Formación al cliente final.

• Apoyo al cliente en incidencias, dudas, nuevos proyectos, etc.

• Gestión Documental de los proyectos e instalaciones

• Gestión de las conexiones de instrumentos.

• Soporte a la red de ventas

Perfil requerido:

• Ingeniería Técnica o superior de Informática de Sistemas o Telecomunicaciones

• Inglés Nivel Medio

• Conocimientos mínimo técnicos de BBDD

• Conocimientos de sistemas Windows y Linux

• Persona comunicativa

• Disponibilidad para viajar (esporádicamente)

Perfil Deseado:

• Conocimientos técnicos de BBDD (SQL, MysQL y Oracle)

• Conocimientos mensajería HL7 y Motor integración Mirth

• Conocimientos de herramientas de ticketing

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Experiece- 4 to 6 years
Location - Pune

The Business Systems Analyst is an active and self-sufficient functional contributor within their project or product team. In this role, you will analyze business requirements independently and translate them into detailed functional system specifications, with a strong focus on utilizing ServiceNow . As a functional BA, you will provide direct consultation to users, create detailed documentation, support testing phases, and ensure seamless operations. You will leverage your strong communication skills and background in the healthcare or pharmaceutical domain to navigate validated environments (such as GxP) and regulatory frameworks effectively.
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / Content Leadership: Plays an active part within the project and/or product team. Provides constructive feedback, seeks feedback for self, reflects on own challenges and successes, and actively supports others.

• Accountability / Problem Solving: Analyzes business requirements and translates them into functional specifications. Maps out user needs to system capabilities, specifically utilizing ServiceNow. Plans and supports unit, integration, and user acceptance testing (UAT). Able to assess and communicate functional and regulatory risks effectively.

• Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills are required. Identifies and communicates with stakeholders in a straightforward, clear manner. Considers both short-term and long-term implications in decision-making and adjusts rapidly in response to shifting priorities.

• Impact / Strategy: Executes an independent personal development plan and remains familiar with current functional and technological trends in Pharma R&D. Seeks best-fit trainings, gains external certificates if applicable, and actively takes part in knowledge-sharing initiatives (e.g., conferences, CoEs, CoPs).

• Complexity / Product Size: Operates at the Project level, making an impact on the workload of other chapter members through clear documentation and requirement gathering.

• Business / Functional Ability: Acts as the bridge between the business and IT. Provides functional assistance in resolving business systems issues and offers direct consultation to users. Creates meticulous, detailed system specifications and documentation. Understands how individual functional components fit into larger systems, identifies opportunities, suggests process improvements, consciously builds up a colleague network, and thinks of alternative ways to solve problems before asking for support.

Qualifications
Education & Experience

• Target Experience: Bachelor degree, with 4-6 years of proven experience as a Business Analyst, specifically in a functional capacity.

• Domain Expertise: Strong background in the Healthcare or Pharmaceutical domain is highly preferred.

• Demonstrated experience acting as an active and independent contributor within project or product teams.

• Proven track record of executing an independent development plan and participating in knowledge-sharing initiatives.

Core & Technical Skills(Preferred)

• ServiceNow Expertise: Specific experience and strong capability in utilizing ServiceNow for business systems management.

• Regulated Environments: Experience working in a validated environment, such as GxP (Good Practice) regulations, and a solid understanding of pharmaceutical regulatory frameworks.

jobs.title: R&D Business Tools Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Digital Innovation and Operational Services Chapter is a global team in R&D that focuses on internal improvement: increasing productivity, efficiency, and the ability of the R&D organization to collaborate across its global organizational interfaces. Our work involves reducing complexity of our systems, harmonizing processes, tools, and business practices, and building connections across geographical and organizational silos.
We are seeking a R&D Enterprise Tools Operations Specialist to join our global support team. You are well organized and detail-oriented. You will be the reliable service provider handling critical system requests within our core business tools, ensuring our scientists and engineers worldwide can focus on developing innovative products for patients.

This role requires building organizational know-how —understanding who our internal customers are, how they work, and solving problems in a way that anticipates their support needs. You are quick in learning new software systems and tools , enjoy helping your coworkers every day, and are motivated to innovate internal processes to automate tasks, you will fit right into our team!

Key Responsibilities

As a part of a global centralized expert support team, execute enterprise tool system tasks based on R&D customer requests, leveraging expert knowledge of business tools, compliance requirements, and R&D teams and processes.

• Execute R&D System Requests: Fulfill customer tool requests using expertise in business systems and compliance standards.

• Provide Timely Expert Support: Offer professional, empathetic, and quick solutions to R&D operational issues and system problems.

• Expert in our Global Business Applications: Act as the subject matter expert for one or more complex R&D business applications.

• Specialize in R&D Processes: Develop deep expertise in key processes (e.g., records management, lab data, change requests) for high-accuracy execution.

• Maximize Scientist Productivity: Use your expertise across business data and organizational structure to streamline operations and save significant time for R&D scientists.

• Anticipate Customer Needs: Build organizational know-how of R&D roles and priorities to deliver proactive system support.

• Maintain Global Service Excellence: Demonstrate a strong, collaborative customer service mindset within a diverse, global team.

• Drive Process Improvement: Identify manual steps and actively suggest opportunities for digitization and improvement.

• Automate Administrative Tasks: Apply or develop automation and AI tools to reduce administrative load on R&D staff.

• Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance: Guarantee all activities strictly adhere to regulated R&D processes, supporting audits and data retrieval.

Requirements:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a technical, scientific, or business discipline.

• Experience: 2+ years of professional experience in an operations, technical support, or system administration role, or equivalent academic projects / internships

• Language Skills: Excellent written and verbal English Language skills are required to support our global organization. German language skills are a plus.

• System Proficiency: Ability to quickly learn new software, systems, and processes is essential.

•
• Prior experience in enterprise business applications is desirable (e.g., Electronic Document Management Systems, Learning Management Systems, or Project Management tools).

jobs.title: Cross-Portfolio Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Roche diagnostics has a broad portfolio of 1000+ products across several business areas that include our widely-used molecular, pathology, near patient care and core lab solutions in conjunction with our diagnostics and healthcare insights digital solutions.

The Portfolio Management team works as part of the Portfolio and Project Management group to help each of these areas track and manage their portfolio from a strategic vantage point.

As part of the Portfolio Management team, the Cross-Portfolio Managers think holistically about the Diagnostics portfolio to ensure that strategic trade-offs are made to realize our overall strategic imperatives. Cross-Portfolio Managers work closely with colleagues from the broader Portfolio Management team including our Business Insights & Analytics Maangers to to develop tools and derive insights relevant for effective portfolio management.

The Opportunity

• You work closely with Customer Area Portfolio Managers, Business Analytics & Insights Managers, Project Managers and Finance to drive portfolio transparency and generate relevant portfolio insights for decision making

• You improve available portfolio tools and generate relevant reports to support strategic portfolio management

• You ensure excellent portfolio management by placing individual portfolio decisions in the context of the broader pipeline

• You enable overview of critical portfolio interdependencies

• You lead dedicated strategy initiatives across and within the different Roche Diagnostics customer areas

• You maintain expert knowledge of industry trends, competition, and current/emerging technologies to guide overall portfolio management

• You coach other members of the team, develop new skills and provide ongoing, constructive feedback on performance and progress toward goals and expectations

Who you are

• You hold an advanced degree in life sciences, medicine, or business (ideally a PhD, MD, or MBA)

• You have 3+ years of work experience in management consulting, investment banking, or corporate strategic development preferred

• You have a proven track record of influencing and presenting complex strategic topics to senior management and key stakeholders

• You possess strong analytical, planning, and organizational skills, with a demonstrated ability to solve complex problems and build quantitative models

• You are skilled at distilling complex or abstract problems into succinct strategic frameworks and tactical plans

• You have the ability to influence senior leadership through active listening, excellent communication, and strong facilitation skills

• You can clearly articulate critical analytical findings to senior leadership and drug development teams

• You effectively facilitate discussions with business leaders and cross-functional teams to develop insights and drive alignment on strategic decisions

Every role at Roche plays a part in making a difference in patients’ lives. Apply now and join us in making an impact!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare soluti

jobs.title: Data Scientist - Applied AI
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Data Scientist - Applied AI

About Our Team: Partnering Digital Solutions

Join our Partnering Digital Solutions team, a strategic group focused on maximizing partnership impact through digital and AI-enabled ecosystems to advance the Pharma and DIA Partnering business. We are at the forefront of innovation - building scalable data infrastructure, applying advanced data engineering practices, and integrating cutting-edge external capabilities to accelerate decision-making and unlock business value.

Our work spans across multiple high-impact initiatives, from developing intelligent data products to enabling end-to-end AI workflows. Whether it’s structuring complex data ecosystems or collaborating with external research institutions, this is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of data and AI at Roche by directly supporting key strategic decisions across our global Partnering organization.

Responsibilities

As a Data Scientist, you will play a critical role in shaping and delivering AI and machine learning capabilities across the Partnering Digital Solutions ecosystem. You will work closely with product owners, data engineers, architects, and business stakeholders to develop scalable machine learning models, intelligent workflows, and data-driven solutions that improve visibility, prioritization, operational efficiency, and strategic decision making.
This role focuses on applied AI, machine learning, predictive modeling, and operational intelligence rather than purely research-oriented AI. You will help translate complex business challenges into scalable AI and analytics solutions that create measurable business impact across partnering operations.

You will be responsible for:

Machine Learning & Applied AI Solutions

• Design, develop, and deploy machine learning and AI-enabled solutions that support partnering activities such as opportunity prioritization, portfolio intelligence, forecasting, operational insights, and decision support.

• Apply advanced analytics, statistical modeling, machine learning, and emerging AI techniques to solve complex business problems and deliver scalable intelligence capabilities across the partnering ecosystem.

Model Development & Experimentation

• Lead exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, model selection, training, validation, and performance evaluation for machine learning and AI-enabled solutions.

• Design and evaluate multiple modeling approaches, establish appropriate evaluation metrics, and optimize models for scalability, reliability, and business impact.

Business Problem Solving & Decision Support

• Partner closely with business stakeholders and product teams to translate complex business challenges into analytical approaches, machine learning solutions, and scalable intelligence capabilities.

• Support data-driven prioritization and strategic decision making through actionable insights, predictive models, and operational intelligence.

AI & Intelligence Enablement

• Collaborate with AI, data, and engineering teams to operationalize AI-enabled capabilities and support the adoption of scalable intelligence solutions across partnering platforms and workflows.

• Evaluate and apply modern AI techniques including predictive modeling, NLP, LLM-enabled workflows, and intelligent automation approaches to enhance partnering operations and decision making.

Data & Intelligence Development

• Design and develop analytics solutions, dashboards, KPIs, and intelligence capabilities that improve visibilit

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Data Scientist - AI applicato Informazioni sul nostro team: Partnering Digital Solutions Unisciti al nostro team di Partnering Digital Solutions, un gruppo strategico focalizzato sulla massimizzazione dell'impatto del partenariato attraverso ecosistemi digitali e abilitati all'intelligenza artificiale per promuovere il business di Pharma e DIA Partnering. Siamo all'avanguardia nell'innovazione: la costruzione di infrastrutture dati scalabili, l'applicazione di pratiche di ingegneria dei dati avanzate e l'integrazione di capacità esterne all'avanguardia per accelerare il processo decisionale e sbloccare il valore aziendale. Il nostro lavoro si estende su più iniziative ad alto impatto, dallo sviluppo di prodotti di dati intelligenti per consentire flussi di lavoro AI end-to-end. Che si tratti di strutturare ecosistemi di dati complessi o di collaborare con istituzioni di ricerca esterne, questa è un'opportunità unica per contribuire a plasmare il futuro dei dati e dell'intelligenza artificiale a Roche sostenendo direttamente le decisioni strategiche chiave in tutta la nostra organizzazione globale Partnering. responsabilità In qualità di Data Scientist, svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale nella modellazione e nella fornitura di capacità di apprendimento automatico e di intelligenza artificiale nell'ecosistema Partnering Digital Solutions. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con i proprietari di prodotti, ingegneri di dati, architetti e stakeholder aziendali per sviluppare modelli scalabili di machine learning, flussi di lavoro intelligenti e soluzioni basate sui dati che migliorano la visibilità, la priorità, l'efficienza operativa e il processo decisionale strategico. Questo ruolo si concentra sull'IA applicata, l'apprendimento automatico, la modellazione predittiva e l'intelligenza operativa piuttosto che l'IA puramente orientata alla ricerca. Ti aiuterà a tradurre complesse sfide aziendali in soluzioni scalabili AI e analytics che creano un impatto commerciale misurabile attraverso le operazioni di partner. Sarete responsabili di: Apprendimento della macchina & Soluzioni AI applicate
• Progettazione, sviluppo e distribuzione di soluzioni di machine learning e AI-enabled che supportano attività di partner come la priorità delle opportunità, l'intelligenza del portafoglio, la previsione, le intuizioni operative e il supporto decisionale.
• Applicare l'analisi avanzata, la modellazione statistica, l'apprendimento automatico e le tecniche AI emergenti per risolvere problemi aziendali complessi e fornire funzionalità di intelligenza scalabile in tutto l'ecosistema partner. Sviluppo del modello e sperimentazione
• Analisi dei dati esplorativi di piombo, ingegneria delle caratteristiche, selezione dei modelli, formazione, convalida e valutazione delle prestazioni per l'apprendimento automatico e soluzioni AI-enabled.
• Progettare e valutare più approcci di modellazione, stabilire metriche di valutazione appropriate e ottimizzare i modelli per scalabilità, affidabilità e impatto aziendale. Risolvere i problemi aziendali e sostenere le decisioni
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder aziendali e i team di prodotti per tradurre complesse sfide aziendali in approcci analitici, soluzioni di machine learning e capacità di intelligenza scalabile.
• Supporta la priorità dei dati e il processo decisionale strategico attraverso intuizioni attuabili, modelli predittivi e intelligenza operativa. AI & Intelligence Enables
• Collaborare con i team AI, i dati e l'ingegneria per gestire le funzionalità abilitate all'IA e supportare l'adozione di soluzioni di intelligenza scalabile attraverso piattaforme di partner e flussi di lavoro.
• Valutare e applicare tecniche AI moderne, tra cui la modellazione predittiva, NLP, flussi di lavoro abilitati a LLM, e approcci di automazione intelligente per migliorare le operazioni di partner e il processo decisionale. Sviluppo dei dati e dell'intelligence
• Progettazione e sviluppo di soluzioni di analisi, dashboard, KPI e funzionalità di intelligenza che migliorano la visibilità

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Scientifique des données - AI appliquée À propos de notre équipe: Partenaires Solutions numériques Rejoignez notre équipe de Solutions numériques partenaires, un groupe stratégique axé sur la maximisation de l'impact du partenariat grâce aux écosystèmes numériques et à l'IA pour faire progresser les activités de Partenariats Pharma et DIA. Nous sommes à l'avant-garde de l'innovation - construire une infrastructure de données évolutive, appliquer des pratiques avancées en matière d'ingénierie des données et intégrer des capacités externes de pointe pour accélérer la prise de décisions et débloquer la valeur commerciale. Notre travail s'étend à de multiples initiatives à impact élevé, depuis le développement de produits de données intelligents jusqu'aux flux de travail d'IA de bout en bout. Qu'il s'agisse de structurer des écosystèmes de données complexes ou de collaborer avec des institutions de recherche externes, il s'agit d'une occasion unique de contribuer à façonner l'avenir des données et de l'IA à Roche en appuyant directement les décisions stratégiques clés de notre organisation mondiale de partenariat. Responsabilités En tant que Data Scientist, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans l'élaboration et la fourniture de capacités d'IA et d'apprentissage automatique dans l'ensemble de l'écosystème des solutions numériques partenaires. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les propriétaires de produits, les ingénieurs de données, les architectes et les intervenants commerciaux pour développer des modèles d'apprentissage automatique évolutives, des workflows intelligents et des solutions axées sur les données qui améliorent la visibilité, la priorisation, l'efficacité opérationnelle et la prise de décisions stratégiques. Ce rôle est axé sur l'intelligence artificielle appliquée, l'apprentissage automatique, la modélisation prédictive et l'intelligence opérationnelle plutôt que sur la recherche. Vous aiderez à traduire des défis d'affaires complexes en solutions d'IA et d'analyse évolutives qui créent un impact commercial mesurable dans les opérations de partenariat. Vous serez responsable : Apprentissage automatique et solutions d'IA appliquées
• Concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions d'apprentissage automatique et d'IA qui soutiennent des activités de partenariat telles que la priorisation des opportunités, le renseignement de portefeuille, les prévisions, les perspectives opérationnelles et le soutien à la décision.
• Appliquer des techniques avancées d'analyse, de modélisation statistique, d'apprentissage automatique et d'IA émergentes pour résoudre des problèmes d'affaires complexes et fournir des capacités d'intelligence évolutives dans l'écosystème partenaire. Développement et expérimentation de modèles
• Diriger l'analyse des données exploratoires, l'ingénierie des caractéristiques, la sélection des modèles, la formation, la validation et l'évaluation des performances pour l'apprentissage automatique et les solutions compatibles avec l'IA.
• Concevoir et évaluer plusieurs approches de modélisation, établir des paramètres d'évaluation appropriés et optimiser les modèles pour l'évolutivité, la fiabilité et l'impact commercial. Résolution des problèmes d'affaires et soutien à la décision
• S'associer étroitement avec les parties prenantes et les équipes de produits pour traduire les défis complexes en approches analytiques, solutions d'apprentissage automatique et capacités d'intelligence évolutives.
• Appuyer la hiérarchisation axée sur les données et la prise de décisions stratégiques au moyen d'éléments concrets, de modèles prédictifs et de renseignements opérationnels. IA & Intelligence Activement
• Collaborer avec les équipes d'intelligence artificielle, de données et d'ingénierie pour opérationnaliser les capacités d'intelligence artificielle et soutenir l'adoption de solutions d'intelligence évolutives sur les plateformes de partenariat et les flux de travail.
• Évaluer et appliquer les techniques modernes d'intelligence artificielle, y compris la modélisation prédictive, la NLP, les flux de travail compatibles avec la LLM et les approches d'automatisation intelligentes pour améliorer les opérations de partenariat et la prise de décisions. Développement de données et de renseignements
• Concevoir et développer des solutions analytiques, des tableaux de bord, des KPI et des capacités de renseignement qui améliorent la visibilité

jobs.title: Procurement Specialist - Research & Development (Clinical Laboratories)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Procurement Specialist - Research & Development (Clinical Laboratories)
Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions
Hyderabad

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

This role sits within the Indirect Procurement Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. The Indirect Procurement Delivery group comprises many communities grouping categories of the same value chain or having commonality, including Research & Development, Commercial and Corporate Services, Digital & Technology, and Facilities. The communities are key enablers of strong category expertise while allowing flexibility in the procurement delivery response to the evolving needs of our customers.

As a Procurement Specialist in Clinical Laboratories, you will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Applying both general procurement and specialized knowledge or expertise in a specific commodity or spend area, you will ensure effective and efficient delivery of core procurement services and continuous improvement of automation and content availability.

You will collaborate closely with internal procurement (i.e. Chapters and capability areas such as customer relationship management, contracting, solutions, analytics, etc.) and business stakeholders to translate business needs into sourcing and spend management activities and content enhancement.

You will work closely with other team members to support customer demand, improve the customer buying experience, deliver on day-to day operational activities, and provide capacity and expertise to deliver productivity and other customer oriented projects/solutions.

As a Procurement Specialist in Clinical Laboratories, you will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and general business requirements, including but not limited to:

• You are a Category and sourcing subject matter specialist in Clinical Laboratories conducting market and internal analysis to develop strategies and tactical plans for how Roche should source and negotiate for third party goods and services in order to satisfy stakeholder requirements.

• You are a Procurement delivery practitioner delivering and executing sourcing strategies by leveraging spend, category know-how, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, supplier management methodologies and frameworks and project management skills.

• You develop content and automation, translating sourcing outcomes and opportunities into content and automated buying channels that improve business adoption, satisfaction, and overall efficiency.

Who you are:

• You hold a university degre

• You develop content and automation, translating sourcing outcomes and opportunities into content and automated buying channels that improve business adoption, satisfaction, and overall efficiency. Who you are:
• You hold a university degre

jobs.title: Sales Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join us at a pivotal moment in healthcare—one driven by our market-leading success and expansion strategy." As the UK market leader in immunohistochemistry (IHC) and Digital Pathology for Cellular Pathology/Histology, we work directly with healthcare partners to deliver essential products and solutions globally. We have a strong product portfolio, a clear pipeline for future success, and an excellent team.

Reporting to the Regional Sales Manager, you will be joining our expanding sales team at an exciting time of growth. Due to our continued market success and expansion plans, we are recruiting an additional highly motivated individual to to play a vital part in reshaping the healthcare landscape. Your deep understanding of customer needs and our collaborative environment will ensure continued success in a highly impactful field.

The role

Thanks to our strong history of success we have an exciting opportunity for an additional highly motivated individual to join our Tissue Diagnostics sales team in the Central UK region, covering the West of Central England or Wales . You will be promoting the value proposition of our products with key clinical, procurement and finance stakeholders in West of Central England or Wales.
As part of your remit, you will mainly focus on:

• Taking a lead in the account sales strategy and execution for the product portfolio on you territory, you will work closely with Customer Account Managers, Product Specialists, Managed Laboratory Service Team and Workflow IT Specialists.

• Managing and coordinating complex pan pathology procurements, utilising self-discipline and a creative approach to ensure sales methodology is delivered on time and in full. This will involve engagement with all levels of the key decision making team, including senior management.

• Identifying market development and changes in NHS landscape on your territory (payment,procurement, tendering, and NHS processes) to maximise opportunities/minimise threats.

• Developing innovative strategies to retain existing Roche sites and acquire new sites.

Your profile

• Educated to BSc (Hons) /BA Degree or equivalent in a life science or with related experience such as a biomedical scientist background and preferably with previous experience of field sales/or knowledge of laboratories and the Roche Tissue Diagnostics product portfolio.

• You will be skilled in defining customer needs and building strong and effective relationships and have knowledge of best practices in Cellular pathology (especially IHC) and cancer pathways.

• In order to be effective in this role you will need to be resilient, tenacious and both adaptable and flexible to work within a changing environment.

• You have the blend of discipline to follow best practice and creativity to re-define what that looks like. You will understand barriers to acceptance of new solutions and be able to drive positive sales outcomes.

• You will be self-motivated, focused and methodical, with the ability to work alone, yet readily communicate and share knowledge to the team.

• You will have the ability to sell with high credibility and be able to turn strategy into actionable implementation.

• You will drive commercial excellence in your territory by using the latest digital sales engagement tools.

Why Join Us?

This is a fantastic opportunity to work within an exciting and diverse industry and within a highly successful team whilst developing and gaining invaluable knowledge and experiences in the process.

jobs.title: Software Engineer in Test
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Overview
We are seeking a skilled and proactive QA / Test Automation Engineer to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be a champion for product excellence, ensuring our software meets strict quality standards and exceeds customer expectations. You will be responsible for the end-to-end testing lifecycle—from analyzing requirements and designing robust test strategies to coding automated test suites and fostering a "built-in quality" mindset across the organization.

Your Main Tasks & Duties

• Test Strategy & Execution: Compose, execute, and assess functional and non-functional tests aligned with the defined test strategy to ensure product quality and customer satisfaction. + Requirements & Design Review: Review the product backlog, requirements, and specifications for clarity, testability, and traceability. Analyze system designs and architecture with a sharp eye for code quality, risks, and testability.

• Test Case Management: Create, maintain, and review test cases for software across all lifecycle phases within our designated tooling and documentation standards + Test Automation: Build software that tests software by writing automated test code or integrating robust third-party tools into our existing test suites.

• Environment & Infrastructure Management: Configure, manage, and maintain stable and scalable Test Environments + Defect Tracking & Metrics: Execute test cases, analyze results, report/track issues, and verify incoming fixes. Define and monitor relevant quality metrics to track overall product health.

• Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation under your responsibility (including test cases, test results, tooling guides, and best practices).

• Risk & Compliance: Collaborate on product risk assessments by identifying potential failures and ensuring adequate test coverage. Guarantee strict adherence to quality standards, relevant Quality Assurance Plans (QAPs), SOPs, and Working Instructions.

Continuous Improvement & Leadership

• Process Optimization: Provide continuous input to improve testing processes and overall efficiency, heavily leveraging test automation where appropriate.

• QA Initiatives: Actively participate in internal testing improvement initiatives to elevate our engineering standards.

• Mentorship & Culture: Share, coach, and actively train team members both within and outside the department to promote a strong built-in quality mindset .

Who you are

• Experience: Proven experience as a QA Engineer, Test Automation Engineer, or in a similar software testing role.

• Automation Skills: Experience building test frameworks via code (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript) or integrating modern third-party automation tools.

• Analytical Mindset: Strong ability to review architectural designs, pinpoint technical risks, and ensure full test traceability.

• Compliance Awareness: Familiarity working within structured environments governed by SOPs, QAPs, and strict quality guidelines is a plus.

• Soft Skills: Excellent collaboration, communication, and coaching skills to advocate for quality across cross-functional teams.

There is a preferred candidate.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conduct

jobs.title: Innovation & Sustainability Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Internship in Innovation & Sustainability

For students in the field of Environmental Engineering, Sustainability Related Departments, Biochemistry, Materials Science, Biology, Molecular Biology, Bioprocess Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science or related Biotechnology / Life Sciences fields

Our Global Internship Programme in Innovation & Sustainability (#IP2TIS) offers a unique opportunity for passionate individuals to gain hands-on experience in the pharmaceutical industry while making a positive impact on the world.

Are you ready to join a global network spanning 20+ countries, where bright minds collaborate to tackle real-world challenges in Innovation & Sustainability? Do you want to work on impactful projects, shape the future, and drive change from within?

The Position

As an intern, you will contribute to a project focused on research on assessing & reducing the environmental impact of synthetic polymer excipients in the Pharmaceutical Industry by identifying and evaluating safer biodegradable alternatives. The project explores how polymers used in pharmaceutical formulations may contribute to microplastic pollution in municipal water systems and aims to support more sustainable product design in light of evolving regulatory expectations such as EU REACH 2026. Within your first 3 months, you are expected to assess target polymers, research promising biodegradable substitute materials, analyze supplier and production feasibility, and contribute to a final technical report and strategic roadmap. Your work will support Roche’s sustainability ambitions by addressing biodiversity and water-related impacts, advancing sustainable products, and encouraging the use of more environmentally responsible raw materials. This internship offers a high-impact opportunity to work on an innovative topic at the intersection of pharmaceutical science, sustainability, and environmental protection.

The Opportunity

• Conduct a product-based preliminary analysis of target polymers

• Research and evaluate potential biodegradable alternatives for relevant synthetic polymer excipients

• Assess production feasibility and supply landscape for alternative materials, including scalability, supplier availability, quality standards, and regulatory considerations

• Compare synthetic and biodegradable options across environmental impact, ecotoxicity, pharmaceutical performance, and compliance criteria

• Explore how polymer choice influences product life cycle sustainability, from raw material sourcing through use and disposal

• Support the development of a strategic roadmap for improving or replacing selected synthetic polymers with more sustainable alternatives

• Prepare a final technical report and presentation summarizing findings, trade-offs, and recommendations

• Collaborate with stakeholders across functions to gather input and support a multidisciplinary evaluation process

Who You Are

You are enrolled or have completed your Master’s or PhD studies at a university, preferably in the field of Environmental Engineering, Sustainability Related Departments, Biochemistry, Materials Science, Biology, Molecular Biology, Bioprocess Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science or related Biotechnology / Life Sciences within the last 12 months and are interested in applying your knowledge in a modern working environment as part of an internship of at least 3 months.

Preferred Qualifications Are

• Familiar with bioprocesses, biochemical or biological

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Die Finanzabteilung der Roche Pharma Schweiz AG vereint Spezialisten aus verschiedenen Bereichen, wie Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain und Strategic Insights und Analytics. Gemeinsam sind wir dafür verantwortlich, Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen zu analysieren und daraus Erkenntnisse zu generieren und somit die bestmögliche Entscheidungsgrundlage für unser Business zu erstellen.

Die Möglichkeit
Wir suchen einen Praktikanten für unser Finance und Business Partnering Cluster in der Filiale mit Standort in Basel, Schweiz. Du wirst eng mit verschiedenen Teammitgliedern zusammenarbeiten, um wertvolle Erfahrungen im Supply Chain, der Durchführung von Kundenzufriedenheitsumfragen, Finanzen und Procurement zu sammeln.

Wer Du bist:

• Du bist derzeit in einem Masterstudiengang in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration oder einem verwandten Bereich eingeschrieben oder hast dein Studium maximal 12 Monate vor Praktikumsbeginn abgeschlossen.

• Du hast starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten.

• Du arbeitest zuverlässig und detailgenau.

• Du verfügst über hervorragende Kommunikations- und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten.

• Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Google cSuite und Microsoft Office.

• Du bist in der Lage, selbstständig und im Team zu arbeiten.

• Du beherrschst die deutsche Sprache einwandfrei, verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

• Du unterstützt bei der Masterdatenbewirtschaftung.

• Du unterstützt bei der Durchführung von Marktforschungs- und Kundenzufriedenheitsstudien, um unsere Kunden besser zu verstehen und die richtigen Empfehlungen daraus abzuleiten.

• Du unterstützt im Bereich Finanzen beim Monatsabschluss sowie bei Finanzanalysen, -planung und -reporting.

• Du nimmst an verschiedenen, teamübergreifenden Projekten teil, die vom Finance und Business Partnering Team zugewiesen werden.

Bewerbungsprozess:
Deine Bewerbung muss einen Lebenslauf und ein Motivationsschreiben enthalten.

Zusätzliche Information:

• ​Bitte beachte, aufgrund von Vorschriften müssen Nicht-EU/EFTA-Bürger als Teil der Bewerbungsunterlagen eine Bescheinigung der Universität vorlegen, aus der hervorgeht, dass ein Praktikum verpflichtend ist, sowie die Dauer des Pflichtpraktikums.

• Dieses Praktikum ist nicht für eine Masterarbeit geeignet.

Wenn du dich in einem Umfeld entfalten möchtest, das Teamwork und Innovation fördert, dann ist Roche das richtige Unternehmen für dich. Jede Rolle bei Roche trägt dazu bei, das Leben von Patienten zu verbessern. Bewirb dich jetzt!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Insieme, siamo responsabili di analizzare i dati da diverse fonti e generare intuizioni e quindi creare la migliore base possibile per il nostro business. Si lavorerà a stretto contatto con vari membri del team per acquisire preziosa esperienza nella catena di fornitura, sondaggi di soddisfazione del cliente, finanze e appalti. Chi sei:

• Hai forti capacità analitiche e di problem solving.
• Lavorate in modo affidabile e preciso.
• Hai una comunicazione eccellente e competenze interpersonali.
• Sei sicuro nel gestire Google cSuite e Microsoft Office.
• È possibile lavorare in modo indipendente e in una squadra.
• È possibile padroneggiare perfettamente la lingua tedesca, la conoscenza dell'inglese che è sicuro dalla negoziazione è un vantaggio.
• Supporti la gestione dei dati master.
• Supporti l'implementazione di ricerche di mercato e studi di soddisfazione del cliente per comprendere meglio i nostri clienti e trarre le giuste raccomandazioni da loro.
• Sostenere la finanza nel bilancio mensile, nonché analisi finanziarie, pianificazione e reporting.
• Parteciperete a vari progetti multi-team assegnati dal Finance and Business Partnering Team. Processo di applicazione: La vostra domanda deve contenere un CV e una lettera di motivazione. Informazioni aggiuntive:
• Si prega di notare che, nell'ambito dei documenti di richiesta, i cittadini non UE/EFTA devono presentare un certificato universitario che indica che uno stage è obbligatorio e la durata dello stage obbligatorio.
• Questo stage non è adatto per una tesi master. Se si desidera sviluppare in un ambiente che promuove il lavoro di squadra e l'innovazione, Roche è la società giusta per voi. Qualsiasi ruolo in Roche aiuta a migliorare la vita dei pazienti. Contatta subito! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alti i nostri ambiziosi, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Field Service Engineer – Medical Diagnostics (Stoke-on-Trent to Wrexham)
A Healthier Future. It’s What Drives Us.
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate, to continuously advance science, and to ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.
Together, we’re creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
That’s what makes us Roche.
Roche Diagnostics presents an exceptional opportunity for you to leverage your technical expertise while providing vital, life-saving support to our valued customers.
As an integral member of the Central Customer-Centric Field Support Team in the UK, this role offers the possibility of field-based assignments across Stoke and surrounding areas or focusing on a designated customer base. (North Wales, Shropshire, and Staffordshire)

The Opportunity: Technical Excellence in the Field
Ideal Location: Based out of Stoke or the surrounding areas to the west, with excellent access to motorway networks.
As a Field Service Engineer, your focus is to ensure the seamless operation and maximum uptime of Roche’s innovative Systems/Products, ranging from serum work area, pre/post analytics and our digital portfolio.
You will utilise a combination of on-site support and remote diagnostic tools to identify and resolve complex electro-mechanical faults efficiently. Additionally, you will perform preventive maintenance and generate insightful reports to enhance operational efficiency across assigned customer sites.
Key Responsibilities

• Deliver Essential Support: Deliver electro-mechanical hardware support, including routine proactive and reactive tasks and technical training.

• Resolve Complex Faults: Perform troubleshooting and fault resolution, conduct preventive maintenance, and generate reports to enhance operational efficiency.

• Customer Training: Provide technical training and guidance to customers, enabling them to excel in the use of Roche diagnostic systems.

• Compliance & Administration: Maintain rigorous administration and regulatory documentation to ensure compliance and efficient service delivery.

• Stakeholder Management: Build productive relationships with peers and key stakeholders to align service and sales objectives seamlessly.

• Service Excellence: Attend internal review meetings to showcase progress, discuss objectives, and ensure service excellence.

Who you are
We are seeking resilient, adaptable, and customer-focused individuals who thrive on solving technical challenges and exceeding expectations. Ideally, you will bring:

• Educational Qualifications: A degree or equivalent qualification in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering is preferred. Candidates with equivalent experience at the HNC/HND level with a proven track record are also encouraged to apply.

• Experience: Extensive experience within the IVD industry, with a history of delivering exceptional technical support.

• Skills: Excellent analytical ability, self-motivation, advanced troubleshooting expertise, and the ability to work effectively under pressure in a collaborative team environment.

• Attributes: Resilience, tenacity, motivation to exceed customer expectations, and the ability to grow and mentor others through training, coaching, and continuous development.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come.

• Customer Training: fornire formazione tecnica e guida ai clienti, consentendo loro di eccellere nell'uso dei sistemi diagnostici Roche.

• Qualifiche didattiche: Si preferisce una laurea o una qualifica equivalente in Ingegneria Elettrica/Meccanica. I candidati con esperienza equivalente a livello HNC/HND con un record di traccia collaudato sono anche incoraggiati ad applicare.
• Esperienza: Ampia esperienza nell'industria IVD, con una storia di supporto tecnico eccezionale.
• Competenze: eccellente capacità analitica, automotivazione, esperienza avanzata di risoluzione dei problemi, e la capacità di lavorare efficacemente sotto pressione in un ambiente di team collaborativo.
• Attributi: Resilienza, tenacia, motivazione per superare le aspettative dei clienti, e la capacità di crescere e mentore gli altri attraverso formazione, coaching e sviluppo continuo. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position
Please submit your CV in English.
The role is based in Estonia.

As a Finance Enterprise Partner (FEP), you will serve as a strategic thought partner, advisor, and consultant to the business. You will ensure financial excellence and compliance in our daily operations while guiding decision-making on resource allocation. Your role is to bridge the gap between financial data and actionable strategy, ensuring that prioritized business areas receive the support necessary to deliver outstanding value to patients.

Key Areas of Responsibilities and Accountabilities

Strategic Partnering and Performance

• Support the local business planning, budgeting and forecasting in close collaboration with wider Baltics team.

• Guide strategic resource allocation decisions and oversee the financial performance of the affiliate’s operating expenses.

• Provide relevant insights and recommendations through regular performance reporting and dashboards to facilitate decision-making.

Local Stewardship, Governance & Operational Excellence

• Act as a guardian for high standards of compliance, ethics, and Roche's Code of Conduct while maintaining robust internal control standards.

• Oversee essential local financial tasks including payment approvals, local reporting and others as required.

• Serve as primary local contact for local government authorities

• Lead local tax compliance, including alignment of global requirement to local regulation (for example: impact calculations for co-payment schemes; dividend payment support; and preparation for statutory audits).

• Identify opportunities for simplification, automation, and efficiency gains in finance processes and systems.

• Support the organizational transition to updated ERP systems.

Cluster & Regional Collaboration

• Act as a role model for collaboration within the Baltic countries, ensuring a unified approach to financial challenges and opportunities.

• Lead or contribute to cross-functional projects and initiatives as business needs evolve within the Baltics and the wider region

• As part of the broader Finance community, participate in above-country squads to leverage network effects and achieve desired outcomes.
