jobs.title: Legal/Compliance Partner（社内弁護士）
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
募集要項：社内弁護士（法務・コンプライアンス部門）

職務の目的と使命

ロシュ・ダイアグノスティックス株式会社の「Doing now what patients need next」という企業理念のもと、法務・コンプライアンス部門の一員として会社の法的及びコンプイアンスリスクを適切に管理し、事業の発展に貢献する職種です。 私たちの組織は、チームワークで貢献することを大切にしています。単なる法律解釈にとどまらず、組織一丸となって、業務の仕組み化やAIの活用や法務DXの推進を含めた運用の改善にも積極的に関わっていただける方を募集します。

主な職務内容

法務業務とコンプライアンス（法令遵守・企業倫理）業務の双方において、幅広い領域をバランスよくお任せします。

• 法務相談・契約関連業務
• 各事業部門からの法務相談への対応、および事業推進における良き相談相手としての支援

• 契約書の作成、審査、交渉の支援（高度な専門領域、海外や特定の法域が関わる契約、紛争の危険がある案件などへの対応）

• 外部弁護士との連携および委託業務の管理

• コンプライアンス・組織基盤への貢献
• 法令遵守・企業倫理全般の推進、各種研修や監査実務の実施

• 内部通報（適切な通報対応）に関する調査の支援

• 「判断基準の共有書庫」の整備など、部内の仕組み化（法務運用の効率化）への参画

求める経験・能力

• 必須要件
• 日本の弁護士資格をお持ちの方

• 仕事で使える水準の英語力（英語に対し高い学習意欲のある者でも可）（海外との連携、調査対応などで使用、目安：読み書きに加え、会議等で意思疎通が図れるレベ ル）

• 組織の一員としてお互いに「補い合い」、協調して業務を進められる高い協調性

• 法律知識だけでなく、組織への貢献や事業への深い理解を前向きに楽しめる姿勢

• 歓迎要件
• 弁護士としての実務経験（資料内では3〜7年程度を想定していますが、意欲や潜在能力も考慮します）

• 業界経験者、未経験共に歓迎です

求める人物像

• 組織として働くことに楽しみを感じる方

• チームワークを発揮することが好きな方

• 会社全体の変化を楽しみ、柔軟に適応・推進できる方

• 事業に寄り添い、会社の発展のために法律の観点から自発的に提案・貢献ができる方

雇用形態および期間
雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

業務内容 　（雇い入れ直後）：社内弁護士（法務・コンプライアンス部門）
　　　　　（変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり

就業場所 （雇い入れ直後）: 本社 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南1-2-70 品川シーズンテラス
（変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする
給与
　　 基本給（月額）：400,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　 住宅手当（月額）：22,000円～
　　 時間外固定手当（月額）：68,065円～（時間外労働の有無に関わらず、20時間分の固定残業代として支給）
　　 ※20時間を超える時間外労働分についての割増賃金は追加で支給
　　 ＜補足＞ ■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
諸手当：住宅手当、営業手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤手当、別居手当など　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）
コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
休暇:
・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休　暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など）

福利厚生・その他
社会保険：　健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険

受動喫煙防止措置 　屋内全面禁煙

募集者名 　ロシュ・ダイアグノスティックス株式会社　(Roche Diagnostics K.K.)

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
La persona en este cargo actúa como vínculo de la compañía con las cuentas asignadas para favorecer la imagen corporativa y ofrecer propuestas de valor. Debe administrar las cuentas de manera rentable mediante la planeación de cuotas de venta, manejo de inventarios y negociaciones para cumplir los objetivos. Además, es responsable de desarrollar nuevos modelos de negocio e implementar estrategias para incrementar las ventas en instituciones públicas y privadas, gestionando proyectos con distribuidores y hospitales.

Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:

Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen:
● Lograr los objetivos de venta y participación de mercado mensuales, cuatrimestrales y anuales en las cuentas y territorios asignados.
● Realizar pronósticos de necesidades por producto y cuenta para maximizar el potencial de ventas del territorio.
● Implementar planes de acción para asegurar el desplazamiento del producto y ofrecer soluciones integrales.
● Desarrollar actividades de promoción visitando médicos, asociaciones, hospitales (Privados y Públicos) y distribuidores para detectar necesidades del mercado.
● Realizar análisis de datos para tomar decisiones estratégicas fundamentadas, reduciendo riesgos y aumentando la competitividad.
● Elaborar el presupuesto anual (forecast) y coordinar las operaciones comerciales con los clientes.
● Identificar oportunidades en sectores donde no se tiene presencia y desarrollar una propuesta comercial.
● Mantener actualizada la base de datos de los diferentes stakeholders para un seguimiento estratégico en los diferentes negocios del territorio

Tu perfil:

• Estudios universitarios completos y graduación son un requerimiento

• Experiencia de al menos 3 años en el sector farmacéutico, estrategias comerciales, conocimiento del mercado público y privado, manejo administrativo y estadístico, así como experiencia en el uso de portales de compras gubernamentales y manejo de licitaciones.

• Conocimiento intermedio del idioma inglés

• Colaboración o Relaciones Externas: Instituciones públicas y privadas, distribuidores, clientes y proveedores.

Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición.

We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
What do we offer?

To be part of a new cohort of the Roche-CEU San Pablo postgraduate degree as an expert in the Pharmaceutical Industry. An 11-month internship at Roche where you will participate in challenging projects and benefit from pioneering postgraduate training in the market about the pharmaceutical industry.

In this internal customer-facing role, you will join the Finance team acting as a strategic partner to Roche Digital Technology (RDT) and other global functions for one academic year. RDT is our global community of technologists committed to designing the digital future of medicine. Your mission will be to guide the organization through solid financial stewardship, with a clear focus on results, productivity, and cross-functional business transformation initiatives.

You will have the opportunity to receive on-the-job training by working on key projects with your designated department from Monday to Thursday and attending in-person postgraduate classes at the university on Friday.

Our main location is Madrid. We are open to applications from all over Spain, but relocation will be needed as part of the program expectations. Office attendance is expected (with some flexibility) to encourage collaboration, networking, and exposure to multidisciplinary teams and international stakeholders.

Last but not least, you will receive mentorship from a Roche tutor who will provide continuous feedback to support your professional development. The mentors for the program are Roche’s senior and experienced young talent development professionals.

Main responsibilities as an intern:

As an active member of our finance squad, your work will directly impact our strategy by:

Organizational & Restructuring Support: Provide high-impact analytical and operational support to the RDT Finance Enterprise Partnering team during its global organizational restructuring process and other global functions.

Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate daily with global finance and technology teams on digital transformation initiatives, ensuring the standardization of internal processes and the exchange of best practices.

Strategic Partnering (Customer-facing) : Act as a strategic point of contact for RDT's global teams and product owners, facilitating their financial understanding and transforming complex financial data into agile, automated, and transparent tools.

Tactical Impact Monitoring: You will assist in tracking digital strategies and internal financial plans to ensure RDT aligns with Roche’s long-term healthcare vision. Through an entrepreneurial lens, you will help monitor financial flows and learn how daily technical and financial decisions create sustainable value.

What are we looking for?

> Academic Background: University degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Business Administration (ADE), Finance, Economics , or dual degrees (e.g., ADE + Computer Engineering / Business & Technology / Data Analytics) that successfully bridge business and technology.

> Core Skills & Mindset:

• Financial & Business Mindset : Strong foundational analytical skills with the ability to see the story behind the numbers. Highly results-oriented, productive, and eager to quickly grasp the mechanics of the company’s value chain.

• Collaboration & Communication : Natural team player with the interpersonal skills needed to bridge the gap between finance and technical teams, translating financial data into simple, actionable insights across diverse cultures.

• Proactive Growth : An e

jobs.title: Publication Data Entry Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Publication Data Entry Specialist

Healthcare’s future is driven by the exchange of science and data. As a Publication Data Entry Specialist at Roche, you’ll be actively shaping this future and giving our wealth of science a voice as a member of the Scientific Communications Community.

The Opportunity

Publication Data Entry Specialists execute Scientific Communications (SC) Strategies by assisting with the accurate and timely entry, validation, and maintenance of all publication-related data within designated management systems. This meticulous documentation of publication activities supports effective project oversight and reporting across product-specific teams, Disease Areas, early research, and other cross-lifecycle engagements, ultimately contributing to the goal of changing medical practice.

• Scientific Data Curation: Research, enter, and maintain high volumes of publication data with 100% accuracy.

• Metadata Validation: Review and audit data points to ensure completeness.

• Quality Assurance: Perform quality control checks on peer-reviewed content and historical archives under supervision.

• SOP Support: Assist with the creation and documentation of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for specialized data harvesting.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with IT and Therapeutic Areas to improve the data entries.

• Reporting: Assist in generating status reports on database health and publication trends for management.

• System Integrity: Assist with data migrations and help identify system errors within our publication management tools.

Who You Are

• Technical Skills: Ability to learn and implement new IT Systems across the network; keyboarding speed & accuracy is required.

• Experience: 0-5 years experience in customer service or data entry positions. Fresh graduates and students are encouraged to apply for this position.

• Attention to Detail: Exceptional focus on accuracy; able to maintain high standards while processing large datasets with minimal supervision.

• Organizational Skills: Strong time management skills; able to prioritize tasks independently based on data volume and deadlines.

• Communication: Fluency in written and spoken English is a must.

• Ability to operate successfully in a matrix environment with shared responsibilities.

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes, and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching/mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global, inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes, and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitme

The Position

AI Solutions Engineer - Mergers & Acquisitions

About Our Team: Partnering Digital Solutions

Join our Partnering Digital Solutions team, a strategic group focused on maximizing partnership impact through digital and AI-enabled ecosystems to advance the Pharma and DIA Partnering business. We are at the forefront of innovation - building scalable data infrastructure, enabling intelligent workflows, and integrating advanced AI capabilities to accelerate decision-making and unlock business value.

Our work spans multiple high-impact initiatives, including AI-enabled partnering solutions, intelligent data products, workflow automation, and enterprise-scale data and AI integrations. This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of AI-enabled partnering at Roche by operationalizing innovative capabilities that directly support strategic decisions across our global Partnering organization.

Responsibilities

As an AI Solutions Engineer, you will play a critical role in enabling and operationalizing AI and intelligence capabilities across the Partnering Digital Solutions ecosystem. You will work closely with product owners, data engineers, Data Scientists, architects, and business stakeholders to implement scalable AI-enabled workflows, integrations, automation solutions, and intelligent applications that support partnering operations and decision making.

This role combines AI enablement, integration engineering, workflow orchestration, cloud-native solution development, and operationalization of AI capabilities at enterprise scale. In addition, the role offers opportunities to contribute to modern web application development and user-facing AI experiences where needed.

You will be responsible for:

AI Workflow & Solution Enablement

• Support the implementation and operationalization of AI-enabled solutions across partnering platforms and intelligence products.

• Develop and integrate AI workflows that support automation, decision support, insights generation, and orchestration of AI-enabled capabilities across the partnering ecosystem.

System Integration & API Development

• Develop and maintain APIs and integration services that connect AI capabilities, enterprise platforms, and data ecosystems.

• Enable seamless integration between internal platforms, external data sources, AI services, and workflow orchestration frameworks.

AI & Agent Integration:

• Support the integration of AI services, LLM-based applications, and agentic workflows into enterprise solutions and partnering processes.

• Collaborate with AI and data teams to operationalize intelligent capabilities and scalable automation workflows.

Cloud-Native Solution Development

• Build and deploy scalable services and integrations using cloud-native technologies and AWS services such as ECS, Lambda, and API-based architectures.

• Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, reliable, and aligned with enterprise architecture and Roche security standards

Data & Platform Integration

• Support integration of structured and unstructured data sources across partnering platforms, analytics solutions, and AI-enabled capabilities.

jobs.title: Project Manager CAPEX
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
With an eye to the future, we are actively shaping the continued development of the Roche site in Rotkreuz. The Engineering & Project department makes a vital contribution to this endeavor: It holds the responsibility for the strategic advancement of the site and all capital investments in buildings and facilities (CAPEX). This encompasses complex construction projects as well as the realization of infrastructure and modern process plants in the areas of production and research. In all our activities, we place particular emphasis on sustainability, safety (SHE), quality, and cost-effectiveness.

The Opportunity
As Project Manager you are responsible for:

• Accountable that the project design and execution meets project objectives outlined in the approved Credit Application, URB, URS, project charter, PEP (scope, functionality, capacity, cost, schedule, SHE, sustainability, maintenance & reliability, quality, construction safety)

• Establish, onboard and lead the engineering team, coordinate their activities and acquire the necessary resources

• Ensure compliance with corporate and site directives / SOP’s, local laws and building codes

• Implement project controls (scope, cost, schedule, progress, risk, change mgmt.) and ensure monthly cost and schedule forecast of the project (PMR) from PI to HO

• Report project status, key issues and corrective actions to project SC on a regular basis

Who you are:

• Bachelor or Master/University degree in engineering, construction, etc.

• Min 5-10 years work experience as project manager in capital projects

• Experience managing DIA process projects.

• Excellent collaboration, teambuilding and communication skills at all levels of the project

• Proven ability to lead large teams working in a matrix environment

• Very good understanding of customer needs

• Excellent project mgmt and planning skills

• Very good analytical and problem solving skills

Be part of our 'Engineering & Project' team in Rotkreuz, apply now !

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
We are seeking a Senior Software Developer (C#) for a hybrid engineering (75%) and Scrum Master (25%) role in Spain. You will take ownership of the full software development lifecycle - leveraging your deep expertise in C#, WPF, and .NET 8.0 to build high-performance applications - while also guiding the development team through Agile principles as a servant leader.
If you thrive on navigating ambiguity, utilizing modern AI-supporting tools, and are passionate about both exceptional code quality and team empowerment, this is the perfect opportunity to make a lasting technical impact.

Key Responsibilities:

Engineering & Development (75%)

• Software Development Lifecycle : Participate fully in all phases of software development, including feasibility studies, design, development, testing, bug fixing, and ongoing software maintenance.

• Design & Implementation: Produce unit and subsystem specifications based on software requirements, project architecture, and guidelines. Accurately design and implement code, including the necessary tests to verify functionality against specifications.

• Team Collaboration & Planning: Self-organizing and proactive in defining, estimating, planning, and implementing work packages within the development team. Provide timely work status updates and issue notifications to the team and project management.

• Quality Assurance & Review: Conduct thorough reviews and analysis of personal source code and, upon request, the source code of peers. Review application design, functionality, usability, and performance to drive enhancements.

• Ambiguity Management: Possess the ability to navigate ambiguity and maintain forward progress.

• Role Type: Function as a Fullstack Developer.

Scrum Master Responsibilities (25%)

• Act as a servant leader for the development team, applying Scrum principles to facilitate progress, resolve conflicts, and increase transparency.

• Empower the team by removing blockers and applying proven Agile techniques to drive continuous improvement.

Who You Are
You are a proactive, collaborative software engineer who excels at navigating ambiguity and taking end-to-end ownership of technical problems. You possess a strong analytical mindset, are passionate about data-heavy infrastructure, and thrive when facilitating team progress and empowering others to succeed.

Qualifications & Skills:

Education and General Experience

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT,

jobs.title: Manufacturing Operator - 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Manufacturing Operator contributes to producing reliable products and supplies with effective operations in an empowered organization. As part of a dynamic team, the Manufacturing Operator is responsible for collaborating with their team to operate automated equipment and systems to perform a wide variety of complex tasks related to assembly, printing, fill and kitpack manufacturing operations.

The Manufacturing Operator recognizes and elevates safety, equipment, and product problems, contributing to the achievement of production goals. Utilizes validated software and systems to maintain processes, batch records, and inventory control. Ensures all production related documentation is in compliance with quality system regulations. May be responsible for low complexity training of new employees and sharing best practices. They must have good communication and organizational skills and the ability to identify opportunities that would drive the business forward.

This is an essential position supporting the organizational goals requiring attendance on weekends, holidays, and during emergency or exceptional conditions.

Responsibilities:

Production

◦ Executes the process of assembly, filling, labeling & packaging equipment of varying complexity and in accordance with production manufacturing records, operating procedure requirements to produce finished intermediates and final kits while meeting production targets.
◦ Performs basic transactions within highly complex systems and controls in a regulated manufacturing environment (e.g., receive, process, build product/materials, facilitate material availability, SAP transactions/confirmations).
• ◦ Runs automated systems/equipment and sequences of operation, including: equipment setup, operation, and cleaning; monitoring and performing basic troubleshooting.
• ◦ Participates in the execution of protocol/validations.
• ◦ Maintains the ability to be a subject matter expert (SME) in one or more areas of production.
• ◦ Contributes to daily end-of-shift reports and pass downs.

Safety and Quality

◦ Maintains Right to Operate and ensures that all processes are performed in a safe and healthy manner; Addresses and escalates any potentially unsafe hazards; Provides feedback during investigation of safety hazards, incidents, and near misses using safety reporting tools.
• ◦ Performs tasks/transactions in the quality system to ensure we achieve our quality objectives.
• ◦ Understands the expectations of audit readiness (OSHA, FDA, QSR, GMP, ISO, etc.); may be required to answer questions about processes on the spot.
• ◦ Maintains accurate and complete system transactions, ensuring material traceability, and inventory accuracy (e.g., receipt, storage, issuance of materials, and other inventory transactions).
• ◦ Provides feedback on NCR investigations, reworks, and corrective actions.
• ◦ Adheres to 95% or above internal training compliance

Continuous Improvement

• ◦ Performs 6S activities, gathers/meets cycle times, and develops/follows standard work; identifies and implements process improvements and continuous improvement initiatives utilizing lean tools.
• ◦ Participates and contributes in tier meetings.
• ◦ May participate in the collection of data for daily metrics purposes and to support operational excellence initiatives and improvements.
• Teamwork and Collaboration
• ◦ Proactively collaborates with peers in other shifts/functions to ensure daily targets are achieved.
• ◦ Assists in the successful onboarding of new employees and contractors.

May be responsible for low complexity training of new employees and sharing best practices. They must have good communication and organizational skills and the ability to identify opportunities that would drive the business forward. This is an essential position supporting the organizational goals requiring attendance on weekends, holidays, and during emergency or exceptional conditions. Responsibilities: Production ◦ Executes the process of assembly, filling, labeling & packaging equipment of varying complexity and in accordance with production manufacturing records, operating procedure requirements to produce finished intermediates and final kits while meeting production targets. ◦ Performs basic transactions within highly complex systems and controls in a regulated manufacturing environment (e.g., receive, process, build product/materials, facilitate material availability, SAP transactions/confirmations).
• ◦ Runs automated systems/equipment and sequences of operation, including: equipment setup, operation, and cleaning; monitoring and performing basic troubleshooting.
• ◦ Participates in the execution of protocol/validations.
• ◦ Maintains the ability to be a subject matter expert (SME) in one or more areas of production.
• ◦ Contributes to daily end-of-shift reports and pass downs. Safety and Quality ◦ Maintains Right to Operate and ensures that all processes are performed in a safe and healthy manner; Addresses and escalates any potentially unsafe hazards; Provides feedback during investigation of safety hazards, incidents, and near misses using safety reporting tools.
• ◦ Performs tasks/transactions in the quality system to ensure we achieve our quality objectives.
• ◦ Understands the expectations of audit readiness (OSHA, FDA, QSR, GMP, ISO, etc.); may be required to answer questions about processes on the spot.
• ◦ Maintains accurate and complete system transactions, ensuring material traceability, and inventory accuracy (e.g., receipt, storage, issuance of materials, and other inventory transactions).
• ◦ Provides feedback on NCR investigations, reworks, and corrective actions.
• ◦ Adheres to 95% or above internal training compliance Continuous Improvement
• ◦ Performs 6S activities, gathers/meets cycle times, and develops/follows standard work; identifies and implements process improvements and continuous improvement initiatives utilizing lean tools.
• ◦ Participates and contributes in tier meetings.
• ◦ May participate in the collection of data for daily metrics purposes and to support operational excellence initiatives and improvements.
• Teamwork and Collaboration
• ◦ Proactively collaborates with peers in other shifts/functions to ensure daily targets are achieved.
• ◦ Assists in the successful onboarding of new employees and contractors.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Python / FastAPI)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
We are looking for an experienced Backend Python Engineer to build robust, scalable APIs and services that power our digital products in the life sciences sector. Working closely with our Frontend/UX team and Data Scientists, you will design the backend infrastructure required to process, manage, and serve complex bioinformatics and machine learning data.

In this highly collaborative role, you will tackle challenges ranging from optimizing database queries for massive datasets to architecting cloud-native solutions on AWS. We value engineers who are comfortable exploring complex data structures, establishing clean API boundaries, and ensuring high reliability as we scale our platforms to support critical scientific innovation.

Key Responsibilities:

• Design, build, and maintain high-performance, asynchronous backend services and robust RESTful APIs.

• Architect, deploy, and manage scalable and secure cloud infrastructure, utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles.

• Design efficient database schemas, manage complex data relationships, execute seamless migrations, and ensure performant query optimization for massive datasets.

• Build and maintain data pipelines to ingest, normalize, and process large volumes of structured and unstructured scientific and bioinformatics data.

• Champion engineering excellence by writing clean, testable code, implementing comprehensive automated testing, and maintaining reliable CI/CD pipelines.

• Partner directly with the UX/Frontend team to establish seamless API integrations, and collaborate with Data Scientists to bring machine learning models into production workflows.

Who You Are
You are a proactive, collaborative software engineer who thrives on solving complex backend challenges. You possess a strong analytical mindset, are passionate about clean API boundaries, and excel at transforming data infrastructure to drive meaningful progress.

Qualifications & Skills

The Must-Haves:

• 5+ years of software engineering experience, with Python as your primary language.

• Strong software engineering fundamentals, including robust API design and experience building and scaling RESTful systems.

• Solid understanding of relational databases, data modeling, schema migrations, and query optimization.

• Proven experience building, deploying, and managing scalable infrastructure in cloud environments, ideally utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

• A strong focus on code quali

jobs.title: Lead UX Designer & Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
We are looking for a visionary Lead UX Designer & Frontend Engineer to shape the future of our digital products in the life sciences sector. In this hybrid leadership role, you will be the driving force behind the user interfaces and complex dashboards that empower our Machine Learning and Data Science teams.

Operating at the intersection of UX design and high-performance frontend engineering, you will translate complex bioinformatics, PCR, and sequencing data into intuitive, lightning-fast web applications. If you are passionate about building scalable UI architectures and graphing millions of data points to drive scientific innovation, this is the role for you.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture:

• Act as the bridge between UX, Frontend, and Backend teams, driving architecture and design discussions to establish robust technical solutions and API designs (REST/GraphQL).

• Lead the end-to-end frontend implementation of enterprise-scale business applications deployed on AWS.

• Mentor and guide junior frontend engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, code quality, and continuous learning.

UX Engineering & System Design:

• Own the user experience for highly complex data tools, ensuring seamless workflows for data scientists and researchers.

• Champion, maintain, and expand our internal component library (R-Design System) to ensure visual consistency across all products.

• Work closely with cross-functional teams in an Agile/SCRUM environment to map out user journeys and interface requirements.

Advanced Frontend & Data Visualization:

• Build scalable, responsive, and highly interactive frontends using Vue.js and Tailwind CSS.

• Architect high-performance data visualization solutions capable of rendering millions of data points smoothly in the browser using D3.js.

• Interface directly with AWS cloud services and help shape backend interface requirements.

Who You Are
You are an engineering champion and a collaborative technical leader who is passionate about leveraging technology to transform medicine. You thrive when navigating ambiguity, enjoy solving complex data challenges, and excel at empowering your team through technical mentorship.

Qualifications & Skills

The Must-Haves:

• 5+ years of hands-on software development experience using modern JavaScript MVC frameworks, with deep, proven expertise in Vue.js.

• Strong practical experience with D3.js, including optimizin

• Lead the end-to-end frontend implementation of enterprise-scale business applications deployed on AWS.
• Mentor and guide junior frontend engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, code quality, and continuous learning. UX Engineering & System Design:
• Own the user experience for highly complex data tools, ensuring seamless workflows for data scientists and researchers.
• Champion, maintain, and expand our internal component library (R-Design System) to ensure visual consistency across all products.
• Work closely with cross-functional teams in an Agile/SCRUM environment to map out user journeys and interface requirements. Advanced Frontend & Data Visualization:
• Build scalable, responsive, and highly interactive frontends using Vue.js and Tailwind CSS.
• Architect high-performance data visualization solutions capable of rendering millions of data points smoothly in the browser using D3.js.
• Interface directly with AWS cloud services and help shape backend interface requirements. Who You Are You are an engineering champion and a collaborative technical leader who is passionate about leveraging technology to transform medicine. You thrive when navigating ambiguity, enjoy solving complex data challenges, and excel at empowering your team through technical mentorship. Qualifications & Skills The Must-Haves:
• 5+ years of hands-on software development experience using modern JavaScript MVC frameworks, with deep, proven expertise in Vue.js.
• Strong practical experience with D3.js, including optimizin

jobs.title: Office & Workplace Experience Lead (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality.

The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here .

Here's what we're looking for:

Our office at Trattnerhof 1 isn’t just a place to work; it’s a three-floor hub of digital innovation and collaboration. We are looking for a proactive Team Lead to lead our office squad and ensure our physical environment keeps pace with our digital evolution.

As our Office & Workplace Experience Lead , you won't just manage a front desk (which we don’t have, btw); you will be the architect of our "Office-as-a-Service" philosophy. You will lead a team of three people and manage external vendors to provide a world-class experience for our employees and the many global visitors who call our office their favorite place to work.

The Anchor of our Hub: While many of our roles offer high flexibility for remote work, the nature of this leadership position requires a consistent on-site presence. You are the face of the office and the primary caretaker of our physical culture, ensuring that whether it's a Monday morning or a high-stakes workshop Friday, the site is buzzing and functional.

Your upcoming mission

• Lead & Empower: Mentor and lead our Office Team (3 people), fostering a culture of service excellence and proactive problem-solving.

• Global Collaboration Host: Orchestrate the experience for global Roche partners and international visitors. From high-level workshops to cross-site collaboration weeks, you ensure every visitor feels the unique welcoming energy of our site.

• Workspace Innovation: Continuously improve our 3-floor office for hybrid usage. You’ll find creative ways to make our space work for both high-energy collaboration and global virtual meetings.

• Building & Facility Management: Take full ownership of building maintenance, improvements, and construction projects. You’ll be the point of contact for external providers and contractors.

• Employee Experience: Maintain the spirit and continuously improve our space for our 250+ on-site staff, ensuring our office reflects our vibrant culture from the moment someone walks through the door.

Essential skills for your mission:

• You are a "people person" with a technical backbone. You understand that a broken coffee machine is a crisis, but a poorly planned office layout is a strategic hurdle.

• Industry Experience: 7+ years of relevant work experience

• Experience: You have a proven track record in Office Management, Facility Management, and Project Management, preferably within a professional digital or tech-heavy environment.

• Language Skills: You have native-level German skills (essential for local vendor management and legal compliance) and excellent English (our "official" company language and the key to greeting our global partners).

• Leadership Style: You lead with empathy and a "can-do" attitude. You enjoy being "where the action is" and thrive on the daily interactions that come with being on-site while always keeping the big picture in mind.

• Hospitality Mindset: You treat office management like premium hospitality, anticipating the needs of workshop facilitators and ensuring our facilities support seamless collaboration.

• Organizational Talent: You can juggle multiple projects at once without losing your cool.

Bonus skills:

• Experience with office construction project management

• Experience in a corporate / global environment

What to expect:

• Ambitious and passionate people building m

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Timkl est une entreprise de services en santé de nouvelle génération née en 2019 d’une démarche soutenue par le groupe Roche , acteur majeur de la santé en France et premier investisseur dans l’innovation santé. Nous proposons une prestation de suivi renforcé pour tous les patients diabétiques sous insulinothérapie par pompe, y compris ceux équipés des systèmes les plus innovants, comme la boucle fermée.

Notre modèle est aujourd’hui accessible sur tout le territoire français hexagonal. Il est co-construit avec les acteurs de soins, parmi lesquels : les pharmaciens, les infirmiers libéraux, les diabétologues et les médecins généralistes.

Tu as le goût du challenge ?
Tu souhaites t'impliquer dans le développement d’un modèle innovant pour améliorer la prise en charge des personnes vivant avec un diabète? Prends part à cette aventure au sein d'une équipe motivée et dynamique.

Responsabilités Principales :

Rattaché(e) à l’équipe marketing / ventes, tes missions auront pour objectif d’aider à la stratégie et au pilotage de l’activité commerciale :

• Réseaux Sociaux : Accompagnement pour le lancement de Timkl sur le réseau Instagram

• Communication Partenaires : Lancement des Newsletters Professionnels de Santé

• Relation Presse : aide à la rédaction de communiqué de presse selon l’actualité, travailler la relation avec les journalistes de l’environnement diabète

• GSite - intranet interne: Mise à jour des pages en appliquant la charte graphique et en s’assurant auprès des "page owner" que les informations sont à jour.

• Veille marché & environnement France : Nourrir les équipes marketing, ventes et administration commerciale des évolutions de marché, des concurrents et des nouvelles tendances. Analyser et traiter les chiffres clés du marché grâce à des bases de données en open data)

• Veille presse : mise en place d’un processus de partage auprès collaborateurs Timkl sur l’environnement diabète.

Idéalement, tu correspondes au profil suivant :

• Tu prépares actuellement un diplôme d'étude supérieur pour valider votre cursus M2 (Domaines: Ecole de commerce / Business intelligence : ).

• Tu es dynamique, autonome, organisé(e)

• Tu as la capacité de manipuler des données et des chiffres, avec une bonne compréhension des enjeux business opérationnels et de la collaboration avec des organisations transversales.

• Tu fais preuve d’agilité dans l’utilisation d’Excel et dans la représentation des données sous forme de graphiques.

• Tu possèdes une vision stratégique, une curiosité naturelle et des compétences en analyse de marché.

• Tu as des connaissances d’un outil de CRM (Salesforce ou autre).

• Tu démontres une capacité d’analyse et de synthèse.

Poste basé à Montbonnot (Isère, 38)

Stage de 6 mois à compter de Septembre 2026 /
Alternance de 12 mois à compter de Septembre 2026

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
● Nous considérons les stagiaires comme de véritables partenaires qui pourront être amenés à évoluer à nos côtés. Ta contribution, tes propositions seront écoutées et valorisées par les équipes.
● Tous nos postes sont ouverts au recrutement de personnes en situation de handicap. Si tu as besoin d’un aménagement spécifique en vue de l’entretien de recrutement, n’hésite pas à nous le signaler en amont de l’entretien.
● Tu cherches un sens à ce que tu fais ? Rejoins un groupe qui œuvre pour des projets à fort impact et l’avancée pour la santé de tous.

Si tu es prêt(e) à faire partie de notre écosystème novateur, envoie dès maintenant ta candidature

jobs.title: AI Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Position:

The AI Full Stack Engineer is a pivotal role within the Service Intelligence team, responsible for designing and deploying the software solutions that turns Roche Support Network (RSN) operational data into actionable tools. This individual will bridge the gap between complex AI models and the daily operations of field and depot service teams, ensuring that intelligence is not just generated, but accessible and intuitive for the enterprise. Your mission is to design, craft, deploy, and sustain software solutions that are tailored to business requirements and objectives using a combination of frontend, backend, full-stack, and mobile development expertise. You adhere to in-depth domain knowledge and promote a DevOps and Cloud-focused approach. You will also act as a technical lead for projects and lead employees and processes in programming activities.
You have an overall understanding of the key challenges in our industry. You are passionate about the application of software engineering practices and their advanced application to data science to drive insights and value within a business-centric environment.

The Opportunity:

• Drives End-to-End Service AI Applications : Oversees the full lifecycle of applications that support service performance, from initial design to the deployment of tools used by the RSN organization.

• Integrate Service Ecosystems : Design and deploy production-grade APIs and interfaces that connect AI insights with core service systems like Salesforce® FSM and SAP®.

• Engineers for the Full Stack : Designs, crafts, and deploys production-grade AI solutions using Python (Flask/FastAPI), SQL, and modern front-end frameworks (like React or Vue.js with JavaScript). This includes building backend APIs, managing data pipelines as needed, and creating interactive user interfaces.

• Implements and Manages MLOps Infrastructure : Establishes and maintains the CI/CD/CT (Continuous Integration/Delivery/Training) pipelines necessary for automating the deployment, monitoring, and retraining of machine learning models in a cloud environment.

• Champions Service Intelligence Architecture : Ensures all solutions are built with scalability, reliability, and security in mind. Promotes best practices in version control (Git), containerization (Docker and Kubernetes), and cloud services (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

• Agile Prototyping for Service Excellence : Use agile methodologies to rapidly prototype and iterate on solutions based on feedback from service stakeholders and field leadership.

• Regulatory Alignment : Ensure all developed code and documentation adhere to the Roche Quality Management System (QMS) and regulatory standards such as ISO 13485

• Leads with Change Agility : Acts as a catalyst for transitioning the team from a project-based support function to a product-driven AI platform team, driving the adoption of new technologies from IT, and methodologies in a positive manner.

Who You Are:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or other related field or equivalent work experience

• 7 years experience with previous business application system implementations / ERP system configuration or AI or data science

The Position
Pathology Solutions Specialist

The Opportunity:

The Pathology Solutions Specialist in Tissue Diagnostics is responsible for protecting and growing the High Medical Value IHC portfolio and research market share. Implements sales plans designed to achieve established revenue and financial goals. Knows and understands the Advanced Staining competitive landscape including product, sales tools, and pricing for Roche Pathology Lab and all competitors. Leverages current business relationships to maintain and grow current customer base. Works in coordination with Account Managers and Strategic Account Managers to call on perspective and current customers. Works closely with Account Managers to sell capital equipment to most prominent health systems, hospitals and reference laboratories, either via capital expenditures or bundling with reagents.

Has a complete knowledge of company products and services, and is viewed as an expert by the company and customers. May be tasked with sales of new or strategic products. Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Networks with internal and external personnel in their own area of expertise. Focuses on critical, large, complex, high-visibility, strategic or tactically important accounts. Acts independently to determine methods and procedures on new or special assignments.

Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

This is a field based role - the territory includes: OH, PA & WV . Candidate must reside within 50 miles of the territory border. Relocation benefits are not provided for this role.

Job Facts:

• Assumes an active leadership role during the development and implementation of capital equipment sales strategies to attain assigned sales objectives. Intimacy with company and competitive market dynamics.

• Provides professional leadership in planning, organizing, and controlling balanced sales growth, continued account penetration, and customer satisfaction.

• Utilizes strong product/market knowledge and sales experience to manage complex sales and resolve customer questions and concerns.

• Continuously builds knowledge of current industry trends, competitive information, and industry/technical knowledge and shares with other Roche colleagues.

• Responsible for the effective management of sales funnel by identification of opportunities and the creation and implementation of solutions.

• Establishes and works with Account Managers and Strategic Account Managers to build strong client relationships that allow for growth, profitability and predictability. Communicates with other relevant Roche functions to ensure needed sales support and delivery of programs/products.

• Effectively utilizes internal sales and operations support teams to advance the sale.

Who You Are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

• You hold 5+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience required with the highest level of sales proficiency

Preferred:

• PhD or Master's Degree

• Expertise in competitive business and instrumentation, reimbursement landscape, and all other product lines.

• Leadership presence and business acumen with an understanding of the IHC and Anatomic Pathology laboratory landscape and the ability to create/drive solutions with others.

• Proven success in previou

Agisce in modo indipendente per determinare i metodi e le procedure per i nuovi o speciali incarichi. È responsabile del mantenimento e dell miglioramento continuo del sistema di qualità e dell'ottenimento degli obiettivi di qualità attraverso le azioni quotidiane. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Team Lead Clinical Trial Payment Operations
Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions
Hyderabad

The Team Lead Clinical Trail Payment Operations will be responsible for overseeing and coordinating the payment-related activities for our Clinical Studies within the team. This includes managing the team, ensuring efficient operations, handling people management tasks, and cultivating relationships with stakeholders and customers. The role demands a combination of payment expertise and leadership competencies to drive the team's performance and meet organizational standards and objectives.

Your Opportunity

Team Coordination and Management:

• Coordinate and manage the team’s daily activities in payment processing and related tasks

• Perform people management activities, including onboarding, offboarding, training, and development of team members

• Facilitate regular team meetings to ensure smooth communication and collaboration

• Provide functional expertise and guidance to the team, sharing knowledge and best practices

Payment Processing Activities:

• Oversee the regional processing of payments, ensuring accuracy and compliance with company policies

• Monitor payment-related KPIs, quality, and budget adherence

• Track performance, compliance, costs, and deviations in payment processes

• Actively participate in the day-to-day operations of payment processing

Stakeholder and Relationship Management:

• Develop and manage key stakeholder relationships to ensure satisfaction and alignment with business objectives

• Act as a primary point of contact for stakeholder inquiries and concerns

• Manage outsourcing activities and relationships with external service providers

Regulatory and Compliance:

• Ensure all payment activities are in line with legal, regulatory, and company standards and codes of practice

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of relevant regulations and compliance requirements

• Implement and monitor compliance measures within the team

Who You Are:

• The ideal candidate should be motivated and skilled professional with a solid background in financial processes, particularly in calculating and processing complex payments and team leadership

• You should thrive in dynamic environments, have exceptional problem-solving abilities, and possess a strong commitment to both team and stakeholder satisfaction

• You should bring a collaborative approach, excellent communication skills, and a validated track record of leadership success

• You are someone who holds University degree in Finance, Accounting, or related business discipline with 2-3 years of team management and practical experience in payment processing or related financial activities

• Proficiency in SAP, MDMS, and other approval tools

Leadership Competencies:

• Strong leadership skills with demonstrated success in team coordination and stakeholder management. Alternatively, you are an identified talent showing high growth potential in leadership and are ready to take the first steps into leadership

• Proven ability to provide guidance and support to team members in a dynamic and fast-paced environment

• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, and a growth mindset

Skills:

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Proficiency in English

• Ability to interpret and analyze payment-related data and performance metrics

• Strong organizational and multitasking abilities

Personal Attributes:

• Agile mindset to adapt to changing circumstances and handle ambiguou

jobs.description:

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Product Manager, Neurology & Core IA

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Who We Are:
Core Lab Marketing is a place for passionate leaders who are determined to make an impact for patients, customers and for the organization. We aspire to deliver better health outcomes for all patients by providing comprehensive solutions to Core Laboratories supporting Integrated Health Networks and Reference Labs. We are committed to creating a positive culture and focus on the values of the team and its members. We take responsibility for our actions and deliver on our commitments, while also prioritizing work/life balance to ensure everyone thrives both personally and professionally. The team emphasizes learning and development and we empower team members to speak openly.

We represent Roche’s commitment to lead with science in order to develop transformational solutions that help improve patient outcomes and simplify lab operations. As the Core Lab market leader in the US, the Core Lab team excels at the identification, commercialization and the full end-to-end management of reagent solutions that enable our customers to deliver on their overarching priorities, including improving patient outcomes.

The Opportunity:
We are seeking an experienced professional who is driven by deep customer insights and strong business acumen to bring value to laboratorians, physicians, and patients in the Neurology and Core Immunoassay portfolios - drivers of over $300M in annual revenue. jobs.title: Estágio em Finanças - Propostas Comerciais
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Estagiário(a) de Finanças e Propostas Comerciais você terá a oportunidade de criar impacto sendo essencial para o time, auxiliando na criação, revisão e envio das propostas comerciais da afiliada. Se você tem vontade de aprender e possui os requisitos necessários, junte-se a nós para aprimorar-se continuamente em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo.

A Oportunidade:

• Você elabora e acompanha as propostas comerciais para a equipe de Diagnóstica, oferecendo uma visão financeira estratégica para as demandas dos clientes.

• Você auxilia na revisão, no acompanhamento e no controle das propostas com os clientes, contribuindo ativamente para o cumprimento das cláusulas financeiras estabelecidas.

• Você gerencia stakeholders de diferentes áreas e realiza conexões com marketing, vendas e finanças para garantir a execução das estratégias comerciais da companhia.

• Você apoia o uso de ferramentas para o gerenciamento e acompanhamento contínuo dos indicadores gerenciais (KPIs).

• Você identifica oportunidades de melhoria nos processos diários e atua diretamente nas suas implementações.

• Você colabora com a equipe de pricing na execução, análise e definição das estratégias de precificação para produtos e serviços.

• Você suporta o time de finanças na preparação das análises de rentabilidade e de preços.

• Você prepara apresentações e mantém uma interface clara e contínua com a equipe de liderança.

Quem você é:

• Você possui habilidade colaborativa, gosta de lidar com pessoas, tem comunicação clara e assertiva e se adapta facilmente a contextos de mudanças.

• Você demonstra agilidade no aprendizado, foco e organização nas atividades processuais, e proatividade para buscar melhorias.

• Você está cursando o Ensino Superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas (a partir do 2º ano de formação).

• Você possui forte habilidade analítica, facilidade com números e dados, e extrema atenção aos detalhes.

• Você tem conhecimento intermediário em Excel (tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas, etc.) e valoriza o trabalho em equipe em seu dia a dia.

Diferenciais:

• Você tem conhecimento prático em ferramentas de análise de dados (Power BI, SQL, Python, R).

• Você possui nível de inglês intermediário ou avançado para interações corporativas.

Benefícios de recolocação não estão disponíveis para esta vaga.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: New Account Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Impacto sostenible
Nuestra responsabilidad va más allá de innovar. Contribuyes a soluciones que responden a los desafíos más urgentes de la salud mientras reducimos nuestro impacto en el planeta. Juntos construimos un entorno laboral más sano, una sociedad más justa y un futuro mejor para las próximas generaciones.

La Oportunidad
En Roche Diagnóstica buscamos un/a New Account Manager en Lima, Perú, con la misión de conquistar nuevas cuentas y expandir el acceso de más pacientes a soluciones médicas de alta calidad. A través de propuestas de valor disruptivas y modelos comerciales innovadores, serás el motor que impulse soluciones integradas en beneficio de los pacientes, el sistema de salud y la sostenibilidad de nuestra compañía.

Responsabilidades:

• Estrategia y análisis de mercado: Evaluar el potencial del mercado, prospectar y segmentar clientes para diseñar estrategias de conquista personalizadas junto a los squads de trabajo.

• Liderazgo de propuestas de valor: Liderar la creación y ejecución de ofertas comerciales integradas que sumen consultoría, soluciones digitales, marketing y disease management .

• Crecimiento de negocio y Market Share: Identificar, desarrollar y cerrar oportunidades de negocio incremental, enfocándose en ganar cuentas de la competencia y expandir la participación de mercado.

• Modelos de negocio innovadores: Colaborar en la implementación de nuevas soluciones de valor y modelos comerciales adaptados a las necesidades específicas del cliente.

• Gestión de visitas clave: Planificar y ejecutar visitas de venta estratégicas bajo el enfoque One Roche Solutions , coordinando con otros roles para unificar mensajes clave y ofertas diferenciadoras.

• Gestión integral de ofertas: Supervisar la preparación de propuestas y ofertas comerciales en conjunto con el equipo de contratos para asegurar cierres exitosos.

• Coordinación interna y campo: Liderar la interacción de los squads de trabajo y coordinar con todas las áreas de la compañía para asegurar la firma del contrato, manteniendo cobertura nacional mediante visitas de campo.

Quién eres:

• Título de 3er nivel en ciencias de la salud, negocios, marketing o similar es requerido, Título de 4to nivel de preferencia y nivel medio-alto de idioma inglés.

• Experiencia de 3 años en la industria de la salud, específicamente en diagnóstico. Experiencia de 3 años en funciones comerciales y apertura de nuevos clientes.

• Conocimiento de la dinámica y los participantes del mercado de IVD y de la industria: la problemática y soluciones para el laboratorio. Amplio conocimiento de la tecnología y marcas de los competidores.

• Conocimiento e interés de las áreas analíticas de laboratorio y sus tendencias y actualizaciones.

Beneficios de reubicación no disponibles para este puesto de trabajo.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Commercial Support Expert (CRM Product Manager)

titleByLocale.it: Esperto di supporto commerciale (CRM Product Manager)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:

As a Commercial Support Expert (CRM Product Manager) , you will provide hands-on execution support for ongoing CRM product activities. Your role is critical in bridging the gap between business strategy and technical execution, focusing on day-to-day support by translating complex business needs into functional requirements and ensuring a healthy, prioritized product backlog.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Product & Delivery Support: Assist with requirements clarification and documentation, creating detailed user stories with clear use cases and acceptance criteria. You will develop business process flow documents and maintain product backlogs and JIRA stories.

• Operational & BAU Support: Support ongoing CRM enhancements, minor configuration requests, and release activities—including release notes and deployment readiness. You will help track dependencies and risks across workstreams and support the triage of requests from business stakeholders.

• Cross-Functional Coordination: Serve as a key point of contact between CRM operations, developers, QA teams, and vendors. You will participate in agile ceremonies (stand-ups, grooming, sprint reviews) and maintain project documentation in Confluence and JIRA.

• Quality & Testing: Support SQA and UAT planning, coordination, and defect tracking to ensure high-quality delivery.

• Data & Reporting: Assist with basic CRM reporting needs and validate data outputs, ensuring all documentation aligns with necessary compliance and audit requirements.

Who you are:
You are a highly organized professional with strong communication skills, capable of working in a fast-paced, matrixed environment to turn business vision into technical reality.
Requirements and Qualifications:

• Education: University degree in Business, Information Technology, or a related field.

• Experience: 5+ years of experience supporting Veeva CRM platform ideally within the Life Sciences, Commercial, or Medical sectors.

• Technical Skills: Strong Product Management expertise with experience writing functional requirements and user stories.

• Hands-on experience with JIRA and Confluence .

• Deep familiarity with Agile / Scrum delivery models.

• Competencies: Ability to translate business needs into technical specifications.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and dependencies.

• A proactive approach to problem-solving and backlog hygiene.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Direct Sales Manager- Diagnostics Roche
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It's what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That's what ma kes us Roche.
This role is based in the Diagnostics division where we focus on sustaining and increasing market share in existing accounts through high-value medical solutions. We operate with a customer-centric and holistic approach, delivering innovative proposals to our key stakeholders, clients, and patients to drive long-term business growth and sustainability.

The Opportunity

As the Direct Sales Manager, your main focus will be to achieve commercial objectives by innovating, co-creating, and identifying new business opportunities. You will build deep relationships with key accounts to implement comprehensive, high-value medical diagnostic solutions.

• You plan and execute commercial growth strategies in existing and new markets by interpreting data and utilizing market insights.

• You build and maintain strategic networking relationships with high-level account stakeholders, including C-level executives, presidents, financial directors, medical directors, and laboratory heads.

• You monitor and manage institutional budgets, expenditures, and revenues to protect and maximize organizational profitability.

• You design effective commercial strategies, tailored sales presentations, and communication action plans that address specific client needs.

• You collaborate cross-functionally with internal departments such as Logistics, Production, and Finance to ensure solutions align with operational capabilities.

• You analyze the competitive landscape, target markets, and public/private market data to identify differentiators and increase overall market share.

• You manage and lead engagement spaces with potential new clients to expand relationships and secure new business opportunities.

• You negotiate commercial conditions, evaluate operational or legal risks, and implement continuous improvement actions to maximize customer satisfaction.

​
Who you are

• You hold a University Degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Health Sciences, Business Administration, or a related field.

• You possess years of professional experience within the Diagnostic Industry.

• You possess years of successful experience in commercial, sales management, or marketing functions & p roven track record of leading high-performance teams.

• You have a strong strategic and systemic vision, with the proven ability to interpret complex market data and translate it into successful action plans.

• You demonstrate excellent interpersonal and communication skills, allowing you to easily build environments of trust and manage stress effectively.

• You are highly motivated, adaptive to change, resilient, and thrive in an Agile and collaborative team environment.

• Advanced English and Spanish are required for this role.

Location: Based in Quito, Ecuador.
Reporting to: Commercial Director of Diagnostics.
